english: Introduction–A Collection of Heists
zh_tw: 導言：劫案集

english: {@i Keys from the Golden Vault} presents thirteen Dungeons & Dragons adventures that feature heists. In each adventure, the characters receive a mission, plan the job, execute their plan, and try to escape the scene. You can run each heist as a standalone adventure or as part of a larger campaign (see "{@area A Campaign of Heists|005|x}" later in this introduction). Each adventure can be adapted to take place in any campaign setting you wish.
zh_tw: {@i 金庫之鑰}提供了十三個以劫案為主題的《龍與地下城》冒險故事。在每個冒險中，角色們將接受任務、制定計劃、執行方案，並試圖逃離現場。你可以將每個劫案作為獨立的冒險來執行，也可以將其作為更大戰役的一部分（參見引言後面的"{@area 一場劫案行動|005|x}"）。每個冒險都可以根據你的意願改編為任何戰役設定。

english: A rogue rappels down the icy walls of Revel's End, a prison in the frozen north
zh_tw: 一個盜賊沿著瑞維爾盡頭的冰牆滑降，那是一個位於極北之地的監獄

english: Using the Adventures
zh_tw: 使用冒險

english: The Heist Adventures table summarizes the adventures in this anthology. Each adventure is designed for four to six characters of a particular level and adheres to the following narrative structure:
zh_tw: 《盜竊冒險》表格總結了這本選集中的冒險。每個冒險都設計為四到六名特定等級的角色，並遵循以下敘事結構：

english: Mission Briefing
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: The characters are recruited to undertake a specific job. In most cases, this involves procuring an object.
zh_tw: 角色們被招募去執行一個特定的任務。在大多數情況下，這涉及到獲取一個物品。

english: Plan the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃搶劫

english: The characters investigate the heist location, learn about the obstacles they need to overcome, and strategize about completing the job. Each adventure includes a way for the characters to create or obtain a map of the target location.
zh_tw: 角色們調查搶劫地點，瞭解他們需要克服的障礙，並策劃完成這項工作。每個冒險都包括一種方式，讓角色們能夠建立或獲得目標地點的地圖。

english: Execute the Heist
zh_tw: 執行搶劫

english: The characters enact their plans. Unforeseen complications often arise during this stage.
zh_tw: 角色們實施他們的計劃。在這個階段，往往會出現一些意料之外的複雜情況。

english: Conclude the Heist
zh_tw: 完成劫案

english: The characters' success determines their reward and how the story might progress beyond the main adventure.
zh_tw: 角色們的成功決定了他們的獎勵以及故事可能會如何超越主要冒險繼續發展。

english: These short adventures work best with players who enjoy the heist genre. In addition to thrills, drama, strategizing, and twists, each adventure includes opportunities for exploration, roleplaying, and combat.
zh_tw: 這些短小的冒險最適合那些喜歡搶劫題材的玩家。除了刺激、戲劇性、策略制定和情節轉折之外，每個冒險都包括了探索、角色扮演和戰鬥的機會。

english: Running the Adventures
zh_tw: 執行冒險

english: To run these adventures, you need the fifth edition core rulebooks ({@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, and {@book Monster Manual|MM}).
zh_tw: 為了執行這些冒險，你需要第五版核心規則書（{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}, {@book 城主指南|DMG}, 和 {@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}）。

english: Text that appears in a box like this is meant to be read aloud or paraphrased for the players when their characters first arrive at a location or under a specific circumstance, as described in the text.
zh_tw: 在這樣方框中的文段，是在玩家角色們第一次到達某地區或在特定情況時，為其讀出或解釋的內容。

english: When a creature's name appears in bold type, that's a visual cue pointing you to its stat block as a way of saying, "Hey, DM, get this creature's stat block ready. You're going to need it." If the stat block appears elsewhere, the text tells you so; otherwise, you can find the stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: 當一個生物的名字以粗體字出現時，這是一個視覺提示，指向它的統計塊，作為一種方式說：'嘿，DM，準備好這個生物的統計塊。你會需要它的。'如果統計塊出現在其他地方，文字會告訴你；否則，你可以在《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中找到統計塊。

english: Spells and equipment mentioned in the adventure are described in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Magic items are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} unless the adventure's text directs you to an item's description elsewhere.
zh_tw: 冒險中提到的法術和裝備在《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》中有描述。魔法物品在《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》中有描述，除非冒險文字指導您到其他地方檢視物品的描述。

english: Creating a Heist Crew
zh_tw: 組建盜竊團隊

english: This book's adventures require the characters to practice teamwork. Encourage your players to think of their characters as longtime associates or perhaps relatives so they feel tight-knit from the start.
zh_tw: 這本書的冒險要求角色們練習團隊合作。鼓勵你的玩家將他們的角色想象成長期合作伙伴或者可能是親戚，這樣他們從一開始就感覺緊密相連。

english: Similarly, ask your players to consider creating characters suited to undertaking heists. Combat prowess is less important when sneaking through a guarded complex, for example, whereas stealth, skill with locks, social skills, clever problem-solving, and versatile character abilities will shine.
zh_tw: 同樣，要求你的玩家們考慮建立適合執行盜竊任務的角色。例如，在潛入一個有守衛的建築群時，戰鬥能力不那麼重要，而潛行、解鎖技能、社交技能、聰明的解決問題能力和多面手角色能力將會大放異彩。

english: Well-outfitted characters are also more likely to succeed at these adventures. Equipment such as thieves' tools, rope, and a grappling hook might mean the difference between taking a shortcut to the objective and getting caught.
zh_tw: 裝備精良的角色在這些冒險中也更有可能成功。例如盜賊工具、繩索和抓鉤等裝備可能意味著在被抓住和找到通往目標的捷徑之間的區別。

english: Characters can accomplish these adventures' missions in multiple ways. As the Dungeon Master, reward creative thinking!
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過多種方式完成這些冒險任務。作為地下城主，獎勵創造性思維！

english: A Campaign of Heists
zh_tw: 一場劫案行動

english: You can combine the adventures in this book to form a campaign. Each adventure would be an episode in the campaign, with you filling in the details of the characters' stories between jobs.
zh_tw: 你可以將這本書中的冒險組合起來形成一個戰役。每個冒險將是戰役中的一集，由你來填充角色在任務之間的故事細節。

english: If you go this route, encourage the players to create a crack team and a base of operations, a supporting cast of allies, and other hallmarks of a heist crew. Have your group decide on these details before play begins so the adventures progress seamlessly.
zh_tw: 如果你選擇這條路線，鼓勵玩家們建立一個精英團隊和行動基地，一支支援性的盟友陣容，以及其他搶劫團隊的標誌。在你的團隊開始遊戲之前決定這些細節，以便冒險能夠無縫進行。

english: To ensure the characters are always prepared for their next heist, make sure their level matches the heist's level, as shown in the Heist Adventures table. For example, the characters should be 2nd level before undertaking "The Stygian Gambit."
zh_tw: 為確保角色們總是為下一次盜竊做好準備，請確保他們的等級與盜竊任務的等級相匹配，如盜竊冒險表格所示。例如，在進行《冥河的謀略》之前，角色們應該是2級。

english: The Golden Vault
zh_tw: 金庫

english: A heist crew might have a patron organization that hires the characters to undertake these adventures. If you wish to use such an organization, consider the Golden Vault.
zh_tw: 劫案團隊可能有一個贊助組織僱傭角色們進行這些冒險。如果你希望使用這樣的組織，可以考慮金庫。

english: Rumored to be associated with metallic dragons, the Golden Vault is a secretive organization that has its base on one of the good-aligned Outer Planes. Its membership and activities are almost impossible for outsiders to track, but those in the know are aware that the organization rights moral wrongs, supports virtuous underdogs, and handles delicate situations local authorities won't touch. The Golden Vault's motto reflects its primary motivation: "Do good, no matter the cost." Missions from the Golden Vault are often illegal, but they always support a just, moral cause.
zh_tw: 據傳與金屬龍有關，金庫是一個秘密組織，其基地位於善良陣營的外層位面之一。外人幾乎不可能追蹤其成員和活動，但知情者都知道該組織糾正道德錯誤，支援有德行的弱者，並處理當地權威不願觸及的微妙情況。金庫的座右銘反映了其主要動機：'行善，不論代價。'來自金庫的任務通常是非法的，但它們總是支援一個正義、道德的事業。

english: The Golden Vault's undercover operatives monitor adventuring groups from major cities on the Material Plane. An operative might be a priest, a scholar, a charity worker, a government liaison, a philanthropist, or any other upstanding local.
zh_tw: 金庫的臥底特工監視物質位面上主要城市的冒險團體。特工可能是牧師、學者、慈善工作者、政府聯絡人、慈善家或任何其他值得尊敬的當地人。

english: Once an adventuring group proves itself effective and virtuous, an operative approaches the characters to offer Golden Vault membership. Should the group accept, its members join the ranks of the Golden Vault, and the person who invited them becomes their handler for future missions. For an example of a handler, see the "{@area Meera Raheer|009|x}" section.
zh_tw: 一旦冒險團隊證明自己既有效又具有美德，一名特工就會接近角色們，提供金庫會員資格。如果團隊接受，其成員將加入金庫的行列，邀請他們的人將成為他們未來任務的負責人。有關負責人的例子，請參見"{@area 米拉·拉希爾|009|x}"部分。

english: If the characters get stuck, the Golden Vault can provide unexpected help. For instance, if the characters lack vital information needed for a heist, their handler might share a recent discovery. If the characters need special equipment, their handler might be able to obtain it for them, provided the equipment is readily available and not too expensive.
zh_tw: 如果角色們陷入困境，金庫可以提供意想不到的幫助。例如，如果角色們缺少搶劫所需的關鍵資訊，他們的聯絡人可能會分享最近的發現。如果角色們需要特殊裝備，他們的聯絡人可能能夠為他們獲得，前提是裝備容易獲得且價格合理。

english: If you decide to use the Golden Vault as the characters' patron organization, work with the players to determine what heroic or impressive deeds their characters performed in their backstories to gain the attention of the Golden Vault. Then improvise a roleplaying scene in which the characters meet their Golden Vault handler.
zh_tw: 如果你決定使用金庫作為角色的贊助組織，與玩家合作確定他們的角色在背景故事中完成了哪些英勇或令人印象深刻的事蹟，以吸引金庫的注意。然後即興創作一個角色扮演場景，其中角色們會見他們的金庫負責人。

english: Keys from the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 金庫之鑰

english: If the characters become Golden Vault operatives, they receive an ornate, key-operated music box from their handler. Each adventure in this book includes a "Using the Golden Vault" section, in which the Golden Vault dispatches a golden key to the group, usually via a hired courier. When the golden key is inserted into the characters' music box and turned, the box pops open and plays a message that assigns them a heist, provides basic details, and sets them on the right path. After the message plays, the box closes and the key vanishes.
zh_tw: 如果角色成為金庫的特工，他們會從他們的聯絡人那裡收到一個裝飾華麗的、用鑰匙操作的音樂盒。這本書中的每個冒險都包括一個"使用金庫"的部分，在這部分中，金庫會透過僱傭的信使向小組傳送一把金鑰匙。當金鑰匙插入角色的音樂盒並轉動時，盒子會彈開並播放一條訊息，這條訊息會指派他們一個搶劫任務，提供基本資訊，並將他們引向正確的道路。訊息播放完畢後，盒子關閉，鑰匙消失。

english: Heroes in the Shadows
zh_tw: 暗影中的英雄

english: Secrecy is paramount for the Golden Vault. To protect the organization, the characters' handler never provides more information than is absolutely necessary. Similarly, Golden Vault operatives are aware of only a handful of their fellow members. This compartmentalization ensures no one individual knows enough to jeopardize the organization at large.
zh_tw: 對於金庫來說，保密至關重要。為了保護組織，角色的聯絡人從不提供比絕對必要的更多資訊。同樣，金庫的特工們只知道少數幾個同伴的資訊。這種分割確保了沒有人知道足夠多的資訊來危及整個組織。

english: Should operatives be caught breaking the law while serving the Golden Vault, the organization does its best to protect them. It may pull strings to ensure members aren't incarcerated—or worse—depending on the organization's resources in the area.
zh_tw: 如果特工在為金庫服務期間被發現違法，組織會盡其所能保護他們。根據組織在該地區的資源，它可能會動用關係確保成員不會被監禁——或者更糟。

english: Meera Raheer
zh_tw: 米拉·拉希爾

english: {@creature Meera Raheer|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Meera Raheer|KftGV|米拉·拉希爾}

english: {@creature Meera Raheer|KftGV} (lawful good, human {@creature commoner}) is a Golden Vault handler you can assign to oversee your players' heist crew.
zh_tw: {@creature Meera Raheer|KftGV|米拉·拉希爾}（守序善良，人類{@creature commoner||平民})是一位金庫的聯絡人，您可以指派她來監督您玩家的搶劫團隊。

english: When Meera was young, her kindhearted and upstanding mothers served as city clerks. But when they began investigating financial irregularities, the unscrupulous mayor framed them for embezzlement to cover his own corruption. The only evidence of the Raheers' innocence was a packet of letters between the mayor and his conspirators. The letters were locked in the mayor's office.
zh_tw: 當米拉還年輕時，她心地善良、正直的母親們擔任城市文員。但當她們開始調查財務不規範時，不擇手段的市長為了掩蓋自己的腐敗，誣陷她們貪汙。拉希爾家族清白的唯一證據是市長與他的同謀者之間的一包信件。這些信件被鎖在市長的辦公室裡。

english: Luckily for the Raheers, a crew of Golden Vault operatives infiltrated city hall, retrieved the letters, and revealed the mayor's crimes. The Raheers kept fighting against government corruption, and Meera has followed in her parents' footsteps, continuing their anti-corruption work by becoming a city's clerk and a member of the Golden Vault.
zh_tw: 幸運的是，對於拉希爾家族來說，一群金庫特工潛入了市政廳，取回了信件，並揭露了市長的罪行。拉希爾家族繼續與政府腐敗作鬥爭，米拉也追隨了她父母的足跡，透過成為一名城市的職員和金庫的成員，繼續他們的反腐敗工作。

english: Meera lives and breathes city protocols, procedures, and statutes. She also understands that sometimes doing the right thing means operating outside the law.
zh_tw: 米拉生活和呼吸著城市的協議、程式和法規。她也明白，有時做正確的事情意味著要在法律之外行事。

english: Heist Complications
zh_tw: 搶劫複雜情況

english: Unforeseen complications are an iconic aspect of heist narratives. Whether they take the form of a rival crew appearing out of nowhere or a treasure that turns out to be fake, complications ratchet up the tension and require the characters to think on their feet.
zh_tw: 不可預見的複雜情況是搶劫敘事中的一個標誌性方面。無論是突然出現的競爭對手團隊，還是發現財寶是假的，這些複雜情況都增加了緊張感，並要求角色們即興思考。

english: If you want to challenge your players, consider adding one of the complications below to any of this book's adventures.
zh_tw: 如果你想挑戰你的玩家，考慮在這本書的任何冒險中新增下面的複雜情況之一。

english: The Moving MacGuffin
zh_tw: 移動的麥高芬

english: Many of this book's heists involve procuring a MacGuffin. Part of preparing for these heists is determining where the MacGuffin in question is located.
zh_tw: 這本書中的許多劫案都涉及到獲取一個麥高芬。為這些劫案做準備的一部分是確定所討論的麥高芬位於何處。

english: If the characters are having too easy of a time finding the MacGuffin, consider shifting its location to another place that makes sense. Or consider revealing that the MacGuffin is a fake, and the real prize is still nearby. The characters should still be able to determine where it's really located.
zh_tw: 如果角色們發現尋找麥高芬太容易了，可以考慮將其位置轉移到另一個合理的地點。或者考慮揭示麥高芬是假的，而真正的獎品仍然在附近。角色們應該仍然能夠確定它真正的位置。

english: For example, in "{@adventure The Murkmire Malevolence|KftGV|1}," perhaps the MacGuffin is no longer in the Gemstone Wing and is being stored in the museum's attic overnight. The characters could learn this detail by reading notes they discover in the curator's office or by questioning one of the museum guards.
zh_tw: 例如，在"{@adventure 穆克米爾的邪惡|KftGV|1}"中，也許麥高芬不再存放在寶石翼，而是在博物館的閣樓上過夜。角色們可以透過閱讀他們在館長的辦公室裡發現的筆記，或者透過詢問博物館的一名警衛來瞭解這個細節。

english: If you use the moving MacGuffin complication, be careful of moving the MacGuffin more than once. Having trouble locating the object of the heist could unduly frustrate your players.
zh_tw: 如果你使用移動的麥高芬複雜情況，請小心不要多次移動麥高芬。如果難以找到搶劫的物件，可能會不必要地讓你的玩家感到沮喪。

english: Rival Crew
zh_tw: 敵對團隊

english: A rival crew vying for the same goal can increase the pressure on the characters. Regardless of your players' goal, once another crew appears, the adventure becomes a race to accomplish the objective first.
zh_tw: 一個爭奪同一目標的對手團隊可以增加角色們的壓力。不管你的玩家目標是什麼，一旦另一個團隊出現，冒險就變成了一場首先完成目標的競賽。

english: You can add a rival crew to an adventure at any time. When you do, make it clear to the characters that they have competition. The characters might see evidence of their rivals, such as an alarm that has already been disabled or an {@condition incapacitated} guard. At some point, the characters might even catch their rivals trying to steal the adventure's MacGuffin from right under their noses!
zh_tw: 你可以隨時在冒險中增加一個競爭團隊。當你這樣做時，要向角色們明確表示他們有競爭對手。角色們可能會看到對手的證據，比如已經被解除的警報或被{@condition incapacitated||無力}的警衛。在某個時候，角色們甚至可能抓到他們的對手正試圖在他們眼皮底下偷走冒險的麥高芬！

english: {@b Gregir Fendelsohn} (lawful neutral human) is loyal and passionate. He insists on the crew getting paid no matter what.

english: {@b Sabrina "Kill More" Kilgore} (chaotic neutral human) is a brash, violent woman who loves thrills and sweets.
zh_tw: {@b 薩布麗娜"殺更多"·基爾戈爾}（混亂中立人類）是一個魯莽、暴力的女人，她喜歡刺激和甜食。

english: {@b Torgja Stonecrusher} (chaotic neutral dwarf) has a jovial, happy-go-lucky nature that belies her ruthlessness.
zh_tw: {@b 託格雅·石碎}（混亂中立矮人）擁有一個愉快、無憂無慮的性格，這掩蓋了她的無情。

english: {@b Tosh Starling} (neutral orc) is loquacious but always focused on his objective. He takes pride in his meticulously groomed appearance.
zh_tw: {@b 託什·星雀} 非常健談，但總是專注於他的目標。他為自己的精心打理的外表感到自豪。

english: Decide whether the rival crew is ahead of or behind the characters in pursuit of the objective. If either would make sense for your game, roll a {@dice d20}. On an even result, the rivals are closer to achieving the objective than the characters. On an odd result, the rivals are nipping at the characters' heels.
zh_tw: 決定敵對團隊是在角色之前還是之後追求目標。如果兩者中的任何一個對您的遊戲有意義，請擲一個{@dice d20}骰子。如果是偶數結果，敵對團隊比角色更接近實現目標。如果是奇數結果，敵對團隊正緊追角色的腳跟。

english: Golden Vault Seal
zh_tw: 金庫封印

english: Pay attention to how the characters respond to their rivals' presence. If the characters take pains to thwart trailing rivals or catch leading rivals, the characters should achieve their objective without further complication. If the characters ignore the rival crew, the rivals should achieve the objective first. Then it's up to the characters to chase their rivals and try to salvage the mission.
zh_tw: 注意角色對對手存在的反應。如果角色努力挫敗追蹤的對手或抓住領先的對手，角色應該能夠實現他們的目標而沒有進一步的複雜情況。如果角色忽視了對手團隊，對手應該首先實現目標。然後角色需要追趕他們的對手，並嘗試挽救任務。

english: Always give the characters the opportunity to confront rivals who have achieved the objective first. This might lead to a negotiation scene or a fight.
zh_tw: 總是給角色機會去面對那些首先達成目標的對手。這可能會導致談判場景或戰鬥。

zh_tw: 競爭對手團隊的動機

english: A rival crew might pursue the characters' objective for a variety of reasons. Greed might motivate rivals to steal a valuable objective, or they might have deep emotional involvement in the story.
zh_tw: 敵對團隊可能出於多種原因追求角色的目標。貪婪可能驅使對手偷取有價值的目標，或者他們可能在故事中有深刻的情感參與。

english: A rival crew might be working at the behest of a patron. Perhaps an evil guild leader has hired the rivals to steal the MacGuffin. If the characters aren't working for the Golden Vault, perhaps the rivals are—and they might try to recruit the characters to their cause.
zh_tw: 一個對手團隊可能是在某個贊助人的指示下工作。也許一個邪惡的公會領袖僱傭了對手去偷取麥高芬。如果角色們不是為金庫工作，也許對手是——並且他們可能會試圖招募角色加入他們的事業。

english: The Murkmire Malevolence
zh_tw: 穆克米爾的邪惡

english: {@i An Adventure for 1st-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合1級角色的冒險}

english: Unbeknownst to anyone but a disgraced academic, the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History is in grave danger. Archaeologists at a nearby dig site recently unearthed a curiosity: the Murkmire Stone. This object is actually an eldritch creature's egg, and it's about to hatch. The characters must infiltrate the museum, steal the egg, and return it to {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV} to be neutralized before it releases an eldritch horror.
zh_tw: 除了一個聲名狼藉的學者外，沒有人知道瓦爾肯布洛夫自然歷史博物館正處於嚴重的危險之中。附近挖掘現場的考古學家最近發現了一件稀奇之物：穆克米爾石。這個物體實際上是一個古老生物的蛋，而且即將孵化。角色們必須潛入博物館，偷走這個蛋，並將其交給{@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV|卡西·丹內爾博士}以在它釋放出古老恐怖之前進行中和。

english: Adventurers navigate around one of the more fearsome exhibits in the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History
zh_tw: 冒險者們在瓦爾肯布盧夫自然歷史博物館中避開了其中一個更令人畏懼的展品。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV}, a brilliant academic, long ago learned to hide her interest in the occult. She instead built a career gaining expertise in the peoples and cultures of the region surrounding Varkenbluff, continuing her occult research in secret. By age twenty-four, Dr. Dannell had earned her doctorate in anthropology from Varkenbluff University, a prestigious institution in her home city. Her ability to connect local archaeological objects with their cultural context was unrivaled, so after her graduation, Dr. Dannell became a Varkenbluff faculty member and field scientist, accompanying the university's archaeology crews on digs in the area.
zh_tw: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV|卡西·丹內爾博士}是一位傑出的學者，早已學會隱藏自己對神秘學的興趣。她以研究瓦肯布盧夫周邊地區的民族與文化建立學術生涯，私下則繼續神秘學研究。二十四歲時，丹內爾博士已取得家鄉名校瓦肯布盧夫大學的人類學博士學位。她將當地考古文物與其文化背景連結起來的能力無人能及，因此畢業後便留校任教，並擔任田野研究員，隨大學考古隊在當地進行發掘。

english: On a recent expedition into the nearby Murkmire, the archaeologists unearthed a strange object. Light green, opaque, and with a gemstone-like sheen, this ovoid stone was covered in strange furrows. The stone seemed ritualistic in nature, but it matched no recorded historical practices, and no one could identify its composition. The more Dr. Dannell studied it, the more she became convinced this object, which the archaeologists dubbed the Murkmire Stone, was not created by any known civilization—and might be dangerous.
zh_tw: 在最近一次對附近沼澤地的考察中，考古學家們發掘出了一個奇怪的物體。這個卵形的石頭呈淺綠色，不透明，帶有寶石般的光澤，表面覆蓋著奇怪的溝槽。這塊石頭看起來具有儀式性質，但它與任何記錄的歷史實踐都不相符，也沒有人能確定它的成分。丹內爾博士越是研究它，就越確信這個被考古學家稱為沼澤地之石的物體不是由任何已知文明創造的——而且可能是危險的。

english: Dr. Dannell tried to convince the dig's archaeologists to isolate the Murkmire Stone until she could learn more about it, but word of the discovery spread quickly. When the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History offered a generous price for the stone, it was soon whisked from the dig site to the museum.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士試圖說服挖掘現場的考古學家們將穆克米爾石隔離起來，直到她能瞭解更多關於它的事情，但發現的訊息很快就傳開了。當瓦爾肯布盧夫自然歷史博物館為這塊石頭提供了一個慷慨的價格時，它很快就從挖掘現場被帶到了博物館。

english: Dr. Dannell continued to research the strange stone. Her concern turned to dread when she found descriptions of similar objects in her occult tomes. These objects were, in fact, the eggs of eldritch creatures. She learned that such eggs lay dormant for generations, but once the eggs are unearthed, the creatures within rapidly develop and hatch. The resulting creatures are ravenous for raw meat and grow exponentially as they feed, eventually overwhelming entire villages. The eggs are nearly indestructible, but the tomes claim encasing them in crystal can neutralize them.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士繼續研究這塊奇怪的石頭。當她在她的神秘典籍中找到類似物體的描述時，她的擔憂變成了恐懼。這些物體實際上就是古老生物的蛋。她瞭解到，這樣的蛋會休眠數代人，但一旦被挖掘出來，蛋內的生物會迅速發育並孵化。孵化出的生物對生肉有著極大的渴望，並且隨著進食會呈指數級增長，最終壓倒整個村莊。這些蛋幾乎是不可摧毀的，但典籍上聲稱將它們包裹在水晶中可以中和它們。

english: According to Dr. Dannell's research, the Murkmire Stone is due to hatch in a matter of days. She frantically presented her findings to the university's administrators, who deemed her work pseudoscience and refused to interfere with the museum's upcoming exhibition of the Murkmire Stone. Desperate, Dr. Dannell snuck into the museum after hours and tried to steal the stone, but she was caught. The university disavowed her actions and fired her. With mere hours left in the Murkmire Stone's gestation period, Dr. Dannell is nearly out of options.
zh_tw: 根據丹內爾博士的研究，穆克米爾石將在幾天內孵化。她急切地向大學的行政人員展示了她的發現，但行政人員認為她的工作是偽科學，並拒絕幹預即將到來的穆克米爾石博物館展覽。絕望之下，丹內爾博士在閉館後潛入博物館試圖偷走石頭，但她被抓住了。大學否認了她的行為並將她解僱。穆克米爾石的孵化期只剩下幾個小時，丹內爾博士幾乎無計可施。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. The Golden Vault has learned that the egg of an eldritch horror has been mistaken for a historical object and is about to go on display at the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History. The anthropologist {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV} tried to warn officials about this egg, known as the Murkmire Stone, but none believed her. We do, and we know that if this egg hatches, many will die—or worse. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to infiltrate the museum, steal the egg, and return it to Dr. Dannell, who will neutralize it. There's no time to waste; the egg could hatch at any moment. Start by meeting with Dr. Dannell. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。金庫得知一個古老恐怖的卵被誤認為是一個歷史物品，並且即將在瓦爾肯布盧夫自然歷史博物館展出。人類學家{@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV|卡西·丹內爾博士}試圖警告官員們關於這個被稱為穆克米爾石的卵，但沒有人相信她。我們相信，並知道如果這個卵孵化，許多人將會死亡——或者更糟。這個任務，如果您選擇承擔，需要您潛入博物館，偷走卵，然後將其交給丹內爾博士，她將使其失效。沒有時間可以浪費；卵隨時可能孵化。首先與丹內爾博士會面。祝好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: A Cry for Help
zh_tw: 求救的呼聲

english: Time is short, and Dr. Dannell is desperate for help. She has exhausted all official channels and has turned to the characters.
zh_tw: 時間緊迫，丹內爾博士迫切需要幫助。她已經用盡了所有官方途徑，現在轉向了角色們。

english: The characters should have some connection to Dr. Dannell to explain why she reaches out to them. Have your players determine this connection before the adventure begins. Here are some possibilities:
zh_tw: 角色們應該與丹內爾博士有一些聯絡，以解釋她為什麼會聯絡他們。讓你的玩家在冒險開始前確定這種聯絡。以下是一些可能性：

english: Dannell Family Friend
zh_tw: 丹內爾家族的朋友

english: Dr. Dannell hails from a family of professors and scientists who have interacted significantly with Varkenbluff's intellectuals and nobility. One or more characters have rubbed shoulders with members of the Dannell clan, including Cassee.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士來自一個教授和科學家家庭，這個家庭與瓦肯布盧夫的知識分子和貴族有著顯著的交流。一個或多個角色與丹內爾家族的成員，包括卡西，有過接觸。

english: Museum Enthusiast
zh_tw: 博物館愛好者

english: Dr. Dannell's research is cited liberally in the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History's exhibits, and she regularly corresponds with fans of her work, including one or more characters who have earned her respect.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士的研究在瓦爾肯布洛夫自然歷史博物館的展覽中被廣泛引用，她經常與她作品的粉絲通訊，包括一個或多個贏得了她尊重的角色。

english: Varkenbluff University Student
zh_tw: 瓦肯布盧夫大學學生

english: Dr. Dannell has taught numerous anthropology and history classes attended by one or more characters and is impressed with their occult acumen.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士教授過許多人類學和歷史課程，這些課程至少有一兩個角色參加，並且對他們的神秘學敏銳印象深刻。

english: Once the characters have determined their connection to Dr. Dannell, read the following out loud to get this adventure started:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們確定了他們與丹內爾博士的聯絡，大聲讀出以下內容以開始這次冒險：

english: No matter your business this morning, a grave halfling messenger finds you and hands you a sealed parchment.
zh_tw: 不管你今天早上有什麼事，一個嚴肅的半身人信使找到你，遞給你一封密封的羊皮紙。

english: "Meet me at the Sage's Quill today as soon as you can," the missive reads. "I beg your help in a delicate matter whose importance cannot be overstated. I shall await you in a purple hooded robe."
zh_tw: "請儘快在今天到智者之羽筆與我見面，"信中寫道。"我懇求你們幫助解決一個極其重要的微妙問題。我將在一件紫色的帶兜帽長袍中等候你們。"

english: The note is signed, "{@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV}."
zh_tw: 這封信的簽名是"{@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV|卡西·丹內爾博士}。"

english: When you look up, the halfling has wandered off.
zh_tw: 當你抬起頭時，那個半身人已經走遠了。

english: The Clock Is Ticking
zh_tw: 時間在滴答作響

english: The Sage's Quill is a quiet, plush tavern that caters to the city's academics and intellectuals. It is located next to the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History, less than a mile from Varkenbluff University.
zh_tw: 智者之羽筆是一家安靜、豪華的酒館，迎合城市的學者和知識分子。它位於瓦爾肯布洛夫自然歷史博物館旁邊，距離瓦爾肯布洛夫大學不到一英里。

english: Once the characters arrive at the tavern, read the following out loud:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們到達酒館，請大聲讀出以下內容：

english: As you enter the Sage's Quill, soft light reveals mahogany furniture and luxurious carpets. A few genteel patrons murmur in the lounge. You soon notice a purple-hooded figure tucked into a corner booth.
zh_tw: 當您走進賢者之羽筆，柔和的光線映照出桃花心木傢俱和豪華的地毯。幾位文雅的顧客在休息室低聲交談。您很快注意到一個戴著紫色兜帽的身影蜷縮在角落的包廂裡。

english: Dr. Dannell gestures for you to sit. You notice lines of worry etched into her normally cheerful face.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士示意你坐下。你注意到她通常愉快的臉上刻滿了憂慮的線條。

english: Dr. Dannell (neutral good, human {@creature commoner}) has an Intelligence score of 18. She anxiously addresses the characters:
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士（中立善良，人類{@creature commoner||平民}）擁有18的智力值。她焦急地向角色們講話：

english: "Thank you for coming so quickly," she says. "A few weeks ago, I attended a dig in the Murkmire that unearthed a furrowed, light-green stone. I'll give you all the details, but the bottom line is that it isn't a stone at all—it's the egg of an eldritch horror. Moreover, my research indicates it'll hatch at midnight tonight.
zh_tw: "感謝你們這麼快就來了，"她說。"幾周前，我參加了穆克米爾的一次挖掘，出土了一塊有皺紋的淺綠色石頭。我會告訴你們所有的細節，但最重要的是那根本不是石頭——它是一隻古老恐怖生物的卵。而且，我的研究表明它將在今晚午夜孵化。"

english: "Trouble is, no one will listen to me. The university ignored me, and I was caught trying to steal the egg from the museum so I could contain it. Now I've been fired, the Murkmire Stone display at the museum opens tomorrow, and the egg is about to hatch.
zh_tw: "問題是，沒有人會聽我的。大學忽視了我，我試圖從博物館偷走那個蛋以便我能控制它，結果被抓住了。現在我被解僱了，博物館的沼澤地之石展覽明天就要開幕，而那個蛋即將孵化。"

english: "You've got to steal the Murkmire Stone and bring it back so I can save the city!"
zh_tw: "你們必須偷走穆克米爾石，並把它帶回來，這樣我才能拯救這座城市！"

english: What Dr. Dannell Knows
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士所知道的

english: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV|卡西·丹內爾博士}

english: If the characters talk with Dr. Dannell further, she gives more information about their mission and what she has learned about the stone:
zh_tw: 如果角色們繼續與丹內爾博士交談，她會提供更多關於他們任務的資訊以及她對這塊石頭的瞭解：

english: Getting the Egg
zh_tw: 獲取卵

english: The characters need to reconnoiter the museum in search of security measures, steal the Murkmire Stone at an opportune time (see "Stealing the Murkmire Stone" below), and deliver it to Dr. Dannell. She'll wait for them in an alley between the museum and the Sage's Quill.
zh_tw: 角色們需要偵察博物館，尋找安全措施，在適當的時機偷走沼澤地之石（見下文"偷取沼澤地之石"），並將其交給丹內爾博士。她會在博物館和智者之羽筆之間的小巷裡等待他們。

english: Traits of the Egg
zh_tw: 蛋的特徵

english: The Murkmire Stone can't be damaged or destroyed. Unearthing the egg triggered the rapid development of the creature within, which will soon be ready to hatch.
zh_tw: 穆克米爾石不能被損壞或摧毀。挖掘出這個卵觸發了內部生物的快速發育，它很快就要準備好孵化了。

english: Containing the Egg
zh_tw: 控制卵

english: At this point, the only way to keep the egg from hatching is to encase it in a specially prepared crystal container. Dr. Dannell created a crystal box for this purpose. She still needs to seal cracks in the crystal, so the characters can't take the box with them on the heist.
zh_tw: 在這一點上，阻止蛋孵化的唯一方法是將其封裝在一個特製的水晶容器中。丹內爾博士為此目的製作了一個水晶盒。她仍然需要密封水晶上的裂縫，所以角色們不能在搶劫時帶上這個盒子。

english: What's in the Egg
zh_tw: 蛋裡有什麼

english: Dr. Dannell's occult sources indicate an extremely dangerous creature will hatch from the egg unless it can be safely contained.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士的神秘學來源表明，除非這個卵能被安全地控制，否則將會孵化出一個極其危險的生物。

english: Stealing the Murkmire Stone
zh_tw: 偷取穆克米爾石

english: The Murkmire Stone is going on public display tomorrow at the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History, Dr. Dannell explains. A private gala celebrating the new exhibition will occur tonight in the museum's second-floor Gemstone Wing.
zh_tw: 穆克米爾石將在明天在瓦爾肯布洛夫自然歷史博物館公開展出，丹內爾博士解釋說。今晚在博物館二樓的寶石翼將舉行慶祝新展覽的私人晚會。

english: The characters aren't required to attend the gala, but doing so is the only way to glimpse the stone—and the security measures around it—before their heist. Dr. Dannell has secured a gala ticket for each character, and she gives them the tickets now.
zh_tw: 角色們不需要參加晚會，但參加晚會是他們在搶劫之前一窺石頭及其周圍安全措施的唯一方式。丹內爾博士為每個角色都獲得了一張晚會入場券，並且她現在就把票給了他們。

english: The characters must wear formal dress to the gala. Dr. Dannell has an appropriate outfit for each character in her heirloom {@item bag of holding}. Dr. Dannell lends the bag to the characters to store their adventuring gear, which they'll need while sneaking about the museum after hours.
zh_tw: 角色們必須穿著正式服裝參加晚會。丹內爾博士在她的傳家寶{@item bag of holding||次元袋}中為每個角色準備了合適的服裝。丹內爾博士將這個袋子借給角色們，用來存放他們的冒險裝備，這些裝備在他們在博物館閉館後潛行時會用到。

english: Dr. Dannell's Tools
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士的工具

english: Before her unsuccessful attempt to steal the Murkmire Stone, Dr. Dannell scouted the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History. She pretended to be a patron and recorded the museum's layout, filling in what she knows about nonpublic areas, such as the basement.
zh_tw: 在丹內爾博士未能成功偷取沼澤地之石之前，她偵察了瓦肯布盧夫自然歷史博物館。她假裝成一位贊助人，並記錄了博物館的佈局，填寫了她所知道的非公共區域，比如地下室。

english: Dannell's Map
zh_tw: 丹內爾的地圖

english: Dr. Dannell gives the characters her sketch of the museum (see map 1.1) before they leave for the gala. Although she's a brilliant academic, Dr. Dannell is neither an architect nor a burglar. Her map is based on the public map of the museum's exhibits, so it is incomplete and lacks information about the museum's security measures. For instance, Dr. Dannell knows the museum is outfitted with alarms after it closes to the public, but she doesn't know where those alarms are located or how to bypass them.
zh_tw: 在角色們前往晚會之前，丹內爾博士把她對博物館的草圖（見地圖1.1）給了他們。儘管她是一位傑出的學者，但丹內爾博士既不是建築師也不是竊賊。她的地圖基於博物館展覽的公共地圖，因此是不完整的，並且缺少有關博物館安全措施的資訊。例如，丹內爾博士知道博物館在對公眾關閉後裝有警報，但她不知道這些警報的位置或如何繞過它們。

english: Museum Staff
zh_tw: 博物館員工

english: Dr. Dannell knows that the museum has twelve guards and that the museum curator—the elf Alda Arkin—likely has a record of the areas the guards patrol at night. Dr. Dannell suspects this information is in Arkin's office, located somewhere in the eastern wing on the first floor. Arkin herself will attend the gala.
zh_tw: 丹內爾博士知道博物館有十二名警衛，並且博物館館長——精靈阿爾達·阿金——很可能有記錄警衛夜間巡邏區域的記錄。丹內爾博士懷疑這些資訊在阿金的辦公室裡，位於一樓東側的某個地方。阿金本人將參加晚會。

english: The Reward
zh_tw: 回報

english: For bringing the Murkmire Stone back to Dr. Dannell, she offers her {@item bag of holding} plus 20 gp per character. If a character succeeds on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, Dr. Dannell increases her offer to 30 gp per character.
zh_tw: 由於將暮澤石帶回了丹尼爾博士，她提供了她的{@item bag of holding||次元袋}，外加每個角色20金幣。如果一個角色成功透過{@dc 13}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，丹尼爾博士將她的出價提高到每個角色30金幣。

english: Map 1.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 1.1：玩家地圖

english: The Opening Gala
zh_tw: 開幕式

english: The private gala celebrating the opening of the Murkmire Stone exhibition begins at 6 p.m., and the museum closes at 8 p.m. There's enough time for characters to prepare before attending, including retrieving or procuring formal attire if they don't wish to wear the clothes Dr. Dannell provided. Weapons and visible armor are not permitted inside the museum and must be stashed in Dr. Dannell's {@item bag of holding} or elsewhere.
zh_tw: 慶祝穆克米爾石展覽開幕的私人晚會在下午6點開始，博物館在晚上8點關閉。角色們有足夠的時間在參加之前做準備，包括如果他們不想穿丹內爾博士提供的衣服，可以取回或購買正式服裝。武器和可見的盔甲是不允許帶進博物館的，必須存放在丹內爾博士的{@item bag of holding||次元袋}或其他地點。

english: Once the characters are ready to enter the museum, keep track of which character has the {@item bag of holding} that contains the group's adventuring gear. Then read the following aloud:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們準備好進入博物館，記下哪個角色有裝著小組冒險裝備的{@item bag of holding||次元袋}。然後大聲讀出以下內容：

english: The facade of the Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History boasts enormous columns and elegant archways hewn from marble. Cosmopolitan visitors bustle about the entrance, including some clad in sleek formal wear.
zh_tw: 瓦爾肯布拉夫自然歷史博物館的正面裝飾著由大理石鑿成的巨大圓柱與優雅拱門。衣著光鮮的都市訪客在入口處往來穿梭，其中不乏身著絲滑正裝的身影。

english: The museum is open to the public today; only the Gemstone Wing on the second floor is closed for the ticketed gala. The Murkmire Stone is ensconced in the Gemstone Wing.
zh_tw: 今天博物館對公眾開放；只有二樓的寶石翼因售票晚會而關閉。沼澤地之石就安置在寶石翼。

english: Scouting the Museum
zh_tw: 偵查博物館

english: The characters can explore the public areas of the museum while it's open. The entire museum is public except for its offices (areas {@area V5|044|x}–{@area V7|055|x}), basement ({@area area V16|06c|x}), and attic ({@area area V17|071|x}).
zh_tw: 角色們可以在博物館開放時探索其公共區域。除了辦公室（區域 {@area V5|044|x}–{@area V7|055|x}）、地下室（{@area 區域V16|06c|x}）和閣樓（{@area 區域V17|071|x}）之外，整個博物館都是對公眾開放的。

english: The characters have about two hours to prepare for their heist before the museum closes. If the characters don't immediately go to the Gemstone Wing ({@area area V13|064|x}), museum guards notice their formal attire and periodically suggest they do so.
zh_tw: 角色們大約有兩個小時的時間來準備他們的搶劫，然後博物館就會關閉。如果角色們沒有立即前往寶石翼（{@area 區域V13|064|x}），博物館的警衛會注意到他們的正式服裝，並定期建議他們這麼做。

english: Information relevant to the characters' heist plan is below. More information about specific areas of the museum is included in the "{@area Museum Locations|034|x}" section later.
zh_tw: 與角色們的搶劫計劃相關的資訊如下。關於博物館特定區域的更多資訊包含在稍後"{@area 博物館位置|034|x}"部分。

english: Entering Nonpublic Areas
zh_tw: 進入非公共區域

english: The doors to the museum's offices (areas V5–V7) and basement (area V16) are locked at all hours, as described in the "Interior Doors" subsection of the "{@area General Features|033|x}" section. Curator Alda Arkin, whom the characters might meet at the gala, carries a master key, while the museum's guards have keys that grant access to specific areas (see "{@area Circumventing Security|029|x}" and "{@area Curator Alda Arkin|02e|x}").
zh_tw: 博物館辦公室（區域 V5–V7）和地下室（區域 V16）的門始終上鎖，如"{@area 通用特徵|033|x}"部分中的"室內門"小節所述。角色在晚宴上可能會遇到的館長阿爾達·阿金攜帶一把萬能鑰匙，而博物館的警衛則擁有用於進入特定區域的鑰匙（參見"{@area 規避安全措施|029|x}"和"{@area 館長阿爾達·阿金|02e|x}"）。

english: Encountering Museum Guards
zh_tw: 遭遇博物館警衛

english: As long as the characters aren't caught entering a restricted area or causing a public incident, the museum's guards ignore them during the gala.
zh_tw: 只要角色們在晚會期間沒有被抓住進入限制區域或引起公共事件，博物館的警衛會忽視他們。

english: If one or more characters are spotted in a restricted area or cause a public incident, a {@creature guard} approaches them. Roll on the Museum Guards table to determine which guard arrives. Characters in formal dress are escorted to the Gemstone Wing, while characters who are improperly dressed for the occasion are told to leave the museum at once. If the characters protest, the guard becomes hostile and shouts for backup. At the end of each of the guard's turns, an additional {@dice 1d4} {@creature Guard||guards} arrive until all the museum guards are accounted for.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色被發現在限制區域或引起公共事件，一個{@creature guard||警衛}會接近他們。根據博物館警衛表來決定哪個警衛到達。穿著正裝的角色將被護送到寶石翼，而穿著不符合場合的角色將被告知立即離開博物館。如果角色抗議，警衛會變得敵對並大聲呼救。在警衛的每個回合結束時，額外的{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Guard||警衛}會到達，直到所有的博物館警衛都到齊。

english: Provided a guard hasn't shouted for backup, a character can take an action and use trickery or intimidation to convince a guard to leave. The character must make a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Persuasion}) check. If the check succeeds, the character convinces the guard to look for trouble elsewhere. If the check fails, the guard becomes hostile and behaves as described above, and the character can't repeat the check on that particular guard.
zh_tw: 如果守衛沒有大聲呼救尋求支援，角色可以採取行動並利用詭計或恐嚇來說服守衛離開。角色必須進行一個 {@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}、{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色說服守衛去其他地方尋找麻煩。如果檢定失敗，守衛變得敵對，並如上所述採取行動，且角色不能對那個特定守衛重複進行此檢定。

english: Museum Guards
zh_tw: 博物館警衛

english: Guard Description
zh_tw: 警衛描述

english: Darrison Blackwaters (neutral human), a former soldier who takes everything literally
zh_tw: 達裡森·布萊克沃特斯（中立人類），一個把一切都按字面意義理解的前士兵

english: Franceena Van Lictor (neutral good elf), a sarcastic newbie who respects history
zh_tw: 弗蘭希娜·范·利克托（中立善良精靈），一個諷刺的新手，尊重歷史

english: Billie Quartermile (lawful neutral halfling), who loves policy and procedure
zh_tw: 比利·夸特邁爾（守序中立半身人），熱愛政策和程式

english: Milanova Wumplestocking (lawful good gnome), who is very serious but loves a good pun
zh_tw: 米拉諾瓦·沃姆普斯托克（守序善良侏儒），她非常嚴肅但喜歡好的雙關語

english: Garent Millaneff (neutral evil human), a bully who loves money and bragging rights
zh_tw: 蓋倫特·米拉涅夫（中立邪惡人類），一個喜歡金錢和吹噓權的惡霸

english: Violet Pendergilt (neutral good human), a wistful dreamer who plans to quit soon
zh_tw: 維奧萊特·彭德吉爾特（中立善良人類），一個渴望夢想，計劃不久後辭職的夢想家

english: Sureth Dhanvhal (neutral human), a reserve soldier who is always pressed for time
zh_tw: 舒雷思·丹瓦爾（中立人類），一位總是時間緊迫的預備役士兵

english: Brendara Valindril (lawful neutral elf), a graduate student in history at the university
zh_tw: 布倫達拉·瓦林德里爾（守序中立精靈），大學歷史系的研究生

english: Grendor Battleaxe (neutral good dwarf), a wanderer paying off a debt to the museum
zh_tw: 格倫多·戰斧（中立善良矮人），一個為了償還博物館債務而流浪的人

english: Clark Jonathan Vanth (lawful good human), a young and naive individual
zh_tw: 克拉克·喬納森·範斯（守序善良人類），一個年輕且天真的個體

english: Sareena Shu (chaotic neutral tiefling), an overeager lover of history and learning
zh_tw: 薩琳娜·舒（混亂中立提夫林），一位對歷史與學識過度熱忱的愛好者

english: Maryam Bikram (lawful neutral human), a city watch veteran who rigidly enforces the rules
zh_tw: 瑪麗安·比克拉姆（守序中立人類），一位嚴格執法的城市衛隊老兵

english: Investigating Security Measures
zh_tw: 調查安全措施

english: The museum is protected by several security measures after it closes at 8 p.m.
zh_tw: 博物館在晚上8點關閉後由幾項安全措施保護。

english: Alarms
zh_tw: 警報

english: Audible {@spell alarm} spells have been cast in areas marked (A) on {@adventure map 1.2|KftGV|1|MAP 1.2: DM'S MAP}. The museum's guards and the curator have pass cards that allow them to bypass these alarms, and spare pass cards are kept in {@area area V7|04d|x} (see "{@area Bypassing Alarms|029|x}" below for more information). The alarms are located as follows:
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 地圖 1.2|KftGV|1|MAP 1.2: DM'S MAP}上標記為(A)的區域，已經施放了可聽見的{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。博物館的警衛和館長持有通行證卡片，允許他們繞過這些警報，備用的通行證卡片存放在{@area 區域V7|04d|x}（詳見下文"繞過警報{@area 繞過警報|029|x}"以獲取更多資訊）。警報的位置如下：

english: The front doors to {@area area V1|035|x}
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的前門

english: At the bottom of the stairs in {@area area V1|035|x}
zh_tw: 在{@area 區域V1|035|x}區域樓梯底部

english: In each hallway leading from {@area area V1|035|x} to {@area area V3|03d|x}
zh_tw: 在從{@area 區域V1|035|x}通向{@area 區域V3|03d|x}的每條走廊上

english: On the doors leading from {@area area V1|035|x} to areas {@area V5|044|x}, {@area V6|049|x}, and {@area V7|04d|x}
zh_tw: 在從{@area 區域V1|035|x}通往{@area V5|044|x}、{@area V6|049|x}和{@area V7|04d|x}區域的門上

english: In the hall leading from {@area area V11|05c|x} to {@area area V12|05f|x}
zh_tw: 在從{@area 區域V11|05c|x}通往{@area 區域V12|05f|x}的走廊中

english: On the door leading from {@area area V12|05f|x} to the hallway to {@area area V13|064|x}
zh_tw: 在從{@area 區域V12|05f|x}通往{@area 區域V13|064|x}走廊的門上

english: If an alarm is on a door, touching the door sets off the alarm. If an alarm is on a 5-foot square, entering that square sets it off. The alarm on the front doors in area V1 extends 10 feet, covering the entire width of the doorway. When an alarm sounds, any guards in the area plus {@dice 1d3} other guards from that floor hear it and investigate.
zh_tw: 如果警報器安裝在門上，觸碰門就會觸發警報。如果警報器在一個5尺的正方形區域內，進入該區域就會觸發警報。區域V1前門的警報延伸10尺，覆蓋了整個門道的寬度。當警報響起時，該區域內的所有警衛加上該樓層的{@dice 1d3}名其他警衛會聽到並進行調查。

english: The characters can find a record of the museum's payment for these spells, including their specific locations, by searching the records room (area V6); the alarms can also be detected using {@spell detect magic}. The alarms aren't armed while the museum is open to the public.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過搜尋記錄室（區域 V6）找到博物館支付這些法術的記錄，包括它們的具體位置；也可以使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術來探測到這些警報。當博物館對公眾開放時，警報是不會啟動的。

english: Animated Statues
zh_tw: 活化雕像

english: The statues that flank the front desk in {@area area V1|035|x} and the statue next to the stairs in {@area area V12|05f|x} can animate after hours to attack intruders. These statues use the {@creature animated armor} stat block. Causing a statue to animate alerts any guards in that area.
zh_tw: 在{@area 區域V1|035|x}區域前臺兩側的雕像和在{@area 區域V12|05f|x}區域樓梯旁的雕像在營業時間結束後可以活化攻擊入侵者。這些雕像使用{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的統計資料塊。使雕像活化會警告該區域的所有警衛。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation magic around each statue. A character who becomes aware of the statues' magical nature can make a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. If the check is successful, the character realizes the statues can animate.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術會揭示每座雕像周圍的變化魔法光環。一個意識到雕像魔法性質的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 10} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會意識到這些雕像可以活動。

english: Gemstone Wing
zh_tw: 寶石翼

english: If the characters don't carefully remove the Murkmire Stone from its pedestal in area V13, {@spell arcane lock} spells cause all doors leading to the room (including secret doors) to close and lock. As an action, a character can either try to unlock a door using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check, or force open the door by succeeding on a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The characters can learn about this security measure by attending the gala (see the "{@area Attending the Gala|02c|x}" section).
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有小心地從V13區域的臺座上移除泥沼石，{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術會導致所有通往該房間的門（包括暗門）關閉並鎖上。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具解鎖一扇門，成功透過一個{@dc 20}敏捷檢定，或者透過成功的{@dc 20}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟門。角色們可以透過參加舞會瞭解到這一安全措施（參見"{@area 參加晚會|02c|x}"章節）。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: After hours, Maryam Bikram is stationed at the entrance to the gala. Eleven other museum guards watch the areas indicated in the Guard Locations After Hours table. Guards have keys to certain areas. Guards also have pass cards that allow them to bypass the museum's alarms (see "{@area Bypassing Alarms|029|x}" below).
zh_tw: 營業時間結束後，瑪麗亞姆·比克拉姆被安排在晚會入口處。其他十一位博物館警衛監視著"警衛夜間位置"表中指出的區域。警衛們擁有某些區域的鑰匙。警衛們還有通行證卡，允許他們繞過博物館的警報（見下文的"繞過警報{@area 繞過警報|029|x}"）。

english: If the characters get into a noisy fight with one or more guards, an additional {@dice 1d4} {@creature Guard||guards} arrive each round until all the remaining museum guards are accounted for.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與一名或多名警衛發生了喧鬧的戰鬥，每輪會有額外的{@dice 1d4}名{@creature Guard||警衛}到達，直到所有剩餘的博物館警衛都到場。

english: If the guards incapacitate a character or a character surrenders, the guards haul that character to the nearby city watch headquarters. If all the characters are caught, their mission is unsuccessful and the adventure ends.
zh_tw: 如果警衛使一個角色失去行動能力或者一個角色投降，警衛會把那個角色帶到附近的城市警衛隊總部。如果所有角色都被抓住，他們的任務就失敗了，冒險也就結束了。

english: Circumventing Security
zh_tw: 規避安全措施

english: Characters who discover the museum's security measures can find ways to circumvent them. A few suggestions are provided below:
zh_tw: 發現博物館安全措施的角色可以找到規避它們的方法。下面提供了一些建議：

english: Avoiding Statues
zh_tw: 避開雕像

english: Characters can keep the statues from animating by staying more than 5 feet away from them.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過保持在雕像5尺以外來防止它們活化。

english: Bypassing Alarms
zh_tw: 繞過警報

english: The curator and guards each carry a palm-sized pass card embossed with the museum's logo. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around each pass card, which allows the bearer to bypass any of the museum's alarms. The characters can find a stash of extra pass cards in {@area area V7|04d|x}. A character who is hidden and within reach of a guard can try to steal that guard's pass card without the guard's knowledge, doing so with a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 館長和警衛各自攜帶一張手掌大小的通行卡，上面印有博物館的標誌。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術會顯示每張通行卡周圍有一層預言魔法的光環，這使得持有者可以繞過博物館的任何警報。角色可以在{@area 區域V7|04d|x}找到一批額外的通行卡。一個隱匿且處於警衛觸手可及範圍內的角色可以嘗試在警衛不知情的情況下偷取那張通行卡，這需要透過一個成功的{@dc 14}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。

english: Sneaking Past Guards
zh_tw: 悄悄溜過警衛

english: The characters can find a document in the curator's office ({@area area V5|044|x}) that outlines the guards' stations after hours. During the gala, the curator keeps this document on her person (see the "{@area Curator Alda Arkin|02e|x}" section). Characters who spend at least 1 minute studying the document have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to sneak past guards after hours.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在館長的辦公室（{@area 區域V5|044|x}）找到一份檔案，概述了警衛們在閉館後的崗位。在晚會期間，館長隨身攜帶這份檔案（見"{@area 館長阿爾達·阿金|02e|x}"部分）。至少花費1分鐘研究檔案的角色在閉館後潛行避開警衛時，在敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿})檢定上有優勢。

english: Stealing Keys
zh_tw: 偷鑰匙

english: The curator carries a master key, while each guard carries a key that unlocks all doors to the area in which the guard is stationed. Guards in {@area area V1|035|x} also have a key to the break room ({@area area V7|04d|x}). A character can steal a guard's key in the same way as they can steal a pass card, described in "Bypassing Alarms" above.
zh_tw: 館長攜帶著一把萬能鑰匙，而每個警衛都攜帶著一把能開啟他們所駐守區域所有門的鑰匙。在{@area 區域V1|035|x}區域的警衛還有一把休息室（{@area 區域V7|04d|x}）的鑰匙。角色可以像在上文"繞過警報"中描述的偷取通行證卡的方式一樣，偷取警衛的鑰匙。

english: The Murkmire Stone is the primary treasure on display during the Varkenbluff Museum's opening gala
zh_tw: 沼澤地之石是瓦肯布盧夫博物館開幕晚會上展出的主要寶藏

english: Hiding in the Museum
zh_tw: 在博物館中隱藏

english: The characters can hide in numerous locations while the museum closes. Below are good options, which are detailed in the "{@area Museum Locations|034|x}" section:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在博物館關閉時藏在許多地方。以下是好的選擇，這些選擇在"{@area 博物館位置|034|x}"部分有詳細說明：

english: Cleaning Supply Storage
zh_tw: 清潔用品儲藏室

english: Short hallways that hold cleaning supplies are concealed behind secret doors in areas {@area V3|03d|x}, {@area V4|041|x}, {@area V8|052|x}, {@area V9|055|x}, {@area V12|05f|x}, and {@area V13|064|x}.
zh_tw: 清潔用品存放在短走廊裡，這些走廊被隱藏在{@area V3|03d|x}、{@area V4|041|x}、{@area V8|052|x}、{@area V9|055|x}、{@area V12|05f|x}和{@area V13|064|x}區域的秘密門後面。

english: Privies
zh_tw: 廁所

english: The guards nominally check {@area area V15|06b|x} before closing, but anyone who hides here avoids detection.
zh_tw: 警衛在關閉前名義上會檢查{@area 區域V15|06b|x}，但任何藏在這裡的人都不會被探測到。

english: Attic or Basement
zh_tw: 閣樓或地下室

english: The guards don't enter areas {@area V16|06c|x} or {@area V17|071|x} before the museum closes.
zh_tw: 在博物館關閉前，警衛不會進入{@area V16|06c|x}或{@area V17|071|x}。

english: Reentering the Museum
zh_tw: 重新進入博物館

english: The characters might decide to leave the museum when it closes and sneak back inside after hours. Below are some strategies they might use:
zh_tw: 角色們可能會決定在博物館關閉時離開，並在閉館後偷偷溜回裡面。以下是他們可能使用的一些策略：

english: Front Doors
zh_tw: 前門

english: The characters could pick the lock on the front doors to {@area area V1|035|x}, use pass cards to bypass the alarm (see "{@area Bypassing Alarms|029|x}"), and contend with the falling net trap just inside the doors while remaining a safe distance from the animated statues.
zh_tw: 角色們可以撬開通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的前門鎖，使用通行卡繞過警報（參見"{@area 繞過警報|029|x}"），並在與門內落下的網陷阱周旋的同時，保持與活化雕像的安全距離。

english: Attic Skylight
zh_tw: 閣樓天窗

english: The characters could pick the lock on the skylight to enter the building. Grappling hooks and ropes are required to scale the building. By the end of the gala, it is dark enough to allow characters to enter through the attic skylight without being seen.
zh_tw: 角色們可以撬開天窗的鎖進入建築物。需要使用抓鉤和繩索來攀登建築物。到晚會結束時，天色已足夠暗，允許角色們透過閣樓天窗進入而不被發現。

english: Basement Doors
zh_tw: 地下室門

english: The characters could pry open the loading dock doors or prop open the secret door if they find it.
zh_tw: 角色們可以撬開裝卸碼頭的門，或者如果找到了，可以撐開秘密門。

english: Attending the Gala
zh_tw: 參加晚會

english: If the characters approach the private gala in the Gemstone Wing ({@area area V13|064|x}), they encounter Maryam Bikram (lawful neutral, human {@creature guard}). The captain of the museum's security force, Maryam is a serious woman and a veteran of the city's watch. She admits any character who is dressed for the occasion and has a ticket. Others are turned away.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接近寶石翼（{@area 區域V13|064|x}）中的私人晚會，他們會遇見瑪麗亞姆·比克拉姆（守序中立，人類{@creature guard||警衛}）。作為博物館安全部隊的隊長，瑪麗亞姆是一個嚴肅的女性，也是城市警衛隊的老兵。她允許穿著得體並持有門票的任何角色進入。其他人則被拒之門外。

english: When the characters enter the gala, read the following aloud:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入盛大的舞會時，請大聲朗讀以下內容：

english: The Gemstone Wing's oak doors open into a luxuriously appointed ballroom. Crimson tablecloths and fine china adorn dining tables, and chandeliers sparkle overhead. Cabinets with glittering gemstones surround the space. At the wing's center is a marble pedestal bearing a peculiar, light-green stone.
zh_tw: 寶石翼的橡木門通向一個豪華裝飾的舞廳。深紅色的桌布和精美的瓷器裝飾著餐桌，而吊燈在頭頂上閃閃發光。周圍是裝有閃閃發光的寶石的櫥櫃。在翼的中心是一個大理石基座，上面放著一塊奇特的淺綠色石頭。

english: Twenty other gala attendees (unarmed and unarmored {@creature Noble||nobles}) mill around the event. All are dressed in elaborate finery, and most are long-time donors to the museum.
zh_tw: 二十位其他晚會來賓（未武裝且未穿戴盔甲的{@creature Noble||貴族}）在活動中閒逛。所有人都穿著華麗的服裝，大多數是博物館的長期捐贈者。

english: When a character interacts with an attendee, roll on the Gala Attendees table to determine whom they meet. The attendees know nothing about the Murkmire Stone beyond basic details about its discovery. However, if the characters fish for information about the stone or the museum and succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, an attendee reveals one random piece of information from the Museum Gossip table.
zh_tw: 當角色與一名參加者互動時，擲一次"晚會參加者"表格以確定他們遇到的是誰。參加者們對默克米爾石一無所知，只知道一些關於其發現的基礎資訊。然而，如果角色們試圖打聽有關石頭或博物館的資訊，並且成功透過一個{@dc 12}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，一位參加者將會從"博物館閒話"表格中透露一條隨機的資訊。

english: Gala Attendees
zh_tw: 舞會出席者

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Attendee
zh_tw: 來賓

english: Captain Frankheim Walters (chaotic neutral human), who never served in the military but implies he did
zh_tw: 弗蘭克海姆·沃爾特斯隊長（混亂中立人類），他從未服過役但暗示自己曾服役

english: Georgina Lucina Vandylarahal (neutral evil elf), a sneering heir to a mining fortune
zh_tw: 喬治娜·露西娜·範迪拉蘭（守序邪惡的精靈），一位礦業財富的嘲笑繼承人

english: Countess Helene Danforth (neutral good human), a member of an ancient, titled family with little actual wealth
zh_tw: 海倫·丹佛斯伯爵夫人（中立善良人類），一個古老貴族家庭的成員，實際上財富不多

english: Dr. Horthnar Stonecrusher (lawful good dwarf), a surgeon who loves natural history and gemstones
zh_tw: 霍斯納爾·石碎者博士（守序善良矮人），一位熱愛自然歷史和寶石的外科醫生

english: Museum Gossip
zh_tw: 博物館流言

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Juicy Tidbit
zh_tw: 有趣軼事

english: The curator has been fidgeting with her clutch all night. Has she gotten some sort of bad news? Maybe she's about to fire someone!
zh_tw: 館長整晚都在坐立不安地擺弄她的手拿包。她是不是收到了什麼壞訊息？也許她正準備要解僱某人！

english: Sometimes the museum keeps displays hidden in the basement at night. The curator must think her own guards might steal something!
zh_tw: 有時博物館會在夜間將展品藏在地下室裡。館長可能認為她自己的警衛可能會偷東西！

english: It's unfortunate that the museum has fallen on hard financial times. If only they sold all those ore and gem samples they keep in the basement. I've heard there's a fortune down there!
zh_tw: 博物館陷入了財務困境，這真是不幸。如果他們能出售地下室裡存放的所有礦石和寶石樣本就好了。我聽說那裡藏有一筆財富！

english: The curator adores oversized vintage dolls. I've heard she keeps one in her office that's as big as a grown human!
zh_tw: 館長非常喜歡超大號的古董娃娃。我聽說她辦公室裡有一個，大小跟成年人一樣！

english: Curator Alda Arkin
zh_tw: 館長阿爾達·阿金

english: Mingling with the gala's attendees is Alda Arkin (neutral evil, elf {@creature noble}), the museum's curator. During the gala, the curator is unarmed and unarmored. A retired university professor, Alda is responsible for the museum's close ties to Varkenbluff University's anthropology and archaeology departments.
zh_tw: 與晚會的出席者交往的是阿爾達·阿金（中立邪惡，精靈{@creature noble||貴族}），博物館的館長。在晚會期間，館長沒有攜帶武器，也沒有穿戴盔甲。作為一名退休的大學教授，阿爾達負責博物館與瓦爾肯布盧夫大學人類學和考古學系的緊密聯絡。

english: When she notices the characters, she assumes they're wealthy museum donors, welcomes them, and engages in chitchat. Alda is familiar with Dr. Dannell. She deeply dislikes the anthropologist due to Dr. Dannell's interest in the occult. If the characters mention Dr. Dannell's fears about the Murkmire Stone, Alda snorts, dismisses their concerns, and leaves to mingle with other attendees.
zh_tw: 當她注意到角色們時，她以為他們是富有的博物館捐贈者，便歡迎他們，並開始閒聊。阿爾達對丹內爾博士很熟悉。由於丹內爾博士對神秘學的興趣，她非常不喜歡這位人類學家。如果角色們提到丹內爾博士對沼澤惡意之石的恐懼，阿爾達會嗤之以鼻，不以為意，然後離開去與其他來賓交流。

english: Alda's Clutch
zh_tw: 阿爾達的緊握

english: Characters who watch Alda closely notice a fancy clutch she holds behind her back. Inside the clutch is a map of the museum guards' after-hours stations, a master key to the museum's locked doors, and a pass card that allows Alda to bypass the museum's alarms (see "{@area Investigating Security Measures|023|x}" earlier in the adventure for details).
zh_tw: 仔細觀察阿爾達的角色會注意到她背後拿著一個精緻的手拿包。手拿包裡有一張博物館警衛非工作時間的站點地圖、一把能開啟博物館所有鎖著的門的萬能鑰匙，以及一張能讓阿爾達繞過博物館警報的通行卡（詳見冒險早期的"調查安全措施{@area 調查安全措施|023|x}"部分）。

english: Examining the Murkmire Stone
zh_tw: 檢查穆克米爾石

english: The Murkmire Stone sits atop a pedestal in {@area area V13|064|x}, flanked by informational placards about the stone's discovery and theories about its use—though Dr. Dannell's occult theory is missing.
zh_tw: 穆克米爾石位於{@area 區域V13|064|x}區域的基座上，旁邊是關於石頭髮現和其用途理論的資訊牌——儘管丹內爾博士的神秘理論並未包含在內。

english: Gemstone Wing Security Measures
zh_tw: 寶石翅膀安全措施

english: A character who spends at least 1 minute studying the pedestal during the gala realizes it has an elaborate defense mechanism (see area V13).
zh_tw: 在晚會期間，至少花費1分鐘研究基座的角色意識到它有一個複雜的防禦機制（見區域V13）。

english: Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History
zh_tw: 瓦肯布盧夫自然歷史博物館

english: Once the Murkmire Stone exhibition gala ends, the museum closes. Its staff members activate the protections listed in the "{@area Investigating Security Measures|023|x}" section.
zh_tw: 穆克米爾石展覽晚會結束後，博物館關閉。其工作人員啟用了"{@area 調查安全措施|023|x}"部分中列出的保護措施。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The Varkenbluff Museum of Natural History has stone walls and tiled floors. The building's other features are described below:
zh_tw: 瓦爾肯布洛夫自然歷史博物館有石牆和瓷磚地板。建築的其他特點如下所述：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The museum's ceilings are 30 feet high.
zh_tw: 博物館的天花板高30尺。

english: Interior Doors
zh_tw: 室內門

english: The interior doors are closed and locked, with the exception of the privies in {@area area V15|06b|x}. A character can use an action to try to unlock a door using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check unless otherwise noted. Attempting to use thieves' tools to unlock a door with an enabled {@spell alarm} spell triggers that alarm.
zh_tw: 除了區域 {@area 區域V15|06b|x} 的私室外，內部的門都是關閉並上鎖的。角色可以使用一個動作嘗試使用盜賊工具解鎖門，除非另有說明，成功透過 {@dc 12} 的敏捷檢定即可解鎖。嘗試使用盜賊工具解鎖啟用了 {@spell alarm||警報術} 的門會觸發該警報。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: On the first two floors, most areas are lit with {@spell continual flame} spells placed on sconces. The grand entrance ({@area area V1|035|x}), Prehistoric Predators exhibit ({@area area V12|05f|x}), basement ({@area area V16|06c|x}), and attic ({@area area V17|071|x}) are areas of {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. Guards in areas {@area V1|035|x} and {@area V12|05f|x} carry hooded lanterns.
zh_tw: 在一樓和二樓，大部分區域由安裝在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術提供照明。宏偉入口（{@area 區域V1|035|x}）、史前掠食者展覽（{@area 區域V12|05f|x}）、地下室（{@area 區域V16|06c|x}）和閣樓（{@area 區域V17|071|x}）是{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}區域。位於區域{@area V1|035|x}和{@area V12|05f|x}的警衛們攜帶著覆影明燈。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door can be found by any character who takes an action to examine the surrounding wall and succeeds on a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 任何角色只要採取行動檢查周圍的牆壁併成功透過 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，就可以發現一扇秘密門。

english: Museum Locations
zh_tw: 博物館位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 1.2. The descriptions assume the characters are exploring the museum after it's closed to the public.
zh_tw: 以下地點與地圖1.2相關。描述假設角色在博物館對公眾關閉後進行探索。

english: Map 1.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖 1.2: 地下城主的地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: V1: Grand Entrance
zh_tw: V1. 宏偉入口

english: Statues depicting robed human women flank the sides of this public mingling space, which boasts a marble column in the center. The museum's information desk is situated just inside the front doors. To the north is a grand staircase draped in rich carpet.
zh_tw: 描繪著長袍女性形象的雕像位於這個公共交流空間的兩側，空間中央有一根大理石柱子。博物館的諮詢臺就位於前門內側。向北是一個覆蓋著華麗地毯的宏偉樓梯。

english: Two {@creature Guard||guards} patrol this area. The two statues flanking the information desk animate if a character comes within 5 feet of either of them. The statues use the {@creature animated armor} stat block and fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 這個區域由兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}巡邏。資訊臺兩側的兩座雕像如果有人接近5尺內就會活化。這些雕像使用{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的統計塊，並會戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: Alarms
zh_tw: 警報

english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the bottom of the grand staircase. Another such spell has been cast on the front doors.
zh_tw: 在宏偉樓梯的底部施加了一道{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。另一道類似的法術施加在前門上。

english: Front Doors
zh_tw: 前門

english: The museum's front doors are locked from the inside. As an action, a character can try to pick the lock using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 博物館的前門從內部上鎖了。作為一個動作，一個角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具開鎖，這需要成功進行一次 {@dc 16} 的敏捷檢定。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The 5-foot-by-10-foot section of floor immediately north of the museum's front doors (marked T on map 1.2) contains a pressure plate hidden under a rug. Lifting the rug or pushing it aside reveals the pressure plate, which is activated and deactivated by a toggle switch hidden under the nearby information desk. The trap is normally activated while the museum is closed to the public and deactivated while the museum is open to the public.
zh_tw: 博物館前門正北方向的5尺乘10尺的地板區域（在地圖1.2上標記為T）下隱藏著一個壓力板。提起地毯或將其推到一邊會露出壓力板，它透過隱藏在附近諮詢臺下方的切換開關來啟用和停用。這個陷阱通常在博物館對公眾關閉時啟用，在博物館對公眾開放時停用。

english: The first time a creature steps on the pressure plate while the trap is activated, a weighted net drops from a secret compartment in the ceiling, covering the 10-foot-square area between the front doors and the information desk. Creatures in that area are {@condition restrained} by the net, and those that fail a {@dc 10} Strength saving throw are also knocked {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 當一個生物在陷阱啟用時第一次踏上壓力板，一個加重的網從天花板上的隱藏隔間落下，覆蓋前門和資訊臺之間的10尺見方區域。該區域內的生物被網{@condition restrained||束縛}，那些未能透過{@dc 10}力量豁免的生物還會被擊倒{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 10} Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The net has AC 10 and 12 hit points. Creatures are no longer {@condition restrained} by the net once it drops to 0 hit points.
zh_tw: 一個生物可以使用它的動作進行一次{@dc 10}力量檢定，成功時可以釋放自己或另一個在它觸及範圍內的生物。這張網的AC為10，生命值為12點。一旦網的生命值降至0點，生物將不再被{@condition restrained||束縛}。

english: V2: Museum Shops
zh_tw: V2. 博物館商店

english: Display racks here are filled with tunics, bandannas, books, and bric-a-brac, most emblazoned with the museum's logo. Plush benches serve as seating areas.
zh_tw: 這裡的展示架上擺滿了束腰外衣、頭巾、書籍和小擺設，大多數都印有博物館的標誌。柔軟的長椅作為休息區。

english: The eastern shop sells cheap souvenirs and bears a sign that reads, "The Historian's Gifts." The western shop sells books and artifact replicas and is labeled "The Archaeologist's Spade."
zh_tw: 東部的商店出售廉價的紀念品，上面掛著一個牌子，寫著"歷史學家的禮物"。西部的商店出售書籍和文物複製品，標著"考古學家的鏟子"。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each shop includes a small back room with a locked door. As an action, a character can try to unlock either door using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity check. Inside each shop's back room is a till containing {@dice 1d6} gp, {@dice 2d6} sp, and {@dice 3d6} cp. Additionally, one set of {@item thieves' tools|PHB} can be cobbled together from the supplies in the back rooms.
zh_tw: 每個商店都包括一個帶鎖門的小後室。作為動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具解鎖任一扇門，成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 的敏捷檢定即可做到。每個商店的後室裡有一個收銀機，裡面裝有 {@dice 1d6} 金幣、{@dice 2d6} 銀幣和 {@dice 3d6} 銅幣。此外，可以從後室的物資中拼湊出一套 {@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}。

english: V3: Ancient Plants Exhibit
zh_tw: V3. 古植物展區

english: Artificial plants made of wood, silk, and other materials sprout from artfully arranged planters. Tall ferns, bushes with strange berries, and slender trees are represented alongside placards about ancient plant life.
zh_tw: 由木頭、絲綢和其他材料製成的人造植物從巧妙佈置的花盆中生長出來。高大的蕨類植物、帶有奇異漿果的灌木和細長的樹木被展示在關於古代植物生命的標牌旁邊。

english: One {@creature guard} patrols this area. Hallways to the north and south connect to area V4.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature guard||警衛}在此區域巡邏。向北和向南的走廊連線到區域V4。

english: Alarms
zh_tw: 警報

english: The short hallways that connect this area to the grand entrance ({@area area V1|035|x}) have {@spell alarm} spells cast on them.
zh_tw: 連線這個區域到宏偉入口（{@area 區域V1|035|x}）的短走廊上施有{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The northern and central exhibit rooms each have a secret door in the west wall that opens into a short hallway containing cleaning supplies. At the opposite end of the hallway is another secret door that doesn't require an ability check to spot from inside the hall. This secret door pulls open to reveal a similarly sized exhibit room in area V4.
zh_tw: 北部和中部的展覽室各自在西牆上有一個秘密門，通向一個短走廊，裡面有清潔用品。在走廊的另一端是另一個秘密門，從走廊內部不需要屬性檢定就能發現。這扇秘密門拉開後，會露出與區域V4同樣大小的展覽室。

english: V4: Ancient Cultures Exhibit
zh_tw: V4. 古代文化展覽

english: Glass display cases boast objects related to life in ancient Varkenbluff. Clay pots, stone tools, and scraps of leather clothes are interspersed with informational placards about their historical use.
zh_tw: 玻璃展示櫃展示著與古代瓦爾肯布洛夫生活有關的物品。陶罐、石制工具和皮革衣物碎片與關於它們歷史用途的資訊牌相間陳列。

english: One {@creature guard} patrols this area. Hallways to the north and south connect to area V3.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature guard||警衛}在此區域巡邏。向北和向南的走廊連線到區域V3。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The northern and central exhibit rooms each have a secret door in the east wall that opens into a short hallway containing cleaning supplies. At the opposite end of the hallway is another secret door that doesn't require an ability check to spot from inside the hall. This secret door pulls open to reveal a similarly sized exhibit room in area V3.
zh_tw: 北部和中央的展覽室各自在東牆上有一個秘密門，通向一個短走廊，裡面存放著清潔用品。在走廊的另一端是另一個秘密門，從走廊內部不需要屬性檢定就能發現。這個秘密門拉開後，會露出一個同樣大小的展覽室，位於區域 V3。

english: V5: Curator's Office
zh_tw: V5. 館長的辦公室

english: A solid oak desk stands on a plush carpet in the center of this office. In the southeast corner, a strange, human-sized doll is posed in an elaborate silk dress.
zh_tw: 在這個辦公室的中心，一張堅固的橡木桌子立在一塊豪華的地毯上。在東南角，一個奇怪的、真人大小的娃娃穿著一件精緻的絲綢連衣裙襬好姿勢。

english: Alarm
zh_tw: 警報術

english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
zh_tw: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell alarm||警報術}。

english: Deadly Doll
zh_tw: 致命玩偶

english: After hours, the curator enables her office's defense mechanism: a five-foot-tall doll with the name "Marigold" sewn onto its vintage dress. When a creature other than Alda enters the room, the doll animates and attacks. Marigold uses the {@creature scarecrow} stat block and fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 閉館後，館長啟動了她辦公室的防禦機制：一個五尺高的洋娃娃，其復古連衣裙上縫著"瑪麗戈德"這個名字。當除了阿爾達以外的生物進入房間時，洋娃娃就會活化並發動攻擊。瑪麗戈德使用的是 {@creature scarecrow||稻草人}（稻草人）的統計資料塊，並會一直戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: At your discretion, a noisy fight might attract the attention of the guards patrolling area V1.
zh_tw: 根據您的判斷，一場嘈雜的戰鬥可能會吸引在區域 V1 巡邏的警衛的注意。

english: Guards' Patrol Routes
zh_tw: 守衛的巡邏路線

english: If the characters didn't snatch Alda's clutch during the gala, they can find a copy of the guards' after-hours patrol routes on the desk under some other loose paperwork (see the "{@area Curator Alda Arkin|02e|x}" section).
zh_tw: 如果角色們在晚會上沒有搶走阿爾達的手拿包，他們可以在桌面上的一些散亂檔案下面找到警衛們非工作時間巡邏路線的副本（見"{@area 館長阿爾達·阿金|02e|x}"部分）。

english: V6: Records Room
zh_tw: V6. 檔案室

english: Filing cabinets stand in this records room.
zh_tw: 檔案櫃擺放在這個檔案室內。

english: Alarm
zh_tw: 警報術

english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
zh_tw: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell alarm||警報術}。

english: Records
zh_tw: 檔案

english: This room contains records about past and current exhibits as well as the museum's financial records. A character who searches this area also finds information about the placement of the building's {@spell alarm} spells (see "{@area Investigating Security Measures|023|x}" earlier in the adventure).
zh_tw: 這個房間包含有關過去和當前展覽以及博物館財務記錄的資料。搜尋這個區域的角色還會找到有關建築中{@spell alarm||警報術}法術佈置的資訊（見冒險早期的"{@area 調查安全措施|023|x}"）。

english: V7: Break Room and Storage
zh_tw: V7. 休息室與儲藏

english: Boxes of display supplies are stacked into this room's corners. Chairs surround a circular table in the middle.
zh_tw: 展示用品的箱子堆放在這個房間的角落裡。椅子圍繞著中間的一張圓桌擺放。

english: Alarm
zh_tw: 警報術

english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door that connects this room to {@area area V1|035|x}.
zh_tw: 這扇通往{@area 區域V1|035|x}的門被施放了{@spell alarm||警報術}。

english: Pass Card Stash
zh_tw: 通行證卡藏匿處

english: Characters who take a minute to search the boxes find a small, partially open box in the southwest corner. Inside are three palm-sized pass cards, each stamped with the museum's logo. A scrap of paper inside the box reads "spare alarm pass cards." Each pass card allows its bearer to bypass the museum's alarms, as described in the "{@area Bypassing Alarms|029|x}" section earlier in this adventure.
zh_tw: 如果角色們花一分鐘搜尋箱子，他們會在西南角找到一個半開著的小箱子。裡面有三張手掌大小的通行卡，每張都印有博物館的標誌。箱子裡的一張紙條上寫著"備用警報通行卡"。每張通行卡允許持有者繞過博物館的警報，正如本冒險早期"繞過警報{@area 繞過警報|029|x}"部分所描述的。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Tucked between supply boxes in the northwest corner is a vial containing a {@item potion of vitality}.
zh_tw: 在西北角的供應箱之間藏著一個裝有{@item potion of vitality||活力藥水}的小瓶。

english: V8: Creatures of the Past Exhibit
zh_tw: V8. 古代生物展覽

english: Fossils of small prehistoric creatures are arranged here, some as fully reconstructed skeletons. The exhibit includes microraptors, ornithopods, dwarf elephants, and an ancestor of the cockatrice. Informational placards tell the stories of these creatures and their bones' discovery.
zh_tw: 這裡陳列著小型史前生物的化石，有些是完全重建的骨架。展覽包括小盜龍、鳥腳類恐龍、矮象和雞蛇獸的祖先。資訊牌匾講述了這些生物及其骨骼的發現故事。

english: One {@creature guard} patrols this area.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature guard||警衛}在這片區域巡邏。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Between two of the 15-foot-square exhibit rooms is a secret door that opens into a short hallway heading north. At the opposite end of the hallway, which holds cleaning supplies, is another secret door that doesn't require an ability check to spot from inside the hall. This secret door opens to reveal {@area area V12|05f|x}.
zh_tw: 在兩個15尺見方的展覽室之間有一道秘密門，通向一個向北的短走廊。在走廊的另一端，存放著清潔用品，還有另一道秘密門，從走廊內部不需要屬性檢定就能發現。這扇秘密門開啟後會顯露出{@area 區域V12|05f|x}。

english: V9: Underground Wonders Exhibit
zh_tw: V9. 地下奇觀展覽

english: Glittering ore and gemstones are arranged in velvet-backed display cases. Informational placards explain local geologic history.
zh_tw: 閃閃發光的礦石和寶石被陳列在襯有天鵝絨的展示箱中。資訊牌匾解釋了當地的地質歷史。

english: Two {@creature Guard||guards} patrol this exhibit and area V10, moving from one room to the other every 5 minutes.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}巡邏這個展區和區域V10，每5分鐘從一個房間移動到另一個房間。

english: The gems on display here hold little value; precious stones are reserved for display in the Gemstone Wing ({@area area V13|064|x}).
zh_tw: 這裡展出的寶石價值不高；珍貴的寶石保留在寶石翼（{@area 區域V13|064|x}）展出。

english: Fake Murkmire Stone
zh_tw: 假穆克米爾石

english: A character who examines the stones on display in the easternmost room realizes the central display cabinet includes a chunk of jade similar in size and weight to the Murkmire Stone. The display case is locked, but a character can take an action to try to open it using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check. Smashing the display case's glass attracts the guards patrolling this area.
zh_tw: 一名角色如果檢查最東邊房間展出的石頭時，會意識到中央展示櫃中有一塊大小和重量與默克邁爾石相似的玉石。展示櫃是鎖著的，但角色可以採取行動嘗試使用盜賊工具開啟它，成功透過 {@dc 10} 敏捷檢定即可做到。打碎展示櫃的玻璃會吸引在該區域巡邏的守衛。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Between this exhibit and area V10 is a secret door that opens into a short hallway heading north. At the opposite end of the hallway, which holds cleaning supplies, is another secret door that doesn't require an ability check to spot from inside the hall. This secret door pulls open to reveal area V13.
zh_tw: 這個展區和區域V10之間有一扇秘密門，通向一條向北的短走廊。在走廊的另一端，放著清潔用品，還有另一扇秘密門，從走廊內部不需要屬性檢定就能發現。這扇秘密門拉開後會露出區域V13。

english: V10: Archaeology Display
zh_tw: V10. 考古學展示

english: Picks, trowels, brushes, and other archaeological tools are on display here. Informational placards label them as tools famous local experts used to dig up the wonders found in the museum. Murals along the south wall depict famous digs.
zh_tw: 這裡展示著鎬、鍬、刷子以及其他考古工具。資訊牌將它們標記為著名當地專家用來挖掘博物館中發現的奇蹟的工具。南牆上的壁畫描繪了著名的挖掘場景。

english: Two {@creature Guard||guards} patrol both this exhibit and area V9, moving from one room to the other every 5 minutes.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}巡邏這個展覽和區域 V9，每5分鐘從一間房間移動到另一間。

english: This exhibit tells the story of the infamous Rogerson dig, where most of the creatures in the Prehistoric Predators exhibit were found. The placards dismiss local legends that claim the excavators were subsequently cursed.
zh_tw: 這個展覽講述了聲名狼藉的羅傑森挖掘事件的故事，史前掠食者展覽中的大部分生物都是在那裡發現的。說明牌上對當地傳說嗤之以鼻，這些傳說聲稱挖掘者隨後被詛咒了。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who studies the exhibit and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check realizes the items on display include two flawless weapons: a {@item +1 dagger} and a {@item +1 handaxe}. The weapons are inside a glass case with a jammed lock, so the characters must break or cut through the glass to access the weapons. Breaking the glass attracts the guards patrolling this area.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果研究了展覽並且成功透過了一個 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會意識到展出的物品中包括兩件完美無瑕的武器：一把 {@item +1 dagger||+1 匕首} 和一把 {@item +1 handaxe||+1 手斧}。這些武器被放置在一個鎖卡住的玻璃櫃中，因此角色們必須打破或割開玻璃才能拿到武器。打破玻璃會吸引正在巡邏該區域的守衛。

english: V11: Unearthed Café
zh_tw: V11. 挖掘咖啡館

english: This space holds a mix of cafeteria-style tables and lounge furniture. A counter in the northeast corner sits underneath a sign that reads, "Unearthed Café."
zh_tw: 這個空間擺放著自助餐廳風格的桌子和休息室傢俱。東北角的櫃檯上方掛著一個標誌，上面寫著"出土咖啡館"。

english: One {@creature guard} patrols this area.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature guard||警衛}在這片區域巡邏。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A small lockbox is stashed under the counter. As an action, a character can try to open the lockbox using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity check. The lockbox contains 15 gp, 7 sp, and 24 cp.
zh_tw: 一個小保險箱被藏在櫃檯下面。作為一個動作，一個角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開啟保險箱，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 14} 敏捷檢定。保險箱內包含15枚金幣、7枚銀幣和24枚銅幣。

english: V12: Prehistoric Predators Exhibit
zh_tw: V12. 史前掠食者展覽

english: The intact skeletons of several large prehistoric monsters are on display here, including the museum's most famous display: the beautifully preserved body of an allosaurus, its leathery skin appearing supple to the touch. An informational placard next to the dinosaur explains it died in the Murkmire millennia ago and was naturally preserved. Display cases along the room's walls hold fossils of other ancient local predators.
zh_tw: 這裡展出了多個大型史前怪物的完整骨架，包括博物館最著名的展品：一具儲存得非常完好的異特龍，它的皮膚觸感柔軟。恐龍旁邊的說明牌解釋說，它在數千年前死於沼澤地，並且自然地被儲存了下來。房間牆壁上的展示櫃中還陳列著其他古代當地捕食者的化石。

english: Two {@creature Guard||guards} patrol this area.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}巡邏此區域。

english: The statue west of the stairs depicts a winged satyr. If a character comes within 5 feet of the statue, it springs to life. The statue uses the {@creature animated armor} stat block and fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 樓梯西側的雕像描繪了一個有翼的半羊人。如果角色接近雕像5尺以內，它就會活過來。雕像使用{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的統計塊，並會戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: Alarms
zh_tw: 警報

english: An {@spell alarm} spell has been cast in the hallway leading to the Unearthed Café (area V11). Another {@spell alarm} spell has been cast on the door in the middle of the east wall (which leads to area V13).
zh_tw: 在通往出土咖啡館（區域 V11）的走廊上施放了{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。在東牆中間的門上（通往區域 V13）也施放了另一個{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。

english: Allosaurus
zh_tw: 異特龍

english: The allosaurus looks like a preserved specimen, but the museum hired rock gnomes to transform it into a harmless animatronic display. A character who examines the display's base notices a small hatch covering a panel of buttons. A character can use these controls to turn on the animatronic display, which alerts not only the guards in this area but also the guards in areas V11 and V13.
zh_tw: 異特龍看起來像是一個儲存完好的標本，但博物館聘請了岩石地精將其改造成一個無害的自動化展示。檢查展示底座的角色會注意到一個小艙口，蓋住了一個按鈕面板。角色可以使用這些控制按鈕來啟動自動化展示，這不僅會警告這個區域的警衛，還會警告V11和V13區域的警衛。

english: As an action, a character can use tinker's tools or thieves' tools to try to overload the magic that powers the controls, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. This causes the animatronic creature to break free from its display base and rampage for 10 minutes before becoming inert again. The creature stomps through the area, then heads down the grand staircase, causing mayhem in area V1. While it rampages, the creature uses the {@creature allosaurus} stat block, with these changes:
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以使用工匠工具或盜賊工具嘗試過載控制系統的魔法，成功透過 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定即可實現。這會導致這個機械生物從展示底座中掙脫出來，肆虐 10 分鐘後再次變為靜止。該生物在區域內踐踏，然後衝下大樓梯，在區域 V1 引發混亂。在它肆虐時，該生物使用 {@creature allosaurus||異特龍} 的屬性塊，但有以下變化：

english: The {@creature animatronic allosaurus|KftGV} is a Construct.
zh_tw: {@creature animatronic allosaurus|KftGV|機械動畫異龍} 是一種構裝生物。

english: It is immune to poison and psychic damage, as well as the {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, and {@condition poisoned} conditions.
zh_tw: 它對毒素和心靈傷害免疫，以及對{@condition charmed||魅惑}（魅惑）、{@condition frightened||恐懼}（恐懼）、{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}（麻痺）和{@condition poisoned||中毒}（中毒）狀態免疫。

english: Vent
zh_tw: 通風口

english: The east wall has a 3-foot-high, 3-foot-wide, 5-foot-deep air vent leading to area V13. The vent is 10 feet above the floor. Reaching it requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Safely returning to the floor doesn't require an ability check.
zh_tw: 東牆有一個3尺高、3尺寬、5尺深的通風口，通往V13區域。通風口離地面10尺高。要到達它需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 10} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定。安全返回地面不需要能力檢定。

english: V13: Gemstone Wing
zh_tw: V13. 寶石翼

english: Chairs surround several tables cluttered with crystal and silver tableware. Against the east wall, a light-green stone rests atop a marble pedestal.
zh_tw: 椅子圍繞著幾張雜亂無章的桌子，上面擺滿了水晶和銀質餐具。在東牆邊，一塊淺綠色的石頭放在大理石基座上。

english: Two {@creature Guard||guards} patrol this area.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}巡邏此區域。

english: Staff members plan to remove the tables and restore the normal gemstone exhibits in the morning before the museum opens. For now, the contents of those exhibits are in the basement ({@area area V16|06c|x}).
zh_tw: 工作人員計劃在博物館開門前，也就是早上，移走桌子並恢復寶石展覽的原樣。目前，這些展品的內容存放在地下室（{@area 區域V16|06c|x}）。

english: Light-Green Stone
zh_tw: 淺綠色石頭

english: The light-green stone on the pedestal is the Murkmire Stone, which is described at the end of this adventure. As Dr. Dannell fears, the stone is indeed an eldritch creature's egg. At 10:30 p.m., the effects described in "{@area The Murkmire Stone|080|x}" begin, and at midnight, the egg hatches. See "{@area Museum Feeding Frenzy|07d|x}" to learn what happens when the egg hatches.
zh_tw: 基座上的淺綠色石頭是穆克米爾石，其描述在本次冒險的末尾。正如丹內爾博士所擔心的，這塊石頭確實是一個古怪生物的卵。在晚上10:30，如"{@area 穆爾米爾石|080|x}"所述的效果開始出現，而在午夜時分，卵將孵化。請參閱"{@area 博物館餵食狂潮|07d|x}"瞭解卵孵化時會發生什麼。

english: Rigged Pedestal
zh_tw: 陷阱基座

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the pedestal, which is attached to the floor and can't be moved. A character who examines the pedestal notices tiny glyphs carved into its base and can make a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a success, the character realizes that all doors leading to the room will lock if the stone is removed from the pedestal.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術揭示了基座周圍環繞著變化魔法的靈光，基座與地面相連且無法移動。仔細檢查基座的角色會注意到基座底部刻有微小的符文，並可以進行一次 {@dc 12} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定。如果成功，角色會意識到如果石頭從基座上被移除，通往這個房間的所有門都會鎖上。

english: If the Murkmire Stone is removed from the pedestal, {@spell arcane lock} spells activate on all doors leading to the room (including secret doors), causing them to close and lock. As an action, a character can try to open a locked door using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check, or force open a locked door by succeeding on a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The {@spell arcane lock} spells don't prevent the curator or the museum guards from opening the doors.
zh_tw: 如果穆克邁爾之石從基座上被移開，所有通向房間的門（包括暗門）上的{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術將會啟用，導致它們關閉並鎖上。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具開啟一扇鎖上的門，成功透過一個{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定，或者透過成功透過一個{@dc 20}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟一扇鎖上的門。{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術不會阻止管理員或博物館守衛開啟這些門。

english: Replacing the Murkmire Stone with a fake can prevent the trap from triggering. A suitable fake can be found in {@area area V9|055|x}. Swapping it for the real Murkmire Stone without activating the {@spell arcane lock} spells requires a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 用假貨替換泥沼石可以防止陷阱觸發。一個合適的假貨可以在 {@area 區域V9|055|x} 找到。在不啟用 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 的情況下將假貨替換為真正的泥沼石需要成功透過 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。

english: Vent
zh_tw: 通風口

english: The west wall has a 3-foot-high, 3-foot-wide, 5-foot-deep air vent leading to {@area area V12|05f|x}. The vent is 10 feet above the floor. Reaching it requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Safely returning to the floor doesn't require an ability check.
zh_tw: 西牆上有一個3尺高、3尺寬、5尺深的通風口，通向{@area 區域V12|05f|x}。通風口位於地面以上10尺處。到達它需要進行一次成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。安全返回地面不需要進行能力檢定。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The south wall contains a secret door that opens into a short hallway containing cleaning supplies. At the far end of the hallway is another secret door that doesn't require an ability check to spot from inside the hall. This secret door pulls open to reveal the hallway between areas {@area V9|055|x} and {@area V10|059|x}.
zh_tw: 南牆上有一個秘密門，通向一個短走廊，裡面存放著清潔用品。在走廊的另一端，還有另一個秘密門，從走廊內部不需要屬性檢定就能發現。這扇秘密門拉開後，會顯露出連線區域{@area V9|055|x}和{@area V10|059|x}之間的走廊。

english: V14: Access Hallway
zh_tw: V14. 通道走廊

english: This hallway connects the Unearthed Café ({@area area V11|05c|x}) to the Prehistoric Predators exhibit ({@area area V12|05f|x}) and the privies (area V15).
zh_tw: 這個走廊連線著出土咖啡館（{@area 區域V11|05c|x}）到史前掠食者展覽（{@area 區域V12|05f|x}）和廁所（區域 V15）。

english: V15: Privies
zh_tw: V15. 廁所
