zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有帶回贓物，但將昆汀的信交給了維裡蒂，她會在憤怒的沉默中閱讀它。然後她告訴角色們離開，並不給予他們任何報酬。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters accomplish the heist for the Golden Vault, Verity ensures that the Golden Vault learns about the characters' success. She also informs the characters that they are entitled to an uncommon magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment for the statuette. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫完成了盜竊任務，維裡蒂確保金庫得知角色們的成功。她還通知角色們，他們有權選擇一件不常見的魔法物品（需經你批准）作為小雕像的報酬。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: Reach for the Stars
zh_tw: 伸手摘星

english: {@i An Adventure for 3rd-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合3級角色的冒險}

english: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV}'s curiosity has taken a tragic turn. A Far Realm entity called Krokulmar has taken control of Markos, compelling him to commit evil acts. At Krokulmar's command, Markos is using a book called {@i The Celestial Codex} to bring part of Krokulmar into the world. The book's rightful owner hired adventurers to retrieve {@i The Celestial Codex} and prevent Markos from using it, but these adventurers fell prey to the horrors of Delphi Mansion. A new group of adventurers—the player characters—must now complete the task. Meanwhile, Markos is close to accomplishing Krokulmar's goal.
zh_tw: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV|馬寇斯·特爾裴}的好奇心已經發生了悲慘的轉變。一個叫做克羅庫瑪的遙遠國度實體控制了馬寇斯，迫使他犯下惡行。在克羅庫瑪的命令下，馬寇斯正在使用一本名為{@i 《天界法典》}的書將克羅庫瑪的一部分帶入這個世界。這本書的合法所有者僱傭了冒險家來取回{@i 《天界法典》}並阻止馬寇斯使用它，但這些冒險家卻成了特爾裴大廈恐怖的犧牲品。現在，一群新的冒險家——玩家角色——必須完成這項任務。與此同時，馬寇斯即將完成克羅庫瑪的目標。

english: Acquiring {@i The Celestial Codex} is the primary goal of this adventure, but the characters also have a chance to free Markos from the Far Realm entity's control. Body horror is a recurring theme in this adventure; before running it, discuss with your players their level of comfort with these elements.
zh_tw: 獲得{@i 《天界法典》}是這次冒險的主要目標，但角色們也有機會將馬寇斯從遙遠國度實體的控制中解放出來。身體恐怖是這次冒險中反覆出現的主題；在進行冒險之前，請與您的玩家們討論他們對這些元素的舒適度。

english: A friendly spirit appears as a disembodied head, warning heroes about the dangers that await them in Delphi Mansion
zh_tw: 一個友好的精靈以無身體的頭部形態出現，警告英雄們在特爾裴莊園等待他們的危險

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV} grew up with an insatiable curiosity. Eventually, he had his fill of worldly knowledge and began delving into the arcane, eager to understand the secrets of the planes of existence. Raised in a family of scholars and academics, Markos wished to make a breakthrough discovery that would propel himself and his family to new heights.
zh_tw: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV|馬寇斯·特爾裴}從小就有著無法滿足的好奇心。最終，他對世俗知識感到厭倦，開始鑽研奧秘，渴望理解存在層面的秘密。馬寇斯出生在一個學者和學術家的家庭，他希望做出突破性的發現，使自己和他的家庭達到新的高度。

english: This quest for understanding became Markos's obsession. He sequestered himself and his fellow researchers in the remote Delphi Mansion. Markos used astrology-based magic to attempt to contact other planes, and something finally answered him: an entity that called itself Krokulmar. This entity made a pact with Markos, granting insight into the multiverse in exchange for influence on the Material Plane. Markos assumed Krokulmar's intentions were benign.
zh_tw: 這種對理念的追求成為了馬寇斯的執念。他將自己和其他研究同事隔離在偏遠的特爾裴莊園中。馬寇斯使用基於占星術的魔法試圖聯絡其他位面，並最終得以回應：一位自稱是"克羅庫瑪"（克羅庫瑪）的實體。這個實體與馬寇斯達成了協議，賦予了他洞悉多元宇宙的能力，其代價是增進實體在物質位面的影響力。馬寇斯認為克羅庫瑪的本質是善良的。

english: Krokulmar hails from the Far Realm. In making its pact with Markos, Krokulmar corrupted the mansion and its residents, then eroded Markos's sense of self until he became eager to commit evil acts in Krokulmar's service.
zh_tw: 克羅庫馬爾來自遙遠國度。在與馬寇斯達成契約時，克羅庫馬爾腐蝕了大廈及其居民，然後侵蝕了馬寇斯的自我意識，直到他渴望為克羅庫馬爾服務而犯下邪惡行為。

english: Acting under Krokulmar's control, Markos visited one of his peers, a sage named Vasil Talistrome. Markos incapacitated Vasil and stole {@i The Celestial Codex} from the sage's library. In addition to containing lore about stars and the planes of existence, the book describes rituals that can be used to summon extraplanar entities. Krokulmar needs Markos to perform one of these rituals to bind a {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} to the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 在克羅庫瑪的控制下，馬寇斯拜訪了他的一位同行，一個名叫瓦西里·塔利斯特羅姆的賢者。馬寇斯使瓦西里失去能力，並從賢者的圖書館中偷走了{@i 《天界法典》}。除了包含有關星星和存在層面的傳說外，這本書還描述了可以用來召喚位面之外實體的儀式。克羅庫瑪需要馬寇斯執行其中之一的儀式，將一個{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}繫結到物質位面。

english: Without any knowledge of the profane entity influencing Markos, Vasil Talistrome hired a warrior named Elra Lionheart to retrieve {@i The Celestial Codex}. Elra and three other adventurers traveled to Markos's mansion, where they witnessed a number of peculiar magical effects caused by Krokulmar's growing influence. One by one, they fell prey to the mansion's sinister occupants.
zh_tw: 在不瞭解褻瀆實體影響馬寇斯的情況下，瓦西里·塔利斯特羅姆僱傭了一位名叫埃爾拉·獅心的戰士去取回{@i 《天界法典》}。埃爾拉和另外三位冒險家前往馬寇斯的豪宅，在那裡他們目睹了由克羅庫馬爾日益增長的影響力引起的許多奇特的魔法效果。一個接一個，他們成為了豪宅邪惡居民的犧牲品。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. Vasil Talistrome, a sage who works with the Golden Vault, has reported the theft of {@i The Celestial Codex}. This book contains rituals that, in the wrong hands, could be used to summon dangerous extraplanar entities. The book was stolen by a nobleman named {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV}, who might be under the influence of some profane entity. Four adventurers hired to retrieve the book from Delphi Mansion have disappeared without a trace. We have good reason to believe they're dead. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to travel to Delphi Mansion and retrieve {@i The Celestial Codex}. May you fare better than the last group. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。與金庫合作的智者瓦西里·塔利斯特羅姆報告了{@i 《天界法典》}的失竊。這本書包含了一些儀式，若落入惡人之手，可能會被用於召喚危險的異界實體。這本書被一位名叫{@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV|馬寇斯·特爾裴}的貴族偷走，而他可能受到了某種邪惡實體的影響。四名冒險者受僱從特爾裴莊園取回這本書，但他們消失得無影無蹤。我們有充分的理由相信他們已經遇難。這次任務，如果你們選擇接受，將需要你們前往特爾裴莊園並取回{@i 《天界法典》}。願你們比上一組人更幸運。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Adventure Hooks
zh_tw: 冒險引子

english: If you're not using the Golden Vault as the characters' patron, choose one of the following adventure hooks instead.
zh_tw: 如果你不是使用金庫作為角色的贊助者，可以選擇以下任一冒險鉤子代替。

english: Hired by Vasil
zh_tw: 被瓦西里僱傭

english: Vasil Talistrome, a human sage who lives in a city of your choice, hires the characters to retrieve {@i The Celestial Codex} from Delphi Mansion. Vasil doesn't want any harm to befall Markos, whom he still regards as a friend. Vasil is worried about what might've prompted Markos to steal the book and what he might do with the book's information.
zh_tw: 瓦希爾·塔利斯通，一位居住在你選擇的城市中的人類智者，僱傭角色們從特爾裴莊園取回{@i 《天界法典》}。瓦希爾不希望馬克斯受到任何傷害，他仍然將馬克斯視為朋友。瓦希爾擔心是什麼促使馬克斯偷走了這本書，以及他可能會如何利用書中的資訊。

english: The characters aren't the first group to receive this quest, as Vasil is quick to mention. The last group he hired was led by a human warrior named Elra Lionheart. Elra and her companions perished in Delphi Mansion. (Vasil paid for the casting of a {@spell divination} spell that confirmed as much.)
zh_tw: 正如瓦西里很快提到的，角色們並不是第一個接到這個任務的團隊。上一個他僱傭的團隊是由一個名叫埃爾拉·獅心的人類戰士領導的。埃爾拉和她的同伴們在特爾裴莊園中喪生了。（瓦西里支付了施放一個{@spell divination||預言}法術的費用，這證實了這一點。）

english: Vasil's Reward
zh_tw: 瓦西里的獎賞

english: Vasil is prepared to pay 250 gp to each character if {@i The Celestial Codex} is safely delivered to him.
zh_tw: 瓦西里準備向每個角色支付250金幣，如果{@i 《天界法典》}能安全送達他手中。

english: Hired by Markos's Family
zh_tw: 被馬寇斯的家族僱傭

english: Shortly after Markos stole {@i The Celestial Codex} from the library of Vasil Talistrome, the incident was reported to Markos's wealthy family. Several family members are concerned about Markos and fear his recent studies have led him down a troubled path. One of Markos's family members hires the characters to travel to Delphi Mansion and stop Markos from doing anything that might hurt himself or others. The family member asks the characters to return {@i The Celestial Codex} to its rightful owner, preferably without harming Markos.
zh_tw: 在馬寇斯從瓦西里·塔利斯特羅姆的圖書館偷走{@i 《天界法典》}後不久，這一事件就被報告給了馬寇斯的富裕家庭。幾位家庭成員對馬寇斯感到擔憂，擔心他最近的學習使他走上了一條麻煩的道路。馬寇斯的一位家庭成員僱傭了角色們前往特爾裴宅邸，阻止馬寇斯做出任何可能傷害自己或他人的事情。這位家庭成員要求角色們將{@i 《天界法典》}歸還給它的合法主人，最好在不傷害馬寇斯的情況下。

english: Reward
zh_tw: 獎勵

english: Markos's family is prepared to pay 100 gp to each character for delivering {@i The Celestial Codex} safely to Vasil Talistrome, plus an extra 150 gp each if the characters bring Markos home. (The family strongly prefers him to be alive but pays to have him raised from the dead if necessary.)
zh_tw: 馬寇斯的家族準備好為每位角色支付100金幣，以安全地將{@i 《天界法典》}交給瓦西里·塔利斯楚姆，如果角色們將馬寇斯帶回家，每人還將額外獲得150金幣。（家族強烈希望他活著，但如有必要，會支付費用將他從死亡中復活。）

english: Meeting Elra
zh_tw: 會見埃爾拉

english: The journey to Delphi Mansion can be as eventful as you wish. When the characters get within 1 mile of the mansion, they encounter a manifestation of the late Elra Lionheart.
zh_tw: 前往特爾裴宅邸的旅程可以根據您的意願變得多麼充滿事件。當角色們接近豪宅1英里內時，他們遇到了已故的埃爾拉·獅心的顯靈。

english: Elra's spirit manifests as a disembodied head. In this form, Elra reaches out to the characters and provides some helpful information:
zh_tw: 埃爾拉的靈魂以一個無身體的頭部形式顯現。在這種形態下，埃爾拉向角色們伸出援手，並提供了一些有用的資訊：

english: A ray of sunlight shines down on a tree stump by the side of road, and the disembodied head of a human woman appears above the stump.
zh_tw: 一束陽光照射在道路旁的樹樁上，一個人類女性的無身體頭部出現在樹樁上方。

english: "My name is Elra Lionheart," says the head. "My companions and I died trying to retrieve {@i The Celestial Codex}. Heed my words, lest you too fall prey to the dangers of Delphi Mansion. Markos is using the book to conjure an otherworldly being not meant to exist in this world. Meanwhile, his purple-robed cultists busy themselves with eldritch experiments. Beware creatures that look like puddles of eyes and mouths. Beware the thing that has hooks for hands. And beware the mansion itself, for it transforms weirdly. Most of all, stop Markos before it's too late!
zh_tw: "我的名字是艾爾拉·獅心，"這顆頭顱說道。"我和我的同伴在試圖取回{@i 《天界法典》}時喪命。請聽我一句，以免你也成為特爾裴莊園危險的犧牲品。馬寇斯正在用這本書召喚一個不該存在於這個世界的異界生物。與此同時，他那些穿著紫色長袍的教徒們忙於進行一些詭異的實驗。當心那些看起來像是一灘眼睛和嘴巴的生物。當心那個手上有鉤子的東西。還有，當心這座莊園本身，因為它會奇怪地變形。最重要的是，在為時已晚之前阻止馬寇斯！"

english: "My companions and I had a camp on a bluff due south of the mansion. If you go there first, you'll find a backpack containing a map of the mansion and some notes we acquired from a dubious source. These might help you plan your approach. Best of luck!"
zh_tw: "我和我的同伴們在豪宅正南方向的懸崖上有一個營地。如果你們先去那裡，你們會找到一個揹包，裡面有一張豪宅的地圖和我們從一個可疑來源獲得的一些筆記。這些可能會幫助你們計劃你們的行動。祝你們好運！"

english: The characters have a choice: go to Elra's camp or to the mansion.
zh_tw: 角色們有一個選擇：去埃爾拉的營地還是去豪宅。

english: At your discretion, Elra's spectral head can float alongside the characters as they explore Delphi Mansion. In this form, Elra can't be harmed, nor can she physically interact with her surroundings in any way. Moreover, Elra can't stray more than a few feet from the characters. But she can provide helpful advice if the characters get stuck and don't know what to do.
zh_tw: 根據您的決定，埃爾拉的幽靈頭部可以在角色們探索特爾裴宅邸時漂浮在他們旁邊。在這種形態下，埃爾拉不會受到傷害，也無法以任何方式與周圍環境進行物理互動。此外，埃爾拉不能遠離角色們幾尺之外。但如果角色們陷入困境，不知道該怎麼辦時，她可以提供有益的建議。

english: If you choose not to have Elra accompany the characters, her head fades away.
zh_tw: 如果您選擇不讓埃爾拉陪伴角色，她的頭部就會逐漸消失。

english: Elra's Camp
zh_tw: 埃爾拉的營地

english: Elra and her companions camped on a bluff that has an unobstructed view of the south wall of Delphi Mansion. The characters can locate the camp without difficulty.
zh_tw: 埃爾拉和她的同伴們在一處可以無阻礙地看到特爾裴宅邸南牆的懸崖上紮營。角色們可以毫不費力地找到這個營地。

english: A quick search of the camp yields a backpack containing a rolled-up map of Delphi Mansion. Give your players a copy of map 3.1 at this time.
zh_tw: 對營地進行快速搜尋，發現了一個揹包，裡面裝有一張捲起的特爾裴宅邸地圖。此時，請給您的玩家一份地圖3.1的副本。

english: Accompanying the map are some scraps of paper with notes written on them in Common. Elra and her companions obtained the map and notes from one of Markos's cultists, whom they caught leaving the mansion. The notes are as follows:
zh_tw: 地圖旁邊還有一些用通用語寫的紙條。埃爾拉和她的同伴們從一名離開豪宅的馬寇斯的邪教徒那裡得到了地圖和筆記。筆記內容如下：

english: "Markos has a room on the third floor where he performs rituals."
zh_tw: "馬寇斯在三樓有一個房間，他在那裡進行儀式。"

english: "A cavernous room underneath the basement contains four large crystals—purpose unknown."
zh_tw: "地下室下方有一個洞穴般的房間，裡面有四個大型水晶——用途不明。"

english: "Mansion windows can be unlocked using the password 'Krokulmar.'"
zh_tw: "使用密碼'克羅庫瑪'可以解鎖豪宅的窗戶。"

english: Map 3.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖3.1：玩家地圖

english: Delphi Mansion
zh_tw: 特爾裴宅邸

english: Members of the Delphi family are nobles known for their academic studies of the multiverse. Markos's ancestors built Delphi Mansion in a forest away from civilization so they could study in peace.
zh_tw: 特爾裴家族的成員是因其對多元宇宙的學術研究而聞名的貴族。馬寇斯的祖先在遠離文明的森林中建造了特爾裴宅邸，以便他們能夠安靜地進行研究。

english: Arriving at the Mansion
zh_tw: 到達豪宅

english: Once the characters are within sight of the mansion, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們能看到豪宅，閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: A three-story mansion stands alone in a clearing. It has alabaster walls, windows on all three levels, and a closed double door on the ground floor. The area around the mansion seems unnaturally quiet.
zh_tw: 一棟三層高的豪宅獨自矗立在一片空地上。它有雪花石膏般的牆壁，三個樓層都有窗戶，以及一樓的一對關閉的雙門。豪宅周圍的區域異常地安靜。

english: Delphi Mansion Features
zh_tw: 特爾裴宅邸特點

english: The mansion has the following features:
zh_tw: 豪宅具有以下特點：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: The ceilings throughout the mansion are 20 feet high.
zh_tw: 豪宅內所有樓層的天花板高度為20尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The mansion's doors and secret doors are unlocked unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 除非文字另有說明，否則豪宅的門和秘密門都是未上鎖的。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The mansion is illuminated by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on candles that are mounted to the walls.
zh_tw: 豪宅由施放在牆壁上的蠟燭上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: Each window is under the effect of an {@spell arcane lock} spell. The password to circumvent the magical locks is "Krokulmar."
zh_tw: 每一扇窗戶都受到{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術的影響。繞過這些魔法鎖的密碼是"克羅庫瑪"。

english: Eldritch Surges
zh_tw: 詭異波動

english: Since the day Markos contacted Krokulmar, its presence has slowly warped Delphi Mansion and its residents. Krokulmar's influence is strongest in certain rooms. When a room's description calls for it, or whenever a creature casts a spell in Delphi Mansion, roll on the Eldritch Surges table to see how Krokulmar's influence manifests in that location. The surge lasts for 1 hour. Rolling on the Eldritch Surges table while a surge is already in effect causes the current surge to end.
zh_tw: 自從馬寇斯聯絡了克羅庫馬爾以來，它的存在已經慢慢扭曲了特爾裴宅邸及其居民。克羅庫馬爾的影響在某些房間最為強烈。當房間描述要求時，或者每當有生物在特爾裴宅邸施放法術時，滾動詭異波動表以檢視克羅庫馬爾的影響如何在那個地點顯現。波動持續1小時。在已經有波動效果的情況下滾動詭異波動表會導致當前波動結束。

english: The Entity
zh_tw: 實體

english: Krokulmar, the entity at the center of this adventure, is an enigmatic being from the Far Realm. Krokulmar can serve any campaign, or you can replace it with a more suitable otherworldly being.
zh_tw: 克羅庫馬爾，這次冒險中心的實體，是來自遙遠國度的神秘存在。克羅庫馬爾可以服務於任何戰役，或者您可以將其替換為更合適的異界生物。

english: Eldritch Surges
zh_tw: 詭異波動

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Surge Effect
zh_tw: 波動效果

english: The air becomes heavy and malleable. The space in the room becomes {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}. While in the room, creatures have a flying speed equal to their walking speed.
zh_tw: 空氣變得沉重且可塑。房間內的空間變成了{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。在房間內時，生物的飛行速度等於它們的步行速度。

english: Doors and windows in the room grow biting teeth. A creature that passes through a door or window in the room must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 2d4}) piercing damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
zh_tw: 房間內的門和窗戶長出了鋒利的牙齒。任何生物在透過房間內的門或窗戶時，必須成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則將受到 5 ({@dice 2d4}) 點穿刺傷害。一個生物每回合只能受到一次這種傷害。

english: Illusory magic causes one to perceive objects and creatures a short distance from their actual locations. While in the room, a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls.
zh_tw: 幻象魔法使得人們感知到的物體和生物與它們實際的位置有一定的距離。在房間內，生物在攻擊檢定上具有劣勢。

english: An animated shadow of the creature that caused the surge appears in its space while it is in the room. Until the creature leaves the room, immediately after it makes an ability check, an attack roll, or casts a spell on its turn, the shadow makes a melee spell attack ({@hit 4} to hit) against a random creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 5 ({@dice 2d4}) necrotic damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 造成波動的生物活化暗影出現在其所在空間，只要該生物仍在房間內。直到該生物離開房間前，每當它在自己的回合進行屬性檢定、攻擊檢定或施放法術時，該暗影會立即對5尺內隨機一個生物發動一次近戰法術攻擊（命中加值{@hit 4}），命中時造成5（{@dice 2d4}）點暗蝕傷害。

english: Delphi Mansion Locations
zh_tw: 特爾裴宅邸地點

english: Locations in Delphi Mansion are keyed to map 3.2.
zh_tw: 特爾裴宅邸的地點與地圖3.2相對應。

english: Map 3.2: DM's map
zh_tw: 地圖3.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: D1: Foyer
zh_tw: D1. 門廳

english: A sickly sweet scent hangs in the air of this dusty foyer. Two staircases rise from the hardwood floor to a balcony, and a glass chandelier hangs above the center of the room. Below the chandelier, the pelt of an owlbear has been made into a fine rug, its head staring at the entrance.
zh_tw: 這個佈滿灰塵的門廳裡瀰漫著一股令人作嘔的甜味。兩座樓梯從硬木地板上升起，通向一個陽臺，一個玻璃吊燈懸掛在房間中央的上方。吊燈下方，一隻梟熊的皮毛被製成了一塊精美的地毯，它的頭部凝視著入口。

english: The stairs climb to a balcony ({@adventure area D10|KftGV|3|D10: Balcony}). The ceiling here rises 30 feet from the floor. The owlbear rug weighs 50 pounds.
zh_tw: 樓梯向上通往一處陽臺（{@adventure 區域D10|KftGV|3|D10: Balcony}）。此處天花板距地面高30尺。那張梟熊地毯重50磅。

english: D2: Dining Hallway
zh_tw: D2. 餐廳走廊

english: This L-shaped hall is lined with large paintings of members of House Delphi. The ones that feature knights in silvery suits of armor have their faces scratched off.
zh_tw: 這個L形的走廊兩旁掛滿了特爾裴家族成員的大型畫像。那些畫著穿著銀色盔甲的騎士的畫像，他們的臉部都被刮花了。

english: A character who examines the armor in the paintings and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recalls that the knights belong to an order of paladins that battles extraplanar threats.
zh_tw: 一個檢查畫中盔甲的角色，若成功透過 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定，會回憶起這些騎士屬於一個對抗外層威脅的聖武士團。

english: D3: Dining Room
zh_tw: D3. 餐廳

english: Chairs and candelabras accompany a large dining table. The heads of several deer are mounted on the walls.
zh_tw: 椅子和燭臺圍繞著一張大型餐桌擺放。幾頭鹿的頭被掛在牆上。

english: A {@creature mimic} disguised as a stuffed deer head has attached itself to a blank wooden plaque mounted on a secret door in the south wall. Markos trained the mimic to guard the secret door, which leads to a hidden room (described below). The mimic attacks if a character comes within 5 feet of it.
zh_tw: 一個偽裝成填充鹿頭的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}附著在南牆上一扇秘密門上的空白木牌上。馬寇斯訓練這個擬身怪守衛秘密門，這扇門通向一個隱藏的房間（如下所述）。如果角色接近它5尺之內，擬身怪就會攻擊。

english: Hidden Room
zh_tw: 隱藏房間

english: The wooden plaque behind the mimic is a lever of sorts. A character who inspects the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots scratches around the plaque that suggest the plaque can be rotated in either direction. Doing so causes the secret door to swing inward, revealing a dusty room with several shelves. Lining the shelves are jars, most of which contain harmless liquids. Among these are six specimen jars, each containing one {@creature slaad tadpole}.
zh_tw: 模仿怪後面的木牌是一種槓桿。一個檢查牆壁並透過 {@dc 11} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現木牌周圍有劃痕，表明木牌可以向任一方向旋轉。這樣做會導緻密門向內開啟，露出一個佈滿灰塵的房間，裡面有幾個架子。架子上排列著罐子，大多數罐子裡裝著無害的液體。其中有六個標本罐，每個罐子裡裝著一隻 {@creature slaad tadpole||史拉蟾蝌蚪}。

english: Hiding in the dark corners of the hidden room are two {@creature Crawling Claw||crawling claws}. If one or more characters enter the hidden room, the claws start pushing the jars with slaad tadpoles off the shelves and onto the ground, releasing the tadpoles. On its turn, a crawling claw can move to a specimen jar and take an action to release the slaad tadpole trapped within.
zh_tw: 隱藏在隱藏房間的黑暗角落中的是兩個{@creature Crawling Claw||蠕行之爪}。如果一個或多個角色進入隱藏房間，這些爪子會開始將裝有史拉蟾蝌蚪的罐子從架子上推到地面上，釋放出蝌蚪。在它的回合，爬行爪可以移動到一個標本罐旁邊，並採取行動釋放被困在裡面的史拉蟾蝌蚪。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: On the shelf along the dining room's west wall is a small box with the Delphi family crest (a purple eye) engraved on the lid. The box is unlocked. Inside is a bag that contains 150 gp and three {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}.
zh_tw: 在餐廳西牆的架子上是一個小盒子，盒蓋上刻有特爾裴家族的徽章（一個紫色的眼睛）。盒子沒有上鎖。裡面有一個袋子，裝有150金幣和三瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

english: D4: Kitchen
zh_tw: D4. 廚房

english: This large kitchen is in poor condition. Flies cover foul-smelling messes of several meals stacked on a worktable in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 這個大廚房狀況很差。蒼蠅覆蓋著房間中央工作臺上堆積的幾頓飯菜的惡臭混亂。

english: The kitchen is in shambles. The half-eaten food on the cookery and plates has begun to rot.
zh_tw: 廚房一片狼藉。烹飪器具和盤子上的半吃剩食物已經開始腐爛。

english: {@b Chimney}. A fireplace in the middle of the east wall contains a black iron pot hung on a hook. The chimney is too narrow for Medium or Small characters to climb, but a Tiny creature could fit.
zh_tw: {@b 煙囪}。東牆中間的壁爐裡掛著一個黑色的鐵鍋，掛在一個鉤子上。這個煙囪對於中等或小型角色來說太窄，無法攀爬，但一個小型生物可以適應。

english: D5: Pantry
zh_tw: D5. 食品儲藏室

english: The pantry is well stocked, and the foodstuffs here haven't spoiled yet. A sack of potatoes rests against the east wall next to stairs that lead to the wine cellar ({@adventure area D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}).
zh_tw: 食品儲藏室儲備充足，這裡的食物尚未變質。一袋土豆靠在東牆邊，旁邊是通往酒窖（{@adventure 區域D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}）的樓梯。

english: D6: Parlor
zh_tw: D6. 客廳

english: Small circular pedestals dot the room, each one large enough to hold a couple of drinking cups. In the corners of the room stand four suits of armor. The two on the west side of the room are noticeably cleaner than the others.
zh_tw: 房間內散佈著一些小圓形基座，每個都足夠放置幾對飲酒杯。房間的角落裡擺放著四套盔甲。房間西側的兩套盔甲明顯比其他的更加乾淨。

english: The two suits of {@creature animated armor} on the west side of the room attack if a character comes within 5 feet of either of them. They fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 房間西側的兩套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}，如果角色進入它們5尺範圍內，就會發動攻擊。它們會戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: D7a: Empty Sitting Room
zh_tw: D7a. 空蕩的客廳

english: All furnishings and decorations have been removed from this room, leaving nothing but dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個房間的所有傢俱和裝飾品都已被移除，只剩下灰塵和蛛網。

english: D7b: Room with a Secret
zh_tw: D7b. 有秘密的房間

english: The walls of this sitting room are decorated with grim paintings, but all furnishings have been removed except a ten-foot-square rug in the middle of the floor and a sword mounted on the middle of the north wall.
zh_tw: 這個休息室的牆壁上裝飾著陰森的畫作，但除了地板中央的一塊十尺見方的地毯和掛在北牆中央的一把劍之外，所有的傢俱都已被移除。

english: The rug is a {@creature rug of smothering}, and the sword is a {@creature flying sword}. They both attack if a character comes within 5 feet of either.
zh_tw: 地毯是一隻{@creature rug of smothering||悶人毯}，劍是一把{@creature flying sword||凌空劍}。如果角色靠近任何一個5尺內，它們都會進行攻擊。

english: Hidden Room
zh_tw: 隱藏房間

english: A secret door in the north wall (where the flying sword hangs when it isn't attacking) leads to a hidden room. A character who examines the north wall and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds the secret door, which pushes inward easily enough.
zh_tw: 北牆上的一扇密門（在不攻擊時，飛劍懸掛於此）通向一個隱藏的房間。一個檢查北牆併成功透過 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定的角色會發現這扇密門，門向內推開相當容易。

english: The hidden room has a pair of cobwebbed chairs at one end and a dusty table at the opposite end. Tucked under the table is a small wooden chest with handles.
zh_tw: 這個隱藏的房間裡，一端有一對佈滿蛛網的椅子，另一端有一張積滿灰塵的桌子。桌子下面藏著一個帶手柄的小木箱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The wooden chest is unlocked and holds three {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell arms of Hadar}, {@spell bane}, and {@spell dimension door}) and a bag containing six pieces of jewelry worth 100 gp each.
zh_tw: 木箱沒有上鎖，裡面裝有三份{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell arms of Hadar||哈達之臂}, {@spell bane||災禍術}, 和 {@spell dimension door||任意門}）以及一個袋子，袋子裡裝有六件珠寶，每件價值100金幣。

english: D8a: Tower Ground Floor
zh_tw: D8a. 塔樓底層

english: A cold wind descends this tower staircase.
zh_tw: 一股冷風沿著這座塔樓的樓梯下降。

english: The stairs here climb 20 feet to area D8b.
zh_tw: 這裡的樓梯向上爬升20尺到達D8b區域。

english: D8b: Tower Stairs
zh_tw: D8b. 塔樓樓梯

english: The stairs here descend 20 feet to area D8a and climb 20 feet to area D8c.
zh_tw: 這裡的樓梯向下延伸20尺到達D8a區域，向上攀升20尺到達D8c區域。

english: D8c: Stargazer's Roost
zh_tw: D8c. 觀星者的巢穴

english: Rubble lies scattered across the floor where part of the roof has collapsed, revealing the sky. Perched atop the rubble is a hunched figure wrapped in a cloak. It gazes at the sky, unaware of you.
zh_tw: 部分屋頂坍塌，露出天空，碎石散落在地板上。一個彎腰的身影裹著斗篷，坐在碎石堆上，凝視著天空，沒有注意到你。

english: {@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV|薩拉·墨菲斯}

english: The cloaked figure is {@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV}, a human mage who has been transformed into a {@creature nothic}. Zala helped Markos contact Krokulmar and blames this Far Realm entity for her transformation. Now she anxiously turns to the stars, hoping to find a way to return to her human form. Zala has no interest in Markos's current activities and little knowledge about them.
zh_tw: 這個披著斗篷的身影是{@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV|薩拉·墨菲斯}，一個被變成了{@creature nothic||諾斯怪}的人類法師。薩拉幫助馬寇斯聯絡了克羅庫瑪，並將她的轉變歸咎於這個來自遙遠國度的實體。現在，她焦急地轉向星空，希望找到恢復人類形態的方法。薩拉對馬寇斯當前的活動不感興趣，也幾乎不瞭解它們。

english: Zala speaks Common, Deep Speech, and Elvish. If the characters attack her, Zala responds in kind. If they claim to be looking for {@i The Celestial Codex}, Zala advises them to search Markos's office ({@area area D11b|111|x}) or his bedroom ({@adventure area D15|KftGV|3|D15: Markos's Bedroom}).
zh_tw: 薩拉會說通用語、深潛語和精靈語。如果角色攻擊她，薩拉會以牙還牙。如果他們聲稱在尋找{@i 《天界法典》}，薩拉建議他們去馬寇斯的辦公室（{@area 區域D11b|111|x}）或他的臥室（{@adventure 區域 D15|KftGV|3|D15: Markos's Bedroom}）搜尋。

english: Zala wants a map of the Great Snake constellation from the star-map room ({@adventure area D21|KftGV|3|D21: Star-Map Room}). If the characters retrieve the map for her, Zala tells characters about the locked secret door in the wine cellar ({@adventure area D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}) along with the password ("farrl'v hrak").
zh_tw: 薩拉想要從星圖室（{@adventure 區域 D21|KftGV|3|D21: Star-Map Room}）獲得巨蛇星座的地圖。如果角色們為她取回地圖，薩拉會告訴角色們關於酒窖（{@adventure 區域D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}）中上鎖的暗門以及密碼（"farrl'v hrak"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Zala carries two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell crown of madness} and {@spell sleep}) and a {@item spellbook|PHB} that contains the following spells: {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell knock}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell phantasmal force}, {@spell shield}, and {@spell suggestion}.
zh_tw: 薩拉攜帶了兩張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell crown of madness||瘋狂冠冕}和{@spell sleep||睡眠術}），以及一本包含以下法術的{@item spellbook|PHB|法術書}：{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，{@spell knock||敲擊術}，{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}，{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}，{@spell phantasmal force||魅影之力}，{@spell shield||護盾術}，以及{@spell suggestion||暗示術}。

english: D9: Guest Bedrooms
zh_tw: D9. 客房

english: These two adjacent rooms are furnished identically:
zh_tw: 這兩個相鄰的房間裝飾得完全一樣：

english: This dusty room contains a bed, a wardrobe, and a writing desk.
zh_tw: 這個佈滿灰塵的房間裡有一張床、一個衣櫃和一張寫字檯。

english: The first character to enter the westernmost bedroom triggers a roll on the {@area Eldritch Surges table|0f2|x}.
zh_tw: 第一個進入最西邊臥室的角色會觸發在{@area 奧術激流表|0f2|x}上的滾動。

english: The easternmost bedroom contains a {@creature gibbering mouther}. It attacks any character who opens the door and fights to the death.
zh_tw: 最東邊的臥室裡有一個{@creature gibbering mouther||囈語之口}。它攻擊任何開啟門的角色，並戰鬥至死。

english: D10: Balcony
zh_tw: D10. 陽臺

english: This balcony overlooks the foyer ({@adventure area D1|KftGV|3|D1: Foyer}), the floor of which is 20 feet below.
zh_tw: 這個陽臺俯瞰著門廳（{@adventure 區域D1|KftGV|3|D1: Foyer}），其地板位於下方20尺處。

english: D11a: Empty Office
zh_tw: D11a. 空辦公室

english: All furnishings have been removed from this room, leaving nothing but dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的所有傢俱都被移走了，只剩下灰塵和蜘蛛網。

english: D11b: Markos's Office
zh_tw: D11b. 馬寇斯的辦公室

english: This room contains a black wooden desk with a cushioned, high-backed chair behind it. Two smaller chairs face the desk with their backs to the door. A niche in the northeast corner contains a wooden file cabinet.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張黑色的木製辦公桌，桌後有一把帶墊子的高背椅子。兩張較小的椅子面對著辦公桌，背對著門。東北角的壁龕裡有一個木製檔案櫃。

english: The first character to enter the office triggers a roll on the {@area Eldritch Surges table|0f2|x}.
zh_tw: 第一個進入辦公室的角色觸發在{@area 奧術激流表|0f2|x}上的滾動。

english: Correspondence
zh_tw: 通訊

english: The file cabinet in the northeast niche is unlocked and contains correspondence between Markos and other nobles. You can decide if these letters are addressed to or written by anyone of significance to the characters.
zh_tw: 東北角的檔案櫃未上鎖，裡面存放著馬寇斯與其他貴族之間的通訊。您可以決定這些信件是否是寫給或由對角色們有重要意義的人所寫。

english: {@b Desk}. The desk contains a complete set of {@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB}.
zh_tw: {@b 書桌}。書桌上擺放著一整套{@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB|書法工具}。

english: D12: Gallery
zh_tw: D12. 畫廊

english: Framed portraits and alabaster busts of members of the Delphi family decorate the walls and corners of the room, with facial expressions ranging from proud to downright haughty. Four cushioned chairs surround a table in the center of the room, on which is displayed an ivory dragonchess set.
zh_tw: 特爾裴家族成員的鑲框肖像和雪花石膏半身像裝飾著房間的牆壁和角落，面部表情從自豪到傲慢不一。四把帶墊子的椅子圍繞著房間中央的一張桌子，桌上展示著一套象牙龍棋。

english: {@b Treasure}. Two of the busts and five of the framed paintings are well made and in good condition, and each could fetch 50 gp from a collector. Each bust weighs 30 pounds, and each framed painting weighs 15 pounds. The ivory {@item dragonchess set|PHB} is worth 150 gp.
zh_tw: {@b 寶藏}。兩個半身像和五幅裝框畫製作精良且儲存完好，每件都能從收藏家那裡賣得50金幣。每個半身像重30磅，每幅裝框畫重15磅。象牙制的{@item dragonchess set|PHB|龍棋組}價值150金幣。

english: D13: Alchemy Lab
zh_tw: D13. 鍊金實驗室

english: This room reeks of chemicals. A long table with various vials and compounds occupies the center of the room. At the table, two cloaked figures oversee various alchemical experiments.
zh_tw: 這個房間散發著化學藥品的氣味。一張長桌上擺放著各種小瓶和化合物，佔據了房間的中心。在桌旁，兩個披著斗篷的身影監督著各種鍊金實驗。

english: One of the cloaked figures is Markos's head researcher, Xander (lawful evil, human {@creature cult fanatic}). The other figure is an apprentice named Kura (lawful evil, human {@creature cultist}). Both have embraced the Far Realm entity and the power it offers. Xander and Kura are indifferent toward intruders and don't attack unless the intruders aim to harm them or hinder their research.
zh_tw: 其中一位披著斗篷的人物是馬寇斯的首席研究員，桑德爾（守序邪惡，人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}）。另一位是名叫庫拉的學徒（守序邪惡，人類{@creature cultist||邪教徒}）。他們都已接受了來自遙遠國度實體的力量。桑德爾和庫拉對入侵者漠不關心，除非入侵者打算傷害他們或妨礙他們的研究，否則他們不會發動攻擊。

english: Xander and Kura don't keep track of Markos's movements, but they know he has been spending a lot of time in the caves below the basement ({@adventure area D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room}). They assume {@i The Celestial Codex} is with Markos or in his bedroom ({@adventure area D15|KftGV|3|D15: Markos's Bedroom}).
zh_tw: 贊德和庫拉不追蹤馬寇斯的行蹤，但他們知道他最近在地下室下方的洞穴（{@adventure 區域D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room}）裡待了很長時間。他們推測{@i 《天界法典》}與馬寇斯在一起或在他的臥室（{@adventure 區域 D15|KftGV|3|D15: Markos's Bedroom}）裡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters can assemble two sets of {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} (50 gp each) from the contents of this lab. Among the various concoctions found throughout the room are four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, a {@item potion of gaseous form}, a vial containing {@item oil of slipperiness}, and a vial with one dose of {@item assassin's blood} poison (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG|8|Poisons}).
zh_tw: 角色們可以從這個實驗室的內容中組裝兩套{@item alchemist's supplies|PHB|鍊金工具}（每套50金幣）。在房間各處發現的各種混合物中，有四瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}，一瓶{@item potion of gaseous form||氣化形體藥水}，一瓶含有{@item oil of slipperiness||滑溜之油}的小瓶，以及一瓶含有一劑{@item assassin's blood||刺客之血}毒藥（見{@book 城主指南|DMG|8|Poisons}）。

english: D14: Meditation Room
zh_tw: D14. 冥想室

english: A fetid stench permeates this room, which is empty save for two small, bare tables standing against the west wall and an ornate rug in front of the window. Resting next to the rug is a wooden candlestick holding the melted stump of a red candle. A long pull-rope hangs from a wooden trapdoor in the ceiling.
zh_tw: 這個房間瀰漫著一股惡臭，除了靠西牆放著兩張小的空桌子和窗戶前的一塊華麗的地毯外，房間裡空無一物。地毯旁邊放著一個木製燭臺，上面插著一支紅色蠟燭的融化殘餘。一根長長的拉繩從天花板上的一個木製活板門垂下。

english: There's no obvious source for the horrible smell that lingers here. The first character who enters the room triggers a roll on the {@area Eldritch Surges table|0f2|x}.
zh_tw: 這裡瀰漫著一股難以忍受的惡臭，但並沒有明顯的來源。第一個進入房間的角色會觸發一次在{@area 奧術激流表|0f2|x}上的滾動。

english: Markos used to sit on the rug and meditate while pondering the forces of the multiverse, but he hasn't used this room in a while.
zh_tw: 馬寇斯過去常常坐在地毯上冥想，同時思考多元宇宙的力量，但他已經有一段時間沒有使用這個房間了。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: The trapdoor in the ceiling leads to the master bath ({@adventure area D17|KftGV|3|D17: Bathroom}). An unfolding wooden ladder allows easy access.
zh_tw: 天花板上的活板門通往主浴室 ({@adventure 區域D17|KftGV|3|D17: Bathroom})。一個可展開的木梯便於通行。

english: D15: Markos's Bedroom
zh_tw: D15. 馬寇斯的臥室

english: This room contains a bed with an ornately carved frame, a wardrobe, a writing desk, and a leather chair. A fireplace stands along the east wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張床，床架上雕刻精美，還有一個衣櫃、一張寫字檯和一把皮椅。東牆上有一個壁爐。

english: Behind the headboard of the bed is a secret door to a hidden walk-in closet. A character who examines the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers not only the secret door but also a secret button on the headboard. Pushing the button causes the bed to slide eastward, allowing easy access to the hidden closet.
zh_tw: 床頭的後部是一個通往隱藏步入式衣櫥的秘密門。一個檢查牆壁並在 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功的角色不僅會發現這扇秘密門，還會發現床頭上的一個秘密按鈕。按下按鈕會使床向東滑動，從而輕鬆進入隱藏的衣櫥。

english: {@b Hidden Closet}. This closet contains clothing on hooks and shelves, plus an assortment of footwear. On a small table against the east wall sits an iron lockbox. A character using thieves' tools can try to pick the lock, which requires 1 minute and a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: {@b 隱藏的壁櫥}. 這個衣櫃在鉤子和架子上放著衣物，還有各種鞋類。在東牆邊的小桌上放著一個鐵製保險箱。角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試撬鎖，這需要 1 分鐘和一個成功的 {@dc 14} 敏捷檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The lockbox contains an amethyst cloak pin shaped like an eye (125 gp) and a {@item ring of jumping}.
zh_tw: 這個鎖盒裡有一個紫水晶製成的眼形斗篷別針（125金幣）和一個{@item ring of jumping||跳躍戒指}。

english: D16: Student Quarters
zh_tw: D16. 學生宿舍

english: These rooms were set aside for Markos's pupils, who shared his drive for knowledge but didn't share in their master's reward for contacting Krokulmar. The pupils fled the mansion after Markos made his pact. Each room now contains two {@creature Gray Ooze||psychic gray oozes} (see the "Variant: Psychic Gray Ooze" sidebar in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}) that mill about. They attack intruders on sight.
zh_tw: 這些房間是為馬寇斯的學生們準備的，他們與馬寇斯一樣渴望知識，但沒有分享到他們導師因聯絡克羅庫瑪而得到的獎賞。馬寇斯締約後，學生們逃離了這座大廈。現在每個房間都包含了兩隻{@creature Gray Ooze||心靈灰泥怪}（詳見《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中的"變體：靈能灰色軟泥怪"側邊欄）。它們在房間內徘徊，一見到入侵者就會發動攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the northernmost room find a {@item spellbook|PHB} that contains the following spells: {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell identify}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell Tasha's hideous laughter}, and {@spell unseen servant}.
zh_tw: 搜尋最北邊房間的角色找到一個{@item spellbook|PHB|法術書}，其中包含以下法術：{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，{@spell identify||鑑定術}，{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}，{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}，{@spell Tasha's hideous laughter||塔莎狂笑術}，以及{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}。

english: D17: Bathroom
zh_tw: D17. 浴室

english: A raised marble tub occupies this room. Near it are two marble sinks with oval mirrors mounted above them, a fireplace, and a small table against the east wall that has a colorful collection of bottles atop it.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一個大理石製成的高腳浴缸。靠近它的是兩個大理石洗手盆，上面掛著橢圓形的鏡子，東牆上有一個壁爐，還有一個靠牆的小桌子，上面擺著一排色彩繽紛的瓶子。

english: The tub and sinks have pipes that draw rainwater from cisterns on the roof. Further, each basin is equipped with a plugged drainpipe and two faucets: one that magically heats water and one that magically cools it.
zh_tw: 浴缸和洗手盆有管道，可以從屋頂的蓄水池中引雨水。此外，每個洗手盆都配備了一個堵塞的排水管和兩個水龍頭：一個能神奇地加熱水，另一個能神奇地冷卻水。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Four bottles of perfumes and scented oils (25 gp each) sit on the small table.
zh_tw: 四瓶香水和香精油（每瓶25金幣）放在小桌子上。

english: Alchemy is afoot in Delphi Mansion
zh_tw: 特爾裴莊園里正在進行鍊金術

english: D18: Third-Floor Hall
zh_tw: D18. 三樓走廊

english: This hallway has become a lair for {@creature Stirge||stirges}—two per character. The stirges entered the mansion through the hole in the roof above {@area area D8c|10a|x}. They attack anyone who tries to cross the hall.
zh_tw: 這個走廊已經成為{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}的巢穴——每個角色對應兩隻。螞蟥透過{@area 區域D8c|10a|x}上方屋頂的洞進入了這座大廈。它們會攻擊任何試圖穿越走廊的人。

english: D19: Eldritch Observation Room
zh_tw: D19. 奧術觀察室

english: This room is empty except for a circle of vile symbols on the floor. Standing in the circle is an eight-foot-tall, bipedal creature with two long arms, each one ending in a sharp hook. The creature wears the tattered remnants of a butler's uniform.
zh_tw: 這個房間除了地板上的一圈邪惡符號外是空的。站在圓圈中是一個八尺高的雙足生物，它有兩個長臂，每隻手臂末端都有一個鋒利的鉤子。這個生物穿著破舊的管家制服殘片。

english: The first character who enters the room triggers a roll on the {@area Eldritch Surges table|0f2|x}.
zh_tw: 第一個進入房間的角色會觸發在{@area 奧術激流表|0f2|x}上的滾動。

english: Circle of Symbols
zh_tw: 符號圈

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around the circle on the floor. A creature standing fully inside the circle feels the unsettling presence of a Far Realm entity and can choose to receive an omen from that entity, as if the creature had cast an {@spell augury} spell. After receiving such an omen, the creature can't receive another one for 24 hours but still feels the otherworldly presence while inside the circle.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了地板上圓圈周圍有占卜魔法的氣息。一個完全站在圓圈內的生物會感到來自遙遠國度的實體的不安存在，並且可以選擇從那個實體那裡接收一個徵兆，就好像生物施放了{@spell augury||卜筮術}法術一樣。接收到這樣的徵兆後，生物在接下來的24小時內不能再接收另一個徵兆，但在圓圈內仍然能感覺到超自然的存在感。

english: Esquire
zh_tw: 侍從

english: The hook-handed figure is Markos's former butler, Esquire (use the {@creature hook horror} stat block). Esquire isn't bound inside the circle and attacks intruders on sight. He doesn't know the cause of his transformation. If the characters explain that an evil entity is responsible for Esquire's transformation or that Markos might be in danger from this entity, Esquire lets them live if they vow to save Markos.
zh_tw: 這個鉤手的人物是馬寇斯的前管家，侍從（使用{@creature hook horror||恐爪怪}的統計資料塊）。侍從沒有被束縛在圈內，一見到入侵者就會攻擊。他不知道自己變形的原因。如果角色們解釋說一個邪惡實體是侍從變形的原因，或者馬寇斯可能因這個實體而處於危險之中，侍從會讓他們活下去，如果他們發誓要救馬寇斯的話。

english: Esquire's tattered butler uniform has a pocket containing a locket and a note. The locket is under the effects of a {@spell magic mouth} spell; when opened, it speaks the password to the temple ({@adventure area D24|KftGV|3|D24: Temple}), "farrl'v hrak," which is Deep Speech for "forever changing." The note contains a sketch of a wine bottle and a row of four circles. The second circle from the left is crossed out. (The circles represent the casks in {@adventure area D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}, the crossed-out one representing the cask blocking a secret door.)
zh_tw: 侍從的破爛管家制服口袋裡裝有一個掛墜盒和一張便條。掛墜盒受到{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}法術影響；開啟時會說出通往廟宇（{@adventure 區域 D24|KftGV|3|D24: Temple}）的密碼"farrl'v hrak"，這是深潛語中"永遠變化"的意思。便條上畫著一個酒瓶和四個排成一排的圓圈，左起第二個圓圈被劃掉了。（這些圓圈代表{@adventure 區域D23|KftGV|3|D23: Wine Cellar}中的酒桶，被劃掉的圓圈代表擋住暗門的那個酒桶。）

english: A bubbling green potion contains a Far Realm surprise
zh_tw: 一瓶冒泡的綠色藥水含有來自遙遠國度的驚喜

english: D20: Component Storage
zh_tw: D20. 元件儲存室

english: This walk-in closet contains four cabinets, each one filled with carefully organized material components.
zh_tw: 這個步入式衣櫥裡有四個櫃子，每個櫃子裡都裝滿了精心整理的材料成分。

english: {@b Treasure}. Characters who search the cabinets can find a material component for any 1st- or 2nd-level spell, provided the component has a value less than 1 gp. Characters also find a potion, its bubbling green liquid stained by a drop of some dark substance (octopus ink).
zh_tw: {@b 寶藏}。搜尋櫥櫃的角色可以找到一個任何1級或2環法術的材料成分，前提是該成分的價值小於1金幣。角色們還找到了一瓶藥劑，其冒泡的綠色液體被一些黑色物質（墨魚墨水）染上了汙點。

english: The alchemists in {@adventure area D13|KftGV|3|D13: Alchemy Lab} concocted the potion, which functions as a {@item potion of poison} but has an additional property. When the poison effect ends, the imbiber sprouts a tentacle made of inky shadow. This shadowy tentacle lasts for 1 hour. As a bonus action, the potion's imbiber can use the tentacle to make a melee weapon attack ({@hit 4} to hit) against a creature the imbiber can see within 5 feet of itself. On a hit, the target takes 4 ({@dice 1d8}) necrotic damage.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 區域D13|KftGV|3|D13: Alchemy Lab}的鍊金術師們調製了這種藥水，其功能如同{@item potion of poison||劇毒藥水}但具有額外特性。當毒藥效果結束時，飲用者會長出一條由墨色幽影構成的觸鬚。這條幽影觸鬚持續1小時。作為附贈動作，藥水飲用者可以使用觸鬚對自身5尺內可見的生物進行一次近戰武器攻擊（{@hit 4}命中）。若命中，目標受到4（{@dice 1d8}）暗蝕傷害。

english: D21: Star-Map Room
zh_tw: D21. 星圖室

english: The walls and floor of this room are covered with star maps. The {@creature ghost} of an elf researcher named Farenhel wanders the room, looking through the maps and searching for an answer the ghost will never find. The ghost is harmless and attacks only in self-defense or if a character tries to steal a star map. The ghost stops attacking as soon as the stolen map is returned.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁和地板上都覆蓋著星圖。一個名叫法倫赫爾的精靈研究員的{@creature ghost||幽魂}在房間裡徘徊，瀏覽星圖並尋找一個幽靈永遠找不到的答案。這個幽靈是無害的，只有在自衛或角色試圖偷竊星圖時才會攻擊。一旦被偷的星圖歸還，幽靈就會停止攻擊。

english: Characters who examine the maps closely find one that depicts a constellation called the Great Snake. This is the map sought by the nothic {@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV} (see {@area area D8c|10a|x}).
zh_tw: 仔細檢查地圖的角色會發現一張描繪名為大蛇星座的地圖。這是諾斯怪（{@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV|薩拉·墨菲斯}）所尋找的地圖（見{@area 區域D8c|10a|x}）。

english: D22: Storage Rooms
zh_tw: D22. 儲藏室

english: Each of these unfurnished rooms contains two {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} that were attracted to the mansion by Far Realm energies. The ghouls are hostile.
zh_tw: 這些沒有傢俱的房間裡每個都含有兩隻被遙遠國度能量吸引到莊園的{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}。這些食屍鬼具有敵意。

english: D23: Wine Cellar
zh_tw: D23. 酒窖

english: The faint aroma of grapes fills the air in this cellar. Four large wine casks stand against the west wall, a fine layer of dust covering each of them. The three wine racks to the south are empty.
zh_tw: 這個地窖裡瀰漫著淡淡的葡萄香氣。四個大酒桶靠在西牆上，每個桶上都覆蓋著一層細塵。南邊的三個酒架是空的。

english: Three of the wine casks contain varying amounts of wine. The fourth cask is empty and positioned in front of a secret door in the west wall. Characters who examine the empty cask see handprints on it, suggesting it has been moved multiple times. The characters also feel cold air coming from the wall, suggesting the presence of a secret door. The wine cask must be moved aside to access the secret door.
zh_tw: 三個酒桶中裝有不同量的葡萄酒。第四個酒桶是空的，它位於西牆前的一個秘密門前。檢查空酒桶的角色可以看到上面的手印，這表明它已經被移動了多次。角色們還感覺到從牆壁吹來的冷風，暗示著有一個秘密門的存在。必須將酒桶移開才能進入秘密門。

english: {@b Secret Door}. An {@spell arcane lock} spell has been cast on the secret door. The password to bypass the spell is "farrl'v hrak," which is Deep Speech for "forever changing." Esquire's locket (see {@adventure area D19|KftGV|3|D19: Eldritch Observation Room}) speaks the password when opened.
zh_tw: {@b 暗門}。一道{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術已被施放在這扇暗門上。繞過該法術的口令是"farrl'v hrak"，這是深潛語中"永恆變幻"的意思。侍從的掛墜盒（見{@adventure 區域D19|KftGV|3|D19: Eldritch Observation Room}）在開啟時會說出這個口令。

english: Alternatively, a character can use an action to try to force open the locked secret door, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 或者，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試強行開啟鎖住的秘門，成功透過 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。

english: D24: Temple
zh_tw: D24. 神廟

english: Four wooden pews face a stone statue in the middle of this torchlit chamber. The statue has a roughly bipedal shape and is carved to look like it's coming undone, like a frayed rope. Its form is covered with mouths and outstretched tongues.
zh_tw: 四條木製長凳面向這個火把照亮的房間中央的石雕。這尊雕像大致呈兩足動物形狀，雕刻得看起來像是正在解體，就像一根磨損的繩子。它的形態上佈滿了嘴巴和伸出的舌頭。

english: Standing before the statue are four purple-cloaked figures, their faces hidden by cowls. They are writing on pieces of paper and muttering to each other, oblivious to your presence.
zh_tw: 站在雕像前的四個身披紫色斗篷的人，他們的臉龐被兜帽遮住。他們正在紙上寫著什麼，彼此低聲交談，對你的存在毫無察覺。

english: The arcane energies in this room are particularly volatile. The first character who enters the room triggers a roll on the {@area Eldritch Surges table|0f2|x}. After the surge begins, on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), roll again on the Eldritch Surges table.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的奧術能量特別不穩定。第一個進入房間的角色會觸發在{@area 奧術激流表|0f2|x}上的滾動。湧動開始後，在主動性計數20（在主動性平局中失敗）時，再次在奧術湧動表上滾動。

english: Cloaked Figures
zh_tw: 披著斗篷的人物

english: The cloaked figures are four neutral, human {@creature Cultist||cultists} who are taking notes on the eldritch surges that occur in this area. These cultists defend themselves if attacked but otherwise pose no threat. They know Markos is performing a ritual in {@adventure area D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room} but won't share this information until the statue is destroyed.
zh_tw: 這些披著斗篷的人物是四名中立的人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，他們正在記錄該區域發生的詭異波動。這些邪教徒在受到攻擊時會自衛，但除此之外不構成威脅。他們知道馬寇斯正在{@adventure 區域D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room}進行儀式，但在雕塑被摧毀前不會透露此資訊。

english: {@b Statue}. The statue depicts Krokulmar and was created with the aid of a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell stone shape}. Any creature that touches the statue for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: {@b 雕像}. 這座雕像描繪了克羅庫瑪，並使用了{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}上的{@spell stone shape||塑石術}協助鑄造。任何在一回閤中首次觸控雕像的生物必須透過一個{@dc 11}的感知豁免檢定，否則將受到3 ({@dice 1d6})點心靈傷害。

english: The statue amplifies the eldritch surges, which a character can ascertain by examining the statue and then succeeding on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. If the statue is destroyed, the eldritch surges stop occurring throughout the mansion. The statue is a Medium object with AC 17, 36 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 雕像放大了那些詭異的能量波動，角色可以透過檢查雕像併成功進行一次 {@dc 15} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定來確認這一點。如果雕像被摧毀，整個宅邸中的詭異能量波動將停止發生。雕像是一箇中型物體，AC為17，擁有36點生命值，且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: D25: Storage
zh_tw: D25. 儲藏

english: Four severed heads and three headless bodies lie on the floor of this room, which also contains four small crates in the far corner.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上躺著四個被割下的頭顱和三具無頭屍體，房間的遠角還有四個小箱子。

english: The severed heads and decapitated bodies belong to Elra Lionheart and her three human adventuring companions. The body of one of Elra's companions is missing (and can be found in {@adventure area D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room}).
zh_tw: 被斬斷的頭顱和無頭的屍體屬於艾爾拉·萊昂哈特和她的三位人類冒險同伴。艾爾拉其中一位同伴的屍體失蹤了（可以在{@adventure 區域D27|KftGV|3|D27: Ritual Room}找到）。

english: If Elra is with the characters (see "{@area Meeting Elra|0eb|x}" earlier in this adventure), she mourns her dead companions and hopes there might be a way to bring her and her friends back from the dead.
zh_tw: 如果埃爾拉與角色們在一起（見本冒險早期的"{@area 會見埃爾拉|0eb|x}"），她會哀悼她死去的同伴，並希望有辦法讓她和她的朋友們從死亡中復活。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Four small crates rest in the northwest corner. One contains a set of gold-plated cups and plates worth 200 gp total. Another contains a {@item wand of magic missiles} hidden in a pile of straw. The third contains 20 days' worth of edible {@item Rations (1 day)|PHB|rations}. The final crate contains a dozen {@item Torch|PHB|torches} and three flasks of {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|alchemist's fire}.
zh_tw: 四個小箱子放在西北角。其中一個裝有一套鍍金的杯子和盤子，總共價值200金幣。另一個箱子裡藏著一根{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}，藏在稻草堆裡。第三個箱子裡有足夠20天食用的{@item Rations (1 day)|PHB|口糧}。最後一個箱子裡裝有一打{@item Torch|PHB|火把}和三個{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|熾火膠}的瓶子。

english: D26a: Vestry
zh_tw: D26a. 聖器室

english: This dusty chamber contains four unlocked wooden trunks, each of which contains four dark-purple silk robes.
zh_tw: 這個積滿灰塵的房間內含有四個未上鎖的木製箱子，每個箱子裡都裝有四件深紫色的絲綢長袍。

english: D26b: Ceremony Room
zh_tw: D26b. 儀式室

english: Iron brackets bolted to the walls hold four sputtering torches that cast this otherwise empty room in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. On the far side of the room, a spiral staircase descends into darkness. From below, you hear a human voice chanting in a blasphemous tongue.
zh_tw: 螺栓固定在牆壁上的鐵支架託著四支噼啪作響的火把，為這間原本空無一物的房間提供了{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。在房間的遠端，一段螺旋樓梯向下延伸，沒入黑暗之中。從下方傳來一個人類的聲音，正用一種褻瀆的語言吟唱著。

english: The spiral staircase descends 20 feet to area {@dice D27}. The voice rising up the stairs is chanting in Deep Speech, calling to an entity named Krokulmar.
zh_tw: 螺旋樓梯下降20尺到達區域{@dice D27}。樓梯上升起的聲音用深潛語唸誦，呼喚一個名為克羅庫瑪的實體。

english: D27: Ritual Room
zh_tw: D27. 儀式室

english: This location consists of two roughly circular caves joined by an opening. The staircase from area D26b leads to the southern cave, which is empty. From the stairs, characters can see activity in the northern cave:
zh_tw: 這個地點由兩個大致呈圓形的洞穴組成，它們透過一個開口相連。來自D26b區域的樓梯通向南方的洞穴，南方的洞穴是空的。從樓梯上，角色可以看到北方洞穴中的活動：

english: The staircase leads to a roughly circular cave that is empty and unlit. Opposite the stairs, though a twelve-foot-wide archway, you see a similar cavern lit by purple light emanating from four large crystals jutting from the floor. All crystals flicker in concert with the chanting that echoes through the caves.
zh_tw: 樓梯通向一個大致呈圓形的洞穴，這個洞穴空無一物且沒有照明。在樓梯的對面，透過一個十二尺寬的拱門，你看到一個類似的洞穴，由從地面突出的四個大水晶發出的紫色光芒照亮。所有水晶隨著洞穴中迴盪的唸誦聲一起閃爍。

english: The chants come from a sallow, dark-robed figure who stands near the edge of a circle of arcane runes inscribed on the floor. The figure recites an eldritch passage from a book, then carefully sets the book atop a wooden crate near the back wall. The figure turns toward the circle, wherein kneels a {@creature headless body|KftGV} in plate armor. A sluglike creature has attached itself to the body's neck, almost like a makeshift head. The slug's form is covered with mouths and eyes that open and close in and out of existence.
zh_tw: 唸誦聲來自一個面色蒼白、身穿黑袍的身影，他站在地板上刻著奧術符文的圓圈邊緣。這個身影從一本書中唸誦一段奧術篇章，然後小心翼翼地將書放在靠近後牆的木箱上。這個身影轉向圓圈，圓圈內跪著一個穿著板甲的{@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體}。一個類似蛞蝓的生物附著在這個身體的脖子上，幾乎像是一個臨時的頭部。這個蛞蝓形態的生物身上覆蓋著不斷開合的嘴巴和眼睛。

english: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV} is performing a ritual that will allow a {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} (see their {@area stat blocks|140|x} at the end of the adventure) to attach to the {@creature headless body|KftGV} of one of Elra's adventuring companions, thus enabling a piece of Krokulmar to exist outside the Far Realm. The {@creature headless body|KftGV} is {@condition stunned} and remains so until the ritual is complete. It is possible to attack the fragment without harming the {@creature headless body|KftGV}.
zh_tw: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV|馬寇斯·特爾裴} 正在執行一個儀式，這個儀式將允許一個{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}（在冒險的末尾檢視他們的{@area 資料卡|140|x}）附著到埃爾拉的一位冒險夥伴的{@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體}上，從而使克羅庫瑪的一部分能夠在遙遠國度之外存在。{@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體}處於{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態，直到儀式完成。可以攻擊碎片而不傷害{@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體}。

english: The Celestial Codex
zh_tw: 《天界法典》

english: On each of his turns in combat, Markos defends himself while taking a bonus action to continue the ritual. If he's able to take this bonus action three more times, the {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} takes control of the {@creature headless body|KftGV}, at which point the body is no longer {@condition stunned}.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，馬寇斯在每個回合都會自衛，同時使用附贈動作繼續進行儀式。如果他能再進行三次這樣的附贈動作，{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}將控制{@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體}，此時身體不再處於{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態。

english: The {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} and the body to which it is attached are considered two creatures occupying the same space. Neither can be separated from the other until one or both of them drop to 0 hit points, at which point the {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} returns to the Far Realm. While under the fragment's control, the body uses the {@creature knight} stat block, has {@sense blindsight} within a range of 30 feet, is blind beyond this radius, and acts immediately after the fragment in the initiative order. The fragment determines what the body does on the body's turn.
zh_tw: {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}與它所附著的軀體被視為佔據同一空間的兩個生物。在它們中的一個或兩個生命值降為0之前，兩者無法被分開，此時{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}會返回至遙遠國度。在碎片的控制下，軀體使用{@creature knight||騎士}的統計資料塊，在30尺的範圍內擁有{@sense blindsight||盲視}，超出此範圍則處於失明狀態，並且在先攻順序中緊隨碎片之後行動。碎片決定軀體在其回合中的行動。

english: The fragment uses the body to protect itself from harm and to destroy the characters.
zh_tw: 這個碎片利用身體來保護自己免受傷害並摧毀角色。

english: Helping Markos
zh_tw: 幫助馬寇斯

english: As an action, a character can make a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to try to convince Markos he's being controlled. If the check fails, nothing happens and the action is wasted. If the check succeeds, Markos has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of his next turn as he wrestles with the possibility that he's not in control of his actions.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以進行一個 {@dc 14} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，試圖說服馬寇斯他正被控制。如果檢定失敗，無事發生，並且該動作被浪費。如果檢定成功，馬寇斯在他的下一回合結束前，攻擊擲骰和能力檢定都處於劣勢，因為他掙扎於可能無法控制自己行為的可能性。

english: {@b Crystals}. As a bonus action, a character can make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) to ascertain the purpose of the large crystals sprouting from the floor. These crystals focus the ritual's extraplanar energy, allowing the {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} to remain on the Material Plane long enough for it to bond with the {@creature headless body|KftGV}. A character who succeeds on the check also knows that destroying all four crystals stops the ritual. Each crystal is a Large object with AC 13, 10 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: {@b 晶體}. 作為一個附加動作，一個角色可以進行一次 {@dc 15} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定來確定從地板上生長出來的大水晶的作用。這些水晶集中了儀式的異界能量，使得 {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節} 能夠在物質界停留足夠長的時間以與 {@creature headless body|KftGV|無頭屍體} 結合。成功透過檢定的角色也知道，摧毀所有四個水晶將停止儀式。每個水晶是一個大型物體，AC 13，10 點生命值，對鈍擊和雷鳴傷害有易傷，對毒素和精神傷害有免疫。

english: Each time a crystal is destroyed, Markos has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of his next turn as he confronts the possibility that he might not be in control of his actions.
zh_tw: 每當一個水晶被摧毀時，馬寇斯在下一次回合結束前的所有攻擊卷和屬性檢定上都有劣勢，因為他面對自己可能無法控制自己行為的可能性。

english: {@b Ending the Threat}. If all four crystals are destroyed, if Krokulmar or the body it's attached to drops to 0 hit points, or if Markos drops to 0 hit points before the ritual is completed, the {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} returns to the Far Realm. Sending the fragment back to the Far Realm ends the eldritch surges in Delphi Mansion, frees Markos from Krokulmar's influence (see "Conclusion" below), restores {@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV} and Esquire to their former human selves, and causes the cultists in area {@dice D24} to flee.
zh_tw: {@b 結束威脅}。如果所有四個水晶都被摧毀，或者克羅庫瑪或它附著的身體降至0點生命值，或者在儀式完成前馬寇斯降至0點生命值，{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}將返回遙遠國度。將碎片送回遙遠國度將結束特爾裴宅邸中的奧術湧動，使馬寇斯擺脫克羅庫瑪的影響（見下文的"結論"），恢復{@creature Zala Morphus|KftGV|薩拉·墨菲斯}和侍從到他們以前的人類形態，並導致區域{@dice D24}的邪教徒逃離。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The book resting on the crate is The Celestial Codex. A {@spell mage hand} spell can easily lift the book. An {@condition invisible} character can sneak across the room and try to steal the book without Markos noticing, doing so with a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. On a failed check, Markos detects the theft. Although he no longer needs the book to complete the ritual, Markos won't give it up without a fight while he's under Krokulmar's influence. Once free of that influence, Markos is horrified by his actions and gladly gives up the book (see "{@area Markos Lives|13d|x}").
zh_tw: 放在板條箱上的書是《天界法典》。一個{@spell mage hand||法師之手}法術可以輕鬆地抬起這本書。一個{@condition invisible||隱形}的角色可以偷偷穿過房間，嘗試在馬寇斯沒有注意到的情況下偷走這本書，透過一個成功的{@dc 14}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，馬寇斯會察覺到盜竊行為。儘管他不再需要這本書來完成儀式，但在克羅庫瑪的影響下，馬寇斯不會放棄書而不進行戰鬥。一旦擺脫了這種影響，馬寇斯對自己的行為感到驚恐，並樂意交出這本書（見"{@area 馬寇斯 生存|13d|x}"）。

english: {@i The Celestial Codex} is filled with arcane lore about the stars and the planes of existence. Nestled among its benign descriptions are eldritch incantations written in Celestial, and tucked between the book's pages are two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell armor of Agathys} and {@spell arms of Hadar}).
zh_tw: 《{@i 《天界法典》}》充滿了關於星辰和存在的位面的奧術知識。在其溫和的描述中，夾雜著用天界語書寫的奧術咒語，書頁之間還夾著兩張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell armor of Agathys||黯冰獄鎧}和{@spell arms of Hadar||哈達之臂}）。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: If the characters obtain {@i The Celestial Codex}, they can return the book to its rightful owner and claim their reward.
zh_tw: 如果角色獲得了{@i 《天界法典》}，他們可以將書歸還給其合法的所有者並領取獎勵。

english: Markos Dies
zh_tw: 馬寇斯死亡

english: If Markos dies, the characters can return his body to his family. The Delphi family gives each character 150 gp for bringing Markos home and pays to have Markos raised from the dead.
zh_tw: 如果馬寇斯死亡，角色們可以將他的遺體送回他的家族。特爾裴家族給每位角色150金幣作為將馬寇斯帶回家的報酬，並支付復活馬寇斯的費用。

english: Markos Lives
zh_tw: 馬寇斯生存

english: Defeating the {@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV} frees Markos from the evil entity's influence, at which point Markos is eager to make amends for the trouble he has caused. He allows the characters to keep whatever treasure they found in the mansion.
zh_tw: 擊敗{@creature fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}使馬寇斯擺脫了邪惡實體的影響，此時馬寇斯急於彌補他所造成的麻煩。他允許角色們保留他們在莊園中發現的所有寶藏。

english: If Markos is reunited with his family, the family gives 150 gp to each character as a reward.
zh_tw: 如果馬寇斯與家人團聚，家人會給每個角色150金幣作為獎勵。

english: Dead Adventurers
zh_tw: 死去的冒險者

english: If the characters recount the horrors of Delphi Mansion to Markos's family, the family makes arrangements to rid the mansion of any remaining monsters. The bodies of adventurers who were killed in the mansion (including Elra and her companions) are brought to a temple, where they are raised or resurrected at the Delphi family's expense. If the characters are present when Elra's life is restored, she congratulates them on their heroism and looks forward to one day repaying the favor.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向馬寇斯的家人敘述特爾裴莊園的恐怖事件，這個家庭會做出安排，清除莊園中所有剩餘的怪物。在莊園中被殺的冒險者（包括埃爾拉和她的同伴）的屍體被帶到一個神廟，在那裡他們被以特爾裴家族的費用復活或恢復生命。如果角色們在埃爾拉的生命恢復時在場，她會祝賀他們的英勇行為，並期待著將來有一天能夠回報這份恩情。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization's representative approaches them after their harrowing experience at Delphi Mansion. For returning {@i The Celestial Codex} to its rightful owner, the characters are promised an uncommon magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，該組織的代表將在他們在特爾裴公館的驚險經歷後接近他們。為了將{@i 《天界法典》}歸還給其合法所有者，角色們被承諾可以選擇一件不常見的魔法物品（需經你批准）作為報酬。物品將在第二天交付給角色們。

english: Stat Blocks
zh_tw: 資料卡

english: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Markos Delphi|KftGV|馬寇斯·特爾裴}

english: {@creature Fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Fragment of Krokulmar|KftGV|克羅庫瑪肢節}

english: Prisoner 13
zh_tw: 十三號囚犯

english: {@i An Adventure for 4th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合4級角色的冒險}

english: On the world of Toril, in the frozen reaches north of the Sword Coast, lies an impenetrable fortress built to house the region's most dangerous criminals. One of this prison's earliest inmates, a dwarf known as {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}, spends her days in seeming quiet and solitude while secretly pulling the strings of a spy network that spans much of the continent. She holds the key to a treasure she stole from a dwarf clan. In this heist, the characters must infiltrate the prison, retrieve the key from {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} (found in a tattoo on her hand), and return the key to Varrin Axebreaker, the dwarf who hired them.
zh_tw: 在託瑞爾世界，在劍海岸北部的冰冷地區，有一座堅不可摧的堡壘，建造它的目的是為了關押該地區最危險的罪犯。這個監獄的早期囚犯之一，一個被稱為{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}的矮人，她在外表上過著看似平靜和孤獨的生活，同時秘密地操縱著一個遍佈大陸大部分地區的間諜網路。她擁有一把她從一個矮人氏族那裡偷來的寶藏的鑰匙。在這個搶劫案中，角色們必須潛入監獄，從{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}那裡取回鑰匙（在她手上的紋身中找到），並將鑰匙交還給僱傭他們的矮人瓦林·碎斧。

english: Perched on a windswept bluff is the prison of Revel's End, wherein waits {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}
zh_tw: 坐落在風掃的峭壁上的是瑞維爾的終結監獄，裡面等待著{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} is a dwarf named Korda Glintstone. Prior to her incarceration years ago, Korda was an ally and agent of Clan Axebreaker, a moderately influential dwarf clan in a stronghold called Gauntlgrym. Korda built a network of informants and agents, ostensibly all to the benefit of Clan Axebreaker. With each success, she paid tattooists to inscribe a memorial of her triumph onto her skin. Using ancient rituals, Korda infused many of these artful etchings with the magic of Gauntlgrym's forges, granting her wondrous gifts.
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 是一位名叫柯達·閃石的矮人。在多年前被監禁之前，柯達是碎斧氏族家族的盟友和代理人，這是一個在名為岡特格里的要塞中具有中等影響力的矮人家族。柯達建立了一個由情報員和代理人組成的網路，表面上看都是為了碎斧氏族的利益。隨著每一次成功，她都會讓紋身師在她的皮膚上刻下她勝利的紀念。利用古老的儀式，柯達將這些藝術性的雕刻中的許多注入了岡特格里鍛造場的魔力，賦予了她奇妙的禮物。

english: Korda grew too ambitious for her role as an agent, so she devised a plan to take power for herself. Over five years she took careful stock of Clan Axebreaker's wealth and, in one fell swoop, used her network of lieutenants to steal away most of the clan's gold, leaving only a pittance.
zh_tw: 柯達對於她作為特工的角色過於雄心勃勃，於是她設計了一個計劃，為自己奪取權力。在五年的時間裡，她仔細盤點了碎斧氏族的財富，並在一次突然行動中，利用她的副手網路偷走了氏族的大部分黃金，只留下了很少的一部分。

english: The Axebreaker dwarves discovered her almost immediately. They rounded up her agents, who either fought to the death or were executed. They captured Korda and interrogated her, but she never revealed the location of the stolen fortune, even under magical compulsion. The Axebreaker dwarves used their influence to have her sentenced to life in prison at Revel's End. There, Clan Axebreaker was hopeful Korda would eventually break and reveal the location of the stolen wealth. This played right into Korda's hands, since she had made copious enemies who can't move against her while she's incarcerated.
zh_tw: 碎斧矮人們幾乎立即發現了她。他們集結了她的代理人，這些人要麼戰鬥至死，要麼被處決。他們捕獲了柯達並審問她，但她從未透露被偷走財富的位置，即使在魔法強迫下也是如此。碎斧矮人們利用他們的影響力將她判處在享樂之終終身監禁。在那裡，碎斧家族希望柯達最終會崩潰並透露被盜財富的位置。這正好落入了柯達的手中，因為她在那裡製造了許多敵人，而這些敵人在她被監禁時無法對她採取行動。

english: Korda, now known as {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}, prepared for her imprisonment by laying the groundwork for a new spy and criminal network, which cost her much of her stolen fortune. She now runs her operations from the prison. Using her magical tattoos, she telepathically coordinates agents throughout Faerûn and beyond, none of whom know the identity of their employer. As for what remains of the stolen Axebreaker wealth, it rests in an unmarked vault in the depths of Gauntlgrym, sealed by a magical lock that only the runic sequence tattooed on Korda's right hand can open.
zh_tw: 柯達，現在被稱為{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}，為了她的監禁做好了準備，為一個新的間諜和犯罪網路奠定了基礎，這花費了她大部分偷來的財富。她現在從監獄中運營她的行動。利用她的魔法紋身，她心靈感應地協調著遍佈費倫乃至更遠地區的代理人，而這些代理人中沒有人知道他們僱主的身份。至於剩下的碎斧財富，它被存放在岡特格里姆深處一個沒有標記的金庫中，被一個只有柯達右手上紋的符文序列才能開啟的魔法鎖封印著。

english: Adventure Hooks
zh_tw: 冒險引子

english: After years of financial hardship due to their stolen fortune, the mountain dwarves of Clan Axebreaker have located the lost treasure but have been unable to access it. A representative of the clan, Varrin Axebreaker, wishes to hire the characters to learn how to access the treasure. If you're not using the Golden Vault as a patron (see "Using the Golden Vault" below), here are some possible ways Varrin learned about the characters:
zh_tw: 由於財富被盜導致的多年財政困難，碎斧氏族的山地矮人們已經找到了失落的寶藏，但卻無法接觸到它。家族的代表，瓦林·碎斧，希望僱傭角色們來學習如何接觸到寶藏。如果你不使用金庫作為贊助人（見下文的"使用金庫"），以下是瓦林可能瞭解到角色們的一些方式：

english: By Reputation
zh_tw: 以名聲

english: Varrin learned of the characters in the aftermath of a previous adventure, especially one that involved retrieving a person or treasure from a dangerous location.
zh_tw: 瓦林在上一次冒險之後聽說了這些角色，特別是那次涉及從一個危險地點取回人或寶藏的冒險。

english: Mutual Acquaintance
zh_tw: 共同熟人

english: One of the characters' patrons is an old acquaintance of Varrin's and arranged the meeting. If the characters are involved with the Golden Vault, use this option.
zh_tw: 角色們的一個贊助人是瓦林的老熟人，並安排了這次會面。如果角色們與金庫有關聯，請選擇這個選項。

english: Trial Run
zh_tw: 試執行

english: Varrin was responsible for a previous adventure the characters completed successfully. It was a test to see if they were worthy of this mission.
zh_tw: 瓦林負責了角色們之前成功完成的一次冒險。這是一次測試，以檢視他們是否值得執行這次任務。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. We have discovered the location of a great dwarven treasure, but only a prisoner incarcerated within the prison Revel's End knows how to access the vault. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you travel to the prison, infiltrate it, and learn how to access the treasure from the prisoner. Return this information to the dwarf known as Varrin Axebreaker, who will brief you on the details of the mission. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。我們已經發現了一處巨大的矮人寶藏的位置，但只有被關押在享樂之終監獄中的一名囚犯知道如何進入金庫。這個任務，如果你們選擇承擔，需要你們前往監獄，潛入其中，並向囚犯學習如何接觸到寶藏。將這些資訊帶回給名為瓦林·碎斧的矮人，他將向你們簡要介紹任務的細節。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Varrin's Proposition
zh_tw: 瓦林的提議

english: Varrin Axebreaker (lawful good, dwarf {@creature noble}) contacts the characters to enlist their aid in retrieving the key. Varrin's braided hair and beard are black with streaks of gray. He wears a loose, comfortable robe over a steel breastplate. Whether Varrin approaches the characters or invites them to a meeting, read the following text:
zh_tw: 瓦林·艾克布雷克（守序善良，矮人{@creature noble||貴族}）聯絡這些角色，以爭取他們的幫助來取回鑰匙。瓦林的頭髮和鬍鬚是黑色的，夾雜著灰色的條紋。他穿著一件寬鬆舒適的長袍，外面套著鋼製胸甲。無論瓦林是親自去找這些角色還是邀請他們參加會議，請閱讀以下文字：

english: "Thank you for hearing me out. My name is Varrin Axebreaker, and I have a proposition for you. My clan has located wealth stolen from us many years ago, but it's sealed in a vault that's magically locked. If you can recover the key—whatever it is—you'll gain the undying gratitude of Clan Axebreaker. And I'll cut you in for a percentage of the recovered treasure, of course.
zh_tw: "感謝您傾聽我的話。我叫瓦林·碎斧，我有一個提議給您。我的氏族已經找到了多年前從我們這裡偷走的財富，但它被封印在一個魔法鎖定的金庫中。如果你們能夠找回鑰匙——無論它是什麼——你們將獲得碎斧氏族的永恆感激。當然，我會給你們一部分找回的寶藏作為分成。"

english: "The catch here is the person who knows how to open the vault is rotting away in the prison of Revel's End. She's proved uncooperative with my people in the past, but I recently discovered the vault where she hid what she stole from us. I need you to question her and learn how to open the vault. How you do that is up to you; if you need to spring her from the prison in exchange for this information, please do so. I can provide you with a way in, as well as the layout of Revel's End and a few useful tricks."
zh_tw: "這裡的問題是知道如何開啟金庫的人正在享樂之終監獄裡腐爛。她過去對我的人員一直不合作，但我最近發現了她藏匿從我們這裡偷走的東西的金庫。我需要你們審問她並學習如何開啟金庫。你們如何做到這一點由你們決定；如果你們需要為了這個資訊而將她從監獄中釋放出來，請這樣做。我可以為你們提供進入的方式，以及享樂之終的佈局和一些有用的技巧。"

english: Give the players a copy of {@adventure map 4.1|KftGV|4|Map 4.1: Players' Map} (see "The Breaker's Map" below), and read the following text:
zh_tw: 給玩家一份{@adventure 地圖 4.1|KftGV|4|Map 4.1: Players' Map}（見下文的"破壞者地圖"），然後閱讀以下文字：

english: Varrin retrieves a faceted sapphire the size of a small orange and places it on the table. He waves his hand over the gem, and a glowing blue image of a building floor plan appears in the air above it. He taps the gem, and the image vanishes. The sapphire splits into sections, and he passes one fragment to each of you. The fragment grows warm in your hand, melts, then vanishes, leaving a warm, tingling sensation behind. "Think about the map of Revel's End, and you'll be able to see it."
zh_tw: 瓦林取出一顆大小如小橙子的多面藍寶石放在桌上。他揮手在寶石上方，一個發光的藍色建築平面圖出現在寶石上方的空中。他輕敲寶石，影象消失了。藍寶石分成幾部分，他把每一塊碎片遞給你們。碎片在你們手中變暖，融化，然後消失，留下一種溫暖、刺痛的感覺。"想一想享樂之終的地圖，你們就能看到它。"

english: The gem's magic lasts until five days after the characters reach Revel's End.
zh_tw: 寶石的魔法持續到角色們到達享樂之終後的五天。

english: The Breaker's Map
zh_tw: 破碎者地圖

english: Each character can now cause a magical image of map 4.1 to appear in the air before them while they aren't {@condition incapacitated} (no action required). A breaker's map isn't visible to others while a character is viewing it. Varrin explains each of the features the characters can see on their maps:
zh_tw: 現在，每個角色都可以在他們沒有處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態時，不透過任何動作就讓地圖4.1的魔法影象出現在他們面前。當角色在檢視時，其他人是看不見破壞者地圖的。瓦林解釋了角色們可以在他們的地圖上看到的所有特徵：

english: Cells
zh_tw: 牢房

english: The cells, highlighted in red, are blanketed in permanent antimagic. {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}'s cell is clearly marked.
zh_tw: 這些用紅色高亮的牢房被永久性反魔法覆蓋。{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}的牢房被清晰地標記出來。

english: Doors and Hatches
zh_tw: 門與艙門

english: The doors and hatches are sealed with {@spell arcane lock} spells that only prison staff can bypass. However, while the characters are within 100 feet of Revel's End, the map allows them to use an action to touch the image of a door or hatch and suppress the lock on that portal. While a lock is suppressed, its image turns green. The lock remains suppressed for 1 minute or until another lock is suppressed.
zh_tw: 門和艙口被施加了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，只有監獄工作人員才能繞過。然而，當角色們在享樂之終的100尺範圍內時，地圖允許他們採取動作觸控門或艙口的影象，從而抑制該門的鎖。當鎖被抑制時，它的影象會變成綠色。鎖被抑制的狀態將持續1分鐘，或者直到另一個鎖被抑制。

english: Patrol Route
zh_tw: 巡邏路線

english: The yellow path marked on the map is the regular patrol route guards take. The usual patrol rotation is once every 20 minutes, but if the guards are suspicious, patrols will likely become more frequent.
zh_tw: 地圖上標記的黃色路徑是守衛們常規的巡邏路線。通常的巡邏輪換是每20分鐘一次，但如果守衛們感到可疑，巡邏可能會變得更加頻繁。

english: Map 4.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 4.1：玩家地圖

english: The Devil in the Details
zh_tw: 細節中的魔鬼

english: In the likely event that the characters want more information, Varrin answers their questions succinctly and honestly. He has spent the last of his personal fortune gathering information on the prison and making the arrangements for a team to confront Korda. These are the details he can provide:
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要獲取更多資訊，瓦林會簡潔而誠實地回答他們的問題。他已經用盡了他的個人財產來收集有關監獄的資訊，併為一個團隊面對柯達做準備。以下是他能提供的詳細資訊：

english: Entering the Prison
zh_tw: 進入監獄

english: The prison staff rotate out periodically. Varrin knows the schedule of the next rotation, and his agents are standing by to capture a number of guards and cooks so the characters can take their place (see "{@area Approaching the Prison|150|x}").
zh_tw: 監獄工作人員會定期輪換。瓦林知道下一次輪換的時間表，他的特工們已準備好抓捕一些守衛和廚師，以便角色們可以取而代之（參見"{@area 抵達監獄|150|x}"）。

english: Prisoner 13
zh_tw: 十三號囚犯

english: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} was a trusted agent of Clan Axebreaker until she betrayed the clan and stole its fortune. If pressed, Varrin reluctantly tells the characters her name (Korda Glintstone), but he stresses that they shouldn't reveal they know it. No one in the prison except perhaps the warden knows {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} by her real name, so using it would only raise suspicion. Her cell is marked on the map.
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}曾是碎斧氏族家族的一名受信任的代理人，直到她背叛了家族並偷走了家族的財富。如果被追問，瓦林會不情願地告訴角色們她的名字（柯達·閃石），但他強調他們不應該透露他們知道這個名字。監獄裡除了可能的監獄長之外，沒有人知道{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}的真實姓名，所以使用這個名字只會引起懷疑。她的牢房在地圖上被標記了出來。

english: Key
zh_tw: 鑰匙

english: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} must have the vault key or know where it is, but every magical method Clan Axebreaker has tried to locate the key has failed. Varrin presumes {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} would give up the key only in exchange for freedom, but if the characters can find the key or convince her to give it up any other way, he'll be just as pleased. Clan Axebreaker tried to arrange her release, but the Absolution Council at Revel's End denied the request.
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 必須擁有金庫鑰匙或者知道它的位置，但碎斧氏族嘗試的所有魔法方法都未能定位到鑰匙。瓦林推測{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 只有在換取自由的情況下才會交出鑰匙，但如果角色們能找到鑰匙或以其他方式說服她交出鑰匙，他也會同樣高興。碎斧氏族試圖安排她的釋放，但享樂之終的寬恕委員會拒絕了這一請求。

english: Meeting Prisoner 13
zh_tw: 會見囚犯13

english: Visitors can request meetings with prisoners, but those meetings are always supervised by the warden (to learn about the warden, see "{@area R21: Warden's Quarters|180|x}"). If the characters want to talk to {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}, their best bet is to try when she's not in her cell, hopefully out of sight of the guards. Prisoners do chores such as emptying latrine buckets and cleaning up after meals, and they exercise in the courtyard daily. When prisoners are injured or fall ill, they are taken to the prison hospital.
zh_tw: 訪客可以請求與囚犯會面，但這些會面總是由監獄長監督的（要了解監獄長的資訊，請參閱"{@area R21: 典獄長宿舍|180|x}"）。如果角色們想要與{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}交談，他們最好的機會是在她不在牢房的時候嘗試，希望在守衛視線之外。囚犯們會做一些雜務，比如倒空廁所桶和飯後清理，他們每天在庭院裡鍛鍊。當囚犯受傷或生病時，他們會被帶到監獄醫院。

english: Revel's End Details
zh_tw: 享樂之終細節

english: Varrin can give a general overview of Revel's End, the security features on doors and hatches, and the prison's high-alert procedure (see below). Varrin also knows the armory has a dangerous guardian, but he doesn't know the details.
zh_tw: 瓦林可以提供關於瑞維爾之末的總體概述，門和艙口的安全特性，以及監獄的高度警戒程式（見下文）。瓦林還知道武器庫有一個危險的守衛，但他不知道具體細節。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The treasure is locked in a vault deep beneath the dwarf stronghold of Gauntlgrym. Varrin promises the characters 2 percent of whatever treasure they recover if they make it possible for him to open the vault. If the characters press for more, Varrin is irritated, but he agrees to 3 percent if the characters succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. Varrin notes that the warden likely has some funds hidden in her office or quarters, if the characters are inclined to seek these out.
zh_tw: 財寶被鎖在位於矮人要塞崗特爾格里姆深處的地下金庫中。瓦林承諾，如果角色們能使他開啟金庫，他們將獲得所回收財寶的2%。如果角色們要求更多，瓦林會感到不悅，但如果角色們成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，他同意增加到3%。瓦林指出，如果角色們有意尋找，看守可能在辦公室或住所隱藏了一些資金。

english: Escape Route
zh_tw: 逃生路線

english: Varrin will have a small ship within sight of the prison but at a safe distance. When the characters are ready to leave the prison with their target, they can shine a light from the dock after dark, and the ship will pick them up.
zh_tw: 瓦林將在監獄視線範圍內但安全距離內準備一艘小船。當角色們準備帶著目標離開監獄時，他們可以在天黑後從碼頭髮出一束光，船隻會來接他們。

english: When the characters are ready to depart from their meeting with Varrin, he provides them each with the choice to pose as a guard or a cook. Guards must wear splint armor, and kitchen staff must wear simple uniforms. Cooks can hide light armor under their uniforms. Small characters also have the option to stow away inside a crate of supplies.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好離開與瓦林的會面時，他為他們每個人提供了選擇，可以偽裝成守衛或廚師。守衛必須穿戴板條護甲，而廚房工作人員必須穿戴簡單的制服。廚師可以在制服下藏輕型護甲。身材較小的角色還有選擇藏在供應品箱裡。

english: Trek to the Prison
zh_tw: 前往監獄的旅程

english: Varrin has sent word to his agents, and Bethra (chaotic good, dwarf {@creature spy}) meets the characters when they arrive in Luskan. She provides the uniforms for their chosen cover and directs them to report to a ship called the Jolly Pelican the following dawn. The ship regularly delivers a fresh rotation of prison staff to Revel's End and returns the relieved shift to the Sword Coast. The journey to Revel's End by sea is 350 miles, which a sailing ship can cover in three days under normal conditions.
zh_tw: 瓦林已經向他的特工發出了訊息，貝絲拉（混亂善良，矮人{@creature spy||間諜}）在角色們到達路斯坎時與他們會面。她為他們提供了所選擇掩護的制服，並指示他們在第二天黎明向一艘名為歡樂鵜鶘的船隻報告。這艘船定期將新輪換的監獄工作人員運送到享樂之終，並將換班的工作人員帶回劍海岸。在正常情況下，乘船前往享樂之終的旅程是350英里，帆船可以在三天內完成。

english: Twenty-five guards and six cooks are bound for the prison, including any characters taking their places. If the characters express concern over the fate of staff they're replacing, Bethra assures them that none of the people were killed, and they'll be released safely when the job is over.
zh_tw: 包括任何取代他們位置的角色在內，共有二十五名守衛和六名廚師前往監獄。如果角色們對他們所取代的員工的命運表示擔憂，貝絲拉向他們保證，這些人沒有被殺害，並且當工作結束時，他們將被安全釋放。

english: The players can make up whatever names they like for their cover. Those are the names of the guards or cooks they've replaced.
zh_tw: 玩家們可以隨意編造他們想要的化名作為掩護。這些名字是他們所替代的守衛或廚師的名字。

english: Revel's End
zh_tw: 享樂之終

english: Revel's End is a panopticon, a prison configured in such a way that the activities of the prisoners can be closely monitored from a central location. Situated on the frigid, misty coast of the Sea of Moving Ice, the prison is a single-story structure topped with battlements. Rising from the core of the panopticon is a tower that holds the prison's administrative offices and guard barracks. Both the prison and the tower are carved from a tall, blade-shaped rock that rises high above the sea cliffs. This rock, called the Windbreak, shields the tower against the brutal winds that sweep down from the Reghed Glacier.
zh_tw: 享樂之終是一個全景監獄，這種監獄的設計使得從中心位置可以密切監視囚犯的活動。它位於移動冰海的寒冷、霧濛濛的海岸上，監獄是一個帶有城垛的單層結構。從全景監獄的核心升起的是一座塔，裡面設有監獄的行政辦公室和警衛營房。監獄和塔都是從一塊高聳於海崖之上的高大、刀鋒形狀的岩石中雕刻出來的。這塊岩石被稱為擋風石，它保護塔免受來自瑞格冰川的猛烈風的侵襲。

english: One can approach Revel's End by land, sea, or air. A pier allows prisoners to be taken from ships up an elevator to the prison, and a mooring dock at the top of the tower allows prisoners to be delivered by airship.
zh_tw: 人們可以透過陸地、海洋或空中接近享樂之終。一個碼頭允許從船上帶囚犯透過電梯到達監獄，而在塔頂的繫留碼頭允許透過飛艇運送囚犯。

english: Revel's End is controlled by the Lords' Alliance, a loose confederation of settlements whose current members include the cities of Baldur's Gate, Mirabar, Neverwinter, Silverymoon, Waterdeep, and Yartar; the towns of Amphail, Daggerford, and Longsaddle; and the dwarven stronghold of Mithral Hall. To be imprisoned in Revel's End, one must have committed a serious crime against one or more of the member cities and been sentenced to a lengthy period of incarceration (typically a year or more).
zh_tw: 享樂之終由領主聯盟控制，這是一個由定居點組成的鬆散聯盟，其當前成員包括博德之門、米拉巴爾、無冬城、銀月城、深水城和雅塔城等城市；安普海爾、匕首福特和長鞍鎮等城鎮；以及矮人要塞米斯拉爾廳。要在享樂之終被監禁，一個人必須對一個或多個成員城市犯下嚴重罪行，並被判處長期監禁（通常為一年或更長時間）。

english: Each member of the Lords' Alliance assigns one representative to Revel's End, and together the representatives form a parole committee called the Absolution Council. Rarely are all ten council members present, since Revel's End offers little in the way of comfort and amenities. If the council needs a tiebreaking vote to determine whether to commute a prisoner's sentence, the prison warden—a neutral arbiter with no ties to any Lords' Alliance member—casts the deciding vote.
zh_tw: 每個領主聯盟的成員指派一名代表到瑞維爾之末，這些代表共同組成一個名為寬恕委員會的假釋委員會。由於瑞維爾之末在舒適和便利設施方面提供的很少，所以很少會出現所有十位委員會成員同時在場的情況。如果委員會需要一個決定性的投票來決定是否減輕一個囚犯的刑期，監獄長官——一個與任何領主聯盟成員沒有聯絡的中立仲裁者——會投出決定性的一票。

english: Prison Features
zh_tw: 監獄特徵

english: The prison, hewn from stone, has 20-foot-high outer walls and flat, 20-foot-high ceilings throughout. Additional information about the prison is summarized below:
zh_tw: 這座由岩石開鑿而成的監獄擁有20尺高的外牆和通體20尺高的平坦天花板。關於監獄的更多資訊總結如下：

english: Doors and Hatches
zh_tw: 門與艙門

english: Each door and rooftop hatch is made of reinforced iron held shut by an {@spell arcane lock} spell. Prison personnel can open these doors and hatches normally.
