A locked door or hatch is too strong to be shouldered or kicked open, but it can be destroyed if it takes enough damage. A door or hatch has AC 19, a damage threshold of 10, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 每扇門和屋頂艙門都由強化鋼鐵製成，並透過{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術固定。監獄人員可正常開啟這些門和艙門。上鎖的門或艙門過於堅固而無法用肩膀撞開或用腳踢開，但如果受到足夠傷害則可被摧毀。門或艙門具有AC 19、傷害閾值為10、30點生命值，且免疫毒素和心靈傷害。

english: Heating
zh_tw: 供暖

english: Interior spaces are magically heated. The temperature in these areas is a constant 68 degrees Fahrenheit (20 degrees Celsius). The exterior of the prison, including the guard towers, is 0 degrees Fahrenheit (−18 degrees Celsius) or colder. Creatures outside the prison are exposed to {@area extreme cold|152|x} (see below).
zh_tw: 室內空間以魔法供暖，溫度恆定在華氏 68 度（攝氏 20 度）。監獄外部，包括守衛塔在內，溫度為華氏 0 度（攝氏 −18 度）或更低。監獄外的生物會承受{@area 極寒|152|x}的影響（見下文）。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Unless a location states otherwise, the courtyard, corridors, rooms, and staircases are brightly lit with {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces. (The unlit cells in {@area area R17|176|x} are exceptions.) In some locations, the magical lights can be dimmed or suppressed, as noted in the text.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，庭院、走廊、房間和樓梯間都透過在壁燈上施放的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術明亮地照亮。（{@area 區域R17|176|x}區域中未點亮的牢房是例外。）在某些地點，魔法燈光可以被調暗或抑制，如文字中所註明。

english: Prison Guards
zh_tw: 監獄看守

english: The prison has a garrison of 75 guards (use the {@creature veteran} stat block) who work eight-hour shifts. Two-thirds of the garrison is off duty and resting in {@area area R19|17c|x} at any given time. While on duty, each guard wears a tunic that bears the Lords' Alliance emblem: a gold crown on a red field.
zh_tw: 監獄有一個由75名守衛組成的守備隊（使用{@creature veteran||老兵}的統計資料塊），他們工作八小時輪班制。任何時候，守備隊的三分之二都在{@area 區域R19|17c|x}休息。當值時，每個守衛都穿著一件印有領主聯盟徽章的束腰外衣：紅色背景上的金色皇冠。

english: Prisoners
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: All prisoners in Revel's End are identified by a number. This simple protocol keeps prisoners on an equal footing. Prison personnel commit these numbers to memory, and the records of all prisoners—past and present—are stored in {@area area R22|184|x}. Each inmate wears a uniform that consists of a hoodless robe without pockets, leather slippers without laces, and cloth undergarments. While outside their cells, prisoners wear manacles on their wrists and ankles. While manacled, a prisoner's walking speed can't exceed 10 feet.
zh_tw: 瑞維爾之末的所有囚犯都透過一個數字來識別。這個簡單的程式讓囚犯處於平等地位。監獄人員將這些數字牢記在心，所有囚犯的記錄——無論是過去的還是現在的——都存放在{@area 區域R22|184|x}。每個囚犯都穿著一種制服，包括一件無兜的無帽長袍、無鞋帶的皮拖鞋和布質內衣。在牢房外時，囚犯的手腕和腳踝上都戴著鐐銬。戴著鐐銬時，囚犯的行走速度不能超過10尺。

english: Approaching the Prison
zh_tw: 抵達監獄

english: When the characters approach the prison, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近監獄時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: Perched on a high cliff overlooking the Sea of Moving Ice is a bleak stone fortress carved from a gigantic, blade-shaped rock. A central tower looms above the rest of the fortress, and light leaks from its arrow slits. Four smaller towers rise from the outermost corners of the fortress, and guards can be seen atop them.
zh_tw: 坐落在俯瞰移動冰海的高崖上，是一座由巨大刀鋒形岩石雕刻而成的荒涼石堡。一座中央塔樓高聳於堡壘的其餘部分之上，光線從它的箭縫中漏出。四個較小的塔樓從堡壘的最外圍角落升起，可以看到守衛們站在上面。

english: Characters might approach the prison via the Jolly Pelican, or they might choose to approach on their own (see "{@area Getting Inside|154|x}" below).
zh_tw: 角色們可能透過"快樂的鵜鶘號"接近監獄，或者他們可能選擇自己接近（見下文的"{@area 進入內部|154|x}"）。

english: Characters approaching from the north can also see the prison's northern entrance at the top of a 160-foot-high cliff with a pier protruding from its base. A giant wooden crane stands nearby, and a wooden scaffold clings to the cliff face.
zh_tw: 從北邊接近的角色還能看到監獄的北入口，它位於160尺高的懸崖頂端，底部有一個突出的碼頭。一臺巨大的木製起重機矗立在附近，木製腳手架緊貼在懸崖崖壁上。

english: Characters approaching from the south can see the prison's south entrance and the trail that leads up to it.
zh_tw: 從南方接近的角色可以看到監獄的南入口以及通往它的小徑。

english: Extreme Cold
zh_tw: 極度寒冷

english: The temperature outside is at or below 0 degrees Fahrenheit (−18 degrees Celsius) while the characters are at the prison. A creature exposed to the cold must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at the end of each hour or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures with resistance or immunity to cold damage automatically succeed on the saving throw, as do creatures wearing cold-weather gear (thick coats, gloves, and the like) and creatures naturally adapted to cold climates.
zh_tw: 當角色們在監獄時，室外溫度為0華氏度（-18攝氏度）或更低。暴露在寒冷中的生物必須在每小時結束時進行一次{@dc 10}體質豁免，否則獲得1層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。對寒冷傷害有抗性或免疫的生物自動透過豁免檢定，穿著寒冷天氣裝備（厚外套、手套等）的生物以及自然適應寒冷氣候的生物也是如此。

english: Guards on Watch
zh_tw: 瞭望塔上的守衛

english: The prison has four guard towers (see {@area area R9|16a|x}), and three guards in cold-weather clothing are stationed atop each one. If you need to make Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks for the guards to determine if they notice something, make only one roll with advantage.
zh_tw: 監獄有四個警衛塔（見{@area 區域R9|16a|x}), 每個塔頂上都駐紮著三名穿著寒冷天氣服裝的警衛。如果您需要為警衛進行感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，以確定他們是否注意到某些事情，請只進行一次有利的擲骰。

english: If the guards on a tower see or hear something out of the ordinary—such as an approaching ship, a group of visitors, or a monster flying overhead—one guard descends into the tower to alert the rest of the prison while the others stay at their posts.
zh_tw: 如果塔樓上的守衛看到或聽到任何不尋常的情況——比如接近的船隻、一群訪客，或者頭頂飛過的怪物——一名守衛會下到塔樓內去通知監獄的其他人，而其他人則留在他們的崗位上。

english: Getting Inside
zh_tw: 進入內部

english: If the characters use the cover Varrin provided, their ship arrives at Revel's End just before dawn, three days after leaving Luskan. The characters are directed off the ship, ride the elevator to the cliff top, and are admitted through the front doors. Characters posing as guards are taken to the barracks ({@area area R19|17c|x}), where they meet with head guard Yula Dargeria, a no-nonsense stickler for the prison's rules. Characters posing as cooks are delivered to the kitchen ({@area area R8|169|x}), where they report to Chef Tiny Toulaine, a hulking, jovial man who carries an enormous saucepan instead of a heavy crossbow. Small characters who stowed away in supply crates are taken to either the storeroom ({@area area R13|171|x}), the kitchen's cold storage room (the middle room off area R8), or the pantry (the northernmost room off area R8). If more than one Small character stows away, pick one location where they're all delivered.
zh_tw: 如果角色們使用了瓦林提供的掩護，他們的船將在離開路斯坎三天後的黎明前到達享樂之終。角色們被引導下船，乘坐電梯到達懸崖頂部，並透過前門進入。偽裝成警衛的角色被帶到兵營（{@area 區域R19|17c|x}），在那裡他們遇到了主管警衛尤拉·達格里亞，她是一個嚴格遵守監獄規則的嚴格之人。偽裝成廚師的角色被送到廚房（{@area 區域R8|169|x}），在那裡他們向廚師小不點圖萊恩報告，他是一個身材魁梧、性格開朗的人，他攜帶著一個巨大的燉鍋而不是沉重的十字弓。藏在供應箱中的小型角色被帶到儲藏室（{@area 區域R13|171|x}）、廚房的冷藏室（R8區域中間的房間）或食品儲藏室（R8區域最北邊的房間）。如果有多個小型角色潛藏，選擇一個他們都被送到的地點。

english: Characters who bang on the prison's north or south door are admitted into a 30-foot-long corridor, where they are greeted by the three guards from a nearby guard room ({@area area R3|161|x}). These guards insist on confiscating the characters' weapons and storing them in a nearby lockbox. In addition, one guard searches each character for concealed weapons. A character can conceal a dagger or similarly sized weapon from a guard's notice with a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 敲打監獄北門或南門的角色會被允許進入一條30尺長的走廊，在那裡他們會遇到來自附近警衛室（{@area 區域R3|161|x}）的三名警衛。這些警衛堅持沒收角色的武器，並將其存放在附近的保險箱中。此外，一名警衛會對每個角色進行搜身，檢查是否有隱藏的武器。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 13}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，將一把匕首或類似大小的武器隱藏，使其不被警衛發現。

english: If the characters have sled dogs or pack animals, a guard grants the party access to the stables ({@area area R5|165|x}), where the animals can be kept safe. Animals aren't allowed in the prison otherwise.
zh_tw: 如果角色們有雪橇犬或馱獸，守衛會允許隊伍進入馬廄（{@area 區域R5|165|x}），在那裡動物可以安全地被保管。否則，動物是不允許進入監獄的。

english: After relinquishing their weapons and securing their animals, the characters are escorted by one of the guards to the meeting room ({@area area R12|16f|x}), where they must wait one hour for the warden to greet them. During this time, the characters are unattended and can attempt to sneak into the prison at large. Doing so without alerting the guards requires a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. Recovering the characters' weapons from the lockbox requires a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity check with thieves' tools. If the characters are caught attempting either of these tasks, the guards return them to the meeting room and wait with them for the warden, who throws them out unless they provide a satisfactory reason for their visit and subterfuge.
zh_tw: 在交出武器並安置好動物後，角色們由一名守衛護送到會議室（{@area 區域R12|16f|x}），在那裡他們必須等待一小時以等候典獄長的接見。在此期間，角色們無人看管，可以嘗試溜進監獄。要在這過程中不讓守衛察覺到，需要進行一次成功的{@dc 13}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。要從鎖箱中取回角色們的武器，需要使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 16}敏捷檢定。如果角色在嘗試這些任務時被抓，守衛會將他們帶回到會議室，並和他們一起等待典獄長，除非他們能為自己的來訪和詭計提供一個令人滿意的理由，否則典獄長會把他們趕出去。

english: The warden only accepts the characters' presence if they are seeking shelter. In that case, she grants them temporary accommodations (in {@area area R7|167|x}) for up to two days and two nights, and the characters receive three meals a day during their stay. If the characters fail to provide a satisfactory reason for their visit, the warden has their weapons and animals returned to them before throwing them out.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尋求庇護，監獄長才會接受他們的存在。在這種情況下，她為他們提供臨時住宿（在{@area 區域R7|167|x}）最多兩天兩夜，並且在逗留期間角色們每天會收到三餐。如果角色們未能提供令人滿意的訪問理由，監獄長會在將他們趕出去之前將他們的武器和動物歸還給他們。

english: Suspicion
zh_tw: 懷疑

english: Activities outside the daily routine of the prison draw attention from the guards and what few other staff members there are. Suspicion is measured in levels from 1 to 6. When the characters arrive at the prison, the suspicion level is 1.
zh_tw: 監獄日常活動之外的行為會引起守衛和其他少數工作人員的注意。懷疑程度以1到6級來衡量。當角色們到達監獄時，懷疑程度是1。

english: Suspicion can increase when prison staff members witness or find evidence of behavior outside the norm. Circumstances that increase the suspicion level include the following:
zh_tw: 當監獄工作人員目睹或發現異常行為的證據時，懷疑可能會增加。增加懷疑水平的情況包括以下幾點：

english: Using a prisoner's real name while in the guise of prison staff
zh_tw: 在偽裝成監獄工作人員時使用囚犯的真實姓名

english: Getting caught by a patrol (see {@area Patrol Routes|15d|x})
zh_tw: 被巡邏隊抓住（見{@area 巡邏路線|15d|x}）

english: Casting a spell that has perceptible components or effects in sight of a guard
zh_tw: 在警衛視線範圍內施放具有可感知成分或效果的法術

english: Conversing with a prisoner about anything other than prison business (such as giving them instructions for tasks)
zh_tw: 與囚犯交談關於除監獄事務以外的任何事情（例如給他們下達任務指令）

english: For suspicion to increase, prison staff members must witness the characters performing unusual activity, and any witnesses must report their observations. If the characters can convince the witness what they saw was justified, the suspicion level doesn't increase.
zh_tw: 為了使懷疑增加，監獄工作人員必須目睹角色執行不尋常的活動，並且任何目擊者必須報告他們的觀察結果。如果角色能說服目擊者他們所看到的是合理的，懷疑水平就不會增加。

english: Distractions
zh_tw: 分散注意力

english: A character can create a distraction, giving themself or an ally time to undertake a suspicious activity without being witnessed. If the distracting character succeeds on a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check against a DC set by the current suspicion level (see the Suspicion table), the suspicious activity goes unnoticed. Use your discretion to decide if any given activity is subtle enough to be covered by a distraction. For example, a glib conversation can't cover up an explosion.
zh_tw: 角色可以製造幹擾，給自己或盟友爭取時間進行可疑活動而不被目擊。如果製造幹擾的角色在當前懷疑等級設定的DC上成功進行了魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定（見懷疑表），可疑活動將不被發現。請自行判斷任何特定活動是否足夠隱蔽，可以被幹擾所掩蓋。例如，巧妙的對話無法掩蓋一次爆炸。

english: Effects of Suspicion
zh_tw: 懷疑的效果

english: As the suspicion level increases, patrols become more frequent, and the prison staff become increasingly vigilant. At suspicion level 6, the warden puts the prison on high alert.
zh_tw: 隨著懷疑程度的提高，巡邏變得更加頻繁，監獄工作人員也變得更加警覺。在懷疑程度達到6級時，監獄長將監獄置於高度警戒狀態。

zh_tw: 懷疑

zh_tw: 等級

english: Level
zh_tw: 等級

english: The current suspicion level is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1) every 8 hours if the prison staff detects no suspicious activity during that time.
zh_tw: 如果監獄工作人員在那段時間內沒有發現可疑活動，當前的懷疑等級每8小時降低1（最低降至1）。

english: Patrol Die
zh_tw: 巡邏骰

english: Roll a die based on the current suspicion level when characters enter the patrol route to see if they encounter a guard patrol (see "{@area Patrol Routes|15d|x}").
zh_tw: 當角色進入巡邏路線時，根據當前的懷疑等級擲一個骰子，以檢視他們是否遇到了守衛巡邏隊（見"{@area 巡邏路線|15d|x}"）。

english: DC
zh_tw: DC

english: The DC of Charisma checks made against prison staff and of ability checks made to avoid patrols is set by the current suspicion level.
zh_tw: 針對監獄工作人員進行的魅力檢定的難度等級（DC）以及為了避免被巡邏發現而進行的屬性檢定是由當前的懷疑水平設定的。

english: High Alert
zh_tw: 高度警戒

english: When a matter of concern is brought to her attention, the warden (see {@area area R21|180|x}) decides whether to place the prison on high alert. Circumstances that warrant taking such action include a prisoner revolt, an escape, the approach of an unfamiliar ship, a dragon sighting, an attack, discovering a dead body, or suspicious activity (see "Suspicion" above).
zh_tw: 當監獄長（見{@area 區域R21|180|x})注意到引起關注的問題時，她會決定是否讓監獄進入高度警戒狀態。需要採取這種行動的情況包括囚犯暴動、越獄、不熟悉的船隻接近、看到龍、遭到攻擊、發現屍體或可疑活動（見上文的"懷疑"）。

english: By speaking the command word, "maristo," the warden—and only the warden—can place the prison on high alert (or speak it again to end the high alert), with the following effects:
zh_tw: 透過說出命令詞"maristo"，監獄長——且只有監獄長——可以將監獄置於高度警戒狀態（或者再次說出它以結束高度警戒），其效果如下：

english: High-Alert Signals
zh_tw: 高警戒訊號

english: For 1 minute, a warning horn blares throughout the prison, and all light created by {@spell continual flame} spells in the prison takes on a reddish hue.
zh_tw: 在1分鐘的時間裡，警告號角在監獄內響起，監獄內由{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術創造的所有光線都變成了一種紅色的色調。

english: Prison Deployment
zh_tw: 監獄部署

english: The guards in {@area area R19|17c|x} don their armor, arm themselves, and move to {@area area R18|179|x}. The warden does the same and commands the garrison from there. Members of the Absolution Council retreat to {@area area R20|17e|x}.
zh_tw: 在{@area 區域R19|17c|x}的守衛們穿上他們的盔甲，武裝自己，並移動到{@area 區域R18|179|x}。監獄長也這樣做，並從那裡指揮守衛隊。寬恕委員會的成員撤退到{@area 區域R20|17e|x}。

english: See Invisibility
zh_tw: 識破隱形

english: The warden and all prison guards gain the benefit of a {@spell see invisibility} spell.
zh_tw: 典獄長和所有監獄守衛獲得{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術的效果。

english: Patrol Routes
zh_tw: 巡邏路線

english: Guards regularly patrol in pairs from the guard rooms ({@area area R3|161|x}, alternating which room for each patrol) around the hexagon ({@area area R15|173|x}), with short checks into the courtyard ({@area area R11|16e|x}) and the armory ({@area area R10|16b|x}). The route is marked in yellow on the players' map of Revel's End. It normally takes 4 minutes for a patrol to make its round and return to its post.
zh_tw: 警衛們通常兩人一組從警衛室（{@area 區域R3|161|x}，每次巡邏交替使用房間）繞著六邊形區域（{@area 區域R15|173|x}）進行巡邏，並對庭院（{@area 區域R11|16e|x}）和軍械庫（{@area 區域R10|16b|x}）進行簡短的檢查。巡邏路線在享樂之終的玩家地圖上用黃色標出。通常，一個巡邏隊完成其巡邏並返回崗位需要4分鐘。

english: When one or more characters enter an area marked on the patrol route, roll a die. The size of the die rolled is determined by the current suspicion level of the prison, as indicated on the {@area Suspicion table|158|x}. On a 1, the characters encounter a patrol. Ask the players how their characters react, and give them 1 round of actions. The characters can try to slip away if there is a nearby exit or corner to duck around by making a group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check or try to blend in by making a group Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. Each check is made against a DC set by the current suspicion level. On a failure, the patrol notices the characters, who must account for their presence.
zh_tw: 當一個或多個角色進入巡邏路線上標記的區域時，擲一個骰子。擲骰子的大小由監獄當前的懷疑等級決定，如{@area 懷疑等級表|158|x}所示。如果是1，角色們遇到了巡邏隊。詢問玩家他們的角色如何反應，並給他們1輪行動時間。角色們可以透過進行群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定嘗試溜走，如果有附近的出口或角落可以躲避；或者透過進行群體魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定嘗試融入其中。每次檢定都是針對當前懷疑等級設定的難度等級（DC）。如果失敗，巡邏隊就會注意到角色們，他們必須解釋自己的存在。

english: If the characters try to talk their way past a patrol, have one of the characters make a Charisma check using {@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Persuasion}, depending on their story, against a DC set by the suspicion level. If other characters support the story, the check is made with advantage. On a success, the patrol lets them go. On a failure, the patrol escorts the characters to a guard room (area R3), where the guard interrogates the characters about the characters' presence in a prohibited area. If the characters have a cover story for being in the prison, the guards escort them to where they should be: the kitchen staff's quarters (the largest side room off {@area area R8|169|x}) or the barracks ({@area area R19|17c|x}) in the case of off-duty guards. The suspicion level then increases by 1.
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖用言辭讓自己透過巡邏隊，讓其中的一個角色使用{@skill Deception||欺瞞}、{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}進行魅力檢定，根據他們的故事，對抗由懷疑水平設定的難度等級（DC）。如果有其他角色支援這個故事，那麼檢定會有優勢。成功時，巡邏隊會放他們走。失敗時，巡邏隊會護送角色們到警衛室（區域 R3），在那裡警衛會審問角色們關於他們在禁止區域出現的原因。如果角色們有一個在監獄中的掩護故事，警衛會護送他們到他們應該去的地方：廚房工作人員的宿舍（{@area 區域R8|169|x}中最大的側室）或在非值班守衛的情況下的軍營（{@area 區域R19|17c|x}）。然後，懷疑水平增加1。

english: Once the characters encounter a patrol, don't check for another patrol when the characters enter the route until 20 minutes have passed.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們遇到了巡邏隊，在角色們進入巡邏路線直到20分鐘過去之前，不要再檢查遇到另一支巡邏隊的情況。

english: Revel's End Locations
zh_tw: 享樂之終地點

english: The following locations are keyed to Revel's End, as shown on map 4.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖4.2所示的享樂之終。

english: Map 4.2: DM's map
zh_tw: 地圖 4.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: R1: Dock
zh_tw: R1. 碼頭

english: Ships dock here to offload prisoners and supplies.
zh_tw: 船隻在這裡停靠，卸下囚犯和物資。

english: R2: Elevator
zh_tw: R2. 電梯

english: A sturdy wooden scaffold clings to the 160-foot-high cliff separating the prison from the dock. Looming above the scaffolding is a wooden crane that is controlled from area R3. The crane raises and lowers an elevator car that has a retractable wooden gate on the side opposite the crane. The elevator car is a hollow wooden cube measuring 10 feet on each side. It takes 1 minute for the car to travel all the way up or down the scaffold.
zh_tw: 一個堅固的木製腳手架緊貼著分隔監獄和碼頭的160尺高的懸崖。在腳手架上方，有一個由R3區域控制的木製起重機。起重機提升和降低一個電梯車廂，該車廂在遠離起重機的側面有一個可伸縮的木製門。電梯車廂是一個每邊長10尺的空心木製立方體。車廂完全上升或下降腳手架需要1分鐘。

english: R3: Guard Rooms
zh_tw: R3. 警衛室

english: This room contains a table with four chairs, and a cabinet holding whetstones and other simple supplies for repairing armor and weapons.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含一張有四把椅子的桌子，以及一個存放磨刀石和其他簡單裝備的櫃子，用於修理盔甲和武器。

english: Three guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans}) are stationed in each of these two rooms. The guards pass the time by playing cards, sharpening their weapons, and complaining about the weather.
zh_tw: 這兩個房間裡各駐紮著三名守衛（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）。守衛們透過打牌、磨利他們的武器和抱怨天氣來打發時間。

english: Embedded in the north wall of the northern guard room is an iron lever that raises and lowers the elevator in area R2. During a patrol, two of the guards leave the room to make their rounds for 4 minutes.
zh_tw: 在北邊警衛室的北牆內嵌有一個鐵桿，用來控制區域R2中的電梯上升和下降。在巡邏期間，兩名警衛離開房間進行4分鐘的巡視。

english: R4: Hospital
zh_tw: R4. 醫院

english: This chamber contains a dozen simple beds. Cabinets along the north wall hold medical supplies.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有十二張簡易床。靠北牆的櫃子裡存放著醫療用品。

english: The cabinets hold enough supplies to assemble twenty {@item Healer's Kit|PHB|healer's kits}, five vials of {@item Antitoxin (vial)|PHB|antitoxin}, and various other medicines and tinctures.
zh_tw: 櫃子裡存放著足夠的物資，可以組裝二十套{@item Healer's Kit|PHB|醫療包}，五瓶{@item Antitoxin (vial)|PHB|抗毒劑}，以及各種其他藥品和酊劑。

english: Some of these substances are poisonous if ingested in the wrong proportion. A character proficient with alchemist's supplies, a poisoner's kit, an herbalist's kit, or the {@skill Medicine} skill can identify the tinctures and combine them into an ingested poison. A creature that ingests the poison must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, it takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage and becomes {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. On a successful saving throw, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. In either case, the creature has painful stomach cramps until it finishes a short rest, drinks a vial of antitoxin, or is targeted by an effect that ends the {@condition poisoned} condition. If a prisoner suffers these cramps, the guards bring the prisoner to the hospital to be examined and treated. Characters disguised as guards can volunteer for or be assigned that duty.
zh_tw: 這些物質中的一些如果攝入比例不當，可能會導致中毒。精通鍊金術工具、毒師工具、草藥師工具或 {@skill Medicine||醫療} 技能的角色可以識別這些藥水並將其混合成一種可攝取的毒藥。攝入了毒藥的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 的體質豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，它將受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）的毒素傷害，並在1小時內處於 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態。如果檢定成功，它只受到一半的傷害，並且不會 {@condition poisoned||中毒}。無論是哪種情況，該生物都會經歷痛苦的胃痙攣，直到它完成一次短暫的休息、喝下一瓶解毒劑，或受到一個結束 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態的效果的影響。如果一個囚犯遭受了這些胃痙攣，守衛會將囚犯帶到醫院進行檢查和治療。偽裝成守衛的角色可以選擇或可能被分配去執行這項任務。

english: R5: Stables
zh_tw: R5. 馬廄

english: Visitors who bring mounts, sled dogs, pack animals, or pets to Revel's End can keep their animals here. The prison doesn't supply food for animals, however.
zh_tw: 將坐騎、雪橇犬、馱獸或寵物帶到享樂之終的訪客可以在這裡安置他們的動物。然而，監獄不為動物提供食物。

english: R6: Mess Hall
zh_tw: R6. 食堂

english: Prison personnel dine here. Tables and benches fill the room, and dishes and dulled cutlery are stored in cabinets along the south wall. The mess hall serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The characters can meet here without arousing any suspicion.
zh_tw: 監獄人員在此用餐。桌子和長凳填滿了房間，餐具和鈍了的餐具存放在南牆的櫃子裡。食堂提供早餐、午餐和晚餐。角色們可以在這裡見面而不引起任何懷疑。

english: R7: Councilors' Quarters
zh_tw: R7. 議員宿舍

english: These ten rooms are furnished identically. Each contains a bed, a desk with matching chair, a claw-footed chest, and wall hooks for hanging clothes. The {@spell continual flame} spell that illuminates each room can be suppressed or returned to its normal light level by uttering the command word, "lights."
zh_tw: 這十個房間的佈置完全相同。每個房間都包含一張床、一張配有椅子的書桌、一個爪足式衣櫃，以及用於掛衣服的牆鉤。照亮每個房間的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術可以透過說出命令詞"lights"來抑制或恢復到正常的光照水平。

english: These rooms are set aside for the ten members of the Absolution Council, though only three rooms are currently in use. The other seven members of the council are absent, so the warden lets visitors use the spare rooms.
zh_tw: 這些房間是為寬恕委員會的十名成員預留的，儘管目前只有三個房間在使用中。委員會的其他七名成員不在，所以監獄長允許訪客使用這些空餘的房間。

english: Council Members
zh_tw: 委員會成員

english: These three members of the Absolution Council are at Revel's End:
zh_tw: 這三個寬恕委員會的成員在享樂之終：

english: Councilor Voss Anderton
zh_tw: 委員沃斯·安德頓

english: Voss represents the city of Neverwinter. He is a lawful neutral, human noncombatant who has a precise, lawyerly way of speaking. He never misses a council meeting or parole hearing. He votes with his head, not his heart, and he always weighs the ramifications of commuting a prisoner's sentence.
zh_tw: 沃斯代表無冬城。他是一個守序中立的人類非戰鬥人員，說話方式精確，帶有律師的風格。他從不錯過任何委員會會議或假釋聽證會。他用頭腦而不是心來投票，並且總是權衡減輕囚犯刑期的後果。

english: Councilor Jil Torbo
zh_tw: 委員吉爾·託博

english: Jil represents the city of Baldur's Gate. She is a neutral, halfling noncombatant who loathes her job. She has no sense of humor and sighs deeply when her patience is tested. She likes giving others the benefit of the doubt, however—perhaps as an act of dissent—and votes yes on commutations more often than not.
zh_tw: 吉爾代表博德之門城市。她是一箇中立的半身人非戰鬥人員，對自己的工作感到厭惡。她沒有幽默感，當她的耐心受到考驗時會深深地嘆息。然而，她喜歡給別人懷疑的好處——可能作為一種異議行為——並且比不經常更頻繁地對減刑投贊成票。

english: Councilor Kriv Norixius
zh_tw: 委員克里夫·裡修斯

english: Kriv represents the town of Daggerford. He is a lawful good, dragonborn noncombatant of silver dragon ancestry. He hopes to impress the Duchess of Daggerford by doing a good job. He has no tolerance for unrepentant criminals and often votes no on commutations.
zh_tw: 克里夫代表匕首灘鎮。他是一個守序善良，具有銀龍血統的龍裔非戰鬥人員。他希望透過做好工作給匕首灘公爵夫人留下深刻印象。他對不知悔改的罪犯沒有容忍之心，經常對減刑投反對票。

english: R8: Kitchen and Side Rooms
zh_tw: R8. 廚房及側房

english: Six cooks (neutral, human {@creature Commoner||commoners}) take shifts here, working in pairs to produce meals for the prisoners and staff. The kitchen contains everything one would expect to see, as well as an iron stove and a pump that draws water from a magically heated cistern on the roof.
zh_tw: 六名廚師（中立，人類{@creature Commoner||平民}）在這裡輪班工作，他們成對工作，為囚犯和工作人員製作餐食。廚房裡包含了人們期望看到的一切，還有一臺鐵爐和一臺從屋頂上的魔法加熱水箱抽水的泵。

english: Off-duty cooks sleep in the largest of the three rooms west of the kitchen. This side room is lit by {@spell continual flame} spells that can be suppressed or activated by uttering the command word, "lights."
zh_tw: 下班的廚師們在廚房西側三個房間中最大的一個房間內睡覺。這個側房由可以被說出命令詞"lights"來抑制或啟用的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮。

english: The middle side room—not heated, unlike the rest of the prison—is used for cold storage.
zh_tw: 中間的側室——與監獄其他區域不同，沒有供暖——被用作冷藏室。

english: The smallest side room is a well-stocked pantry.
zh_tw: 最小的側室是一個庫存充足的食品儲藏室。

english: R9: Guard Towers
zh_tw: R9. 警衛塔

english: Each of these four triangular towers is two stories tall. A tower's interior chamber is empty except for a wooden ladder that climbs to an iron hatch held shut by an {@spell arcane lock} spell (see the "{@area Prison Features|14f|x}" section for more details). This hatch leads to the tower's flat rooftop, which is lined with battlements. Three Lords' Alliance guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans}) in cold-weather clothing are stationed on the roof of each tower.
zh_tw: 這四個三角形的塔樓每座都有兩層樓高。塔樓內部的房間除了一架木梯通向一個被{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術（見"{@area 監獄特徵|14f|x}"部分的更多詳情）鎖住的鐵質艙門外，其餘都是空的。這個艙口通向塔樓的平坦屋頂，屋頂周圍有城垛。每個塔樓的屋頂上都駐有三名穿著寒冷天氣服裝的領主聯盟守衛（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）。

english: R10: Armory
zh_tw: R10. 軍械庫

english: This room contains wooden racks and chests filled with weaponry. Floating in the middle of the room is a spherical creature with a large central eye and four writhing eyestalks.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有裝滿武器的木架和箱子。房間中央懸浮著一個球形生物，它有一個大眼睛和四隻扭動的眼柄。

english: The inventory is nonmagical and includes twenty {@item Halberd|PHB|halberds}, fifteen {@item Longsword|PHB|longswords}, fifteen {@item Shortsword|PHB|shortswords}, ten {@item Pike|PHB|pikes}, ten {@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|heavy crossbows}, five {@item Light Crossbow|PHB|light crossbows}, and hundreds of {@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|crossbow bolts}.
zh_tw: 庫存是非魔法的，包括二十把{@item Halberd|PHB|長戟}，十五把{@item Longsword|PHB|長劍}，十五把{@item Shortsword|PHB|短劍}，十把{@item Pike|PHB|長矛}，十把{@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|重弩}，五把{@item Light Crossbow|PHB|輕弩}，以及數百支{@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|弩矢}。

english: The armory is guarded by a {@creature spectator} that treats the weapons as treasure. It knows every member of the prison staff on sight. It won't leave the room and attacks anyone it doesn't recognize.
zh_tw: 軍械庫由一隻{@creature spectator||觀察者眼魔}看守，它將武器視為珍寶。它能認出監獄的每一名工作人員。它不會離開房間，並會攻擊任何它不認識的人。

english: Hatch
zh_tw: 艙門

english: A wooden ladder leads to an iron hatch in the ceiling. An {@spell arcane lock} spell seals the hatch (see the "{@area Prison Features|14f|x}" section for more details), which opens onto the roof.
zh_tw: 一架木梯通向天花板上的一個鐵質艙口。一個{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術封印了這個艙口（見"{@area 監獄特徵|14f|x}"部分的更多詳情），艙口通向屋頂。

english: R11: Courtyard
zh_tw: R11. 庭院

english: This courtyard is paved with flagstones, which are covered with drifting snow.
zh_tw: 這個院子鋪著石板，上面覆蓋著飄動的雪花。

english: When the weather allows, prisoners are brought here—individually or in small groups—for fresh air and exercise. They are watched closely by guards on the ground as well as the guards on the corner tower. Characters can speak quietly with a prisoner without being noticed from the tower.
zh_tw: 天氣允許的情況下，囚犯們會單獨或小組被帶到這裡來呼吸新鮮空氣和鍛鍊。他們被地面的守衛以及角樓的守衛嚴密監視。角色可以不被角樓注意地與囚犯小聲交談。

english: R12: Meeting Room
zh_tw: R12. 會議室

english: This room holds a large, rectangular table with a single chair on one long side and three similar chairs on the opposite side. The room is used for meetings with prisoners or the warden.
zh_tw: 這個房間擺放著一張長方形的大桌子，長邊一側有一把椅子，對面則有三把相似的椅子。該房間用於與囚犯或典獄長會面。

english: Hatch
zh_tw: 艙門

english: A wooden ladder leads to an iron hatch in the ceiling that opens onto the roof. An {@spell arcane lock} spell seals the hatch (see the "{@area Prison Features|14f|x}" section for more details).
zh_tw: 一架木梯通向天花板上的一個鐵質艙口，艙口開啟通向屋頂。一個{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術封印了這個艙口（見"{@area 監獄特徵|14f|x}"部分的更多詳情）。

english: R13: Storeroom
zh_tw: R13. 儲藏室

english: Supplies are stored here in crates and other containers. At present, the prison has stockpiled enough necessities to continue operations for six months.
zh_tw: 物資儲存在這裡的板條箱和其他容器中。目前，監獄已儲備了足夠維持六個月運作的必需品。

english: R14: Privy
zh_tw: R14. 廁所

english: This room contains a dozen wooden waste buckets. Once per day, usually in the morning, manacled prisoners carry the buckets outside the prison and dispose of the waste while watched by guards.
zh_tw: 這個房間內放置了一打木製的廢料桶。通常在早上，帶著手銬的囚犯們會在警衛的監視下將這些桶帶到監獄外處理垃圾。

english: R15: Hexagon
zh_tw: R15. 六邊形

english: This corridor allows guards and visitors to access the outermost rooms of the prison while avoiding the panopticon (area R16) and its prison cells (area R17). The guards refer to this corridor as "the hexagon" because of its shape.
zh_tw: 這條走廊允許守衛和訪客在避開全景監獄（區域 R16）及其牢房（區域 R17）的同時，進入監獄最外圍的房間。守衛們因其形狀稱這條走廊為"六邊形"。

english: R16: Panopticon
zh_tw: R16. 全景監獄

english: This hexagonal chamber is a large open space at the center of the prison. Cells line the chamber walls, and a smaller hexagonal room occupies the center of the space.
zh_tw: 這個六邊形的大廳是監獄中心的一個大型開放空間。牢房沿著大廳的牆壁排列，而一個較小的六邊形房間位於這個空間的中心。

english: The {@spell continual flame} spells that light this area can be dimmed from the surveillance hub ({@area area R18|179|x}). The hall is dimly lit at night.
zh_tw: 照亮這個區域的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術可以從監控中心（{@area 區域R18|179|x}）調暗。大廳在夜間照明昏暗。

english: R17: Cells
zh_tw: R17. 牢房

english: Each cell is enclosed by formidable steel bars. Bolted to the back wall are iron bunk beds, each with a thin mattress. A waste bucket sits near the beds.
zh_tw: 每個牢房都被堅固的鋼條包圍。後牆上固定著鐵製雙層床，每張床都有一層薄床墊。床邊放著一個廢物桶。

english: The prisoners are kept in these unlit cells (effectively illuminated by the lights in R16) behind barred gates that can be opened only from {@area area R18|179|x}. The gates are too secure to be forced open using brute strength or weapons, and magical attempts to open or bypass them are thwarted by permanent antimagic fields. Each field encompasses one cell and its gate. Spells and other magical effects, except those created by an artifact or a deity, are suppressed in an antimagic field and can't protrude into it. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.
zh_tw: 囚犯被關在這些沒有直接照明的牢房中（實際上由R16區域的燈光照亮），他們被關在有柵欄的大門後面，這些門只能從{@area 區域R18|179|x}區域開啟。這些大門非常安全，無法用蠻力或武器強行開啟，而且嘗試用魔法開啟或繞過它們的嘗試也會被永久性的反魔法領域所挫敗。每個領域覆蓋一個牢房及其大門。除了神器或神靈創造的法術和其他魔法效果外，在反魔法領域中都被壓制，不能延伸進入其中。當一個效果被壓制時，它不會起作用，但它被壓制所花費的時間會計入其持續時間。

english: Bolted to the back wall of each cell is an iron bunk bed with thin mattresses and a waste bucket nearby. Prisoners take their meals in their cells.
zh_tw: 每個牢房的後牆上都固定著一個帶有薄床墊的鐵製雙層床，附近放著一個廢料桶。囚犯們在他們的牢房裡用餐。

english: Prisoners
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: Each of the twenty-four cells can hold one or two prisoners. Roll {@dice 4d10} to determine the number of prisoners currently incarcerated at Revel's End, give each one an identification number, and distribute them in the cells as you see fit. Numbers are assigned in the order in which the prisoners arrive and are never reused. The longest-serving prisoner currently incarcerated at Revel's End is Prisoner 6, and the newest one is Prisoner 299. {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} (see the "{@area Roleplaying Prisoner 13|187|x}" section later in this adventure for more details) has no cellmate. Her cell is marked on {@adventure map 4.1|KftGV|4|Map 4.1: Players' Map}.
zh_tw: 這二十四個牢房每個可以關押一名或兩名囚犯。擲{@dice 4d10}來確定目前在瑞維爾之末關押的囚犯人數，給每個囚犯一個身份證號碼，並根據您的判斷將他們分配到牢房中。號碼按照囚犯到達的順序分配，並且永遠不會重複使用。目前在瑞維爾之末服刑時間最長的囚犯是6號囚犯，最新的一個是299號囚犯。{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}（詳見本冒險後面的"{@area 扮演囚犯13|187|x}"部分以獲取更多詳細資訊）沒有牢房同伴。她的牢房在{@adventure 地圖 4.1|KftGV|4|Map 4.1: Players' Map}上有標記。

english: To add detail to other inmates, roll on the Prisoners table or choose entries you like. If a prisoner's game statistics become necessary, choose an appropriate stat block from the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, and remove armor, weapons, and other gear.
zh_tw: 要為其他囚犯新增細節，可以在囚犯表上擲骰子或選擇您喜歡的條目。如果需要囚犯的遊戲具體數值，從{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中選擇一個合適的具體數值塊，並移除盔甲、武器和其他裝備。

english: Prisoners
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Prisoner
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: Gallia Strand (neutral evil human), convicted of smuggling contraband luxuries, has served {@dice 1d6} years of a 10-year sentence.
zh_tw: 加莉亞·史特蘭德（中立邪惡人類），因走私違禁奢侈品被定罪，已經服刑了10年刑期中的{@dice 1d6}年。

english: Barlo Rageblade (chaotic good human), a famous adventurer convicted of reckless endangerment, has served {@dice 1d4} years of a 5-year sentence.
zh_tw: 巴洛·怒刃（混亂善良人類），一位因魯莽危害罪被定罪的著名冒險家，已經服刑了5年刑期中的{@dice 1d4}年。

english: Quillion Sardo (lawful neutral halfling), convicted of using magic to influence others, has served {@dice 1d4} years of a 5-year sentence.
zh_tw: 奎利昂·薩爾多（守法中立的半身人），因使用魔法影響他人而被定罪，已經服刑{@dice 1d4}年，刑期為5年。

english: Pirouette (chaotic evil tiefling), a thieves' guild leader convicted of multiple crimes, has served {@dice 1d20} years of a life sentence.
zh_tw: 皮魯埃特（混亂邪惡的提夫林），一個被定罪的盜賊公會領袖，因多項罪行已被判處無期徒刑，已服刑{@dice 1d20}年。

english: Ishar (chaotic evil elf), convicted of conspiracy to murder members of a noble family, has served {@dice 1d20} years of a life sentence.
zh_tw: 伊沙爾（混亂邪惡精靈），因密謀殺害貴族家庭成員而被定罪，已經服了無期徒刑中的{@dice 1d20}年。

english: Grix (neutral goblin), convicted of espionage, has served {@dice 1d6} years of a 10-year sentence.
zh_tw: 格里克斯（中立地精），因間諜罪被判刑，已經服刑了{@dice 1d6}年，刑期為10年。

english: An adventurer makes contact with the enigmatic {@creature prisoner 13|KftGV}
zh_tw: 一位冒險家與神秘的{@creature prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}取得聯絡

english: R18: Surveillance Hub
zh_tw: R18. 監控中心

english: This hexagonal room is the base of the prison's central tower. A spiral staircase rises to the tower's upper levels. Several guards watch through the arrow slits, observing the cells, while one sits at a metal desk and console with a myriad of switches and dials and a brass tube with a funnel-like flare.
zh_tw: 這個六邊形的房間是監獄中心塔的基座。一座螺旋樓梯通向上層。幾名守衛透過箭縫觀察牢房，而另一名守衛坐在一個帶有各種開關和旋鈕的金屬桌前，旁邊是一個帶有漏斗狀噴口的黃銅管。

english: The stairs lead to areas {@area R19|17c|x} through {@area R23|186|x}. Seven guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans}) are stationed in this surveillance hub. One sits at a console south of the staircase. The other guards watch the prisoners through 4-foot-tall, 1-foot-wide arrow slits in the walls. Hanging on the walls between the arrow slits are fifty sets of iron manacles guards use to bind prisoners' wrists and ankles.
zh_tw: 樓梯通往{@area R19|17c|x}至{@area R23|186|x}區域。這個監控中心有七名守衛（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）駐守。其中一名坐在樓梯南邊的控制檯前。其他守衛透過牆上4尺高、1尺寬的箭縫觀察囚犯。牆上的箭縫之間掛著五十套鐵製手銬和腳鐐，供守衛用來繫結囚犯的手和腳。

english: Console
zh_tw: 控制檯

english: The console is a magical device that resembles a desk with a slanted top and is bolted to the floor. It is a Large object with AC 15, 18 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The console has the following magical properties, which are disabled if it is reduced to 0 hit points:
zh_tw: 控制檯是一個類似斜面辦公桌的魔法裝置，固定在地板上。它是一個大型物體，具有15的護甲等級，18點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。控制檯具有以下魔法屬性，如果它的生命值降至0點，則這些屬性將被禁用：

english: Gate Control
zh_tw: 門控

english: Twenty-four switches on the console open and close the gates to the prison cells. A master switch opens or closes all the gates at once. Flipping one or more switches on the console requires an action.
zh_tw: 控制檯上的二十四個開關用來開啟和關閉監獄牢房的門。一個主開關可以一次性開啟或關閉所有的門。翻轉控制檯上的一個或多個開關需要一個動作。

english: Light Control
zh_tw: 燈控

english: A brass dial on the console controls the light level in {@area area R16|174|x}. Turning the dial requires an action or a bonus action.
zh_tw: 控制檯上面的黃銅旋鈕用來控制{@area 區域R16|174|x}的光線強度。轉動旋鈕需要一個動作或一個附贈動作。

english: Loudspeaker
zh_tw: 揚聲器

english: As an action, a creature can use this device, which resembles the bell of a trumpet, to broadcast its voice throughout the prison.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，生物可以使用這個類似小號喇叭口的裝置在整個監獄中廣播它的聲音。

english: R19: Barracks
zh_tw: R19. 營房

english: A door in the spiral staircase leads into a large room filled with wooden bunk beds. There are arrow slits in the north, west, and south walls. Footlockers and armor racks accompany each bed. The spiral stairs continue up past the door.
zh_tw: 螺旋樓梯中的一扇門通向一個大型房間，房間裡擺滿了木製雙層床。北面、西面和南面的牆上有箭縫。每個床邊都有儲物箱和盔甲架。螺旋樓梯在門上方繼續向上延伸。

english: Characters who climb the spiral staircase come to a door 100 feet above the prison roof. The staircase continues beyond this door to the tower's higher levels.
zh_tw: 爬上螺旋樓梯的角色會來到監獄屋頂上方100尺處的一扇門前。樓梯在此門後繼續延伸至塔樓的更高層。

english: The door opens into a room filled with wooden bunk beds. Areas to the north, west, and south can be viewed through 4-foot-tall, 1-foot-wide arrow slits. The {@spell continual flame} spells that light the room can be dimmed or brightened by uttering the command word, "lights."
zh_tw: 門通向一個充滿木製雙層床的房間。透過北面、西面和南面的4尺高、1尺寬的箭縫可以檢視其他區域。照亮房間的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術可以透過說出命令詞"lights"來調暗或調亮。

english: When the prison isn't on high alert, fifty guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans} without armor or weapons) sleep in the bunks. The guards keep their armor and weapons within easy reach. They keep other belongings in unlocked footlockers tucked under their bunk beds.
zh_tw: 當監獄沒有處於高度警戒狀態時，五十名守衛（沒有穿戴盔甲或攜帶武器的{@creature Veteran||老兵}）在雙層床上睡覺。守衛們將他們的盔甲和武器放在容易拿到的地方。他們將其他個人物品放在雙層床下未上鎖的儲物箱中。

english: The guards need 10 minutes to don their armor. If the prison is put on high alert, the guards take the time to put on their armor before making their way down to area R18.
zh_tw: 守衛們需要10分鐘來穿戴護甲。如果監獄進入高度警戒狀態，守衛們會花時間穿上護甲，然後前往R18區域。

english: R20: Hall of Absolution
zh_tw: R20. 寬恕大廳

english: The floor of this room is 120 feet above the prison roof. A spiral staircase connects the room to the other levels of the tower ({@area area R18|179|x} is 140 feet down, area R19 is 20 feet down, and {@area area R23|186|x} is 20 feet up). Narrow windows line the outer walls.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板位於監獄屋頂上方120尺處。一座螺旋樓梯將這個房間與塔的其他層連線起來（{@area 區域R18|179|x}在下方140尺，R19在下方20尺，而{@area 區域R23|186|x}在上方20尺）。狹窄的窗戶排列在外牆。

english: A long, slightly curved table with eleven chairs takes up much of the room. The middle chair has no special adornments, while the others have banners hanging over their high backs, each one emblazoned with the crest of a Lords' Alliance member. Banners hanging on the walls display the alliance's emblem: a golden crown on a red field.
zh_tw: 一張長而微彎的桌子，配有十一個椅子，佔據了房間的大部分空間。中間的椅子沒有特別的裝飾，而其他的椅子上方掛著橫幅，每張橫幅上都印有領主聯盟成員的紋章。掛在牆上的橫幅展示著聯盟的標誌：紅色背景上的金色皇冠。

english: Absolution Council Meetings
zh_tw: 赦免委員會會議

english: Members of the Absolution Council gather here to weigh the merits of releasing prisoners whom one or more council members have recommended for parole. No prisoner can receive such consideration more than once a year. Prisoners up for parole are brought to this room in manacles and given a chance to sway the council members before votes are cast. The warden (see area R21), who always attends such meetings, sits in the middle chair and casts the tiebreaking vote, if necessary.
zh_tw: 寬恕委員會的成員們聚集在這裡，權衡釋放被一個或多個委員會成員推薦假釋的囚犯的優點。沒有囚犯一年內可以被考慮超過一次。被考慮假釋的囚犯被帶到這個房間，戴著鐐銬，並在投票前有機會影響委員會成員。監獄長（見區域 R21），總是參加這樣的會議，坐在中間的椅子上，如果需要，投下決定性的一票。

english: R21: Warden's Quarters
zh_tw: R21. 典獄長宿舍

english: The {@spell arcane lock} on this door can be opened only by the warden. Beyond the door is a comfortable bedchamber lit by a {@spell continual flame} spell that can be dimmed or brightened by uttering the command word, "vaudra."
zh_tw: 這扇門上的{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}只能由監獄長開啟。門的另一邊是一個舒適的臥室，由一個可以調暗或調亮的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮，說出命令詞"vaudra"即可。

english: Prison Warden
zh_tw: 典獄長

english: The calm and unflappable warden of Revel's End is Marta Marthannis, a lawful good, human {@creature mage} who speaks Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, and Orc. She wears a red robe with gold trim and keeps a ring with seven tiny keys hanging from it in one pocket. One key unlocks the warden's chest (see "Treasure" below); the others unlock the desk drawer and the cabinets in the warden's office ({@area area R22|184|x}).
zh_tw: 瑞維爾之末的監獄長瑪塔·瑪薩尼斯是一個沉著冷靜、守序善良的人類{@creature mage||魔法師}，她會說通用語、龍語、矮人語和獸人語。她穿著一件帶有金色飾邊的紅色長袍，口袋裡掛著一枚帶有七個小鑰匙的戒指。其中一把鑰匙可以開啟監獄長的箱子（見下文的"寶藏"部分）；其他的鑰匙可以開啟監獄長辦公室（{@area 區域R22|184|x}）的書桌抽屜和櫃子。

english: Warden Marthannis is secretly a member of the Harpers, a faction that works behind the scenes to keep power out of the hands of evildoers. In her current position, she works to keep some of the Sword Coast's worst malefactors behind bars. So far, the warden has managed to conceal her Harper affiliation from everyone else in the prison.
zh_tw: 監獄長瑪珊尼斯實際上是豎琴手（豎琴手聯盟）的秘密成員，這是一個在幕後工作，防止權力落入惡人手中的派系。在她目前的職位上，她致力於讓劍灣一些最壞的罪犯留在監獄裡。到目前為止，監獄長設法向監獄中的其他人隱瞞了她作為豎琴手的身份。

english: Marthannis's Possession
zh_tw: 瑪珊尼斯遭附身

english: Unlike her membership in the Harpers, Marthannis hasn't concealed the fact that she is periodically possessed. Lodged inside her is the spirit of a deceased adventuring companion: a lawful good, shield dwarf fighter named Vlax Brawnanvil. The spirit of Vlax takes control of Warden Marthannis once or twice a day, each time for an hour or two—though never while she's performing important duties, such as supervising prisoner meetings with visitors.
zh_tw: 與她在豎琴手團的成員身份不同，瑪薩尼斯沒有隱瞞她定期被附身的事實。在她體內的是一個已故的冒險夥伴的靈魂：一個守序善良、盾矮人戰士，名叫弗拉克斯·布勞南維爾。弗拉克斯的靈魂每天會控制監獄長瑪薩尼斯一次或兩次，每次持續一到兩個小時——儘管永遠不會在她執行重要職責時，例如監督囚犯與訪客的會面。

english: While under Vlax's control, the warden can't cast her prepared spells or use the command word for high alert (see the "{@area High Alert|15c|x}" section), speaks only Dwarvish, and occasionally indulges Vlax's vice for ale and spirits.
zh_tw: 在弗拉克斯的控制下，監獄長不能施放她準備好的法術，也不能使用高警戒的命令詞（見"{@area 高度警戒|15c|x}"部分），只能說矮人語，並且偶爾會沉溺於弗拉克斯對啤酒和烈酒的嗜好。

english: Warden Marthannis knows that to rid herself of Vlax's spirit, she must visit the Brawnanvil crypts in Gauntlgrym, a dwarven fortress under Mount Hotenow (near Neverwinter), where the spirits of Vlax's kin can persuade Vlax to join them in the afterlife. The warden refuses to make the journey, however, because she can't bear to lose all contact with Vlax. The warden has made her state known to the prison guards and Absolution Council members, and they have grown accustomed to her personality changes and bouts of revelry. The possession hasn't affected the warden's ability to carry out her duties, and so far, no one has questioned her fitness for her job.
zh_tw: 監獄長瑪薩尼斯知道，要想擺脫弗拉克斯的靈魂，她必須前往位於霍特諾山下（靠近無冬城）的岡特格林的布勞南維爾家族墓穴，那裡是矮人堡壘，弗拉克斯的族人的靈魂可以說服弗拉克斯加入他們的來世。然而，監獄長拒絕踏上這段旅程，因為她無法忍受與弗拉克斯完全失去聯絡。監獄長已經向監獄守衛和寬恕委員會成員表明了她的立場，他們已經習慣了她性格的變化和狂歡發作。附身並沒有影響監獄長履行職責的能力，迄今為止，沒有人質疑她是否適合這份工作。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the chamber's furnishings is a locked wooden chest, for which the warden carries the only key. A character using thieves' tools can use an action to try to pick the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 房間的陳設中包括一個上鎖的木箱，典獄長持有唯一的鑰匙。使用盜賊工具的角色可以用一個動作嘗試開鎖，成功透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定即可開啟。

english: The chest holds a set of {@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB}, a {@item sack|PHB} containing 750 gp (money that's used mainly to pay ship captains who drop off prisoners and cargo), and a silver cloak pin (25 gp) bearing the symbol of the Harpers: a tiny harp nestled between the horns of a crescent moon.
zh_tw: 這個箱子裡裝有一套{@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB|書法工具}，一個裝有750金幣（主要用於支付運送囚犯和貨物的船長）的{@item sack|PHB|麻袋}，以及一枚帶有豎琴手標誌的銀色斗篷別針（25金幣）：一把小豎琴嵌在新月形的角之間。

english: Any character who searches the chest for secret compartments finds one in the lid. It holds a {@item wand of binding} that the warden keeps for emergencies.
zh_tw: 任何在箱子內尋找暗格的角色都會發現，箱子的蓋子就有一個暗格。裡面放著一根典獄長為應付緊急狀況而保留的{@item wand of binding||定身魔杖}。

english: R22: Office
zh_tw: R22. 辦公室

english: A heavy desk stands in the middle of the room with parchment, quills, and ink at the ready. Five heavy wood cabinets line the east wall.
zh_tw: 房間中央放著一張沉重的書桌，上面備有羊皮紙、羽毛筆和墨水。東牆邊排列著五個結實的木製檔案櫃。

english: Prison records are stored here in the locked cabinets. The cabinets also contain ship cargo manifests and records of past deliveries, as well as prisoner transfer orders and a ledger documenting the names, crimes, sentences, and commutations of every prisoner who has been incarcerated at Revel's End. The records include death certificates for prisoners who died while incarcerated. The cause of death is always given as "natural," "accidental," or "unnatural," with no details.
zh_tw: 監獄記錄存放在這些鎖著的櫃子裡。櫃子裡還包含船隻貨物清單和過去的交貨記錄，以及囚犯轉移令和一本賬簿，記錄了在瑞維爾之末服刑的每名囚犯的名字、罪行、刑期和減刑情況。記錄中包括了在押期間死亡囚犯的死亡證明。死因總是被標註為"自然"、"意外"或"非自然"，沒有詳細說明。

english: A desk in the middle of the room has ten financial ledgers packed into a locked side drawer. The keys for the desk and the cabinets are in the warden's possession. A character with thieves' tools can use an action to try to pick the lock on the desk drawer or one of the cabinets, doing so with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 房間中央的一張桌子上有一個鎖著的側抽屜，裡面塞滿了十本財務賬簿。桌子和櫃子的鑰匙由典獄長保管。擁有盜賊工具的角色可以使用一個動作嘗試撬開桌子抽屜或其中一個櫃子的鎖，成功透過 {@dc 12} 敏捷檢定即可開啟。

english: R23: Tower Roof
zh_tw: R23. 塔樓屋頂

english: This flat rooftop is 140 feet above the prison roof and 300 feet above sea level. Three 6-foot-high walls to the north, southwest, and southeast provide limited cover, but much of the rooftop is exposed to the elements.
zh_tw: 這個平坦的屋頂位於監獄屋頂上方140尺，海平面以上300尺。北面、西南面和東南面的三面6尺高的牆提供了有限的掩護，但屋頂的大部分都暴露在自然環境中。

english: A wooden drawbridge can be lowered on one side to create an airship dock. An action is required to raise or lower the drawbridge.
zh_tw: 可在其中一側放下木製吊橋以形成飛艇停泊處。升起或降下吊橋需要一個標準動作。

english: No guards are stationed here. If the guards in the prison watchtowers ({@area area R9|16a|x}) see an airship or an airborne threat approaching Revel's End, they alert the rest of the prison. The warden then dons cold-weather clothing and heads to the roof to greet the airship crew or deal with the airborne threat herself.
zh_tw: 這裡沒有守衛駐守。如果監獄的瞭望塔中的守衛（{@area 區域R9|16a|x}）看到飛艇或空中威脅接近瑞維爾之末，他們會向監獄的其他部分發出警報。然後監獄長會穿上適合寒冷天氣的服裝，前往屋頂迎接飛艇工作人員或親自處理空中威脅。

english: Roleplaying Prisoner 13
zh_tw: 扮演囚犯13

english: The first time the characters encounter {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}, read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次遇到{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This tightly muscled dwarven woman keeps her red hair cut short. Her bronze skin is covered in tattoos that stretch from her collarbone to her ankles. She surveys you with unimpressed eyes.
zh_tw: 這位肌肉結實的矮人女性留著短髮。她的青銅色皮膚上佈滿了從鎖骨延伸到腳踝的紋身。她用不以為然的眼神審視著你。

english: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} is a cunning schemer, ruthless and patient. She listens and watches, absorbing every detail she can, and shares as little as she can get away with.
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 是一個狡猾的策劃者，無情且有耐心。她傾聽和觀察，吸收她能收集到的每一個細節，並且儘可能少地分享資訊。

english: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} is comfortable with her lot in life, enjoying the anonymity and ironic protection of Revel's End like a warm blanket on a winter night. While confined to her antimagic cell, she is cautious since she can't rely on her magic tattoos to defend herself. Outside her cell, she grows overly confident and even banters if she's able to do so without being caught by guards. In battle she poses a potent threat, creating blasts of flame and striking with magical force in both melee and ranged combat.
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 對她的生活境遇感到滿意，享受著瑞維爾之末的匿名性和諷刺性的保護，就像冬夜溫暖的毯子一樣。雖然她被困在她的反魔法牢房裡，她很謹慎，因為她不能依靠她的魔法紋身來保護自己。在牢房外，她變得過於自信，甚至如果她能在不被守衛發現的情況下，還會進行打趣。在戰鬥中，她構成了巨大的威脅，能夠創造出火焰爆炸，並在近戰和遠端戰鬥中以魔法力量攻擊。

english: She spends her time contemplating the web of schemes she learns through the eyes, ears, and hands of her agents outside the prison. While outside her cell during daily exercise in the courtyard or during chores, she contacts her agents for updates and makes arrangements that keep her network running.
zh_tw: 她透過監獄外的代理人的眼睛、耳朵和手，花時間沉思她所瞭解的陰謀網路。在監獄中庭進行日常鍛鍊或在雜務期間外出時，她聯絡她的代理人以獲取更新，並做出安排以保持她的網路運作。

english: Prisoner 13's Tattoos
zh_tw: 十三號囚犯的紋身

english: Most of {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}'s inkwork is covered by her uniform. Her tattoos include the following:
zh_tw: {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 的大部分紋身被她的制服所覆蓋。她的紋身包括以下內容：

english: Dwarven Poetry
zh_tw: 矮人詩歌

english: An excerpt from a poem in Dwarvish script on her neck and across her shoulder blades reads, "Endless dreams entombed in stone."
zh_tw: 她的頸背和肩胛骨上刻著一段矮人文字的詩篇，上面寫著：'無盡的夢境埋葬在石頭之中。'

english: Flames
zh_tw: 噴火

english: A roiling storm of brilliant flames covers her back and ribs.
zh_tw: 在她的背部和肋骨上，有一圈燦爛的火焰風暴。

english: Shroud
zh_tw: 環繞

english: Black and gray smoke and shadows coil down her left arm, ending in runes on the fingers of her left hand.
zh_tw: 黑色和灰色的煙霧和陰影沿著她的左臂盤旋而下，在她的左手手指上以符文結束。

english: Knotwork
zh_tw: 繩結

english: Purple and blue knotwork and runes run down her right arm, across the back of her right hand, and down the length of each finger. The runes on her fingers, known as the keystone tattoo, form the key to the vault in Gauntlgrym. The characters must acquire this key to complete their mission (see "{@area Acquiring the Key|18b|x}" below).
zh_tw: 紫色和藍色的結繩圖案和符文沿著她的右臂延伸，穿過她右手的背面，覆蓋每個手指的長度。她手指上的符文被稱為基石紋身，構成了岡特格林金庫之鑰。角色們必須獲得這把鑰匙才能完成他們的任務（見下文的"{@area 獲取鑰匙|18b|x}"部分）。

english: Mountain
zh_tw: 山地

english: Silver and brown mountain peaks cover her chest, the tips following the angles of her collarbones.
zh_tw: 銀色和棕色的山峰覆蓋在她的胸前，山峰的頂端與她鎖骨的角度一致。

english: River
zh_tw: 河流

english: Swirling green and blue waters form a cascading river across her stomach, with scaly creatures leering from the water.
zh_tw: 旋轉的綠色和藍色的水在她的腹部形成一條層層疊疊的河流，有鱗片的生物從水中露出來。

english: Power and Plunder
zh_tw: 權力與掠奪

english: Dwarvish script on her hips reads "Power" and "Plunder."
zh_tw: 她臀部上的矮人文字寫著"力量"和"掠奪"。

english: Traced among {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}'s tattoos are tiny magical sigils, each one matching a twin tattooed on one of her agents. A character who examines any visible tattoos and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices some of the hidden marks. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check determines that the sigils have something to do with minds or telepathy.
zh_tw: [在{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}的紋身中隱藏著微小的魔法符號，每一個符號都與她的一名特工的對應符號相匹配。一個角色如果檢查任何可見的紋身並在{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定中成功，會注意到一些隱藏的標記。一個角色如果在{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定中成功，可以確定這些符號與心靈或心靈感應有關。]

english: Acquiring the Key
zh_tw: 獲取鑰匙

english: If she's approached with the possibility of freedom, {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} looks genuinely surprised but quickly assumes her usual neutral mask. Here's how she responds to some likely questions:
zh_tw: 如果有人向她提出自由的可能性，{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 看起來真的感到驚訝，但很快又恢復了她通常的中立表情。以下是她對一些可能問題的回答方式：

english: {@b What do you know about the vault and key?} She plays coy: "I don't know what you mean." If pressed further, she shrugs. "I've been asked about this vault and key before. Assuming I did know where the key might be, what would be in it for me to tell you?"
zh_tw: {@b 你對金庫和鑰匙瞭解多少？} 她故作天真：'我不知道你在說什麼。' 如果進一步追問，她聳聳肩。'我之前也被問過關於這個金庫和鑰匙的事。假設我知道鑰匙可能在哪裡，我告訴你的話，我能得到什麼好處？'

english: {@b Do you want to be set free?} "As flattered as I am that you care, I'm afraid I must decline. I'm fine where I am, thanks."
zh_tw: {@b 你想獲得自由嗎？} '雖然我對你關心我感到受寵若驚，但我恐怕必須拒絕。我在這裡很好，謝謝。'

english: {@b What do you want for the key?} She ponders for a moment before answering: "The warden has a ledger, probably in her office. It contains all the names, crimes, and prisoner numbers of everyone ever incarcerated at Revel's End. Bring me that list, and I'll see to it that you get your key."
zh_tw: {@b 你想要什麼作為鑰匙的交換？} 她思考了片刻後回答：'典獄長有一個賬本，可能在她的辦公室裡。它包含了所有在瑞維爾盡頭監獄服刑過的人的名字、罪行和囚犯編號。把那份名單帶給我，我會確保你得到你想要的鑰匙。'

english: In response to a verbal threat, {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} shakes her head and says, "I could make quite a scene and bring the guards down on you. Maybe even the warden herself. You really don't have anything to threaten me with."
zh_tw: 面對口頭威脅，{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 搖了搖頭並說：'我可以讓場面變得很難看，把守衛引來對付你。甚至可能是典獄長本人。你真的沒有什麼可以威脅我的。'

english: Finding the Key
zh_tw: 尋找鑰匙

english: When {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} talks about the key, each character present can make a {@dc 19} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If the check is successful, the character notices {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} flexing her right hand and tracing a fingertip across the tattoo there when she mentions the key. The character deduces that the tattoo is the key.
zh_tw: 當 {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 談論鑰匙時，在場的每個角色都可以進行一次 {@dc 19} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到 {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 在提到鑰匙時彎曲她的右手，並用指尖劃過她右手上的紋身。角色推斷出那個紋身就是鑰匙。

english: Forcible Jailbreak
zh_tw: 強制越獄

english: Taking {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} alive and delivering her to Varrin is difficult but possible. She won't go willingly and fights back if the characters try to force her. In that case, they'll be hard-pressed to knock her {@condition unconscious} and make their escape without alarming the guards and placing the prison on high alert. If a fight breaks out with closed doors between the battle and the nearest guards, on initiative count 0, make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check for the guards to see if they notice the commotion. If they succeed, roll initiative for the guards. They investigate on the following round.
zh_tw: 活捉{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}並將其交給瓦林是困難的，但有可能。她不會自願前往，如果角色試圖強迫她，她會進行反抗。在這種情況下，他們很難將她擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}並在不驚動守衛和使監獄進入高度警戒的情況下逃脫。如果戰鬥在關閉的門後發生，且最近的守衛距離戰場有一定距離，在先攻計數0時，為守衛進行一次{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，看他們是否注意到騷動。如果他們成功，為守衛擲先攻。他們將在下一回合進行調查。

english: Trade for the Key
zh_tw: 交換鑰匙

english: If the characters acquire the prisoner files from the warden's office ({@area area R22|184|x}), {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} demands to read them somewhere outside her cell. She takes 20 minutes to read through the documents and telepathically relay the information to her agents for later use. Following that, she reveals that the tattoo on her right hand is the key to the vault. She allows the characters to study it so they can replicate its image using magic such as {@spell disguise self} or {@spell minor illusion}, or even copy it with pen and ink. In any case, a character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to correctly re-create the tattoo, which requires 10 minutes of study or drawing. The characters can retry if they fail, at the cost of more time and more risk of discovery.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從典獄長的辦公室（{@area 區域R22|184|x}）獲得了囚犯檔案，{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯} 會要求在她的牢房外某個地方閱讀檔案。她花了20分鐘瀏覽檔案，並透過心靈感應將資訊傳遞給她的特工以備後用。之後，她透露她右手上的紋身是金庫之鑰。她允許角色們研究它，以便他們可以使用諸如{@spell disguise self||易容術}或{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}等魔法複製其影象，甚至可以用筆和墨水複製它。無論如何，角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定以正確複製紋身，這需要10分鐘的研究或繪製。如果失敗，角色們可以重試，但會花費更多時間並增加被發現的風險。

english: Last Resort
zh_tw: 絕境反撲

english: A gruesome but effective option is killing {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV} and taking her body back, or just her right hand. If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, they know the organization would not approve of this method. The characters receive no reward from the organization if they kill or mutilate {@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 一種殘忍但有效的選擇是殺死{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}並帶回她的身體，或者僅僅是她的右手。如果角色們為金庫工作，他們知道該組織不會批准這種方法。如果角色們殺死或肢解{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}，他們將不會從組織那裡獲得任何獎勵。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: When the characters successfully deliver the key ({@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV}'s keystone tattoo), Varrin's joy and relief crack his usually reserved exterior, and he sends his agents to open the vault and reveal the lost Axebreaker treasure (he won't allow the characters to be present for the vault opening). While much of the clan's stolen wealth has been spent, there's still a great fortune remaining. As a result of their success, the characters have advantage whenever one of them attempts a Charisma check that would influence Axebreaker dwarves. Varrin makes good on his bargain and gives a fair share to the characters as promised. The reward includes the following coins and gems (use the amounts in brackets if the characters negotiated a 3 percent fee):
zh_tw: 當角色們成功交付鑰匙（即{@creature Prisoner 13|KftGV|十三號囚犯}的關鍵石紋身）時，瓦林的喜悅和寬慰打破了他通常的剋制外表，他派他的代理人去開啟金庫，揭示失落的斧破者寶藏（他不允許角色們在場觀看金庫開啟）。儘管家族的大部分被盜財富已經被花費，但仍有大量財富剩餘。由於他們的成功，當角色們中的任何一個嘗試進行魅力檢定以影響斧破者矮人時，他們將獲得優勢。瓦林履行了他的交易，並如承諾給予角色們公平的份額。獎勵包括以下硬幣和寶石（如果角色們協商了3%的費用，則使用括號內的金額）：

english: 12 (18) {@item Bloodstone||bloodstones} worth 50 gp each
zh_tw: 12 (18) {@item Bloodstone||血玉髓}，每個價值 50 gp

english: The characters can also choose three magic items from the following list, or four items if they successfully negotiated for a bigger reward from Varrin:
zh_tw: 角色們還可以從以下列表中選擇三個魔法物品，如果他們成功地與瓦林協商獲得了更大的獎勵，則可以選擇四個物品：

english: {@item Cap of water breathing}
zh_tw: {@item Cap of water breathing||水下呼吸帽}

english: {@item Dust of disappearance}
zh_tw: {@item Dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}

english: {@item Gem of brightness}
zh_tw: {@item Gem of brightness||光彩奪目寶石}

english: {@item Mithral armor}
zh_tw: {@item Mithral armor||秘銀甲}

english: {@item Potion of Lightning Resistance||Potion of resistance (lightning)}
zh_tw: {@item Potion of Lightning Resistance||抗性藥水（閃電）}

english: {@item Slippers of spider climbing}
zh_tw: {@item Slippers of spider climbing||蛛行便鞋}

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, they must deliver the key to Varrin Axebreaker. Once they do, the organization rewards the characters with a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，他們必須將鑰匙交給瓦林·斧破者。一旦他們這樣做了，該組織將獎勵角色們一個他們選擇的稀有魔法物品（需經你批准）作為報酬。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: Tockworth's Clockworks
zh_tw: 托克沃斯的鐘表機械

english: {@i An Adventure for 5th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合5級角色的冒險}

english: The clockwork automatons that guard the svirfneblin town of Little Lockford have attacked the very residents they were meant to keep safe, forcing a town-wide evacuation. At the heart of the matter is Security Overseer {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV}, a tinkerer who has turned malicious.
zh_tw: 守衛斯涅布力小鎮利特爾洛克福德的發條自動機械攻擊了他們本應保護的居民，迫使整個小鎮疏散。問題的關鍵在於安全監督官{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}，一個變得惡意的修補匠。

english: In this adventure, the characters must enter Little Lockford, recover a security key, and use it to activate a fail-safe device that shuts off the automatons.
zh_tw: 在這個冒險中，角色們必須進入利特爾洛克福德，找回一個安全金鑰，並使用它啟用一個故障安全裝置來關閉自動機械。

english: The svirfneblin town of Little Lockford holds many wonders—and many hidden dangers
zh_tw: 斯涅布力的小鎮小鎖堡擁有許多奇蹟——以及許多隱藏的危險

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: The clockwork automatons that protect Little Lockford are the creations of a gnome tinkerer named {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV}, who recently decided to become a mechanical being herself. She began with a series of procedures whereby she replaced parts of her body with machinery created in her workshop. At some point, Tockworth lost all compassion and empathy for her fellow townspeople. Her fellow tinkerers urged her to stop what she was doing, but she refused. When the militia tried to shut down her workshop, Tockworth unleashed her automatons on the citizens of Little Lockford, many of whom were killed. The survivors fled and regrouped outside the settlement in a nearby network of Underdark tunnels and caverns. The survivors then magically sealed the doors to Little Lockford to keep Tockworth's automatons from escaping.
zh_tw: 保護利特爾洛克福德的發條自動機械是由一個名叫{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}的侏儒修補匠創造的，她最近決定自己成為一個機械生物。她首先透過一系列程式，用自己的工坊裡創造的機械替換了她身體的部分。在某個時刻，托克沃斯失去了對她的同胞的同情和共情。她的修補匠同伴們敦促她停止她正在做的事情，但她拒絕了。當民兵試圖關閉她的工坊時，托克沃斯在利特爾洛克福德的市民上釋放了她的自動機械，許多人被殺害。生還者逃走並在附近的地下黑暗隧道和洞穴網路中重新集結。然後，生還者用魔法封閉了利特爾洛克福德的門，以防止托克沃斯的自動機械逃脫。

english: Tockworth's painstaking transformation into a machine has occupied her for the past few weeks, during which time the other residents of Little Lockford have been searching for adventurers to help them reclaim their settlement.
zh_tw: 托克沃斯費盡心思地將自己改造成機器，這在過去幾週中一直佔據著她的時間，與此同時，小鎖堡的其他居民一直在尋找冒險者來幫助他們奪回他們的定居點。

english: Little Lockford's mayor, Braith Broadfoot, asks the adventurers to infiltrate the town and retrieve a security key last seen in Tockworth's possession. When used to activate a fail-safe device in Tockworth's workshop, the key permanently shuts down the automatons, rendering them harmless. How the characters deal with Tockworth is left up to them.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡的市長佈雷斯·布羅德福特請求冒險者潛入小鎮並取回上次在托克沃斯手中看到的安全鑰匙。當用來啟用托克沃斯工作室中的一個故障安全裝置時，這把鑰匙可以永久關閉自動機，使它們變得無害。角色如何處理托克沃斯則由他們自己決定。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. We have learned the svirfneblin town of Little Lockford needs your help. {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV}, once entrusted with the town's security, has turned the town's clockwork automatons against the populace. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to infiltrate Little Lockford, retrieve a security key, and use it to power down the automatons. You are also empowered to stop {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV} from doing further harm to the town. Start by meeting with the town's mayor, Braith Broadfoot. She's waiting for you in the caves outside the gates of Little Lockford. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。我們得知斯涅布力小鎮利特爾洛克福德需要你們的幫助。{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}，曾經負責小鎮的安全，現在已經把小鎮的發條自動機械對準了民眾。如果你們選擇接受這個任務，你們需要潛入利特爾洛克福德，取回一個安全金鑰，並使用它來關閉自動機械。你們也有權阻止{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}對小鎮造成進一步的傷害。首先，與小鎮的市長佈雷斯·布羅德福特會面。她在利特爾洛克福德大門外的洞穴裡等著你們。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Into the Underdark
zh_tw: 進入幽暗地域

english: Little Lockford is situated in the Underdark, but the tunnels leading to the settlement are well traveled and relatively easy to navigate. Stone signs illuminated by {@spell continual flame} spells can be found at every junction, pointing the way to the settlement.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡位於幽暗地域，但通往定居點的隧道交通繁忙且相對容易導航。在每個交叉路口都可以找到被{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮的石制路標，指引著通往定居點的方向。

english: If you want to make the journey to Little Lockford more interesting, you can insert a random encounter or two as the characters make their way through dark tunnels. To determine what the characters encounter, roll on the Underdark Encounters table.
zh_tw: 如果你想讓前往小洛克福德的旅程更加有趣，你可以在角色們穿越黑暗隧道時插入一兩次隨機遭遇。要確定角色們遇到了什麼，請在幽暗地域遭遇表上進行擲骰。

english: Underdark Encounters
zh_tw: 幽暗地域遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: Two {@creature Grell||grells} drop on the characters from above.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Grell||觸鬚怪}從上方降落到角色們身上。

english: The characters hear the clicks and clacks of three {@creature Hook Horror||hook horrors} several minutes before these predators appear and attack.
zh_tw: 角色們在這些掠食者出現併發起攻擊前幾分鐘就聽到了三個{@creature Hook Horror||恐爪怪}的咔噠聲。

english: A {@creature galeb duhr} reveals itself and tries to converse with the characters in Terran. The creature is bored and eager to strike up a conversation, if only to ask about the weather.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature galeb duhr||石人}現身並試圖用特倫語與角色們交談。這個生物感到無聊，急於開始一段對話，哪怕只是為了詢問天氣。

english: A {@creature black pudding} oozes from a hole in the wall and attacks.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}從牆上的洞中滲出併發起攻擊。

english: The characters find a Tiny clockwork device that was left behind by a svirfneblin miner. The device produces a miniature flame that can be used to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires an action.
zh_tw: 角色們發現了一個由斯涅布力礦工留下的微小發條裝置。這個裝置能產生一個小型火焰，可以用來點燃蠟燭、火把或篝火。使用這個裝置需要一個動作。

english: The characters enter a small cave containing a stone throne fit for a gnome. The throne, which looks like it was carved from a stalagmite, is a {@creature mimic} that attacks anyone who sits on it.
zh_tw: 角色們進入一個小型洞穴，裡面有一個適合侏儒的石制寶座。這個寶座看起來像是從石筍上雕刻出來的，是一個會攻擊任何坐在上面的人{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。

english: A {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} named Nyx Riddlestone is on the lookout for adventurers heading to Little Lockford. Nyx speaks Common, Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon. She greets the characters curtly and offers to escort them to Mayor Broadfoot without delay.
zh_tw: 一個名叫妮克絲·謎石的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}正在尋找前往利特爾洛克福德的冒險者。妮克絲會說通用語、侏儒語、地底語和下界語。她冷淡地向角色們打招呼，並提出立即護送他們去見布羅德福特市長。

english: Meeting the Mayor
zh_tw: 會見市長

english: Mayor Braith Broadfoot (neutral good, deep gnome {@creature commoner}) speaks Common in addition to Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon. She and her fellow gnome exiles are gathered in a cavern not too far from the front gates of the Little Lockford. If the characters say they've come to help, the mayor eagerly gives them an overview of the situation:
zh_tw: 市長佈雷斯·布羅德福特（中立善良，地底侏儒{@creature commoner||平民})除了地精語、特倫語和下層通用語之外，還會說通用語。她和她的同胞侏儒流亡者聚集在離小鎖堡前門不遠的一個洞穴裡。如果角色們說他們是來幫忙的，市長會急切地給他們一個情況概述：

english: "I can't tell you how pleased we are that you're here to help us! We've sealed the gates of Little Lockford to contain the threat that has claimed so many innocent lives.
zh_tw: "我們非常高興你們能來這裡幫助我們！我們已經封閉了利特爾洛克福德的大門，以控制已經奪去許多無辜生命的威脅。"

english: "Some weeks ago, Tockworth, our security overseer, ordered her clockwork automatons to attack her fellow citizens. Not knowing what else to do, I ordered an evacuation. But Little Lockford is our home, and I am determined to reclaim it.
zh_tw: "幾周前，我們的安全監督員托克沃斯命令她的發條自動機攻擊她的同胞。我不知道還能做什麼，所以我下令疏散。但小鎖堡是我們的家，我決心要奪回它。"

english: "Tockworth built a fail-safe device to shut down the automatons in the event of malfunction. The device is in her workshop, protected by a magic symbol on the floor that messes with the mind of any creature that sets foot on it. To activate the fail-safe, you need a security key that Tockworth keeps in a safe in her workshop. We need you to retrieve the security key and use it to shut down the clockwork automatons. How you deal with Tockworth is up to you."
zh_tw: "托克沃斯建造了一個故障安全裝置，用於在自動機械發生故障時關閉它們。這個裝置在她的工坊裡，由地板上的一個魔法符號保護，任何踏上它的生物都會受到心靈幹擾。要啟用故障安全，你需要一個托克沃斯放在她工坊保險箱裡的安全金鑰。我們需要你取回這個安全金鑰，並用它來關閉發條自動機械。至於你如何處理托克沃斯，由你們決定。"

english: Mayor Broadfoot provides a hand-drawn map of the town (give your players a copy of map 5.1). In her haste, the flustered mayor has flip-flopped the locations of the infirmary ({@area area L4|1b5|x}) and the jail ({@area area L5|1b8|x}) on her map.
zh_tw: 布羅德福特市長提供了一張手繪的小鎮地圖（給玩家一份地圖5.1的副本）。在她匆忙之中，這位慌張的市長在她的地圖上把醫務室（{@area 區域L4|1b5|x}）和監獄（{@area 區域L5|1b8|x}）的位置弄反了。

english: Mayor Broadfoot also tells the characters about some useful items hidden under her desk in the town hall ({@area area L2|1ab|x}). The characters are free to claim the items for themselves. If asked why the items were left behind, Mayor Broadfoot admits she forgot about them in her rush to evacuate Little Lockford. The items are as follows:
zh_tw: 布羅德福特市長還告訴角色們，在市政廳（{@area 區域L2|1ab|x}）她的桌子下藏有一些有用的物品。角色們可以自由地為自己索取這些物品。如果被問及為何這些物品被留下，布羅德福特市長承認，在匆忙撤離利特爾洛克福德時，她忘記了它們。這些物品如下：

english: Four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}
zh_tw: 四個{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}

english: A packet of {@item dust of disappearance}
zh_tw: 一包{@item dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}

english: Two {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|flasks of alchemist's fire}
zh_tw: 兩瓶{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|熾火膠}

english: Map 5.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖5.1：玩家地圖

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}

english: Armed with Mayor Broadfoot's map, the characters can begin planning their heist. If they do so in the company of Mayor Broadfoot and her advisers, these deep gnomes share the following useful information:
zh_tw: 有了布羅德福特市長的地圖，角色們可以開始策劃他們的盜竊行動。如果他們在布羅德福特市長和她的顧問們的陪同下這樣做，這些地底侏儒分享了以下有用的資訊：

english: Features
zh_tw: 特性

english: The gnomes can share the information in the "{@area General Features|19d|x}" section. The "{@area Bridges|19e|x}" and "{@area Slagline|1a3|x}" sections are especially important when it comes to planning the heist.
zh_tw: 侏儒可以分享"{@area 通用特徵|19d|x}"部分的資訊。在計劃盜竊時，"{@area 橋|19e|x}"和"{@area 渣線|1a3|x}"部分尤其重要。

english: Tockworth's Automatons
zh_tw: 托克沃斯的自動機械

english: If the characters request more information about Tockworth's automatons, use the information in the "{@area Security Forces|1a4|x}" section to describe them.
zh_tw: 如果角色請求更多關於托克沃斯自動機的資訊，請使用"{@area 安全力量|1a4|x}"部分的資訊來描述它們。

english: Tixie Tockworth
zh_tw: 蒂克西·托克沃斯

english: The trouble began when Tockworth began performing magical procedures on herself, replacing parts of her body with machine parts. Her fellow tinkerers urged her to stop these procedures, but she refused. The mayor ordered the militia to shut down Tockworth's workshop, but the militia was unable to get past the shield guardian stationed outside the workshop. After the militia was rebuffed, Tockworth instructed her automatons to attack everyone else in Little Lockford.
zh_tw: 問題始於托克沃斯開始對自己進行魔法程式，用機器部件替換她身體的部分。她的同僚修補匠們敦促她停止這些程式，但她拒絕了。市長下令民兵關閉托克沃斯的工作室，但民兵無法越過工作室外的防護守衛。民兵被擊退後，托克沃斯指示她的自動機攻擊小鎖堡中的其他人。

english: Warehouse Contraption
zh_tw: 倉庫裝置

english: Warehouse 6, in the Cavemouth district, contains a magical drilling machine big enough to hold two characters (see {@area area L11|1df|x} for details). The svirfneblin have no clue what the characters might use it for, but it could come in handy.
zh_tw: 位於洞口區區的6號倉庫包含一個足夠容納兩個角色的魔法鑽探機（詳見{@area 區域L11|1df|x}）。斯涅布力人不知道角色們可能用它來做什麼，但它可能會派上用場。

english: Rewards
zh_tw: 獎勵

english: If the characters retrieve the security key and shut down Tockworth's automatons, Mayor Broadfoot promises to award the characters the following treasure:
zh_tw: 如果角色們取回安全鑰匙並關閉了托克沃斯的自動機，布羅德福特市長承諾將獎勵角色們以下寶藏：

english: Ruby ring worth 5,000 gp
zh_tw: 紅寶石戒指，價值5000 gp

english: {@item Boots of striding and springing}
zh_tw: {@item Boots of striding and springing||跑跳之靴}

english: {@item Driftglobe}
zh_tw: {@item Driftglobe||漂浮之球}

english: {@item Stone of good luck}
zh_tw: {@item Stone of good luck||吉運之石}

english: If the characters make the case that one or more of the magic items might help them accomplish their mission, Mayor Broadfoot agrees to give them one magic item as a down payment—though if the characters abandon the mission, she expects them to return the item.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提出一個或多個魔法物品可能有助於他們完成使命，布羅德福特市長同意給他們一個魔法物品作為預付款——儘管如果角色們放棄使命，她希望他們歸還這個物品。

english: Shown the Door
zh_tw: 被指門

english: When the characters are ready to enter Little Lockford, they're led to the town's fortified entrance by Sergeant Yombad Cragknuckle (neutral good {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome}), the highest ranked of the surviving militia members. Stern and scowling, he walks with a slight limp and has a heavily bandaged arm, both the result of injuries he sustained during the evacuation.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好進入小鎖堡時，他們被帶到小鎮的加固入口，由軍士長約姆巴德·克雷格克納克（中立善良{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}），他是倖存民兵中級別最高的成員。他嚴肅且皺眉，走路時有輕微的跛行，手臂上纏著厚厚的繃帶，這都是他在疏散過程中受傷的結果。

english: Sergeant Cragknuckle speaks Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon, but not Common. If asked for advice on the mission, the sergeant offers the following information and guidance:
zh_tw: 岩拳軍士會說侏儒語、地語和下界語，但不會說通用語。如果被問及有關任務的建議，軍士提供了以下資訊和指導：

english: Friendly Advice
zh_tw: 友好建議

english: The sergeant urges the characters to move quickly and quietly through the town, doing their best to avoid Tockworth's automatons.
zh_tw: 軍士長敦促角色們在小鎮中快速且安靜地移動，盡最大努力避免托克沃斯的自動機。

english: Avoid Cavemouth
zh_tw: 避開洞口區

english: The sergeant suggests the characters avoid the Cavemouth district due to the likely presence of monsters there. (Normally kept at bay by the clockwork automatons, monsters are likely to have ventured from their hidey-holes and into the streets. Gricks are a particular nuisance.)
zh_tw: 軍士長建議角色們避開洞口區，因為那裡很可能有怪物存在。（通常由發條自動機控制，怪物很可能已經從它們的藏身之處出來，進入了街道。穴居攫怪蟲特別討厭。）

english: Healing Aids
zh_tw: 治療輔助

english: The sergeant recalls that {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} and {@item Healer's Kit|PHB|healer's kits} can be found in the city infirmary in Turbine Heights.
zh_tw: 軍士回憶說，在渦輪高地的市立醫院可以找到{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}和{@item Healer's Kit|PHB|醫療包}。

english: Additionally, if the characters show Sergeant Cragknuckle the map of Little Lockford provided by Mayor Broadfoot, the sergeant points out that the map flip-flops the locations of the infirmary ({@area area L4|1b5|x}) and the jail ({@area area L5|1b8|x}).
zh_tw: 此外，如果角色們向克雷格克納克軍士長展示布羅德福特市長提供的《小鎖堡地圖》，軍士長會指出地圖上醫務室（{@area 區域L4|1b5|x}）和監獄（{@area 區域L5|1b8|x}）的位置被顛倒了。

english: Little Lockford Overview
zh_tw: 小洛克福德概覽

english: Due to its strategic location and proximity to valuable resources, Little Lockford has been a consistent target of attack. As a result, the deep gnomes have fortified the town, which is described in greater detail below.
zh_tw: 由於其戰略位置和靠近寶貴資源，小鎖堡一直是攻擊的持續目標。因此，地底侏儒加固了小鎮，下面將更詳細地描述。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The town is situated in a vast cavern tinged red by the magma that flows through the channels that separate the various districts. By and large, the town is well maintained, with streets and buildings composed of gray stone bricks. Other noteworthy features are summarized in the sections that follow.
zh_tw: 這個小鎮位於一個巨大的洞穴中，洞穴被流經分隔各個區域的通道的巖漿染成了紅色。總體而言，這個小鎮維護得很好，街道和建築物由灰色石磚構成。其他值得注意的特點在以下各節中進行了總結。

english: Bridges
zh_tw: 橋

english: Bridges made of wood and metal span the magma lake at various points, connecting the town's various districts to one another. Consoles in the power station ({@area area L6|1bb|x}) and the security center ({@area area L12|1e7|x}) enable these bridges to be raised or lowered, much like a modern-day drawbridge that spans a waterway.
zh_tw: 由木頭和金屬製成的橋樑在不同的點橫跨巖漿湖，將小鎮的各個區域連線起來。在發電站（{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}）和安全中心（{@area 區域L12|1e7|x}）的控制檯可以控制這些橋樑的升起或降下，就像現代的吊橋橫跨水道一樣。

english: To control the flow of traffic through town, Tockworth has raised the following bridges: the Old Lockford–Cavemouth bridge, the Cavemouth–Smoldertown bridge, one of the two Smoldertown–Turbine Heights bridges, and the two bridges leading to the Overlook from Old Lockford and Turbine Heights.
zh_tw: 為了控制城鎮內的交通流量，托克沃斯提高了以下橋樑：舊洛克福德-洞穴口橋、洞穴口-煙霧鎮橋、兩個煙霧鎮-渦輪高地橋中的一個，以及通往舊洛克福德和渦輪高地的兩個俯瞰區的橋樑。

english: Buildings
zh_tw: 建築物

english: Most of Little Lockford's buildings are single-story stone structures (about 12 feet high) with stone doors that are 5 feet high and 3 feet wide. Building interiors tend to be unlit (which is of little concern to deep gnomes, who have {@sense darkvision}), and they contain furnishings sized for gnomes.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡的大多數建築是單層的石結構（大約12尺高），配有5尺高、3尺寬的石門。建築內部往往沒有照明（對於擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}能力的地底侏儒來說，這不是什麼大問題），它們包含了為侏儒量身定做的傢俱。

english: Little Lockford contains many buildings not described in the adventure. If the characters investigate one of these buildings, roll on the Buildings of Little Lockford table to determine what kind of building it is. Each building's occupants took everything of value before fleeing Little Lockford, leaving nothing of value for characters to find.
zh_tw: 利特爾洛克福德包含許多在冒險中未被描述的建築。如果角色們調查這些建築中的一個，可以透過利特爾洛克福德建築表來決定它是什麼型別的建築。每個建築的居住者在逃離利特爾洛克福德之前帶走了所有有價值的東西，沒有留下任何有價值的東西供角色們發現。
