english: While most districts sit 150 feet above the magma lake, two do not. The Overlook, built into a rock formation at the center of the cavern, sits 170 feet above the magma. Cavemouth is 120 feet above the magma.
zh_tw: 雖然大多數區域位於巖漿湖上方150尺處，但有兩個區域不是。位於洞穴中心的岩石形態中的俯瞰區（瞭望區）位於巖漿上方170尺。洞口區位於巖漿上方120尺。

english: Exterior Lighting
zh_tw: 外部照明

english: The roof and walls of Little Lockford are bathed in a fiery hue, thanks to the magma that fills the lake and heats the town. The town's power station ({@area area L6|1bb|x}) generates electricity that powers streetlamps in every district, although the streetlamps have gone out in Cavemouth. These lights can be switched on or off from control consoles in the power station and the security center ({@area area L12|1e7|x}).
zh_tw: 由於充滿巖漿的湖泊加熱了整個小鎮，利特爾洛克福德的屋頂和牆壁被染上了火紅色。小鎮的發電站（{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}）發電，為每個區域的路燈供電，儘管洞穴口區的路燈已經熄滅了。這些燈可以在發電站和安全中心（{@area 區域L12|1e7|x}）的控制檯上開啟或關閉。

english: Magma
zh_tw: 巖漿

english: Any creature that falls into Little Lockford's magma lake is likely to be killed instantly unless that creature is immune to fire damage. Any creature that enters the magma for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 任何掉入小鎖堡巖漿湖的生物都可能立即死亡，除非該生物對火焰傷害免疫。任何在回合中首次進入巖漿的生物，或者在巖漿中開始其回合的生物，將受到55點（{@dice 10d10}）火焰傷害。

english: Slagline
zh_tw: 渣線

english: Suspended above the magma lake is a carousel-like chain of dangling steel buckets called the Slagline. The buckets are spaced 15 feet apart. Roughly half of them contain ore and uncut gems from the mines; the rest are empty and big enough to carry five Small creatures or two Medium creatures each.
zh_tw: 懸掛在巖漿湖上方的是一個旋轉木馬式的鏈條，鏈條上懸掛著鋼桶，被稱為渣線。這些桶間隔15尺。大約一半的桶裡裝有來自礦山的礦石和未切割的寶石；其餘的桶是空的，每個足夠大，可以攜帶五隻小型生物或兩隻中型生物。

english: The Slagline is automated so that the buckets move counterclockwise around the town. (Normally, ore and gems from the Cavemouth district are received at the foundry in the Smoldertown district for smelting and refining. The processed materials are then transported past Turbine Heights to Old Lockford, where they are sold by merchants and guild artisans.) The Slagline alternates between running for 1 minute and then pausing for 1 minute to allow time to load and unload its buckets. Whenever the Slagline stops, the buckets suspended above the magma bob and sway slightly—not so much that they spill their contents, however.
zh_tw: 渣線是自動化的，因此吊桶會逆時針方向在小鎮周圍移動。（通常，來自洞穴口區的礦石和寶石會在煙霧鎮區的鑄造廠進行冶煉和精煉。然後，加工過的材料被運送到渦輪高地，再到舊洛克福德，那裡的商人和行會工匠會進行銷售。）渣線交替執行1分鐘，然後暫停1分鐘，以便有時間裝載和解除安裝其吊桶。每當渣線停止時，懸掛在巖漿上方的吊桶會輕微地上下晃動——但不會晃動到足以溢位其內容物。

english: Creatures can safely climb into buckets at one of four loading stations (two in Cavemouth, one in Smoldertown, and one in Old Lockford) and ride the Slagline from one district to another.
zh_tw: 生物們可以安全地爬進四個裝載站（洞口區兩個，煙燻鎮一個，老鎖堡一個）的桶裡，然後乘坐渣線從一個區域移動到另一個區域。

english: Security Forces
zh_tw: 安全力量

english: Tockworth created two primary types of automatons to protect Little Lockford:
zh_tw: 托克沃斯創造了兩種主要型別的自動機來保護小鎖堡：

english: Clockwork Defenders
zh_tw: 發條守衛者

english: Little Lockford has twenty {@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV|clockwork defenders} (see their description and stat block at the end of the adventure), not including ones that were destroyed during the town's evacuation or the damaged one in {@area area L6|1bb|x}.
zh_tw: 利特爾洛克福德有二十個{@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV|發條防禦者}（見冒險末尾的描述和統計塊），不包括在小鎮疏散期間被摧毀的或在{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}中受損的那一個。

english: Clockwork Observers
zh_tw: 發條觀察者

english: Little Lockford has eight {@creature Clockwork Observer|KftGV|clockwork observers} (see their description and stat block at the end of the adventure). The observers are tasked with monitoring the streets to ensure nothing has penetrated the city's defenses. If an observer detects intruders, it contacts Tockworth telepathically, letting her know where the intruders are. Tockworth then orders the observer to use its next action to emit a piercing shriek, which is loud enough to summon {@dice 1d4} {@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV|clockwork defenders} (see their description and stat block at the end of the adventure). These reinforcements arrive 2 rounds later. If the number of clockwork defenders summoned is greater than the number left in Little Lockford, adjust the number of reinforcements accordingly.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡有八個{@creature Clockwork Observer|KftGV|發條觀察者}（請參閱冒險的最後部分中它們的描述和統計塊）。觀察者的任務是監視街道，確保沒有東西滲透城市的防禦。如果觀察者檢測到入侵者，它會透過心靈感應與托克沃斯聯絡，讓她知道入侵者的位置。然後托克沃斯命令觀察者使用其下一個動作發出尖銳的尖叫，聲音足夠大，可以召喚{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV|發條防禦者}（請參閱冒險的最後部分中它們的描述和統計塊）。這些增援在2輪後到達。如果召喚的發條防禦者的數量大於小鎖堡中剩餘的數量，請相應調整增援的數量。

english: Other Constructs under Tockworth's control include two suits of {@creature animated armor} (see {@area area L9a|1cf|x}) and a {@creature shield guardian} that lost its master and its control amulet. The shield guardian stands guard outside Tockworth's workshop ({@area area L9|1cb|x}).
zh_tw: 托克沃斯控制下的其他構造物包括兩套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}（詳見{@area 區域L9a|1cf|x}）和一個失去了主人及其控制護身符的{@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}。盾衛守護者守衛在托克沃斯的工作坊外（{@area 區域L9|1cb|x}）。

english: Wandering Monsters
zh_tw: 遊蕩怪物

english: Each time one or more visible characters exit a building or enter a new district, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1 or 2 (or just 1 if the characters are trying to be stealthy), they attract the attention of one or more wandering monsters determined by rolling another {@dice d6} and consulting the Wandering Monsters table. See "{@area Security Forces|1a4|x}" above for more information about how many clockwork defenders and clockwork observers are present in Little Lockford.
zh_tw: 每當一個或多個可見的角色離開一棟建築或進入一個新的區域時，擲一個{@dice d6}。如果是1或2（或者如果角色們試圖保持隱蔽，就只有1），他們會吸引一個或多個遊蕩怪物的注意，透過擲另一個{@dice d6}並查詢遊蕩怪物表來確定。有關利特爾洛克福德中發條守衛者和發條觀察者數量的更多資訊，請參見上面的"{@area 安全力量|1a4|x}"。

english: In the Cavemouth district, the monsters encountered have all crawled from the mines. The characters encounter Tockworth's automatons elsewhere.
zh_tw: 在洞口區，遇到的怪物都是從礦井裡爬出來的。角色們在其他地方遇到了托克沃斯的自動機。

english: Old Lockford (Areas L1–L2)
zh_tw: 舊洛克福德（區域L1-L2）

english: Old Lockford is the oldest part of the town. The cobblestones here have been worn smooth over the centuries, and the streetlamps are wrought in a more ornate style than those in the rest of Little Lockford. A few dead deep gnomes lie in the streets; most wear the weapons and armor of the militia.
zh_tw: 老鎖堡是小鎮最古老的部分。這裡的鵝卵石經過幾個世紀的磨損已經變得光滑，街燈的製作風格比小鎖堡其他地區的更為華麗。一些死去的地底侏儒躺在街上；大多數佩戴著民兵的武器和盔甲。

english: L1: Entrance and Gatehouse
zh_tw: L1. 入口與門衛室

english: When the characters are ready to enter the town, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好進入小鎮時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Sergeant Cragknuckle leads you to a bulwark hastily erected outside Little Lockford's impressive gates. The bulwark is defended by weary-looking members of the town militia, who salute the sergeant as he limps past them.
zh_tw: 克雷格克納克軍士長帶領你們來到小鎖堡宏偉大門外匆忙搭建的防禦工事。防禦工事由看起來疲憊的城鎮民兵成員守衛，當軍士長跛行經過時，他們向他敬禮。

english: Standing watch by the gates are two dour gnomes in black robes. On Cragknuckle's signal, each of these gnomes casts a spell that causes the gates to swing open before you. A wave of heat washes through the bulwark as the gates part, revealing a grim town bathed in hellish light and periodically brightened by flashes of lightning.
zh_tw: 站在大門外守衛的是兩個穿著黑色長袍的嚴肅侏儒。在岩拳的訊號下，這兩個侏儒各自施放了一個法術，使得大門在你們面前敞開。當大門開啟時，一股熱浪穿過堡壘，露出一個在地獄般光線中沐浴的陰鬱小鎮，偶爾被閃電的閃光照亮。

english: The outer gates lock automatically when they close. The two gnome mages on duty have prepared {@spell knock} spells, which they use to circumvent the gates' complex locking mechanisms. It takes two {@spell knock} spells to open the gates.
zh_tw: 外門在關閉時會自動上鎖。值班的兩位侏儒法師準備了{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術，他們使用這些法術來繞過大門複雜的鎖定機制。開啟大門需要兩個{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術。

english: Sergeant Cragknuckle goes no farther. In Gnomish, he wishes the characters good luck, instructs them to knock on the gates seven times to signal that they're ready to exit, and assures them he will be here waiting for them. (If the characters don't speak his language, the sergeant raps his knuckles on the outer gates seven times to explain what they must do to signal for the gates to be opened.)
zh_tw: 岩拳軍士不再前進。他用侏儒語祝願角色們好運，指示他們敲門七次以表示他們準備好離開，並保證他會在這裡等待他們。（如果角色們不會說他的語言，軍士會用指關節敲擊外門七次來解釋他們必須如何做才能發出訊號讓門開啟。）

english: As soon as the characters enter the town, the gates lock behind them. True to his word, Sergeant Cragknuckle instructs the mages to open the gates if he hears someone on the other side knock on the gates seven times.
zh_tw: 角色們一進入小鎮，大門就在他們身後鎖上了。克雷格克納克軍士長信守諾言，如果聽到有人在大門另一側敲擊大門七次，他會指示法師們開啟大門。

english: Gatehouse
zh_tw: 門樓

english: A modest gatehouse stands inside the gates. {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes an inset map that shows the interior of the gatehouse, which the characters can use as a place to rest or regroup. The gatehouse contains sleeping quarters and an armory that was cleaned out during the evacuation.
zh_tw: 大門內有一個樸素的門房。{@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} 包括一個內嵌地圖，顯示了門房內部，角色們可以用作休息或重新集結的地方。門房包含臥室和武器庫，在疏散期間被清空了。

english: L2: Town Hall
zh_tw: L2. 市政廳

english: The bodies of three dead gnomes clad in the armor of the town militia splay on the front steps of the town hall, the doors to which are wide open.
zh_tw: 三具穿著城鎮民兵盔甲的死去侏儒的屍體橫七豎八地躺在市政廳的前臺階上，市政廳的大門敞開著。

english: The town hall features a spacious chamber for large gatherings and has three small offices at the back.
zh_tw: 市政廳設有一個寬敞的大廳，適合舉行大型集會，並在後面設有三個小辦公室。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: From Mayor Broadfoot's office, characters can retrieve four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, two {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|flasks of alchemist's fire}, and one use of {@item dust of disappearance} in a small packet. These items are kept in an unlocked footlocker under the mayor's desk. On the desk is a {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|PHB|calligraphy set}.
zh_tw: 從布羅德福特市長的辦公室，角色們可以取回四瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}，兩個{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|熾火膠}，以及一個小包中的一次{@item dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}的使用。這些物品存放在市長辦公桌下未上鎖的儲物箱裡。辦公桌上有一套{@item Calligrapher's Supplies|PHB|書法工具套裝}。

english: Halfway Isle (Area L3)
zh_tw: 半途島（區域L3）

english: Halfway Isle used to be a giant stalagmite until the gnomes sheared off the top of it to create a plateau, atop which they built the Abbey of the Deep Brother (area L3). Bridges connect Halfway Isle to the neighboring districts of Old Lockford and Turbine Heights.
zh_tw: 半途島曾經是一個巨大的石筍，直到侏儒們將其頂部削去，創造了一個高原，在其上建造了深兄弟修道院（區域L3）。橋樑將半途島連線到鄰近的舊洛克福德和渦輪高地區域。

english: L3. Abbey of the Deep Brother
zh_tw: L3. 深兄弟修道院

english: Next to the road stands a squat stone building capped with a stone dome. The building's entrance is a double door carved to resemble interlocking hands, and centered above the doorway is a golden pick with a short handle.
zh_tw: 在道路旁邊矗立著一座低矮的石制建築，頂部是石質圓頂。建築的入口是一對雕刻成相互交織的手的雙門，門楣上方中央位置是一把金色的短柄鎬。

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes an inset map that shows the interior of this building.
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} 包括一個內嵌地圖，顯示了這座建築的內部。

english: A character who examines the golden pick and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check recognizes it as the symbol of the Deep Brother, Callarduran Smoothhands, a god worshiped by svirfneblin (particularly miners and stone carvers).
zh_tw: 一個角色如果檢查這把金色鎬並在 {@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定中成功，就能認出它是深層兄弟卡拉丁·滑手（卡勒杜蘭·滑手）的象徵，這是一位被斯里弗涅布林（特別是礦工和石雕師）崇拜的神祇。

english: Abbey Interior
zh_tw: 修道院內部

english: A 4-foot-tall statue of Callarduran, his face and figure hidden under a cowled robe, stands in an alcove just inside the entrance. The statue's right hand is held out, displaying stone-carved rings on every stubby finger.
zh_tw: 一尊4尺高的卡勒杜蘭雕像，他的臉和身形被藏在兜帽長袍下，站在入口內側的一個壁龕中。雕像的右手伸出，每個粗短的手指上都展示著石刻的戒指。

english: The largest room in the abbey, directly across from the entrance, serves as a place of worship. Low benches face the middle of the domed chamber, where every word spoken—even a whisper—can be heard throughout the space. Skulking in the dark corners of this room are two prisoners who escaped the custody of their guards as they were being led from the jail ({@area area L5|1b8|x}) during the evacuation of Little Lockford. The two prisoners—a {@creature goblin boss} named Slonk and a {@creature bugbear} named Yuzzik—have manacles on their wrists and carry no weapons. Slonk was the leader of a gang of goblin brigands that preyed on travelers in the tunnels near Little Lockford. Yuzzik is Slonk's sole surviving bodyguard. Both are unscrupulous and will do almost anything to survive, short of betraying each other.
zh_tw: 修道院裡最大的房間，正對著入口，用作禮拜場所。低矮的長凳面向圓頂房間的中央，在那裡說的每一個字——即使是耳語——都能在整個空間中聽到。在這個房間的陰暗角落裡躲藏著兩個逃犯，他們在小鎖堡疏散期間從監獄（{@area 區域L5|1b8|x}）被帶出來時逃脫了警衛的看管。這兩個逃犯——一個名叫斯隆克的{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}和一個名叫尤茲克的{@creature bugbear||熊地精}——手腕上戴著鐐銬，沒有攜帶武器。斯隆克是一群在小鎖堡附近隧道中襲擊旅行者的地精強盜的頭目。尤茲克是斯隆克唯一倖存的保鏢。兩人都不擇手段，為了生存幾乎會做任何事情，但不會背叛彼此。

english: Other rooms in the abbey include sleeping quarters for svirfneblin monks, a private chamber for the abbot, and a privy. A search of these areas yields nothing of value.
zh_tw: 修道院的其他房間包括斯涅布力僧侶的臥室、院長的私人房間和一個廁所。對這些區域的搜尋沒有發現任何有價值的東西。

english: Abbot Kavoda
zh_tw: 院長卡沃達

english: The abbot {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} tried to flee Little Lockford with his fellow monks, but he didn't get far before one of Tockworth's automatons chased him back to the abbey. Minutes after {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} returned to the abbey, Slonk and Yuzzik showed up. {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} avoided them by casting {@spell meld into stone}. He has been using {@spell meld into stone} spells to hide ever since. As the characters explore the abbey, {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} hears one of them and emerges from a nearby wall when he thinks it's safe to do so.
zh_tw: 修道院長{@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}試圖和他的僧侶們一起逃離小鎖堡，但在托克沃斯的一個自動機追捕下，他沒有逃遠就被迫返回修道院。在{@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}回到修道院幾分鐘後，斯隆克和尤茲克出現了。{@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}透過施放{@spell meld into stone||融身入石}來避開他們。從那以後，他一直在使用{@spell meld into stone||融身入石}法術來隱藏自己。當角色們探索修道院時，{@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}聽到了其中一人的聲音，在他認為安全的情況下從附近的牆壁中出現。

english: {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} is a chaotic good {@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||deep gnome} who speaks Common, Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon. His Innate Spellcasting trait includes the ability to cast {@spell meld into stone} three times per day. He wears a gray robe instead of armor (AC 12) and carries a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell magic weapon} and a {@item Potion of Hill Giant Strength||potion of giant strength (hill)}.
zh_tw: {@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達} 是一個混亂善良的{@creature Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，會說通用語、侏儒語、地語和下界語。他的天生施法能力包括每天三次施放{@spell meld into stone||融身入石}的能力。他穿著灰色長袍而不是盔甲（AC 12），攜帶著一個{@spell magic weapon||魔化武器}的{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}和一瓶{@item Potion of Hill Giant Strength||巨人之力藥水（丘陵）}。

english: {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} doesn't want to stay in Little Lockford any longer. Desperate and hungry, he begs the characters to escort him safely to Little Lockford's outer gates ({@area area L1|1a8|x}), offering his magic items if they accept the quest. He insists they deliver him to the gates by the most direct route without delay, and he protests loudly if they dawdle or deviate from this course of action. If he is separated from the characters or wounded, {@creature Kavoda|KftGV} runs back to the abbey, crying "Callarduran, protect me!" all the way.
zh_tw: {@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}不再想留在小洛克福德了。他絕望又飢餓，懇求角色們安全護送他到小洛克福德的外門（{@area 區域L1|1a8|x}），如果他們接受這個任務，他願意提供他的魔法物品作為報酬。他堅持要求他們以最直接的路線無延遲地將他送到大門口，如果他們拖延或偏離這個行動路線，他會大聲抗議。如果他與角色們分開或受傷，{@creature Kavoda|KftGV|卡沃達}會跑回修道院，一路喊著"卡勒杜蘭，保護我！"

english: Turbine Heights (Areas L4–L6)
zh_tw: 渦輪高地（區域 L4-L6）

english: Turbine Heights is where members of the militia and their families lived. This district also contains a power station and an infirmary.
zh_tw: 渦輪高地是民兵成員及其家人居住的地方。這個區域還包含一個發電站和一個醫務室。

english: When the characters first arrive at Turbine Heights, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次到達渦輪高地時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: The streets of this district are filled with steam. Through the haze, you can see bright streetlamps and abandoned buildings. Every fifteen seconds, a bolt of electricity arcs from a metal tower in the middle of the district to similar towers in other districts.
zh_tw: 這個區域的街道充滿了蒸汽。透過霧氣，你可以看到明亮的街燈和被遺棄的建築。每十五秒，一道電弧從一個位於區域中心的金屬塔連線到其他區域的類似塔。

english: The electrically charged metal tower is attached to the roof of the power station ({@area area L6|1bb|x}). Due to a backup at the station, steam has overflowed into the streets of Turbine Heights. Consequently, the district is {@book lightly obscured|PHB|8|Vision and Light}, as if by fog. A {@spell gust of wind} spell rids a street of steam for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 這座帶電的金屬塔附在發電站的屋頂上（{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}）。由於電站的故障，蒸汽已經溢位到了渦輪高地的街道上。因此，該區域{@book 輕度遮蔽|PHB|8|Vision and Light}，如同被霧氣籠罩。一道{@spell gust of wind||造風術}法術可以在1分鐘內清除一條街道上的蒸汽。

english: L4. Infirmary
zh_tw: L4. 醫務室

english: A stone sign depicting a crutch hangs above the entrance to this one-story building. The double door below the sign is ajar, revealing a hallway beyond.
zh_tw: 一塊刻有手杖圖案的石制標誌懸掛在這個單層建築的入口上方。標誌下方的雙門微微敞開，露出了後面的走廊。

english: Beyond the double door is a long, dark hallway with three small examination rooms on one side of it and three small storage rooms on the opposite side (see "Treasure" below). At the far end of the hall, behind another double door, is an operating room. Characters who search the infirmary thoroughly can find crutches and wheelchairs sized for gnomes, as well as bandages and other mundane medical supplies.
zh_tw: 在雙扇門的另一邊是一條長長的、黑暗的走廊，走廊一側有三個小檢查室，對面有三間小儲藏室（見下面的"寶藏"）。在走廊的盡頭，另一扇雙扇門後面，是一間手術室。徹底搜尋醫院的角色可以找到適合侏儒的柺杖和輪椅，以及繃帶和其他普通的醫療用品。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who loot the storage rooms find six {@item Healer's Kit|PHB|healer's kits} and six {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}.
zh_tw: 搜查儲藏室的角色們發現了六個{@item Healer's Kit|PHB|醫療包}和六瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

english: L5: Jail
zh_tw: L5. 監獄

english: This fortified, two-story stone edifice has a heavy iron door that hangs open. In front of the building, four dead gnomes in armor lie amid the fragments of a doglike automaton.
zh_tw: 這座加固的兩層石制建築有一扇沉重的鐵門敞開著。在建築前，四個穿著盔甲的死去的侏儒躺在一隻類似狗的自動機殘骸之中。

english: The dead gnomes lying in the street are prison guards who were killed by Tockworth's automatons. The guards managed to destroy one of the clockwork defenders that attacked them, but the prisoners they were escorting slipped away (and ended up in {@area area L3|1af|x}). Characters who search the corpses find a small ring of keys. These keys unlock all the cells in the jail.
zh_tw: 躺在街上的死去侏儒是被托克沃斯的自動機械殺死的獄警。這些警衛設法摧毀了攻擊他們的一個發條守衛者，但他們護送的囚犯逃跑了（最終出現在{@area 區域L3|1af|x}）。搜查屍體的角色們找到一個小鑰匙圈。這些鑰匙可以開啟監獄裡的所有牢房。

english: Building Interior
zh_tw: 建築內部

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes inset maps that show both floors of this two-story building. The lower floor contains a kitchen and mess hall for the jailers and an office reserved for the head jailer. A spiral staircase connects to the upper level, which contains prison cells.
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}包括了展示這座兩層建築的兩個樓層的插圖地圖。較低的樓層設有廚房和供獄卒使用的餐廳，以及為獄長保留的辦公室。一個螺旋樓梯連線到上層，上層設有監獄牢房。

english: L6: Power Station
zh_tw: L6. 發電站

english: A thirty-foot-tall metal tower extends from the rooftop of this blocky, one-story stone building. The tower crackles with electricity and spews clouds of steam. Every fifteen seconds, it discharges an arc of lightning that leaps to a tower in another district.
zh_tw: 這座方正的單層石制建築屋頂上伸出一座高達三十尺的金屬塔。塔上電光閃爍，噴出蒸汽雲團。每十五秒，它會釋放一道電弧，跳躍至另一個區域的塔上。

english: The power station generates electricity that powers the bridges, the Slagline (see "{@area General Features|19d|x}" earlier in the adventure), and various workshops scattered throughout the town. The electricity is transmitted through arc towers like the one rising from the power station's roof.
zh_tw: 發電站產生電力，為橋樑、礦渣線（見冒險早期的"{@area 通用特徵|19d|x}"）以及散佈在城鎮各處的各個車間提供動力。電力透過像從發電站屋頂升起的電弧塔這樣的設施傳輸。

english: Building Interior
zh_tw: 建築內部

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes an inset map that shows the power station's interior, which you can describe as follows:
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}包括了一個插圖地圖，展示了發電站的內部，你可以如下描述：

english: The interior of the power station is one big room filled with billowing clouds of steam. Four howling turbines take up most of the floorspace. Iron steps lead to a six-foot-high iron balcony on the west side of the room. At the north end of the balcony is an iron ladder that climbs to a trapdoor in the roof. The balcony also supports a metal console.
zh_tw: 發電站的內部是一個大房間，裡面充滿了翻滾的蒸汽雲。四個咆哮的渦輪機佔據了大部分地面空間。鐵製臺階通向房間西側的六尺高鐵陽臺。在陽臺的北端是一個鐵製梯子，通往屋頂的一個活板門。陽臺上還支撐著一個金屬控制檯。

english: Damaged Turbine
zh_tw: 損壞的渦輪機

english: A power station worker was cornered by a clockwork defender at the north end of the balcony and shoved the automaton off the balcony into the northwest turbine. One of the clockwork defender's hind legs became stuck in the turbine, causing the turbine to malfunction. Characters within 10 feet of the northwest turbine can see the damaged {@creature clockwork defender|KftGV}, which has 24 hit points remaining. This defender is {@condition restrained} and unable to free itself, but it can attack creatures that come within reach of it.
zh_tw: 發電站的一名工人在陽臺的北端被一個發條防禦者逼到角落，並將自動機推下陽臺，掉進了西北方向的渦輪機中。發條防禦者的一條後腿卡在了渦輪機裡，導致渦輪機發生故障。在渦輪機西北方向10尺範圍內的角色可以看到損壞的{@creature clockwork defender|KftGV|發條防禦者}，它還剩下24點生命值。這個防禦者處於{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，無法自行脫困，但可以攻擊進入其攻擊範圍的生物。

english: Once the clockwork defender is defeated, a character can use an action to try to dislodge it from the turbine, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. Removing the clockwork defender's mangled leg from the turbine's machinery causes the power station to stop spewing steam, with the steam throughout Turbine Heights dissipating {@dice 1d10} minutes later.
zh_tw: 一旦機械防禦者被擊敗，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試將其從渦輪中移除，透過成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）或敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來完成。將機械防禦者扭曲的腿從渦輪機械中移除會導致發電站停止噴出蒸汽，整個渦輪高地的蒸汽將在 {@dice 1d10} 分鐘後消散。

english: Control Console
zh_tw: 控制檯

english: The metal console overlooking the turbines is inscribed with a map of the town. Next to this map are several switches: one for every bridge and district, one for the Slagline (see "{@area General Features|19d|x}"), and one for the power station. All are described below:
zh_tw: 俯瞰渦輪機的金屬控制檯刻有小鎮的地圖。在這張地圖旁邊有幾個開關：每個橋樑和區域各有一個，一個用於渣線（見"{@area 通用特徵|19d|x}"），還有一個用於發電站。所有這些都在下面進行了描述：

english: Bridge Switches
zh_tw: 橋樑開關

english: There's one switch for each of Little Lockford's nine bridges. A bridge can be raised by turning its switch to the left or lowered by turning its switch to the right.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡的九座橋各有對應的一個開關。將開關向左轉可以升起橋樑，向右轉則可以降下橋樑。

english: District Switches
zh_tw: 區域開關

english: There's one switch for each of Little Lockford's six districts (Cavemouth, Halfway Isle, Old Lockford, the Overlook, Smoldertown, and Turbine Heights). The streetlamps in a district can be shut off by turning that district's switch to the left or switched on by turning its switch to the right.
zh_tw: 小鎖堡的六個區域（洞口區、半途島、老鎖堡、俯瞰區、煙燻鎮和渦輪高地）各有對應的一個開關。將某個區域的開關向左轉可以關閉該區域的街燈，向右轉則可以開啟街燈。

english: Slagline Switch
zh_tw: 渣線開關

english: There's one switch for the Slagline. Turning it to the left shuts off the bucket chain. Turning it to the right switches the bucket chain on.
zh_tw: 渣線有一個對應的開關。將其向左轉會關閉桶鏈。將其向右轉則會啟動桶鏈。

english: Station Shutdown Switch
zh_tw: 電站關閉開關

english: Turning this switch to the left shuts down the turbines in the power station, causing the streetlamps to turn off throughout town, shutting down the Slagline, and preventing the town's bridges from being raised or lowered. Turning it to the right switches the power back on.
zh_tw: 將此開關向左轉會關閉發電站中的渦輪機，導致全鎮的街燈熄滅，關閉渣線，並阻止小鎮的橋樑升起或降下。將其向右轉則會重新啟動電源。

english: Smoldertown (Areas L7–L9)
zh_tw: 煙燻鎮（區域 L7-L9）

english: When the characters first enter this district, describe it as follows:
zh_tw: 當角色首次進入這個區域時，可以按以下方式描述：

english: The acrid stench of hot metal hangs over this district. Buildings here have no decoration, and nearly every surface is caked in decades of grime and soot. A few more gnome bodies lie face-down in the grit.
zh_tw: 這個區域上空瀰漫著刺鼻的熱金屬氣味。這裡的建築物沒有任何裝飾，幾乎所有的表面都覆蓋著幾十年的汙垢和煤煙。一些侏儒的屍體面朝下躺在沙礫中。

english: Smoldertown, with its many workshops and smithies, is the industrial heart of Little Lockford. Tockworth's workshop ({@area area L9|1cb|x}) is located here, but Tockworth herself is taking a break at the Motherlode Tavern (area L8).
zh_tw: 煙燻鎮，擁有眾多的作坊和鐵匠鋪，是小鎖堡的工業中心。托克沃斯的工作室（{@area 區域L9|1cb|x}）就位於這裡，但托克沃斯本人正在母礦酒館（區域 L8）休息。

english: L7: Foundry
zh_tw: L7. 鑄造廠

english: The soot-stained foundry stands at the edge of this district, overlooking the magma lake far below. Its huge sliding doors stand open, revealing dark furnaces and silent machinery. A raised loading dock allows access to the dangling buckets of the Slagline, which deliver unrefined ore to the foundry.
zh_tw: 這座被煤煙燻黑的鑄造廠位於這個區域的邊緣，俯瞰著下方遠處的巖漿湖。它巨大的滑動門敞開著，露出了黑暗的熔爐和靜默的機械。一個升高的裝卸臺允許進入懸掛的渣線桶，這些桶將未精煉的礦石運送到鑄造廠。

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes an inset map that shows the foundry's interior, which is one large, open space. The building has no ceiling, allowing heat and smoke to escape. Ore from the Slagline's buckets can be dumped via chute into any of the foundry's five large furnaces.
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}包括了一個插圖地圖，展示了鑄造廠的內部，這是一個大型的開放空間。這座建築沒有天花板，允許熱量和煙霧逸出。來自渣線桶的礦石可以透過滑槽倒入鑄造廠的五個大型熔爐中的任何一個。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who loot the foundry find three sets of {@item smith's tools|PHB} and two sets of {@item tinker's tools|PHB}.
zh_tw: 搜刮鑄造廠的角色發現了三套{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}和兩套{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}。

english: L8: Motherlode Tavern
zh_tw: L8. 富礦酒館

english: Hanging above the entrance of this grimy stone building is a painted wooden sign that depicts gemstones pouring from a flagon. A minor magical effect causes the gemstones to glitter invitingly.
zh_tw: 掛在這座骯髒石制建築入口上方的是一個繪有寶石從酒壺中傾瀉而出的木製招牌。一個小小的魔法效果使寶石閃爍著誘人的光芒。

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes an inset map that shows the tavern's interior, which consists of a cellar and a taproom.
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}包括了一個插圖地圖，展示了酒館的內部，包括一個地下室和一個酒吧間。

english: Cellar
zh_tw: 地窖

english: The cellar contains crates of worthless supplies, several kegs of a locally brewed mushroom beer called Rubbleclub Classic (named for its brewer, the svirfneblin Glyphy Rubbleclub), and several more kegs of an oaky whiskey called Oofenklanger's Finest (named after the family that originally distilled it).
zh_tw: 地下室存放著裝滿無價值物資的板條箱，還有幾桶當地釀造的名為碎石棒經典款的蘑菇啤酒（以它的釀造者，斯涅布力格里菲·碎石棒的名字命名），以及幾桶名為烏芬克蘭格極品的橡木味威士忌（以最初蒸餾它的家族命名）。

english: Taproom
zh_tw: 酒吧間

english: The taproom contains seating areas, including a row of stools next to a low bar made of carved basalt. Hanging above the bar are two soot-stained lanterns with {@spell continual flame} spells cast inside them. Half-drunk flagons of flat mushroom beer rest on the bar and on the tables, abandoned by patrons in their haste to evacuate Little Lockford.
zh_tw: 酒吧間內設有座位區，包括一排靠在由雕刻玄武岩製成的低矮酒吧旁的凳子。酒吧上方掛著兩個被煙燻黑的燈籠，裡面施有{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術。半空的平菇啤酒壺放在酒吧和桌子上，是客人們匆忙撤離小洛克福德時留下的。

english: Tixie Tockworth
zh_tw: 蒂克西·托克沃斯

english: Unless she was defeated elsewhere, {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV} (see her description and stat block at the end of the adventure) sits on the barstool farthest from the entrance, cradling an empty flagon while mumbling to herself.
zh_tw: 除非她在別處被擊敗，{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}（見冒險末尾對她的描述和屬性塊）坐在離入口最遠的酒吧凳上，抱著一個空酒壺，同時自言自語。

english: The presence of intruders confuses, disturbs, and annoys Tockworth. If she is confronted by the characters here or if the {@spell alarm} spell triggers on the safe in {@area area L9b|1d3|x}, she casts {@spell dimension door} and steps through the spell's magical doorway into area L9b. As she leaves, she says, "Break time's over, Poots!" (The characters have no way to know this, but Poots is the name of an imaginary friend Tockworth invented in her childhood. This long-lost imaginary friend has resurfaced recently in response to Tockworth's mounting loneliness.)
zh_tw: 入侵者的出現讓托克沃斯感到困惑、不安和惱怒。如果她在這裡被角色們對峙，或者在{@area 區域L9b|1d3|x}區域的保險箱上的{@spell alarm||警報術}法術被觸發，她會施放{@spell dimension door||任意門}並穿過法術的魔法門進入L9b區域。當她離開時，她說：'休息時間結束，普茨！'（角色們無法知道這一點，但普茨是托克沃斯童年時發明的想象中的朋友的名字。這個長久失蹤的想象中的朋友最近因托克沃斯日益增長的孤獨感而重新出現。）

english: L9: Tockworth's Workshop
zh_tw: L9. 托克沃斯的工作室

english: This windowless, two-story structure has a single door tucked near a corner on the ground floor. Standing in front of the door is an eight-foot-tall, bipedal construct made of chipped stone, rusty metal, and green copper. Its heavy iron gauntlets are clenched into fists, and the ominous helm that forms its head turns slowly from side to side.
zh_tw: 這座沒有窗戶的兩層建築在一樓的角落裡有一個隱蔽的單門。站在門前的是一個八尺高的雙足構裝生物，由磨損的石頭、生鏽的金屬和綠色銅製成。它沉重的鐵手套緊握成拳，構成其頭部的不祥頭盔慢慢地左右轉動。

english: Shield Guardian
zh_tw: 構裝盾衛

english: The construct blocking passage into Tockworth's workshop is a {@creature shield guardian} that lacks the Spell Storing trait. Its creator and control amulet were destroyed long ago. Tockworth found a way to reanimate the shield guardian without having to create a new amulet, rendering the shield guardian autonomous. The shield guardian has been loyal to Tockworth ever since. It defends itself if attacked and attacks anyone who tries to slip past it. It is too big to fit through the workshop's front door.
zh_tw: 阻擋進入托克沃斯工作室的構裝生物是一個沒有法術儲存特性的{@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}。它的創造者和控制護身符很久以前就被摧毀了。托克沃斯找到了一種重新啟用盾衛者的方法，而無需製作新的護身符，使盾衛者變得自主。從那時起，盾衛者一直忠於托克沃斯。如果受到攻擊，它會自我防禦，並且會攻擊任何試圖悄悄溜過它的人。它太大了，無法透過工作室的前門。

english: Workshop Interior
zh_tw: 工作室內部

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} includes inset maps that show both floors of Tockworth's workshop, which are described in areas {@area L9a|1cf|x} and {@area L9b|1d3|x}.
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} 包含了內嵌地圖，展示了托克沃斯工作室的兩個樓層，這些樓層在區域 {@area L9a|1cf|x} 和 {@area L9b|1d3|x} 中有描述。

english: Animated suits of armor do much of the assembly work in Tockworth's workshop
zh_tw: 在托克沃斯的工作室裡，許多組裝工作是由活動盔甲完成的。

english: L9a: Workshop, Lower Floor
zh_tw: L9a. 工作室，下層

english: The ground floor is one big work area containing a smelter, drums filled with clockwork parts, and a dizzying array of tools. Mounted on one wall is an iron ladder that ends before a trapdoor in the ceiling.
zh_tw: 一樓是一個大型工作區，包括一個冶煉爐、裝滿發條部件的桶，以及令人眼花繚亂的工具陣列。一面牆上裝有一架鐵梯，鐵梯頂端是天花板上的一個活板門。

english: Inscribed on the floor is a complex geometric design that pulsates with light. In the middle of this design, embedded in the floor, is a one-foot-square metal box with a keyhole in the top of it.
zh_tw: 地面上刻有一個複雜的幾何圖案，它隨著光線的跳動而脈動。在這一設計的中心，嵌入地面的是一個一尺見方的金屬盒子，盒子頂部有一個鑰匙孔。

english: This workshop is where Tockworth creates her clockwork automatons. Two suits of {@creature animated armor} named Rack and Pinion serve as her assistants and perform most of the hands-on work. These Constructs attack intruders on sight.
zh_tw: 這個工作室是托克沃斯創造她的發條自動機械的地方。兩套名為架子和骨翼的{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}作為她的助手，執行大部分實際操作。這些構造物會在看到入侵者時進行攻擊。

english: The workshop contains a smelter used to fabricate parts and tools. There are enough tools here to assemble one set of {@item smith's tools|PHB} and one set of {@item tinker's tools|PHB}.
zh_tw: 這個工作室裡有一個冶煉爐，用來製造零件和工具。這裡有足夠多的工具來組裝一套{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}和一套{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}。

english: The trapdoor in the ceiling opens into area L9b.
zh_tw: 天花板上的活板門通向L9b區域。

english: Geometric Design
zh_tw: 幾何圖案

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of abjuration magic around the complex geometric symbol inscribed on the floor. When a creature other than Tockworth enters the space above the symbol for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature becomes the target of a {@spell crown of madness} spell (save {@dc 15}) that has a duration of 1 minute.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術揭示出在地板上刻畫的複雜幾何符號周圍有一層防護魔法的光環。當一個非托克沃思的生物在一回合內首次進入符號上方的空間或在那裡開始其回合時，該生物將成為 {@spell crown of madness||瘋狂冠冕} 法術的目標（豁免 {@dc 15}），持續時間為1分鐘。

english: Fail-Safe Device
zh_tw: 安全裝置

english: If Tockworth's security key is inserted into the metal box embedded in the floor and turned counterclockwise, Little Lockford's clockwork defenders and clockwork observers are rendered {@condition unconscious} indefinitely. Turning the key clockwise deactivates the magic of the geometric design on the floor and ends any ongoing effects of its magic. The security key is kept in Tockworth's safe (in area L9b).
zh_tw: 如果將托克沃斯的安全鑰匙插入嵌入地面的金屬箱中並逆時針旋轉，小洛克福德的發條守衛和發條觀察者將無限期地處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態。將鑰匙順時針旋轉會解除地面上幾何圖案的魔法，並結束其魔法的任何持續效果。安全鑰匙存放在托克沃斯的保險箱中（在L9b區域）。

english: L9b: Workshop, Upper Floor
zh_tw: L9b. 工作室，上層

english: The workshop's upper floor consists of a sparse room furnished with a simple cot and worktables covered in schematics. An iron safe, five feet on a side, stands against one wall, its thick metal door fitted with a combination lock and a handle.
zh_tw: 工作室的上層是一個陳設簡陋的房間，配有一張簡易的帆布床和覆蓋著圖紙的工作臺。一個邊長五尺的鐵質保險箱靠在一面牆上，它厚重的金屬門上裝有組合鎖和一個把手。

english: Safe
zh_tw: 保險箱

english: The safe can't be moved, and a {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of abjuration magic around it.
zh_tw: 這個保險箱無法移動，並且一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術可以揭示出圍繞它的防護魔法氣息。

english: A character equipped with thieves' tools can spend 1 minute trying to crack open the safe door, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. Alternatively, a character can spend 1 minute pressing their ear to the safe's door while trying to delicately pick its combination lock, opening the door with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The safe door also opens when the proper command word ("Poots") is spoken within 5 feet of it. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the safe.
zh_tw: 一名裝備了盜賊工具的角色可以花費1分鐘嘗試撬開保險箱門，成功透過一個{@dc 20}敏捷檢定即可完成。或者，角色可以花費1分鐘將耳朵貼在保險箱門上，同時嘗試小心翼翼地撥動其密碼鎖，成功透過一個{@dc 16}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）或感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定即可開啟門。當在距離保險箱5尺內說出正確的命令詞（"普茨"）時，保險箱門也會開啟。一個{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟保險箱。

english: Tixie Tockworth
zh_tw: 蒂克西·托克沃斯

english: If the safe door is opened by any means other than speaking the proper command word, a mental {@spell alarm} spell alerts {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV} (see her description and stat block at the end of the adventure). Unless she was defeated in {@area area L8|1c6|x}, Tockworth uses a {@spell dimension door} spell to appear in the middle of the room and attacks any burglars she sees.
zh_tw: 如果保險箱門透過除了說出正確的口令之外的任何方式被開啟，一個心靈{@spell alarm||警報術}法術會提醒{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}（見冒險末尾她的描述和統計塊）。除非她在{@area 區域L8|1c6|x}被擊敗，否則托克沃斯會使用一個{@spell dimension door||任意門}法術出現在房間中央，並攻擊她看到的任何竊賊。

english: If Tockworth is reduced to 40 hit points or fewer, she uses her next action to cast {@spell dimension door} again, then steps through the doorway into {@area area L12|1e7|x}.
zh_tw: 如果托克沃斯的生命值降至40點或更少，她會在下一個行動中再次施放{@spell dimension door||任意門}，然後透過門道進入{@area 區域L12|1e7|x}區域。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The safe contains an onyx-studded jewelry box worth 250 gp. The box is unlocked and holds the following items:
zh_tw: 保險箱內有一個鑲嵌黑玉的珠寶盒，價值250金幣。這個盒子沒有上鎖，裡面裝有以下物品：

english: Zircon ring (60 gp)
zh_tw: 鋯石戒指（60金幣）

english: Three {@item Amethyst||amethysts} (100 gp each)
zh_tw: 三顆{@item Amethyst||紫水晶}（每顆價值100金幣）

english: The security key to the fail-safe device in {@area area L9a|1cf|x} (the key is 8 inches long, made of brass, and decorated with clockwork designs)
zh_tw: 安全鑰匙是用於{@area 區域L9a|1cf|x}中的安全裝置的（鑰匙長8吋，由黃銅製成，並裝飾有發條設計圖案）。

english: Cavemouth (Areas L10–L11)
zh_tw: 洞穴口（區域 L10-L11）

english: When the characters first enter Cavemouth, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當角色首次進入洞口區時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: Mining equipment lies abandoned in the alleys and stalagmite-lined streets of this gloomy district.
zh_tw: 採礦裝置被遺棄在這個陰暗區域的小巷和鐘乳石林立的街道上。

english: The Cavemouth district is where most of Little Lockford's miners live and work. Two roads lead to the mines, which are not shown on {@adventure map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}.
zh_tw: 洞口區區是小洛克福德大多數礦工居住和工作的地方。有兩條道路通向礦井，這些在{@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map}上沒有顯示。

english: The bridges to Cavemouth have been raised, and the streetlamps throughout the district have been shut off. The characters can lower the bridges and turn on the streetlamps using a control console in {@area area L6|1bb|x} or {@area area L12|1e7|x}.
zh_tw: 通往凱夫茅斯的橋樑已經升起，整個區域的路燈都已關閉。角色們可以使用位於{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}或{@area 區域L12|1e7|x}的控制檯來降低橋樑並開啟路燈。

english: Mines
zh_tw: 礦區

english: The mine entrances, once protected by Tockworth's automatons, are now unguarded. The mines are beyond the scope of the adventure. If the characters insist on exploring them, they eventually attract the attention of a wandering {@creature cloaker} that tries to frighten them away with haunting moans.
zh_tw: 礦井入口曾經由托克沃斯的自動機械保護，現在無人守衛。礦井不在這次冒險的範圍之內。如果角色堅持探索它們，他們最終會吸引一隻遊蕩的{@creature cloaker||斗篷怪}的注意，它會試圖用令人毛骨悚然的呻吟聲嚇走他們。

english: L10: Miners' Guildhall
zh_tw: L10. 礦工公會大廳

english: Hanging above the open doorway of this large, gem-studded building is a stone sign depicting a pick and a hammer.
zh_tw: 懸掛在這個裝飾著寶石的大型建築的敞開的門楣上方，是一個刻有鎬和錘子的石制招牌。

english: The miners' guildhall has offices for senior guild members, stout metal lockers where miners can store their gear, and functional showers. Most of the building's former occupants vacated in a hurry, leaving sundry equipment scattered about.
zh_tw: 礦工公會大廳設有高階公會成員的辦公室、結實的金屬儲物櫃供礦工存放裝備，以及實用的淋浴裝置。建築的大多數前居住者匆忙撤離，留下了散落四處的各種裝置。

english: Guildmaster Deepdelve
zh_tw: 公會會長深掘

english: A thorough search of the building reveals the corpse of a robed deep gnome named Schnella Deepdelve, the master of the town's miners' guild. Schnella refused to leave and died fending off Tockworth's clockwork defenders. Her restless soul lurks in this building, manifesting as a troublesome {@creature specter} known as a {@creature poltergeist} (see the "Variant: Poltergeist" sidebar in the "Specter" entry of the {@book Monster Manual|MM}).
zh_tw: 徹底搜查這座建築會發現一具穿著長袍的地底侏儒屍體，名叫施妮拉·深掘，她是鎮上礦工公會的會長。施妮拉拒絕離開，並在抵禦托克沃斯的發條守衛時死去。她不安的靈魂徘徊在這座建築中，表現為一個麻煩的{@creature specter||惡靈}，被稱為{@creature poltergeist||騷靈}（見《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中"幽靈"條目下的"變體：作祟幽靈"側邊欄）。

english: Characters who disturb the body or spend more than 1 minute in the guildhall anger the poltergeist, which hurls picks and iron spikes at them until they leave or until the poltergeist is destroyed. The poltergeist is {@condition invisible} and can't speak.
zh_tw: 打擾屍體或在公會大廳逗留超過1分鐘的角色會激怒作祟幽靈，它會向他們投擲鎬和鐵釘，直到他們離開或作祟幽靈被摧毀。作祟幽靈是{@condition invisible||隱形}的，且不能說話。

english: L11: Warehouse 6
zh_tw: L11. 倉庫6

english: {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Bright light} seeps through cracks around the sliding metal doors of this otherwise nondescript warehouse.
zh_tw: {@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}從這間平淡無奇的貨棧滑動金屬門周圍的縫隙中滲入。

english: If the characters slide open the doors, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們推開門，閱讀以下內容：

english: The interior of the warehouse is an open space roughly twenty feet wide and thirty feet long. Parked in the middle of the warehouse is a strange metal vehicle with treads. Quartz gemstones embedded in the hull shine light in all directions. Mounted to the front of this contraption is a large, cone-shaped drill. At the rear of the contraption is a closed, three-foot-square steel hatch. Two dead gnomes in armor lie on the floor next to the vehicle and a puddle of oil.
zh_tw: 倉庫的內部是一個開闊的空間，大約二十尺寬，三十尺長。倉庫中央停放著一輛帶有履帶的奇怪金屬車輛。嵌入船體的石英寶石向四面八方發出光芒。這個裝置的前部安裝著一個大型的圓錐形鑽頭。裝置的後部是一個封閉的、三尺見方的鋼製艙口。兩個穿著盔甲的死去侏儒躺在車輛旁邊的地板上，旁邊有一灘油。

english: The dead gnomes are two {@creature Mimic||mimics} that attack anyone who touches or otherwise disturbs them. The mimics are working with a {@creature Gray Ooze||psychic gray ooze} (see the "Variant: Psychic Gray Ooze" sidebar in the "Oozes" entry of the {@book Monster Manual|MM})—the "puddle of oil" mentioned above. The gray ooze and the mimics recently crept into the warehouse and are waiting for food to come to them.
zh_tw: 死去的侏儒是兩個{@creature Mimic||擬身怪}，它們會攻擊任何觸碰或以其他方式打擾它們的人。這些擬身怪與一個{@creature Gray Ooze||靈能灰泥怪}（見《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中"軟泥怪"條目下的"變體：心靈灰泥怪"側邊欄）——即上文中提到的"油漬"——合作。心靈灰泥怪和擬身怪最近潛入了倉庫，正在等待食物自動送上門來。

english: Contraption
zh_tw: 裝置

english: The vehicle in the warehouse is a Large, magical drilling machine used by the miners of Little Lockford to burrow new tunnels. The vehicle has the properties of an {@item apparatus of Kwalish}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 倉庫中的車輛是一輛大型魔法鑽探機，由小洛克福德的礦工用來挖掘新隧道。該車輛具有{@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}的屬性，有以下變化：

english: Treads
zh_tw: 履帶

english: Instead of legs and a tail, it has treads that give it a walking speed of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 它沒有腿和尾巴，而是有履帶，這使它的行走速度為30尺。

english: Burrowing Speed
zh_tw: 掘進速度

english: Instead of a swimming speed, it has a burrowing speed of 10 feet. Using its drill, it can burrow through solid rock, leaving a 10-foot-wide, 10-foot-high tunnel behind it.
zh_tw: 它沒有游泳速度，而是有掘進速度10尺。使用它的鑽頭，它可以鑽穿堅硬的岩石，並在其後留下一個10尺寬、10尺高的隧道。

english: Lever 1
zh_tw: 拉桿1

english: Moving lever 1 to the up position starts the drill. Moving the same lever to the down position shuts off the drill.
zh_tw: 將槓桿1移到上方位置啟動鑽頭。將同一槓桿移回下方位置關閉鑽頭。

english: Lever 9
zh_tw: 槓桿9

english: Moving lever 9 to the up position causes the contraption to move backward at its walking speed. Moving the same lever to the down position stops its backward movement.
zh_tw: 將槓桿9移到上方位置會導致裝置以行走速度向後移動。將同一槓桿移回下方位置停止其向後移動。

english: Ignus Flint
zh_tw: 伊格納斯·弗林特

english: An inventor named Ignus Flint (lawful neutral, deep gnome {@creature mage} who speaks Common, Gnomish, Terran, and Undercommon) built the contraption and recently locked himself inside it with enough food and water to keep himself alive for 1 week. A metal hatch at the back of the vehicle is the only entrance, and Ignus used a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell arcane lock} to seal it. A character can use an action to try to pull open the magically sealed hatch, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the characters knock on the contraption, they hear Ignus's muffled voice shout, "Go away!" in Gnomish. Ignus attacks anyone who breaks into his contraption but surrenders if reduced to 10 hit points or fewer.
zh_tw: 一位名叫伊格納斯·弗林特（守序中立，深侏儒 {@creature mage||魔法師}，會說通用語、侏儒語、土族語和地底通用語）的發明家建造了這個裝置，最近他把自己鎖在裡面，並且配備了足夠維持一週的食物和水。車輛後部的一個金屬艙口是唯一的入口，伊格納斯使用了一張 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 的 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 來封住它。角色可以使用一個動作嘗試拉開這個魔法密封的艙口，成功透過 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。如果角色敲擊這個裝置，他們會聽到伊格納斯模糊的聲音用侏儒語大喊："走開！"。伊格納斯會攻擊任何闖入他裝置的人，但如果生命值降至10點或以下，他會投降。

english: Ignus and Tockworth are rivals, and Ignus long suspected Tockworth's experiments would prove troublesome for Little Lockford. His public warnings about Tockworth went ignored, however. A character can use an action to try to convince Ignus to help them, first by impressing on him the importance of freeing Little Lockford from Tockworth's control and then by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. Once coaxed into helping the characters, Ignus pilots his contraption anywhere they need him to go. The vehicle has enough space inside for Ignus plus one other passenger. If a character asks Ignus to allow the party to drive the contraption, he adamantly refuses to part with his prized invention.
zh_tw: 伊格努斯與托克沃斯是競爭對手，伊格努斯長期以來懷疑托克沃斯的實驗會給小洛克福德帶來麻煩。然而，他對托克沃斯的公開警告被忽略了。角色可以使用一個動作嘗試說服伊格努斯幫助他們，首先向他強調將小洛克福德從托克沃斯的控制中解救出來的重要性，然後透過一個 {@dc 14} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。一旦被說服幫助角色們，伊格努斯會駕駛他的裝置前往任何需要他去的地方。該車輛內部有足夠的空間容納伊格努斯和另一名乘客。如果角色要求伊格努斯允許團隊駕駛他的裝置，他會堅決拒絕與他的珍貴發明分離。

english: Questioning Ignus
zh_tw: 審問伊格努斯

english: Ignus knows the following useful information about Tockworth and her workshop, which he shares with characters who befriend him:
zh_tw: 伊格納斯知道以下有關托克沃斯及其工作室的有用資訊，他會與成為朋友的字元分享：

english: Animated Armor
zh_tw: 活化盔甲

english: Two suits of animated armor help Tockworth assemble her other contraptions.
zh_tw: 兩套活化的盔甲幫助托克沃斯組裝她的其他裝置。

english: Safe
zh_tw: 保險箱

english: Tockworth has an iron safe on the upper floor of her workshop.
zh_tw: 托克沃斯的工作室上層有一個鐵製保險箱。

english: Shield Guardian
zh_tw: 構裝盾衛

english: Tockworth found a way to animate a derelict shield guardian and now uses it to guard the front door to her workshop. The guardian is too big to fit through the door. (Ignus covets the shield guardian and wishes he had one of his own.)
zh_tw: 托克沃斯找到了一種方法來活化一個廢棄的盾衛守護者，並現在用它來守衛她工作室的前門。這個守護者太大了，無法透過門進入。（伊格納斯非常渴望得到盾衛守護者，希望自己也能擁有一個。）

english: Who Is Poots?
zh_tw: 誰是普茨？

english: When Tockworth is upset, she speaks to an imaginary friend named Poots—as if Poots were standing right next to her. (Ignus doesn't know that "Poots" is also the command word to bypass the {@spell alarm} spell on Tockworth's safe.)
zh_tw: 當托克沃斯不高興時，她會與一個名叫普茨的想象中的朋友交談——就好像普茨就站在她旁邊一樣。（伊格努斯不知道"普茨"也是繞過托克沃斯保險箱上{@spell alarm||警報術}法術的口令。）

english: The Overlook (Area L12)
zh_tw: 俯瞰點（區域L12）

english: When the characters are close enough to see the Overlook, describe it as follows:
zh_tw: 當角色們足夠接近俯瞰點時，可以按照以下方式描述它：

english: The central feature of Little Lockford is an enormous, hollowed-out stalactite with luminous clock faces built into it.
zh_tw: 小洛克福德的中心特徵是一個巨大的、內部被挖空的鐘乳石，其內部建造有發光的時鐘面。

english: The Overlook's clocks are mechanical wonders illuminated by magic. They keep perfect time.
zh_tw: 俯瞰區的時鐘是被魔法照亮的機械奇蹟。它們保持完美的時間。

english: A hollowed-out central chamber in the Overlook contains Little Lockford's security center (area L12). This facility is surrounded by rough-hewn chambers containing magnificent fungi gardens and open windows overlooking the town. Residents of Little Lockford used to come here to wander the gardens, pick mushrooms, and enjoy the views.
zh_tw: 俯瞰區中的一箇中央空洞室包含了小洛克福德的安全中心（區域 L12）。這個設施周圍是粗糙鑿成的房間，裡麵包含著壯麗的真菌花園，以及可以俯瞰整個城鎮的開放窗戶。小洛克福德的居民過去常常來這裡漫步花園，採摘蘑菇，享受風景。

english: Characters can use the control consoles in areas {@area L6|1bb|x} and {@area L12|1e7|x} to raise and lower the bridges that connect the Overlook to the districts of Old Lockford, Smoldertown, and Turbine Heights.
zh_tw: 角色們可以使用位於{@area L6|1bb|x}和{@area L12|1e7|x}的控制檯來升起和降下連線俯瞰點與老洛克福德區、悶燒鎮和渦輪高地的橋樑。

english: L12: Security Center
zh_tw: L12. 安全中心

english: A large, rough-hewn cavern in the heart of the Overlook has a floor that rises toward the middle. Scores of lizards—a few of them big enough to ride as mounts—sleep and crawl on the slopes of this natural rise. Perched atop the rocky mound is a squat stone building topped with a crystal dome. Multicolored light gleams within the dome.
zh_tw: 在俯瞰區中心的一個大型、粗糙鑿成的洞穴，地面向中間升高。許多蜥蜴——其中一些足夠大，可以騎乘——在這個自然隆起的斜坡上睡覺和爬行。坐落在岩石堆上的是一個矮胖的石制建築，頂部是一個水晶圓頂。圓頂內部閃爍著多彩的光芒。

english: The cavern is home to six {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards} and hundreds of ordinary {@creature Lizard||lizards}, all of which are docile but skittish. The giant ones are trained to serve the svirfneblin as pack animals. A character who approaches a giant lizard can use an action to try to keep it from running away, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check. A giant lizard that doesn't run away can be used by that character as a mount.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴是六隻 {@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥} 和數百隻普通 {@creature Lizard||蜥蜴} 的家園，它們都溫順但易受驚。巨蜥被訓練為服務於斯里弗涅布靈（斯涅布力）作為馱獸。接近巨蜥的角色可以使用一個動作嘗試阻止它逃跑，成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 的感知（{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}）檢定即可。沒有逃跑的巨蜥可以被該角色作為坐騎使用。

english: Domed Building
zh_tw: 圓頂建築

english: {@adventure Map 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} provides an inset map of the security center. Spiral staircases on the north and south sides of the building climb 15 feet to a circular chamber, which you can describe to the players as follows:
zh_tw: {@adventure 地圖 5.2|KftGV|5|Map 5.2: DM's map} 提供了安全中心的插圖地圖。建築物的北側和南側的螺旋樓梯上升15尺到達一個圓形房間，你可以按照以下方式向玩家描述：

english: Beneath a fifteen-foot-high crystal dome is a chamber containing a ten-foot-square, three-dimensional projection of Little Lockford. Rising from the floor near the projection is a metal console with numerous switches on it.
zh_tw: 在一個十五尺高的水晶圓頂下，有一個房間，裡面有一個小洛克福德的三維投影，面積為十尺見方。在投影附近的地板上，有一個帶有眾多開關的金屬控制檯。

english: Control Console
zh_tw: 控制檯

english: The console functions like the one in the power station ({@area area L6|1bb|x}).
zh_tw: 這個控制檯的功能與電站（{@area 區域L6|1bb|x}）中的控制檯相似。

english: Magical Projection
zh_tw: 魔法投影

english: The projection of Little Lockford is a harmless illusion that changes to match the current state of things in town; for example, if a bridge is lowered in Little Lockford, the projection's version of the bridge lowers as well. The projection has no substance, allowing creatures to pass right through it.
zh_tw: 小洛克福德的投影是一個無害的幻象，它會隨著城鎮中事物的當前狀態而變化；例如，如果小洛克福德的一座橋被放下，投影中的橋樑版本也會相應放下。投影沒有實體，允許生物直接穿過它。

english: Tixie Tockworth
zh_tw: 蒂克西·托克沃斯

english: If she fled to this chamber using {@spell dimension door}, {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV} (see her description and stat block at the end of the adventure) is next to the console. She has attached an experimental jet pack to her body, giving her a flying speed of 30 feet and the ability to hover. She accuses the characters of being pawns and mocks their heroics. She occasionally speaks to an imaginary friend named Poots, saying things like, "We'll show them, Poots!" and "No one can stop us!"
zh_tw: 如果她使用{@spell dimension door||任意門}逃到這個房間，{@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}（見冒險末尾對她的描述和屬性塊）就在控制檯旁邊。她將一個實驗性的噴氣揹包附著在身上，使她具有30尺的飛行速度和懸停能力。她指責角色們是棋子，並嘲笑他們的英勇。她偶爾與一個名叫普茨的想象中的朋友說說話，比如說："我們會給他們好看的，普茨！"和"沒有人能阻止我們！"

english: If Tockworth is reduced to 0 hit points, her jet pack explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere, blowing Tockworth to smithereens. Every other creature within that sphere must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@dice 3d10}) piercing damage from flying shrapnel. If the explosion occurs under the crystal dome, the dome shatters, showering creatures in the room with harmless, confetti-sized quartz particles.
zh_tw: 如果托克沃斯的生命值降至0點，她的噴氣揹包會在一個20尺半徑的球體內爆炸，將托克沃斯炸成碎片。在此範圍內的其他生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}敏捷豁免檢定，否則會受到16點（{@dice 3d10}）來自飛散的碎片的穿刺傷害。如果爆炸發生在水晶穹頂下，穹頂會破裂，使房間內的生物被無害的、彩紙大小的石英顆粒覆蓋。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: Once the characters use the security key to activate the fail-safe device and shut down Tockworth's automatons, the major threat to the city is ended.
zh_tw: 一旦角色使用安全鑰匙啟用了故障安全裝置並關閉了托克沃斯的自動機械，對城市的主要威脅就結束了。

english: Little Lockford's residents feel a mixture of grief and relief when they return to the town. They are grateful to the characters for saving the town and raise statues in the characters' honor. Furthermore, Mayor Broadfoot gives the characters their promised rewards (see "{@area Rewards|19a|x}" earlier in the adventure), and invites the characters to stay in Little Lockford as long as they wish and return as often as they can.
zh_tw: 當小洛克福德的居民返回小鎮時，他們感到悲傷和寬慰的混合。他們對角色拯救小鎮表示感激，併為角色樹立了雕像以示榮譽。此外，闊足市長給予了角色們他們承諾的獎勵（見冒險早期的'{@area 獎勵|19a|x}'），並邀請角色們在小洛克福德停留儘可能長的時間，並儘可能頻繁地回來。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization's representative is waiting with Mayor Broadfoot to confirm the automatons were shut down. Once the representative confirms the characters' success, the organization rewards them with a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day. This reward is in addition to the treasures promised by Mayor Broadfoot.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，該組織的代表正在等待與闊足市長確認自動機械已被關閉。一旦代表確認角色們成功了，組織將獎勵他們一個稀有的魔法物品（需經您批准）作為報酬。這個物品將在第二天送達給角色們。這個獎勵是除了闊足市長承諾的財寶之外的。

english: Stat Blocks
zh_tw: 資料卡

english: This section provides stat blocks for new creatures encountered in this adventure.
zh_tw: 這一節為在這次冒險中遇到的新生物提供了統計塊。

english: {@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Clockwork Defender|KftGV|發條防禦者}

english: {@creature Clockwork Observer|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Clockwork Observer|KftGV|發條觀察者}

english: {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Tixie Tockworth|KftGV|蒂克西·托克沃斯}

english: Masterpiece Imbroglio
zh_tw: 傑作糾葛

english: {@i An Adventure for 5th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合5級角色的冒險}

english: A group of scholars and sages known as the Cognoscenti Esoterica recently purchased a painting of Constantori, a famous courtier rumored to once have been the most beautiful man alive. The portrait supposedly has occult properties, but before the sages could study it, the painting was stolen by the Agile Hand, a thieves' guild. In this adventure, the characters must retrieve the portrait of Constantori from the Agile Hand's guildhouse and return it to Adrisa Carimorte, a member of the Cognoscenti Esoterica.
zh_tw: 一群組成「祕學智者會」的學者與賢者，最近購入了一幅康斯坦托里的畫像。這位著名朝臣相傳曾是世上最美麗的男子。據說畫像具有神秘力量，但賢者們尚未展開研究，它就被盜賊公會「敏捷之手」偷走了。在本冒險中，角色必須從敏捷之手的公會館取回康斯坦托里的畫像，交還祕學智者會成員阿德莉莎·卡里莫特。

english: Two adventurers hide from a guard outside the guildhouse of the Agile Hand
zh_tw: 兩名冒險者在敏捷之手公會館外躲避一名守衛。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: The Cognoscenti Esoterica collects obscure objects of curious origin and historical significance. The group's interests focus on items owned by powerful and popular individuals speculated to maintain covert ties with occult or nefarious organizations. Serious academics often write off the Cognoscenti Esoterica as charlatans or pranksters, and with good reason: the Cognoscenti rarely collect enough evidence to support their outlandish claims. Still, the organization occasionally stumbles upon something of true significance.
zh_tw: 高深莫測的學者和智者收集那些來源奇特、具有歷史意義的晦澀物品。這個團體的興趣集中在那些被推測與神秘或邪惡組織有秘密聯絡的強大且受歡迎的個人所擁有的物品上。嚴肅的學者經常將高深莫測的學者和智者視為騙子或惡作劇者，並且有很好的理由：高深莫測的學者和智者很少收集到足夠的證據來支援他們那些離奇的主張。儘管如此，這個組織偶爾也會偶然發現一些真正重要的東西。

english: Recently the group acquired a magical painting known as {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV}, a work reputed to depict one of the most beautiful men who ever lived. The group spent a small fortune acquiring the painting and prepared to host a debate over its cultural significance, the aesthetics of masculine beauty, and its influence on society. They also planned to research the portrait's magical properties (see the end of this adventure for a {@area description of the painting's properties|282|x}).
zh_tw: 最近，這個團體獲得了一幅被稱為{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}的魔法畫像，這幅作品據說描繪了曾經活著的最美麗的男人之一。該團體花費了一筆小財富來獲得這幅畫像，並準備舉辦一場辯論，討論它的文化意義、男性美的美學以及它對社會的影響。他們還計劃研究這幅畫像的魔法屬性（見本冒險末尾對畫像屬性的{@area 畫像屬性的描述|282|x}）。

english: The day after the debate was announced, a small team of Agile Hand thieves raided the Cognoscenti's vaults. The thieves slew three guards during the theft, then fled with the painting. Word has spread that the Agile Hand plans to fence the portrait in the next three days.
zh_tw: 辯論宣佈後的第二天，一小隊敏捷之手的盜賊襲擊了高深莫測的學者和智者的金庫。盜賊在盜竊過程中殺害了三名守衛，隨後帶著畫像逃走。有訊息傳出，敏捷之手計劃在接下來的三天內將畫像轉手出售。

english: During the robbery, Cognoscenti guards captured a lookout working with the thieves. This captive is willing to trade information for his freedom.
zh_tw: 在搶劫過程中，高深莫測的學者和智者的守衛捕獲了一個與盜賊合作的望風者。這名俘虜願意用資訊交換他的自由。

english: The Cognoscenti Esoterica distrusts the authorities and doesn't wish to report the theft. Instead, the organization seeks skilled adventurers to recover the painting.
zh_tw: 高深莫測的學者和智者不信任當局，也不想報告這次盜竊。相反，該組織尋求技術嫻熟的冒險者來追回畫像。

english: Adventure Hooks
zh_tw: 冒險引子

english: If you're not using the Golden Vault as a patron (see "Using the Golden Vault" below), you can use any of the following hooks to help motivate the characters:
zh_tw: 如果您沒有使用金庫作為贊助人（見下文的"使用金庫"），您可以使用以下任何鉤子來幫助激發角色的動機：

english: A Favor Owed
zh_tw: 一個欠下的人情

english: The characters either owe someone in the Cognoscenti Esoterica a favor or seek the counsel of one of its members. Upon arrival, this individual might request that the characters retrieve {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} to repay the individual's patronage or for mutual benefit.
zh_tw: 角色們要麼欠了神秘學社的某人一個人情，要麼尋求該社團某位成員的建議。到達後，這個人可能會要求角色們取回{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}以回報該個人的贊助或為了共同的利益。

english: Knowledge Sought
zh_tw: 尋求知識

english: The characters have prior reason to find the portrait or seek knowledge they believe someone in the Cognoscenti Esoterica possesses. However, the knowledge actually resides in {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 角色們有先前的理由去尋找畫像或尋求他們相信高深莫測的學者和智者擁有的知識。然而，知識實際上存在於{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}中。

english: Strike a Blow
zh_tw: 打擊一下

english: One or more characters have clashed with the Agile Hand in the past and want to strike a blow against the troublesome thieves' guild.
zh_tw: 一個或多個角色過去曾與敏捷之手發生過沖突，希望對這些麻煩的盜賊公會造成打擊。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. A valuable painting has been stolen from a member of the Cognoscenti Esoterica, an organization with connections to the Golden Vault. The Cognoscenti Esoterica specializes in the study of rare objects of historical significance. We suspect that the stolen painting, Constantori's Portrait, has magical properties and ties to the occult.
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。一幅有價值的畫像從高深莫測的學者和智者的成員那裡被盜，該組織與金庫有聯絡。高深莫測的學者和智者專門研究具有歷史意義的稀有物品。我們懷疑被盜的畫像，康斯坦托里的畫像，具有魔法屬性並與神秘學有關。"

english: "This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to infiltrate the guildhouse of the Agile Hand, a dangerous thieves' guild. Find where the painting is kept, recover it, and return it to Adrisa Carimorte of the Cognoscenti Esoterica. A preliminary meeting with Adrisa has already been arranged, and a coach will arrive shortly to deliver you safely to her location. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "這個任務，如果你們選擇承擔，需要你們潛入敏捷之手公會館，這是一個危險的盜賊公會。找到畫像存放的地方，取回它，然後將其歸還給高深莫測的學者和智者的阿德莉莎·卡里莫特。與阿德莉莎的初步會面已經安排好了，不久將有一輛馬車到達，安全地將你們送到她的所在地。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: A coach pulled by two black horses arrives not long after the key vanishes. The coach driver, a cheerful woman, invites the characters to climb aboard and delivers them safely to Adrisa if they accept the ride.
zh_tw: 關鍵物品消失後不久，一輛由兩匹黑馬拉動的馬車到達。馬車伕是一位開朗的女性，如果角色們接受乘車，她會邀請他們上車，並安全地將他們送到阿德莉莎那裡。

english: Barn Visit
zh_tw: 參觀穀倉

english: Read or paraphrase the following if the characters choose to meet with Adrisa Carimorte:
zh_tw: 如果角色們選擇與阿德莉莎·卡里莫特會面，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Rain begins to fall as your coach pulls up beside an open barn surrounded by fields of dead corn. A tall, well-dressed human woman emerges from the barn as you exit the coach. "Thank you for coming," she says with a smile. "I'm Adrisa Carimorte. My organization would like to hire you to retrieve a painting that was stolen from us by a thieves' guild. For the painting's safe return, I'm prepared to pay you two thousand gold pieces. Let's go inside to escape the rain, shall we? There's someone else I'd like you to meet."
zh_tw: 當你們的馬車停在一個被枯死的玉米田包圍的開放穀倉旁邊時，雨開始下了起來。一位高大、穿著考究的人類女性從穀倉裡走出來，當你們下車時。"感謝你們的到來，"她帶著微笑說道。"我是阿德莉莎·卡里莫特。我的組織希望僱傭你們來取回一幅被盜賊公會從我們這裡偷走的畫像。為了畫像的安全歸還，我準備支付你們兩千金幣。讓我們進去避雨，好嗎？還有一個人我想讓你們見見。"

english: Adrisa Carimorte (neutral, human {@creature mage}) is an influential member of the Cognoscenti Esoterica. If the characters turn down the offer, Adrisa has the coach driver return them whence they came. If the characters express interest in the job, Adrisa escorts them into the barn, which the Cognoscenti Esoterica sometimes uses as a warehouse and secret meeting place. The barn has magical wards that thwart all attempts to magically scry on its interior, as well as other wards Adrisa temporarily deactivated.
zh_tw: 阿德莉莎·卡里莫特（中立，人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）是高深莫測的學者和智者中一位有影響力的成員。如果角色們拒絕了這個提議，阿德莉莎會讓馬車伕把他們送回原來的地方。如果角色們對這項工作表示興趣，阿德莉莎會帶領他們進入穀倉，高深莫測的學者和智者有時會將穀倉用作倉庫和秘密會面的地方。穀倉有魔法結界，可以阻止所有試圖魔法窺視其內部的企圖，以及阿德莉莎暫時停用的其它結界。

english: Adrisa leads the characters up a ladder to the barn's loft. Once everyone is in the loft, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 阿德莉莎帶領角色們爬上通往穀倉閣樓的梯子。當所有人都到達閣樓後，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: In the middle of the loft, tied to a wooden chair, is a scrawny human man with patchy facial hair. He is sweating profusely and chewing nervously on a cloth gag.
zh_tw: 在閣樓中央，一個瘦弱的人類男子被綁在一把木椅上，臉上的鬍鬚斑駁不齊。他汗流浹背，緊張地嚼著一個布制的塞口物。

english: The man tied to the chair is Grinky Brithwort (neutral evil, human {@creature bandit}). He was captured during the theft of {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} and has useful information about the Agile Hand and its headquarters—information the characters can use to help plan their heist.
zh_tw: 被綁在椅子上的男人是格林基·布里斯沃特（中立邪惡，人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}）。他在盜取{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}期間被捕獲，並且擁有有關敏捷之手及其總部的有用資訊——這些資訊角色們可以用來幫助計劃他們的盜竊行動。

english: Grinky's Deal
zh_tw: 格林基的交易

english: Grinky has been associated with the Agile Hand for years. During the theft of {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV}, Grinky's job was to watch for guards. He was caught and given to Adrisa for questioning. Adrisa has offered to release Grinky in exchange for his help.
zh_tw: 格林基已經和敏捷之手有多年的聯絡。在盜取{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}的過程中，格林基的任務是監視守衛。他被抓住後交給了阿德莉莎審問。阿德莉莎提出釋放格林基作為他幫助的交換。

english: What Grinky Knows
zh_tw: 格林基所知道的

english: Adrisa gives the characters a chance to question Grinky. During this conversation, Grinky shares the following true information:
zh_tw: 阿德莉莎給了角色們一個機會來審問格林基。在這次對話中，格林基分享了以下真實的資訊：

english: Guildmaster Dusk
zh_tw: 達斯克會長

english: "Guildmaster Dusk leads the Agile Hand. She's a trained assassin with powerful political connections."
zh_tw: "公會會長達斯克領導著敏捷之手。她是一個訓練有素的刺客，擁有強大的政治聯絡。"

english: Getting Inside
zh_tw: 進入內部

english: "The windows of the guildhouse are boarded up, and its doors are usually locked. At least three guild members have master keys to the doors: Guildmaster Dusk; Elix the Saint, one of Dusk's lieutenants; and Jaymont the Sinner, the guild's resident spy. The master of ravens, Gwish, might have a key as well. If you want to get your hands on a master key, your best bet is to snatch it from Elix the Saint, who frequents a seedy tavern called the Tipsy Tankard."
zh_tw: "公會館的窗戶被封閉了，門通常也是鎖著的。至少有三名公會成員擁有萬能鑰匙：公會會長達斯克；聖徒埃利克斯，達斯克的副手之一；以及罪人傑蒙特，公會的常駐間諜。養烏鴉的格威許可能也有一把鑰匙。如果你想弄到一把萬能鑰匙，你最好的機會是從經常光顧一個叫微醺酒杯的破舊酒館的聖徒埃利克斯那裡偷取。"

english: Guildhouse Guards
zh_tw: 公會館守衛

english: "By late evening, most guild members have gone to sleep. Senior guild members bully lower-ranking guild members into taking the late-night shifts."
zh_tw: "到了深夜，大多數公會成員都去睡覺了。高階公會成員欺負低階公會成員，讓他們來值深夜班。"

english: Guild Membership
zh_tw: 公會成員身份

english: "Dusk isn't accepting new guild members right now. I've been working for the guild since I was a kid, and I'm still not a ranking member."
zh_tw: "達斯克現在不接受新公會成員。我從小就為公會工作，到現在我還不是正式成員。"

english: Portrait's Location
zh_tw: 畫像的位置

english: "I don't know where the portrait is, but I'm guessing it's either in Guildmaster Dusk's quarters, which are on the second floor of the guildhouse's tower, or hidden in the basement, where new guild members are trained."
zh_tw: "我不知道畫像在哪裡，但我猜它要麼在公會會長達斯克的房間裡，她的房間在公會館塔樓的二樓，要麼藏在地下室裡，那裡是新公會成員受訓的地方。"

english: Supply Deliveries
zh_tw: 供應品交付

english: "Supplies are sometimes delivered to the guildhouse by riders on horseback or by mule-drawn cart. All supplies are received and inspected by Laris Drot, the stablemaster, at the livery stables."
zh_tw: "供應品有時由騎馬的騎手或由騾子拉的貨車送到公會館。所有供應品都由馬廄的馬伕拉里斯·德羅特接收和檢查。"

english: What Adrisa Knows
zh_tw: 阿德莉莎所知道的

english: After the characters question Grinky, they can ask Adrisa questions about the Agile Hand or {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV}. She knows the following:
zh_tw: 在角色們審問格林基之後，他們可以向阿德莉莎詢問有關敏捷之手或{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}的問題。她知道以下資訊：

english: Guildmaster Dusk
zh_tw: 達斯克會長

english: "Everyone seems to ignore the activities of Dusk and her guild. Larceny is the Agile Hand's specialty, but Dusk uses blackmail, extortion, threats of violence, and whatever else it takes to keep her enemies at bay."
zh_tw: "每個人似乎都忽視了達斯克和她的公會的活動。盜竊是敏捷之手的專長，但達斯克利用勒索、敲詐、暴力威脅以及任何必要的手段來抵禦她的敵人。"

english: Portrait Lore
zh_tw: 畫像傳說

english: "The portrait is the work of famed artist Dkesii Kwan and was commissioned by the late Daiyani Grysthorn, a grand dame in the criminal underworld. The painting is sentient and was made to eavesdrop on conversations and pass along secrets to its owner. Like its beautiful subject, the painting is notoriously vain."
zh_tw: "這幅畫像是由著名藝術家德克西·關創作的，由已故的戴雅妮·格里斯索恩委託製作，她是犯罪黑社會的一位顯赫女士。這幅畫是有感知能力的，被製造出來是為了偷聽對話，並向其主人傳遞秘密。就像它那美麗的主題一樣，這幅畫以虛榮而聞名。"

english: Sense of Urgency
zh_tw: 緊迫感

english: "It's likely that the Agile Hand has a buyer for the painting. Therefore, it's vital you recover it as quickly as possible before it ends up in an even more secure location."
zh_tw: "很可能會有一個買家在等待敏捷之手的畫像。因此，你們必須儘快將其追回，以防止它最終落入一個更加安全的地方。"

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: The characters' goals are simple: locate the portrait and return it safely to the Cognoscenti Esoterica.
zh_tw: 角色們的目標很簡單：找到畫像並安全地將其歸還給高深莫測的學者和智者。

english: Grinky's Map
zh_tw: 格林基的地圖

english: Grinky furnished Adrisa with a sketched map of the Agile Hand's guildhouse (see {@adventure map 6.1|KftGV|6|Map 6.1: Players' Map}). Adrisa gives Grinky's map to the characters.
zh_tw: 格林基為阿德莉莎提供了一張敏捷之手公會館的草圖（見{@adventure 地圖 6.1|KftGV|6|Map 6.1: Players' Map}）。阿德莉莎將格林基的地圖交給了角色們。

english: Grinky is neither well informed nor a high-ranking member of the Agile Hand. Consequently, his map contains inaccuracies, such as the following:
zh_tw: 格林基既不是敏捷之手的知情者，也不是高階成員。因此，他的地圖包含一些不準確之處，例如：

english: Grinky's guesses as to where Dusk stored the painting are wrong.
zh_tw: 格林基關於達斯克存放畫像的猜測是錯誤的。

english: Grinky's map is missing the topmost level of the tower, where the painting is kept ({@area area G27|260|x} on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}).
zh_tw: 格林基的地圖缺少了塔樓的最高層，畫像就存放在那裡（見{@area 區域G27|260|x} 在{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}）。

english: Elix the Saint
zh_tw: 聖徒埃利克斯

english: Characters can obtain one of the guildhouse's master keys from Elix the Saint (lawful evil, human {@creature bandit captain}), a high-ranking member of the Agile Hand and one of Guildmaster Dusk's more capable lieutenants. After questioning Grinky, the characters should know that Elix the Saint frequents a tavern called the Tipsy Tankard, which is about a 45-minute walk from the guildhouse. He travels there alone because he likes to flirt with a bartender named Karyssa (neutral, human {@creature commoner}).
zh_tw: 角色們可以從聖徒埃利克斯（守序邪惡，人類{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}），敏捷之手的高階成員之一，也是公會會長達斯克的得力副手那裡獲得公會館的萬能鑰匙之一。審問格林基之後，角色們應該知道聖徒埃利克斯經常光顧一個叫做微醺酒杯的酒館，它距離公會館大約45分鐘的步行路程。他獨自一人去那裡，因為他喜歡和一個名叫卡莉莎（中立，人類{@creature commoner||平民}）的酒保調情。

english: Elix usually leaves the guildhouse at sundown and returns by midnight. Characters can approach him during this interval and take his master key by force or snatch it from him without his knowledge. As an action, a character within reach of Elix can try to snatch the key from his pocket, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the attempt is made in a crowded place where others might notice the theft, increase the DC by 5.
zh_tw: 埃利克斯通常會在日落時離開公會會所，並在午夜前返回。角色們可以在這段時間內接近他，並透過武力奪取他的萬能鑰匙或在他不知情的情況下從他身上奪走它。作為一個動作，角色可以在能觸及埃利克斯的範圍內嘗試從他的口袋中奪取鑰匙，成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定可以完成此操作。如果嘗試在擁擠的地方進行，其他人可能會注意到這次盜竊，將 DC 增加 5。

english: Elix would sooner die than betray Guildmaster Dusk, although a {@spell suggestion} spell or other coercive magic can wring information from him. For example, he knows where {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} is being kept (on the tower's third floor, above Guildmaster Dusk's private quarters).
zh_tw: 埃利克斯寧願死也不會背叛公會會長達斯克，儘管{@spell suggestion||暗示術}法術或其他強迫性魔法可以從他那裡榨取資訊。例如，他知道{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}被存放在哪裡（在塔樓的第三層，位於公會會長達斯克私人房間的上方）。

english: Clever characters can steal Elix's identity as well as his key. If Elix is either detained or disposed of, a character can use magic (for example, {@spell alter self} or {@spell disguise self}) to mimic his appearance. A disguise kit can also help perpetrate such a ruse. In this form, a character can search most of the guildhouse without inviting altercations.
zh_tw: 聰明的人物不僅可以偷走埃利克斯的鑰匙，還可以冒充他的身份。如果埃利克斯被拘留或被處理掉，一個角色可以使用魔法（例如，{@spell alter self||變身術}或{@spell disguise self||易容術}）來模仿他的外貌。偽裝工具包也可以幫助進行這種詭計。以這種形態，一個角色可以在不引起爭執的情況下搜尋公會館的大部分地區。

english: If Elix the Saint doesn't return to the guildhouse by midnight, the lookouts on watch assume he had too much to drink and either passed out in a field or got thrown in jail for brawling. His failure to return won't cause alarm.
zh_tw: 如果聖徒埃利克斯在午夜前沒有回到公會館，值班的望風者會認為他喝得太多，要麼在田野中昏倒，要麼因鬥毆被關進了監獄。他未能返回不會引起警報。

english: Magical Surveillance
zh_tw: 魔法監視

english: Characters can use {@spell invisibility} spells to approach and observe the guildhouse without being seen. They can also use a {@spell locate object} spell to pinpoint the painting's location ({@area area G27|260|x} on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}). If they don't have access to such magic, they can request Adrisa's help. Within a day, she can obtain a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell locate object} for them.
zh_tw: 角色們可以使用{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術來接近並觀察公會館而不被看到。他們還可以使用{@spell locate object||物件定位術}法術來精確定位畫像的位置（在{@area 區域G27|260|x}上，見{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}）。如果他們沒有接觸到這樣的魔法，他們可以請求阿德莉莎的幫助。在一天之內，她可以為他們獲得一張{@spell locate object||物件定位術}法術的{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}。

english: The characters might have access to other magic that can help with surveillance, such as the {@spell clairvoyance} spell. A wizard's familiar can slip inside the guildhouse without attracting too much attention, as can a druid using Wild Shape to assume the form of a stray cat or some other common animal.
zh_tw: 角色們可能可以使用其他有助於監視的魔法，比如{@spell clairvoyance||鷹眼術}法術。一個法師的魔寵可以悄無聲息地溜進公會館，不會引起太多注意，同樣，一個使用野性變形變為流浪貓或其他常見動物的德魯伊也可以做到這一點。

english: Map 6.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 6.1: 玩家地圖

english: Agile Hand Guildhouse
zh_tw: 敏捷之手公會館

english: The Agile Hand's guildhouse is situated at the end of a winding, cobbled street that runs parallel to a small river. The back of the stables faces a grassy embankment scattered with mulberry trees.
zh_tw: 敏捷之手的公會館位於一條蜿蜒的鵝卵石街道的盡頭，這條街道與一條小河平行。馬廄的背面是一個雜草叢生的堤岸，上面散佈著桑樹。

english: The guildhouse is a wooden complex consisting of a main building with an adjoining tower and basement, as well as a livery area that includes stables, an office, and quarters for paying visitors.
zh_tw: 公會館是一個木製建築群，包括一個主樓、一個附屬的塔樓和地下室，以及一個馬廄區域，其中包括馬廄、辦公室和為付費訪客準備的房間。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: Recurring features of the guildhouse are described in the following sections.
zh_tw: 公會館的重複出現的特徵在以下各節中進行了描述。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Doors in the guildhouse complex are locked unless otherwise noted. Some individuals have keys to specific areas, as noted in their descriptions. Others possess a master key that opens all locked doors in the complex.
zh_tw: 公會館建築群內的門都是鎖著的，除非另有說明。一些人擁有特定區域的鑰匙，這在他們的描述中有所註明。其他人則擁有一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟建築群內所有上鎖的門。

english: As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to open a locked door, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check, or force open the door with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Each door has AC 15, 18 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開啟一扇鎖上的門，成功透過 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定即可開啟，或成功透過 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。每扇門擁有 AC 15，18 點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door blends in perfectly with the wall that surrounds it. A character who uses an action to examine a stretch of wall can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, finding any secret door hidden there on a success. The guildhouse complex's secret doors have well-oiled hinges, allowing them to be opened and closed quietly.
zh_tw: 一扇暗門完美地融入周圍的牆壁中。一個角色若用一個動作來檢查一段牆壁，可以進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，成功時可以發現隱藏在那裡的任何暗門。公會建築群中的暗門鉸鏈都經過良好潤滑，使得它們可以安靜地開啟和關閉。

english: Floors
zh_tw: 地板

english: The upper floors, stable loft, and porches are unlacquered hardwood planks. Rough, splintery, and slightly warped with age, these floors creak when walked on. Characters make any ability checks to move stealthily on the upper floors at disadvantage. The ground floor is paved with slate tiles, except the stable, which is hard-packed dirt. The basement is cobblestone.
zh_tw: 上層地板、馬廄閣樓和門廊是未上漆的硬木地板。這些地板因年代久遠而變得粗糙、易裂和略微變形，行走時會發出吱吱聲。角色在上層地板上進行潛行移動的屬性檢定時處於不利狀態。一樓鋪有板岩瓷磚，除了馬廄是硬實的泥土地面。地下室則是鵝卵石鋪成。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: The stables are unlit. During the day, light filters in from the entrances and through cracks in the plank walls, filling the area with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}.
zh_tw: 馬廄內沒有照明。在白晝，光線從入口和板條牆的縫隙中透入，使該區域充滿{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。

english: The rest of the guildhouse complex is filled with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} during the day, either from lanterns or the sun. At night, rooms and hallways are dimly lit by low-burning lanterns.
zh_tw: 公會館建築群的其餘部分在白晝期間充滿了{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}，光源來自提燈或太陽。在夜晚，房間和走廊被低燃的提燈昏暗地照亮。

english: Guild members carry light sources with them when they descend into the basement, which is unlit.
zh_tw: 當公會成員下到沒有照明的地下室時，他們會攜帶光源。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: The exterior walls are made of wood. The interior walls are plastered lath, making them relatively soundproof. The basement walls are made of clay bricks braced at regular intervals by thick, rough-cut wooden beams.
zh_tw: 外牆由木材製成。內牆是抹了灰泥的木格柵，使它們相對隔音。地下室的牆壁由粘土磚製成，在規律間隔處由厚實、粗糙切割的木樑支撐。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: Most of the guildhouse complex's windows are boarded up (except the ones in {@area area G21|24a|x}), but tiny cracks between the boards allow creatures to peer through. Prying away the boards is relatively easy, but doing so quietly requires a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 公會建築群的大部分窗戶都用木板封住了（除了 {@area 區域G21|24a|x} 中的那些），但木板之間的小裂縫允許生物窺視。撬開木板相對容易，但要安靜地做到這一點，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 13} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。

zh_tw: 公會成員姓名

zh_tw: 如果您需要為敏捷之手的低階或中級成員選擇一個名字，請從以下列表中挑選：

zh_tw: 夜百合

english: Ookie the Cheat
zh_tw: 作弊的奧基

english: Pistachio

english: Vaelin Shadowblade
zh_tw: 瓦林·影刃

zh_tw: 潛行者齊克

zh_tw: 高度警戒

zh_tw: 如果出現使公會館進入高度警戒狀態的情況，一個特遣隊會集結來應對威脅。這個力量在公會特遣隊表中進行了總結。從表中減去已經被中和的任何個人。

english: Guild Task Force

zh_tw: 生物

zh_tw: 位置

zh_tw: 公會會長達斯克（{@creature assassin||刺客}）

english: {@area G26|25b|x}
zh_tw: {@area G26|25b|x}

english: Guildhouse Locations
zh_tw: 公會館地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 6.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖6.2。

english: Map 6.2: DM's map
zh_tw: 地圖 6.2: 地下城主地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: G1: Front Porch
zh_tw: G1. 前廊

english: Nailed to this lengthy porch are short planks that bear the words "Private Property. No Trespassing!" in Common. A lookout is stationed on a second-floor balcony above the western end of the porch.
zh_tw: 這個長長的門廊上釘著幾塊短木板，上面用通用語寫著"私有財產。禁止擅入！"。在門廊西端的二樓陽臺上，有一個哨兵駐守。

english: Any character who approaches the porch in plain view is spotted by the {@creature bandit} on the south balcony ({@area area G22|24f|x}), who calls out, "Hey, you, get lost! Can't you read the signs?" If this warning is ignored, the lookout shouts the same thing again, putting the guildhouse on high alert, then shoots a crossbow bolt into the ground near the character's feet as a final warning.
zh_tw: 任何在陽臺上顯眼地接近門廊的角色都會被南陽臺上的{@creature bandit||匪徒}（見{@area 區域G22|24f|x}）發現，他會大聲喊道："嘿，你，迷路了！你不識字嗎？"如果這個警告被忽視，望風者會再次大聲喊出同樣的話，使公會館進入高度警戒狀態，然後用弩向角色腳邊的地面射出弩箭，作為最後的警告。

english: Drop Box
zh_tw: 投幣箱

english: The staircase in front of the double door to {@area area G10|22d|x} has a loose plank near the top. This plank conceals a drop box where visitors stash black-market goods, fenced items, and guild tributes. Any character who lifts the plank sees a dusty satchel in the drop box. The satchel contains 25 sp and a piece of parchment that transfers ownership of two horses to Guildmaster Dusk.
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域G10|22d|x}的雙扇門前的樓梯頂部附近有一塊鬆動的木板。這塊木板下隱藏著一個投遞箱，訪客們在這裡存放黑市商品、贓物和公會貢品。任何角色抬起木板都會看到一個滿是灰塵的小包。小包裡有25枚銀幣和一張羊皮紙，上面轉讓了兩匹馬的所有權給暮色公會的會長。

english: G2a: Livery Stables
zh_tw: G2a. 馬廄

english: Ten horse stables and a hayloft line the walls of this barn, which has an open doorway at each end. Flies swarm around a full dung cart that exudes a horrible stench.
zh_tw: 這個穀倉的牆壁上排列著十個馬廄和一個乾草棚，每個端頭都有一個敞開的門。蒼蠅圍繞著一輛滿載糞便、散發著可怕惡臭的糞車成群結隊。

english: The stalls contain ten {@creature Riding Horse||riding horses}.
zh_tw: 馬廄裡有十匹{@creature Riding Horse||乘用馬}。

english: Cart
zh_tw: 二輪貨車

english: The dung-filled cart is a fire hazard. If the cart is pushed against a wall and set ablaze, the fire quickly spreads to the loft and ignites the hay there. After 1 minute, the smoke and panic of the horses put the guildhouse on high alert.
zh_tw: 滿是糞便的推車是一個火災隱患。如果把推車推到牆邊並點燃，火勢會迅速蔓延到閣樓並點燃那裡的乾草。1分鐘後，煙霧和馬匹的驚慌會使公會房進入高度警戒狀態。

english: Fire
zh_tw: 火焰

english: The Agile Hand isn't equipped to stop a fire that starts in the barn. Such a fire takes 1 minute to spread throughout the structure. After that, the fire moves 5 feet westward each minute until the whole east building is engulfed. After 5 minutes, the building collapses, and the stairs to the basement are buried in flaming debris. The west building is spared.
zh_tw: 敏捷之手沒有裝備來阻止在穀倉裡開始的火災。這樣的火災需要1分鐘才能在整個建築中蔓延。之後，火勢每分鐘向西蔓延5尺，直到整個東樓被吞沒。5分鐘後，建築物倒塌，通往地下室的樓梯被埋在燃燒的廢墟中。西樓則倖免於難。

english: Ladders
zh_tw: 梯子

english: A wooden ladder in each corner stall ascends to a trapdoor that leads to the hayloft (area G2b). The trapdoors are unlocked.
zh_tw: 每個角落的馬廄裡都有一架木梯，通向通往乾草棚（區域G2b）的活板門。這些活板門沒有上鎖。

english: G2b: Hayloft
zh_tw: G2b. 乾草棚

english: The hayloft is 10 feet above the stables and consists of a 5-foot-wide wooden walkway that runs the perimeter of the building. Broad, square loading doors open in the north and south walls, each fitted with block-and-tackle rigs for hoisting hay bales and other supplies into the loft. Hay bales and burlap sacks stuffed with feed grains take up most of the space. A few pitchforks, ropes, and feed buckets lie scattered about the bales.
zh_tw: 乾草棚位於馬廄上方10尺處，由一條5尺寬的木製走道構成，環繞建築的四周。寬闊的方形裝載門在北牆和南牆上開啟，每個門都裝有滑輪系統，用於將乾草捆和其他物資吊到棚子裡。乾草捆和裝滿飼料穀物的麻袋佔據了大部分空間。一些乾草叉、繩子和飼料桶散落在草捆之間。

english: Stable Hand
zh_tw: 馬伕

english: A young stable hand named Needly Pitts (neutral, human {@creature commoner}) lazes in the loft, supposedly guarding against horse thieves. He has nodded off but wakes if characters disturb the horses, make too much noise in the barn, or start a fire. In the event of trouble, Needly bangs a metal pail and yells for the stablemaster (see {@area area G16|23e|x}), who takes 1 minute to arrive.
zh_tw: 一個名叫尼德利·皮茨（中立，人類{@creature commoner||平民})的年輕馬伕在閣樓裡偷懶，據說是在防範偷馬賊。他打瞌睡了，但如果角色打擾了馬匹，在馬廄裡製造太多噪音，或者點火，他就會醒來。遇到麻煩時，尼德利會敲擊一個金屬桶並大聲呼叫馬廄主管（見{@area 區域G16|23e|x}），後者需要1分鐘才能到達。

english: G3: Staircase
zh_tw: G3. 樓梯

english: Halfway up this flight of stairs is a sleeping figure wrapped in a wool blanket. A door is situated at the top of the stairs.
zh_tw: 在這樓梯的中間，有一個裹在羊毛毯子裡睡覺的身影。樓梯頂部有一扇門。

english: The door at the top of the stairs is unlocked and opens into {@area area G14|239|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯頂部的門沒有上鎖，開啟後通向{@area 區域G14|239|x}。

english: Jaymont the Sinner
zh_tw: 罪人傑蒙特

english: The figure on the steps is Jaymont the Sinner, a {@creature doppelganger} disguised as a drunken guest. Only Guildmaster Dusk knows Jaymont's true nature.
