The doppelganger pretends to be asleep, but a character can discern that it's awake with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. Jaymont doesn't start fights it knows it can't win and allows intruders to pass by. When the intruders are gone, Jaymont taps three times on the staircase wall to alert Gwish in {@area area G21|24a|x}, then slinks away to alert Guildmaster Dusk in {@area area G26|25b|x}.
zh_tw: 臺階上的人物是罪人傑蒙特，一個偽裝成醉酒客人的{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}。只有公會會長達斯克知道傑蒙特的真實本性。變形怪假裝睡著了，但角色可以透過成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定察覺它是醒著的。傑蒙特不會挑起它知道自己無法獲勝的戰鬥，並允許入侵者透過。當入侵者離開後，傑蒙特會在樓梯牆上敲擊三次以提醒{@area 區域G21|24a|x}的格維什，然後悄悄離開去通知公會會長達斯克在{@area 區域G26|25b|x}。

english: Master Key
zh_tw: 萬能鑰匙

english: Jaymont carries a master key that unlocks all doors in the guildhouse complex.
zh_tw: 傑蒙特持有一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟公會館建築群內的所有門。

english: G4: Cartwright's Workshop
zh_tw: G4. 馬車匠的作坊

english: Three carts occupy this room. Pegs and hooks on the inner walls bear ropes, tackle, leather harnesses, wheels, and leatherworking tools. Shoved into a corner is a crate filled with horseshoes. Nearby, shelves hold smaller boxes filled with buckles, nails, cotter pins, and miscellaneous hardware.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡有三輛手推車。內牆上的釘子和鉤子上掛著繩索、滑輪、皮製挽具、輪子和皮革加工工具。角落裡堆放著一個裝滿馬蹄鐵的箱子。附近，架子上放著裝有釦子、釘子、銷釘和各種五金的小盒子。

english: The shop has two access points: the stables to the east and a door to the west that leads to {@area area G7|227|x}.
zh_tw: 這家商店有兩個入口：東邊的馬廄和西邊的一扇門，通向{@area 區域G7|227|x}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters can assemble one set of {@item leatherworker's tools|PHB} from the tools stored here.
zh_tw: 角色們可以從這裡存放的工具中組裝一套{@item leatherworker's tools|PHB|皮匠工具}。

english: G5: Livery Office
zh_tw: G5. 馬房辦公室

english: A wooden countertop divides the room. Signboards display services and fees for stabling and room rentals. Two keys hang from hooks on the east wall above the counter. A third hook is bare.
zh_tw: 一個木製櫃檯將房間分隔開。招牌上展示了馬廄服務和房間租賃的服務和費用。櫃檯上方的東牆上掛著兩把鑰匙。第三個掛鉤是空的。

english: When the office is staffed, a visitor can secure an upstairs bed for 5 cp per night (5 sp for a private room). Accommodations can also be made in the stables for a traveler's mount at a cost of 1 sp per night.
zh_tw: 當辦公室有人值班時，訪客可以預訂樓上的床位，每晚5銅幣（私人房間5銀幣）。也可以為旅行者的坐騎在馬廄安排住宿，費用為每晚1銀幣。

english: Coin Box
zh_tw: 錢幣盒

english: Tucked behind the counter is a wooden coin box with a copper clasp. A character who inspects the coin box before opening it notices a row of tiny pinholes in the lid. The coin box contains 15 cp and 11 sp, as well as a {@creature spider}.
zh_tw: 櫃檯後面隱藏著一個帶有銅釦的木製錢箱。在開啟錢箱之前檢查它的人物會注意到蓋子上有一排細小的針孔。錢箱裡有15銅幣和11銀幣，還有一隻{@creature spider||蜘蛛}。

english: Keys
zh_tw: 鑰匙

english: The two keys hanging on the wall unlock the doors to areas {@area G17|241|x} and {@area G18|242|x}, respectively.
zh_tw: 掛在牆上的兩把鑰匙分別開啟了{@area G17|241|x}和{@area G18|242|x}區域的門。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the office's back wall leads to {@area area G6|225|x}.
zh_tw: 辦公室後牆上的一扇秘密門通向 {@area 區域G6|225|x}。

english: G6: Basement Staircase
zh_tw: G6. 地下室樓梯

english: A wooden staircase in the northeast corner of this empty, boarded-up room leads to the basement.
zh_tw: 這個空蕩且封閉的房間東北角有一座木製樓梯，通向地下室。

english: The stairs descend 15 feet to {@area area G28|264|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯向下延伸15尺至{@area 區域G28|264|x}。

english: G7: Service Entrance
zh_tw: G7. 服務入口

english: Hanging on the walls of this small, muddy room are several riding cloaks, bits and harnesses, oil lanterns, and coils of rope.
zh_tw: 這個小而泥濘的房間裡的牆上掛著幾件騎手斗篷、馬勒和馬具、油燈和繩索卷。

english: Guild members store their riding gear here. A search of the room yields nothing of great value.
zh_tw: 公會成員在這裡存放他們的騎行裝備。搜查這個房間沒有發現什麼價值很大的東西。

english: G8: Courtyard
zh_tw: G8. 庭院

english: A cobblestone courtyard is wedged between the two main buildings of the guildhouse. Situated in the middle of the yard is a stone well rigged with a simple bucket winch.
zh_tw: 一個鵝卵石鋪成的庭院被夾在公會館的兩座主建築之間。庭院中央是一個裝有簡單吊桶絞車的石井。

english: The well is 30 feet deep and has fresh water filling its bottom 5 feet. The well's winch and rope are sturdy enough to bear 250 pounds of weight.
zh_tw: 井深30尺，底部5尺處有清水。井的絞車和繩索足夠堅固，可以承受250磅的重量。

english: G9: Conference Room
zh_tw: G9. 會議室

english: This room contains several unmatched chairs situated around a long oak table scarred with knife marks. On the table sits a half-eaten cheese wheel, four clay wine jugs, and some wine-stained flagons.
zh_tw: 這個房間內擺放著幾把不成套的椅子，圍繞著一張帶有刀痕的長橡木桌。桌上放著半塊被吃掉的乳酪、四個陶製酒壺，以及一些沾有酒漬的大酒杯。

english: Guildmaster Dusk holds meetings here.
zh_tw: 公會會長達斯克在這裡舉行會議。

english: G10: Main Hall
zh_tw: G10. 主廳

english: Visitors who try to enter this hall through the north door must contend with a trap.
zh_tw: 試圖透過北門進入這個大廳的訪客必須應對一個陷阱。

english: Back-Door Trap
zh_tw: 後門陷阱

english: The northernmost door has a "No Trespassers!" sign hanging on the outside of it and is nailed shut on the inside (a fact not discernible from the outside). As an action, a character can try to force open the door using brute strength, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Breaking down the door puts the guildhouse on high alert unless a {@spell silence} spell or similar magic is used to muffle the noise.
zh_tw: 最北邊的門上掛著一個"禁止闖入！"的牌子，門從內部釘死（這一點從外部無法察覺）。作為一個動作，一個角色可以嘗試用蠻力強行開啟門，成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。強行破門會使公會處於高度警戒狀態，除非使用 {@spell silence||沉默術} 或類似法術來掩蓋聲音。

english: A character who searches the door for traps can make a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the check is successful, the character notices that the doorknob is loose and attached to a vial of poison gas hidden in the door itself. As an action, a character can try to disable the trap using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 一個搜尋門上陷阱的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到門把手鬆動，並且連線到一個隱藏在門內的毒氣瓶。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具來解除陷阱，這需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定。

english: Unless the trap is disabled, tugging or turning the knob causes the vial in the door to break, releasing a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the door. The trap also triggers if the door is forced open. Each creature in the trap's area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 16 ({@dice 3d10}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute; on a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. The trap can be triggered only once.
zh_tw: 除非陷阱被解除，否則拉動或轉動門把手會導致門中的小瓶破裂，釋放出一團毒氣，形成一個以門為中心的10尺半徑的球體。如果門被強行開啟，陷阱也會觸發。陷阱範圍內的每個生物都必須進行一次{@dc 14}體質豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，該生物會受到16（{@dice 3d10}）點毒素傷害，並且會{@condition poisoned||中毒}1分鐘；如果檢定成功，該生物只受到一半傷害，並且不會{@condition poisoned||中毒}。該陷阱只能觸發一次。

english: Entering the Hall
zh_tw: 進入大廳

english: Use the following boxed text to describe the hallway:
zh_tw: 使用以下框內文字來描述走廊：

english: A long, well-trafficked hall runs the width of the house. A staircase along the west wall leads to the second floor.
zh_tw: 一條長且經常有人來往的走廊貫穿了整個房子的寬度。沿著西牆的樓梯通向二樓。

english: The stairs climb 15 feet to {@area area G23|252|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯上升15尺到達{@area 區域G23|252|x}。

english: G11: Kitchen
zh_tw: G11. 廚房

english: A cooking hearth occupies one corner of this kitchen, and nets holding dried sausages, cheese, peppers, and garlic hang from the rafters. Other items found here include a butcher's block, a table for preparing meals, a pail of potatoes, a few cast-iron pots, a sack of flour, a tin filled with cooking utensils, a block of salt, and a knife with a cutting board.
zh_tw: 這個廚房的一角設有一個烹飪爐灶，掛著的網中裝有幹香腸、乳酪、辣椒和大蒜。這裡還發現了其他物品，包括一個切肉臺、一個準備餐食的桌子、一桶土豆、幾個鑄鐵鍋、一袋麵粉、一個裝滿烹飪用具的錫盒、一塊鹽磚和一把帶有砧板的刀。

english: The kitchen contains nothing of great value.
zh_tw: 廚房裡沒有什麼價值很大的東西。

english: G12: Parlor
zh_tw: G12. 客廳

english: This room contains a fireplace, a tattered couch, and several upholstered chairs, one of which is bright blue. Playing cards and coins lie scattered across a table. Slumped around the table are four drunken guild members clutching empty mugs and reeking of ale.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一個壁爐、一張破舊的沙發和幾把軟墊椅子，其中一把是鮮亮的藍色。紙牌和硬幣散落在桌子上。圍坐在桌子周圍的是四個醉酒的公會成員，他們手裡緊握著空酒杯，散發著啤酒的氣味。

english: The four guild members have been drinking and playing card games. The motley crew consists of three {@creature Thug||thugs} and one {@creature gladiator}. The thugs are {@condition poisoned} and {@condition unconscious}, while the gladiator is merely {@condition poisoned} and spoiling for a fight. The {@condition unconscious} condition ends on a thug who is wounded, knocked out of their chair, or splashed with a pint or more of liquid.
zh_tw: 這四名公會成員一直在喝酒和玩紙牌遊戲。這個雜亂無章的隊伍由三名{@creature Thug||暴徒}和一名{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}組成。暴徒們{@condition poisoned||中毒}並且{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，而角鬥士只是{@condition poisoned||中毒}並且急於戰鬥。如果一個暴徒受傷、從椅子上摔下來，或者被潑了一品脫或更多的液體，{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態就會結束。

english: Blue Chair
zh_tw: 藍色椅子

english: The blue chair in the south corner covers a secret trapdoor in the stone floor. A character who examines the floor near the chair can make a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, finding the trapdoor on a success. Pulling open the trapdoor reveals a wooden ladder that descends 15 feet to {@area area G37|27f|x}.
zh_tw: 南角的藍色椅子掩蓋了石地板上的一個秘密活板門。檢查椅子附近地板的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，成功則發現活板門。拉開活板門後，可以看到一個木梯向下延伸15尺，通向 {@area 區域G37|27f|x}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The coins on the table amount to 65 cp, 35 sp, and 11 gp.
zh_tw: 桌上的硬幣總計65銅幣，35銀幣和11金幣。

english: G13: Tower Rotunda
zh_tw: G13. 塔樓圓形大廳

english: A lit fireplace warms this mostly empty tower chamber. A wooden staircase hugs the west wall.
zh_tw: 這個塔樓房間大部分是空的，但被一個點燃的壁爐溫暖著。一座木製樓梯緊貼著西牆。

english: A {@creature thug} sits near the bottom of the stairs, engrossed in a saucy novella. If this guard detects intruders, he tries to run up the stairs to wake Guildmaster Dusk in {@area area G26|25b|x}.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature thug||暴徒}坐在樓梯底部，全神貫注地閱讀著一本辛辣的小說。如果這名守衛發現入侵者，他會試圖跑上樓梯去喚醒{@area 區域G26|25b|x}的公會會長達斯克。

english: G14: Upstairs Foyer
zh_tw: G14. 二樓門廳

english: This rectangular room has a door on every wall. A plaque on the west door says, "Private Rooms."
zh_tw: 這個長方形的房間每面牆上都有一扇門。西牆上的一塊牌子上寫著"私人房間"。

english: The north door leading to {@area area G19|244|x} is locked; the other doors are unlocked.
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域G19|244|x}的北門是鎖著的；其他門是開著的。

english: G15: L-Shaped Hall
zh_tw: G15. L形走廊

english: Wooden doors line the walls of this L-shaped hallway.
zh_tw: 這個L形的走廊兩邊的牆上排列著木門。

english: Closets
zh_tw: 盥洗室

english: The two small rooms to the north are closets behind unlocked doors. One stores a mop and broom, a few buckets, and a stack of copper chamber pots. The other has shelves holding linens, blankets, soap, and candles.
zh_tw: 北邊的兩個小房間是未上鎖的壁櫥。一個存放著拖把和掃帚、幾個水桶以及一疊銅製便壺。另一個則有架子，上面放著亞麻布、毯子、肥皂和蠟燭。

english: G16: Stablemaster's Quarters
zh_tw: G16. 馬廄管理員宿舍

english: This room belongs to the stablemaster, Laris Drot (neutral, human {@creature commoner}), who is a stout woman in her fifties. Laris carries two keys on her person: one unlocks the door to this room, and the other unlocks the doors to {@area area G7|227|x}.
zh_tw: 這個房間屬於馬廄管理員，拉里斯·德羅特（中立，人類{@creature commoner||平民}），她是一位五十多歲的健壯女性。拉里斯身上攜帶著兩把鑰匙：一把開啟這個房間的門，另一把開啟通往{@area 區域G7|227|x}的門。

english: A wooden trunk at the foot of Laris's bed contains folded clothing and personal effects.
zh_tw: 拉里斯床腳的木製箱子裡裝著摺疊好的衣服和個人物品。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: On a nightstand, next to a set of keys to the stables, is a coin pouch containing 5 gp, 13 sp, and 25 cp.
zh_tw: 在一張床頭櫃上，放著一套馬廄的鑰匙，旁邊是一個裝有5金幣、13銀幣和25銅幣的錢包。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If Laris is here when the stable hand in {@area area G2b|217|x} bangs his pail, Laris heads to the stables to find out what's going on. It takes her 1 minute to get there.
zh_tw: 如果拉里斯在這裡時，馬廄裡的馬伕在{@area 區域G2b|217|x}敲響他的桶，拉里斯會前往馬廄瞭解發生了什麼。她需要1分鐘才能到達那裡。

english: G17: Small Common Room
zh_tw: G17. 小公共休息室

english: This room stinks of horse manure due to its proximity to the stables. It contains two neatly made beds, two empty footlockers, and a nightstand with an oil-filled lantern hanging above it. Beneath each bed is a copper chamber pot.
zh_tw: 由於靠近馬廄，這個房間散發著馬糞的臭味。房間裡有兩張整潔的床、兩個空的行李箱，以及一個床頭櫃，上面掛著一個裝滿油的燈籠。每張床下都有一個銅製便壺。

english: G18: Large Common Room
zh_tw: G18. 大公共休息室

english: This room stinks of horse manure due to its proximity to the stables. It contains four neatly made beds, each with its own nightstand and empty footlocker. An oil-filled lantern rests atop each nightstand. Beneath each bed is a copper chamber pot.
zh_tw: 由於靠近馬廄，這個房間散發著馬糞的臭味。房間裡有四張整潔的床，每張床都有自己的床頭櫃和空的儲物箱。每個床頭櫃上都放著一盞裝滿油的燈籠。每張床下都有一個銅製的便盆。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: One of the lanterns is a {@item lantern of revealing}. No one in the guild is aware the lantern is magical.
zh_tw: 其中一盞燈籠是一件{@item lantern of revealing||顯像提燈}。公會裡沒有人知道這盞燈籠具有魔法。

english: G19. North Balcony
zh_tw: G19. 北陽臺

english: A wooden railing encloses this balcony. Mounted on one corner of the railing is a copper spyglass.
zh_tw: 一個木製欄杆圍繞著這個陽臺。欄杆的一個角落上裝有一個銅製望遠鏡。

english: A {@creature bandit} stationed atop this balcony watches for trouble coming from the north and west. If she sees anything suspicious or threatening, she shouts loud enough to put the rest of the guildhouse on high alert. This bandit carries a key that unlocks the door to {@area area G14|239|x}.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature bandit||匪徒}駐守在這個陽臺上，監視來自北方和西方的麻煩。如果她看到任何可疑或威脅的東西，她會大聲喊叫，使公會房的其餘部分進入高度警戒狀態。這個匪徒攜帶一把鑰匙，可以開啟{@area 區域G14|239|x}的門。

english: Spyglass
zh_tw: 望遠鏡

english: The {@item spyglass|PHB} attached to the balcony is missing one of its lenses and is nonfunctional.
zh_tw: 陽臺上掛著的{@item spyglass|PHB|望遠鏡}缺少一個鏡片，無法使用。

english: G20: Private Room
zh_tw: G20. 私人房間

english: This private room contains a bed, a nightstand, a footlocker, and a small fireplace. A small oil lamp, a pewter water pitcher, and two mugs rest on the nightstand. Sitting on the edge of the bed is a heavy man in a nightgown.
zh_tw: 這個私人房間內有一張床、一個床頭櫃、一個儲物箱和一個小壁爐。一個小油燈、一個錫制水壺和兩個杯子放在床頭櫃上。床邊坐著一個穿著睡衣的胖男人。

english: A traveling merchant named Thyval Horne (neutral, human {@creature commoner}) rents this room. On the nightstand rests a key that unlocks the door to this room. Beneath the bed is a copper chamber pot.
zh_tw: 一位名叫賽瓦爾·霍恩（中立，人類{@creature commoner||平民})的旅行商人租用了這個房間。床頭櫃上放著一把鑰匙，可以開啟這個房間的門。床下是一個銅製便壺。

english: Roleplaying Thyval
zh_tw: 扮演賽瓦爾

english: The merchant hasn't had a good night's sleep in days and quickly angers if disturbed. Characters who threaten Thyval or use magic to coerce him can pry the following information out of him:
zh_tw: 這位商人已經好幾天沒有好好睡過覺了，如果被打擾會很快生氣。如果角色威脅賽瓦爾或使用魔法強迫他，他們可以得知以下資訊：

english: Guildmaster Dusk is hosting an unscrupulous, well-connected noble named Dartinal Livereth. (Thyval suspects the two are lovers.)
zh_tw: 公會會長達斯克正在招待一個不擇手段、人脈廣泛的貴族名叫達提納爾·利維雷斯。（賽瓦爾懷疑這兩人是情人。）

english: Jaymont the Sinner, the guild's resident spy, is a master of disguise.
zh_tw: 罪人傑蒙特，公會的常駐間諜，是偽裝大師。

english: Thyval can't sleep because of the squawking birds in the room next door (area G21).
zh_tw: 賽瓦爾因為隔壁房間（區域 G21）裡鳥的尖叫聲而無法入睡。

english: G21: Gwish's Room
zh_tw: G21. 格威許的房間

english: The room contains a large bed, a sturdy trunk, a wooden nightstand, and a darkened fireplace. The windows here aren't boarded, and the window in the west wall is open slightly. In the middle of the room, an old man in an oversized black robe carefully removes a strip of parchment coiled around the leg of a raven while muttering kind words to the bird. Two more ravens watch from the rafters.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張大床、一個結實的箱子、一個木製床頭櫃和一個昏暗的壁爐。這裡的窗戶沒有被封閉，西牆上的窗戶微微敞開。在房間中央，一個穿著過大黑色長袍的老人正小心翼翼地從一隻烏鴉的腿上取下捲起的羊皮紙，同時對這隻鳥輕聲說些親切的話。另外兩隻烏鴉從樑上注視著。

english: The man is an {@creature oni} named Gwish. Guildmaster Dusk is the only other guild member who knows Gwish's true nature.
zh_tw: 這個男人是一個名叫格威許的{@creature oni||惡鬼}。公會長達斯克是唯一知道格威許真實身份的另一位公會成員。

english: Gwish is reclusive and rarely interacts with the other guild members. The oni has three {@creature Raven||ravens} that act as messengers, and it uses a {@item ring of animal influence} to speak with them. These ravens deliver secret messages to the guildmaster's spies abroad and receive similar messages from those spies.
zh_tw: 格威許性格孤僻，很少與其他公會成員交流。這個鬼有三個{@creature Raven||渡鴉}作為信使，它使用一個{@item ring of animal influence||影響動物戒指}與它們交流。這些烏鴉向國外的公會長間諜傳遞秘密資訊，並從那些間諜那裡接收類似的資訊。

english: If one or more characters interrupt the oni, it politely asks them to leave. If they refuse, it shoos away the ravens and attacks the characters. The oni's glaive leans in the northeast corner behind the door.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色打擾了鬼，它會禮貌地要求他們離開。如果他們拒絕，它會趕走烏鴉並攻擊這些角色。鬼的長柄武器靠在門後的東北角。

english: Gwish's Trunk
zh_tw: 格威許的箱子

english: When the oni is hungry, it sneaks from the guildhouse and invisibly preys on the city, feeding primarily on anyone sleeping outside. The trunk at the foot of Gwish's bed is filled with gnawed bones mixed with small bundles of torn clothing.
zh_tw: 當這個鬼餓的時候，它會悄悄地從公會房裡溜出去，在城市中隱形捕食，主要捕食那些睡在外面的人。格威許床腳的箱子裡裝滿了被啃過的骨頭，混雜著撕破的小捆衣物。

english: Master Key
zh_tw: 萬能鑰匙

english: One of the deep pockets on Gwish's robe contains a master key that unlocks all doors in the guildhouse.
zh_tw: 格威許的長袍上有一個深口袋，裡面裝有一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟公會房內所有的門。

english: Raven's Note
zh_tw: 烏鴉的便條

english: Gwish has received a note from one of Guildmaster Dusk's spies. The note is written in code on a slip of parchment, and only Guildmaster Dusk is authorized to read it. Gwish plans to deliver the message to Dusk once her guest leaves (see {@area area G26|25b|x}).
zh_tw: 格威許收到了公會長達斯克的一名間諜發來的便條。便條是用密碼寫在羊皮紙片上的，只有公會長達斯克有權閱讀它。格威許計劃在她的客人離開後（見{@area 區域G26|25b|x}）將資訊傳遞給達斯克。

english: A {@spell comprehend languages} spell can decipher the note, as can a character who succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check after studying the note for 1 minute. It reads, "Constantori in danger. Cognoscenti retaliation imminent. Be on high alert."
zh_tw: 一個{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}法術可以解讀這張便條，同樣地，一個角色在研究了便條1分鐘後，透過{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定也可以解讀。便條上寫著，"康斯坦托里處於危險之中。康諾森蒂的報復即將到來。保持高度警惕。"

english: G22: South Balcony
zh_tw: G22. 南陽臺

english: A wooden railing encloses this balcony. Mounted on one corner of the railing is a copper spyglass.
zh_tw: 一個木製欄杆圍繞著這個陽臺。欄杆的一個角落上裝有一個銅製望遠鏡。

english: A {@creature bandit} stationed atop this balcony watches for trouble coming from the south and east. If she sees anything suspicious or threatening, she shouts loud enough to put the rest of the guildhouse on high alert. This bandit carries keys that unlock the doors to areas {@area G23|252|x}, {@area G24|256|x}, and {@area G25|259|x}.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature bandit||匪徒}駐守在這個陽臺上，監視來自南方和東方的麻煩。如果她看到任何可疑或威脅的東西，她會大聲喊叫，使公會房的其餘部分進入高度警戒狀態。這個匪徒攜帶的鑰匙可以開啟{@area G23|252|x}、{@area G24|256|x}和{@area G25|259|x}區域的門。

english: Spyglass
zh_tw: 望遠鏡

english: The {@item spyglass|PHB}, which is damaged but functional, is worth 250 gp.
zh_tw: 這個{@item spyglass|PHB|望遠鏡}雖然損壞但仍然可以使用，價值250金幣。

english: G23: Stolen Goods
zh_tw: G23. 贓物

english: Deep scrapes crisscross the floor of this spacious room, and wood shavings scatter the perimeter. A string of oil lanterns dangles from the ceiling, suspended on block and tackle above several containers—mostly small casks and crates, although there's an earth-encrusted coffin here as well.
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的房間的地板上佈滿了深深的劃痕，木屑散落在四周。一串油燈從天花板上懸掛下來，懸掛在滑輪和繩索上方，下面有幾個容器——大多是小桶和板條箱，儘管這裡也有一具沾滿泥土的棺材。

english: Elix the Saint (lawful evil, human {@creature bandit captain}; see the "{@area Elix the Saint|201|x}" section earlier in the adventure) works here during the day. Armed with a crowbar, he examines containers stolen by the Agile Hand. He then records their contents (and the estimated value of those contents) in a leather-bound ledger.
zh_tw: 聖者埃利克斯（守序邪惡，人類{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}；見冒險早期的"{@area 聖徒埃利克斯|201|x}"部分）白天在這裡工作。他手持撬棍，檢查敏捷之手偷來的容器，然後他在一個皮革裝訂的賬簿中記錄它們的內容（以及這些內容的估計價值）。

english: Master Key
zh_tw: 萬能鑰匙

english: Elix carries a master key that unlocks all doors in the guildhouse complex.
zh_tw: 埃利克斯攜帶一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟公會房大樓內所有的門。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The following stolen goods are stored here:
zh_tw: 以下被盜物品存放在這裡：

english: Six casks of exquisite elven wine (250 gp each)
zh_tw: 六桶精緻的精靈葡萄酒（每桶250金幣）

english: Wooden chest containing six {@item Poisoner's Kit|PHB|poisoner's kits}
zh_tw: 一個木製箱子，內含六套{@item Poisoner's Kit|PHB|毒藥工具}

english: Wooden crate containing eight sets of {@item thieves' tools|PHB}
zh_tw: 一個木製板條箱，內含八套{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}

english: Wooden crate containing two {@item Spyglass|PHB|spyglasses} (1,000 gp each) packed in beds of straw
zh_tw: 一個木製板條箱，內含兩個{@item Spyglass|PHB|望遠鏡}（每個1000金幣），並用稻草墊著包裝

english: Dirty wooden coffin containing the moldy corpse of a human priest wearing a copper {@item holy symbol|PHB} shaped like the sun (25 gp), a sun-shaped death mask made of gold (250 gp), and a {@item necklace of prayer beads}
zh_tw: 一個髒汙的木製棺材，內含一個穿著銅製{@item holy symbol|PHB|聖徽}的腐爛人類牧師屍體，這個聖徽形狀像太陽（25金幣），一個用金子製成的太陽形狀的死亡面具（250金幣），以及一條{@item necklace of prayer beads||念珠項鍊}

english: G24: Elix's Office
zh_tw: G24. 埃利克斯的辦公室

english: This office contains a plain wooden desk, a simple chair, and a fireplace. A door in the south corner sports a plaque that says, "Private! Enter at your own risk."
zh_tw: 這個辦公室內有一個普通的木製辦公桌、一把簡單的椅子和一個壁爐。南角的門上掛著一個牌子，上面寫著"私人空間！擅自進入後果自負。"

english: A {@creature bandit} stands guard outside the door to Guildmaster Dusk's quarters ({@area area G26|25b|x}). The bandit's job is to shout at the first sign of trouble, thus alerting the guildmaster.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature bandit||匪徒}在公會長達斯克的住處門外（{@area 區域G26|25b|x}）站崗。匪徒的任務是在遇到麻煩的第一個跡象時大聲喊叫，以此提醒公會長。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: If the characters search the desk at night, they find a leather-bound ledger in an unlocked drawer, along with a writing quill and a jar of ink. The ledger provides an account of stolen goods acquired by the Agile Hand, but {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} is not among the items listed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在夜間搜查這張辦公桌，他們會在一個未上鎖的抽屜裡找到一個皮革裝訂的賬簿，還有一支羽毛筆和一瓶墨水。賬簿記錄了敏捷之手獲得的被盜物品的賬目，但{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}並未列在物品清單中。

english: A stealthy rogue tries to sneak upstairs without disturbing Guildmaster Dusk and her lover
zh_tw: 一個狡猾的盜賊試圖不打擾公會長達斯克和她的情人，悄悄地溜上樓。

english: G25: Shared Bedroom
zh_tw: G25. 共用臥室

english: Guild members take turns resting here. The room contains two beds, two nightstands, and two trunks (each one packed with linens). Tucked beneath each bed is a copper chamber pot. A hearth in the south corner keeps the room warm.
zh_tw: 公會成員輪流在這裡休息。房間裡有兩張床、兩個床頭櫃和兩個箱子（每個都裝滿了亞麻布）。每張床下都塞著一個銅製便壺。南角的壁爐使房間保持溫暖。

english: Sleeping Guards
zh_tw: 睡覺的守衛

english: Two {@creature Thug||thugs} sleep in the beds. They wake if disturbed and spend their first action scrambling for their weapons.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Thug||暴徒}睡在床上。如果被打擾，他們會醒來，並在第一時間尋找他們的武器。

english: G26: Dusk's Quarters
zh_tw: G26. 達斯克的住處

english: This circular room contains a canopied bed with a leather trunk at the foot of it and a fireplace. Wooden staircases hug the walls—one leading up, the other down. The scent of tobacco hangs in the air.
zh_tw: 這個圓形房間內有一張帶天篷的床，床腳有一個皮箱和一個壁爐。木製樓梯緊貼著牆壁——一個向上，另一個向下。空氣中瀰漫著菸草的香味。

english: Among the clutter on the guildmaster's desk is a diary that might contain a secret or two
zh_tw: 在公會會長的桌子上的雜物中，有一本日記，可能包含一兩個秘密

english: Unless she has been lured elsewhere, Guildmaster Dusk (lawful evil, half-elf {@creature assassin}) is asleep in bed with her lover, a politically influential noble named Dartinal Livereth (lawful evil, human {@creature noble}). Neither is wearing armor, but they keep their weapons within reach.
zh_tw: 除非她被引誘到其他地方，公會長達斯克（守序邪惡，半精靈{@creature assassin||刺客}）正和她的政治上有影響力的貴族情人，名叫達提納爾·利維雷斯（守序邪惡，人類{@creature noble||貴族}）一起在床上睡覺。兩人都沒有穿盔甲，但他們的武器都在手邊。

english: If the guildhouse is on high alert, Dusk leaves the room to find out what's happening. Meanwhile, Dartinal smokes a pipe in bed and waits for Dusk to return.
zh_tw: 如果公會房進入高度警戒狀態，達斯克會離開房間去了解發生了什麼。與此同時，達提納爾在床上抽著菸鬥，等待達斯克回來。

english: Fireplace
zh_tw: 壁爐

english: Resting on the fireplace mantel are a wedge of soap, a brush, a clay pipe, and an ivory tobacco jar carved in the shape of a skull. Buried in the ashes of the hearth is a spare {@item shortsword|PHB} covered with soot.
zh_tw: 壁爐架上放著一塊肥皂楔、一把刷子、一個陶製菸鬥，以及一個雕刻成骷髏形狀的象牙菸草罐。壁爐的灰燼裡埋著一把備用的{@item shortsword|PHB|短劍}，上面覆蓋著菸灰。

english: Leather Trunk
zh_tw: 皮箱

english: This trunk holds a spare, loaded {@item light crossbow|PHB} under some linens, bedding, and neatly folded outfits.
zh_tw: 這個箱子裡在一些亞麻布、床上用品和整齊摺疊的衣服下面，放著一把備用的、裝滿子彈的{@item light crossbow|PHB|輕弩}。

english: Master Key
zh_tw: 萬能鑰匙

english: Guildmaster Dusk keeps a master key on a nightstand next to her bed, and she takes it with her when she leaves the room. The key unlocks all doors in the guildhouse complex.
zh_tw: 公會長達斯克在床邊的床頭櫃上放了一把萬能鑰匙，當她離開房間時會帶上它。這把鑰匙可以開啟公會房大樓內所有的門。

english: G27: Tower Peak
zh_tw: G27. 塔頂

english: This room is situated at the top of the tower and is off limits to everyone except Guildmaster Dusk, who comes here to reflect, doodle in her diary, and gaze upon her latest acquisition: {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 這個房間位於塔樓的頂部，除了公會長達斯克之外，對所有人禁止入內。她來到這裡反思、在日記上塗鴉，並凝視她最新的收藏：{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}。

english: This tower chamber is lit by a pewter chandelier suspended from beams that support a conical roof. A cluttered writing desk and a padded chair are positioned opposite the descending staircase. A gold-framed painting of a beautiful, well-dressed man hangs in a shallow alcove near the top of the stairs.
zh_tw: 這個塔樓房間由懸掛在支撐著圓錐形屋頂的橫樑上的錫制吊燈照亮。一個雜亂的寫字檯和一把墊椅被放置在下樓梯的對面。樓梯頂部附近的一個淺凹處掛著一幅金框的畫像，畫中是一個穿著考究的英俊男子。

english: Characters who search the guildmaster's cluttered desk find sketches and descriptions of deadly mechanical traps, including a rough sketch of the trap in this room (see "Trap" below).
zh_tw: 搜查公會長雜亂的辦公桌的角色們發現了致命機械陷阱的草圖和描述，包括這個房間中陷阱的粗略草圖（見下面的"陷阱"）。

english: Constantori's Portrait
zh_tw: 康斯坦托里的肖像畫

english: The painting that hangs in the alcove is {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} (described at the end of the adventure). Guildmaster Dusk is attuned to the painting and has commanded it to defend itself against all creatures except her. As an action, a character can throw a sheet over the painting, making it unable to cast spells.
zh_tw: 掛在凹處的畫作是{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}（在冒險的末尾有描述）。公會長達斯克與這幅畫有共鳴，並命令它除了她之外，對所有生物進行自衛。作為一個動作，角色可以向畫作扔一張床單，使其無法施放法術。

english: The Cognoscenti Esoterica was wrong about one thing: Guildmaster Dusk has no intention of selling the painting. By learning its secrets, she hopes to become as notorious and wealthy as the late Daiyani Grysthorn, the crime lord who commissioned the painting in the first place.
zh_tw: 《知情者秘典》在一件事上弄錯了：公會長達斯克無意出售這幅畫。透過學習它的秘密，她希望變得和已故的犯罪領主戴亞尼·格里斯索恩一樣聲名狼藉和富有，戴亞尼·格里斯索恩最初委託了這幅畫。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: Canisters of poisonous gas are hidden in the wall behind the painting. Removing the painting from its hooks without first disabling the trap causes the gas to spew from tiny holes previously concealed by the painting. Each creature in the room when the gas is released must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@dice 8d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 裝有有毒氣體的罐子藏在畫作後面的牆裡。如果不先解除陷阱就將畫作從其掛鉤上取下，氣體會從之前被畫作掩蓋的小孔中噴出。當氣體釋放時，房間內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 14}的體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到36（{@dice 8d8}）點毒素傷害，若成功則傷害減半。

english: A character who searches the alcove for traps spots the holes behind the painting with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. This check is made with advantage if the character saw the trap's sketch in Dusk's diary. Once the trap is detected, a character can spend 1 minute trying to disable it, either by plugging the holes or by placing counterweights on the hooks as someone else carefully lifts the painting. The character trying to disable the trap must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, disabling the trap on a success and triggering the trap on a failure.
zh_tw: 一名角色在搜尋壁龕中的陷阱時，若成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，可以發現畫作後面的孔洞。如果該角色曾在達斯克日記中看到過陷阱的草圖，則此次檢定具有優勢。一旦發現陷阱，一名角色可以花費 1 分鐘時間嘗試解除它，方式可以是堵住孔洞，或者在其他人小心抬起畫作時在鉤子上放置配重。嘗試解除陷阱的角色必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，成功則解除陷阱，失敗則觸發陷阱。

english: G28: Cellar
zh_tw: G28. 地窖

english: This room lies at the bottom of a wooden staircase that climbs 15 feet to {@area area G6|225|x}. The cellar is unlit.
zh_tw: 這個房間位於一個木製樓梯的底部，樓梯上升15尺到達{@area 區域G6|225|x}。地窖沒有照明。

english: This dank cellar reeks of soured wine. Wooden trunks line the south wall, and a chamber to the east contains stacks of barrels and crates.
zh_tw: 這個潮溼的地窖散發著變質葡萄酒的氣味。南牆邊排列著木製箱子，東側的房間內堆放著成堆的木桶和板條箱。

english: The crates, barrels, and trunks are all empty.
zh_tw: 這些板條箱、木桶和箱子都是空的。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the south wall can't be opened from this side without magic (see {@area area G33|272|x} for details). It leads to area G33.
zh_tw: 南牆上的一個秘密門在沒有魔法的情況下無法從這一側開啟（詳見{@area 區域G33|272|x}）。它通向區域 G33。

english: Thieves' Test
zh_tw: 盜賊測試

english: The door leading to area G29 is unlocked and has the following note (handwritten in Common) tacked to it:
zh_tw: 通往區域 G29 的門沒有上鎖，門上貼著以下便條（用通用語手寫）：

english: Here are the rules. Look for keys and keyholes. Watch out for my pets. Follow the arrows, but don't let them hit you. Trust your ears, and remember: a little pressure can be a good thing. Get out alive. Remember, you wanted this. Good luck, grunt.—Dusk
zh_tw: 這裡是規則。尋找鑰匙和鑰匙孔。小心我的寵物。跟隨箭頭，但別讓它們打中你。相信你的耳朵，並記住：一點壓力可能是好事。活著出來。記住，這是你想要的。祝你好運，小兵。——達斯克

english: Areas {@area G29|269|x}–{@area G33|272|x} contain challenges that are meant to test thieves who want to join the guild. The note is meant for those applicants, but characters would be wise to heed its advice:
zh_tw: 區域{@area G29|269|x}至{@area G33|272|x}包含了旨在考驗想要加入公會的盜賊的挑戰。便條是為了那些申請者準備的，但角色們最好聽從其建議：

english: "Look for keys and keyholes" and "Watch out for my pets" refer to challenges in area G29.
zh_tw: "尋找鑰匙和鑰匙孔"和"小心我的寵物"指的是區域 G29 中的挑戰。

english: "Follow the arrows, but don't let them hit you" refers to the set-up in {@area area G31|26d|x}.
zh_tw: "跟隨箭頭，但別讓它們打中你"指的是在{@area 區域G31|26d|x}中的設定。

english: "Trust your ears" and "A little pressure can be a good thing" speak to areas {@area G32|270|x} and {@area G33|272|x}.
zh_tw: "相信你的耳朵"和"一點壓力可能是好事"分別指的是區域{@area G32|270|x}和{@area G33|272|x}中的挑戰。

english: G29: Murky Pool
zh_tw: G29. 昏暗水池

english: A ten-foot-square pool of murky water occupies most of this unlit room. A narrow ledge surrounds the pool, and a chalk-drawn arrow on the east wall points down.
zh_tw: 這個沒有照明的房間裡，一個十尺見方的渾濁水池佔據了大部分空間。水池周圍有一條狹窄的邊緣，東牆上用粉筆畫了一個指向下方的箭頭。

english: The pool is 10 feet deep, and the murky water reduces underwater visibility to 0 feet. Characters can find the way to area G30 by exploring the pool:
zh_tw: 這個水池深10尺，渾濁的水質使得水下能見度降為0尺。角色可以透過探索水池找到通往區域 G30 的路徑：

english: Pool Floor
zh_tw: 水池底部

english: A nonmagical silver key rests on the floor of the pool. A character submerged in the pool can take an action to feel around its floor, finding the key with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 一把非魔法的銀鑰匙靜靜地躺在水池的底部。浸沒在水池中的角色可以採取一個動作來摸索底板，透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定找到這把鑰匙。

english: Pool Walls
zh_tw: 游泳池牆壁

english: The east wall of the pool has a tiny keyhole in the middle of it. A character submerged in the pool can take an action to search the pool's walls, finding the keyhole with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 水池的東牆中央有一個小鑰匙孔。一個浸入水池的角色可以用一個動作搜尋池壁，透過一次成功的{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定找到鑰匙孔。

english: Secret Exit
zh_tw: 秘密出口

english: If the pool's silver key is inserted into the pool's keyhole, a section of the pool's east wall retracts, revealing a 4-foot-high, 4-foot-wide, flooded tunnel containing a {@creature swarm of quippers}. The swarm attacks the nearest prey. A character who swims to the far end of the tunnel and feels around for an exit finds an unlocked trapdoor in the ceiling that pops open to reveal a dry, T-shaped chamber (area G30) and a passageway leading south ({@area area G31|26d|x}).
zh_tw: 如果將游泳池的銀鑰匙插入池壁的鑰匙孔，游泳池東牆的一部分將會收回，露出一個4尺高、4尺寬、被水淹沒的隧道，裡面含有一群{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}。這群食人魚會攻擊最近的獵物。一個角色如果游到隧道的盡頭並摸索尋找出口，會發現天花板上一個未上鎖的活板門，推開它將露出一個乾燥的T形房間（區域G30）和一條通往南方的通道（{@area 區域G31|26d|x}）。

english: Light Sources
zh_tw: 光源

english: Characters who don't have {@sense darkvision} must find a way to keep their light sources dry, or else they could end up fumbling in the dark until their light sources dry out.
zh_tw: 沒有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}的角色必須找到方法保持他們的光源乾燥，否則他們可能會在黑暗中摸索，直到他們的光源乾燥。

english: G30: Trapdoor
zh_tw: G30. 活板門

english: This unlit, T-shaped area is empty except for a wooden trapdoor in the floor. A tunnel (area G31) leads south from here.
zh_tw: 這個沒有照明的T形區域除了地板上的一個木製活板門外什麼也沒有。一個隧道（區域G31）從這裡向南延伸。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: Below the trapdoor is a 4-foot-wide, 4-foot-high tunnel filled with murky water and a hungry {@creature swarm of quippers} (see area G29 for details). Characters who follow this tunnel west come to a dead end unless they previously opened that end of tunnel in area G29.
zh_tw: 活板門下面是一條4尺寬、4尺高的隧道，裡面充滿了渾濁的水和一群飢餓的{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}（詳見區域G29）。角色如果沿著這條隧道向西走，會來到一個死衚衕，除非他們之前在區域G29開啟了隧道的那一端。

english: G31: Follow the Arrows
zh_tw: G31. 跟隨箭頭

english: Characters who have {@sense darkvision} or a light source can see the following:
zh_tw: 擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源的角色可以看到以下情景：

english: Chalk arrows drawn on the floor point toward the south end of this narrow corridor. Arrow slits are evenly spaced along the walls.
zh_tw: 地板上畫著指向這個狹窄走廊南端的粉筆箭頭。箭縫沿著牆壁均勻分佈。

english: The arrow slits are too narrow for a Small or larger character to squeeze or crawl through. Behind the arrow slits are two closed-off chambers—one to the west and one to the east. A character who has {@sense darkvision} or a light source can peer through nearby arrow slits to see what each closed-off area contains: five freestanding human skeletons draped in cobwebs and clutching shortbows. Most of these skeletons are inanimate, propped-up dummies made to look threatening. Each one is a Medium object with AC 15, 4 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 箭縫太窄，無法讓一個小型或更大的角色擠過或爬過。箭縫後面是兩個被封閉的房間——一個在西邊，一個在東邊。擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源的角色可以透過附近的箭縫窺視，看看每個封閉區域包含什麼：五個獨立的人類骷髏，身上披著蜘蛛網，握著短弓。這些骷髏大多數是無生命的，是支撐起來的假人，看起來具有威脅性。每一個都是一箇中型物體，具有AC 15，4點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Only two {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} are animated, and they guard the hallway's midpoint. When a character enters the square marked T on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}, one animated skeleton uses its reaction (if available) to make a Shortbow attack, targeting that character. The character can make a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to tumble out of the way; if the check is successful, the skeleton has disadvantage on its attack roll.
zh_tw: 只有兩個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}被活化，它們守衛著走廊的中間點。當角色進入{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}上標有 T 的方格時，一個活化的骷髏會使用其反應（如果可用）進行一次短弓攻擊，目標為該角色。角色可以進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定以翻滾避開；如果檢定成功，骷髏的攻擊擲骰將處於劣勢。

english: If a character somehow gains access to one of the closed-off chambers, perhaps by shrinking to Tiny size or by assuming a gaseous form, the animated skeleton in that area stops guarding the hallway and instead attacks that character.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色以某種方式進入了其中一個封閉的房間，也許是透過縮小到微型尺寸或採取氣態形態，那個區域的活化骷髏將停止守衛走廊，轉而攻擊那個角色。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door at the south end of the hallway is unlocked and can be pushed open to reveal a tunnel leading to area G32.
zh_tw: 走廊南端的一扇秘密門沒有上鎖，可以推開以露出通往區域G32的隧道。

english: G32: Eastern Maze
zh_tw: G32. 東方迷宮

english: Characters who have {@sense darkvision} or a light source can see the following:
zh_tw: 擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源的角色可以看到以下情景：

english: Branches in the tunnel ahead suggest you're entering some sort of maze. You hear the sounds of heavy breathing coming from somewhere ahead.
zh_tw: 前方隧道中的分支表明你正在進入某種迷宮。你聽到了來自前方某處的沉重呼吸聲。

english: Permanent {@spell minor illusion} spells create the sounds of heavy breathing. These sounds originate in the two spaces marked T on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check can track the sounds to their points of origin. A character who enters one of these squares steps on a pressure plate that sinks 1 inch into the floor and remains in that position for 1 minute before resetting itself. A character who searches that section of floor before stepping on it must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the check is successful, the character spots the pressure plate and can avoid it. If the characters depress the two pressure plates here along with the one in G33, the north secret door in area G33 swings open.
zh_tw: 永久的{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}法術會產生沉重呼吸的聲音。這些聲音源自於{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}上標記為 T 的兩個區域。任何成功透過{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色都可以追蹤聲音的來源。進入其中一個方塊的角色會踩到一個壓力板，壓力板會下沉 1 吋並保持這個位置 1 分鐘，然後重置。在踏入該區域前搜尋地板的角色必須進行一個{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到壓力板並可以避開它。如果角色在這裡的兩個壓力板以及 G33 區域的一個壓力板都被觸發，G33 區域的北側密門將開啟。

english: G33: Western Maze
zh_tw: G33. 西部迷宮

english: This maze is like the one in area G32, right down to the heavy breathing. The square marked T on {@adventure map 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map} contains a hidden pressure plate on the floor identical to the ones in area G32.
zh_tw: 這個迷宮和區域G32中的迷宮一樣，包括沉重的呼吸聲。在{@adventure 地圖 6.2|KftGV|6|Map 6.2: DM's map}上標記為T的方格包含了一個與區域G32中相同的隱藏壓力板。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: This maze contains two secret doors, one to the north and the other to the west:
zh_tw: 這個迷宮包含兩扇秘密門，一扇在北邊，另一扇在西邊：

english: North Secret Door
zh_tw: 北秘密門

english: This secret door has three separate locks built into it. If all three pressure plates in the maze (the one in this area and the two in area G32) are in their sunken positions, the door unlocks and swings open on its own, revealing {@area area G28|264|x} beyond. Otherwise, each of the door's three locks requires a separate {@spell knock} spell or similar magic to bypass. The locks are hidden and can't be picked.
zh_tw: 這扇秘密門內建有三個獨立的鎖。如果迷宮中的所有三個壓力板（這個區域中的一個和區域G32中的兩個）都處於下沉位置，門就會自動解鎖並開啟，露出另一邊的{@area 區域G28|264|x}。否則，門上的每個鎖都需要分別使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法來繞過。這些鎖是隱藏的，無法被撬開。

english: West Secret Door
zh_tw: 西秘密門

english: This secret door is unlocked and pushes open to reveal area G34 beyond.
zh_tw: 這扇秘密門是開著的，推開它可以看到另一邊的區域G34。

english: G34: Cell Block
zh_tw: G34. 牢房區

english: Characters who have {@sense darkvision} or a light source can see the following:
zh_tw: 擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或光源的角色可以看到以下情景：

english: Vertical iron bars stretch from floor to ceiling, dividing this room into six cells. The two southernmost cells have wooden barrels and trunks in them, while the cell in the northern corner contains a scruffy-looking prisoner.
zh_tw: 垂直的鐵欄杆從地板延伸到天花板，將這個房間分成了六個小隔間。最南邊的兩個隔間裡有木桶和箱子，而東北角的隔間裡關著一個看起來蓬頭垢面的囚犯。

english: All the cell doors are locked, and a secret door connects the cell block to area G33.
zh_tw: 所有的牢房門都是鎖著的，一扇秘密門連線著牢房區和區域G33。

english: G34a: Smugglers' Barrels
zh_tw: G34a. 走私者的桶

english: This cell contains four wooden barrels that have padded interiors and air tubes for breathing. The thieves use these barrels for smuggling people.
zh_tw: 這個隔間裡裝有四個內部有襯墊和用於呼吸的空氣管的木桶。盜賊們用這些桶來走私人口。

english: G34b: Smugglers' Trunks
zh_tw: G34b. 走私者的箱子

english: Three iron-bound trunks rest against the back wall of this cell. The chests have padded interiors and air tubes for breathing. Like the barrels in the adjoining cell, these trunks are used for smuggling people.
zh_tw: 三個帶鐵箍的箱子靠在這個隔間的後牆上。這些箱子內部有襯墊和用於呼吸的空氣管。和隔壁隔間的桶一樣，這些箱子被用來走私人口。

english: G34c: Prison Cells
zh_tw: G34c. 監獄牢房

english: Each of these cells contains a wooden bench and a small drain hole in the floor.
zh_tw: 這些牢房每個都包含一條木凳和地板上的一個小排水孔。

english: Imprisoned in the northernmost cell is a thief named Dury Sneeth (neutral evil, human {@creature spy}), who was caught taking a bribe from a member of the Velvet Glove, a rival thieves' guild. After he was rightly accused of spying for the Velvet Glove, Dury was locked up and interrogated. He found a dagger hidden behind one of the bricks in the wall of his cell, and he keeps it hidden on his person. He has no other weapons.
zh_tw: 被關在最北邊的牢房裡的是一名名叫杜裡·斯尼思（中立邪惡，人類{@creature spy||間諜}），他因收受來自天鵝絨手套——一個敵對的盜賊公會的成員的賄賂而被抓住。在被正確地指控為天鵝絨手套從事間諜活動後，杜裡被關押並受到審訊。他在牢房牆壁的一塊磚後面找到了一把匕首，並一直藏在身上。他沒有其他武器。

english: Guildmaster Dusk is satisfied that Dury is guilty of betraying the Agile Hand, but she hasn't gotten around to punishing him yet and has, in fact, told Dury that she's willing to give him a second chance if he behaves himself from now on. Dury is not convinced Dusk has his best interests at heart and pleads for release.
zh_tw: 公會會長達斯克確信杜裡背叛了敏捷之手，但她還沒有對他進行懲罰，實際上，她告訴杜裡，如果他從現在起表現得好，她願意給他第二次機會。杜裡不相信達斯克真的關心他的最佳利益，並懇求獲釋。

english: G35: Storage Room
zh_tw: G35. 儲藏室

english: Lining two walls of this room are four wooden crates and four wooden chests.
zh_tw: 這個房間的兩面牆上排列著四個木製板條箱和四個木製箱子。

english: The crates contain stolen weapons and ammunition: ten {@item Scimitar|PHB|scimitars}, twelve {@item Light Crossbow|PHB|light crossbows}, five {@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|heavy crossbows}, and hundreds of {@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|crossbow bolts}. The chests are filled with ordinary cutlery, candlesticks, plates, pitchers, and mugs.
zh_tw: 這些箱子裡裝有被盜的武器和彈藥：十把{@item Scimitar|PHB|彎刀}，十二把{@item Light Crossbow|PHB|輕弩}，五把{@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|重弩}，以及數百支{@item Crossbow Bolts (20)|PHB|弩矢}。箱子裡裝滿了普通的餐具、燭臺、盤子、水壺和杯子。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: One of the chests has a secret compartment, which a character searching the chest can find with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The secret compartment contains six pieces of costume jewelry (5 gp each), a gold necklace with a black pearl pendant (750 gp), and a {@item necklace of fireballs}.
zh_tw: 其中一個箱子有一個秘密隔間，搜尋箱子的角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定找到它。秘密隔間內含六件舞臺珠寶（每件價值5 gp）、一條帶有黑珍珠吊墜的金項鍊（價值750 gp）以及一個 {@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}。

english: G36: Storage Room
zh_tw: G36. 儲藏室

english: This room is mostly empty except for a small wooden crate shoved in a corner next to a paper-wrapped block of butter.
zh_tw: 這個房間大部分是空的，除了角落裡塞著一個小木箱，旁邊是一塊用紙包著的黃油。

english: The crate is a {@creature mimic} that loves the taste of salted butter. To keep the mimic on friendly terms, Guildmaster Dusk brings it a fresh block of salted butter every few days. The mimic attacks any character who tries to steal the block of butter but otherwise prefers to be left alone. The mimic can carry on conversations in Common.
zh_tw: 這個箱子是一個{@creature mimic||擬身怪}，它非常喜歡鹹黃油的味道。為了和擬身怪保持友好關係，公會會長達斯克每隔幾天就會給它帶來一塊新鮮的鹹黃油。擬身怪會攻擊任何試圖偷走黃油的角色，但除此之外，它更願意被單獨留下。擬身怪可以用通用語進行對話。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Hidden in the room's south corner is a secret door that swings open into area G37.
zh_tw: 隱藏在房間南角的是一個秘密門，它向G37區域敞開。

english: G37: Secret Tunnel
zh_tw: G37. 秘密隧道

english: This tunnel has a secret door at one end and a 15-foot-tall ladder at the opposite end. The ladder climbs to a stone trapdoor in the ceiling that leads to {@area area G12|233|x}. A character at the top of the ladder can try to push open the trapdoor, doing so with a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check; the check is made with disadvantage if the blue chair in area G12 is weighing down the trapdoor.
zh_tw: 這個隧道的一端有一扇秘密門，另一端有一個15尺高的梯子。梯子通向天花板上的石制活板門，通往 {@area 區域G12|233|x}。在梯子頂端的角色可以嘗試推開活板門，需要進行一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定；如果區域G12的藍色椅子壓在活板門上，則檢定帶有劣勢。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: If the characters return {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} to Adrisa Carimorte, she gives them their promised reward. If they also present Elix the Saint's leather-bound ledger (see areas {@area G23|252|x} and {@area G24|256|x}), Adrisa offers to buy it for 500 gp.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}歸還給阿德莉莎·卡里莫特，她會給他們承諾的獎勵。如果他們還出示了聖徒埃利克斯的皮革裝訂賬簿（見區域{@area G23|252|x}和{@area G24|256|x}），阿德莉莎願意以500金幣購買它。

english: If the characters deciphered the coded message delivered by Gwish's raven (see {@area area G21|24a|x}) and share the message with Adrisa, she suspects one of Guildmaster Dusk's spies has infiltrated the Cognoscenti Esoterica. She thanks the characters for the information and gives them a pair of {@item sending stones} as an added reward. Identifying the spy is beyond the scope of this adventure but a good hook for a future one.
zh_tw: 如果角色們破譯了格威許的烏鴉傳遞的編碼資訊（見{@area 區域G21|24a|x}）並與阿德莉莎分享了這條資訊，她會懷疑公會會長達斯克的一個間諜已經滲透進了祕學智者會。她感謝角色們提供的資訊，並給他們一對{@item sending stones||短訊石}作為額外的獎勵。識別這個間諜超出了這次冒險的範圍，但為未來的冒險提供了一個很好的鉤子。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, Adrisa Carimorte arranges to give the characters a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment for delivering the painting to her. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，阿德莉莎·卡里莫特會安排給他們一件他們選擇的稀有魔法物品（需經你批准）作為將畫作交付給她的報酬。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: Magic Item
zh_tw: 魔法物品

english: This section presents {@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV} as a magic item. In your campaign, the artist might have painted other magical portraits of Constantori, perhaps with slight differences to distinguish them.
zh_tw: 這一節將{@item Constantori's Portrait|KftGV|康斯坦托里的肖像畫}呈現為一件魔法物品。在您的戰役中，藝術家可能還畫了其他康斯坦托里的魔法肖像，或許有細微的差別來區分它們。

english: Axe from the Grave
zh_tw: 墳墓之斧

english: {@i An Adventure for 6th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合6級角色的冒險}

english: Famed bard Froderic Dartwild is dead, and his beautiful mandolin, called Golden Axe, has been stolen from his grave. Even worse, Froderic has risen as a zombie, terrifying the hamlet of Toadhop. In this heist, the characters must track down Golden Axe from the music school owner who stole it and return it to Froderic so the bard can rest peacefully in death once again.
zh_tw: 著名的吟遊詩人弗羅德里克·達特維爾德已經去世，他那把美麗的曼陀林，名為金斧，被人從他的墳墓中偷走了。更糟糕的是，弗羅德里克變成了殭屍，嚇壞了蟾蜍跳躍的小鎮。在這次劫案中，角色們必須從偷走金斧的音樂學校老闆那裡追蹤到它，並將樂器歸還給弗羅德里克，以便這位吟遊詩人能夠再次在死後安息。

english: A chasme demon aims to thwart a bard's bold escape from Skalderang Conservatory
zh_tw: 一個喀嘶魔企圖破壞一位吟遊詩人從斯考德蘭音樂學院大膽的逃脫計劃。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: Froderic Dartwild—Frody to those who knew him well—was a gifted human bard born and raised in the hamlet of Toadhop. He could play the mandolin by age three and performed regularly at Toadhop's local tavern until his eighteenth year, when he left this bucolic backwater and became an adventurer. But his adventuring exploits paled in comparison to his reputation as a performer. So gifted a musician was he that an admiring wizard gave Frody an {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||instrument of the bards}—a famous Canaith mandolin called Golden Axe. The mandolin's magic served Frody well during his many adventures but wasn't enough to save his life. On a crisp autumn day, Frody and his companions were beset by manticores on a lonely stretch of road, and Frody was killed by a manticore's tail spike.
zh_tw: 弗羅德里克·達特維爾德——親近的人都叫他弗羅迪——是一個在蟾跳鎮出生長大的有天賦的人類吟遊詩人。他在三歲時就能彈奏曼陀林，並在蟾蜍跳躍的當地酒館定期演出，直到十八歲時，他離開了這個寧靜的鄉村，成為了一名冒險家。但他的冒險事蹟與他作為表演者的聲譽相比黯然失色。他是一位如此有天賦的音樂家，以至於一位欽佩他的法師贈予了弗羅迪一把{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||吟遊詩人樂器}——一把名為金斧的著名卡納伊特曼陀林。這把曼陀林的魔法在弗羅迪的許多冒險中都發揮了作用，但並不足以挽救他的生命。在一個秋高氣爽的日子，弗羅迪和他的同伴們在一條荒涼的道路上被一群蠍尾獅圍攻，弗羅迪被蠍尾獅的尾部尖刺殺死。

english: Frody's body was returned to Toadhop and laid to rest in the earth next to his mother, Veena, and his sister, Marigold. Golden Axe was buried with him. Shortly after Frody was interred, a tiefling named {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV}, who lived many miles away, learned of the famous bard's untimely death.
zh_tw: 弗羅迪的遺體被送回蟾跳鎮，安葬在他母親維娜和妹妹金盞花的旁邊。金斧也隨他一同被埋葬。弗羅迪下葬不久後，一個名叫{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}的提夫林得知了這位著名吟遊詩人早逝的訊息，他住在許多英里之外。

english: Sythian had inherited his parents' estate and debts, but a mysterious poison killed off the family's olive orchard, leaving him with nothing but the mansion and its furnishings. Those furnishings included a multitude of musical instruments Sythian's parents had bought in the hopes of making him a musical prodigy. While he excelled at none of the instruments, he realized he could pay off his family's debts by turning his home into a conservatory for young musicians from wealthy families. One of his current students, Wylie van Timmel, shows great promise. Sythian hatched a plan to snatch Golden Axe from Frody's grave and give it to Wylie as a present, hoping to earn the favor and long-term financial support of her wealthy family.
zh_tw: 西提安繼承了父母的遺產和債務，但一種神秘的毒藥殺死了家裡的橄欖園，讓他除了豪宅和其中的傢俱外一無所有。這些傢俱中包括了父母為了讓他成為音樂神童而購買的眾多樂器。雖然西提安在這些樂器上都沒有表現出色，但他意識到他可以透過將自己的家變成一個音樂學院，為來自富裕家庭的年輕音樂家提供培訓，來償還家庭的債務。他目前的一名學生，懷利·范·提梅爾，展現出了巨大的潛力。西提安策劃了一個計劃，從弗羅迪的墳墓中偷走金斧，並將其作為禮物送給懷利，希望以此贏得她富裕家庭的青睞和長期財政支援。

english: Sythian hired a pair of halflings named Mackerel Mudbottom and Trout Bonanza to dig up Frody's remains and pry the Canaith mandolin from his hands. They did just that, leaving behind an open grave. After the halflings fled with the mandolin, Frody awakened, crawled from his coffin, shambled to his mother's old cabin, and knocked on the door. The young family living there fled in terror at the sight of him and took shelter in a neighbor's barn. The good folks of Toadhop have been on edge ever since.
zh_tw: 西提安僱傭了一對名叫鯖魚·泥底和鱒魚·寶礦的半身人，去挖掘弗羅迪的遺骸並從他手中撬出凱納斯曼陀林。他們確實這麼做了，留下了一個敞開的墳墓。半身人帶著曼陀林逃跑後，弗羅迪甦醒過來，從棺材裡爬出來，蹣跚地走到他母親的舊小屋，敲了敲門。住在那裡的年輕家庭在看到他時驚恐地逃跑，並在鄰居的穀倉裡尋求庇護。從此以後，蟾跳鎮的善良居民就一直處於緊張狀態。

english: The characters arrive in Toadhop and quickly discover that someone has disturbed the grave of a famous bard named Froderic Dartwild and that Frody's corpse is "none too happy about it." Locals ask the characters to speak with Frody, who is holed up in a cabin on the outskirts of the hamlet. From Frody's zombified corpse, the characters learn that the stolen mandolin is called Golden Axe. They also learn the identities of the grave robbers who stole the mandolin, as Frody's restless spirit heard the halflings refer to each other by name before they inadvertently animated his corpse. Frody refuses to return to his grave until the mandolin is returned to him.
zh_tw: 角色們抵達蟾跳鎮，並很快發現有人擾亂了一位名叫弗羅德里克·達特維爾德的著名吟遊詩人的墳墓，而弗羅迪的屍體對此"並不高興"。當地人請求角色們與弗羅迪交談，他正躲在小鎮郊區的一間小屋中。從弗羅迪的殭屍化屍體那裡，角色們得知被盜的曼陀林叫做金斧。他們還瞭解到偷墓賊的身份，因為弗羅迪不安分的靈魂聽到了半身人們在無意中活化他的屍體之前互相稱呼對方的名字。弗羅迪拒絕回到他的墳墓，除非曼陀林被歸還給他。

english: If the characters agree to retrieve the mandolin, they find Mackerel and Trout at their riverside abode, five miles from Toadhop. The two halflings reveal that their employer, {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV}, has Golden Axe in his possession and plans to give it to one of his students. Stealing Golden Axe from Skalderang Conservatory forms the crux of this adventure. Ideally, at least one character in the party should be a bard.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意取回曼陀林，他們會在距離蟾跳鎮五英里的河畔住所找到鯖魚和鱒魚。這兩個半身人透露，他們的僱主{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}擁有金斧，並計劃將它贈予他的一名學生。從斯考德蘭音樂學院偷走金斧構成了這次冒險的核心。理想情況下，至少隊伍中的一個角色應該是吟遊詩人。

english: The hamlet of Toadhop can be situated in any countryside. Skalderang Conservatory stands in the middle of a dead olive orchard on the outskirts of a city that's about two days' travel from Toadhop on horseback.
zh_tw: 蟾跳鎮的小村莊可以位於任何鄉村。斯考德蘭音樂學院位於一個死寂的橄欖園中，這個橄欖園位於一個城市郊區，從蟾跳鎮騎馬大約需要兩天的旅程。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. A Canaith mandolin has been stolen from the grave of a famous bard, whose spirit remains restless from the injustice. The Golden Vault wants the instrument returned to its proper owner. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to travel to the village of Toadhop. Details will reveal themselves to you shortly after your arrival. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。一把卡納伊特曼陀林從一個著名吟遊詩人的墳墓中被盜，其精神因不公正而無法安息。金庫希望這件樂器能歸還給它的合法所有者。這個任務，如果你們選擇承擔，需要你們前往蟾跳鎮。到達後不久，細節將向你們顯現。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Toadhop
zh_tw: 蟾跳鎮

english: The rustic hamlet of Toadhop boasts a population of thirty—all hardworking folk. Two local establishments cater to visitors: a ramshackle inn called Misty's Bunks and a quaint tavern called My Left Boot. Toadhop's honorary mayor, a brown sow named Jenna Bean, pays visits to the tavern to greet strangers. To dispel any doubts concerning Jenna Bean's role in Toadhop, the hamlet's cheery tavernkeeper, Huberta Hadley, uses white paint to write the word "Mayor" on the friendly sow's flanks.
zh_tw: 蟾跳鎮這個質樸的小村莊擁有三十位勤勞的居民。兩個當地的場所為遊客提供服務：一個破舊的客棧叫做米絲蒂床鋪旅店，和一個古色古香的小酒館叫做我的左靴。蟾跳鎮的名譽市長是一隻名叫珍娜·比恩的棕色母豬，她經常去小酒館問候陌生人。為了消除對珍娜·比恩在蟾跳鎮角色的任何疑慮，這個小村莊熱情的酒館老闆休伯塔·哈德利用白色油漆在這隻友好的母豬的側腹上寫下了"市長"這個詞。

english: Frody Dartwild
zh_tw: 弗羅迪·達特維爾德

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to begin the adventure:
zh_tw: 閱讀或改述以下框內文字以開始冒險：

english: Froderic Dartwild, a famous bard born and raised in Toadhop, is all anyone in the hamlet can talk about. You've already met Toadhop's honorary mayor: a friendly sow named Jenna Bean. You've also seen the frightened, troubled looks on the faces of the simple, hard-working folk who inhabit this rustic thorp.
zh_tw: 弗羅德里克·達特維爾德，一個在蟾跳鎮出生並長大的著名吟遊詩人，是這個小村莊裡每個人談論的焦點。您已經見過蟾跳鎮的名譽市長：一隻友好的名叫珍娜·比恩的母豬。您也看到了這個質樸村莊裡簡單、勤勞的居民們臉上的驚恐和憂慮的表情。

english: You see, Frody died almost a month ago. Everyone in town attended his funeral. Now, he's crawled from his grave and returned to the cabin where he was born and where he spent his childhood. The family that owns the cabin now is out of sorts, to say the least. The family that lives there—a father, a mother, and their three daughters—is staying with neighbors until this grave matter is resolved.
zh_tw: 你看，弗羅迪幾乎一個月前去世了。鎮上每個人都參加了他的葬禮。現在，他從墳墓裡爬出來，回到了他出生並度過童年的小木屋。現在擁有這個小木屋的家庭至少可以說是心煩意亂。住在那兒的家庭——一個父親，一個母親，以及他們的三個女兒——正在鄰居家暫住，直到這個嚴重的問題得到解決。

english: The good folk of Toadhop would like it very much if you, being adventurers, could pay a visit to the old Dartwild cabin and find out why Toadhop's most famous bard has returned from the dead. The sooner he stops stinking up the place, the sooner he can be laid to rest—again.
zh_tw: 蟾跳鎮的善良居民非常希望你們，作為冒險者，能夠訪問老達特維爾德小木屋，查明為什麼蟾跳鎮最著名的吟遊詩人從死亡中回來了。他越早停止散發惡臭，他就能越早再次安息。

english: If the characters wish to help Frody and the people of Toadhop, they can get directions to the old Dartwild cabin and check it out. Four unkempt youths led by a rabble-rouser named Ebbin Fulchre spot the characters as they make their way to the Dartwild cabin and follow them, curious to see what happens next.
zh_tw: 如果角色們希望幫助弗羅迪和蟾跳鎮的居民，他們可以獲得前往達特維爾德舊木屋的指引並去一探究竟。當他們前往達特維爾德木屋時，會被由名為埃賓·富爾徹的煽動者帶領的四名邋遢青年發現並尾隨，這些年輕人好奇接下來會發生什麼。

english: The Old Dartwild Cabin
zh_tw: 老達特維爾德小木屋

english: As the characters approach the cabin, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近小屋時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: The front door of the cabin is wide open, and a rotten stench emanates from it. A noise behind you signals the arrival of four clumsy local youths, who keep their distance from the cabin once they catch a whiff of something unnatural.
zh_tw: 小屋的前門大開著，一股腐爛的惡臭從裡面散發出來。你身後的一陣響動預示著四個笨拙的當地年輕人的到來，他們一聞到不自然的氣味就與小屋保持了距離。

english: "Dang if they ain't goin' inside!" exclaims one youth.
zh_tw: "天哪，他們不會是想進去吧！"一個年輕人驚呼道。

english: "Shut up, or Frody might hear you!" hisses another.
zh_tw: "閉嘴，不然弗羅迪可能會聽到你！"另一個人低聲警告。

english: Ebbin Fulchre and his three companions are unarmed {@creature Commoner||commoners} who refuse to enter the cabin, even on a dare. Morbid curiosity brought them here, but they're nothing more than harmless spectators.
zh_tw: 埃賓·福爾克和他的三個同伴是手無寸鐵的{@creature Commoner||平民}，他們拒絕進入小屋，即使是在挑戰下。病態的好奇心把他們帶到了這裡，但他們不過是無害的旁觀者。

english: When the characters enter the cabin, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入小屋時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: The cabin is full of buzzing flies. Seated in a dark corner behind a rickety kitchen table is what's attracting the flies: a putrid human corpse with yellow eyes. In a raspy voice, the creature says, "Well met. My name is Froderic Dartwild. My friends call me Frody."
zh_tw: 小屋裡面滿是嗡嗡作響的蒼蠅。在一個昏暗的角落裡，坐在搖搖欲墜的廚房桌後的正是吸引蒼蠅的東西：一具眼睛發黃的腐爛人類屍體。這個生物用嘶啞的聲音說：'幸會。我叫弗羅德里克·達特維爾德。我的朋友們叫我弗羅迪。'

english: {@creature Frody Dartwild|KftGV} is neutral good, speaks Common, and has an Intelligence score of 10; he otherwise uses the {@creature zombie} stat block.
zh_tw: {@creature Frody Dartwild|KftGV|弗羅迪·達特維爾德} 是中立善良，會說通用語，智力得分為10；除此之外，他使用{@creature zombie||喪屍}的統計資料塊。

english: Bard's Quest
zh_tw: 吟遊詩人的探險

english: Frody didn't intend to frighten away the cabin's proper owners, but his appearance can't be helped, and he has nowhere else to go. Toadhop's inhabitants are too frightened to speak to him, so Frody has been waiting for braver souls to arrive so he can explain his plight to them. Given the chance, he imparts the following information:
zh_tw: 弗羅迪並沒有打算嚇跑小屋的真正主人，但他的外表無法改變，而且他無處可去。蟾跳鎮的居民們太害怕了，不敢和他說話，所以弗羅迪一直在等待更勇敢的靈魂到來，這樣他就可以向他們解釋他的困境。如果有機會，他會傳達以下資訊：

english: Grave Theft
zh_tw: 墓地盜竊

english: Two halflings dug up his grave in the dead of night and stole his Canaith mandolin (an {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||instrument of the bards}). Frody wants it back. ("It was a gift," he says.) The mandolin has a name: Golden Axe.
zh_tw: 兩個半身人在夜深人靜時挖掘了他的墳墓，並偷走了他的凱納斯曼陀林（一個{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||吟遊詩人樂器}）。弗羅迪想要它回來。（"那是一份禮物，"他說。）曼陀林有一個名字：金斧。

english: Halfling Robbers
zh_tw: 半身人強盜

english: The grave robbers' names were Mackerel and Trout. Frody's waking spirit could hear the halflings talking to each other as they broke into his coffin. However, Frody could do nothing to stop the theft of his mandolin, and the halflings were long gone by the time he figured out how to animate his own corpse.
zh_tw: 盜墓者的名字是鯖魚和鱒魚。弗羅迪的覺醒靈魂能聽到半身人們在撬開他的棺材時彼此交談。然而，弗羅迪無法阻止他的曼陀林被盜，而且當他弄清楚如何讓自己的屍體動起來時，半身人們早已逃之夭夭。

english: Halflings' Whereabouts
zh_tw: 半身人的下落

english: The two halflings had local accents. Someone in Toadhop might know where to find them.
zh_tw: 這兩個半身人有當地的口音。蟾跳鎮的某人可能知道在哪裡能找到他們。

english: Frody agrees to return peacefully to his grave if the characters find and retrieve his stolen mandolin. If the characters slay Frody instead, he reappears 24 hours later as a neutral good {@creature ghost} and haunts Toadhop until his spirit finds rest—which happens only when Golden Axe is returned to Frody's grave.
zh_tw: 如果角色們找到並取回他被盜的曼陀林，弗羅迪同意和平地回到他的墳墓。如果角色們殺死弗羅迪，他將在24小時後以中立善良的{@creature ghost||幽魂}身份重新出現，並在蟾跳鎮出沒，直到他的靈魂找到安寧——這只有在金斧被放回弗羅迪的墳墓時才會發生。

english: Mackerel and Trout
zh_tw: 鯖魚和鱒魚

english: Characters who share what they learned with the living residents of Toadhop discover that Mackerel Mudbottom and Trout Bonanza are well known in these parts. The two halflings live about five miles away, in a hut on stilts next to a river. The halflings catch crayfish and frogs and sell them in Toadhop occasionally.
zh_tw: 與蟾跳鎮的居民分享他們所瞭解到的資訊的角色們發現，鯖魚·泥底和鱒魚·寶礦在這一帶是眾所周知的。這兩個半身人住在大約五英里外，靠近河邊的一座高架小屋中。半身人們捕捉小龍蝦和青蛙，並偶爾在蟾跳鎮出售它們。

english: If the characters pay Mackerel and Trout a visit, read the following text:
zh_tw: 如果角色們去拜訪鯖魚和鱒魚，請閱讀以下文字：

english: A lopsided wooden hut squats on four wooden stilts next to the sandy shore of a shallow river.
zh_tw: 一座歪斜的木屋坐落在四根木樁上，緊鄰一條淺河的沙質河岸。

english: You see two halflings in overalls, both enjoying the day. One is next to the hut, feeding a carrot to a mule, while the other stands in the middle of the river, futzing with a broken crayfish trap.
zh_tw: 你看到兩個穿著工裝褲的半身人，都在享受這一天。一個在小屋旁邊，正在給一頭騾子喂胡蘿蔔，而另一個站在河中央，擺弄著一個壞掉的小龍蝦陷阱。

english: Mackerel and Trout are unarmed {@creature Commoner||commoners}. The characters can approach the halflings openly or attempt to sneak up on them. The {@creature mule}, which the halflings have named Lucky Me, doesn't startle easily.
zh_tw: 鯖魚和鱒魚是手無寸鐵的{@creature Commoner||平民}。角色們可以公開接近這兩個半身人，或者嘗試悄悄地接近他們。這頭被半身人命名為幸運如我的{@creature mule||騾子}不容易受到驚嚇。

english: The mule doesn't belong to the halflings; they found it tied to a tree by a road and took it, probably while its owner was answering the call of nature. The halflings feed the mule wild carrots and turnips that grow in a tiny garden under their hut.
zh_tw: 這頭騾子不是半身人的；他們在路旁的一棵樹上發現它被拴著，就把它帶走了，可能是當它的主人去解決生理需要的時候。半身人用在他們小屋下的小花園裡生長的野生胡蘿蔔和蘿蔔餵養這頭騾子。

english: Questioning the Halflings
zh_tw: 詢問半身人

english: Mackerel and Trout used to pick olives in the Skalderang orchard until all its trees died suddenly. They suspect the orchard was poisoned (by whom, they don't know). Now they catch and sell crayfish and frogs, supplementing their meager income by performing occasional chores for {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 馬克拉爾和特魯特以前在斯考德蘭果園採摘橄欖，直到那裡的樹突然全部死亡。他們懷疑果園被人下了毒（是誰幹的，他們不知道）。現在他們捕撈並銷售小龍蝦和青蛙，並透過為{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}偶爾做些雜活來補充他們微薄的收入。

english: Mackerel and Trout were paid to steal the Canaith mandolin. Characters who search the halflings' cramped hut find a small purse containing 20 gp. The halflings have yet to decide what to buy with their ill-gotten gold. They reckon they might get a nice dragonchess set, although neither of them knows how to play the game.
zh_tw: 鯖魚和鱒魚被僱來偷走凱納斯曼陀林。角色們如果搜尋半身人狹窄的小屋，會發現一個小錢包，裡面有20金幣。這兩個半身人還沒有決定要用他們不義之財買什麼。他們認為可能會買一套不錯的龍棋，儘管他們倆都不會玩這個遊戲。

english: The halflings have no idea their foray into grave robbing has awakened an undead creature; the thought of Froderic Dartwild exacting revenge from beyond the grave is enough to make them confess everything. In fact, any serious questioning or threat of harm earns the pair's cooperation. The halflings readily share the following information:
zh_tw: 這兩個半身人並不知道他們盜墓的行為喚醒了一個不死生物；想到弗羅德里克·達特維爾德可能從墳墓中回來復仇就足以讓他們坦白一切。實際上，任何嚴肅的詢問或威脅傷害都能獲得這對半身人的合作。半身人們很樂意分享以下資訊：

english: Sythian
zh_tw: 西提安

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} has Golden Axe.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭} 擁有金斧。

english: Sythian's Debts
zh_tw: 西提安的債務

english: Sythian is plagued by debt collectors. To help pay off debts, Sythian turned his mansion into a conservatory where young musicians from wealthy families can hone their craft. Sythian is a musician himself, though neither Mackerel nor Trout has heard Sythian perform or is familiar with his work.
zh_tw: 西提安被討債人困擾。為了幫助償還債務，西提安將自己的豪宅變成了音樂學院，讓來自富裕家庭的年輕音樂家們可以在那裡磨練他們的技藝。西提安本人也是一位音樂家，儘管鯖魚和鱒魚都沒有聽過西提安的表演，也不熟悉他的作品。

english: Van Timmels
zh_tw: 范·提梅爾一家

english: Sythian plans to give Golden Axe to Wylie van Timmel, one of his pupils. The van Timmels are filthy rich, and Sythian believes their financial support is worth more than the mandolin itself.
zh_tw: 西提安計劃將金斧贈予他的一個學生懷利范·提梅爾。范·提梅爾家族非常富有，西提安相信他們的財務支援比曼陀林本身更有價值。

english: Halfling Sandcastle
zh_tw: 半身人沙堡

english: Mackerel and Trout don't have a map of Skalderang Conservatory, but they know it well enough to make a miniature version from sand. Building the sandcastle takes them about 20 minutes.
zh_tw: 鯖魚和鱒魚沒有斯考德蘭音樂學院的地圖，但他們對它足夠熟悉，可以用沙子做一個微型版本。建造這個沙堡大約需要他們20分鐘。

english: When the halflings' sandcastle is complete, show players the accompanying Skalderang Conservatory sandcastle illustration (map 7.1), which depicts the location from two points of view. The characters can use the sandcastle to help plan their heist.
zh_tw: 當半身人的沙堡完成後，向玩家展示附帶的斯考德蘭音樂學院沙堡插圖（地圖7.1），它從兩個視角描繪了位置。角色們可以使用沙堡來幫助計劃他們的盜竊行動。

english: Map 7.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖7.1：玩家地圖

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: The rest of the adventure revolves around the theft of Golden Axe from Skalderang Conservatory. Whether the characters return the mandolin to its proper owner, keep it for themselves, or do something else with it is for them to decide.
zh_tw: 其餘的冒險圍繞從斯考德蘭音樂學院盜竊金斧展開。角色們是將曼陀林歸還給其合法所有者，自己保留它，還是用它做其他事情，由他們自己決定。

english: In addition to providing a sandcastle model of Skalderang Conservatory, Mackerel and Trout furnish the characters with the following information, which is framed as boxed text that you can read or paraphrase to the players.
zh_tw: 除了提供一個斯考德蘭音樂學院的沙堡模型外，鯖魚和鱒魚還向角色們提供了以下資訊，這些資訊被框起來，您可以讀給玩家聽或向玩家轉述。

english: About the Conservatory
zh_tw: 關於音樂學院

english: "The conservatory has four floors, counting the roof. The outer doors—that's a double door in front and a back door leading to the kitchen—they're good, sturdy oak and barred shut at night. And all the windows are latched shut from the inside. We maybe checked.
zh_tw: "音樂學院有四層樓，算上屋頂。外門——前門是雙扇門，後門通向廚房——它們都是堅固的橡木製成，並且在夜間被牢固地閂上。所有的窗戶也從內部被鎖上了。我們可能已經檢查過了。"

english: "From the skylights on the roof, you can see the third-floor room that holds Sythian's fancy instruments. Sythian's quarters are somewhere on the third floor, too. He let most of the staff go, excepting the cook and housekeeper. They sleep next to the kitchen on the ground floor. The students live on the second floor—they each get a room, but they take their vittles in the dining hall on the first floor.
zh_tw: "從屋頂的天窗，你可以看到三樓的房間，那裡存放著西提安的高階樂器。西提安的住處也在三樓的某個地方。他讓大部分員工離職了，只留下了廚師和管家。他們睡在一樓廚房旁邊。學生們住在二樓——他們每個人都有一個房間，但他們在一樓的餐廳用餐。"

english: "There are staircases between all the floors in the towers, and an elevator powered by magic that runs between the dining hall and the second and third floors."
zh_tw: "在塔樓的所有樓層之間都有樓梯，還有一個由魔法驅動的電梯，它在餐廳和第二層以及第三層之間執行。"

english: About Sythian Skalderang
zh_tw: 關於西提安·斯考德蘭

english: "Sythian is a tiefling with blue skin and black horns. He's not the most likable person. He rains on everyone's parade. His folks must've never taught him how to be nice, so when he tries, he mucks it up. He's always unhappy and never has anything nice to say. I got no idea what a rich guy like that's got to be unhappy about.
zh_tw: "西提安是一個藍色皮膚、黑色犄角的提夫林。他不是那種最受歡迎的人。他總是給每個人的樂趣潑冷水。他的父母可能從未教過他如何友好待人，所以當他嘗試時，總是弄得一團糟。他總是不高興，從不說些好聽的話。我真不明白像他這樣富有的人有什麼可不高興的。"

english: "Sythian wears a master key around his neck that unlocks doors inside the conservatory. Vordell, the housekeeper, has another master key.
zh_tw: "西提安脖子上掛著一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟音樂學院內部的門。管家沃德爾還有另一把萬能鑰匙。"

english: "One more thing. Sythian is terrified of frogs and toads—has been ever since he was swallowed by a giant toad as a young boy. He'd kill us for telling you that."
zh_tw: "還有一件事。西提安非常害怕青蛙和蟾蜍——自從他小時候被一隻巨大的蟾蜍吞下後就一直是這樣。如果我們告訴你們這個秘密，他會殺了我們的。"

english: Mackerel and Trout know that frogs commonly huddle near the river. A character who spends at least 15 minutes walking along the shoreline can make a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check, locating {@dice 1d4} {@creature Frog||frogs} on a success. Catching a frog requires a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check.
zh_tw: 馬鮫魚和鱒魚知道青蛙通常會在河邊聚集。角色如果沿著河岸步行至少15分鐘，可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，成功則可以找到{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Frog||青蛙}。捕捉一隻青蛙需要成功進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。

english: About Joster Mareet
zh_tw: 關於喬斯特·馬裡特

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} has an {@creature incubus} acquaintance who goes by the name {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV}. This servant of the demon lord Graz'zt usually takes the form of a tall, beautiful, male tiefling. The incubus has telepathy out to a range of 60 feet, enabling the fiend to have telepathic conversations with Sythian even when they're not in the same room.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭} 有一個名為 {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特} 的 {@creature incubus||夢魔} 熟人。這個惡魔領主格拉茲特的僕人通常以一個高大、英俊的男性提夫林的形象出現。這個夢魔擁有60尺範圍內的心靈感應能力，使得這個邪魔即使與西提安不在同一個房間時也能進行心靈交流。

english: Joster came knocking shortly after Sythian inherited the Skalderang estate. Unknown to Sythian, Joster was responsible for poisoning the Skalderang olive orchard. Joster was following instructions from Graz'zt, with the goal of making Sythian stop growing olives. Joster wants Sythian to use connections gained through the students' elite families to earn their patronage. With that newfound wealth and influence, Sythian could ruin lives and lead a decadent cult worthy of Graz'zt.
zh_tw: 西提安繼承斯考德蘭莊園後不久，喬斯特就來敲門了。西提安不知道的是，喬斯特是毒害斯考德蘭橄欖園的罪魁禍首。喬斯特按照格拉茲特的指示行事，目的是讓西提安停止種植橄欖。喬斯特希望西提安利用透過學生精英家庭獲得的聯絡來贏得他們的贊助。有了這新發現的財富和影響力，西提安可以毀掉生活，並領導一個值得格拉茲特的墮落邪教。

english: Sythian knows Joster is an incubus but is under the false impression that Joster cares for his well-being.
zh_tw: 西提安知道喬斯特是一個夢魘魔，但卻錯誤地以為喬斯特關心他的福祉。

english: Mackerel and Trout know the following information about Joster:
zh_tw: 鯖魚和鱒魚知道關於喬斯特的以下資訊：

english: "One of Sythian's friends is staying at the castle—a tall, handsome tiefling chap named {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV}. He has red skin, yellow horns, and a smoky voice. Joster doesn't do much except hang around the estate, although sometimes he paints portraits of the students.
zh_tw: "西提安的一個朋友住在城堡裡——一個高大、英俊的名叫{@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}的提夫林人。他有著紅色的皮膚、黃色的角和沙啞的聲音。喬斯特大部分時間無所事事，只是在莊園裡閒逛，儘管有時他會為學生們畫肖像。"

english: "Joster showed up shortly after the Skalderang orchard died and encouraged Sythian to open his home to gifted musicians. We caught Joster chatting with a little green-skinned demon, which turned invisible the instant it saw us. Joster pretended like the demon wasn't there, but we saw it, all right."
zh_tw: "喬斯特在斯考德蘭果園死去後不久就出現了，並鼓勵西提安向有天賦的音樂家開放他的家。我們抓到喬斯特在和一個小綠皮惡魔聊天，那個惡魔一看到我們就立刻隱形了。喬斯特假裝惡魔不在那裡，但我們確實看到了。"

english: About the Students
zh_tw: 關於學生們

english: "Sythian has four students currently. They all reside at the conservatory, but their families have grand estates in the nearby city.
zh_tw: "西提安目前有四名學生。他們都住在音樂學院，但他們的家庭在附近的城市擁有宏偉的莊園。"

english: "Wylie plays strings and has a beautiful singing voice. She is attending her father's birthday party and won't be back for a couple of days. That leaves Embry, a talented composer and horn player; Mazia, who plays the flute; and Mytchyl, who plays the drums and the harpsichord.
zh_tw: "懷利彈奏絃樂器並且擁有美妙的歌唱聲音。她正在參加她父親的的生日派對，並且幾天內不會回來。這樣就剩下恩布里，一個有才華的作曲家和號手；瑪齊雅，她吹奏長笛；還有米契爾，他演奏鼓和大鍵琴。"

english: "All the students are good-natured and kind."
zh_tw: "所有的學生都天性善良、和藹。"

english: A Typical Day
zh_tw: 典型的一天

english: If the characters request information about how the conservatory's occupants spend a typical day, Mackerel and Trout share the information in the Conservatory Schedule table.
zh_tw: 如果角色們請求有關音樂學院居住者如何度過典型一天的資訊，鯖魚和鱒魚會分享音樂學院日程表中的資訊。

english: Conservatory Schedule
zh_tw: 音樂學院日程安排

english: Start Time
zh_tw: 開始時間

english: Activity
zh_tw: 用途

english: 8 a.m.
zh_tw: 上午8點

english: Breakfast is served in the dining hall ({@area area C1|2b6|x}) on level 1.
zh_tw: 早餐在一樓的餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）供應。

english: 9 a.m.
zh_tw: 上午9點

english: Sythian supervises rehearsals in the music hall ({@area area C11|2cb|x}) on level 3 while the servants work and Joster lazes about.
zh_tw: 西提安在三樓的音樂廳（{@area 區域C11|2cb|x}）監督排練，而僕人們工作，喬斯特則閒逛。

english: Noon
zh_tw: 中午

english: Lunch is served in the dining hall ({@area area C1|2b6|x}).
zh_tw: 午餐在餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）供應。

english: 1 p.m.
zh_tw: 下午1點

english: A courier drops off Sythian's mail, which he reads in his study ({@area area C14|2d3|x}) on level 3, with Joster present, while the students relax in the gallery ({@area area C4|2bf|x}) on level 1.
zh_tw: 一名信使送來了西提安的郵件，他在三樓的書房（{@area 區域C14|2d3|x}）閱讀郵件，喬斯特在場，而學生們在一樓的畫廊（{@area 區域C4|2bf|x}）放鬆。

english: 5 p.m.
zh_tw: 下午5點

english: Dinner is served in the dining hall ({@area area C1|2b6|x}).
zh_tw: 晚餐在餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）供應。

english: 6 p.m.
zh_tw: 下午6點

english: The students practice their music unsupervised, either in their quarters ({@area area C7|2c5|x}) on level 2 or in the music hall ({@area area C11|2cb|x}). Sythian writes letters in his study ({@area area C14|2d3|x}) or prays in the shrine ({@area area C5|2c1|x}) on level 1, usually with Joster present.
zh_tw: 學生們在無人監督的情況下練習音樂，要麼在他們在二樓的房間（{@area 區域C7|2c5|x}），要麼在音樂廳（{@area 區域C11|2cb|x}）。西提安在他的書房（{@area 區域C14|2d3|x}）寫信，或者在一樓的神龕（{@area 區域C5|2c1|x}）祈禱，通常喬斯特在場。

english: 9 p.m.
zh_tw: 晚上9點

english: Sythian, Joster, and the students gather in the dining hall ({@area area C1|2b6|x}) to tell stories, share city gossip, snack, and discuss music theory.
zh_tw: 西提安、喬斯特和學生們聚集在餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）講故事、分享城市八卦、吃點心，並討論音樂理論。

english: Midnight
zh_tw: 午夜

english: Sythian, Joster, and the students retire to their quarters (Joster and the students in {@area area C7|2c5|x} on level 2, Sythian in {@area area C15|2d6|x} on level 3) while the servants tidy up.
zh_tw: 西提安、喬斯特和學生們退回到他們的房間（喬斯特和學生們在二樓的{@area 區域C7|2c5|x}，西提安在三樓的{@area 區域C15|2d6|x}），而僕人們在打掃。

english: Skalderang Conservatory
zh_tw: 斯考德蘭音樂學院

english: When the characters are close enough to see the conservatory, describe the location as follows:
zh_tw: "當角色們接近到足以看清音樂學院時，按以下方式描述這個地方："

english: You recognize Skalderang Conservatory at once: a brooding keep surrounded by rows of dead olive trees. A long, straight, cobblestone driveway in need of repair passes through the orchard on its way to the conservatory, forming a loop before the entrance. Where the driveway meets the main road, someone has posted a plain wooden sign that reads as follows:
zh_tw: 你一眼就認出了斯考德蘭音樂學院：一座沉思的堡壘，周圍環繞著成排的死橄欖樹。一條長長的、直直的、需要修理的鵝卵石車道穿過果園，通往音樂學院，在入口前形成一個環路。在車道與主幹道交匯的地方，有人立了一塊簡單的木牌，上面寫著如下內容：

english: "Skalderang Conservatory—School for the Musically Gifted. No Tours! No Solicitors! No Amateurs!"
zh_tw: "斯考德蘭音樂學院——天賦音樂人的學府。不接待參觀！不接待推銷！不接待業餘愛好者！"

english: The earth throughout the orchard is saturated with demon ichor, which killed the olive trees. A character who takes a minute to examine the earth and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check can determine that the ground is saturated with a putrid, oily substance not found in nature. A character who gets a 20 or higher on the check identifies the substance as demon ichor.
zh_tw: 果園的土地被惡魔之血浸透，導致橄欖樹死亡。角色需要花一分鐘檢查土地，並透過一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定，才能確定地面被一種自然界不存在的腐臭油脂物質浸透。如果檢定結果為 20 或更高，角色可以識別出這種物質為惡魔之血。

english: If the characters tell Sythian that his orchard was poisoned with demon ichor, he concludes {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV} is responsible but keeps his suspicions to himself. The revelation makes Sythian bitter toward the incubus and poisons their long-term relationship.
zh_tw: 如果角色們告訴西提安他的果園是被惡魔之血毒害的，他會得出結論是{@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}所為，但會將自己的懷疑保留在心中。這一發現使西提安對那個夢魔產生了怨恨，並毒害了他們長期的人際關係。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: Skalderang Conservatory has stone walls and a stone-tiled ground floor. The upper floors have polished mahogany floors and wainscoting. Other prevalent features are summarized in the sections that follow.
zh_tw: 斯考德蘭音樂學院有石牆和石鋪的底樓。上層有打磨過的桃花心木地板和護壁板。其他顯著特點在以下各節中進行了總結。

english: Chimneys
zh_tw: 煙囪

english: The conservatory's chimneys haven't been cleaned in a long time. A Small character can try to squeeze up or down one, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. A failed check indicates that the character makes no progress. To enter or exit a chimney from the top, one must first use an action to try to remove the chimney's stone cap, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A character in gaseous form can navigate a chimney without having to make these checks or remove the chimney cap.
zh_tw: 音樂學院裡的煙囪已經很久沒有清理過了。一個小型生物可以嘗試擠進或擠出煙囪，需要透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。檢定失敗則意味著毫無進展。要從煙囪頂部進入或離開，必須首先使用一個動作嘗試移除煙囪的石帽，需要透過一次 {@dc 18} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。氣化形態的生物可以無需進行這些檢定或移除煙囪帽就能透過煙囪。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The conservatory's doors are made of thick, sturdy oak with iron fixtures. Locked doors are noted in their area's heading and require a master key to open. Sythian has one master key; Vordell, the housekeeper, has another. A character can take an action to try to pick a lock using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 音樂學院的門是由厚實堅固的橡木製成，配有鐵製配件。上鎖的門會在其區域標題中註明，並需要一把萬能鑰匙才能開啟。西提安擁有一把萬能鑰匙；管家沃德爾擁有另一把。角色可以採取一個動作，使用盜賊工具嘗試撬鎖，成功完成一次 {@dc 18} 的敏捷檢定即可開啟。

english: Elevator
zh_tw: 升降機

english: A 5-foot-wide cage elevator fitted with stained-glass windows connects the dining hall on level 1 ({@area area C1|2b6|x}) to the mezzanine on level 2 ({@area area C6|2c3|x}) and the hallway on level 3 ({@area area C13|2d0|x}). The elevator is powered by magic. A creature in the elevator need only say "level 1," "level 2," or "level 3" in Common, and the elevator will ascend or descend to that floor, clattering noisily and taking about 6 seconds to move from one floor to the next. The elevator doesn't respond to commands while it is moving.
zh_tw: 一個5尺寬的籠子電梯，配備了彩色玻璃窗，連線了一樓的餐廳（{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}）到二樓的夾層（{@area 區域C6|2c3|x}）和三樓的走廊（{@area 區域C13|2d0|x}）。電梯由魔法驅動。電梯內的生物只需用通用語說出"一樓"、"二樓"或"三樓"，電梯就會上升或下降到相應樓層，嘈雜地響動並在大約6秒內從一個樓層移動到另一個樓層。電梯在移動時不響應命令。

english: Exterior Lighting
zh_tw: 外部照明

english: The conservatory's exterior walls are lit up at night by golden {@spell continual flame} spells spaced evenly around the building's foundation. These spells are suppressed during daylight hours.
zh_tw: 音樂學院的外牆在夜間被金色的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮，這些法術均勻地分佈在建築的基礎周圍。這些法術在日間被抑制。

english: Interior Lighting
zh_tw: 室內照明

english: Natural light illuminates most of the conservatory's interior spaces. Students and servants who lack {@sense darkvision} use candles, lamps, or lit fireplaces to see at night.
zh_tw: 自然光照亮了音樂學院的大部分內部空間。沒有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}的學生和僕人們在夜間使用蠟燭、燈具或點燃的壁爐來照明。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: The conservatory's windows are 6 feet tall and 3 feet wide, their lead frames fitted with dozens of small, diamond-shaped panes of frosted glass. Each window has small hinges on one side of it, allowing it to be swung open like a door. All windows are latched shut from the inside except on hot days. As an action, a character can try to force open a latched window, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or use thieves' tools to unlatch a window from the outside, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 音樂學院窗戶高達6尺，寬3尺，鉛製框架上鑲嵌著數十塊小的菱形磨砂玻璃。每扇窗戶的一側都裝有小鉸鏈，可以像門一樣向外開啟。除炎熱天氣外，所有窗戶都從內部閂上。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試強行開啟閂上的窗戶，成功透過{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可，或者使用盜賊工具從外部開啟窗戶，成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定即可。

english: Inhabitants
zh_tw: 居民

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} is described at the end of the adventure. His muse, the {@creature incubus} {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV}, clings to him like a shadow and uses telepathy to communicate secretly with him. The conservatory's other regular inhabitants are described below.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭} 在冒險的末尾有描述。他的繆斯，{@creature incubus||夢魔} {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}，像影子一樣緊貼著他，並使用心靈感應與他秘密交流。音樂學院的其他常駐居民如下所述。

english: Demons
zh_tw: 惡魔

english: {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV} petitioned and received aid from Graz'zt in the form of one {@creature chasme} and six {@creature Quasit||quasits}:
zh_tw: {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特} 請求並獲得了格拉茲特的援助，援助的形式是一個{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}和六個{@creature Quasit||小惡魔}：

english: Chasme
zh_tw: 喀嘶魔

english: This Large demon crawls around the outside of the conservatory and is usually encountered on the rooftop ({@area area C18|2df|x}). It attacks enemies it detects in the air, on the ground, or on the third-floor balcony ({@area area C12|2ce|x}).
zh_tw: 這個大型惡魔在音樂學院外部爬行，通常在屋頂上遇到（{@area 區域C18|2df|x}）。它攻擊它在空中、地面上或三樓陽臺上（{@area 區域C12|2ce|x}）探測到的敵人。

english: Quasits
zh_tw: 小惡魔

english: These Tiny demons haunt the conservatory, where they remain {@condition invisible} or take the forms of bats and giant centipedes.
zh_tw: 這些微小的惡魔出沒於音樂學院，它們保持{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態或變成蝙蝠和巨型蜈蚣的形狀。
