english: Sythian and Joster are the only ones at the conservatory who are aware of the demons' presence, as the demons take care to hide themselves from students, servants, and most visitors. When a demon dies, it dissolves into a puddle of putrid ichor.
zh_tw: 西提安和喬斯特是音樂學院中唯一意識到惡魔存在的人，因為惡魔小心地隱藏自己，不讓學生、僕人和大多數訪客看到。當一個惡魔死亡時，它會溶解成一灘惡臭的粘液。

english: Students
zh_tw: 學生

english: Sythian has opened his home to four students:
zh_tw: 西提安向四名學生開放了他的家：

english: {@b Embry Hale} (chaotic good) is a loud, 17-year-old human who plays a mean horn. He also composes his own songs and lyrics, recording them on scraps of parchment. He plans to become an adventuring bard but hasn't the courage to tell his parents, who would never tolerate such a pedestrian, dangerous life for their son.
zh_tw: {@b 安布里·黑爾}（混亂善良）是一個喧鬧的17歲人類，擅長演奏號角。他還自己創作歌曲和歌詞，將它們記錄在羊皮紙碎片上。他計劃成為一名冒險吟遊詩人，但沒有勇氣告訴他的父母，他們永遠不會容忍他們的兒子過上這樣平凡而危險的生活的。

english: {@b Mazia Foulard} (lawful good) is a 20-year-old tiefling who has taught the other students a sign language she and her deaf grandmother created together. Mazia can play several instruments, but her favorite is the flute. She doesn't think Sythian is a particularly good teacher but has great love and respect for her fellow students.
zh_tw: {@b 瑪齊雅·富拉爾}（守序善良）是一個20歲的提夫林，她和她聾啞的祖母一起創造了一種手語，並教會了其他學生。馬齊亞能演奏幾種樂器，但她最喜歡的是長笛。她不認為西提安是一個特別好的老師，但對同學們有著深厚的愛和尊重。

english: {@b Mytchyl Dwyer} (neutral good) is a 13-year-old human who was born without legs. He gets around in a gold-trimmed wheelchair. When it comes to music, his lack of discipline prompted his parents to send him to the Skalderang Conservatory. He was unhappy at first, but he warmed to the company of the other students and secretly idolizes Embry.
zh_tw: {@b 米契爾·德懷爾}（中立善良）是一個13歲的人類，他天生沒有腿。他乘坐一個鑲金邊的輪椅四處移動。在音樂方面，他缺乏紀律性，這促使他的父母將他送到斯考德蘭音樂學院。起初他並不開心，但後來他喜歡上了其他學生的陪伴，並且暗中崇拜安布里。

english: {@b Wylie van Timmel} (lawful good) is a 16-year-old human who comes from a loving home and enjoys a life of privilege. Great things are expected of her, and she intends to make a name for herself. She is absent when the characters arrive and won't return for a couple days.
zh_tw: {@b 懷利范·提梅爾}（守序善良）是一個16歲的人類，來自一個充滿愛的家庭，享受著特權生活。人們對她寄予厚望，她也打算為自己贏得名聲。當角色們到達時她不在場，並且幾天後才會回來。

english: Should their statistics become necessary, the students are unarmed and unarmored {@creature Noble||nobles} with an extra skill: {@skill Performance} {@skillCheck performance 7}. The students are friendly but scream loudly and try to hide if confronted by unidentified intruders. They refuse to cooperate with anyone opposed to Sythian until his true colors are revealed to them.
zh_tw: 如果需要他們的具體數值，這些學生是未武裝且未穿戴盔甲的{@creature Noble||貴族}，並且擁有額外的技能：{@skill Performance||表演} {@skillCheck performance 7|+7|表演}。學生們很友好，但如果遇到未識別的入侵者，他們會大聲尖叫並試圖隱藏。在西提安的真實面目被揭露之前，他們拒絕與任何反對他的人合作。

english: Embry, Mazia, and Mytchyl saw the halflings Mackerel and Trout deliver a mandolin to Sythian, and they know what Sythian plans to do with it. They assume he procured the instrument legally and are unaware that it was stolen from a grave. Should they learn about the grave robbery, the three students instruct the housekeeper to pack up their belongings, and they leave the conservatory at once.
zh_tw: 安布里、馬齊亞和米奇爾看到半身人馬鯖魚和鱒魚將一把曼陀林交給西提安，並且他們知道西提安打算用它做什麼。他們假設他是合法獲得這個樂器的，並且不知道它是從墳墓裡偷來的。如果他們得知墳墓被盜的情況，這三名學生會指示管家打包他們的行李，並立即離開音樂學院。

english: Sythian can't afford to lose his students, so if the characters threaten to tell the students about his grave robbing or the fact that he consorts with demons, he surrenders the instrument to ensure the characters' silence.
zh_tw: 西提安無法承受失去學生的代價，所以如果角色們威脅要告訴學生們他盜墓的事情或者他與惡魔有往來的事實，他會交出樂器以確保角色們的沉默。

english: Servants
zh_tw: 僕人

english: Sythian employs two full-time servants, both {@creature Commoner||commoners}:
zh_tw: 西提安僱傭了兩名全職僕人，都是{@creature Commoner||平民}：

english: {@b Merle} (lawful good) is an 83-year-old dwarf cook. He has a neatly trimmed beard and a cheerful disposition. He doesn't socialize with the students much except to crack jokes. Merle has been a fixture in Skalderang Conservatory since before Sythian was born and doesn't have an unkind word to say about anybody except for {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV}, whom he suspects is up to no good.
zh_tw: {@b 默爾}（守序善良）是一位83歲的矮人廚師。他留著整齊修剪的鬍鬚，性情開朗。他不太與學生們社交，除非是為了講笑話。默爾在西提安出生之前就一直在斯考德蘭音樂學院工作，除了對{@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}，他認為這個人不懷好意之外，他對任何人都沒有惡言。

english: {@b Vordell} (lawful neutral) is a dour, 50-year-old human housekeeper with a full head of salt-and-pepper hair pulled into a ponytail. He carries a master key that opens all locked doors in the conservatory. If he could find employment elsewhere, Vordell would abandon Sythian in a heartbeat. Vordell doesn't like that Sythian partakes in demon worship but keeps his misgivings to himself. Joster's {@condition invisible} quasits torment Vordell by soiling or breaking things, which Vordell must then tidy up. Vordell doesn't know who or what to blame for these unexplained messes.
zh_tw: {@b 沃德爾}（守序中立）是一個憂鬱的50歲人類管家，他有一頭灰白相間的頭髮，紮成了馬尾。他攜帶著一把能開啟音樂學院所有鎖著的門的萬能鑰匙。如果他能在別處找到工作，沃德爾會毫不猶豫地拋棄西提安。沃德爾不喜歡西提安參與惡魔崇拜，但他把自己的顧慮藏在心裡。喬斯特的{@condition invisible||隱形}誇塞魔透過弄髒或破壞東西來折磨沃德爾，沃德爾必須隨後清理這些。沃德爾不知道這些無法解釋的混亂應該歸咎於誰或什麼。

english: The servants are indifferent toward guests and hostile toward burglars. Duty and loyalty prevent them from cooperating with intruders willingly.
zh_tw: 僕人們對客人漠不關心，對竊賊則持敵對態度。職責和忠誠阻止了他們自願與入侵者合作。

english: The Direct Approach
zh_tw: 直接方法

english: Although he doesn't like unexpected guests, Sythian has enough grace to briefly entertain visitors who arrive at the conservatory without an appointment. Characters who knock on the front door or otherwise announce their presence are greeted by Vordell or one of the students and led by that individual into {@area area C1|2b6|x}, where the characters are expected to wait until Sythian and Joster arrive to question them. Should this encounter occur at night, Sythian is doubly annoyed by the disturbance, and Charisma checks made to influence him have disadvantage.
zh_tw: 儘管西提安不喜歡不速之客，但他有足夠的風度，可以短暫地招待那些沒有預約就來到音樂學院的訪客。敲前門或以其他方式宣佈他們存在的人物將由沃德爾或一名學生迎接，並由該人帶領進入{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}，在那裡他們應該等待西提安和喬斯特到來詢問他們。如果這次遭遇發生在晚上，西提安對打擾感到特別煩惱，並且試圖影響他的魅力檢查將處於劣勢。

english: "Are You Accepting New Students?"
zh_tw: "您接受新學生嗎？"

english: A character who is a bard (or pretends to be one) can petition Sythian to become a student at Skalderang Conservatory. The character must first prove they can afford Sythian's tutelage (by displaying treasure worth 250 gp or more), after which the character must impress Sythian by playing a musical instrument and succeeding on a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check. On a failed check, Sythian delivers a scathing critique of the character's musical ability before sending the characters away empty-handed. Sythian changes his mind if the characters pay him a bribe of 500 gp or more. On a successful check or upon receiving such a bribe, Sythian allows the would-be student (and only that character) to stay overnight and orders Vordell to prepare a room for them ({@area area C7d|2c5|x}).
zh_tw: 一個作為吟遊詩人（或假裝是吟遊詩人）的角色，可以向西提安請願，成為斯考德蘭學院的學徒。角色必須首先證明他們能夠負擔西提安的學費（透過展示價值250金幣或更多的寶藏），之後角色必須透過演奏樂器並在一次{@dc 20}魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定中成功來打動西提安。如果檢定失敗，西提安會對角色的音樂能力進行尖銳的批評，然後讓他們空手離開。如果角色支付給他500金幣或更多的賄賂，西提安會改變主意。在檢定成功或收到賄賂後，西提安允許這位準學徒（並且僅限該角色）過夜，並命令沃德爾為他們準備一個房間（{@area 區域C7d|2c5|x}）。

english: Where's the Mandolin?
zh_tw: 曼陀林在哪裡？

english: Golden Axe is in Sythian's quarters ({@area area C15|2d6|x}). If you're running this adventure for one or more players who have played through the adventure before, you might move the mandolin to a different location in the conservatory.
zh_tw: 金斧在西提安的住處（{@area 區域C15|2d6|x}）。如果你為一個或多個之前已經玩過這個冒險的玩家執行這個冒險，你可能會將曼陀林移到音樂學院內的另一個位置。

english: "Surrender the Mandolin or Else!"
zh_tw: "交出曼陀林，否則後果自負！"

english: If the characters use their audience with Sythian to demand that Golden Axe be handed over to them, Sythian lets out a haughty laugh and orders the characters to leave at once. If the characters refuse, Sythian and Joster flee to {@area area C15|2d6|x}, where Sythian equips himself with {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||Golden Axe} and tries to escape out the window using the mandolin's {@spell fly} spell while Joster makes his own escape.
zh_tw: 如果角色們利用與西提安的會面要求將金斧交給他們，西提安會發出傲慢的笑聲，並命令角色們立刻離開。如果角色們拒絕，西提安和喬斯特會逃到{@area 區域C15|2d6|x}，在那裡西提安裝備上{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||金斧}，並試圖使用曼陀林的{@spell fly||飛行術}法術從窗戶逃脫，而喬斯特則自行逃脫。

english: "We're Debt Collectors."
zh_tw: 我們是討債人。"

english: Sythian owes money to various loan sharks and banks. Characters who claim to represent one of these individuals or institutions must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to convince Sythian that they are who they say they are. If one or more characters fail this check, Sythian becomes suspicious (see "Sythian's Suspicion" below).
zh_tw: 西提安欠了各種高利貸和銀行的錢。那些聲稱代表其中某個個人或機構的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定，才能讓西提安相信他們的身份。如果一個或多個角色檢定失敗，西提安會變得懷疑（見下文"西提安的懷疑"）。

english: If the characters trick Sythian into believing they are debt collectors and demand a payment of no more than 200 gp, Sythian fetches the sum from his study ({@area area C14|2d3|x}) while Joster keeps a watchful eye on the characters. After making the payment, Sythian sends the characters on their way. If the characters demand more than 200 gp or anything other than coins, Sythian becomes suspicious (see below).
zh_tw: 如果角色們欺騙西提安，讓他相信他們是討債人，並要求支付不超過200金幣，西提安會從他的書房（{@area 區域C14|2d3|x}）取來這筆款項，而喬斯特則警惕地監視著角色們。支付完成後，西提安會打發角色們離開。如果角色們要求超過200金幣或除了硬幣之外的任何東西，西提安會變得懷疑（見下文）。

english: Sythian's Suspicion
zh_tw: 西提安的懷疑

english: If Sythian becomes suspicious of characters posing as debt collectors, he entertains them long enough for Joster to "fetch the payment." The incubus rounds up the demons in areas {@area C4|2bf|x}, {@area C11|2cb|x}, and {@area C18|2df|x} before returning to dispose of the visitors. When combat erupts, Sythian retreats to his bedroom ({@area area C15|2d6|x}) and grabs {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||Golden Axe}. If the characters catch up to him, he tries to escape out the window using the mandolin's {@spell fly} spell.
zh_tw: 如果西提安對冒充收債人的冒險者產生懷疑，他會以足夠的時間招待他們，以便喬斯特去"取回付款"。這個夢魔會在區域{@area C4|2bf|x}、{@area C11|2cb|x}和{@area C18|2df|x}收集惡魔，然後返回處理訪客。當戰鬥爆發時，西提安退回到他的臥室({@area 區域C15|2d6|x})並抓住{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||金斧}。如果冒險者追上他，他會嘗試使用曼陀林的{@spell fly||飛行術}法術從窗戶逃脫。

english: Conservatory Locations
zh_tw: 音樂學院地點

english: The following locations are keyed to Skalderang Conservatory as shown on map 7.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點是按照7.2地圖上所示的斯考德蘭音樂學院進行標記的。

english: Map 7.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖7.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: C1: Dining Hall
zh_tw: C1. 餐廳

english: At night, the double door to the south is barred shut from the inside.
zh_tw: 晚上，朝南的雙門從內部被閂上了。

english: A large dining table stands in the middle of this hall, surrounded by tall-backed wooden chairs. Suspended above the table are two chandeliers fitted with wax candles. Encircling the hall at a height of fifteen feet is a wooden mezzanine that can be reached by a cage elevator in one corner. West of the dining room is a cozy niche with a fireplace, three padded chairs, and a sideboard. Hanging above the mantelpiece is a framed portrait of two stern, well-dressed, middle-aged tieflings: a short, pudgy fellow and a tall, thin woman. The surrounding walls bear numerous smaller paintings, mostly of young people.
zh_tw: 大廳中央擺放著一張大型餐桌，周圍是高背木椅。餐桌上方懸掛著兩個裝有蠟炬的吊燈。在十五尺高的環繞大廳的木製夾層可以透過一個角落的籠式電梯到達。餐廳西側是一個舒適的壁龕，有一個壁爐、三把軟墊椅子和一個餐具櫃。壁爐上方掛著一幅裝裱的畫像，畫中是兩位嚴肅、穿著考究的中年提夫林：一個矮胖的男子和一個高瘦的女人。周圍的牆壁上掛著許多較小的畫作，大多是年輕人的畫像。

english: During the day, characters are most likely to encounter Vordell, the housekeeper ({@creature commoner}), here, setting the table or returning clean dishes and cutlery to the sideboard. Depending on the time of day, the characters might find {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}), Joster the {@creature incubus} in tiefling form, and students here as well (see the {@area Conservatory Schedule table|2a1|x}).
zh_tw: 白天，角色們最有可能在這裡遇到管家沃德爾（{@creature commoner||平民}），他在擺桌子或將乾淨的餐具放回餐具櫃。根據時間的不同，角色們可能還會在這裡找到{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}（參見{@area 冒險的結束|2e9|x}）、以提夫林形態出現的{@creature incubus||夢魔}喬斯特，以及學生們（參見{@area 音樂學院日程表|2a1|x}）。

english: Chandeliers
zh_tw: 吊燈

english: Simple rope-and-pulley mechanisms allow the chandeliers to be raised or lowered from the mezzanine ({@area area C6|2c3|x}).
zh_tw: 簡單的繩索和滑輪機構允許吊燈從夾層({@area 區域C6|2c3|x})被提升或降低。

english: Paintings
zh_tw: 畫作

english: The painting above the mantelpiece depicts {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV}'s parents, Vexxis and Alyrria. The smaller portraits in the room were painted by Joster and depict Sythian's students, past and present.
zh_tw: 壁爐上方的畫作描繪了{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}的父母，維克西斯和艾莉莉雅。房間裡的小肖像是喬斯特畫的，描繪了西提安的學生，包括過去的和現在的。

english: C2: Kitchen and Pantry
zh_tw: C2. 廚房和食品儲藏室

english: A large pot hangs in the fireplace of this cluttered kitchen, and stout worktables sized for a dwarf are covered with handy implements. A closet pantry stands in the corner next to a door that leads outside.
zh_tw: 這個雜亂的廚房裡，壁爐上掛著一口大鍋，適合矮人使用的結實工作臺覆蓋著各種便利的工具。一個儲物櫃立在角落裡，旁邊有一扇通往室外的門。

english: Merle, the dwarf cook ({@creature commoner}), works here from 6 a.m. to midnight. When confronted with danger, he grabs a rolling pin (treat it as a {@item club|PHB}) and defends himself.
zh_tw: 侏儒廚師默爾（{@creature commoner||平民}），從早上6點工作到午夜。面對危險時，他會抓起擀麵杖（視作{@item club|PHB|短棒}）進行自衛。

english: The door that leads outside is used mainly for food deliveries and is barred shut from the inside at night.
zh_tw: 通往室外的門主要用於食品配送，並且在夜間從內部鎖上。

english: C3: Servants' Quarters
zh_tw: C3. 僕人宿舍

english: This room contains three two-level bunk beds, one of which is currently in use. A washbasin stands in a nearby corner.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含三個雙層床鋪，其中一張目前有人使用。一個洗手盆位於附近的角落。

english: Merle, the cook, claims the lower bunk as his. Vordell, the housekeeper, sleeps in the bunk above him.
zh_tw: 廚師默爾聲稱下鋪是他的。管家沃德爾睡在他上面的上鋪。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each servant has a footlocker that contains personal effects and earnings. Characters who empty the two footlockers find a total of 8 gp, 55 sp, and 62 cp. Merle's footlocker also contains an ivory smoking pipe (25 gp), an electrum-framed hand mirror (25 gp), and a small pair of silvered shears (10 gp) he uses to trim his beard.
zh_tw: 每位僕人都有一個腳箱，裡面裝有個人物品和收入。角色如果清空兩個腳箱，會發現總共有8金幣，55銀幣和62銅幣。梅爾的腳箱裡還有一支象牙菸鬥（25金幣），一個銠金框手鏡（25金幣），以及一對用來修剪鬍鬚的小型鍍銀剪刀（10金幣）。

english: C4: Gallery
zh_tw: C4. 畫廊

english: Several padded armchairs are arranged in this narrow chamber, the walls of which are festooned with hunting trophies and crossbows. Bare hooks and pale rectangles mark places on the walls where paintings once hung. Standing in the southwest corner near a single door is a stuffed wolf, its glassy gaze fixed on a stone staircase going up.
zh_tw: 這個狹窄的房間裡擺放著幾個有墊子的扶手椅，牆壁上裝飾著狩獵戰利品和十字弓。裸露的鉤子和牆壁上的淺色矩形標記著曾經掛畫的地方。站在西南角，靠近一扇門的地方，是一隻填充的狼，它那呆滯的目光注視著向上的石階。

english: Between 1 p.m. and 5 p.m., Sythian's students relax here. Three {@creature Quasit||quasits} lurk by the stuffed wolf and use their Invisibility action to remain unseen. They attack characters who try to break into {@area area C5|2c1|x}.
zh_tw: 下午1點到5點之間，西提安的學生們在這裡放鬆。三隻{@creature Quasit||小惡魔}潛伏在填充狼旁邊，並使用它們的隱形動作保持不被看見。它們會攻擊試圖闖入{@area 區域C5|2c1|x}的角色。

english: The missing paintings were sold at auctions to pay off some of Sythian's debts. The remaining decor includes three {@item Light Crossbow|PHB|light crossbows} and three {@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|heavy crossbows} (all of which are functional but missing ammunition) mounted on the walls, as well as a stag's head mounted above a fireplace.
zh_tw: 失竊的畫作已在拍賣中售出，用以償還西提安的部分債務。剩餘的裝飾品包括三把掛在牆上的{@item Light Crossbow|PHB|輕弩}和三把{@item Heavy Crossbow|PHB|重弩}（所有弩都是功能性的，但缺少彈藥），以及掛在壁爐上方的一隻鹿頭。

english: {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV} conspires with three quasits, including one in centipede form and one in bat form
zh_tw: {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特} 與三個小惡魔合謀，包括一個以蜈蚣形態和一個以蝙蝠形態出現的小惡魔

english: C5: Shrine (Locked)
zh_tw: C5. 神龕（鎖著的）

english: Students and guests are not allowed in this room, which is why Sythian locks the door.
zh_tw: 學生和客人不允許進入這個房間，這就是為什麼西提安鎖上了門。

english: Sythian's father, Vexxis, worshiped gods of the hunt and the harvest. When he died, this room fell into disuse until {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV} showed up and convinced Sythian to empty it and repurpose the shrine for the worship of Graz'zt. Vordell, the housekeeper, is the only person besides Sythian and Joster who's allowed to enter this area.
zh_tw: 西提安的父親，維克西斯，崇拜狩獵和豐收之神。他去世後，這個房間就廢棄了，直到{@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}出現並說服西提安清空它，並將神龕重新用於崇拜格拉茲特。管家沃德爾是除了西提安和喬斯特之外唯一被允許進入這個區域的人。

english: Dark curtains cover the windows of this room, which looks like it might have been a chapel, though most of the decor is gone, leaving empty niches and pedestals. A demonic stone hand rises from the floor and clutches a three-foot-tall, three-foot-wide brazier. The hand has five fingers instead of four.
zh_tw: 這個房間的窗戶被深色窗簾覆蓋，看起來可能曾經是一個禮拜堂，儘管大部分裝飾已經不見了，只留下空蕩蕩的壁龕和底座。一隻惡魔石手從地板上升起，緊握著一個三尺高、三尺寬的火盆。這隻手有五個手指而不是四個。

english: The stone hand merges seamlessly with the stone floor. Spilling a few drops of Humanoid blood into the brazier causes the brazier's coals to produce a hissing purple flame and oily, purplish smoke that reeks of offal. When Sythian summons the flame and speaks to it, the flame responds to him in Graz'zt's whispered voice, but only when the demon lord is in the mood to talk.
zh_tw: 石手與石地板無縫融合。向火盆中滴入幾滴類人生物的血液會導致火盆的炭火產生嘶嘶作響的紫色火焰和油膩的紫色煙霧，散發出內臟的惡臭。當西提安召喚火焰並與之對話時，火焰會以格拉茲特的低語聲回應他，但只有在惡魔領主有心情交談時才會這樣。

english: A character who examines the brazier and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check realizes that it's used by worshipers of Graz'zt to commune with the demon lord, who requires a blood sacrifice. As an action, a character can spill some of their own blood into the bowl and utter a prayer to Graz'zt; doing so has a 10 percent chance of annoying the demon lord, who causes four {@creature Shadow Demon||shadow demons} to appear in the room and attack. These demons return to the Abyss after 10 minutes and disappear instantly when slain. (Graz'zt speaks only to those he considers worthy of his attention; the characters don't qualify in this regard.)
zh_tw: 一個檢查這個火盆並透過了 {@dc 17} 智力 ({@skill Religion||宗教}) 檢定的角色會意識到，這是格拉茲特的崇拜者用來與這位惡魔領主溝通的工具，且需要進行血祭。作為一個動作，角色可以將自己的血液灑入碗中並向格拉茲特祈禱；這樣做有10%的機率激怒這位惡魔領主，他會召喚四隻 {@creature Shadow Demon||幽影惡魔} 出現在房間中併發起攻擊。這些惡魔在10分鐘後會返回無底深淵，並在被擊殺時立即消失。（格拉茲特只會與他認為值得關注的個體交談；角色在這種情況下並不符合他的標準。）

english: C6: Mezzanine
zh_tw: C6. 夾層

english: This wooden mezzanine encircles the dining hall at a height of fifteen feet, and the ceiling is fifteen feet higher still. Two chandeliers hang from ropes, the ends of which are wrapped around hooks bolted to the railing—one to the north, the other to the south.
zh_tw: 這個木製的夾層環繞在餐廳上方，高度為十五尺，天花板則更高出十五尺。兩個吊燈從繩索上懸掛下來，繩索的末端纏繞在固定到欄杆的鉤子上——一個在北邊，另一個在南邊。

english: The mezzanine creaks loudly when stepped on. Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to cross the mezzanine quietly have disadvantage.
zh_tw: 踩在夾層上時會發出很大的吱吱聲。在夾層上悄無聲息地移動的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定會受到不利影響。

english: C7: Students' Quarters
zh_tw: C7. 學生宿舍

english: Students sometimes practice music in their rooms from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. All students can be found in their rooms from midnight until shortly before 8 a.m. (see the {@area Conservatory Schedule table|2a1|x}).
zh_tw: 學生們有時會在晚上6點到9點在自己的房間裡練習音樂。從午夜到早上8點前不久，所有學生都可以在他們的房間裡找到（見{@area 音樂學院日程表|2a1|x}）。

english: Each of these rooms contains a single bed, a dresser, a washbasin, a chamber pot, and an iron stove with clawed feet with a stovepipe that funnels smoke into the nearby chimney. A mirror is mounted on the inside of the door. Other features of each room are summarized below:
zh_tw: 這些房間中的每一個都包含一張單人床、一個梳妝檯、一個洗手盆、一個便壺，以及一個帶爪足的鐵爐，爐管將煙霧引入附近的煙囪。一面鏡子安裝在門內側。每個房間的其他特點如下所述：

english: C7a:
zh_tw: C7a:

english: Wylie's Room. Resting on the dresser is a wooden case containing a beautifully crafted lyre (250 gp) that belongs to Wylie van Timmel.
zh_tw: 懷利的房間。梳妝檯上放著一個木製盒子，裡面裝著一把製作精美的里拉琴（250金幣），它屬於懷利·范·提梅爾。

english: C7b:
zh_tw: C7b:

english: Joster's Room. Joster has claimed this vacant room for himself and uses it primarily as a studio to paint portraits of new students. (These paintings end up on the walls in {@area area C1|2b6|x}.) A wooden easel stands near the window, and a collection of paints and brushes rests on the windowsill. Leaning against the base of the easel are three blank canvases stretched over wooden frames.
zh_tw: 喬斯特的房間。喬斯特已經將這個空房間據為己有，主要用作畫新學生肖像的工作室。（這些畫作最終會掛在{@area 區域C1|2b6|x}的牆上。）一個木製畫架靠近窗戶，窗戶上放著一些顏料和畫筆。三個繃在木框上的空白畫布靠在畫架底座上。

english: C7c:
zh_tw: C7c:

english: Mytchyl's Room. When present, Mytchyl Dwyer lies on his bed with his wheelchair close by. Mounted on the wall above the headboard are three songbirds carved from driftwood.
zh_tw: 米奇爾的房間。當米奇爾·德懷爾在場時，他會躺在床上，他的輪椅就放在旁邊。床頭板上方的牆上掛著三隻用浮木雕刻的鳴禽。

english: C7d:
zh_tw: C7d:

english: Spare Room. No one uses this room currently.
zh_tw: 備用房間。目前沒有人使用這個房間。

english: C7e:
zh_tw: C7e:

english: Mazia's Room. Mazia Foulard keeps a diary and a small leather case tucked under her pillow. The case contains an exquisitely crafted silver flute (250 gp) that was given to Mazia by her grandmother.
zh_tw: 瑪齊婭的房間。瑪齊婭·福爾拉德在枕頭下藏有一本日記和一個小皮箱。箱子裡裝有一支由她祖母贈送的精美製作的銀質長笛（250金幣）。

english: C7f:
zh_tw: C7f:

english: Embry's Room. Odors waft into this room from the kitchen. Embry Hale has a framed painting on one wall that depicts the silhouette of a satyr playing a trumpet (25 gp). Tucked under Embry's mattress is a wooden smoking pipe and packet of pipe tobacco.
zh_tw: 安布里的房間。從廚房飄來陣陣氣味進入這個房間。安布里·黑爾在一面牆上有一幅鑲框的畫作，描繪了一個吹奏小號的半羊人的剪影（25金幣）。在安布里的床墊下藏著一個木製菸鬥和一包菸絲。

english: C8: Bathroom
zh_tw: C8. 浴室

english: Dry towels are stacked on a shelf above a row of empty hooks by the door. Protruding from the far wall is a funnel-shaped shower head, below which is an iron knob.
zh_tw: 乾燥的毛巾疊放在門旁一排空掛鉤上方的架子上。遠處牆上伸出一個漏斗形狀的淋浴頭，其下方是一個鐵製旋鈕。

english: The servants shower here every night after finishing their chores, while students shower here before breakfast each morning.
zh_tw: 僕人們在每天晚上完成家務後在這裡洗澡，而學生們則在每天早上早餐前在這裡洗澡。

english: Turning the iron knob causes hot water to spring from the shower head. The water, which is produced magically, disappears through drains in the floor.
zh_tw: 旋轉鐵製旋鈕會使得熱水從淋浴頭噴出。這些水是魔法產生的，透過地板上的排水口消失。

english: C9: Sythian's Bathroom (Locked)
zh_tw: C9. 西提安的浴室（鎖著的）

english: Sythian showers here every morning before breakfast. This room is otherwise identical to {@area area C8|2c6|x}.
zh_tw: 西提安每天早上早餐前在這裡洗澡。這個房間在其他方面與{@area 區域C8|2c6|x}相同。

english: C10: Laundry Room
zh_tw: C10. 洗衣房

english: The window of this room is opened a crack to let in fresh air. Damp towels and clothing hang on wooden racks, and a washtub with a scrubbing board rests under a spigot that protrudes from one wall, near a shelf lined with bars of soap.
zh_tw: 這個房間的窗戶微微開啟，以讓新鮮空氣進入。潮溼的毛巾和衣物掛在木製架子上，一個洗衣盆和一個搓衣板放在從一面牆上伸出的水龍頭下，靠近一個擺滿了肥皂條的架子。

english: Turning the spigot on the wall causes hot water, which is produced magically, to flow from a faucet and into the washtub, which has a drain plug in the bottom of it.
zh_tw: 旋轉牆上的水龍頭會使得熱水，這是透過魔法產生的，從龍頭流出並流入洗衣盆，盆底部有一個排水塞。

english: C11: Music Hall
zh_tw: C11. 音樂廳

english: This spacious room contains several large instruments, including a harp, a harpsichord, a piano, a cello, and three kettle drums. More portable instruments—such as fiddles, ukuleles, accordions, bagpipes, lutes, lyres, oboes, brass horns, bongos, and violins—rest on padded chairs spaced evenly around the perimeter. Eight rectangular, stained-glass skylights give the chamber a cathedral-like aspect. The room's three double doors have built-in, hand-carved panels depicting scenes of dancing and merrymaking.
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的房間內擺放著幾件大型樂器，包括一架豎琴、一架大鍵琴、一架鋼琴、一架大提琴和三面定音鼓。更便攜的樂器——如小提琴、尤克里裡、手風琴、風笛、琵琶、里拉琴、雙簧管、銅管樂器、邦戈鼓和小提琴——放置在房間周邊均勻分佈的有墊椅子上。八個長方形的彩色玻璃天窗賦予了這個房間一種類似大教堂的氛圍。房間的三扇雙開門上有手工雕刻的嵌板，描繪了跳舞和歡樂的場景。

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}) is here with his students from 9 a.m. to noon. The students often return to this room between the hours of 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. to play music without supervision.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}（見{@area 冒險末尾|2e9|x}）從上午 9 點到中午會和學生待在這裡。學生常在晚上 6 點至 9 點之間回到這個房間，自行演奏音樂，無人監督。

english: Three {@creature Quasit||quasits} lurk under chairs, using their Invisibility action to hide. They attack any intruder who picks up or plays one of the instruments.
zh_tw: 三個{@creature Quasit||小惡魔}潛伏在椅子下面，使用它們的隱形動作來隱藏。它們會攻擊任何拿起或演奏這些樂器的入侵者。

english: Instruments
zh_tw: 樂器

english: Sythian could pay off most of his debts by selling his impressive collection of musical instruments, but he refuses to do so.
zh_tw: 西提安可以透過出售他那令人印象深刻的樂器收藏來償還大部分債務，但他拒絕這麼做。

english: C12: Outdoor Balcony
zh_tw: C12. 室外陽臺

english: A stone battlement encloses this balcony, which overlooks the main entrance.
zh_tw: 這個陽臺被石制的城垛所環繞，可以俯瞰主入口。

english: The {@creature chasme} on the rooftop ({@area area C18|2df|x}) creeps down the exterior wall to attack characters on this balcony. It's a 30-foot drop from the balcony to the ground.
zh_tw: 屋頂上的{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}（{@area 區域C18|2df|x}）悄悄沿著外牆爬下來，攻擊這個陽臺上的角色。從陽臺到地面是一個30尺的落差。

english: C13: Hallway
zh_tw: C13. 走廊

english: Standing in an alcove at the north end of this hallway is an empty suit of armor, its vacant helm staring past the cage elevator toward the double door at the opposite end of the hall.
zh_tw: 站在這個走廊北端的一個凹室裡是一套空的盔甲，它空洞的頭盔凝視著籠式電梯，望向走廊另一端的雙扇門。

english: The elevator climbs no higher than this hallway.
zh_tw: 電梯不會上升到超過這個走廊的高度。

english: Trapped Secret Door
zh_tw: 陷阱密門

english: A secret door disguised to look like a section of wood-paneled wall is hidden behind the suit of armor. A character can detect the secret door by searching the wall and succeeding on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. A successful check also reveals a faint glyph on the secret door—the telltale sign of a {@spell glyph of warding} spell. Only Sythian can open the door without triggering the glyph. When the glyph triggers, each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the suit of armor suffers the effect of a {@spell shatter} spell (save {@dc 14}). The spell also causes the suit of armor to fall to pieces and alerts Sythian and Joster in {@area area C15|2d6|x} if they are there. Once the spell goes off, the secret door is no longer trapped.
zh_tw: 一扇偽裝成木製牆板的秘密門隱藏在盔甲後面。角色可以透過搜尋牆壁併成功進行一次 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定來發現這扇秘密門。成功的檢定還會揭示秘密門上有一個微弱的符文——這是 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 魔法的標誌。只有西提安可以開啟這扇門而不觸發符文。當符文被觸發時，以盔甲為中心的10尺半徑範圍內的每個生物都會受到 {@spell shatter||粉碎音波} 法術的效果（豁免 {@dc 14}）。該法術還會使盔甲碎裂成碎片，並提醒西提安和喬斯特在 {@area 區域C15|2d6|x} 如果他們在這裡。一旦法術觸發，秘密門將不再有陷阱。

english: The secret door is unlocked and leads to area C14.
zh_tw: 秘密門是開著的，通向區域 C14。

english: C14: Sythian's Study
zh_tw: C14. 西提安的書房

english: An unlocked rolltop desk is pushed against the west wall of this study. The desk's chair has a large S carved into its backrest. Near the desk, a wooden staircase spirals up.
zh_tw: 一個未上鎖的卷蓋式書桌靠在書房的西牆上。書桌的椅子背上刻有一個大寫的字母S。在書桌附近，一個木製樓梯螺旋上升。

english: Between the hours of 1 p.m. and 5 p.m., {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}) is here, reading and writing letters, as well as reviewing applications from the families of young hopefuls who seek to benefit from his tutelage. While Sythian is here, Joster the {@creature incubus} reverts to his true form and looms over Sythian's shoulder.
zh_tw: 下午1點到5點之間，{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}（見冒險的{@area 冒險的結束|2e9|x}）在這裡閱讀和寫信，同時審查那些希望從他的教導中受益的年輕有為者家庭提交的申請。當西提安在這裡時，喬斯特這個{@creature incubus||夢魔}變回了他的真身，站在西提安的肩膀上方。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The desk is stuffed with quills, {@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|ink jars}, {@item Candle|PHB|candles}, {@item Sealing Wax|PHB|wax seals}, and {@item Parchment (one sheet)|PHB|sheets of parchment}. A thorough search of the desk takes 1 minute and yields a small wooden coffer containing 270 gp, 165 sp, and 89 cp.
zh_tw: 書桌上塞滿了羽毛筆、{@item Ink (1-ounce bottle)|PHB|墨水瓶}、{@item Candle|PHB|蠟燭}、{@item Sealing Wax|PHB|封蠟}和{@item Parchment (one sheet)|PHB|羊皮紙}。徹底搜查書桌需要1分鐘，並會找到一個裝有270金幣、165銀幣和89銅幣的小木箱。

english: C15: Sythian's Quarters (Locked)
zh_tw: C15. 西提安的住處（鎖著的）

english: This room contains a canopied bed and other furnishings, including a corner fireplace flanked by stone-carved hunting mastiffs. A large trunk rests at the foot of the bed.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張帶天篷的床和其他傢俱，包括一個角落的壁爐，壁爐兩側是石雕的獵犬。床腳放著一個大箱子。

english: Canaith Mandolin
zh_tw: 卡奈斯曼陀林

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}) is here from midnight until 8 a.m.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}（見冒險的{@area 冒險的結束|2e9|x}）從午夜到早上8點在這裡。

english: Trapped Trunk
zh_tw: 被困的樹幹

english: A character who examines the trunk and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check detects a faint glyph on its lid—the telltale sign of a {@spell glyph of warding} spell. The first time a creature other than Sythian opens the trunk, the spell goes off, targeting the creature that opened the trunk with a {@spell suggestion} spell (save {@dc 14}). On a successful saving throw, the creature resists the spell. On a failed saving throw, the creature is compelled to leave the room empty-handed and not return for 8 hours (the duration of the spell). Once the glyph is triggered, the trunk is safe to open.
zh_tw: 一個檢查箱子的角色，如果成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會發現在箱蓋上有微弱的符文——這是 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 法術的跡象。第一次任何非西提安的生物開啟箱子時，法術會觸發，對開啟箱子的生物施放 {@spell suggestion||暗示術} 法術（豁免 {@dc 14}）。如果成功透過豁免檢定，生物抵抗了該法術。如果豁免檢定失敗，生物會被迫空手離開房間，並在8小時（法術的持續時間）內不得返回。一旦符文被觸發，箱子便可以安全開啟。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The trunk contains, among personal items and clothing of little value, the {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||instrument of the bards (Canaith mandolin)} stolen from Froderic Dartwild's grave.
zh_tw: 在這隻箱子裡，除了一些價值不大的個人物品和衣物外，還有從弗羅迪裡克·達特懷爾德的墳墓中偷來的{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||吟遊詩人的樂器（凱納斯曼陀林）}。

english: C16: Attic
zh_tw: C16. 閣樓

english: Gray sheets cover old furniture in this dusty attic.
zh_tw: 灰色的床單覆蓋著這個佈滿灰塵的閣樓裡的舊傢俱。

english: Characters who spend at least 1 minute searching the attic find two life-sized wooden mannequins—one wearing a green wedding dress, the other a white funeral dress. Both dresses belonged to Sythian's mother. They also find a wooden chest that is padlocked; the key is lost, but a character can take an action to try to pick the lock using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 角色若花費至少1分鐘搜尋閣樓，會發現兩個真人大小的人體模型——一個穿著綠色的婚紗，另一個穿著白色的喪服。這兩件衣服都屬於西西安的母親。他們還會發現一個上了掛鎖的木箱；鑰匙已丟失，但角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開鎖，這需要一個成功的{@dc 17}敏捷檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the padlocked chest, wrapped in leather, is a flat wooden case whose lid is engraved with a pair of stags locking horns. The case contains six {@item +2 Crossbow Bolt||+2 crossbow bolts}. Sythian is unaware of these items and won't miss them if someone takes them.
zh_tw: 鎖著的箱子裡，用皮革包裹著的是一個木製的扁平箱子，箱子蓋上雕刻著一對鹿角相鎖的雄鹿。箱子裡裝有六支{@item +2 Crossbow Bolt||+2 弩矢}。西提安並不知道這些物品，如果有人拿走它們，他也不會察覺。

english: C17: Library (Locked)
zh_tw: C17. 圖書館（鎖著的）

english: Empty bookshelves stand between the windows of this musty tower attic.
zh_tw: 這個潮溼的塔樓閣樓的窗戶之間立著空蕩蕩的書架。

english: Sythian sold his family's collection of books to pay off debts. A locked door leads to the rooftop (area C18).
zh_tw: 西提安為了償還債務出售了他家族的書籍收藏。一扇鎖著的門通向屋頂（區域C18）。

english: C18: Rooftop
zh_tw: C18. 屋頂

english: A three-foot-high stone battlement encloses this rooftop. Mounted on one corner of the battlement is a flagpole flying a black pennant emblazoned with a golden olive tree. A chimney pipe juts from the opposite corner, and an oak door leads to each tower.
zh_tw: 一個三尺高的石制城垛環繞著這個屋頂。城垛的一個角上裝有一個旗杆，上面飄揚著一面黑色的旗幟，上面繡著一棵金色的橄欖樹。一個煙囪管從對面的角落伸出，每座塔樓都有一扇橡木門通向那裡。

english: A five-foot-wide walkway wraps around a convex structure composed of eight large stained-glass windows in lead frames. Each skylight is a work of art, its panes shaped and colored to resemble a rising or setting sun.
zh_tw: 一條五尺寬的步道環繞著一個由八個大型彩色玻璃窗組成的凸面結構，這些窗戶都裝在鉛製框架中。每扇天窗都是一件藝術品，其窗格的形狀和顏色都被設計成類似升起或落下的太陽。

english: It's a 45-foot drop from the rooftop to the ground.
zh_tw: 從屋頂到地面是45尺的落差。

english: Unless it has been fought and killed elsewhere, a {@creature chasme} guards this area. At your discretion, the demon might be perched above a doorway, waiting to ambush intruders emerging from one of the towers.
zh_tw: 除非它在別處被戰鬥並殺死，否則一個{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}守衛著這個區域。根據您的判斷，這個惡魔可能棲息在門道上方，等待伏擊從一座塔樓中出現的入侵者。

english: Flagpole
zh_tw: 旗杆

english: The flagpole in the southwest corner is made of metal and is sturdy enough to bear the weight of characters who wish to lower themselves down a wall or through a skylight.
zh_tw: 位於西南角的旗杆由金屬製成，足夠堅固，可以承受想要沿著牆壁或透過天窗下降的角色的重量。

english: Skylights
zh_tw: 天窗

english: There are eight skylights, each one a Large object with AC 13, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Rather than shattering an entire skylight, a character can take an action to break or pry out one of a skylight's panes, creating a hole big enough to slip through. It's a 15-foot drop from the skylights to the floor of {@area area C11|2cb|x}.
zh_tw: 有八個天窗，每一個都是一個大型物體，AC（護甲等級）為13，有5點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。與其打碎整個天窗，角色可以採取行動打破或撬開天窗的一格，從而製造一個足夠滑過的洞。從天窗到{@area 區域C11|2cb|x}的地板是一個15尺的落差。

english: Leaving Post-Heist
zh_tw: 逃離搶劫現場

english: If the characters leave the conservatory with Golden Axe and the {@creature chasme} in area C18 is still alive, the demon swoops down and attacks the characters before they get too far. The demon's goal is to return the mandolin to the conservatory. The mandolin is, after all, Sythian's ticket to earning the patronage of Wylie van Timmel's family.
zh_tw: 如果角色們帶著金斧離開音樂學院，並且區域C18的{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}仍然活著，這個惡魔會俯衝下來，在角色們走遠之前攻擊他們。惡魔的目標是將曼陀林帶迴音樂學院。畢竟，曼陀林是西提安贏得懷利·范·提梅爾家族贊助的關鍵。

english: You can make this final encounter deadlier by adding either a second {@creature chasme} or a {@creature barlgura}.
zh_tw: 您可以透過增加第二隻{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}或一隻{@creature barlgura||惡猿魔}來使這場最終遭遇更加致命。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: Once Golden Axe is safely in their possession, the characters must decide whether to keep it for themselves (in which case the adventure ends here) or return it to its rightful owner (see "Buried Again" below).
zh_tw: 一旦金斧安全地掌握在他們手中，角色們必須決定是將其保留給自己（這種情況下，冒險在這裡結束），還是將其歸還給合法所有者（見下文的"再次埋葬"）。

english: Buried Again
zh_tw: 再次埋葬

english: If Golden Axe is returned to {@creature Frody Dartwild|KftGV}, read:
zh_tw: 如果金斧被歸還給{@creature Frody Dartwild|KftGV|弗羅迪·達特維爾德}，請閱讀：

english: Froderic Dartwild plucks the strings of the mandolin and plays a happy tune. Meanwhile, the news of your return spreads through Toadhop like wildfire. Everyone comes out to greet you, including Honorary Mayor Jenna Bean, who snorts contentedly. Frody apologizes to everyone for the trouble he has caused and says he looks forward to returning to his grave. His words bring tears as well as cheers.
zh_tw: 弗羅迪裡克·達特懷爾德彈撥著曼陀林的琴絃，演奏著歡快的曲調。與此同時，你們歸來的訊息像野火一樣在蟾蜍鎮迅速傳播。包括榮譽市長珍娜·豆在內的所有人都出來迎接你們，她滿意地哼了一聲。弗羅迪向所有人為造成的麻煩道歉，並說他期待著回到他的墳墓。他的話既帶來了淚水，也帶來了歡呼。

english: A local carpenter named Lewth Fulchre (the father of local rabble-rouser Ebbin Fulchre) offers to repair Frody's coffin, which shouldn't take more than a few hours. While Frody waits, he performs his favorite music to an enrapt crowd outside My Left Boot. If there's a bard or another musically inclined individual among the player characters, Frody suggests they perform together as a duet. If the character agrees, award them inspiration.
zh_tw: 一位名叫盧斯·富爾徹（當地麻煩製造者埃賓·富爾徹的父親）的木匠主動提出為弗洛迪修理棺材，這應該不會超過幾個小時。在弗洛迪等待期間，他在'我的左靴'酒館外為著迷的觀眾表演他最愛的音樂。如果玩家角色中有吟遊詩人或其他擅長音樂的角色，弗洛迪會建議他們一起表演二重奏。如果角色同意，給予他們激勵。

english: Everyone in Toadhop attends Frody's second funeral, which you can summarize as follows:
zh_tw: 蟾蜍鎮的每個人都參加了弗羅迪的第二次葬禮，你可以如下概述：

english: After Frody is returned to the earth, Toadhop's residents stand around his grave wearing straw hats—a local custom, you reckon—to sing a somber hymn. A little girl lays a tiny flower on the dead bard's grave before returning to the arms of her weeping parents. As the crowd disperses, locals pat you on the back and shoulder and congratulate you on a quest well done.
zh_tw: 當弗羅迪迴歸大地後，蟾跳鎮的居民們戴著草帽——你推測這是當地的習俗——圍繞著他的墳墓唱著悲傷的聖歌。一個小女孩在回到哭泣的父母懷抱之前，在已故吟遊詩人的墳墓上放了一朵小花。隨著人群散去，當地人拍拍你的背和肩膀，祝賀你完成了一次出色的任務。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, a representative of the organization offers the characters a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment for returning the Canaith mandolin to Frody. The reward is delivered to the characters a day or two after Frody's reburial.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，該組織的一位代表會提供一件稀有的魔法物品作為報酬（需經您批准），以獎勵他們將卡納伊曼陀林歸還給弗羅迪。弗羅迪重新安葬後的一兩天，獎勵會送達角色們手中。

english: Sythian Skalderang
zh_tw: 西提安·斯考德蘭

english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} has been blessed by the demon lord {@creature Graz'zt|MPMM}. Graz'zt's gift to Sythian manifests in several ways, including Sythian's ability to conjure demonic whispers that can fray enemy minds.
zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}得到了惡魔領主{@creature Graz'zt|MPMM|格拉茲特}的祝福。格拉茲特對西提安的贈禮以多種方式顯現，包括西提安能夠召喚惡魔的低語，這些低語可以擾亂敵人的心智。

english: When he was a young boy, Sythian went on a hunting trip with his father. A {@creature giant toad} attacked them and swallowed Sythian. Although Sythian escaped after his father slew the monster, the attack left Sythian with an acute fear of frogs and toads.
zh_tw: 當西提安還是個小男孩的時候，他和父親一起去打獵。一隻{@creature giant toad||巨蟾}襲擊了他們併吞下了西提安。儘管西提安在父親殺死怪物後逃脫了，但這次襲擊給西提安留下了對青蛙和蟾蜍的極度恐懼。

english: Sythian's parents hoped his interest in music would lead Sythian to become an extraordinary musician; he became a mediocre one instead, despite the help of several renowned tutors. Years later, Sythian resents their efforts, as the money his parents lavished on his education left him with many unpaid debts. Now that his parents are dead, he is determined to hold on to his estate and will do whatever it takes to keep what he has left.
zh_tw: 西提安的父母希望他對音樂的興趣能讓西提安成為一名傑出的音樂家;然而，儘管有幾位名師的協助，他還是成了一個平庸的學生。多年後，西提安怨恨他們的努力，因為他的父母在他教育上的慷慨給他留下了許多待償的債務。現在他的父母都去世了，他決心要保住自己的財產，不惜一切代價保住自己剩下的東西。

english: Sythian has attuned to Golden Axe so that he can learn and exercise the {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||Canaith mandolin's} properties. Although he hopes Golden Axe will earn him the good graces and financial support of the van Timmels, Sythian would sooner lose the instrument than see any harm befall his students, as his reputation and financial success hinge on their well-being. He gladly gives up the instrument to save himself.
zh_tw: 西提安已經與金斧調諧，以便他能夠學習和運用{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||卡納伊曼陀林的}屬性。儘管他希望金斧能為他贏得范·提梅爾家族的青睞和財務支援，但西提安寧願失去這個樂器，也不願看到他的學生遭受任何傷害，因為他的聲譽和財務成功取決於他們的福祉。為了自保，他願意放棄這個樂器。

english: Sythian is an impatient and demanding teacher who holds his students to a rigorous schedule. His bone conductor's wand doubles as a spellcasting focus.
zh_tw: 西提安是一位沒有耐心、要求很高的老師，他給學生制定了嚴格的時間表。他的骨制指揮棒還可以作為施法法器。

english: Vidorant's Vault
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特的金庫

english: {@i An Adventure for 7th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合7級角色的冒險}

english: Over the years, the notorious elf thief {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV} has stolen many famed prizes and stored them in her vault. Her former partner believes one of these trophies—a ruby diadem—rightly belongs to him. He hires the characters to infiltrate Vidorant's vault, bypass its security features, and steal the diadem. In a twist, the characters come face-to-face with Vidorant, and she offers them a deal that's hard to refuse.
zh_tw: 多年來，聲名狼藉的精靈盜賊{@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}偷取了許多著名的寶物並將它們儲存在她的金庫中。她的前合夥人認為其中一件戰利品——一枚紅寶石王冠——理應屬於他。他僱傭角色們潛入維朵蘭特的金庫，繞過其安全特性，並偷取王冠。在一個轉折中，角色們與維朵蘭特面對面，並她向他們提出了一個難以拒絕的交易。

english: {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV}'s guards are not yet aware of the would-be thieves lurking below them
zh_tw: {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}的守衛們還沒有意識到潛藏在他們下方的潛在小偷

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: The Silver Fingers Society is no mere guild of pickpockets and ruffians. The elite thieves of this multinational organization pull off impossible heists, targeting crown jewels, national secrets, and other heavily guarded prizes. Decades ago, the elf {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV} joined the Silver Fingers, where she partnered with a dwarf named Samphith Goldenbeard. These friendly rivals made a good pair. Vidorant was skilled with picking locks and deftly getting into tough places, and Goldenbeard used his connections and quick thinking to research targets and talk the pair's way out of trouble.
zh_tw: 銀手指協會不僅僅是一個小偷和流氓的公會。這個跨國組織的精英盜賊們執行著看似不可能的盜竊行動，目標是皇冠珠寶、國家機密以及其他嚴密守護的獎品。幾十年前，精靈{@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}加入了銀手指，在那兒她與一個名叫桑菲斯·金鬚的矮人成為了搭檔。這些友好的競爭對手成為了一對好搭檔。維朵蘭特擅長開鎖，並且能熟練地進入困難的地方，而金鬚則利用他的人脈和快速思考來研究目標，以及用言辭讓兩人擺脫麻煩。

english: As the years passed, the duo rose in the ranks of the Silver Fingers. But their partnership abruptly ended when they stole the Ruby Diadem, an heirloom once worn by Queen Erlynn Blessedore. Goldenbeard's family traces its lineage to the dwarven queen, who was captured in a battle centuries ago, and he desperately wanted to reclaim his family's diadem. The heist seemed like any other—until thirty guards suddenly surrounded the pair of thieves. Vidorant nimbly escaped via the roof with the diadem in hand, but Goldenbeard was caught. He avoided imprisonment by calling in favors with powerful friends, but when he tracked down Vidorant, she refused to hand over the diadem despite his family's claim to it.
zh_tw: 隨著歲月流逝，這對搭檔在銀手指中的排名上升。但他們的合作關係在偷竊紅寶石王冠時突然結束，這是一件曾經由矮人女王埃爾林·布萊索雷佩戴的傳家寶。金鬚的家族血統可以追溯到那位幾個世紀前在戰鬥中被俘的矮人女王，他非常想奪回家族的王冠。搶劫看起來像其他任何一次——直到三十名守衛突然包圍了這對小偷。維朵蘭特手拿王冠，敏捷地透過屋頂逃脫，但金鬚被抓住了。他透過向有權勢的朋友求助避免了監禁，但當他找到維朵蘭特時，儘管他的家族聲稱擁有王冠，她拒絕交出王冠。

english: Goldenbeard claimed Vidorant set him up and alerted the authorities. Meanwhile, Vidorant claimed innocence, insisting Goldenbeard was covering for his own inability to escape the situation. Whatever the truth, she kept the diadem, the once-friendly rivalry turned bitter, and the two have tried to outmaneuver each other ever since.
zh_tw: 金鬚聲稱維朵蘭特陷害了他並向當局告了密。與此同時，維朵蘭特則堅稱自己無辜，堅持認為金鬚是在掩蓋他自己無法逃脫困境的事實。無論真相如何，她保留了那頂王冠，曾經友好的競爭變成了痛苦的敵意，從此兩人一直在試圖相互智勝。

english: Recently, their uneasy relationship changed again with the death of the longtime leader of the Silver Fingers Society. Vidorant and Goldenbeard each competed to win leadership of the society, calling in favors from every ally they had in the organization. Unfortunately for Vidorant, Goldenbeard proved defter at internal politics, winning leadership of the society—and getting Vidorant expelled in the process. Goldenbeard promised harsh retaliation against anyone who helped Vidorant, ensuring none of her former allies would stand against him.
zh_tw: 最近，隨著銀手指協會長期領袖的去世，他們之間微妙的關係再次發生了變化。維朵蘭特和金鬚各自競爭協會領導的位置，動用了他們在組織中的每一個盟友的人情。不幸的是，對於維朵蘭特來說，金鬚在內部政治上更為熟練，贏得了協會的領導權——並在此過程中將維朵蘭特驅逐出去。金鬚承諾將對任何幫助維朵蘭特的人進行嚴厲報復，確保她以前的盟友都不會反對他。

english: Weeks after his takeover of the Silver Fingers Society, Goldenbeard made an even bigger move against Vidorant. He promised a favor to any existing or aspiring Silver Finger who steals the Ruby Diadem of Erlynn Blessedore and delivers it to him. This challenge is the talk of scoundrel circles as everyone vies to steal the diadem from Vidorant. Doing so won't be easy, as Vidorant keeps her treasures in her secure vault on the outskirts of the city.
zh_tw: 在接管銀手指協會幾周後，金鬚對維朵蘭特採取了更大的行動。他向任何現有的或有抱負的銀手指承諾，只要有人能偷走埃爾林·布萊索雷的紅寶石王冠並交給他，他就會給予一個恩惠。這個挑戰在無賴們的圈子裡引起了熱議，每個人都爭相從維朵蘭特那裡偷走紅寶石王冠。要做到這一點並不容易，因為維朵蘭特把她的寶藏存放在城市郊區的安全金庫中。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. An heirloom diadem from a dwarven queen is in the possession of master thief {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV}. The queen's descendant, Samphith Goldenbeard, would like the diadem returned, and the Golden Vault finds value in allying with his Silver Fingers Society. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to infiltrate Vidorant's vault and recover the diadem. Start by meeting with Goldenbeard. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。一位矮人女王的傳家寶王冠現在在大盜{@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}的手中。女王的後裔，桑菲斯·金鬚，希望王冠能被歸還，而金庫認為與他的銀手指協會結盟具有價值。這個任務，如果你們選擇接受，需要你們潛入維朵蘭特的金庫並找回王冠。首先與金鬚會面。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Steal the Diadem
zh_tw: 偷走頭飾

english: To kick off this adventure, the characters receive an invitation to meet with the head of the Silver Fingers Society, Samphith Goldenbeard (lawful neutral, dwarf {@creature noble}). A character who is a thief or has the criminal background is familiar with the Silver Fingers Society, an elite organization for exceptional thieves.
zh_tw: 為了開始這場冒險，角色們收到了與銀手指協會的首領桑菲斯·金鬚（守序中立，矮人{@creature noble||貴族}）會面的邀請。如果角色是盜賊或有犯罪背景，他們就會熟悉銀手指協會，這是一個為傑出盜賊設立的精英組織。

english: Alternatively, the characters could hear about Goldenbeard's challenge to bring him the diadem through the gossip of other thieves; in this case, skip to the "{@area Preparation|2f2|x}" section.
zh_tw: 另外，角色們也可能透過其他小偷的流言蜚語聽說金鬚的挑戰，要將王冠帶給他；在這種情況下，請跳至"{@area 預備|2f2|x}"部分。

english: If the characters are too lawful or good to work with a thieves' guild, consider Goldenbeard approaching them simply as a descendant of Erlynn Blessedore, asking them to return the Ruby Diadem to its rightful heirs.
zh_tw: 如果角色們過於守法或善良，不願意與盜賊公會合作，可以考慮讓金鬚以埃爾林·布萊索雷的後裔的身份接近他們，請求他們將紅寶石王冠歸還給合法的繼承人。

english: Mission from Goldenbeard
zh_tw: 來自金鬚的任務

english: Goldenbeard asks the characters to meet with him in the back room of a restaurant, the Spoke and Wheel. When the party arrives, read the following:
zh_tw: 金鬚要求角色們在餐廳的後室，即輻條與車輪，與他見面。當團隊到達時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: An elegantly dressed dwarf greets you in the back room of the Spoke and Wheel, a polite smile gracing his face. He introduces himself as Goldenbeard and offers you tea. After everyone is served, he casually dips a pinky into his own cup and tastes a drop before taking a larger sip.
zh_tw: 在輻條與車輪的後室，一位穿著優雅的矮人帶著禮貌的微笑迎接你們。他自我介紹為金鬚，並提供茶水。當每個人都得到服務後，他漫不經心地將小指浸入自己的杯子，嚐了一小滴，然後才喝了一大口。

english: Once the characters sit down near him, Goldenbeard addresses them:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們坐在他旁邊，金鬚就會對他們說：

english: "It's a pleasure to meet you all. I'm sure you've heard of my organization, the Silver Fingers Society. Only the most elite thieves in the world qualify for membership.
zh_tw: "很高興見到你們所有人。我相信你們已經聽說過我的組織，銀手指協會。世界上只有最精英的盜賊才有資格成為會員。"

english: "You may have heard that {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV}, my former partner, is no longer with the Silver Fingers. We've withdrawn all protection from her and her property, and we now have room in the society for new members.
zh_tw: "你們可能聽說了，我的前搭檔{@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}已不再與銀手指為伍。我們已經撤回了對她及其財產的所有保護，現在協會裡有空間給新成員。"

english: "As such, I present to you a challenge. Whoever brings me the Ruby Diadem of Erlynn Blessedore from Nixylanna's personal vault will become a member of the society. As my family is descended from Queen Erlynn, we've wanted the diadem returned to us for years.
zh_tw: "因此，我向你們提出一個挑戰。無論是誰，只要能從尼克絲拉娜的私人金庫中為我帶來埃爾林·布萊索雷的紅寶石王冠，就將成為協會的成員。作為埃爾林女王的後裔，多年來我們一直希望這頂王冠能歸還給我們。"

english: "You can keep a few things for yourself from her collection, but I'd advise against too much distraction. Nixylanna has been a problem for me for a long time because she is very good at what she does. And remember: you cannot trust her."
zh_tw: "你們可以從她的收藏中為自己保留一些東西，但我建議不要分心太多。尼克絲拉娜對我來說一直是個問題，因為她非常擅長她的工作。還有記住：你不能信任她。"

english: Goldenbeard relates the information from "{@area Adventure Background|2eb|x}"—though told from his perspective. He explains the diadem is of only moderate value and has no magical properties, but its connection to his family and his history with Vidorant make it valuable to him.
zh_tw: 金鬚從他的角度講述了"{@area 冒險背景|2eb|x}"中的資訊。他解釋說，這頂王冠的價值只是中等，並且沒有魔法屬性，但由於它與他的家族和他與維朵蘭特的歷史聯絡，對他來說它是寶貴的。

english: If the characters are uninterested in membership in the Silver Fingers, Goldenbeard offers a reward of 2,000 gp, though he grumbles the reward is far more than the diadem is worth.
zh_tw: 如果角色們對加入銀手指協會不感興趣，金鬚提供了2000金幣的獎勵，儘管他抱怨說這個獎勵遠遠超過了王冠的價值。

english: Preparation
zh_tw: 預備

english: The party's preparation for the heist might include seeking information from Vidorant's former guards, surveilling Vidorant at her mansion, or staking out her vault. Though each approach can yield useful information, the characters shouldn't delay too much; other Silver Fingers may also be preparing to steal the diadem (at your discretion).
zh_tw: 團隊為這次搶劫做準備可能包括從維朵蘭特的前守衛那裡尋求資訊，在她的豪宅監視維朵蘭特，或者監視她的金庫。儘管每種方法都能提供有用的資訊，但角色們不應該拖延太久；其他銀手指成員也可能正在準備偷竊王冠（由你決定）。

english: Gathering Intelligence
zh_tw: 收集情報

english: By combing through local pubs or asking around with their own informants, the characters can locate up to six guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans}) formerly employed by Vidorant. Use the Former Guards table to help you roleplay each guard.
zh_tw: 透過在當地酒吧裡搜尋或詢問他們自己的線人，角色們可以找到多達六名以前受僱於維朵蘭特的守衛（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）。使用前守衛表格來幫助你扮演每個守衛的角色。

english: Former Guards
zh_tw: 前守衛

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Ex-Guard
zh_tw: 前守衛

english: Turolga Flathelm (neutral dwarf), a gruff woman who has a soft spot for stray cats
zh_tw: 圖羅爾加·平盔（中立矮人），一個粗魯的女人，對流浪貓有著柔軟的心地

english: Ballidyr Josephon (neutral human), a pompous man who refers to himself in the third person
zh_tw: 巴利迪爾·約瑟芬（中立人類），一個自大的男人，以第三人稱稱呼自己

english: Jeniana Damaritz (lawful neutral human), an aloof woman who talks to only the most well-dressed of the characters
zh_tw: 潔妮安娜·達馬里茲（守法中立人類），一個冷漠的女人，只與穿著最考究的角色交談

english: Pelten Kiwaris (chaotic neutral human), a gregarious person who invites the characters to join them at a party
zh_tw: 佩爾滕·基瓦里斯（混亂中立人類），一個社交的人，邀請角色們參加一個派對

english: Kavton Bouldersight (neutral halfling), a jocular man who sells stolen goods
zh_tw: 卡夫頓·岩眼（中立半精靈）,一個愛開玩笑的男人，他出售偷來的商品

english: Breelen Fibblezot (chaotic neutral gnome), a cheerful woman who fidgets constantly
zh_tw: 布利恩·費布林佐特（混亂中立侏儒），一個總是坐立不安的開朗女性

english: To convince a former guard to share information about the vault and its defenses, a character can make a {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check or another appropriate ability check, depending on their approach. A character who offers a bribe of 10 gp reduces the DC of this check by 5.
zh_tw: 為了讓一位前守衛分享關於金庫及其防禦措施的資訊，角色可以進行一次{@dc 12}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定或其他適當的技能檢定，具體取決於他們的方法。如果角色提供10金幣的賄賂，這次檢定的DC將減少5。

english: On a failed check, the former guard walks away, disinterested in further conversation. If other characters approach the guard later, the guard remains unwilling to share information about the vault.
zh_tw: 如果檢定失敗，前守衛會走開，對進一步的對話不感興趣。如果其他角色稍後接近守衛，守衛仍然不願意分享有關金庫的資訊。

english: On a successful check, the character convinces the former guard to reveal the basic layout of the vault's first floor, as shown on map 8.1. The guard also answers simple questions about Vidorant and her physical appearance, the guard uniforms, and other information every guard would know.
zh_tw: 在成功的檢定後，角色說服前警衛透露了金庫一樓的基本佈局，如圖8.1所示。警衛還回答了關於維朵蘭特及其外貌、警衛制服以及其他每個警衛都會知道的資訊的簡單問題。

english: If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the character also learns one of the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 如果檢查結果比DC高出5點或更多，角色還會瞭解到以下資訊之一：

english: The basic layout of the vault's second floor, as shown on map 8.1
zh_tw: 金庫二樓的基本佈局，如地圖8.1所示

english: The location of the secret door between {@area area T3|30f|x} and the building's exterior
zh_tw: 秘密門位於{@area 區域T3|30f|x}與建築物外部之間的位置

english: The password to bypass the conjuration rune in {@area area T9|32e|x}: "quixotic"
zh_tw: 繞過{@area 區域T9|32e|x}中的召喚符文的密碼："quixotic"

english: The location of a switch to disable one trap (either the pit trap in area T3 or the statues in {@area area T6|320|x})
zh_tw: 一個開關的位置，用於禁用一個陷阱（可以是區域T3的坑洞陷阱，或者是{@area 區域T6|320|x}的雕像陷阱）

english: The guard rotation (detailed in "{@area Vault Guards|300|x}")
zh_tw: 守衛輪換（詳細說明在"{@area 金庫守衛|300|x}"）

english: Map 8.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖8.1：玩家地圖

english: Surveilling the Target
zh_tw: 監視目標

english: If the characters spy on Vidorant, they can find her at her mansion in a well-to-do neighborhood near the vault. This doesn't yield useful information about the vault, but the characters can get a good glimpse of Vidorant and several associates, which can aid the characters in creating disguises.
zh_tw: 如果角色們監視維朵蘭特，他們會在金庫附近的一個富裕社群的她的豪宅中找到她。這不會提供有關金庫的有用資訊，但角色們可以很好地觀察維朵蘭特和幾個同夥，這可以幫助角色們在製作偽裝時有所依據。

english: Vidorant is a tall elf woman with sleek black hair. She usually wears black clothes accented with tasteful but clearly valuable silver jewelry. She's brusque, authoritative, and direct, though she listens with remarkable patience and intensity whenever anyone addresses her directly.
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特是一位身材高挑的精靈女性，擁有光滑的黑色頭髮。她通常穿著黑色衣服，上面裝飾著品味高雅且明顯貴重的銀飾。她粗魯、權威且直截了當，儘管當任何人直接對她說話時，她會以驚人的耐心和強度傾聽。

english: While no one in the Silver Fingers Society would dare help Vidorant right now, she still has a few informants and cronies from outside the organization. If the characters watch her long enough, they see meetings with four people: a muscular half-orc woman in a fine suit and hat, a sneering human man carrying a large leather case, an unkempt halfling man with patched clothing, and a smiling elf woman who bears a striking resemblance to Vidorant but is noticeably younger. Learning the identities of these associates would take additional sleuthing.
zh_tw: 儘管銀手指協會中沒有人會在現在幫助維朵蘭特，但她仍然有一些來自組織外部的線人和密友。如果角色們觀察她足夠長的時間，他們會看到與四個人的會面：一個穿著精美西裝和帽子的肌肉發達的半獸人女性，一個攜帶大型皮箱的冷笑人類男性，一個穿著補丁衣服的不整潔的半精靈男性，以及一個與維朵蘭特長得驚人相似但明顯更年輕的微笑精靈女性。瞭解這些同夥的身份將需要進一步的偵查。

english: Casing the Joint
zh_tw: 踩點

english: If the characters scout the vault before the heist, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在搶劫前偵查金庫，閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: The vault stands in a rundown neighborhood, but the street and alleyways around the vault are unobstructed. Small windows glint from high on the vault's stone walls. Two guards keep watch on the second-floor balcony, while another guard patrols around the structure at ground level.
zh_tw: 金庫位於一個破敗的社群，但金庫周圍的街道和小巷都是暢通無阻的。金庫石牆上高處的小窗戶反射著光芒。兩名守衛在二樓陽臺上守望，而另一名守衛在地面層巡邏。

english: Vidorant's vault is an unmarked building on the city outskirts in an area with moderate foot traffic. The neighboring buildings stand at least 20 feet from the vault and don't share walls with it. Nearby businesses include a jewelry store, a lumberyard, a brewery, and a forge. Several other nearby buildings are empty and are ideal locations for a stakeout.
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特的金庫是位於城市郊區的一座未標記的建築，所在區域人流量適中。鄰近的建築物至少距離金庫20尺，並且與金庫沒有共用牆壁。附近的商家包括一家珠寶店、一個木材場、一個釀酒廠和一個鐵匠鋪。其他幾個附近的建築物是空置的，是進行監視的理想地點。

english: If the characters observe the vault before the heist, they learn the general exterior layout, including the locations of the main door, balcony door, and windows. They also get a good look at the guard uniforms—dark blue with gold stitching—which can aid in creating disguises.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在搶劫前觀察金庫，他們會瞭解到一般的外觀佈局，包括主門、陽臺門和小窗戶的位置。他們還仔細檢視了守衛制服——深藍色帶有金色縫線——這有助於製作偽裝。

english: If the characters venture within 30 feet of the south side of the building, they hear animal noises coming from the zoo ({@area area T8|32a|x}), and a character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door leading from the exterior to the gem room ({@area area T3|30f|x}).
zh_tw: 如果角色冒險進入建築物南側30尺範圍內，他們會聽到來自動物園（{@area 區域T8|32a|x}）的動物噪音，成功透過一個{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現從外部通往寶石室（{@area 區域T3|30f|x}）的秘密門。

english: If the characters observe the vault for at least 4 hours, they learn two guards are always on duty on the balcony, accessed via a rope ladder the guards leave hanging down to ground level. The characters also learn the basic exterior and interior guard rotation (detailed in "{@area Vault Guards|300|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們至少觀察金庫4個小時，他們會瞭解到總是有兩名守衛在陽臺上值班，透過守衛留在地面上的繩梯進入。角色們還會瞭解到基本的外部和內部守衛輪換情況（詳細說明在"{@area 金庫守衛|300|x}"）。

english: The Vault
zh_tw: 金庫

english: On the day (or night) of the heist, nothing notable has changed from the party's previous surveillance. If the characters didn't visit the vault earlier during their preparations, read the read-aloud text from "{@area Casing the Joint|2f5|x}" as they approach the vault.
zh_tw: 在搶劫的那天（或夜晚），與黨派之前的監視相比，沒有什麼值得注意的變化。如果角色們在準備過程中沒有提前訪問金庫，請在他們接近金庫時閱讀"{@area 踩點|2f5|x}"中的朗讀書。

english: Vault Features
zh_tw: 寶庫特點

english: Vidorant's vault has the following features.
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特的金庫具有以下特點。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings throughout the vault are 15 feet high.
zh_tw: 金庫內所有樓層的天花板高度為15尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Doors in the vault are made of wood, except for the inner vault's metal door.
zh_tw: 金庫中的門都是木製的，除了內金庫的金屬門。

english: Locked Doors
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: As an action, a character can try to unlock a locked door in the vault, doing so with a successful Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or force the door open with a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Either check's DC is 15 unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具進行敏捷檢定來解鎖金庫中鎖住的門，或者透過成功的膂力（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟門。除非文字另有說明，否則任何檢定的難度等級都是15。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Unless otherwise noted, all areas are brightly lit by lamps imbued with {@spell continual flame} spells.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，所有區域都由被施加了{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術的燈具明亮地照亮。

english: Walls and Floors
zh_tw: 牆壁和地板

english: The vault's walls and floors are made of thick stone. The characters can use the {@spell stone shape} spell or similar magic to create a passage into the vault, though a guard patrol spots them if the characters spend more than a minute getting everyone inside. Each 10-foot section of wall has AC 15, 200 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Damaging the wall catches the attention of the guards unless the characters take extraordinary measures.
zh_tw: 金庫的牆壁和地板由厚實的石頭構成。角色們可以使用{@spell stone shape||塑石術}法術或類似的魔法創造一條通往金庫的通道，儘管如果角色們花費超過一分鐘讓所有人進入，守衛巡邏會發現他們。每10尺長的牆壁部分有AC 15，200生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。破壞牆壁會吸引守衛的注意，除非角色們採取了特別的措施。

english: Wards
zh_tw: 大區

english: The building is warded against teleportation and planar travel. Effects like the {@spell dimension door} spell can't be used to enter, exit, or move within the building.
zh_tw: 這座建築物被防護著，以防止傳送和位面旅行。像{@spell dimension door||任意門}法術這樣的效果不能用來進入、離開或在建築物內部移動。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: Areas {@area T2|30b|x}, {@area T3|30f|x}, {@area T7|326|x}, {@area T8|32a|x}, and {@area T9|32e|x} have windows 10 feet above the ground, and {@area area T13|33e|x} has a window 20 feet above the ground. Each window is locked and can be unlocked easily from the inside. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to unlock a window from the outside, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 區域{@area T2|30b|x}、{@area T3|30f|x}、{@area T7|326|x}、{@area T8|32a|x} 和 {@area T9|32e|x} 的窗戶位於地面以上 10 尺，而 {@area 區域T13|33e|x} 的窗戶位於地面以上 20 尺。每扇窗戶都被鎖上，並且可以從內部輕鬆解鎖。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試從外部解鎖窗戶，成功透過 {@dc 16} 的敏捷檢定即可解鎖。

english: Each window is warded with an abjuration rune that sounds an audible alarm if the window opens (see "{@area Caught in the Act|304|x}"). A character who searches a window for traps notices the rune with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check and can use an action to try to disable it, doing so with a successful {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check or a {@spell dispel magic} spell. A character who disables the alarm on one window can do the same on other vault windows without having to repeat the check.
zh_tw: 每個窗戶都被附上了防護符文，如果窗戶被開啟，符文會發出可聽見的警報（參見"{@area 當場抓獲|304|x}"）。一個角色搜尋窗戶以查詢陷阱時，如果成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，就能注意到符文，並可以使用一個動作來嘗試禁用它，成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定或使用 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} 法術即可禁用。一個角色禁用一個窗戶的警報後，可以無需再次進行檢定就對其他金庫窗戶進行同樣的操作。

english: The windows are too small for a Medium creature to climb through, but a Small creature can squeeze through one with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check.
zh_tw: 窗戶對於中型生物來說太小了，無法爬過，但小型生物可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定擠過去。

english: Vault Guards
zh_tw: 金庫守衛

english: Vidorant employs a dozen guards (use the {@creature veteran} stat block) to protect her treasures—three guards outside and nine inside the vault. Guards remain alert for noises elsewhere in the vault, and if the characters do something particularly loud, a guard might investigate at your discretion.
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特僱傭了一打守衛（使用{@creature veteran||老兵}的統計資料塊）來保護她的財寶——三名守衛在外面，九名在金庫內。守衛們對金庫其他地方的噪音保持警覺，如果角色們做了特別響的事情，守衛可能會在你決定的情況下進行調查。

english: Exterior Security
zh_tw: 外部安全

english: Characters who learned the guard rotation in the "{@area Preparation|2f2|x}" section know two guards are posted on the balcony and one guard patrols around the outside of the building at ground level.
zh_tw: 在"{@area 預備|2f2|x}"部分中學到守衛輪換的角色知道，有兩名守衛被安排在陽臺上，還有一名守衛在建築物外圍的地面層巡邏。

english: A character can avoid the notice of the exterior guards with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. An effective distraction might lower the DC or even bypass this check entirely. At night, the DC of this check decreases to 9.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 12} 敏捷 ({@skill Stealth||隱匿}) 檢定避開外部守衛的注意。有效的幹擾可能會降低 DC 或完全繞過此檢定。在夜間，此檢定的 DC 降低至 9。

english: Interior Security
zh_tw: 內部安全

english: Characters who learned the guard rotation in the "{@area Preparation|2f2|x}" section know two guards are posted in the lobby, seven guards patrol the first floor of the vault, and no guards patrol upstairs.
zh_tw: 在"{@area 預備|2f2|x}"部分中學到守衛輪換的角色知道，有兩名守衛被安排在大廳，七名守衛在金庫的一樓巡邏，樓上沒有守衛巡邏。

english: Rather than requiring you to track each patrolling guard's location, this adventure represents the guards moving about the vault by having you roll to determine whether a guard is present in any given room. In areas specified as part of the guard rotation, roll a {@dice d4} to determine if a guard is present when the characters approach that room. On a 1, a guard is present in that room. If the characters learned the guard rotation in the "Preparation" section, roll a {@dice d6} instead of a {@dice d4}, reflecting their increased ability to avoid the guards.
zh_tw: 這次冒險不需要你跟蹤每個巡邏守衛的位置，而是透過讓你擲骰子來決定當角色接近某個房間時是否有守衛在場。在指定為守衛輪換區域的地方，擲一個{@dice d4}來確定是否有守衛在場。如果是1，那麼那個房間裡就有一名守衛。如果角色在"準備"部分了解了守衛輪換，改為擲一個{@dice d6}而不是{@dice d4}，這反映了他們避開守衛的增加能力。

english: If the characters spend more than 10 minutes in any room that's part of the guard rotation, a guard interrupts them. Any character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 14 or higher hears the guard coming 2 rounds before the guard enters the room.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在任何屬於守衛輪換部分的房間裡逗留超過10分鐘，一名守衛會打斷他們。任何具有14或更高被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數的角色，在守衛進入房間前2輪就會聽到守衛的到來。

english: Evading Guards
zh_tw: 躲避守衛

english: When guards are present in an area, characters can resolve encounters without resorting to combat. Some examples are listed below, though the characters may come up with creative alternatives:
zh_tw: 當警衛出現在某個區域時，角色們可以解決遭遇戰，而不必訴諸戰鬥。以下是一些例子，儘管角色們可能會想出創造性的替代方案：

english: Bluffing
zh_tw: 虛張聲勢

english: A character can lie their way past a guard with a successful {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If the party's preparations convincingly support their story—such as wearing guard uniforms while claiming they're new guards—the DC decreases to 12.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 16} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定用謊言騙過守衛。如果他們的準備工作令人信服地支援他們的故事——例如穿著守衛制服自稱是新來的守衛——檢定難度降至12。

english: Bribing
zh_tw: 賄賂

english: A character can convince a guard to look the other way with a 50 gp bribe and a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以透過50金幣的賄賂以及一次成功的{@dc 10}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來說服一名守衛視而不見。

english: Hiding
zh_tw: 躲藏

english: Before entering a room, a character can tell if a guard is present by listening at the door and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The party can make a {@dc 14} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide in their current room until the guards leave. On a successful check, the guard leaves without noticing the characters, allowing the party to enter the next room undetected. On a failed check, the guard discovers the characters, likely by entering the room the characters are in and spotting them.
zh_tw: 在進入房間之前，角色可以透過在門邊傾聽併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定來判斷是否有守衛在場。隊伍可以進行一個 {@dc 14} 群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，以在他們的當前房間中隱藏，直到守衛離開。如果檢定成功，守衛會離開而沒有注意到角色，使隊伍能夠不被發現地進入下一個房間。如果檢定失敗，守衛會透過進入角色所在的房間並發現他們。

english: Intimidation
zh_tw: 威嚇

english: A character can frighten a guard into letting them pass with a successful {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 17} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定來嚇唬守衛讓他們透過。

english: If you wish, a character who succeeds on one of the above checks by 5 or more might also learn one piece of information from the "{@area Gathering Intelligence|2f3|x}" section, perhaps by overhearing a conversation or persuading a guard to share it.
zh_tw: 如果您願意，一個在上述檢定中成功且超過5點或更多的角色，也可能從 "{@area 收集情報|2f3|x}" 部分中學到一條資訊，或許是透過偷聽對話或說服守衛分享得知。

english: Caught in the Act
zh_tw: 當場抓獲

english: If the characters are spotted by a guard and don't talk their way out of it, the guard yells loudly for backup and attempts to run away, taking the {@action Dash} action. The guard returns 3 rounds later with an additional {@dice 1d4 + 1} guards (unless there aren't that many guards left). The guards (use the {@creature veteran} stat block) fight until reduced to 10 hit points, then flee.
zh_tw: 如果角色被守衛發現，並且不能說服對方放過他們，守衛會大聲呼救並試圖逃跑，採取{@action Dash||疾走}動作。3回合後，守衛會帶著額外的{@dice 1d4 + 1}名守衛回來（除非沒有那麼多守衛剩下）。守衛們（使用{@creature veteran||老兵}的屬性塊）會戰鬥到生命值降至10點，然後逃跑。

english: If the characters set off any audible alarms in the building, a guard immediately investigates, arriving 3 rounds after the alarm sounds. The alarm also puts the guards on high alert throughout the vault. For 1 hour after an alarm sounds, when rolling to determine if a guard is present in a room, roll two dice instead of one; if either result is a 1, a guard is present. Additionally, the DC on checks made to nonviolently deal with guards increases by 2 (see "{@area Evading Guards|303|x}"), and the price to bribe a guard increases to 100 gp.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在建築內觸發了任何聽得見的警報，一名守衛會立即進行調查，並在警報響起後的3回合到達。警報還會使金庫內的所有守衛進入高度警戒狀態。在警報響起後的1小時內，當擲骰以確定房間裡是否有守衛時，擲兩個骰子而不是一個；如果任一結果是1，則有守衛在場。此外，非暴力處理守衛的檢定難度等級增加2（見"{@area 躲避守衛|303|x}"），並且賄賂守衛的價格增加到100金幣。

english: Changing of the Guard
zh_tw: 警衛換班

english: If the characters neutralize all nine interior guards, the party has the run of the building until the next shift's guards show up. However, the three guards outside the building remain alert to loud noises inside the vault and enter the building to investigate suspicious sounds. A new shift starts every four hours, and six guards show up at each shift change.
zh_tw: 如果角色們中和了所有九名內部門衛，那麼在下一班門衛出現之前，團隊可以自由控制這棟建築。然而，建築外的三名門衛對金庫內的大聲噪音保持警覺，並會進入建築調查可疑的聲音。每四小時開始一個新的班次，每次班次更換時會有六名門衛出現。

english: Vault Locations
zh_tw: 金庫位置

english: The following locations are keyed to map 8.2.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應於地圖8.2上的關鍵點。

english: Map 8.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖 8.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: T1: Lobby
zh_tw: T1. 大廳

english: This beautifully decorated lobby has stone floors polished to a mirror finish. To the west, a large statue depicts a human woman wielding a bow and arrow. To the east, two comfortable chairs accompany a small table. A double door leads outside to the north, and two doors on the south wall lead into the vault.
zh_tw: 這個裝飾精美的大廳擁有鏡面般光滑的石質地板。向西，一尊大型雕像描繪了一個手持弓箭的人類女性。向東，兩張舒適的椅子伴隨著一張小桌子。向北的雙扇門通向戶外，南牆上的兩扇門通往金庫。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: Two guards watch the unlocked front door while sitting in the lobby's chairs. Though suspicious of people trying to get in, they're accustomed to confused people occasionally entering the unmarked building.
zh_tw: 兩名警衛坐在大廳的椅子上監視著未上鎖的前門。雖然他們對試圖進入的人持懷疑態度，但已經習慣了偶爾有人誤入這座沒有標誌的建築。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to {@area area T5|31b|x} is locked.
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域T5|31b|x}的門被鎖住了。

english: T2: Break Room
zh_tw: T2. 休息室

english: This break room smells faintly of sweat and greasy food. Scuffed wooden furniture and a large couch provide comfort for off-duty guards.
zh_tw: 這個休息室隱約散發著汗味和油膩食物的氣味。磨損的木製傢俱和一張大沙發為下班的守衛提供了舒適。

english: The room includes a table and chairs for eating, a couch and several chairs for lounging, and a privy. A trunk on the east wall contains a dozen spare guard uniforms.
zh_tw: 這個房間包括一張餐桌和椅子用於用餐，一張沙發和幾把椅子用於休息，以及一個廁所。東牆上的箱子裡裝有十二套備用警衛制服。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: Two off-duty guards are playing cards at the table. They aren't expecting to be interrupted, and each has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 7. If the characters try a nonviolent approach (as detailed in the "{@area Evading Guards|303|x}" section), the DC of those checks decreases by 2 against the off-duty guards.
zh_tw: 兩名下班的守衛在桌子旁玩牌。他們沒有預料到會被打擾，每個人的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為7。如果角色嘗試非暴力方法（如"{@area 躲避守衛|303|x}"部分中詳述的），針對下班守衛的這些檢定的難度等級會降低2。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to area T3 is locked. Each guard in the vault has a key that unlocks this door.
zh_tw: 通往T3區域的門被鎖住了。金庫中的每個守衛都有一把能開啟這扇門的鑰匙。

english: T3: Gem Room
zh_tw: T3. 寶石室

english: This room contains open crates of gems sorted by color and type. Most are neatly faceted, though a few remain uncut.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有開啟的寶石箱，寶石按顏色和型別分類。大部分寶石都經過精心切割，儘管還有一些是未加工的。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}").
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to area T2 is locked. Each guard in the vault has a key that unlocks this door.
zh_tw: 通往區域T2的門被鎖住了。金庫中的每個守衛都有一把可以開啟這扇門的鑰匙。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The southwest wall of this room contains a secret door to the exterior. Vidorant uses this door often. A character who examines the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots the door, which opens silently.
zh_tw: 這個房間的西南牆有一扇通往外部的秘密門。維朵蘭特經常使用這扇門。一個角色如果檢查這面牆並在一個{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中成功，會發現這扇門，它會無聲地開啟。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: Any character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 15 or higher notices the floor is unusually clean in a 10-foot square in front of the gem crates. When a creature steps on this area, the floor collapses into a 10-foot-deep pit with poisoned spikes lining its floor. Any creature on the collapsing floor falls into the pit, taking 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and landing {@condition prone}. In addition, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be impaled by {@dice 1d3} spikes, each of which deals 3 ({@dice 1d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@dice 2d6}) poison damage.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數達到15或更高的角色會注意到寶石箱前一塊10尺見方的地面異常乾淨。當生物踏上該區域時，地面會坍塌成一個10尺深的坑，坑底佈滿帶毒的尖刺。位於坍塌地面上的任何生物都會掉入坑中，受到3（{@dice 1d6})的鈍擊傷害並處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。此外，該生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}敏捷豁免，否則會被{@dice 1d3}根尖刺刺穿，每根尖刺造成3（{@dice 1d6}）的穿刺傷害加上7（{@dice 2d6}）的毒素傷害。

english: A character who searches the floor for traps and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check detects the trap, which can be disabled by placing a strong object such as a pole or crowbar between the floor panels. If the check made to detect the trap succeeds by 5 or more, the character also spots a concealed switch on one wall that disables the trap.
zh_tw: 一名角色若在地面上搜尋陷阱併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，即可發現該陷阱。陷阱可以透過在地板板條之間放置一根堅固的物體，如杆子或撬棍，來解除。如果檢測陷阱的檢定成功超出5點或更多，角色還可以發現牆上隱藏的開關，該開關可以解除陷阱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The crates hold 60 pounds of gemstones. The valuable gems include a large uncut diamond (1,000 gp), four small diamonds (100 gp each), a bag of diamond dust (300 gp), four flawed rubies (50 gp each), and four {@item Pearl||pearls} (100 gp each). The remainder of the semiprecious stones in the crates are worth a total of 1,000 gp.
zh_tw: 這些箱子裝有60磅的寶石。貴重的寶石包括一顆大型未切割的鑽石（1000金幣），四顆小鑽石（每顆100金幣），一袋鑽石粉（300金幣），四顆有瑕的紅寶石（每顆50金幣），以及四顆{@item Pearl||珍珠}（每顆100金幣）。箱子裡剩餘的半寶石總價值為1000金幣。

english: T4: Scrolls and Potions Room
zh_tw: T4. 卷軸與藥水室

english: This room has four short bookshelves, each bearing eight glass vials of liquid. Several open barrels hold rolled-up sheets of parchment.
zh_tw: 這個房間有四個矮書櫃，每個書櫃上都放著八個玻璃小瓶裝著液體。幾個開口的木桶裡裝有捲起的羊皮紙。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}").
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。

english: Shelves of Potions
zh_tw: 藥水架

english: The four shelves each hold eight potions in vials (see "Treasure" below). Any character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 18 or higher notices the shelves are precariously balanced. To safely remove a potion from a shelf, someone must steady the shelf with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check or the shelf collapses, shattering all the potion vials on it. Each creature within 5 feet of a collapsing shelf must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@dice 5d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The noise alerts the guards in the lobby ({@area area T1|307|x}), who arrive 2 rounds later to investigate.
zh_tw: 四個架子上每個都放著八瓶藥劑（見下方的"寶藏"部分）。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值為18或更高的角色會注意到這些架子非常不穩固。要安全地從架子上取下一瓶藥劑，必須成功透過{@dc 12}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來穩住架子，否則架子會倒塌，摔碎上面的所有藥劑瓶。在倒塌架子5尺範圍內的每個生物都必須進行{@dc 12}敏捷豁免檢定，若檢定失敗則受到17點（{@dice 5d6}）酸蝕傷害，檢定成功則僅受到一半傷害。噪音會提醒大廳（{@area 區域T1|307|x}）的守衛，他們會在兩輪後趕到調查。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The shelves contain twenty-six {@item Acid (vial)|PHB|vials of acid}, a {@item potion of animal friendship}, two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||potions of healing (greater)}, two {@item Potion of Resistance||potions of resistance} (one {@item Potion of Fire Resistance||fire}, the other {@item Potion of Poison Resistance||poison}), and one {@item potion of water breathing}.
zh_tw: 架子上包含二十六瓶{@item Acid (vial)|PHB|酸液瓶}，一瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}，兩瓶{@item potion of animal friendship||化獸為友藥水}，兩瓶{@item Potion of Resistance||抗性藥水}（一瓶{@item Potion of Fire Resistance||火焰}，另一瓶{@item Potion of Poison Resistance||毒素}），以及一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}。

english: The sheets of parchment in the barrels include {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} for each of the following spells: {@spell charm person} (2 scrolls), {@spell cure wounds} (1 scroll), {@spell detect magic} (2 scrolls), {@spell dispel magic} (1 scroll), {@spell false life} (1 scroll), {@spell identify} (4 scrolls), {@spell invisibility} (1 scroll), {@spell lesser restoration} (2 scrolls), and {@spell nondetection} (1 scroll).
zh_tw: 桶中的羊皮紙包括以下法術的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}：{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}（2份卷軸），{@spell cure wounds||療傷術}（1份卷軸），{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}（2份卷軸），{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（1份卷軸），{@spell false life||虛假生命}（1份卷軸），{@spell identify||鑑定術}（4份卷軸），{@spell invisibility||隱形}（1份卷軸），{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}（2份卷軸），以及{@spell nondetection||迴避偵測}（1份卷軸）。

english: T5: Documents Room
zh_tw: T5. 檔案室

english: This room holds two large iron safes.
zh_tw: 這個房間有兩個大型鐵製保險箱。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}").
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to {@area area T1|307|x} is locked. Each guard in the vault has a key that unlocks this door.
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域T1|307|x}的門是鎖著的。金庫中的每個警衛都有一把可以開啟這扇門的鑰匙。

english: Trapped Safes
zh_tw: 陷阱保險箱

english: The two document safes in this room contain secret information about local nobles and government officials. Each safe is trapped with enchantment magic. If a creature attempts to open a safe without Vidorant's personal key, the safe's trap emits an audible alarm (see "{@area Caught in the Act|304|x}") and casts {@spell hold person} (save {@dc 16}) on the three creatures nearest the safe. A character who uses an action to search the safe for traps notices the trap's rune with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Once the trap is detected, a character can use an action to try to disarm the trap, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check or a {@spell dispel magic} spell.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的兩個檔案保險箱中包含了當地貴族和政府官員的機密資訊。每個保險箱都被施以附魔魔法陷阱。如果有生物試圖在沒有維朵蘭特的個人鑰匙的情況下開啟保險箱，保險箱的陷阱會發出可聽見的警報（參見"{@area 當場抓獲|304|x}"）並對靠近保險箱的三個生物施放{@spell hold person||定身類人}（豁免難度{@dc 16}）。使用一個動作搜尋保險箱中的陷阱的角色，在成功透過一個{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時可以發現陷阱的符文。一旦檢測到陷阱，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試解除陷阱，透過一個{@dc 16}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定或使用一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術成功解除。

english: A character using thieves' tools can try to unlock a safe, which takes 1 minute. At the end of that time, the character must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity check, or the safe remains locked. The safes are full of documents. Every minute a character spends looking through the documents yields one of the following:
zh_tw: 一名使用盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試開啟保險箱，這需要1分鐘。在時間結束時，角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 17}的敏捷檢定，否則保險箱將保持鎖定狀態。保險箱裡裝滿了檔案。角色每花費一分鐘查閱檔案，可以獲得以下之一：

english: Bribe
zh_tw: 賄賂

english: A tattered parchment details how a prisoner, jailed for stealing racehorses, was freed after a noble bribed a local government official.
zh_tw: 一張破舊的羊皮紙詳細描述了一個因偷賽馬而被監禁的囚犯是如何在一位貴族賄賂了當地政府官員後被釋放的。

english: Disputed Will
zh_tw: 爭議遺囑

english: A parchment bears the original will of a recently deceased local noble. As the noble's family members are currently fighting over the estate, this will would be of great value to the heirs named in it.
zh_tw: 一份羊皮紙記錄了最近去世的當地貴族的原始遺囑。由於貴族的家庭成員目前正在爭奪遺產，這份遺囑對於其中指定的繼承人來說將具有極大的價值。

english: Goldenbeard's Secret
zh_tw: 金鬚的秘密

english: Small scraps of parchment hold notes from Goldenbeard. Though Vidorant's half of the correspondence is absent, the notes suggest Vidorant and Goldenbeard plotted a fake heist and used their "breathtaking success" to gain entrance to the Silver Fingers Society. Vidorant didn't use this information while vying for control of the Silver Fingers, as it implicated her too, but nothing would stop her from using it now.
zh_tw: 小片羊皮紙上記錄著金鬚的筆記。儘管維朵蘭特那一半的通訊內容缺失，但筆記暗示維朵蘭特和金鬚策劃了一場假搶劫，並利用他們的"驚人成功"來獲得進入銀指社團的機會。維朵蘭特在爭奪銀指社團控制權時沒有使用這些資訊，因為這同樣牽涉到她自己，但現在沒有什麼能阻止她使用它。

english: Love Letters
zh_tw: 情書

english: Several perfumed envelopes hold romantic letters between a local noble and a government official. The affair would be a scandal if revealed.
zh_tw: 幾個帶香味的信封裡裝著一位當地貴族和一位政府官員之間的浪漫情書。如果這些情書被公開，將會成為一個醜聞。

english: None of the documents in the safe have intrinsic monetary value, though they could be used to gain money or influence through blackmail.
zh_tw: 保險箱中的檔案本身沒有內在的貨幣價值，儘管它們可以透過勒索來獲得金錢或影響力。

english: T6: Gallery
zh_tw: T6. 畫廊
