english: Landscape paintings cover the walls of this room. In the center of the floor stand two marble statues of a human man and woman, both holding musical instruments. One statue faces the door to the south, and the other faces the door to the west.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上覆蓋著風景畫。在房間中央的地板上，矗立著兩座大理石雕像，分別是一個手持樂器的人類男性和一個女性。一座雕像面向南方的門，另一座面向西方的門。

english: Fire-Breathing Statues
zh_tw: 噴火雕像

english: When a creature steps on a square marked T on {@adventure map 8.2|KftGV|8|Map 8.2: DM's Map}, the statue closest to that square breathes magical fire, which fills the two squares between the statue and the door nearest to it. Any creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 當一個生物踏入標記為T的方格時（參考 {@adventure 地圖 8.2|KftGV|8|Map 8.2: DM's Map}），離該方格最近的雕像會噴出魔法火焰，火焰會填滿雕像與最近的門之間的兩個方格。該區域內的任何生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）點火焰傷害，若豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。

english: As an action, a character can search a trapped area and make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. If this check succeeds, the character finds a tiny switch on the wall next to the nearest door. Flipping the switch temporarily disables whichever statue breathes fire toward that door. The trap reactivates 1 minute later.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以搜尋一個被陷阱覆蓋的區域，並進行一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會在最近的門旁邊的牆上發現一個微小的開關。撥動開關會暫時禁用向該門噴火的雕像。陷阱會在1分鐘後重新啟用。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}"). Guards enter the room only via its secret passage, and they leave through either of the main doors after flipping the switch to temporarily disable the traps.
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。警衛僅透過其秘密通道進入房間，然後在翻轉開關暫時禁用陷阱後，透過任一主門離開。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who inspects the paintings and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers a large painting on the east wall pivots—along with the bookshelf on the other side of the wall—revealing a secret way to {@area area T9|32e|x}.
zh_tw: 一個檢查畫作併成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力 ({@skill Investigation||調查}) 檢定的角色，會發現東牆上的一大幅畫作會旋轉——連同牆另一側的書架——揭示出通往 {@area 區域T9|32e|x} 的秘密通道。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Four 12-foot-wide paintings (400 gp each) and a smaller 2-foot-wide painting (1,000 gp) are on display. A character who examines them and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recognizes the small painting is by a famous artist and is significantly more valuable than the others.
zh_tw: 四幅12尺寬的畫作（每幅400 gp）和一幅較小的2尺寬的畫作（1,000 gp）正在展出。一個檢查這些畫作並在{@dc 15}智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定中成功的角色會認出那幅較小的畫作是由一位著名藝術家創作的，其價值遠高於其他畫作。

english: T7: Armory
zh_tw: T7. 軍械庫

english: Three suits of armor stand against the walls with swords in hand, watching over this armory. Three large chests sit along the south wall.
zh_tw: 三套盔甲手持劍站在牆邊，守護著這個軍械庫。三個大箱子沿著南牆擺放。

english: The two easternmost suits of armor are {@creature Helmed Horror||helmed horrors}. They attack creatures (other than Vidorant) that aren't wearing guard uniforms. They obey Vidorant's spoken commands. If she's not present, they obey anyone wearing a guard uniform, even if commanded to attack another guard. They don't leave this room, and they ignore orders that would cause them to do so.
zh_tw: 最東邊的兩套盔甲是{@creature Helmed Horror||恐怖鎧甲}。它們會攻擊不穿著警衛制服的生物（除了維朵蘭特）。它們聽從維朵蘭特的口頭命令。如果她不在場，它們會聽從任何穿著警衛制服的人的命令，即使被命令攻擊另一個警衛。它們不會離開這個房間，並且會忽視會導致它們離開的命令。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}").
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chests hold more weapons. Most of the equipment in this room is nonmagical, but a character who is proficient with smith's tools or who succeeds on a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check immediately spots the most finely crafted items: a {@item +1 battleaxe}, a {@item +1 shortsword}, and a suit of {@item +1 scale mail}.
zh_tw: 這些箱子裡裝有更多武器。這個房間裡的裝置大多數是非魔法物品，但一個熟練使用鐵匠工具或透過一個 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色會立刻發現最精湛製作的物品：一把 {@item +1 battleaxe||+1 戰斧}，一把 {@item +1 shortsword||+1 短劍}，和一套 {@item +1 scale mail||+1 鱗甲}。

english: T8: Zoo
zh_tw: T8. 動物園

english: This room contains five large cages holding unusual creatures. It smells of fur and feathers. Chirps, grunts, and howls fill the air.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含五個大籠子，裡面關著不尋常的生物。空氣中瀰漫著皮毛和羽毛的氣味。鳥鳴、咕噥聲和嚎叫聲充斥著整個空間。

english: Cages
zh_tw: 籠子

english: Each cage has a door held shut by a rudimentary latch. One contains exotic birds. Another holds two {@creature Giant Lizard||giant lizards} and six {@creature Flying Snake||flying snakes}. A third contains harmless mammals, including jerboas, chinchillas, and a capybara. The last two cages each hold one {@creature displacer beast}. The giant lizards, flying snakes, and displacer beasts are aggressive but accustomed to being placated with food by Vidorant and the guards.
zh_tw: 每個籠子都有一個用簡單門閂關上的門。一個籠子裡裝著異國情調的鳥類。另一個籠子裡裝有兩隻{@creature Giant Lizard||巨蜥}和六條{@creature Flying Snake||飛蛇}。第三個籠子裡裝著無害的哺乳動物，包括跳鼠、毛絲鼠和一隻水豚。最後兩個籠子每個都裝著一隻{@creature displacer beast||移位獸}。巨型蜥蜴、飛蛇和移位獸雖然具有攻擊性，但已習慣於被維朵蘭特和警衛用食物安撫。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}"). Any guard in this room carries food for the animals.
zh_tw: 這個房間是警衛輪換的一部分。擲骰以確定是否有警衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"中所述）。在這個房間裡的任何警衛都攜帶著動物的食物。

english: T9: Library
zh_tw: T9. 圖書館

english: This room smells strongly of incense and paper. It has several bookshelves filled with antique books. A large, embroidered rug covers the floor.
zh_tw: 這個房間的香味和紙張氣息非常濃鬱。它有好幾個書架，書架上擺滿了古董書籍。一塊大型繡花地毯覆蓋著地板。

english: A character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 18 or higher notices a conjuration rune peeking from under the rug. After discovering it, a character can use an action to try to disable the rune, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check or a {@spell dispel magic} spell.
zh_tw: 一個被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）分數為18或更高的角色會注意到地毯下隱約可見的召喚符文。發現後，角色可以使用一個動作嘗試禁制該符文，需成功透過一個智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定（{@dc 18}）或使用一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術。

english: If a creature steps on the rug without saying the password, "quixotic," the rune summons an {@creature invisible stalker}. The invisible stalker doesn't reveal its presence or attack immediately, waiting to do so until the characters either remove a book from the room or try to cross the spiked pit in {@area area T10|333|x}.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物在沒有說出密碼'quixotic'的情況下踩到地毯上，符文會召喚一個{@creature invisible stalker||隱形追獵者}。隱形追獵者不會立即暴露其存在或發動攻擊，而是等待角色們要麼從房間裡拿走一本書，要麼試圖穿越{@area 區域T10|333|x}中的帶刺坑洞時才這麼做。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: This room is part of the guard rotation. Roll to determine if a guard is present (as described in "{@area Interior Security|302|x}"). The guard uses the password if forced to step onto the rug.
zh_tw: 這個房間是守衛輪換的一部分。擲骰決定是否有一名守衛在場（如"{@area 內部安全|302|x}"所述）。如果被迫踏上地毯，守衛會使用密碼。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who inspects the bookshelves and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check discovers the bookshelf to the west pivots—along with the painting on the other side—revealing a secret way to the gallery ({@area area T6|320|x}).
zh_tw: 一個檢查書架的角色若成功透過一項{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會發現西側的書架與另一側的畫作一起轉動，揭示了一條通往畫廊的秘密通道（{@area 區域T6|320|x}）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Most books in this room have no monetary value, but three of the oldest books are worth 500 gp each. A character can identify these valuable books if they spend 5 minutes examining them and succeed on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check:
zh_tw: 這個房間中的大部分書籍沒有金錢價值，但有三本最古老的書籍每本價值500金幣。如果角色花費5分鐘檢查這些書籍併成功透過一個{@dc 14}智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定，則可以識別出這些有價值的書籍:

english: {@i Adventures of the Mystique} (first edition, mint condition) is a transcription of a first mate's logbook, which recounts several harrowing adventures aboard a galleon called the Mystique.
zh_tw: {@i 《神秘冒險》}（第一版，全新品）是航海日記的抄本，記錄了在名為神秘號的帆船上經歷的幾次驚心動魄的冒險。

english: {@i The Diabolical Codex} (covered in spined devil hide), written by a tiefling named Nadir, provides tips and tricks for surviving bargains with devils.
zh_tw: {@i 《魔鬼法典》}（封面是棘魔皮），由一個名叫納迪爾的提夫林所著，提供了與魔鬼交易生存的技巧和竅門。

english: {@i Eight for Dinner} (first edition, signed by the author) is a murder mystery in which an inquisitive mind flayer detective solves a murder aboard a planar locomotive called the Concordant Express.
zh_tw: {@i 《八人晚宴》}（第一版，作者親筆簽名）是一部謀殺懸疑小說，其中一位好奇的靈吸怪偵探在名為協和快車的位面列車上解決了一起謀殺案。

english: T10: Pit
zh_tw: T10. 深坑

english: A ten-foot-wide pit with spikes at the bottom divides this room from east to west. A sturdy-looking stone bridge spans the pit. The room is dimly lit by a flickering lamp on the north wall. Near it, a double door leads west. On the south side of the pit is a spiral metal staircase going up.
zh_tw: 一個底部有尖刺的十尺寬的坑將這個房間從東到西分隔開來。一座看起來堅固的石橋橫跨坑洞。房間由北牆上一盞閃爍的燈微弱地照亮。靠近它，有一對雙門朝西。在坑的南側是一架螺旋形的金屬樓梯向上。

english: Guards don't patrol this room. If the {@creature invisible stalker} was summoned in the library and hasn't attacked yet, it attempts to shove a character into the pit, then attacks the party.
zh_tw: 守衛不會在這個房間巡邏。如果{@creature invisible stalker||隱形追獵者}在圖書館被召喚且尚未發動攻擊，它會試圖將一名角色推進坑裡，然後攻擊隊伍。

english: Illusions
zh_tw: 幻象

english: Two permanent {@spell silent image} spells have been cast over the pit, one on the east side and another on the west. The illusion on the west side depicts a bridge spanning the pit. The illusion on the east side shows an open pit, hiding a real bridge that can be used to safely cross. Touching the fake bridge (which is shown on {@adventure map 8.2|KftGV|8|Map 8.2: DM's Map}) reveals that it has no substance. Similarly, feeling around the pit for the real bridge reveals it in short order. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on either illusion ends it.
zh_tw: 兩個永久的{@spell silent image||無聲幻影}法術被施加在坑上，一個在東側，另一個在西側。西側的幻象描繪了一座橫跨坑洞的橋。東側的幻象顯示了一個開闊的坑洞，隱藏了一個可以安全透過的真實橋樑。觸控假橋（顯示在{@adventure 地圖 8.2|KftGV|8|Map 8.2: DM's Map})會發現它沒有實體。同樣，摸索坑洞尋找真實橋樑很快就會找到它。對任一幻象施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}可以結束它。

english: Spiked Pit
zh_tw: 尖刺陷坑

english: Any creature that falls into the pit is impaled by {@dice 1d3} spikes, each of which deals 3 ({@dice 1d6}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@dice 2d6}) poison damage.
zh_tw: 任何落入坑中的生物都會被{@dice 1d3}根尖刺刺穿，每根尖刺造成3（{@dice 1d6}）點穿刺傷害加上7（{@dice 2d6}）點毒素傷害。

english: T11a–b: Stairwell
zh_tw: T11a–b: 樓梯井

english: A spiral metal staircase ascends gracefully, connecting the first and second floors. A flickering lamp casts {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} on the stairs.
zh_tw: 一座螺旋金屬樓梯優雅地向上延伸，連線著第一層和第二層。一盞閃爍的油燈在樓梯上投下{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。

english: Guards don't patrol this area.
zh_tw: 守衛不巡邏這個區域。

english: T12: Balcony
zh_tw: T12. 陽臺

english: On the second floor's large balcony, a table and chairs allow for dining while enjoying a lovely view of the city. The view is unimpeded by a low railing. To the east, a rope ladder hangs from the balcony to the ground fifteen feet below. A double door leads into the building.
zh_tw: 在二樓的大陽臺上，桌子和椅子讓人可以在享受城市美景的同時用餐。低矮的欄杆並沒有阻礙視線。向東望去，一條繩梯從陽臺垂下，直到下方15尺的地面。一對雙開門通向建築物內部。

english: A creature that falls off the balcony can catch the railing with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature falls to the ground 15 feet below, taking 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物從陽臺上跌落，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 16} 敏捷豁免來抓住欄杆。如果豁免失敗，該生物將跌落到下方 15 尺的地面，並因跌落受到 3 ({@dice 1d6}) 的鈍擊傷害。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: Two guards are posted here. During shift changes, guards access the balcony via the rope ladder and never enter area T13. A guard who notices suspicious activity below uses an action to pull up the rope ladder.
zh_tw: 這裡駐守著兩名警衛。在換崗時，警衛透過繩梯進入陽臺，從不進入T13區域。如果警衛注意到下方有可疑活動，他們會使用一個動作將繩梯拉上來。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The double door to area T13 is locked. The balcony guards have a key but use it only if they detect intruders inside.
zh_tw: 通往區域T13的雙門被鎖住了。陽臺的守衛有鑰匙，但只有在他們察覺到裡面有入侵者時才會使用。

english: Vidorant
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特

english: If Vidorant teleports to the vault (see the "{@area Vidorant Arrives|34c|x}" section later in the adventure), she arrives on the balcony, as the interior of the vault is warded against teleportation magic.
zh_tw: 如果維朵蘭特透過傳送術到達金庫（見冒險中稍後"{@area 維朵蘭特抵達|34c|x}"部分），她會出現在陽臺上，因為金庫內部被防護了傳送魔法。

english: T13: Vidorant's Quarters
zh_tw: T13. 維朵蘭特的住所

english: The north half of these luxurious living quarters holds a study area with a fine desk and two beautiful paintings of night festivals. A delicate curtain opening to the south reveals a sleeping area. The bed is piled high with sumptuous linens. This area also holds a sturdy wooden wardrobe and a privy.
zh_tw: 這些豪華生活區的北半部分設有一個學習區，配有一張精美的書桌和兩幅美麗的夜節畫作。一扇精緻的窗簾朝南開啟，露出一個睡眠區。床上堆滿了華麗的床單。這個區域還有一個堅固的木製衣櫃和一個私人廁所。

english: Guards don't patrol this room, the eastern door of which is unlocked. Though Vidorant lives in a mansion nearby, she sometimes sleeps here after working late in her vault. Her bedroom includes a wardrobe with several changes of clothes, which could be useful if a character wants to fashion a disguise.
zh_tw: 警衛不巡邏這個房間，其東邊的門是未上鎖的。儘管維朵蘭特住在附近的一棟大廈裡，但她有時在金庫工作到很晚後會在這裡過夜。她的臥室包括一個衣櫃，裡面有幾套衣服，如果角色想要製作偽裝，這些衣服可能會有用。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: Vidorant's desk drawer is locked. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to unlock it, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The desk contains many documents. A character who examines them for 1 minute and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds the plans for Vidorant's next heist, targeting a noble with close ties to Goldenbeard.
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特的抽屜被鎖上了。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開鎖，成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定即可開啟。抽屜裡有許多檔案。角色如果花1分鐘時間檢查這些檔案，併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，就能找到維朵蘭特下一次搶劫的計劃，目標是一個與金鬚有密切聯絡的貴族。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to {@area area T12|339|x} is locked but easily unlocked from inside this room.
zh_tw: 通往{@area 區域T12|339|x}的門是鎖著的，但從這個房間裡面很容易開啟。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The two paintings of night festivals are worth 250 gp each.
zh_tw: 兩幅夜間節日的畫作每幅價值250金幣。

english: Disguised as a vault guard, an adventurer sets his sights on the precious Ruby Diadem of Erlynn Blessedore
zh_tw: 偽裝成金庫守衛的冒險者將目光投向了珍貴的埃爾林·布萊索雷的紅寶石王冠。

english: T14: Strong Room
zh_tw: T14. 堅固房間

english: This room contains four large metal cabinets.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含四個大型金屬櫃。

english: Guards don't patrol this unlocked room.
zh_tw: 警衛不巡邏這個未上鎖的房間。

english: Secret Passage
zh_tw: 秘密通道

english: Any character who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 18 or higher notices that the hallway between areas T14 and T15 doesn't extend as far north as this room does. A character who searches the northeast corner of the room can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, finding a secret door on a success. Beyond it is a passage ending at another secret door. No ability check is required to spot the door from inside the passage. Characters can use this route to enter area T15 and avoid the trap there.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）達到18或更高的角色會注意到T14和T15區域之間的走廊沒有像這個房間那樣向北延伸。搜尋房間東北角的角色可以進行一個{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，成功時將發現一扇秘密門。門後是一條通道，通道盡頭是另一扇秘密門。從通道內部無需任何能力檢定即可發現這扇門。角色可以利用這條路線進入T15區域，並避開那裡的陷阱。

english: Trapped Cabinets
zh_tw: 陷阱櫃子

english: All four cabinets in this room are locked and trapped. A character who examines the cabinets for 1 minute can make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, finding all four traps on a success. Inside each cabinet is a delicate glass vial containing poison gas. The vial breaks if the cabinet is opened by any means other than using the proper key (which is in Vidorant's possession). A character can use thieves' tools to try to disarm one of these traps, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity check. Failing the check by 5 or more triggers the trap.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的四個櫃子都被鎖上並設定了陷阱。一個角色如果檢查櫃子1分鐘，可以進行一次{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，成功時發現所有四個陷阱。每個櫃子裡面都有一個裝有毒氣的精緻玻璃瓶。如果櫃子被任何非使用正確鑰匙（由維朵蘭特持有）的方式開啟，瓶子會破裂。一個角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試解除其中一個陷阱，成功需透過一次{@dc 18}敏捷檢定。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，陷阱將被觸發。

english: A character can use thieves' tools to try to unlock a cabinet, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. However, if the trap hasn't been disarmed, the cabinet releases its poison gas. The gas from one vial is enough to fill the room but dissipates quickly. Each creature in the room when the gas is released must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@dice 2d10}) poison damage.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開啟櫃子，成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定即可做到。然而，如果陷阱沒有被解除，櫃子會釋放毒氣。一瓶毒氣足以充滿整個房間，但會迅速消散。毒氣釋放時，房間內的每個生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免檢定，否則將受到 11 點（{@dice 2d10}）毒素傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each cabinet holds 1,000 gp.
zh_tw: 每個櫃子裡存放著1000金幣。

english: T15: Inner Vault
zh_tw: T15. 內金庫

english: This room's main door, situated in the middle of the west wall, is locked ({@dc 18} to open) and made of metal.
zh_tw: 這個房間的正門位於西牆的中間，被鎖住了（需要透過 {@dc 18} 的檢定來開啟），並且是由金屬製成的。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: Just behind the door, inside the room, is an electrically charged metal wire resembling a trip wire. When the door opens, it makes contact with the wire. Any creature touching the door takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) lightning damage from the shock. The wire then snaps, disabling the trap. The trap is easy to disarm from inside the room (no check required), but it can't be disarmed from outside the room.
zh_tw: 門後房間裡有一根帶電的金屬線，看起來像是一個絆線。當門開啟時，會接觸到這根線。任何觸碰門的生物都會從電擊中受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）的閃電傷害。然後這根線會斷開，陷阱失效。從房間裡很容易解除這個陷阱（不需要檢查），但是從房間外則無法解除。

english: Characters can avoid the trap by entering the room through a secret door in the northwest corner (see area T14).
zh_tw: 角色可以透過進入T14區域的西北角的秘密門來避開陷阱。

english: This room has marble flooring and ivory-colored wallpaper with silver accents. The room contains seven glass cases on pedestals, each enclosing a small item.
zh_tw: 這個房間鋪設著大理石地板，牆壁上貼著象牙色的桌布，上面有銀色的裝飾。房間裡有七個玻璃展示櫃，每個櫃子裡都展示著一個小物品。

english: Display Cases
zh_tw: 展示櫃

english: On each case, a notecard written in elegant handwriting bears the item's name and a brief description:
zh_tw: 在每個展示櫃上，一張用優雅的筆跡書寫的卡片上標明瞭物品的名稱和簡短描述：

english: Jeweled Human Skull
zh_tw: 鑲珠寶的人頭骨

english: The card reads, "Unclear if genuine skull or replica. Found in ancient tomb." This skull is coated with gold. Large diamonds are mounted in its eye sockets, and small rubies drip down its cheekbones like bloody tears. (The skull is worth 2,000 gp.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著："不確定是真正的頭骨還是複製品。在古代墓穴中發現。" 這個頭骨被塗覆了金層。它的眼窩中鑲嵌著大鑽石，小紅寶石像血淚一樣滴落在它的顴骨上。（這個頭骨價值2,000 gp。）

english: Lost Map of Tishanos
zh_tw: 提沙諾斯的失落地圖

english: The card reads, "Reportedly from Pirate Queen Shrixette Laderie. No other records of Tishanos found. Must mount expedition." This weathered map details an island that lies about a hundred miles from an unidentified coastline. (The map has no intrinsic monetary value but could lead to adventure.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著，"據說來自海盜女王施莉克賽特·拉德里。沒有找到提沙諾斯的其他記錄。必須組織遠徵。"這張風化的地圖詳細描述了一個位於不明海岸線約一百英里外的島嶼。（這張地圖沒有內在的貨幣價值，但可能引導至冒險。）

english: Royal Scepter
zh_tw: 皇家權杖

english: The card reads, "Used in the coronation of Queen Calinia. Possible gift from elven court." This golden scepter is intricately engraved and set with diamonds and sapphires. (The scepter is worth 2,000 gp.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著，"用於加冕卡利尼亞女王。可能是精靈宮廷的禮物。"這根金色權杖雕刻精細，鑲嵌著鑽石和藍寶石。（這根權杖價值2000金幣。）

english: Ruby Diadem of Erlynn Blessedore
zh_tw: 埃爾林·布萊索雷的紅寶石王冠

english: The card reads, "Owned by Queen Erlynn Blessedore, ancestor of Samphith." Each spire of the diadem is studded with rubies. (The diadem is worth 2,000 gp.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著，"由桑菲斯的祖先，埃爾林·布萊索雷女王所擁有。"這頂王冠的每一座尖塔上都鑲嵌著紅寶石。（這頂王冠價值2000金幣。）

english: Silvered Dagger
zh_tw: 鍍銀匕首

english: The card reads, "Used to assassinate Prince Angryn Sheselitte. Nonmagical." This dagger is unremarkable, though high quality. (The dagger is worth 1,000 gp as a collector's item.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著，"用於暗殺安格林·謝瑟利特王子。非魔法的。"這把匕首雖然不起眼，但質量上乘。（作為收藏品，這把匕首價值1000金幣。）

english: Snowy's Collar
zh_tw: 小雪的項圈

english: The card reads, "Owned by legendary fortune-teller Gratchia Gartirio. Dog reportedly told the future." This fine silk collar, sized for a small dog, has a diamond-encrusted tag reading "Snowy." (The collar is worth 1,000 gp.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著，"屬於傳奇占卜師格拉提雅·加提里奧。據報道，她的狗能夠預知未來。"這個為小狗定製的精緻絲綢項圈上有一個鑲滿鑽石的標籤，上面寫著"小雪"。（這個項圈價值1000金幣。）

english: Thesis of Mortinsor
zh_tw: 《摩蒂索的論文》

english: The card reads, "Owned by Mortinsor, the famous necromancer. Possibly contains secrets of longevity, but difficult to decipher." This oversized tome is full of esoteric, archaic text that would require extensive research to decipher. A character who spends 12 weeks studying it and succeeds on a {@dc 22} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check finds a page that serves as a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell sequester}. (The thesis is worth 500 gp.)
zh_tw: 卡片上寫著："屬於著名死靈法師莫廷索爾。可能包含長壽的秘密，但難以破譯。" 這本超大尺寸的典籍中充滿了深奧且古老的文字，需要大量的研究才能破譯。一個角色如果花費12周時間研究它，併成功透過一個 {@dc 22} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，將發現一頁可以作為 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 的 {@spell sequester||隔離術}。（這篇論文價值500金幣。）

english: Each item is protected by two separate abjuration runes that trigger {@spell alarm} spells. The first rune is on the display case, and it sounds an audible alarm when that display case is opened (see "{@area Caught in the Act|304|x}"). The second rune is on the item itself, and it silently alerts Vidorant when that item is removed from the room (see "Vidorant Arrives" below).
zh_tw: 每件物品都受到兩個獨立的放逐符文保護，這些符文觸發了{@spell alarm||警報術}法術。第一個符文在展示櫃上，當展示櫃被開啟時會發出可聽見的警報（見"{@area 當場抓獲|304|x}"）。第二個符文在物品本身，當物品被帶出房間時，它會無聲地通知維朵蘭特（見下面的"維朵蘭特抵達"）。

english: A character who examines the various treasures and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices the first set of runes on all the display cases. A character who succeeds on this check by 5 or more also notices the second set of runes on the items themselves.
zh_tw: 一個角色檢查各種寶物併成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會注意到所有展示櫃上的第一組符文。如果角色在此檢定中成功超過5點或更多，還會注意到物品本身的第二組符文。

english: A character can disable a particular rune (and its linked {@spell alarm} spell) with the {@spell dispel magic} spell or a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. A character who fails the check by 5 or more triggers the alarm. The first time a character successfully disables one of these runes, the DC to do so on the others decreases to 13. Alternatively, a character can slip an item out of its case without triggering the display case alarm by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. On a failed check, the audible alarm activates (see "Caught in the Act").
zh_tw: 一個角色可以使用{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術或成功透過{@dc 18}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定來禁用特定的符文（及其關聯的{@spell alarm||警報術}法術）。如果角色在檢定中失敗且差值達到5或更多，警報將被觸發。當一個角色首次成功禁用了其中一個符文後，禁用其他符文的DC將降低到13。另外，角色可以透過成功進行{@dc 18}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定，在未觸發展示櫃警報的情況下將物品從展示櫃中取出。如果檢定失敗，可聽見的警報將被啟用（見"當場抓獲"）。

english: Vidorant Arrives
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特抵達

english: Once the characters obtain the diadem, they must escape the vault to complete the heist.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得王冠，他們必須逃離金庫以完成盜竊。

english: If Vidorant (chaotic neutral, elf {@creature assassin}) is alerted to the theft by an alarm in her inner vault ({@area area T15|348|x}), she uses a custom-made ring that functions as a {@item helm of teleportation} (to which only she can attune) to teleport to the balcony 5 rounds after the alarm is triggered. She heads toward the characters while calling loudly for the guards. The balcony guards follow her, and all other guards in the vault go on high alert (see "{@area Caught in the Act|304|x}").
zh_tw: 如果維朵蘭特（混亂中立，精靈{@creature assassin||刺客}）透過她內庫中的警報（{@area 區域T15|348|x}）得知盜竊事件，她會使用一個特製的戒指，該戒指的功能是作為一個{@item helm of teleportation||傳送頭盔}（只有她能夠調整），在警報觸發後5輪傳送到陽臺。她會一邊大聲呼叫警衛，一邊朝角色們走去。陽臺上的警衛跟隨她，金庫中的所有其他警衛都會進入高度警戒狀態（見"{@area 當場抓獲|304|x}"）。

english: Vidorant's Offer
zh_tw: 維朵蘭特的提議

english: If Vidorant intercepts the characters, she makes a surprising offer:
zh_tw: 如果維朵蘭特攔截了角色們，她會提出一個令人驚訝的提議：

english: An elf woman with sleek black hair approaches you with a smile. "You've done well. Not just any thieves could make it to my personal vault. I congratulate you. I'm sure this means the Silver Fingers placed a bounty on that ruby diadem—Goldenbeard's been furious about that thing for years. But if you'll allow me a moment, perhaps I can make you a better offer?"
zh_tw: 一位擁有烏黑亮麗頭髮的精靈女性面帶微笑地走近你。"你們做得不錯。不是隨便哪個小偷都能到達我的私人金庫。我向你們表示祝賀。我敢肯定這意味著銀指社團對那個紅寶石王冠下了懸賞——金鬚多年來一直在為那東西大發雷霆。但如果你們能給我一點時間，也許我能給你們一個更好的報價？

english: If the characters refuse to hear her deal, Vidorant attacks them. If they agree to listen to her deal, she continues speaking:
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕聽取她的交易，維朵蘭特會攻擊他們。如果他們同意聽她的交易，她會繼續說：

english: "I could try to dispatch you—and I might succeed—but more thieves will keep trying to interfere with my business. Instead, what if you went back and told everyone my vault was impenetrable and I thoroughly defeated you? It would head off a lot of trouble. In exchange, I'll give you this." She pulls a delicate ring from her finger. "It's worth more to you than the diadem—after all, it's part of how I've become such a famous thief. Goldenbeard is planning to take the diadem for himself, right? He's still mad about our heist all those years ago. But this ring you can keep. Tell whatever story you like about where you got it, as long as it's not from me. You get rich, I look strong, and no one's the wiser."
zh_tw: "我可以嘗試除掉你們——我可能會成功——但更多的小偷會繼續試圖幹擾我的生意。相反，如果你們回去告訴大家我的金庫是堅不可摧的，我徹底打敗了你們怎麼樣？這將避免很多麻煩。作為交換，我會給你這個。"她從手指上取下一個精緻的戒指。"這對你們來說比王冠更有價值——畢竟，這是我成為如此著名小偷的一部分。金鬚計劃自己拿走王冠，對吧？他還在為我們多年前的搶劫而生氣。但這個戒指你可以留著。關於你從哪裡得到它的，你可以講任何故事，只要不是從我這裡。你變得富有，我看起來強大，沒有人更聰明。"

english: The ring is a {@item ring of evasion}. If the characters agree to Vidorant's terms or negotiate her into a reasonable compromise, she upholds her part of the deal.
zh_tw: 這個戒指是一件{@item ring of evasion||反射閃避戒指}。如果角色們同意維朵蘭特的條件或與她協商出一個合理的妥協，她會履行她那部分的交易。

english: If Vidorant knows the characters have taken items of significant value from her vault, she suggests an even better deal: if they return the most valuable items they stole, she'll also give them her {@item gloves of thievery}, which she's currently wearing invisibly on her hands.
zh_tw: 如果維朵蘭特知道角色們從她的金庫中拿走了價值重大的物品，她會提出一個更好的交易：如果他們歸還他們偷走的最有價值的物品，她也會給他們她的{@item gloves of thievery||竊賊手套}，她目前正無形地戴在手上。

english: If all parties agree, she hands over the ring (and possibly the gloves) in exchange for the diadem, then escorts the characters outside, loudly bragging about their defeat and threatening violence if she ever sees them again.
zh_tw: 如果所有方都同意，她會交出戒指（可能還有手套），以換取王冠，然後護送角色們出去，大聲吹噓他們被打敗，並威脅說如果再見到他們就會施以暴力。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: If the characters return the diadem to Goldenbeard, he offers them lifetime membership in the Silver Fingers Society. He also promises them a personal favor they can redeem next time they need help with a situation. If the party prefers a cash reward instead, he happily obliges and still promises a favor.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將王冠歸還給金鬚，他將提供他們銀手指協會的終身會員資格。他還承諾他們一個個人恩惠，下次他們需要幫助時可以兌現。如果隊伍更傾向於現金獎勵，他也樂意滿足，並仍然承諾一個恩惠。

english: If the characters took Vidorant's deal or decided to keep the diadem for themselves, they must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to convince Goldenbeard they were unable to retrieve the diadem. If Goldenbeard realizes they're lying to him, he grows very serious. He doesn't attack the party himself; instead, he uses the Silver Fingers Society to steal back the diadem or otherwise make the characters' lives difficult.
zh_tw: 如果角色接受了維朵蘭特的提議或決定自己保留王冠，他們必須成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}檢定來說服金鬚，他們無法取回王冠。如果金鬚意識到他們在對他撒謊，他會變得非常嚴肅。他不會親自攻擊隊伍；相反，他會利用銀指公會偷回王冠，或者以其他方式讓角色的生活變得困難。

english: If the characters fool him or were simply unable to recover the diadem, Goldenbeard is disappointed, but he reassures the characters there will be other opportunities to work together in the future.
zh_tw: 如果角色們愚弄了他，或者簡單地無法找回王冠，金鬚會感到失望，但他向角色們保證將來還會有其他合作的機會。

english: Blackmailing Goldenbeard
zh_tw: 敲詐金鬚

english: If the characters found the blackmail material regarding Goldenbeard in Vidorant's safe and they bring it up with him, his face goes blank and he responds:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在維朵蘭特的保險箱中找到了有關金鬚的勒索材料，並且他們向他提起這件事，他的臉色會變得空白，然後他會回答：

english: "I see. She couldn't reveal that without implicating herself, but you have no such hesitation. I have no comment on its truth—but it would be messy if revealed. I am willing to buy this from you."
zh_tw: "我明白了。她不能在不牽連自己的情況下透露那個，但你沒有這樣的猶豫。我對它的真相不做評論——但如果被揭露，那會是麻煩的。我願意從你這裡購買這個。"

english: He offers the characters 1,000 gp for the original copy of Vidorant's blackmail material. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion}) check convinces him to increase his payment to 2,000 gp.
zh_tw: 他願意為維德蘭特的原始勒索材料副本支付角色們 1,000 金幣。如果角色成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 的魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，可以說服他將報酬提高到 2,000 金幣。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault and they return the diadem to Goldenbeard, the organization offers the characters a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，並且他們將王冠歸還給金鬚，該組織將提供一件稀有的魔法物品作為報酬（需經您批准）。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: Shard of the Accursed
zh_tw: 被詛咒的碎片

english: {@i An Adventure for 8th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合8級角色的冒險}

english: A mysterious shard made of obsidian places a curse on everyone who bears it. When the shard comes into the characters' possession, they must break its curse by returning the shard to the ancient tomb it came from. But a dangerous crime syndicate controls the tomb and its riches, and the criminals won't take kindly to the characters' intrusion.
zh_tw: 一塊由黑曜石製成的神秘碎片對每個攜帶它的人都施加了詛咒。當這個碎片落入角色們的手中時，他們必須透過將其歸還到它原本的古老墓穴中來打破這個詛咒。但是一個危險的犯罪集團控制著這個墓穴及其財富，而且這些罪犯不會對角色們的侵入表示友好。

english: This adventure isn't a typical heist; rather, it's a reverse heist. Instead of retrieving a valuable item, the characters are tasked with returning one to its proper place.
zh_tw: 這次冒險不是一個典型的搶劫；相反，它是一個反向搶劫。角色們的任務不是取回一個有價值的物品，而是將其歸還到正確的位置。

english: An unearthed tomb holds the key to saving a nearby town, as adventurers are about to discover
zh_tw: 一個被髮掘的古墓掌握著拯救附近小鎮的關鍵，冒險者們即將發現這一點

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: Long ago, a giant named Xeluan was attacked by his ruthless kin and left to die. After a group of heroes found him and nursed him back to health, the grateful giant pledged his life in their service. Xeluan and his heroic friends went on to perform great deeds.
zh_tw: 很久以前，一個名叫澤巒的巨人被他無情的同族攻擊並被遺棄等死。在一群英雄發現他並幫他恢復健康後，這位感激的巨人承諾將自己的生命奉獻給他們的服務。澤巒和他的英雄朋友們繼續去完成偉大的事蹟。

english: When earthquakes and volcanic eruptions threatened to destroy the heroes' homeland, Xeluan carved a citadel into a mountainside, creating a refuge for the heroes and their people. The giant harnessed earth magic to create a protective ward around the settlement, but the devastation proved unstoppable. As the mountain crumbled and volcanic rifts threatened to engulf those he loved, Xeluan lifted the sanctuary above his shoulders and made a final, desperate sacrifice. He wove his life energy into the magic protecting the citadel, allowing it to withstand the onslaught. In doing so, Xeluan sacrificed his life to save thousands.
zh_tw: 當地震和火山爆發威脅到摧毀英雄們的家園時，澤巒在山腰上雕刻了一座城堡，為英雄們和他們的人民創造了一個避難所。這位巨人利用土系魔法在定居點周圍創造了一個保護結界，但毀滅性的力量證明是無法阻擋的。隨著山體崩塌和火山裂縫威脅要吞噬他所愛的人，澤巒將聖所扛在肩上，做出了最後的、絕望的犧牲。他將自己的生命能量編織進保護城堡的魔法中，使其能夠承受衝擊。透過這樣做，澤巒犧牲了自己的生命來拯救數千人。

english: After the calamity, the heroes looked for the giant amid the changed landscape. They found his petrified body buried beneath the citadel, still holding it aloft. When all efforts to restore him failed, the heroes built a mausoleum around Xeluan's body to honor his sacrifice. The heroes lived prosperous lives, and afterward, their bodies were interred in Xeluan's tomb. When the last hero died, the tomb was sealed, and so it remained for centuries. Xeluan's sacrifice was lost to legend, and the heroes were remembered only as fables. As the citadel eroded to ruins, the tomb below it was all but forgotten.
zh_tw: 災難之後，英雄們在變化的地貌中尋找巨人。他們在城堡下找到了他石化的身體，仍然高舉著它。當所有恢復他的努力都失敗後，英雄們圍繞著澤巒的身體建造了一個陵墓來紀念他的犧牲。英雄們過著繁榮的生活，之後，他們的遺體被安葬在澤巒的墓中。當最後一個英雄去世時，墓穴被封閉了，就這樣持續了幾個世紀。澤巒的犧牲被遺忘在傳說中，英雄們只被當作寓言來記憶。隨著城堡侵蝕成廢墟，下面的墓穴幾乎被遺忘。

english: About a century ago, a group of explorers found the ruins of the citadel, its protective wards still intact. Around the citadel, these explorers founded the settlement of Oztocan. The settlement grew into a thriving hub of commerce. Today, that prosperity is threatened by the machinations of a criminal organization known as the Onyx Scar. The criminals have unearthed Xeluan's tomb and are mining the giant's petrified corpse, selling his remains at local markets. Additionally, their delving has weakened the citadel's wards, causing earthquakes to plague the region.
zh_tw: 大約一個世紀前，一群探險家發現了城堡的廢墟，其保護結界仍然完好無損。在城堡周圍，這些探險家建立了奧茲托坎定居點。這個定居點發展成為一個繁榮的商業中心。今天，這種繁榮受到了一個名為黑玉疤痕的犯罪組織的陰謀威脅。這些罪犯挖掘了澤巒的墳墓，並正在開採巨人的石化屍體，在本地市場上出售他的遺骸。此外，他們的挖掘活動削弱了城堡的結界，導致地震困擾該地區。

english: The Accursed Shard
zh_tw: 詛咒之碎片

english: This adventure revolves around an obsidian shard imbued with powerful magic. In the course of the adventure, the characters discover that the shard is a fragment of Xeluan's petrified heart. Only by using the shard to mend Xeluan's broken heart can they stop the earthquakes that rock Oztocan.
zh_tw: 這次冒險圍繞一塊注入了強大魔法的黑曜石碎片展開。在冒險過程中，角色們發現這塊碎片是澤巒石化心臟的一部分。只有使用這塊碎片修復澤巒破碎的心，他們才能阻止震動奧茲托坎的地震。

english: Shard Rumors
zh_tw: 碎片傳言

english: Some of this adventure's impact relies on the misunderstood nature of the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV}. No one remembers Xeluan's sacrifice or knows the shard is a fragment of his petrified heart. Moreover, the shard has gained an undeservedly sinister reputation because of rumors surrounding it.
zh_tw: 這次冒險的一些影響依賴於對{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}的誤解本質。沒有人記得澤巒的犧牲，也不知道這個碎片是他石化心臟的一部分。此外，由於圍繞它的謠言，這個碎片獲得了不應有的邪惡名聲。

english: Use the Shard Rumors table to inspire stories the characters might hear about the item's history. Whether a rumor is true or false is left to your judgment.
zh_tw: 使用"碎片謠言"表格激發角色可能聽到的關於這個物品歷史的故事情節。一個謠言是真是假由你的判斷決定。

english: Shard Rumors
zh_tw: 碎片傳言

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Rumor
zh_tw: 流言

english: The shard comes from the Abyss. The misery it causes feeds a dying, long-forgotten demon.
zh_tw: 這塊碎片來自無底深淵。它帶來的痛苦滋養著一個垂死、被長久遺忘的惡魔。

english: A sage who tried to learn the magical properties of the shard dropped dead without warning, and her soul became trapped in the shard.
zh_tw: 一位試圖學習這塊碎片魔法屬性的智者突然死亡，她的靈魂被困在了碎片之中。

english: A group of bandits received the shard as ransom. That night, a sickly green light bathed their camp, and all but one bandit disappeared.
zh_tw: 一群匪徒收到了這塊碎片作為贖金。那天晚上，他們營地被一種病態的綠光所籠罩，除了一個匪徒外，其他人都消失了。

english: A knight tried to destroy the shard, but the shard's curse petrified her.
zh_tw: 一位騎士試圖摧毀碎片，但碎片的詛咒使她石化了。

english: Shard Description
zh_tw: 碎片描述

english: See the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} entry. Characters don't become aware of the shard's curse until it comes into play.
zh_tw: 參見{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}條目。角色們在碎片發揮作用之前不會意識到它的詛咒。

english: Adventure Hooks
zh_tw: 冒險引子

english: Either the Golden Vault delivers the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} to the characters at the start of the adventure (see "Using the Golden Vault" below), or the characters come to possess the shard from one of the following individuals:
zh_tw: 要麼金庫在冒險開始時將{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}交給角色們（見下文的"使用金庫"），要麼角色們從以下個人之一處獲得這個碎片：

english: Jamishka Zaril
zh_tw: 賈米什卡·扎裡爾

english: Oztocan is an important outpost for a flourishing trade organization called the Couatl Company. Its owner, Jamishka (lawful good, elf {@creature veteran}), recently acquired the shard and has since learned that it must be returned to the tomb from which it was taken to stop the earthquakes that threaten Oztocan. Jamishka hires the characters to bring the shard to Leandro Sedhar, a playwright in Oztocan who can help them, and promises them a suit of {@item elven chain} (or some other rare magic item of your choice) as payment for stopping the earthquakes.
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎是一個名為羽蛇公司的繁榮貿易組織的重要前哨站。其所有者賈米什卡（守序善良，精靈{@creature veteran||老兵}），最近獲得了這塊碎片，並已得知必須將其歸還到它被取出的墳墓中，以阻止威脅奧茲托坎的地震。賈米什卡僱傭角色們將碎片帶給奧茲托坎的劇作家萊昂德羅·塞達爾，他可以幫助他們，並承諾如果他們能阻止地震，將給予他們一套{@item elven chain||精靈鍊甲}（或您選擇的其他稀有魔法物品）作為報酬。

english: Yana Resendes
zh_tw: 亞娜·雷森德斯

english: A kindly scholar named Yana (neutral good, hobgoblin {@creature mage}) recently acquired the shard at a market. Her investigations revealed the shard comes from Oztocan, which is beset by earthquakes. In Yana's opinion, returning the cursed shard to the place from which it was taken is the best way to stop the earthquakes. If the characters vow to complete this quest, Yana gives them a {@item necklace of prayer beads} (or some other rare magic item of your choice) as a token of her thanks and instructs them to bring the shard to Leandro Sedhar, a playwright in Oztocan who can help them.
zh_tw: 一位名叫雅娜（中立善良，大地精{@creature mage||魔法師})的和藹學者最近在市場獲得了這塊碎片。她的調查揭示了這塊碎片來自經常發生地震的奧茲托坎。在雅娜看來，將這塊被詛咒的碎片歸還到它被拿走的地方是停止地震的最佳方式。如果角色們承諾完成這個任務，雅娜會給他們一條{@item necklace of prayer beads||念珠項鍊}（或你選擇的其他稀有魔法物品）作為她感謝的象徵，並指示他們將碎片帶到奧茲托坎的劇作家萊昂德羅·塞達爾那裡，他可以幫助他們。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. If the characters don't already have the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} in their possession, the golden key is tied to the shard, and both objects are delivered in a stoppered lead tube.
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式交付給角色們。如果角色們尚未擁有{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}，金鑰匙將與碎片繫結，並且兩個物品將一起被放置在一個塞住的鉛管中交付。

english: When the golden key is used to open the music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 當金鑰匙用於開啟音樂盒時，蓋子彈開，一個舒緩的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. Earthquakes threaten the town of Oztocan, and the Golden Vault believes the enclosed shard is the heart of the problem.
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。地震威脅著奧茲托坎鎮，金庫相信所附的碎片是問題的核心。"

english: "This shard was taken from the tomb of a giant named Xeluan. A criminal organization called the Onyx Scar has been plundering Xeluan's tomb and selling off its treasures. The shard passed through many hands before the Golden Vault acquired it. Whoever attunes to the shard gains great strength and magical power but also suffers misfortune due to a curse.
zh_tw: "這個碎片是從一位名叫澤巒的巨人的墳墓中取出的。一個名為黑玉疤痕的犯罪組織一直在掠奪澤巒的墳墓並出售其寶藏。這個碎片經過了許多人的手，最後被金庫獲得。任何與碎片協調一致的人都會獲得巨大的力量和魔法能力，但也會因為詛咒而遭受不幸。"

english: "This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you travel to Oztocan with the shard, descend into Xeluan's tomb, and return the shard to its rightful place. Once you reach Oztocan, contact a playwright named Leandro Sedhar. He knows vital information about Oztocan's history and can help you reach the tomb. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "這個任務，如果你們選擇承擔，需要你們帶著碎片前往奧茲托坎，下到澤巒的墳墓，並將它歸還到它合適的地方。一旦你們到達奧茲托坎，請聯絡一位名叫萊昂德羅·塞達爾的劇作家。他對奧茲托坎的歷史有重要了解，可以幫助你們到達墳墓。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish. The {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} and the lead tube remain.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金色鑰匙消失。{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}和鉛管仍然存在。

english: What Really Happened
zh_tw: 真正發生了什麼

english: Two decades ago, an elf archivist named {@creature Rilago|KftGV} found crumbling journals and architectural plans in his family's ancestral library that mentioned a tomb beneath Oztocan. The town's mayor refused to allow {@creature Rilago|KftGV} to mount an excavation, but the mayor's daughter, Aminta, overheard their conversation and became obsessed with finding the tomb.
zh_tw: 二十年前，一位名叫{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的精靈檔案管理員在他的家族祖傳圖書館中發現了提到位於奧茲托坎下方的墳墓的破舊日記和建築計劃。鎮長拒絕允許{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}進行挖掘，但鎮長的女兒阿明塔無意中聽到了他們的對話，並變得對尋找這個墳墓著迷。

english: Years later, the mayor passed away and his son, Tavio, was elected to replace him. Aminta, who had become involved with the Onyx Scar crime syndicate, persuaded {@creature Rilago|KftGV} to join her search for the tomb and convinced Tavio to overlook their endeavor. Aminta and {@creature Rilago|KftGV} found the tomb and Xeluan's petrified remains, but no treasure. Disappointed, they tried to profit by shattering the giant's body, only to find it indestructible.
zh_tw: 多年後，市長去世了，他的兒子塔維奧被選為接替他的位置。阿明塔已經與黑玉疤痕犯罪集團有牽連，她說服{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}加入她尋找墳墓的行動，並說服塔維奧對他們的嘗試視而不見。阿明塔和{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}找到了墳墓和澤巒的石化遺骸，但沒有發現寶藏。失望之餘，他們試圖透過打碎巨人的身體來獲利，結果發現它堅不可摧。

english: One day, as {@creature Rilago|KftGV} climbed on the scaffolding surrounding Xeluan, he punched the giant's stone chest in frustration. It unexpectedly cracked open, revealing a heart of obsidian. A single shard broke off from the heart, impaling and killing {@creature Rilago|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 有一天，當{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}爬上圍繞著澤巒的腳手架時，他因沮喪而猛擊了巨人的石胸。出乎意料地，它裂開了，露出了一顆黑曜石的心。一顆碎片從心中脫落，刺穿並殺死了{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}。

english: Unbeknownst to everyone involved, {@creature Rilago|KftGV} was descended from one of the ancient heroes Xeluan died to protect. One of {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s rings was a family heirloom from that ancestor. When he punched the giant with that ring, he literally and symbolically broke Xeluan's heart, weakening the magic that protects the giant's corpse.
zh_tw: 在所有相關人員都不知情的情況下，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈} 是古代英雄之一塞魯安為保護而犧牲的後裔。{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈} 的一個戒指是來自那位祖先的家族傳家寶。當他用那個戒指擊打巨人時，他實際上並且象徵性地擊碎了塞魯安的心臟，削弱了保護巨人屍體的魔法。

english: The formerly indestructible giant began to deteriorate, allowing Aminta to collect broken-off pieces of Xeluan's body. This material, called "oztocanite," can be worked into precious gemstones or used to empower spells (see {@area area X4|381|x}). The sale of oztocanite has become a profitable enterprise for Aminta and has increased her status in the Onyx Scar.
zh_tw: 曾經堅不可摧的巨人開始退化，使得阿明塔能夠收集到澤巒身體的碎塊。這種材料被稱為"奧茲托坎石"，可以加工成珍貴的寶石或用於增強法術（見{@area 區域X4|381|x}）。奧茲托坎石的銷售已經成為阿明塔的一項有利可圖的事業，並提高了她在黑玉疤痕中的地位。

english: Town of Oztocan
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎鎮

english: Perched on a flat between two large mountains, the town of Oztocan is surrounded by deep canyons. The town shares the warm and dry climate of the region, which has sparse vegetation and rivers that run dry most of the year.
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎鎮坐落在兩座大山之間的平坦地帶，被深邃的峽谷所環繞。這個小鎮與該地區一樣，擁有溫暖而乾燥的氣候，植被稀疏，河流大部分時間都是乾涸的。

english: Magic radiating from Xeluan's tomb protects the town and the surrounding region from monster attacks and destructive natural occurrences, but the wards have weakened since Xeluan's heart cracked. Earthquakes that would normally be suppressed by the magic are now being felt, raising concerns that Oztocan is no longer safe.
zh_tw: 從澤巒的墓穴散發出的魔法保護著小鎮及周邊地區免受怪物攻擊和破壞性自然災害的影響，但是自從澤巒的心破碎後，這些防護已經減弱。原本會被魔法壓制的地震現在開始被感覺到，這引起了人們對奧茲托坎是否仍然安全的擔憂。

english: Arrival in Oztocan
zh_tw: 抵達奧茲托坎

english: As the characters approach the town, read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近這個小鎮時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Built on a large flat between two rocky mountains, the town of Oztocan is cradled by the crescent-shaped ruins of a massive stone citadel. Three guards stand at the point where the dusty road meets the town.
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎鎮建立在兩座岩石山之間的一個大平地上，被一個巨大的石頭城堡的月牙形廢墟所環繞。三名守衛站在塵土飛揚的道路與小鎮交匯的地方。

english: The three {@creature Guard||guards} eye the characters warily, but they don't stop or interfere with the party in any way. If the characters ask about Leandro Sedhar, a guard directs them to a local inn called the Giant's Skull, where Leandro is known to spend much of his time.
zh_tw: 三名{@creature Guard||警衛}警惕地打量著角色們，但他們並沒有阻止或以任何方式幹擾隊伍。如果角色們詢問關於萊昂德羅·塞達爾的資訊，一名警衛會指引他們去一個叫做巨人頭骨的當地旅館，萊昂德羅在那裡被知道會花費他大部分時間。

english: Tremor
zh_tw: 震顫

english: As soon as the characters enter the town, whoever is carrying the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} feels it drawn downward, as if attracted to something underground. Simultaneously, a small tremor ripples through the town, shaking dust from buildings but otherwise causing no damage. The locals appear accustomed to the quake and continue their activities unfazed.
zh_tw: 角色們一進入小鎮，攜帶{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}的人就感覺到它被向下吸引，彷彿被地下的什麼東西吸引。與此同時，小鎮上發生了一次小地震，震動使建築物上的灰塵落下，但除此之外沒有造成損害。當地人似乎已經習慣了地震，繼續他們的活動，毫不在意。

english: Leandro Sedhar
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅·塞達爾

english: Asking for Leandro around town leads the characters to the Giant's Skull, a welcoming inn made of wood and adobe. Leandro has been staying here for the past few weeks.
zh_tw: 在鎮上詢問萊昂德羅會引導角色們來到巨人頭骨，一個由木頭和土坯建造的溫馨旅館。萊昂德羅在過去的幾周裡一直住在這裡。

english: Leandro (chaotic good {@creature noble}) is a tabaxi—a Humanoid with feline features, including claws and a tail. He's short and stout, with lush, sand-colored fur and thin whiskers. Tiny square glasses frame his amber eyes. He was born in a distant land but has been traveling abroad for nearly twenty years. He arrived in Oztocan a few months ago and is working on a play inspired by the town's local legends. As a playwright, he often draws inspiration from history.
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅（混亂善良{@creature noble||貴族}）是一個斑貓人——一種具有貓科特徵的人形生物，包括爪子和尾巴。他身材矮小而結實，有著濃密的沙色毛髮和細長的鬍鬚。小巧的方形眼鏡框著他的琥珀色眼睛。他出生在遙遠的土地上，但已經在國外旅行了將近二十年。他幾個月前來到奧茲托坎，正在創作一部以小鎮當地傳說為靈感的戲劇。作為一名劇作家，他經常從歷史中汲取靈感。

english: What Leandro Knows
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅所知道的

english: Leandro welcomes the characters and takes an interest in the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} if they show it to him. He asks to see it more closely but refuses to touch it.
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅歡迎角色們，並且如果他們展示給他看，他會對{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}表現出興趣。他請求更近距離地看它，但拒絕觸控它。

english: In the course of a conversation, Leandro shares the following information with the characters:
zh_tw: 在一次對話過程中，萊昂德羅與角色們分享了以下資訊：

english: Earthquakes
zh_tw: 地震

english: "Oztocan hasn't felt earthquakes in years, but quakes have become common in recent weeks. No damage has been done yet, but the quakes are getting worse. It's only a matter of time before someone gets hurt."
zh_tw: "奧茲托坎多年來沒有感受到地震，但近幾周地震變得常見。目前還沒有造成任何損害，但地震正在變得越來越嚴重。遲早會有人受傷的。"

english: Rilago
zh_tw: 里拉戈

english: "Years ago, an elf archivist named {@creature Rilago|KftGV} claimed to have proof of a giant's tomb beneath Oztocan. {@creature Rilago|KftGV} tried to mount a full-scale excavation, but the mayor wouldn't allow it. {@creature Rilago|KftGV} stayed in Oztocan until his disappearance a few weeks ago—around the time the earthquakes began."
zh_tw: "幾年前，一位名叫{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的精靈檔案管理員聲稱有證據證明在奧茲托坎下有一個巨人的墳墓。{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}試圖進行一次全面挖掘，但市長不允許。{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}一直留在奧茲托坎，直到幾周前他失蹤了——大約是地震開始的時候。"

english: Tavio
zh_tw: 塔維奧

english: "I recently spoke to the Tavio Solana, the mayor. He grew uncomfortable when I mentioned {@creature Rilago|KftGV}. It was Tavio's father, the previous mayor, who refused to allow the excavation of Xeluan's tomb. I don't believe Tavio had anything to do with {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s disappearance, but I can't help but think Tavio knows something about it."
zh_tw: "我最近和市長塔維奧·索拉納談過。當我提到{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}時，他顯得不安。是塔維奧的父親，也就是前市長，拒絕允許挖掘澤巒的墳墓。我不認為塔維奧和{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的失蹤有任何關係，但我不禁覺得塔維奧對此事知道一些內情。"

english: Aminta
zh_tw: 阿明塔

english: "Tavio's sister, Aminta, commands the town guard. Rumor has it she was involved with {@creature Rilago|KftGV} romantically."
zh_tw: "塔維奧的妹妹，阿明塔，指揮著鎮上的警衛。有傳言說她與{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}有浪漫關係。"

english: Leandro's Secret
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅的秘密

english: Leandro knows that Aminta is a member of the Onyx Scar, a criminal syndicate with operatives scattered throughout Oztocan. Leandro is fond of Tavio, the mayor, and doesn't want him to suffer blame for Oztocan's troubles or Aminta's criminal pursuits, so he keeps these facts to himself.
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅知道阿明塔是黑玉疤痕的成員，這是一個犯罪集團，其成員遍佈奧茲托坎。萊昂德羅對市長塔維奧有好感，不希望他因為奧茲托坎的麻煩或阿明塔的犯罪行為而受到指責，所以他將這些事實保留在心中。

english: Leandro recently confronted Tavio, who admitted he has been covering up Aminta's criminal activities and her excavation of Xeluan's tomb. Guilt-ridden over the earthquakes, Tavio stole a map of Xeluan's tomb from Aminta's quarters and gave it to Leandro for safekeeping.
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅最近質問了塔維奧，塔維奧承認他一直在掩蓋阿明塔的犯罪活動以及她對澤巒墓穴的挖掘。塔維奧因地震感到內疚，從阿明塔的住處偷了一張澤巒墓穴的地圖，並將其交給萊昂德羅保管。

english: Leandro's Map
zh_tw: 萊昂德羅的地圖

english: If the characters seem interested in stopping the earthquakes and solving the mystery of {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s disappearance, Leandro shows them the map Tavio gave him. (Give the players a copy of {@adventure map 9.1|KftGV|9|Map 9.1: Players' Map}.) The map is pieced together from several torn scraps and shows most of Xeluan's tomb, minus locations that hadn't been uncovered at the time the map was drawn. Leandro informs the characters that the handwriting on the map is {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s.
zh_tw: 如果角色們對阻止地震和解開{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}失蹤之謎表現出興趣，萊昂德羅會向他們展示塔維奧給他的地圖。（給玩家一份{@adventure 地圖 9.1|KftGV|9|Map 9.1: Players' Map}的副本。）這張地圖是由幾塊撕裂的碎片拼湊而成，顯示了澤巒的大部分墳墓，除了繪製地圖時尚未被發現的地點。萊昂德羅告訴角色們，地圖上的筆跡是{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的。

english: If the characters draw Leandro's attention to the words "Heroes Rest Here" on the map's upper level, Leandro shares an Oztocan fable about a band of heroes who defended their homeland with the help of a giant. When the giant died, the heroes honored their mighty companion by building a tomb around his petrified body. Leandro doesn't know what became of the heroes, nor does history remember their names, but the giant's name was Xeluan.
zh_tw: 如果角色們引起萊昂德羅對地圖上層的"英雄歇腳處"字樣的注意，萊昂德羅分享了一個關於一群英雄的奧茲托坎寓言，他們得到了一個巨人的幫助保衛了自己的家園。當巨人去世時，英雄們透過圍繞他的石化身體建造墳墓來紀念他們強大的同伴。萊昂德羅不知道這些英雄後來怎麼樣了，歷史也沒有記住他們的名字，但巨人的名字是澤巒。

english: Placing Oztocan
zh_tw: 定位奧茲托坎

english: Oztocan is situated amid the One Flint Sierras mountain range south of San Citlán, an industrial city-state that first appeared in the adventure anthology {@adventure Journeys through the Radiant Citadel|JttRC}. If your campaign takes place elsewhere in the D&D multiverse, you can insert Oztocan into any mountainous location.
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎位於聖西特蘭南部的一閃石山脈中，聖西特蘭是一個工業城邦，首次出現在冒險文集{@adventure 耀光城之旅|JttRC}中。如果您的戰役發生在D&D多元宇宙的其他位置，您可以將奧茲托坎插入任何多山的地點。

english: Casa Solana
zh_tw: 卡薩·索拉納

english: Tavio and Aminta Solana are the children of the town's previous mayor, the late Nadario Solana. Oztocan has no aristocracy, but the Solana family is the next closest thing.
zh_tw: 塔維奧和阿明塔·索拉納是小鎮前市長，已故的納達里奧·索拉納的孩子們。奧茲托坎沒有貴族，但索拉納家族是最接近貴族的存在。

english: If the characters want to question Tavio Solana, Leandro informs them the mayor lives in a large two-story house with his sister. Well-tended gardens surround the house, which has six guards ({@creature Veteran||veterans}). Two guards stand outside the front entrance, two stand outside the back entrance, and two are inside the house within earshot of the mayor.
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要質問塔維奧·索拉納，萊昂德羅會告訴他們市長和他妹妹住在一個大型的兩層樓房裡。精心打理的花園環繞著這棟房子，房子周圍有六名守衛（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）。兩名守衛站在前門外面，兩名站在後門外面，還有兩名在房子裡面，能聽到市長的聲音。

english: Tavio Solana
zh_tw: 塔維奧·索拉納

english: Tavio Solana (neutral, human {@creature noble}) is the amiable and easily manipulated mayor of Oztocan. In his forties, Tavio has brown skin and sports short black hair, a scruffy beard, and simple clothes. Although he is smart, he has an aversion to conflict and is filled with self-doubt.
zh_tw: 塔維奧·索拉納（中立，人類{@creature noble||貴族}）是奧茲托坎鎮友好且容易被操縱的市長。塔維奧四十多歲，皮膚呈棕色，留著短黑髮，鬍鬚凌亂，穿著樸素的衣服。儘管他很聰明，但他厭惡衝突，內心充滿自我懷疑。

english: When the characters first arrive at the Solana residence, Aminta is not present, but Tavio is in the gardens.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次到達索拉納的住所時，阿明塔不在場，但塔維奧在花園裡。

english: Approaching the Mayor
zh_tw: 接近市長

english: If the characters approach Tavio and politely request his help, he hesitates before telling them that he wants his sister to stop despoiling the tomb, as he believes her actions endanger the town. If the characters press him for information, Tavio laments that most of the town guard is under the sway of the Onyx Scar, except for two guards who have been with his family for years. Tavio then reveals the following information in the course of a whispered conversation:
zh_tw: 如果角色們接近塔維奧並以禮貌的方式請求他的幫助，他會猶豫一下，然後告訴他們他希望他的妹妹停止褻瀆墳墓，因為他相信她的行為危及了小鎮。如果角色們向他追問資訊，塔維奧會嘆息表示，除了兩名多年來一直與他家族相伴的警衛外，大部分鎮上的警衛都受到了黑玉疤痕的影響。接著，在一次低聲交談中，塔維奧透露了以下資訊：

english: Aminta's Whereabouts
zh_tw: 阿明塔的下落

english: "It grieves me to say that my sister is obsessed with plundering the tomb under Oztocan. Of late, she talks of nothing else. She doesn't trust anyone, which is why she is overseeing the operation personally."
zh_tw: "我很難過地說，我的妹妹對掠奪奧茲托坎下的墳墓著迷。最近，她除了這件事什麼都不談。她不信任任何人，這就是她親自監督行動的原因。"

english: Cause of the Earthquakes
zh_tw: 地震的原因

english: "Unearthing the tomb has angered the gods, who send earthquakes as warnings. If we don't heed these warnings, Oztocan will be destroyed."
zh_tw: "挖掘古墓觸怒了眾神，他們派遣地震作為警告。如果我們不重視這些警告，奧茲托坎將會被毀滅。"

english: Rilago's Fate
zh_tw: 里拉戈的命運

english: "{@creature Rilago|KftGV}? He was so keen to explore the tomb—he and my sister, both. Aminta told me a trap killed him—an obsidian splinter through the heart. Poor man."
zh_tw: "{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}？他對探索墳墓非常熱衷——他和我妹妹都是。阿明塔告訴我，一個陷阱殺死了他——一塊黑曜石碎片穿透了心臟。可憐的人。"

english: Workers Needed
zh_tw: 需要工人

english: "Aminta needs more workers to help remove precious stones from the tomb. I'm supposed to help her find workers who know how to keep their mouths shut."
zh_tw: "阿明塔需要更多的工人來幫助從墳墓中移除珍貴的寶石。我應該幫她找到知道如何保守秘密的工人。"

english: Secret Entrance
zh_tw: 秘密入口

english: "Workers are led to and from the tomb through a guarded passage in the ruined citadel around which the town is built."
zh_tw: "工人透過環繞城鎮的廢墟堡壘中的一個守衛通道被帶到古墓並且從那裡返回。"

english: If the characters show Tavio the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV}, he tells them the following:
zh_tw: "如果角色們向塔維奧展示{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}，他會告訴他們以下內容："

english: "That's the splinter that killed {@creature Rilago|KftGV}! Aminta showed it to me after pulling it from his body. She told me it's from the heart of a giant statue. How did you come to acquire it?"
zh_tw: "那是殺死{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的碎片！阿明塔從他的身體裡拔出來後給我看了。她告訴我它來自一個巨大雕像的心臟。你是如何得到它的？"

english: Regardless of what the characters tell him, Tavio urges them to return the shard to its proper place in the tomb. He also asks them to beware his sister, whose allegiance to the Onyx Scar is absolute.
zh_tw: 不管角色們告訴塔維奧什麼，他都敦促他們將碎片歸還到古墓中的適當位置。他還要求他們提防他的妹妹，她對黑曜之痕的忠誠是絕對的。

english: Infiltration Plans
zh_tw: 滲透計劃

english: The characters have several options for infiltrating the tomb.
zh_tw: 角色們有幾種潛入墳墓的選擇。

english: Infiltrating as Workers
zh_tw: 作為工人潛入

english: Tavio believes the characters could most easily infiltrate Aminta's operation by posing as workers, but he warns they'll be searched on the way in. His two trustworthy guards can hide the characters' gear in a chest near the workers' quarters. If the characters agree to this, Tavio concocts an excuse to visit Aminta at the tomb. He and his guards leave the party's equipment in {@area area X9|395|x}.
zh_tw: 塔維奧認為角色們最容易透過偽裝成工人的方式潛入阿明塔的行動中，但他警告說在進入的路上他們會被人搜查。他那兩個值得信賴的守衛可以把角色們的裝備藏在工人宿舍附近的一個箱子裡。如果角色們同意這樣做，塔維奧會編造一個藉口去古墓拜訪阿明塔。他和他的守衛會把隊伍的裝備留在{@area 區域X9|395|x}。

english: Tavio directs the characters to a spot near the citadel where workers wait to be escorted to the tomb (see "{@area Ruined Citadel|371|x}").
zh_tw: 塔維奧指引角色們到城堡附近的一個地方，那裡有工人等待被護送到墳墓（見"{@area 廢墟堡壘|371|x}"）。

english: Rilago's Notes
zh_tw: 里拉戈的筆記

english: Other than the citadel's main entrance (on the lower level of map 9.1), {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s notes point to three other possible means of entry: two ventilation shafts exiting to the hills outside Oztocan (see "{@area Ventilation Shafts|373|x}") and a fountain connected to a nearby grotto (see "{@area Ironbed Grotto|374|x}").
zh_tw: 除了城堡的主入口（在地圖9.1的下層），{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的筆記指向了三個其他可能的入口：兩個通向奧茲托坎外山丘的通風井（見"{@area 通風井|373|x}"）和一個連線到附近巖洞的噴泉（見"{@area 鐵床巖洞|374|x}"）。

english: Map 9.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖9.1：玩家地圖

english: Reaching the Tomb
zh_tw: 到達墓穴

english: The following locations provide different ways to access Xeluan's tomb.
zh_tw: 以下地點提供了進入澤巒墓的不同途徑。

english: Ruined Citadel
zh_tw: 廢墟堡壘

english: Oztocan's most prominent landmark is the ruined citadel around which the town was built. A recently excavated tunnel leads to Xeluan's tomb and is guarded at all times, as described below:
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎最顯著的地標是圍繞其建造的廢墟城堡。最近挖掘的一條隧道通向澤巒的墳墓，並且始終有守衛，如下所述：

english: Ten members of the town guard stand watch atop giant blocks of stone that were once part of a great citadel, now a tumbled-down ruin. A tunnel has been opened at the base of the ruined citadel. Crude, torchlit steps descend into the earth.
zh_tw: 十名城鎮守衛站在曾經是宏偉城堡、現在已成為倒塌廢墟的巨大石塊上。在這座廢墟城堡的底部開鑿了一條隧道。簡陋、火把照亮的臺階向下延伸至地下。

english: The ten {@creature Veteran||veterans} guarding the tunnel entrance are loyal to Aminta and attack anyone who tries to enter the tunnel without an escort. If the characters come here in the guise of workers, five of the guards lead them to {@area area X1|378|x} at the start of the next shift change, which occurs whenever you deem appropriate.
zh_tw: 守衛隧道入口的十名{@creature Veteran||老兵}忠於阿明塔，並且會攻擊任何試圖在沒有護送的情況下進入隧道的人。如果角色以工人的身份來到這裡，五名守衛會在下一個班次開始時，將他們帶到{@area 區域X1|378|x}，班次變更發生在您認為合適的時候。

english: Ventilation Shafts
zh_tw: 通風井

english: Ventilation shafts connect Xeluan's tomb to two caves: one to the east, the other to the west. Oztocan's residents are familiar with the caves but avoid them because they're hard to reach.
zh_tw: 通風井將澤巒的墓穴與兩個洞穴相連：一個在東邊，另一個在西邊。奧茲托坎的居民對這些洞穴很熟悉，但因為難以到達而避開它們。

english: The characters must climb or fly 200 feet to reach either cave, which is situated in the middle of a hillside escarpment. Any such climb requires pitons, rope, and a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check for every 100 feet climbed. On a failed check, a character falls 50 feet before they're caught by their climbing rope, taking 17 ({@dice 5d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall.
zh_tw: 角色們必須攀爬或飛行200尺才能到達位於山坡懸崖中間的洞穴。任何此類攀爬都需要使用巖釘、繩索，並在每攀爬100尺時進行一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色會掉落50尺，直到被他們的攀爬繩拉住，並從墜落中受到17（{@dice 5d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: Each cave is empty except for a ventilation shaft in its back wall. Both shafts are 20 feet wide, 20 feet tall, and made of smooth limestone. The east ventilation shaft leads to a corridor between areas {@area X6|388|x} and {@area X7|38e|x}. The west ventilation shaft leads to a corridor between areas {@area X12|39f|x} and {@area X13|3a2|x}.
zh_tw: 每個洞穴除了後牆上的一個通風井外都是空的。兩個通風井都是20尺寬，20尺高，由光滑的石灰石製成。東側的通風井通向區域{@area X6|388|x}和{@area X7|38e|x}之間的走廊。西側的通風井通向區域{@area X12|39f|x}和{@area X13|3a2|x}之間的走廊。

english: Each ventilation shaft ends at a grate made of corroded, vertical iron bars, which the characters must bypass to enter the corridor beyond. As an action, a character can try to bend or break the rusty bars, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check and creating an opening big enough for Medium or smaller creatures to pass through.
zh_tw: 每個通風井的盡頭都有一個由腐蝕的垂直鐵條製成的柵格，角色們必須繞過它才能進入前方的走廊。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試彎曲或折斷這些生鏽的鐵條，成功透過一次難度等級為 {@dc 17} 的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}檢定後，將建立一個足夠中等或更小體型生物透過的開口。

english: Ironbed Grotto
zh_tw: 鐵床巖洞

english: {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s map mentions Ironbed Grotto—a name Leandro and Tavio recognize as a cavern network east of town. Near Ironbed Grotto's easily found entrance, an underground river winds through the caverns, eventually feeding the fountain in {@area area X6|388|x}. The cave network is devoid of town guards, but monsters might dwell here at your discretion.
zh_tw: {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的地圖提到了鐵床巖洞——一個位於城鎮東側的洞穴網路，萊昂德羅和塔維奧都認出這個名字。在鐵床巖洞容易找到的入口附近，一條地下河流經洞穴，最終流入{@area 區域X6|388|x}的噴泉。洞穴網路中沒有鎮上的警衛，但根據你的決定，可能有怪物居住在這裡。

english: Once the characters near the fountain, the caverns narrow into a small underwater channel the characters must swim through, as detailed in area X6. If the characters use this route, they enter the tomb soaking wet.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們接近噴泉，洞穴就會變窄成為一個角色們必須遊過的小水下通道，如區域X6中詳細描述的那樣。如果角色們選擇這條路線，他們進入墓穴時會渾身溼透。

english: Xeluan's Tomb
zh_tw: 澤巒的墓

english: Xeluan's brave companions built a tomb around the giant's remains so everyone who wanted to honor him could do so. One of these heroes—an elf monk named Itze—founded the Order of Xeluan, a sect of monks dedicated to preserving the tomb.
zh_tw: 澤巒的勇敢同伴們圍繞著巨人的遺體建造了一座墳墓，以便所有想要紀念他的人都能這樣做。其中一位英雄——一個名叫伊茨的精靈僧侶——創立了澤巒教團，這是一個致力於保護墳墓的僧侶宗派。

english: As the years passed, the tomb came to house the remains of Itze's other companions, who wished to join Xeluan in eternal rest. Finally, only Itze remained. In the final years of her life, she prepared to be buried with her companions. When Itze died, her remains were placed in the tomb, and the Order of Xeluan sealed the tomb and disbanded.
zh_tw: 隨著歲月流逝，這個墳墓逐漸成為伊策其他同伴的安息之地，他們希望與澤巒一同享受永恆的安息。最終，只剩下伊策。在她生命的最後幾年，她準備與她的同伴們一起被埋葬。當伊策去世後，她的遺體被安置在墳墓中，澤巒之序封印了墳墓並解散了。

english: Tomb Features
zh_tw: 墳墓特徵

english: Xeluan's tomb has the following features:
zh_tw: 澤巒的墳墓有以下特點：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings are 15 feet high, with the exception of the 40-foot-high Great Chamber ({@area area X4|381|x}).
zh_tw: 天花板通常高15尺，{@area 區域X4|381|x} 除外，它的高度為40尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Unless otherwise specified, doors are made of iron-reinforced wood and are kept locked, requiring a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools or {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to open. Guards carry keys to each door on their level unless otherwise noted.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，門是由鐵加固的木材製成並保持上鎖狀態，需要使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 17}敏捷檢定或{@dc 17}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來開啟。除非另有說明，守衛會攜帶其所在樓層每扇門的鑰匙。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Areas {@area X2|37b|x}, {@area X3|37e|x}, {@area X4|381|x}, and {@area X21|3b9|x} are brightly lit by torches imbued with {@spell continual flame} spells. The rest of the tomb is dark. Members of the Onyx Scar use oil lamps to light their surroundings. Area descriptions assume the characters have a light source or other means of seeing in the dark.
zh_tw: 區域{@area X2|37b|x}、{@area X3|37e|x}、{@area X4|381|x}和{@area X21|3b9|x}由施有{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術的火把照亮，十分明亮。墳墓的其餘部分是黑暗的。黑玉疤痕的成員使用油燈來照亮他們的周圍。區域描述假設角色有光源或在黑暗中看見的其他手段。

english: Walls and Floors
zh_tw: 牆壁和地板

english: The tomb is carved from limestone. The walls on the upper level are engraved with scenes depicting Xeluan's life, though they've eroded considerably after years of neglect.
zh_tw: 這座墓穴是由石灰岩雕刻而成。上層的牆壁上刻有描繪澤巒一生的景象，儘管由於多年的忽視，它們已經相當侵蝕。

english: Tomb Locations
zh_tw: 墳墓位置

english: The following locations in Xeluan's tomb are keyed to map 9.2.
zh_tw: 澤巒的墳墓中以下地點對應於地圖9.2。

english: Map 9.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖9.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: X1: Main Entrance
zh_tw: X1. 主入口

english: A 200-foot-long, excavated tunnel connects the citadel ruins to a natural cavern under Oztocan. Torches light the tunnel at 10-foot intervals. When the characters reach the cavern, read the following:
zh_tw: 一條200尺長的挖掘隧道連線著城堡廢墟和奧茲托坎下面的天然洞穴。隧道每隔10尺就有火把照明。當角色們到達洞穴時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Dampness hangs in the air, and fungus clings to the walls of this limestone cavern. At the far end, worn steps lead up to a pair of massive doors. Each door is made of black iron and shaped like half of a giant face, cast with an expression of deep pain.
zh_tw: 潮溼的空氣瀰漫著，真菌附著在這座石灰岩洞穴的牆壁上。在最遠端，磨損的臺階通向一對巨大的門。每扇門都是由黑鐵製成，形狀像一個巨大面孔的一半，鑄造著深深的痛苦表情。

english: If the characters arrive here under the pretext of pretending to be workers, their armed escort (five {@creature Veteran||veterans}) leads them through the iron doors into area X2.
zh_tw: 如果角色們以假裝是工人為藉口來到這裡，他們的武裝護送（五名{@creature Veteran||老兵}）會帶領他們穿過鐵門進入X2區域。

english: Iron Doors
zh_tw: 鐵門

english: The doors are held shut by two iron bars that can be removed only by creatures in area X2. If the party approaches the doors with an armed escort, one of the guards knocks on the doors six times, which signals the guards in area X2 to lift the bars and open the doors. The guards in area X2 won't open the doors unless they hear a sequence of six knocks—no more, no less. The doors have AC 17, 80 hit points, a damage threshold of 10, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 這兩扇門被兩根鐵條固定著，只有在X2區域的生物才能移除它們。如果隊伍在武裝護送下接近門，其中一名守衛會敲六下門，這是向X2區域的守衛發出的訊號，讓他們抬起鐵條並開啟門。除非他們聽到六下敲擊聲——不多也不少，X2區域的守衛才會開門。這些門有AC 17，80生命值，10點傷害閾值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: The noise of breaking down the doors can be heard by all creatures on the tomb's lower level. These creatures remain in their respective locations but are alert for the next hour, during which time they can't be {@quickref surprised|PHB|3|0|surprised}.
zh_tw: 打破門的聲音可以被墳墓下層的所有生物聽到。這些生物留在各自的位置上，但在接下來的一個小時內保持警覺，在此期間它們不能被{@quickref surprised|PHB|3|0|突襲}。

english: X2: Vestibule
zh_tw: X2. 前廳

english: The following boxed text assumes the characters enter from the south. If they enter from the north, they can't see the carvings on the granite slab, the furniture behind it, or the guards:
zh_tw: 以下方框文字假定角色從南方進入。如果他們從北方進入，他們將看不到花崗岩石板上的雕刻、石板後面的傢俱或守衛：

english: Torches mounted to four pillars light this ancient room. In the center of the room, a table and several chairs are situated in front of a vertical slab of granite measuring ten feet high and thirty feet wide. This slab bears carvings of people carrying offerings to a citadel nestled between two mountains.
zh_tw: 四根柱子上的火把照亮了這個古老的房間。房間中央，一張桌子和幾把椅子擺放在一塊高十尺、寬三十尺的垂直花崗巖板前。這塊石板上雕刻著人們向坐落在兩座山之間的城堡獻上祭品的場景。

english: Four battle-ready members of the town guard stand next to the pillars.
zh_tw: 四名準備戰鬥的城鎮守衛站在柱子旁邊。

english: This antechamber once welcomed pilgrims wishing to pay their respects to Xeluan, but the Onyx Scar has converted it into a guard post. The guards stationed here are four {@creature Veteran||veterans}.
zh_tw: 這個前廳曾經歡迎想要向澤巒表示敬意的朝聖者，但是黑曜之痕已經將其改造成了一個警衛站。駐紮在這裡的守衛是四名{@creature Veteran||老兵}。

english: If the characters are pretending to be workers, the guards search them for concealed armor and weapons before leading them to {@area area X4|381|x}. A character can try to smuggle a light weapon or smaller object past the guards. Doing so requires a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the check fails, the guards spot the prohibited item and try to confiscate it; the character must either talk their way out of trouble with a successful {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check or be attacked.
zh_tw: 如果角色們假裝成工人，守衛會在帶領他們前往{@area 區域X4|381|x}之前搜查他們是否藏有盔甲和武器。角色可以嘗試將一件輕型武器或更小的物品偷偷帶過守衛。這樣做需要透過一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，守衛會發現違禁物品並試圖沒收；角色必須透過一次成功的{@dc 18}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來擺脫麻煩，否則會遭到攻擊。

english: Barred Door
zh_tw: 橫閂門

english: Two iron bars seal the double door to the south. Removing an iron bar takes an action.
zh_tw: 兩道鐵條封住了朝南的雙扇門。移除一根鐵條需要一個動作。

english: X3: Arrow Slit Hallway
zh_tw: X3. 箭縫走廊

english: A narrow hallway lined with arrow slits stretches north and south, opening into brightly lit chambers at each end.
zh_tw: 一條狹窄的走廊兩側排列著箭縫，向北和向南延伸，在兩端都通向明亮的房間。

english: This area once contained shrines to various gods, but the Onyx Scar renovated it, creating a hallway with arrow slits on both sides.
zh_tw: 這個區域曾經供奉著各種神祇的神龕，但是黑曜之痕進行了改造，建立了一條兩側都有箭縫的走廊。

english: Arrow Slits
zh_tw: 箭垛

english: Four Onyx Scar {@creature Thug||thugs} stand behind the western arrow slits, ready to shoot their crossbows at intruders who traverse the hallway without an Onyx Scar escort. The arrow slits give the thugs {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
zh_tw: 四名黑玉傷疤{@creature Thug||暴徒}站在西部箭縫後面，準備用他們的十字弓射擊沒有黑玉傷疤護衛而穿越走廊的入侵者。箭縫為暴徒提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: No guards are stationed behind the eastern arrow slits.
zh_tw: 東部的箭縫後面沒有守衛駐守。

english: The statue of a giant braces the ceiling in Xeluan's Tomb
zh_tw: 在澤巒的墓穴中，一尊巨人雕像支撐著天花板

english: X4: Great Chamber
zh_tw: X4. 大廳

english: Encircling this domed chamber is a fifteen-foot-high mezzanine supported by four limestone pillars. In the room's center, a thirty-foot-tall statue made of lustrous black rock reflects the torchlight. The statue depicts a giant, his face frozen in determination and his arms bracing the ceiling. A hole in the statue's chest exposes an obsidian heart with glittering veins of silver and gold.
zh_tw: 環繞這個圓頂房間的是一個十五尺高的夾層，由四根石灰岩柱子支撐。房間中央，一尊三十尺高的雕像由光彩奪目的黑色岩石製成，反射著火把的光芒。雕像描繪了一個巨人，他的臉帶著堅定的表情，雙臂支撐著天花板。雕像胸部的一個洞露出了一顆黑曜石心臟，上面閃爍著金銀的脈絡。

english: Scaffolding around the statue provides easy access to the mezzanine. Standing on and around the scaffolding are several workers. Some are using pickaxes to chip away at the statue, while others are gathering chunks of the statue into crates.
zh_tw: 雕像周圍的腳手架為到達夾層提供了便捷的通道。站在腳手架上及其周圍的是一些工人。一些人正使用鎬頭敲擊雕像，而其他人則在將雕像的碎片收集到板條箱中。

english: Passages here lead northwest, northeast, and south.
zh_tw: 這裡的通道通往西北、東北和南方。

english: Tremor
zh_tw: 震顫

english: The first time the characters bring the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} into this room or onto the mezzanine ({@area area X18|3b1|x}), the ground shakes and rubble falls from the ceiling. Each creature in these areas must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damage from falling debris.
zh_tw: 當角色首次將{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}帶入這個房間或夾層（{@area 區域X18|3b1|x}）時，地面開始震動，碎片從天花板上落下。這些區域中的每個生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 12} 敏捷豁免，否則將因落下的碎片受到3（{@dice 1d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: Workers
zh_tw: 工人

english: Roll {@dice 1d6 + 3} to determine how many workers ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) are here when the characters arrive. One of the workers acts as an overseer. If the characters are pretending to be workers, the overseer gives them tasks as the other workers retire to {@area area X12|39f|x} for some much-needed rest.
zh_tw: 擲骰{@dice 1d6 + 3}來決定當角色到達時這裡有多少工人（{@creature Commoner||平民}）。其中一個工人充當監工。如果角色們偽裝成工人，監工會在其他工人去{@area 區域X12|39f|x}休息時給他們分配任務。

english: The Onyx Scar pays the workers to keep their mouths shut. Any character who questions the workers can pry the following information from them with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check:
zh_tw: 奧尼克斯疤痕付錢給工人以保持沉默。任何一個角色如果詢問工人，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定從他們口中撬出以下資訊：

english: Aminta
zh_tw: 阿明塔

english: Aminta was last seen on the upper level.
zh_tw: 阿明塔最後一次被看到是在上層。

english: Edino's Research
zh_tw: 埃迪諾的研究

english: An elf mage named Edino is conducting experiments on the giant's remains. Edino's study ({@area area X10|399|x}) lies west of here.
zh_tw: 一個名叫埃迪諾的精靈法師正在對巨人的遺骸進行實驗。埃迪諾的研究區域（{@area 區域X10|399|x}）位於這裡的西側。

english: Trouble to the East
zh_tw: 東方的麻煩

english: The Onyx Scar has sealed off the area to the east due to a "fungal infestation." That area contains a garden, a fountain, and a secret exit from the tomb. (The workers overheard two members of the Onyx Scar talking about {@area area X6|388|x} but don't know any more details.)
zh_tw: 黑玉疤痕因為"真菌感染"封閉了東部區域。那個區域包含一個花園、一個噴泉和一個從墳墓的秘密出口。（工人們無意中聽到兩名黑玉疤痕成員談論{@area 區域X6|388|x}，但不知道更多細節。）

english: Raw Oztocanite
zh_tw: 原始奧茲托坎石

english: Chunks of oztocanite (the giant's magic-imbued remains) are gathered into crates around the room. A fist-sized chunk of oztocanite can be used as a spellcasting focus that grants a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. However, if its wielder rolls a 1 on a spell attack roll while using it as a focus, the chunk shatters and the creature takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) thunder damage.
zh_tw: 奧茲托坎石塊（巨人魔法注入的遺骸）被收集在房間周圍的板條箱中。一個拳頭大小的奧茲托坎石塊可以用作施法焦點，提供+1的法術攻擊加值。然而，如果使用者在使用它作為焦點時擲出了法術攻擊的1點，石塊會碎裂，生物會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）雷鳴傷害。

english: Giant's Heart
zh_tw: 巨人之心

english: The first character to inspect Xeluan's body notices a large sliver is missing from his heart—the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} would easily fit into it. However, the characters can't mend Xeluan's heart without the help of {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s ghost in {@area area X22|3bd|x}.
zh_tw: 第一個檢查澤巒身體的的角色會注意到他的心臟缺少一大塊碎片——{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}可以很容易地放入其中。然而，沒有{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂在{@area 區域X22|3bd|x}的幫助，角色們無法修復澤巒的心臟。

english: If the characters attempt to place the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} in the heart without {@creature Rilago|KftGV}, the shard falls out again and nothing happens. A character who observes this and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check realizes a mystical force shattered the giant's heart and that this same force might be able to mend it.
zh_tw: 如果角色嘗試在沒有 {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈} 的情況下將 {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片} 放入心臟中，碎片會再次掉出，且不會發生任何事。觀察到此情況併成功透過 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色會意識到一種神秘力量摧毀了巨人的心臟，而這種力量或許也能修復它。

english: X5: Barricaded Corridor
zh_tw: X5. 封鎖走廊

english: The Onyx Scar barricaded this corridor after the myconids in area X6 began to attack anyone who got close to them. The hall contains two barricades, each one a floor-to-ceiling stack of wooden logs. A single character can remove a barricade in 30 minutes. Multiple characters working together can reduce this time proportionately.
zh_tw: 黑玉疤痕在區域X6的菌類生物開始攻擊接近它們的任何人之後，封鎖了這條走廊。走廊裡有兩個路障，每個都是從地板到天花板的木柴堆。一個單一的角色可以在30分鐘內移除一個路障。多個角色一起工作可以相應地減少這個時間。

english: X6: Forgotten Garden
zh_tw: X6. 遺忘的花園

english: A haze of spores fills this large room, three corners of which contain walled-in shrines with steps leading up to them. Tangled mushrooms and roots have extended beyond a central garden to cover every visible surface.
zh_tw: 這個大房間內瀰漫著孢子的薄霧，其中三個角落有圍牆的神龕，臺階通向它們。糾纏的蘑菇和根部已經從中心花園延伸出來，覆蓋了所有可見的表面。

english: Rising from the garden is a staircase that connects to a wooden trapdoor in the ceiling. A burbling fountain protrudes from the wall east of the garden.
zh_tw: 從花園中升起的樓梯連線著天花板上的一個木質活板門。一個潺潺的噴泉從花園東側的牆壁突出。

english: A narrow hallway leads north, and from the southeast corner of the room, a wider hallway leads south.
zh_tw: 一條狹窄的走廊向北延伸，從房間的東南角，一條更寬的走廊向南延伸。

english: The room is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||lightly obscured} by clouds of spores. The Order of Xeluan used to harvest mushrooms from the garden, which is now the home of two {@creature Myconid Sovereign||myconid sovereigns}, four {@creature Myconid Adult||myconid adults}, and a {@creature shambling mound}. These creatures lurk amid the garden's vegetation. Characters who have a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 16 or higher see the creatures.
zh_tw: 房間被孢子云{@quickref Vision and Light||2||輕度遮蔽}。澤巒教團過去常從種植園收穫蘑菇，這裡現在是兩個{@creature Myconid Sovereign||蕈人王}、四個{@creature Myconid Adult||蕈人成體}和一個{@creature shambling mound||蔓生怪}的家。這些生物潛伏在種植園的植被中。被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）屬性值為16或更高的角色能看見這些生物。

english: A recent effort by the Onyx Scar to clear the room for storage led to hostilities with the resident Plant creatures. The myconids and the shambling mound attack anyone who approaches the garden or emerges from the fountain (see "Fountain" below). If one or more myconids are killed, the surviving myconids use their Rapport Spores to signal their surrender. The shambling mound, however, fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 黑曜之痕最近試圖清空這個房間作為儲藏室，因而與棲居此地的植物生物發生衝突。蕈人與蔓生怪會攻擊任何靠近花園或從噴泉出現的人（見下文「噴泉」）。若有一個或更多蕈人遭殺害，存活的蕈人便使用通念孢子表達投降。但蔓生怪會戰鬥至被摧毀為止。

english: Fountain
zh_tw: 噴泉

english: A narrow underground river feeds the fountain and connects to the caverns of Ironbed Grotto (see "{@area Reaching the Tomb|370|x}"). Characters who enter the tomb via Ironbed Grotto emerge from the fountain's waterspout, which has an opening big enough for Medium or smaller creatures to crawl through.
zh_tw: 一條狹窄的地下河流為噴泉供水，並連線到鐵床洞穴（見"{@area 到達墓穴|370|x}"）。透過鐵床洞穴進入陵墓的角色會從噴泉的水柱中出來，噴泉開口足夠大，中型或更小的生物可以爬行透過。

english: Shrines
zh_tw: 聖祠

english: The shrines in the northwest, northeast, and southwest corners of the room contain statues representing gods of nature and protection.
zh_tw: 房間的西北角、東北角和西南角的神龕中，有代表自然和保護之神的雕像。

english: South Corridor
zh_tw: 南走廊

english: The south corridor leads to area X7. Halfway down the east-to-west section of the corridor, a rusty iron grate in the south wall blocks access to a ventilation shaft (see "{@area Reaching the Tomb|370|x}").
zh_tw: 南走廊通向區域X7。在東西向走廊的中間，南牆上的一扇生鏽的鐵格柵阻擋了通往通風井的入口（見"{@area 到達墓穴|370|x}"）。

english: Stairs
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: The stairs in the garden ascend to a trapdoor that Edino (see {@area area X10|399|x}) has sealed with an {@spell arcane lock} spell. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to bypass the magical lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity check, or the character can try to force open the trapdoor, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the trapdoor, which swings upward into {@area area X21|3b9|x}.
zh_tw: 花園中的樓梯通向一扇已被艾迪諾（見{@area 區域X10|399|x}）用{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術封閉的活板門。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試繞過這個魔法鎖，成功透過一個{@dc 25}的敏捷檢定即可，或者角色可以嘗試強行開啟活板門，成功透過一個{@dc 25}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。一個{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟活板門，門向上開啟通向{@area 區域X21|3b9|x}。

english: X7: Ruined Shrines
zh_tw: X7. 廢墟神廟

english: Crumbling altars, ruined statues, and idols of forgotten gods litter the floor of this small chamber.
zh_tw: 這個小房間的地面上散佈著破碎的祭壇、殘破的雕像和被遺忘的神祇的偶像。

english: This chamber once housed shrines to the gods of ancient local religions, but they have all been smashed and ruined.
zh_tw: 這個房間曾經供奉著古代當地宗教的神祇的神龕，但它們已經被全部破壞和摧毀。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who examines the west wall and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check discovers a secret door in the middle of it. A character with the Stonecunning trait or proficiency with mason's tools has advantage on this check. The stone door is unlocked and can be pushed aside to access the eastern section of {@area area X3|37e|x}.
zh_tw: 任何檢查西牆併成功透過一個{@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會在其中間發現一扇密門。擁有石之學識特性或熟練使用石匠工具的角色在此檢定中具有優勢。這扇石制門未上鎖，可以被推開以進入{@area 區域X3|37e|x}的東側部分。

english: X8: Living Quarters
zh_tw: X8. 生活區

english: This area of the tomb has thick timber walls lined with wooden doors. The stone floor is strewn with dirt and covered with fresh bootprints.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴區域有厚實的木牆，牆上排列著木門。石地板上撒滿了泥土，並覆蓋著新鮮的靴印。

english: Long ago, this area served as living quarters for the monks of the Order of Xeluan. Now it has been overtaken by the Onyx Scar for the same purpose.
zh_tw: 很久以前，這個區域是澤巒教團僧侶的居住區。現在，它已經被黑玉疤痕為了同樣的目的所佔領。

english: X8a. North Quarters
zh_tw: X8a. 北側區域

english: Five Onyx Scar {@creature Thug||thugs} sleep in these rooms, one per room. Each room contains a cot with an oil lamp hanging above it.
zh_tw: 五名黑玉疤痕的{@creature Thug||暴徒}在這些房間裡睡覺，每個房間一個。每個房間都有一張床，上面掛著一盞油燈。

english: X8b. South Quarters
zh_tw: X8b. 南側區域

english: Each of these rooms contains a cot with an oil lamp hanging above it. All five rooms are currently unoccupied.
zh_tw: 這些房間中的每一個都包含一張床鋪，上面掛著一盞油燈。目前這五個房間都是空的。

english: X9: Storage
zh_tw: X9. 儲藏室

english: This room contains weapon racks, stacks of wooden crates, and doors leading to the north and east. In the center of the room, a staircase rises to the upper level.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有武器架、堆疊的木箱，以及通往北面和東面的門。房間中央有一座通往上層的樓梯。

english: If the characters were brought in as workers, Tavio's personal guards left a wooden chest in this area that contains any equipment the characters arranged for Tavio to smuggle in.
zh_tw: 如果角色們被帶進來作為工人，塔維奧的私人守衛在這個區域留下了一個木製箱子，裡面裝有角色們安排塔維奧偷運進來的任何裝備。

english: Stairs
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: The stairs ascend to {@area area X14|3a6|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯通往{@area 區域X14|3a6|x}。

english: Warded Door
zh_tw: 有防護的門

english: The door to area X10 is warded by an {@spell alarm} spell that mentally alerts Edino if anyone touches it.
zh_tw: 通往X10區域的門被一個{@spell alarm||警報術}法術保護，如果有人觸碰它，會精神上提醒埃迪諾。

english: X10: Edino's Study
zh_tw: X10. 埃迪諾的研究室

english: A hulking figure made of clay stands on the other side of the door, its thick arms ending in balled fists, its head a featureless lump. Behind it is a room containing two bookshelves, a bed, a table, and a desk.
