zh_tw: 門的另一邊站著一個由黏土製成的龐大身影，它的粗大手臂末端是緊握的拳頭，它的頭部是一個沒有特徵的塊狀物。在它後面是一個房間，裡面有兩個書架、一張床、一張桌子和一張書桌。

english: The hulking figure is a {@creature clay golem} that doesn't wait for characters to enter the room before attacking them. It fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 這個龐大的身影是一個{@creature clay golem||粘土魔像}，它不會等待角色們進入房間就會攻擊他們。它會一直戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: A lawful evil, elf {@creature mage} named Edino lurks in the room. Edino is the Onyx Scar's resident spellcaster and has cast {@spell greater invisibility} on himself. If the characters defeat the golem, Edino hides until he can sneak to {@area area X19|3b3|x} and alert Aminta.
zh_tw: 一個守序邪惡的精靈{@creature mage||魔法師}名叫埃迪諾潛伏在這個房間裡。埃迪諾是黑玉疤痕的常駐施法者，並且對自己施放了{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}法術。如果角色們擊敗了魔像，埃迪諾會躲藏起來，直到他能潛行到{@area 區域X19|3b3|x}並警告阿明塔。

english: Edino's Experiments
zh_tw: 埃迪諾的實驗

english: Edino experiments with oztocanite in this room. As part of his experiments, Edino has bound the souls of Xeluan's companions (from {@area area X22|3bd|x}) to four fist-sized pieces of oztocanite. One of these soul fragments sits on Edino's desk. The other three fragments are in a desk drawer. Any character who examines a fragment and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check senses there's a life force trapped inside it but has no clue how to release it (see area X22).
zh_tw: 埃迪諾在這個房間裡用奧茲科卡礦石做實驗。作為實驗的一部分，埃迪諾將澤魯安的同伴們（來自{@area 區域X22|3bd|x}）的靈魂繫結到了四塊拳頭大小的奧茲科卡礦石中。其中一塊靈魂碎片放在埃迪諾的桌子上，另外三塊則放在桌子的抽屜裡。任何角色如果檢查這些碎片併成功透過一次{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，就能感知到其中被困住的生命力，但無法得知如何釋放它（參見區域 X22）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A {@item spellbook|PHB} on the western bookshelf contains the spells Edino has prepared plus {@spell alarm}, {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell dimension door}, and {@spell glyph of warding}. The other books in Edino's collection aren't valuable and cover such topics as geology, gemology, and mining.
zh_tw: 西側書架上的一個{@item spellbook|PHB|法術書}包含了埃迪諾準備好的法術，加上{@spell alarm||警報術}、{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}、{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}、{@spell dimension door||任意門}和{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}。埃迪諾收藏中的其他書籍並不值錢，涵蓋了地質學、寶石學和採礦等主題。

english: X11: Mess Hall
zh_tw: X11. 食堂

english: Loud voices and laughter can be heard through the door to this room.
zh_tw: 透過這扇門可以聽到這個房間裡傳來的大聲說話和笑聲。

english: This room contains three mismatched tables at odd angles, each one littered with food scraps and empty mugs. A makeshift bar has been constructed along the south wall. Four ruffians in leather armor play cards at one table, while two town guards eat at the bar and chat with the dwarf bartender. All eyes turn to you as the door opens.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有三張角度奇怪的不搭配的桌子，每張桌子上都散佈著食物殘渣和空杯子。沿著南牆搭建了一個臨時酒吧。四名穿著皮甲的地痞在一張桌子玩牌，而兩名鎮上警衛在酒吧吃東西並與矮人酒保聊天。門一開，所有的目光都轉向了你。

english: This area is used as a mess hall for workers and low-ranking Onyx Scar members. Four {@creature Thug||thugs} sit at one table, while two {@creature Veteran||veterans} eat snacks at the bar. As soon as they detect intruders, the thugs and veterans draw their weapons and attack.
zh_tw: 這個區域用作工人和低階黑玉疤痕成員的食堂。四名{@creature Thug||暴徒}坐在一張桌子旁，而兩名{@creature Veteran||老兵}在吧檯吃零食。一旦他們發現入侵者，暴徒和老兵就會拔出武器並發動攻擊。

english: Brego, the dwarf bartender (lawful evil {@creature spy}), is a longtime friend of Aminta's and a member of the Onyx Scar. He stands on a small crate to reach the bar's countertop. If a fight erupts, Brego ducks behind the bar and hurls flaming bottles of alcohol at intruders (treat each bottle as a {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|flask of alchemist's fire}) unless he is stopped. The bar gives Brego {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
zh_tw: 布雷戈，這位矮人酒保（守序邪惡{@creature spy||間諜}），是阿明塔的長期朋友，也是黑玉疤的成員。他站在一個小箱子上才能夠到吧檯的檯面。如果發生戰鬥，布雷戈會躲在吧檯後面，向闖入者投擲燃燒的酒精瓶（將每個瓶子視為{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|扁瓶熾火膠}），除非他被阻止。吧檯為布雷戈提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: X12: Worker Rest Area
zh_tw: X12. 工人休息區

english: Nearly two dozen bedrolls are scattered across the floor of this dusty stone room. Some of the bedrolls have workers resting on them.
zh_tw: 這個塵土飛揚的石室地板上散落著近兩打的睡袋。一些睡袋上有工人在休息。

english: Four workers ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) rest in the room, along with any workers who left {@area area X4|381|x}. These workers aren't interested in helping the characters or in making an enemy of the Onyx Scar. If the characters attempt to persuade, deceive, or otherwise recruit the workers to aid them, they can make a relevant {@dc 15} ability check. On a successful check, the workers won't endanger themselves, but they might share helpful intelligence or agree to stay out of the party's way.
zh_tw: 四名工人（{@creature Commoner||平民}）在房間裡休息，還有任何離開{@area 區域X4|381|x}的工人。這些工人不願意幫助角色，也不願意與黑曜之痕成為敵人。如果角色試圖說服、欺騙或以其他方式招募工人來幫助他們，他們可以進行一次相關的{@dc 15}能力檢定。如果檢定成功，工人不會將自己置於危險之中，但他們可能會提供有用的情報或同意不干涉隊伍的行動。

english: Southeast Corridor
zh_tw: 東南走廊

english: The southeast corridor leads to {@area area X13|3a2|x}. A little more than halfway down the corridor, a rusty iron grate in the south wall blocks access to a ventilation shaft (see "{@area Reaching the Tomb|370|x}").
zh_tw: 東南走廊通向{@area 區域X13|3a2|x}。在走廊的中段稍微過一點的地方，南牆上的一個生鏽鐵柵欄阻擋了通往通風井的入口（參見"{@area 到達墓穴|370|x}"）。

english: X13: Reconstructed Shrine
zh_tw: X13. 重建的神廟

english: This room contains four dilapidated altars—two against the north wall and two against the south wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有四個破舊的祭壇——兩個靠北牆，兩個靠南牆。

english: Unlike the tomb's other shrines, which the Onyx Scar destroyed, the shrines in this room were repurposed so laborers could worship their gods and feel at peace while working underground.
zh_tw: 與墓穴中其他被黑曜之痕摧毀的神龕不同，這個房間裡的神龕被重新利用，以便工人們在地下工作時能夠崇拜他們的神靈並感到心安。

english: Altar Deities
zh_tw: 祭壇神祇

english: The deities represented on the altars are left to your judgment. Gods of work, industry, protection, and luck are particularly appropriate. If you're setting this adventure in the San Citlán region, La Catrina is the patron deity. She is a jovial death goddess represented as a skeleton dressed in expensive finery.
zh_tw: 祭壇上所代表的神祇留給你的判斷。工作、工業、保護和運氣之神特別合適。如果你將這個冒險設定在聖克里斯地區，卡特里娜是守護神。她是一個歡樂的死神女神，被描繪成穿著昂貴裝飾的骷髏。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who examines the east wall and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check discovers a secret door in the middle of it. A character with the Stonecunning trait or proficiency with mason's tools has advantage on this check. The stone door is unlocked and can be pushed aside to access the western section of {@area area X3|37e|x}. If the guards in that area haven't been dealt with already, they attack the characters on sight.
zh_tw: 任何檢查東牆併成功透過{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現其中的一扇暗門。具有石之敏銳特性或熟練使用石匠工具的角色在進行此檢定時具有優勢。石頭門未上鎖，可以推開以進入{@area 區域X3|37e|x}的西部分。如果該區域的守衛尚未被處理，他們會在發現角色時發動攻擊。

english: X14: History Room
zh_tw: X14. 歷史室

english: The stone walls of this circular room are engraved with murals depicting a giant at various stages of his life. A hallway leads east, and in the center of the room, stairs descend to the lower level.
zh_tw: 這個圓形房間的石牆上雕刻著描繪一個巨人一生中不同階段的壁畫。一條走廊向東延伸，在房間的中心，樓梯向下通往下層。

english: The murals in this room depict Xeluan's legend (see the "{@area Adventure Background|355|x}" section). If the characters already saw Xeluan in {@area area X4|381|x}, they recognize him in the etchings.
zh_tw: 這個房間的壁畫描繪了澤巒的傳說（見"{@area 冒險背景|355|x}"部分）。如果角色們已經在{@area 區域X4|381|x}看到了澤巒，他們會在雕刻中認出他。

english: X15: Upper West Antechamber
zh_tw: X15. 西側上層前廳

english: Reliefs on this room's walls depict people bowing in gratitude to a smiling giant. Hallways lead east and west, and doors lead north and south. Seated at a table in the northeast corner are two identical human women playing cards.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上的浮雕描繪了人們向一個微笑的巨人鞠躬表示感謝。走廊向東和西延伸，門朝向北和南。坐在東北角桌子旁的是兩個長得一模一樣的人類女性在玩牌。

english: The women playing cards are two {@creature Doppelganger||doppelgangers} that look exactly like Aminta. If they see three or more intruders, the doppelgangers retreat to area X19; otherwise, they stand and fight.
zh_tw: 玩牌的女性是兩個看起來和阿明塔一模一樣的{@creature Doppelganger||變形怪}。如果它們看到三個或更多的入侵者，變形怪會撤退到區域X19；否則，它們會站起來戰鬥。

english: Door to Area X17
zh_tw: 通往區域X17的門

english: Only the real Aminta has a key to {@area area X17|3ae|x}. The lock on the door is trapped with a capsule that contains poisonous gas. The capsule can be found with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. A character who opens the door with Aminta's key safely disarms the capsule, as does a character who picks the lock and succeeds on their check by 5 or more. Otherwise, the capsule breaks when the door is opened, releasing a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the door. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 2d4} hours. A {@condition poisoned} creature falls {@condition unconscious} but wakes up if it takes damage. The cloud disperses a few seconds after the trap triggers.
zh_tw: 只有真正的阿明塔持有 {@area 區域X17|3ae|x} 的鑰匙。門上的鎖被一個裝有有毒氣體的膠囊陷阱所保護。透過成功的 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可以發現這個膠囊。使用阿明塔的鑰匙開門的人物可以安全解除膠囊，同樣地，成功撬鎖且檢定結果超過5點或更多的人物也能解除膠囊。否則，當門被開啟時，膠囊會破裂，釋放出一團有毒氣體，形成一個以門為中心的10尺半徑的球形區域。區域內的每個生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 體質豁免檢定，否則將 {@condition poisoned||中毒} {@dice 2d4} 小時。一個 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 的生物會陷入 {@condition unconscious||昏迷}，但如果受到傷害就會醒來。陷阱觸發後幾秒鐘，毒氣雲會消散。

english: X16: Aminta's Quarters
zh_tw: X16. 阿明塔的住所

english: A large, neatly made bed occupies the west half of this room. Hanging from hooks on the walls are several dresses and cloaks, with pairs of boots and sandals placed neatly below them.
zh_tw: 這個房間的西半部有一張大而整潔的床。牆上的掛鉤掛著幾件連衣裙和斗篷，下面整齊地放著幾雙靴子和涼鞋。

english: On the east side of the room, dinnerware is stacked atop a low wooden table, and a fully stocked wine rack stands against the wall.
zh_tw: 在房間的東側，餐具堆放在一張低矮的木桌上，牆上靠著一個裝滿酒的酒架。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A small coffer under Aminta's bed holds six {@item Zircon||zircons} (50 gp each). Characters who search the wine rack find two bottles of exquisite wine (100 gp each) and three bottles of fine wine (10 gp each). The remaining bottles hold common wine.
zh_tw: 阿明塔床下的一個小箱子裡裝有六顆{@item Zircon||鋯石}（每顆50金幣）。搜尋酒架的角色會發現兩瓶極品葡萄酒（每瓶100金幣）和三瓶優質葡萄酒（每瓶10金幣）。剩下的瓶子裡裝的是普通葡萄酒。

english: X17: Treasury
zh_tw: X17. 國庫

english: This room is lit by oil lamps resting atop two narrow tables. Other furnishings include a desk to the west and four wooden chests to the east.
zh_tw: 這個房間由放在兩張狹窄桌子上的油燈照亮。其他的傢俱包括西邊的一張書桌和東邊的四個木製箱子。

english: The desk has a single drawer, inside which is a leather-bound ledger detailing how much money the Onyx Scar has invested in the tomb excavation thus far (nearly 15,000 gp).
zh_tw: 書桌有一個單獨的抽屜，裡面是一本皮革裝訂的賬簿，詳細記錄了黑玉疤痕迄今為止在墳墓挖掘上的投資金額（將近15,000金幣）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The four chests are unlocked, and each one contains 2,500 gp. Aminta needs this money to pay workers, bribe town guards, and keep the operation running.
zh_tw: 這四個箱子沒有上鎖，每個箱子裡都裝有2,500金幣。阿明塔需要這筆錢來支付工人工資、賄賂城衛，以及保持運營。

english: X18: Mezzanine
zh_tw: X18. 夾層

english: This 15-foot-high mezzanine encircles the Great Chamber ({@area area X4|381|x}). A walkway made of wooden planks connects the mezzanine with the scaffolding that surrounds the petrified remains of Xeluan.
zh_tw: 這個15尺高的夾層環繞著大房間（{@area 區域X4|381|x}）。一條由木板製成的走道連線著夾層和圍繞著澤巒石化遺骸的腳手架。

english: Revolving Stone Doors
zh_tw: 旋轉石門

english: Set into the mezzanine's walls are four heavy stone doors, each of which revolves on a vertical axis. The west and east doors are open, while the north and south doors are shut. These doors aren't locked but grind loudly when opened or closed, attracting the attention of anyone on the upper level or in area X4.
zh_tw: 夾層的牆壁上嵌有四扇沉重的石門，每扇門都圍繞垂直軸旋轉。西邊和東邊的門是開著的，而北邊和南邊的門是關著的。這些門沒有上鎖，但開啟或關閉時會發出很大的噪音，吸引上層或區域X4中任何人的注意。

english: X19: War Room
zh_tw: X19. 戰情室

english: The air in this wide room is thick with the smell of dusty tomes. Eight bookshelves stand against the walls. Half of them have collapsed on themselves, while the remaining four bookshelves are packed with crumbling scrolls and books.
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的房間裡瀰漫著塵封書籍的氣息。牆壁旁有八個書架。其中一半已經倒塌，剩下的四個書架上堆滿了破碎的卷軸和書籍。

english: The room's centerpiece is a long wooden table with an ornate, throne-like chair at one end and smaller chairs along both sides. Seated in the big chair is a human woman clad in leather armor, and she's not alone.
zh_tw: 房間的中心是一張長木桌，一端是一把裝飾華麗的寶座般的椅子，兩側則是較小的椅子。坐在大椅子上的是一位穿著皮甲的人類女性，她並不孤單。

english: This room was once a library chronicling the history of Xeluan and his heroic companions. The Onyx Scar now uses it for leadership meetings. Aminta Solana (neutral evil, human {@creature assassin}) claims the seat at the head of the table.
zh_tw: 這個房間曾經是一個圖書館，記錄著澤巒和他的英雄同伴們的歷史。現在，黑玉疤痕用它來進行領導層會議。阿明塔·索拉娜（中立邪惡，人類{@creature assassin||刺客}）佔據了桌子頭部的座位。

english: Aminta is a human in her late thirties. She has brown skin and long dark hair streaked with gray. She is charming, confident, intelligent, and ruthless. In her pocket is a key to {@area area X17|3ae|x}.
zh_tw: 阿明塔是一位三十多歲的人類女性。她有著棕色的皮膚和夾雜著灰色的長黑髮。她魅力四射、自信、聰明且無情。她的口袋裡有一把開{@area 區域X17|3ae|x}的鑰匙。

english: Aminta is meeting with two of her distribution generals ({@creature Veteran||veterans}). Edino (the elf {@creature mage} from {@area area X10|399|x}) and the two {@creature Doppelganger||doppelgangers} from {@area area X15|3a8|x} might be here as well.
zh_tw: 阿明塔正在與她的兩位分銷將軍（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）會面。來自{@area 區域X10|399|x}的精靈{@creature mage||魔法師}埃迪諾，以及來自{@area 區域X15|3a8|x}的兩個{@creature Doppelganger||變形怪}可能也在這裡。

english: If the characters show up pretending to be workers, Aminta yells at them to leave and warns that another intrusion will result in their deaths. If the characters pose an obvious threat, she calls for the doppelgangers in area X15.
zh_tw: 如果角色們假裝是工人出現，阿明塔會大聲呵斥他們離開，並警告說再次闖入將導致他們的死亡。如果角色們構成明顯的威脅，她會呼叫區域X15的變形怪。

english: Aminta fights until reduced to 10 hit points or fewer, then attempts to flee. Edino behaves similarly. The doppelgangers look and act like the real Aminta, and they do their best to cover Aminta's escape. The two veterans are confident in their combat prowess and fight to the death.
zh_tw: 阿明塔會戰鬥直到她的生命值降至10點或更少，然後嘗試逃跑。埃迪諾的行為也類似。變形怪看起來和真正的阿明塔一樣，並且會盡力掩護阿明塔的逃跑。兩位老兵對自己的戰鬥能力充滿信心，並且會戰鬥至死。

english: Revolving Stone Door
zh_tw: 旋轉石門

english: Set into the west wall is a heavy stone door that revolves on a vertical axis. The door is currently open and grinds loudly when opened or closed. West of the door is an L-shaped hallway leading to {@area area X16|3ab|x}.
zh_tw: 西側牆壁上裝有一扇沉重的石門，它圍繞一個垂直軸旋轉。門目前是開著的，開啟或關閉時會發出很大的響聲。門的西側是一個L形的走廊，通向區域 {@area 區域X16|3ab|x}。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Characters who examine the bookshelf in the northeast corner see scratch marks on the floor that suggest the bookshelf has been pulled away from the wall more than once. Behind this bookshelf is a secret door that leads to {@area area X21|3b9|x}. The secret door can be found by any character who examines the wall behind the bookshelf and succeeds on a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. A character with the Stonecunning trait or proficiency with mason's tools has advantage on this check.
zh_tw: 檢查東北角書架的玩家會看到地板上有刮痕，表明書架曾多次被從牆邊移開。在這個書架後面有一扇通往 {@area 區域X21|3b9|x} 的秘密門。任何檢查書架後面的牆壁並透過 {@dc 11} 智力（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定成功的玩家都可以發現這扇秘密門。具有石匠之識特性或精通石匠工具的玩家在此檢定上具有優勢。

english: The secret door opens to reveal a dusty tunnel with another secret door at the far end. Characters inside the tunnel can find either secret door without needing to make an ability check.
zh_tw: 秘密門開啟後露出一個滿是灰塵的隧道，隧道的另一端有另一扇秘密門。在隧道里的角色可以無需進行屬性檢定就找到任一秘密門。

english: X20: Food Storage
zh_tw: X20. 食品儲藏室

english: Containers of dried vegetables, breads, and cheeses are stacked against the walls of this room, and cured meats hang from hooks. A massive stone door to the west stands open, and a wooden door leads north. A gentle breeze causes the dust on the floor to stir.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上堆放著裝有幹蔬菜、麵包和乳酪的容器，臘肉掛在鉤子上。西邊的一扇巨大的石門敞開著，而一扇木門通向北方。一陣輕風使得地板上的灰塵飄動起來。

english: This room contains enough food and refreshment to supply the Onyx Scar and its workers for weeks. The stone door west of this room is described in {@area area X18|3b1|x}. The north door leads to area X21.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有足夠的食物和飲料供應黑玉疤痕及其工人數週之用。這個房間西邊的石門在{@area 區域X18|3b1|x}中有描述。北邊的門通向區域X21。

english: An {@creature invisible stalker} floats near the ceiling and is the source of the breeze. If one or more characters disturb the supplies, the stalker attacks them. The stalker doesn't attack if the supplies are left alone.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature invisible stalker||隱形追獵者}漂浮在天花板附近，是微風的來源。如果一個或多個角色打擾了物資，追獵者會攻擊他們。如果物資未被觸碰，追獵者不會攻擊。

english: X21: Guest Hall
zh_tw: X21. 賓客大廳

english: This torchlit room contains a large table with several chairs. The ceiling is hung with black-and-green tapestries. Six doors are spaced evenly along the east and west walls. A seventh door stands in the southwest corner.
zh_tw: 這個點著火把的房間裡有一張大桌子和幾把椅子。天花板上掛著黑綠色的掛毯。東西兩面牆上均勻地分佈著六扇門。西南角還有一扇門。

english: Against the south wall, set into the floor, is a wooden trapdoor with iron hinges and a pull ring.
zh_tw: 靠南牆，嵌在地板上的是一個帶有鐵鉸鏈和拉環的木質活板門。

english: This room serves as a guest hall for prominent members of the Onyx Scar and others who come to do business with Aminta. The adjoining guest rooms, which are unlocked, are outfitted with beds and basic amenities.
zh_tw: 這個房間作為黑玉疤痕重要成員和與阿明塔做生意的其他人的賓客大廳。相鄰的客房沒有上鎖，配備了床和基本的生活設施。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: On the north wall, an unlocked secret door leads to {@area area X19|3b3|x}. The secret door can be found by any character who examines the wall and succeeds on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. A character with the Stonecunning trait or proficiency with mason's tools has advantage on this check.
zh_tw: 在北牆上，一扇未上鎖的暗門通向 {@area 區域X19|3b3|x}。任何檢查牆壁併成功透過 {@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色都可以找到這扇暗門。具有石匠知識特性或熟練使用石工工具的角色在此檢定中具有優勢。

english: The secret door opens to reveal a dusty tunnel with another secret door at the far end of it. Characters inside the tunnel can find either secret door without needing to make an ability check.
zh_tw: 秘密門開啟後露出一個滿是灰塵的隧道，隧道的另一端有另一扇秘密門。在隧道里的角色可以無需進行屬性檢定就找到任一秘密門。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: The trapdoor leading to {@area area X6|388|x} is secured with an {@spell arcane lock} spell. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to bypass the magical lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity check, or the character can try to wrench open the trapdoor, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the trapdoor.
zh_tw: 通往 {@area 區域X6|388|x} 的活板門被 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 法術固定。作為一個動作，一個角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試繞過這個魔法鎖，成功透過 {@dc 25} 的敏捷檢定即可，或者角色可以嘗試強行撬開活板門，成功透過 {@dc 25} 的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定也可。一個 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 或類似的魔法也可以開啟活板門。

english: X22: Crypt of the Watched
zh_tw: X22. 被監視者的墓穴

english: A large burial chamber opens before you, divided in two by a central wall running north to south. Engraved stone caskets displayed throughout the crypt are draped in cobwebs.
zh_tw: 一個大型的墓室展現在你面前，由一道從北到南延伸的中心牆一分為二。墓室中展示的雕刻石棺上覆蓋著蛛網。

english: A weak voice breaks the silence. "Hush. Come no closer, or you'll wake the angry spirits."
zh_tw: 一個微弱的聲音打破了寂靜。"噓。別再靠近，否則你會喚醒憤怒的幽靈。"

english: The stone caskets contain the earthly remains (dust and bones) of Xeluan's four companions and their loved ones.
zh_tw: 這些石棺內裝有澤巒四位同伴及其親人的塵世遺骸（塵土和骨頭）。

english: Angry Wraiths
zh_tw: 憤怒的幽靈

english: If the characters ignore the warning and enter the crypt, four {@creature Wraith||wraiths} emerge from the caskets that line the central wall. The wraiths don't respond to verbal entreaties and can't leave the crypt, but they attack anyone who sets foot inside.
zh_tw: 如果角色們忽視警告並進入墓室，四個{@creature Wraith||邪靈}會從排列在中心牆邊的棺材中出現。這些幽靈不會對口頭懇求作出回應，也不能離開墓室，但它們會攻擊任何踏入墓室的人。

english: Rilago's Ghost
zh_tw: 里拉戈的鬼魂

english: The voice belongs to the {@creature ghost} of {@creature Rilago|KftGV}. If the characters heed its warning and don't advance into the crypt, {@creature Rilago|KftGV} materializes in front of them and strikes up a conversation:
zh_tw: 這個聲音屬於{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的{@creature ghost||幽魂}。如果角色們聽從它的警告，不進入墓室，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}會在他們面前顯現，並開始一段對話：

english: "My name is {@creature Rilago|KftGV}, and I am responsible for the unrest that besets Oztocan. My foolishness broke Xeluan's heart. I come to you eager to make amends. Together, we can save Oztocan from destruction."
zh_tw: "我叫{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}，我對困擾奧茲托坎的不安負有責任。我的愚蠢破壞了澤巒的心。我懷著彌補的願望來到你們面前。我們可以一起拯救奧茲托坎免於毀滅。"

english: {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s ghost knows that only it can mend Xeluan's broken heart. If the characters present the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV}, {@creature Rilago|KftGV} thanks the characters for returning the shard to Xeluan's tomb.
zh_tw: {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂知道只有它能夠修復澤巒破碎的心。如果角色們出示{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}會感謝角色們將碎片歸還至澤巒的墓穴。

english: {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s Ghost
zh_tw: {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂

english: The ghost describes the events chronicled in the "{@area What Really Happened|360|x}" section, then asks the characters to release the spirits of Xeluan's heroic companions. Edino trapped their spirits in chunks of oztocanite (see {@area area X10|399|x}), and {@creature Rilago|KftGV} knows how to release them: each oztocanite fragment must be brought in physical contact with the giant's petrified remains (in {@area area X4|381|x}). Physical contact with Xeluan reduces each oztocanite fragment to dust and frees the spirit trapped inside it. Freed spirits manifest as motes of spectral light that the petrified giant seems to absorb.
zh_tw: 鬼魂描述了"{@area 真正發生了什麼|360|x}"部分所記錄的事件，然後請求角色們釋放澤巒英雄同伴的靈魂。埃迪諾將他們的靈魂困在了奧茲托坎石塊中（見{@area 區域X10|399|x}），而{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}知道如何釋放它們：每個奧茲托坎石塊都必須與巨人石化的遺骸（在{@area 區域X4|381|x}）進行物理接觸。與澤巒的物理接觸會將每個奧茲托坎石塊化為灰塵，並釋放困在其中的靈魂。釋放的靈魂表現為幽靈光點，石化的巨人似乎將其吸收。

english: Mending Xeluan's Broken Heart
zh_tw: 修復澤巒破碎的心

english: Once the spirits of Xeluan's four companions are released from their oztocanite prisons, the characters can safely enter this crypt (the wraiths don't arise from their caskets) and reconvene with {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s ghost. The ghost reveals that it can mend Xeluan's heart only by possessing the body of a hero and using its host to place the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} where it belongs: with the rest of Xeluan's heart. The ghost then asks permission to possess one of the characters, leaving it up to the characters to decide which of them should become {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s temporary host.
zh_tw: 一旦澤巒的四位同伴的靈魂從他們的奧茲托坎石監獄中釋放出來，角色們就可以安全地進入這個墓室（幽靈不會從他們的棺材中出現），並與{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂重新會合。鬼魂透露，只有透過附身於一位英雄的身體，並利用其宿主將{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}放到它應該在的地方：與澤巒的其餘心臟一起，它才能修復澤巒的心臟。然後鬼魂求允許附身於角色之一，讓角色們決定誰應該成為{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的臨時宿主。

english: {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s offer to mend the giant's heart is genuine. If the characters allow it, {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s ghost uses Possession against a willing character, who forgoes the saving throw to resist the effect. Only then can the ghost leave the crypt and return the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} to its rightful place. When {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s host touches the shard to the giant's heart, they bind as one. As the giant's heart is made whole again, {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s spirit is laid to rest, and the character ceases to be possessed.
zh_tw: {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}修復巨人心臟的提議是真誠的。如果角色們允許，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂會使用附身能力對一個願意的角色，該角色自願放棄用於抵抗附身效果的豁免。只有這樣，鬼魂才能離開墓穴，並將{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}歸還到它合適的地方。當{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的宿主將碎片碰觸巨人的心臟時，它們合為一體。當巨人的心臟再次完整時，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的靈魂得以安息，角色也不再被附身。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: The story might conclude in one of the following ways, though other outcomes are possible:
zh_tw: 故事可能會以以下方式之一結束，儘管也可能出現其他結果：

english: Xeluan's Heart Is Mended
zh_tw: 澤巒的心臟得以修復

english: If Xeluan's heart is mended, the earthquakes stop. Peace returns to Oztocan. {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s redemption and the characters' heroism have strengthened the protective wards around Xeluan, rendering the giant impervious to further harm. No longer able to mine oztocanite from the giant, the Onyx Scar terminates its mining operation.
zh_tw: 如果澤巒的心臟被修復，地震將會停止。和平將回歸奧茲托坎。{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的救贖和角色們的英雄行為加強了圍繞澤巒的保護結界，使巨人免受進一步傷害。由於無法再從巨人身上開採奧茲托坎石，黑曜之痕終止了它的開採行動。

english: Xeluan's Heart Is Not Mended
zh_tw: 澤巒的心臟未被修復

english: If the characters fail to mend Xeluan's heart, the earthquakes worsen, forcing citizens of Oztocan to evacuate the town.
zh_tw: 如果角色們未能修復澤巒的心臟，地震將加劇，迫使奧茲托坎的市民撤離該鎮。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization rewards the characters once the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} is returned to its rightful place. They receive a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，一旦{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}被歸還到其合適的地方，組織就會獎勵角色們。他們將收到一個他們選擇的稀有魔法物品（需經您批准）作為報酬。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: What's Next?
zh_tw: 後續？

english: The characters' adventures in Oztocan can continue long after Xeluan's heart is mended. The Onyx Scar might send assassins after the characters, or the syndicate's leaders might continue searching for other secrets hidden in Xeluan's tomb.
zh_tw: 澤巒的心臟修復後，角色們在奧茲托坎的冒險可以持續很長時間。黑玉疤痕可能會派遣刺客追殺角色們，或者該集團的領袖可能會繼續在澤巒的墳墓中尋找其他隱藏的秘密。

english: Heart of Ashes
zh_tw: 灰燼之心

english: {@i An Adventure for 8th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合8級角色的冒險}

english: Ghalasine is under a terrible curse. An evil spellcaster has enacted a ritual to siphon life from the city's people and reduce the city itself to ash. Powering the ritual is the heart of Ghalasine's vanquished leader, {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} Astolko. In this adventure, the characters must infiltrate Castle Cinis and recover the king's heart to end the ritual, thereby saving Ghalasine.
zh_tw: 加拉辛正遭受一個可怕的詛咒。一個邪惡的施法者實施了一個儀式，從城市人民那裡吸取生命，並將這座城市本身化為灰燼。儀式的動力來自於加拉辛被擊敗的領袖，{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 阿斯托爾科的心臟。在這個冒險中，角色們必須潛入灰燼城堡並回收國王的心臟，以結束儀式，從而拯救加拉辛。

english: The city of Ghalasine lies in ruins, but it's not too late to undo the damage and set things right
zh_tw: 加拉辛城已成廢墟，但還來得及撤銷破壞並糾正一切

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: Known for its exquisite glasswork, Ghalasine was a prosperous city ruled by {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} Astolko. Governing from Castle Cinis, Jhaeros was advised by two councilors, Regine LaVerne and {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV}, and a guard captain named {@creature Naevys Tharesso|KftGV}. Jhaeros's rule was compassionate, just, and kind. Over the last year, however, Naevys watched with growing concern as Jhaeros became more withdrawn and secretive, closing Ghalasine to trade and failing to honor his alliances.
zh_tw: 加拉辛以其精美的玻璃工藝聞名，曾是一個由{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 阿斯托爾科統治的繁榮城市。賈埃羅斯從灰燼城堡治理國家，得到兩位顧問蕾吉娜·拉維恩和{@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}以及名叫{@creature Naevys Tharesso|KftGV|納維斯·薩雷斯}的衛隊隊長的建議。賈埃羅斯的統治是富有同情心、公正和仁慈的。然而，在過去的一年裡，納維斯對賈埃羅斯變得越來越孤僻和神秘感到日益擔憂，他關閉了加拉辛的貿易，未能履行他的聯盟承諾。

english: A powerful spellcaster, Charmayne had become jealous of the king's passion and warmth. Longing to possess those qualities, she painstakingly created rituals to drain Jhaeros's vitality and charm, and to funnel these qualities into herself. However, the magic only enhanced her greed and jealousy; the more she took from Jhaeros, the hungrier for power Charmayne became, going so far as to murder her fellow councilor, Regine, while she slept.
zh_tw: 作為一位強大的施法者，夏梅恩嫉妒國王既富有激情又有親和力。她渴望佔有這些品質，於是煞費苦心地創造了儀式來榨乾傑哈索王的生命力和魅力，並將它們注入到自己身上。然而，魔法只增強了她的貪婪的嫉妒，夏梅恩越是從傑哈索王手中奪取力量，她越是渴望力量，甚至在睡夢中殺害了自己的同僚雷吉恩。

english: Unaware of Charmayne's magical hold over the king but afraid for his well-being, Naevys sought the counsel of a mage's guild in a neighboring city. With the help of {@spell scrying} spells, the mages gleaned the truth and revealed Charmayne's treachery to Naevys. The loyal captain returned to Ghalasine at once but found herself unable to enter the city. Charmayne had anticipated Naevys's return and prepared accordingly by invoking a powerful ward that prevents anyone born in Ghalasine from entering or leaving the city.
zh_tw: 納埃維斯不知道查瑪恩對國王施加了魔法控制，但出於對他福祉的擔憂，她尋求了鄰近城市一個法師公會的建議。在{@spell scrying||探知術}法術的幫助下，法師們發現了真相，並向納埃維斯揭露了查瑪恩的背叛。這位忠誠的隊長立刻返回了加拉辛，但發現自己無法進入這座城市。查瑪恩預料到納埃維斯會回來，並相應地準備了透過施展一個強大的防護結界，阻止任何在加拉辛出生的人進入或離開這座城市。

english: As she came to realize the people of Ghalasine didn't love her as they did the king, Charmayne became filled with rage. She used magic to tear out Jhaeros's heart while keeping it alive. She then used the still-beating heart as the focus of a ritual to destroy Ghalasine. A spherical void appeared in the sky above Castle Cinis, causing the city to slowly turn to ash and drawing the souls of the dead into it. The longer the void persists, the more quickly the city deteriorates.
zh_tw: 當她意識到加拉辛的人民並不像愛國王那樣愛她時，夏梅恩被憤怒所充滿。她使用魔法撕出賈埃羅斯的心臟，同時保持它活著。然後，她利用這顆仍在跳動的心臟作為毀滅加拉辛的儀式的焦點。在灰燼城堡上空的天空中出現了一個球形虛空，導致城市慢慢變成灰燼，並將死者的靈魂吸入其中。虛空持續的時間越長，城市的惡化速度就越快。

english: Jhaeros has been transformed into a heartless puppet under Charmayne's command. It's up to the characters to steal the king's heart, thereby ending Charmayne's ritual. If the characters are successful, all the damage wrought by Charmayne's magic will be undone, restoring Ghalasine and its king to their former glory. If they fail, the city will be destroyed, and Charmayne's treason will be complete.
zh_tw: 賈埃羅斯已經被轉化成了查瑪恩指揮下的無心傀儡。現在輪到角色們去偷取國王的心臟，從而結束查瑪恩的儀式。如果角色們成功了，查瑪恩魔法所造成的所有傷害將會被撤銷，恢復加拉辛及其國王的昔日榮光。如果他們失敗了，城市將會被毀滅，查瑪恩的叛國行為將會完成。

english: Ashen Creatures
zh_tw: 灰燼生物

english: Many of the creatures that haunt Ghalasine and guard Castle Cinis are ashen effigies of their former selves. These ashen creatures use their normal statistics, except they are lawful evil Elementals that have immunity to fire damage.
zh_tw: 許多出沒在加拉辛並守護灰燼城堡的生物，是它們從前形態的灰燼化身。這些灰燼生物使用它們正常的具體數值，除了它們是守序邪惡的元素生物，並且對火焰傷害有免疫力。

english: When an ashen creature drops to 0 hit points, it is reduced to a pile of ash, and any equipment it was wearing or carrying falls to the ground.
zh_tw: 當一個灰燼生物降至0生命值時，它會化為一堆灰燼，它穿戴或攜帶的任何裝備都會掉落到地面上。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. The city of Ghalasine is under a terrible curse, and the Golden Vault has learned that the evil spellcaster {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV} is behind it. Charmayne was once an adviser to {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}, but she used the king's heart to power a ritual that is devastating the city and killing its people. Our sources say that stopping the ritual will restore the city and its people. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to retrieve the king's still-beating heart and remove it from the city to stop the ritual. Start by meeting with the elf Naevys, guard captain for {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。加拉辛城正遭受一個可怕的詛咒，而金庫得知邪惡的施法者{@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}是幕後黑手。夏梅恩曾經是{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}的顧問，但她利用國王的心臟作為一個儀式的力量，這個儀式正在摧毀城市並殺害其人民。我們的訊息來源說，停止這個儀式將恢復城市和其人民。這個任務，如果你們選擇承擔，要求你們取回國王仍在跳動的心臟，並將其從城市中移除以停止儀式。首先與精靈納維斯會面，他是{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}的衛隊隊長。祝你們好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Heart of the Matter
zh_tw: 問題的核心

english: Naevys (lawful good, elf {@creature knight} equipped with a {@item flame tongue longsword}) approaches the characters with important business from Ghalasine. Her bronze-and-red armor gleams in tones that reflect her braided red-brown hair, and her skin is freckled. She is friendly toward the characters and asks to speak with them privately:
zh_tw: 納埃維斯（守序善良，精靈{@creature knight||騎士}，裝備有一把{@item flame tongue longsword||焰舌長劍}）帶著來自加拉辛的重要事務接近角色們。她那銅紅相間的盔甲閃耀著與她編織的紅棕色頭髮相輝映的色調，她的皮膚上佈滿了雀斑。她對角色們很友好，並請求私下與他們交談：

english: "My city is in trouble," Naevys says. "It deteriorates with every passing second, and my king is part of it. Or rather, his stolen heart is.
zh_tw: "我的城市陷入了困境，"納維斯說。"它每分每秒都在惡化，我的國王也是其中的一部分。或者更確切地說，是他被偷走的心。"

english: "Ghalasine is slowly being reduced to ash, and its people are dying and can't escape. {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} would do everything in his power to stop it if he could. I've served Jhaeros since I was a young squire. His father denied me knighthood—our family was poor, and I had no formal training—but Jhaeros made me his personal knight. That was the start of our friendship. He isn't just kind; he's warm and passionate, ever invested in the people of the city.
zh_tw: "加拉辛正在慢慢地變成灰燼，它的人民正在死亡，無法逃脫。如果可能的話，{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}會盡一切力量阻止這一切。我從年輕時就是賈埃羅斯的侍從。他的父親拒絕給我騎士頭銜——我們家境貧寒，我沒有接受過正式訓練——但賈埃羅斯讓我成為他的個人騎士。那是我們友誼的開始。他不僅善良；他溫暖而充滿激情，始終致力於城市和人民。"

english: "A mages' guild in a neighboring city used scrying spells to confirm my suspicion that one of the king's closest advisers—{@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV}—is behind this. She has stolen the king's heart and is using it to power a ritual. Jhaeros is now her obedient puppet."
zh_tw: "一個鄰近城市的法師公會使用占卜法術證實了我的懷疑，國王的一個最親密的顧問——{@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}——是這一切的幕後黑手。她偷走了國王的心，並正在用它來施展一個儀式。賈埃羅斯現在成了她聽話的傀儡。"

english: Naevys assures the characters that Charmayne's ritual affects only people from Ghalasine; outsiders can safely enter the city. She asks the characters to steal Jhaeros's heart and deliver it to her outside the city, thereby thwarting Charmayne's ritual.
zh_tw: 納埃維斯向角色們保證，查瑪恩的儀式隻影響加拉辛的人；外來者可以安全地進入城市。她請求角色們偷取賈埃羅斯的心臟，並將其交給城外的她，從而破壞查瑪恩的儀式。

english: Naevys provides the following additional information, which she learned with the help of mages in a nearby city:
zh_tw: 納維斯提供了以下額外資訊，這些資訊是在附近城市的法師們的幫助下得知的：

english: Ashen Defenders
zh_tw: 灰燼守護者

english: Castle Cinis is guarded by ashen creatures that used to be the king's guards. The king's dogs, Cinnabar and Sol, have become {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} that wander the castle's interior.
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡由曾經是國王衛隊的灰燼生物守衛。國王的狗，辰砂和索爾，已經變成了在城堡內部徘徊的{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}。

english: Charmayne's Location
zh_tw: 夏梅恩的位置

english: Charmayne spends most of her time in the mage tower ({@area area S14|3f6|x}).
zh_tw: 夏梅恩大部分時間都待在法師塔（{@area 區域S14|3f6|x}）裡。

english: Consuming Void
zh_tw: 虛空吞噬

english: A spherical void has formed high above the castle. The souls of the dead and the ashes of the city are being drawn into it. Most people in the city have already died.
zh_tw: 在城堡上方形成了一個球形的虛空。死者的靈魂和城市的灰燼正被吸入其中。城裡的大多數人已經死亡。

english: {@b Regine LaVerne}. Naevys doesn't know what happened to the king's other councilor, Regine.
zh_tw: {@b 雷吉娜·拉韋爾}。納維斯不知道國王的另一位顧問瑞吉妮發生了什麼。

english: Reversing the Ritual
zh_tw: 逆轉儀式

english: According to the mages with whom Naevys consulted, Charmayne's ritual can be reversed and Ghalasine restored to its former glory by removing Jhaeros's still-beating heart from the city. This might be the only way to repair the damage Charmayne has wrought and restore the lives of those who died because of the ritual.
zh_tw: 根據納埃維斯諮詢的法師們的說法，透過從城市中移除賈埃羅斯仍在跳動的心臟，可以逆轉查瑪恩的儀式，使加拉辛恢復其昔日的輝煌。這可能是修復查瑪恩所造成的破壞並恢復因儀式而死的人的生命的唯一方法。

english: Saving the King's Heart
zh_tw: 拯救國王的心

english: Simply destroying Jhaeros's heart would end the ritual without reversing the damage it has caused or undoing the terrible loss of life. Moreover, Naevys believes Jhaeros will almost certainly die if his heart stops beating.
zh_tw: 簡單地摧毀賈埃羅斯的心臟將結束儀式，但不會逆轉它所造成的破壞或撤銷可怕的生命損失。此外，納埃維斯相信如果賈埃羅斯的心臟停止跳動，他幾乎肯定會死亡。

english: Naevys is loath to discuss rewards until Ghalasine is either saved or lost, but if the characters press her for a reward, she promises to "drown them in gold coins" if they are successful. (In fact, the possible rewards are much greater than that, as discussed in the adventure's {@area conclusion|403|x}.)
zh_tw: 納維斯在加拉辛被拯救或失去之前不願討論獎勵，但如果角色們堅持要求獎勵，她承諾如果他們成功，她會用金幣"淹死他們"。（實際上，可能的獎勵比那要大得多，正如冒險的{@area 結局|403|x}中討論的。）

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: Naevys has sketched a rough map of Castle Cinis for the characters. Give players a copy of map 10.1 for reference. Naevys believes Jhaeros's heart is in a secret room on the second floor that can be accessed from the king's bedroom, and she is correct, but she doesn't know that the magic of Charmayne's ritual has altered the castle's layout.
zh_tw: 納維斯為角色們草擬了一幅灰燼城堡的粗略地圖。給玩家一份地圖10.1的副本以供參考。納維斯相信賈埃羅斯的心在一個秘密房間裡，這個房間可以從國王的臥室進入，她是對的，但她不知道夏梅恩的儀式魔法已經改變了城堡的佈局。

english: Map 10.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖10.1：玩家地圖

english: Getting Inside
zh_tw: 進入內部

english: If the characters ask Naevys for advice on how to enter the castle, she suggests the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色們向納維斯尋求如何進入城堡的建議，她建議如下：

english: "You can expect guards outside the main entrance as well as patrols circling the castle grounds. You could try to slip past the patrols and enter through a dining room window on the west side of the ground floor, out of sight of the main entrance, but close to the staircase that climbs to the second floor."
zh_tw: 你可以預料到在主入口外有守衛，以及在城堡周圍巡邏的隊伍。你可以嘗試溜過巡邏隊，透過一樓西邊的餐廳窗戶進入，這個窗戶位於主入口的視線之外，但靠近通向二樓的樓梯。

english: Charcoal Figurines
zh_tw: 木炭小雕像

english: With the help of scrying magic, the mages with whom Naevys consulted obtained the following additional information, which Naevys passes along to the characters just before they set out for Castle Cinis:
zh_tw: 藉助於占卜魔法的幫助，納維斯所諮詢的法師們獲得了以下額外資訊，納維斯在角色們出發前往灰燼城堡之前將這些資訊傳遞給了他們：

english: "Once you're inside the castle, keep an eye out for a set of charcoal figurines. Charmayne created the figurines herself, and I'm told she uses them to store her victims' psychic trauma. A clever spellcaster can turn the power of these figurines against her. I don't really understand how, but the mages with whom I consulted assured me of this fact."
zh_tw: 一旦你們進入城堡，要留意一套木炭製成的小雕像。查瑪恩親手製作了這些雕像，我聽說她利用它們儲存受害者的心理創傷。一個聰明的施法者可以利用這些雕像的力量反擊她。我不太明白具體怎麼做，但我諮詢的法師們向我保證這是真的。

english: See {@area area S6|3e1|x} for more information about the charcoal figurines.
zh_tw: 有關木炭雕像的更多資訊，請參見{@area 區域S6|3e1|x}。

english: Castle Cinis
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡

english: Starting at the edge of the city, it takes the characters 1 hour on foot to reach Castle Cinis. The city around them is grim and desolate. Its buildings are slowly turning to cinders, with clouds of ash rising toward the black, spherical void that looms above Castle Cinis.
zh_tw: 從城市的邊緣開始，角色們步行到灰燼城堡需要1小時。他們周圍的城市是陰鬱和荒涼的。建築物正慢慢變成灰燼，灰燼雲升向高懸在灰燼城堡上方的黑色球形虛空。

english: The characters have no encounters on their way to the castle. When they arrive at the castle, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 角色們在前往城堡的路上沒有遇到任何情況。當他們到達城堡時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Castle Cinis has deteriorated to the extent that sections of it now float in the air. Ash and detritus rise toward the spherical black void that hovers high above the castle. The void itself seems to be pulling the castle apart. The castle groans in protest as stone grates against stone.
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡已經惡化到這種程度，以至於它的部分區域現在懸浮在空中。灰燼和碎片向高懸在城堡上空的球形黑色虛空上升。這個虛空本身似乎在將城堡撕裂。城堡在抗議中呻吟，石頭與石頭之間相互摩擦。

english: Two guards, their bodies made of ash, flank the castle's entrance. More ashen guards circle the castle in patrols of four guards each.
zh_tw: 兩個由灰燼構成的守衛位於城堡入口兩側。更多的灰燼守衛以每組四人的巡邏隊在城堡周圍巡邏。

english: The characters can count a total of ten guards, all of whom are {@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|ashen veterans} (see the "{@area Ashen Creatures|3c8|x}" sidebar). Two guards flank the door to {@area area S1|3d6|x}, and the remaining eight guards patrol the grounds in two groups of four.
zh_tw: 角色們可以看到總共有十名守衛，全都是{@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|灰燼老兵}（詳見"{@area 灰燼生物|3c8|x}"側邊欄）。兩名守衛分別站在通往{@area 區域S1|3d6|x}的門兩側，剩下的八名守衛分成兩組，每組四人在場地內巡邏。

english: Characters who spend a few minutes studying the guards' movements gain advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to approach the castle unseen.
zh_tw: 花幾分鐘研究守衛動作的角色在進行敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定時獲得優勢，以便不被注意地接近城堡。

english: If the guards at the entrance or the guards on patrol spot the characters, one of them blows a horn to summon the other guards, who arrive {@dice 1d4} rounds later.
zh_tw: 如果入口處的守衛或巡邏的守衛發現了角色們，其中一人會吹響號角以召喚其他守衛，這些守衛將在{@dice 1d4}輪後到達。

english: Castle Features
zh_tw: 城堡特徵

english: Castle Cinis has the following features:
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡具有以下特徵：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Ceilings in the castle are 20 feet high and covered with ash (see "Tug of the Void" below).
zh_tw: 城堡的天花板高20尺，並且覆蓋著灰燼（見下文的"虛空的拉扯"）。

english: Light
zh_tw: 光線

english: Each room in Castle Cinis is brightly lit by one or more torches, or by sunlight during the day if the room lacks a ceiling.
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡的每個房間都由一個或多個火把照亮，如果在白天且房間沒有天花板的情況下，也會由陽光照亮。

english: Tug of the Void
zh_tw: 虛空的拉扯

english: Objects in the castle that weigh 10 pounds or less and aren't being worn, carried, or held in place tend to drift in the direction of the void at a rate of about 1 foot per minute. (For more information about the void, see "{@area The Void|402|x}" section later in the adventure.)
zh_tw: 城堡中重10磅或以下且沒有穿戴、攜帶或固定住的物體傾向於以每分鐘大約1尺的速度向虛空方向漂移。（有關虛空的更多資訊，請參見冒險故事中稍後"虛空"部分的"{@area 虛空|402|x}"。）

english: Weakened Floors and Walls
zh_tw: 削弱的地板和牆壁

english: The walls and floors on the second floor (areas {@area S8|3e5|x}–{@area S13|3f3|x}) and the floating areas (areas {@area S14|3f6|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x}) have been weakened by magic, such that each 5-foot-square section of floor or wall in these areas has AC 13 and 4 hit points. Reducing any such area to 0 hit points causes it to crumble away.
zh_tw: 二樓（區域 {@area S8|3e5|x}–{@area S13|3f3|x}）和浮動區域（區域 {@area S14|3f6|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x}）的牆壁和地板已被魔法削弱，以至於這些區域中每5尺見方的地板或牆壁具有AC 13和4點生命值。將任何這樣的區域降至0點生命值會導致它破碎消失。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: Unless the text states otherwise, all windows are latched shut from the inside. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to unlatch a window from the outside, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check. Shattering a window is easy enough, but unless the sound is silenced by magic, all guards within 60 feet of the breaking window investigate.
zh_tw: 除非文字另有說明，否則所有窗戶都從內部閂上。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試從外部開啟窗戶，成功進行一個 {@dc 17} 的敏捷檢定即可。打破窗戶很容易，但除非聲音被魔法靜音，否則打破窗戶60尺範圍內的所有守衛都會進行調查。

english: Castle Cinis Locations
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 10.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖10.2。

english: Map 10.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖10.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: S1: Entry Hall
zh_tw: S1. 入口大廳

english: Lining the west wall of this once grand hall are six hollow suits of crimson armor. Each one holds an ornate shield and an intricate glass lance, which is topped with a glowing glass sculpture that resembles a flickering torch.
zh_tw: 這個曾經宏偉的大廳的西牆邊排列著六套中空的深紅色盔甲。每一套都握著一個華麗的盾牌和一根複雜的玻璃長矛，長矛的頂端是一個發光的玻璃雕塑，看起來像一支搖曳的火炬。

english: Characters can cross this hall safely if they are wearing the uniforms of castle guards. Otherwise, any attempt by them to cross the hall causes magical flames to fill three of the suits of armor, which spring to life as three {@creature Helmed Horror||helmed horrors}. These helmed horrors also animate if anyone touches one of the suits of armor. The helmed horrors' Spell Immunity trait grants them immunity to {@spell burning hands}, {@spell fireball}, and {@spell scorching ray} spells.
zh_tw: 如果角色穿著城堡守衛的制服，他們可以安全地穿過這個大廳。否則，他們任何試圖穿過大廳的行為都會使三套盔甲充滿魔法火焰，變成三個{@creature Helmed Horror||恐怖鎧甲}。如果有人觸碰其中一套盔甲，頭盔恐怖生物也會活化。頭盔恐怖生物的法術免疫特性使它們對{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}（烈焰之手）、{@spell fireball||火球術}（火球術）和{@spell scorching ray||灼熱射線}（灼熱射線）法術免疫。

english: As a bonus action on its first turn in combat, each helmed horror drops its glass lance (which shatters on the floor) and conjures a longsword-sized blade of fire, which appears in its free hand. The helmed horror deals fire damage instead of slashing damage with its fiery sword, which disappears in a cloud of smoke when the helmed horror drops to 0 hit points.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥的第一個回合作為附贈動作，每個恐怖鎧甲會丟棄它的玻璃長矛（在地板上破碎），並在其空閒手中召喚出一把長劍大小的火焰之刃。恐怖鎧甲用其火焰劍造成火焰傷害，而不是揮砍傷害，當恐怖鎧甲的生命值降至0點時，火焰劍會在一團煙霧中消失。

english: S2: Hallway
zh_tw: S2. 走廊

english: The northernmost wall of this L-shaped hallway turned to ash as the armory ({@area area S15|3f8|x}) tore itself free of the castle, leaving a gaping hole.
zh_tw: 這個L形走廊的最北端牆壁因為軍械庫（{@area 區域S15|3f8|x}）從城堡中自行脫離而變成了灰燼，留下了一個巨大的洞口。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: Three {@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|ashen veterans} (see the "{@area Ashen Creatures|3c8|x}" sidebar) guard this hall and are hostile toward interlopers. They are positioned as follows:
zh_tw: 三名{@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|灰燼老兵}（見"{@area 灰燼生物|3c8|x}"側邊欄）守衛著這個大廳，對入侵者持敵對態度。它們的位置如下：

english: One guard stands in front of the doors to {@area area S5|3df|x}.
zh_tw: 一名守衛站在前往{@area 區域S5|3df|x}的門前。

english: One guard stands in front of the doors to {@area area S6|3e1|x}.
zh_tw: 一名守衛站在前往{@area 區域S6|3e1|x}的門前。

english: One guard stands next to the door to {@area area S7|3e4|x}.
zh_tw: 一名守衛站在前往{@area 區域S7|3e4|x}的門旁邊。

english: S3: Dining Hall
zh_tw: S3. 餐廳

english: Large windows on the west wall of this opulent dining hall look toward the ashen city. Fourteen plush chairs surround a dark walnut table. Three seats at the head of the table face ornate place settings: fine goblets, plates, silverware, and a half-empty bottle of wine.
zh_tw: 這個豪華的餐廳大廳西牆上的大型窗戶朝向灰燼之城。十四把豪華椅子圍繞著一張深色胡桃木桌。桌子頭部的三個座位面對著華麗的餐具設定：精緻的高腳杯、盤子、銀器和半瓶空的葡萄酒。

english: The goblets still have trace amounts of wine in them, and a few breadcrumbs and greasy streaks dirty the plates.
zh_tw: 高腳杯裡還殘留著少量的葡萄酒，一些麵包屑和油膩的痕跡弄髒了盤子。

english: S4: Kitchen
zh_tw: S4. 廚房

english: The door to the kitchen hangs open.
zh_tw: 通往廚房的門敞開著。

english: Two hounds with smoldering black fur feed on a pair of charred human corpses in the middle of this kitchen.
zh_tw: 兩隻黑色皮毛冒著煙的獵犬在廚房中央吃著兩具燒焦的人類屍體。

english: The hounds were once Jhaeros's beloved dogs, Cinnabar and Sol, now transformed into {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds}. The hounds' names are written on their collars in Common. They obey only {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}, and they transform back into friendly mastiffs if the effects of Charmayne's ritual are undone.
zh_tw: 這些獵犬曾經是賈埃羅斯心愛的狗，丹砂和索爾，現在轉變成了{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}。獵犬的名字用通用語寫在它們的項圈上。它們只服從{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}，如果查爾梅恩儀式的效果被解除，它們會重新變回友好的獒犬。

english: If the characters stay out of the kitchen and leave the hounds alone, Cinnabar and Sol ignore them and continue feeding on the cook and dishwasher they incinerated with their breath weapons. The hounds attack characters who approach or harm them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們遠離廚房並且不打擾獵犬，丹砂和索爾會忽略他們並繼續吃它們用吐息武器燒死的廚師和洗碗工。如果有人接近或傷害它們，獵犬會攻擊那些角色。

english: Eating the Food
zh_tw: 食用食物

english: Characters who search the kitchen can find plenty of food, all of which tastes like ash until the effects of Charmayne's ritual are undone.
zh_tw: 在廚房裡搜尋的角色可以找到大量的食物，但在查爾梅恩的儀式效果被解除之前，所有食物嚐起來都像灰燼。

english: S5: Library
zh_tw: S5. 圖書館

english: The library might once have been cozy with its large desk, padded couch, spacious bookshelves, and rich woods. Now, the books are ash, and the furnishings are beginning to deteriorate similarly. Flakes of ash cloud the air.
zh_tw: 圖書館可能曾經因其大書桌、軟墊沙發、寬敞的書架和豐富的木材而顯得溫馨。現在，書籍變成了灰燼，傢俱也開始類似地惡化。灰燼的碎片使空氣變得混濁。

english: All the library's books have been destroyed.
zh_tw: 圖書館的所有書籍都已毀壞。

english: {@b Secret Door and Bridge}. A secret door is hidden in the east wall behind a bookshelf, and any character who searches the wall for secret doors finds it automatically. The secret door can be pulled open to reveal part of a stone bridge that used to connect to the mage tower ({@area area S14|3f6|x}). The bridge ends abruptly after 5 feet, as the tower has since risen 20 feet into the air and is now at the same level as the castle's second floor.
zh_tw: {@b 暗門和橋}。一扇暗門隱藏在東牆後面的書架中，任何搜尋牆壁尋找暗門的角色都會自動發現它。暗門可以拉開，露出曾經連線到法師塔（{@area 區域S14|3f6|x}）的石橋的一部分。橋在5尺後突然中斷，因為塔現在已經升高了20尺，現在與城堡的二樓處於同一水平。

english: S6: Art Gallery
zh_tw: S6. 藝術畫廊

english: This gallery is missing its entire north wall, and what little remains turns to ashes before your eyes. Through the hole, you see two detached sections of the castle floating in the air.
zh_tw: 這個畫廊的整個北牆都不見了，剩下的部分在你眼前變成了灰燼。透過這個洞，你看到兩段脫離的城堡部分在空中漂浮。

english: The gallery itself contains beautiful glass sculptures attached to stone pedestals. The sculptures include a red glass dragon unfurling its wings, blue glass waves crashing against a lighthouse, a delicate teal dryad laughing, and more.
zh_tw: 這個畫廊本身包含了附著在石基座上的美麗的玻璃雕塑。雕塑包括一隻展開翅膀的紅色玻璃龍，藍色玻璃波浪衝擊燈塔，一個精緻的藍綠色玻璃樹精在笑，等等。

english: A narrow table toward the back looks out of place. Six charcoal figurines float above it.
zh_tw: 靠近後面的一張狹窄的桌子看起來格格不入。六個木炭色的小雕像在它上方漂浮。

english: Through the hole in the north wall, the characters can see {@area area S15|3f8|x} (elevated 40 feet in the air) and areas {@area S16|3fb|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x} (elevated 20 feet in the air). Both structures used to be attached to the gallery's north wall, but they have drifted outward about 10 feet as well as upward.
zh_tw: 透過北牆的洞口，角色們可以看到{@area 區域S15|3f8|x}（升高了40尺）以及區域{@area S16|3fb|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x}（升高了20尺）。這兩個結構以前都附著在畫廊的北牆上，但它們也向外漂移了大約10尺，同時也向上升高了。

english: Charcoal Figurines
zh_tw: 木炭小雕像

english: The six figurines are floating because they are subject to the tug of the void (see "{@area Castle Features|3d4|x}"). The figurines are shaped like tiny humans but lack fine features to distinguish them from one another. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals a dim aura of necromantic magic around each one. Each figurine represents someone who was killed by Charmayne. Five of the victims were guards or nobles who tried to defend Jhaeros and Regine; the sixth was Regine herself.
zh_tw: 這六個小雕像之所以漂浮，是因為它們受到了虛空的牽引（見"{@area 城堡特徵|3d4|x}"）。這些小雕像形狀像小人，但缺乏精細的特徵來區分彼此。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術可以揭示每個小雕像周圍微弱的死靈魔法光環。每個小雕像代表了被查爾梅恩殺害的人。五個受害者是試圖保護賈埃羅斯和瑞吉妮的守衛或貴族；第六個是瑞吉妮本人。

english: A character who holds a figurine experiences a flash of emotion like that felt by the victim in their final moments and, in a couple cases, a vision of Charmayne as seen by the victim:
zh_tw: 持有小雕像的角色會體驗到受害者在他們最後時刻所感受到的情感閃現，並且在一些情況下，還會看到受害者眼中的查爾梅恩的幻象：

english: {@b Figurine 1} is full of terror. A momentary vision shows Charmayne (an auburn-haired woman in a scarlet robe) casting a fiery spell.
zh_tw: {@b 雕像1} 充滿了恐懼。瞬間的幻象顯示查爾梅恩（一個穿著紅色長袍的赤褐色頭髮女人）正在施展一個火焰法術。

english: {@b Figurine 2} holds the dying fear of someone fixated on a person they're leaving behind.
zh_tw: {@b 小雕像2} 承載著一個即將死去的人對他們留下的人的恐懼。

english: {@b Figurine 3} seethes with anger and a craving for justice. A momentary vision shows Charmayne using magic to engulf the victim in fire.
zh_tw: {@b 小雕像3} 充滿了憤怒和對正義的渴望。一個瞬間的幻象顯示夏梅恩使用魔法將受害者包圍在火焰中。

english: {@b Figurine 4} is sorrowful and filled with regret from a life that ended too soon.
zh_tw: {@b 雕像4} 充滿了悲傷和遺憾，因為一個過早結束的生命。

english: {@b Figurine 5} is full of undying loyalty to the king.
zh_tw: {@b 小雕像5} 對國王的忠誠是永不消逝的。

english: {@b Figurine 6} exudes denial and refuses to accept what is happening.
zh_tw: {@b 小雕像6} 散發著否認的情緒，拒絕接受正在發生的事情。

english: After holding a figurine and experiencing the emotion bound within it, a character can make a {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a successful check, the character realizes that the psychic power contained in each figurine can be turned against Charmayne. Specifically, each figurine can be used as a spellcasting focus once before it turns to ash. When used as the focus for a spell that targets Charmayne and requires a saving throw, Charmayne not only has disadvantage on her save but also takes 16 ({@dice 3d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 當一個角色持有一個雕像並體驗其中所束縛的情感後，可以進行一個 {@dc 14} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定。檢定成功後，角色會意識到每個雕像中所蘊含的精神力量可以被用來對抗夏曼恩。具體來說，每個雕像在被使用一次作為施法焦點後會化為灰燼。當它被用作針對夏曼恩且需要豁免檢定的法術焦點時，夏曼恩不僅會在她的豁免檢定中處於劣勢，而且如果豁免失敗，她會受到 16（{@dice 3d10}）點精神傷害，如果豁免成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: S7: Stone Staircase
zh_tw: S7. 石質樓梯

english: This 40-foot-high, spiral staircase connects {@area area S2|3d8|x} on the first floor and {@area area S13|3f3|x} on the second floor.
zh_tw: 這個40尺高的螺旋樓梯連線了一樓的{@area 區域S2|3d8|x}和二樓的{@area 區域S13|3f3|x}。

english: The stone tower that contains the staircase no longer has a roof over it; the conical rooftop turned to ash and was sucked into the void above the castle, leaving the top of the staircase open to the sky.
zh_tw: 包含樓梯的石塔不再有屋頂；圓錐形的屋頂變成了灰燼，並被吸入了城堡上方的虛空中，使得樓梯的頂部向天空敞開。

english: S8: Upper Hallway
zh_tw: S8. 上層走廊

english: This wide hallway wraps around {@area area S13|3f3|x}. The northernmost stretch of the hallway is missing an entire wall, which turned to ash and was sucked into the void above the castle.
zh_tw: 這條寬闊的走廊環繞著{@area 區域S13|3f3|x}。走廊最北端的整面牆已經消失，它變成了灰燼並被吸入了城堡上方的虛空中。

english: Guards
zh_tw: 警衛們

english: Four {@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|ashen veterans} (see the "{@area Ashen Creatures|3c8|x}" sidebar) guard the hall and are hostile toward interlopers. They are positioned as follows:
zh_tw: 四名{@creature Ashen Veteran|KftGV|灰燼老兵}（見"{@area 灰燼生物|3c8|x}"側邊欄）守衛著大廳，對入侵者持敵對態度。它們的位置如下：

english: Three guards stand outside the doors to {@area area S13|3f3|x}—one to the north, one to the west, and one to the south.
zh_tw: 三名守衛站在{@area 區域S13|3f3|x}的門外——一個在北邊，一個在西邊，一個在南邊。

english: One guard stands next to the door leading to {@area area S12|3ef|x}.
zh_tw: 一名守衛站在通往{@area 區域S12|3ef|x}的門旁邊。

english: S9: Parlor
zh_tw: S9. 客廳

english: This extravagant parlor holds a dining table, a fireplace, and cushioned couches. Windows along the south wall afford a spectacularly grim view of what has become of Ghalasine.
zh_tw: 這個豪華的客廳設有一張餐桌、一個壁爐以及軟墊沙發。沿著南牆的窗戶提供了一個對加拉辛現狀的壯觀而陰鬱的視角。

english: A scratchy voice from the fireplace calls out, "Visitors? Visitors! Please, over here!"
zh_tw: 壁爐裡傳來一個沙啞的聲音喊道："訪客？訪客！請過來這裡！

english: Charmayne trapped a drow diplomat named {@creature Jalynvyr Nir'Thinn|KftGV} in the fireplace, from which he can't escape until Charmayne's ritual is undone. While trapped in the fireplace, Jalynvyr manifests as a {@creature smoke mephit} that speaks Common and Elvish instead of Auran and Ignan. The mephit is {@condition restrained}, and this condition can't be ended on it so long as Jalynvyr remains trapped. If the mephit is reduced to 0 hit points, Jalynvyr dies as the mephit's smoky form disperses.
zh_tw: 夏梅恩將一個名為 {@creature Jalynvyr Nir'Thinn|KftGV|賈琳維·尼爾瑟恩} 的黑暗精靈外交官困在壁爐中，除非夏梅恩的儀式被解除，否則他無法逃脫。被困在壁爐中時，賈琳維表現為一個 {@creature smoke mephit||煙魔蝠}，它說通用語和精靈語，而不是氣族語和伊格尼亞語。這個魔蝠處於 {@condition restrained||束縛} 狀態，並且只要賈琳維仍然被困，這種狀態就無法結束。如果魔蝠降至 0 點生命值，賈琳維就會死亡，因為魔蝠的煙霧形態消散了。

english: Jalynvyr was a guest at the castle, learned of Charmayne's plans, and threatened to tell {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}. Charmayne lured him here under false pretenses so she could trap him in the fireplace. He's willing to share what he knows with anyone who vows to unravel Charmayne's evil plans:
zh_tw: 賈琳維曾是城堡的客人，得知了查爾梅恩的計劃，並威脅要告訴{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}。查爾梅恩以虛假的藉口將他引誘到這裡，以便將他困在壁爐裡。他願意與任何發誓要揭開查爾梅恩邪惡計劃的人分享他所知道的資訊：

english: Gift for the King
zh_tw: 給國王的禮物

english: "I delivered a {@item flame tongue longsword} to {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}, who then bequeathed it to his most loyal captain, Naevys, as thanks for her years of faithful service. Charmayne was furious that Jhaeros wasted coin on a sword for Naevys, but then, she was always distracted by one petty jealousy or another."
zh_tw: "我向 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 交付了一把 {@item flame tongue longsword||焰舌長劍}，然後他將其贈予了他最忠誠的隊長納維斯，以感謝她多年的忠誠服務。夏梅恩對賈埃羅斯浪費金錢為納維斯買劍感到非常憤怒，但話說回來，她總是被這樣或那樣的小嫉妒所分心。"

english: Heart of Ghalasine
zh_tw: 加拉辛之心

english: "After trapping me in the fireplace, Charmayne bragged that Jhaeros himself would destroy Ghalasine. 'The heart of Ghalasine has always been its king,' she told me, 'so it's fitting that the heart of the king is the key to Ghalasine's demise.'"
zh_tw: "將我困在壁爐後，查爾梅恩誇耀說賈埃羅斯本人將毀滅加拉辛。'加拉辛的心臟一直是它的國王，'她告訴我，'所以國王的心臟是加拉辛滅亡的關鍵，這是合適的。'"

english: If {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}'s heart is taken from the city of Ghalasine or if Charmayne is killed, Jalynvyr reverts to his true form (that of a lawful neutral, drow {@creature mage}) and is no longer {@condition restrained} by the fireplace. The next time he encounters the characters, he gives them one or more potions or {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} as gifts for saving his life.
zh_tw: 如果從加拉辛城中取出了 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 的心臟，或者夏梅恩被殺，賈琳維就會恢復他的真正形態（一個守序中立的黑暗精靈 {@creature mage||魔法師}），並且不再被壁爐所 {@condition restrained||束縛}。下一次他遇到角色們時，他會給他們一瓶或多瓶藥劑或 {@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸} 作為禮物，以感謝他們救了他的生命。

english: S10: Naevys's Bedroom
zh_tw: S10. 納維斯的臥室

english: The walls of this room are adorned with crossed swords and shields. Furnishings include a bed, a wardrobe, and a glass statuette on a nightstand.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上裝飾著交叉的劍和盾牌。傢俱包括一張床、一個衣櫃，以及床頭櫃上的一個玻璃小雕像。

english: The wardrobe holds spare uniforms and outfits.
zh_tw: 衣櫥裡存放著備用的制服和服裝。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The statuette on the nightstand depicts a pillar of flame, weighs 12 pounds, and is worth 250 gp. Naevys would not approve of its theft.
zh_tw: 床頭櫃上的小型雕像描繪了一根火焰柱，重12磅，價值250金幣。納維斯不會贊同盜竊它。

english: S11: Regine's Bedroom
zh_tw: S11. 雷吉娜的臥室

english: This room has been torched. Soot blackens every surface, including a window on the east wall, and the chamber's furnishings have been reduced to charred flinders. The stench of burnt cloth, wood, and flesh hangs in the air.
zh_tw: 這個房間被火燒過。油煙使每個表面都變黑，包括東牆上的一扇窗戶，房間內的傢俱已經被燒成了焦炭。燒焦的布、木頭和肉體的惡臭瀰漫在空氣中。

english: Charmayne used magic to kill Regine while she was asleep in her bed, though no evidence of Regine can be found here.
zh_tw: 查爾梅恩使用魔法在瑞吉妮睡在床上時殺死了她，儘管在這裡找不到瑞吉妮的任何證據。

english: Window
zh_tw: 視窗

english: The window on the east wall is covered with soot on the inside but still intact. It's a 10-foot leap from the windowsill to the floating mage tower ({@area area S14|3f6|x}).
zh_tw: 東牆上的窗戶內側被菸灰覆蓋，但仍然完好。從窗臺跳到漂浮的法師塔（{@area 區域S14|3f6|x}）需要10尺的跳躍。

english: S12: Charmayne's Bedroom
zh_tw: S12. 夏梅恩的臥室

english: A pungent odor fills this room, which is cluttered with arcane materials and eerie trinkets. Much of the decor is slowly turning to ash and floating in the air.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了刺鼻的氣味，裡面雜亂無章地擺放著奧術材料和詭異的小飾品。許多裝飾品正慢慢變成灰燼，並在空中飄浮。

english: Two elementals made of swirling ash and smoke (use the {@creature air elemental} stat block) materialize and attack characters who enter this room. The elementals use their Whirlwind action to hurl characters through the castle's weakened walls (see "{@adventure General Features|KftGV|10|General Features}" earlier in the adventure). It's a 20-foot drop to the ground from there.
zh_tw: 兩個由旋轉的灰燼和煙霧構成的元素生物（使用{@creature air elemental||氣元素}的統計資料塊）出現並攻擊進入這個房間的角色。這些元素生物使用它們的旋風行動將角色拋向城堡的薄弱牆壁（見冒險故事中前面的"{@adventure 通用特徵|KftGV|10|General Features}"）。從那裡到地面是20尺的落差。

english: The Match Thief
zh_tw: 火柴小偷

english: Resting on a nightstand next to Charmayne's bed is a thin, illustrated fairytale book titled The Match Thief, which is written in verse:
zh_tw: 放在查爾梅恩床邊的床頭櫃上的是一本薄薄的、配有插圖的童話書，書名為《火柴小偷》，這本書是用韻文寫成的：

english: Striking a match against the rock in the hill,
zh_tw: 在山上的岩石上擦燃一根火柴，

english: Whit enveloped himself in the thrill.
zh_tw: 惠特沉浸在刺激中。

english: As fire and smoke and passion did whisper
zh_tw: 當火焰、煙霧和激情在低語

english: Of fluttering and risk the first time you kiss her.
zh_tw: 當第一次親吻她時的心跳和風險。

english: The match held elation and a breath on the edge,
zh_tw: 火柴帶來了興奮和屏息的邊緣，

english: The trust strong between you as you lean in and pledge
zh_tw: 當你傾身並承諾時，你們之間的信任變得堅定。

english: To throw yourself into the wind with abandon,
zh_tw: 毫無顧忌地將自己投入風中，

english: A thrill unmatched and she takes your cold hand, and—
zh_tw: 一種無與倫比的激動，她握住你冰冷的手，然後——

english: Ach! The emotion was gone, snuffed out by a breeze,
zh_tw: 啊！情感消失了，被一陣微風撲滅了，

english: And Whit gripped the tinder, loathing the ease
zh_tw: 而惠特緊握著火絨，厭惡它的輕易

english: With which mortals could carry this fervor and fire
zh_tw: 帶著凡人可以承載的這份熱情和火焰

english: Without burning inside out from their pyre.
zh_tw: 以免從他們的火葬柴堆中燒成灰燼。

english: Three matches to go, the impish fey thought,
zh_tw: 三個火柴要用完，頑皮的精類想，

english: The next one would give him all that he sought.
zh_tw: 下一個將給他所有他尋求的東西。

english: The next match would give him a soul bright and stark,
zh_tw: 下一根火柴將會給他一個明亮而清晰的魂魄，

english: Three matches to go, while the world faded dark.
zh_tw: 三根火柴繼續燃燒，而世界逐漸變暗。

english: Charmayne drew upon this tale for inspiration while plotting the downfall of Ghalasine. The poem tells of a mischievous fey, Whit, who captures human emotions and traps them in matches. He experiences each emotion when he strikes a match. He lives a vibrant life, but the world around him grows dull and gray as he traps more and more of it. Soon he has a single match: one filled with sorrow. Whit must choose whether to return the emotion to a dull and empty world or to feel one last thing.
zh_tw: 查爾梅恩在策劃加拉辛的滅亡時，從這個故事中汲取了靈感。這首詩講述了一個淘氣的精類，惠特，他捕捉人類的情感並將它們困在火柴裡。每次劃燃火柴時，他都會體驗每一種情感。他過著充滿活力的生活，但隨著他困住越來越多的情感，周圍的世界變得暗淡和灰暗。很快他只剩下一根火柴：裡面充滿了悲傷。惠特必須選擇是將情感歸還給一個乏味而空洞的世界，還是去感受最後一件事。

english: S13: Royal Gallery
zh_tw: S13. 皇家畫廊

english: Glass cases on tables arranged about this room contain dragon scales, manticore tails, and other hunting trophies, as well as weapons, regal gifts, and royal trinkets—all important to {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}, no doubt. The glass cases are only just beginning to turn to ash.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的桌子上排列著玻璃展示櫃，裡面裝有龍鱗、蠍尾獅尾巴以及其他狩獵戰利品，還有武器、皇家禮物和王室小飾品——無疑對 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 來說都很重要。這些玻璃展示櫃才剛剛開始變成灰燼。

english: This gallery is filled with objects {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} acquired throughout his youth and adult life. The four guards stationed in area S8 investigate any loud noises here.
zh_tw: 這個畫廊充滿了 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 在他的青年和成年時期收集的物品。駐紮在區域 S8 的四名守衛會調查這裡的任何大聲噪音。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the many items on display is a {@item +1 battleaxe} Jhaeros wielded in his youth.
zh_tw: 在展出的眾多物品中，有一把賈埃羅斯年輕時使用的{@item +1 battleaxe||+1 戰斧}。

english: S14: Mage Tower
zh_tw: S14. 法師塔

english: This tower used to be connected to the library ({@area area S5|3df|x}) by a slender stone bridge. It now floats 20 feet off the ground, 10 feet from the window of {@area area S11|3ec|x}.
zh_tw: 這座塔以前透過一座細長的石橋與圖書館（{@area 區域S5|3df|x}）相連。現在它離地面漂浮20尺，距離{@area 區域S11|3ec|x}的窗戶10尺。

english: When the characters enter the tower, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入塔樓時，閱讀或改述以下內容：

english: In the middle of this tower chamber, an ashen figure cackles with glee. Her scarlet gown billows and flaps as trails of ash swirl around her.
zh_tw: 在這個塔室的中央，一個灰燼般的人物狂笑著歡呼。她的紅色禮服隨著她周圍的灰燼旋渦飄揚和拍打。

english: "So bright with emotion!" she yells. "Give me rage, terror, righteous fury! Snarl at me so that I may savor it! Sustain me until the city is no more!" She then affixes her raging gaze upon you. "I can smell your soul-fires! They will be mine soon enough!"
zh_tw: "情感如此熾烈！"她大喊。"給我憤怒，恐懼，正義的狂怒！向我咆哮，好讓我品嚐！支撐我直到這座城市不復存在！"然後她將她憤怒的目光投向你們。"我能聞到你們靈魂之火的氣味！它們很快將屬於我！"

english: {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV} (see her stat block at the end of the adventure) is beyond redemption and doesn't shy away from a fight. When she drops to 0 hit points, she dies as her body crumbles to ash. She leaves behind her scarlet gown and a {@item potion of clairvoyance}.
zh_tw: {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}（在冒險的末尾檢視她的狀態塊）已經無法救贖，並且不迴避戰鬥。當她的生命值降至0點時，她的身體化為灰燼而死。她留下了她的紅色禮服和一瓶{@item potion of clairvoyance||鷹眼術藥水}。

english: The soul of any character killed by Charmayne becomes trapped in the void that hovers over Castle Cinis (see "{@area The Void|402|x}" later in the adventure).
zh_tw: 任何被夏梅恩殺死的角色的靈魂都會被困在懸浮在灰燼城堡上空的虛空中（見冒險後續的 "{@area 虛空|402|x}" 部分）。

english: A daring adventurer leaps to a floating tower that has detached from Castle Cinis
zh_tw: 一個大膽的冒險家跳到了從灰燼城堡脫離的漂浮塔上

english: S15: King's Armory
zh_tw: S15. 國王的軍械庫

english: The first-floor armory is suspended 40 feet in the air, with nothing but the ground below it. The characters need magic or climbing gear to reach it. The northeast wall of the armory is gone, creating an opening through which the characters may enter.
zh_tw: 一樓的軍械庫懸掛在40尺高的空中，下面只有地面。角色們需要魔法或攀爬裝備才能到達那裡。軍械庫的東北牆已經不見了，形成了一個角色們可以透過的開口。

english: The armor and weapons found here are displayed on deteriorating tables, counters, and racks.
zh_tw: 這裡發現的盔甲和武器展示在逐漸惡化的桌子上、櫃檯和架子上。

english: As soon as one or more characters set foot in the armory, two suits of armor come to life as ashen suits of {@creature Ashen Animated Armor|KftGV|animated armor}, and four swords transform into {@creature Ashen Flying Sword|KftGV|ashen flying swords} (see the "{@area Ashen Creatures|3c8|x}" sidebar). These creatures fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 一旦一個或多個角色踏入軍械庫，兩套盔甲就會變成灰燼盔甲的{@creature Ashen Animated Armor|KftGV|活化盔甲}，並且四把劍變成{@creature Ashen Flying Sword|KftGV|灰燼飛行劍}（見"{@area 灰燼生物|3c8|x}"側邊欄）。這些生物會戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the armory find a {@item +1 shield}, eight {@item +1 Arrow||+1 arrows}, and two vials that each contain one use of {@item oil of sharpness}. All other equipment in the armory turns to ash when handled.
zh_tw: 搜尋軍械庫的角色找到一個{@item +1 shield||+1 盾牌}，八支{@item oil of sharpness||銳鋒之油}，以及兩個小瓶，每個小瓶都含有一次使用的{@item +1 Arrow||+1 箭矢}。軍械庫中的所有其他裝備在被觸碰時都會變成灰燼。

english: S16: King's Bedroom
zh_tw: S16. 國王的臥室

english: This location floats 20 feet in the air, with nothing but the ground below it. The characters need magic or climbing gear to reach it. Most of the room's south wall is gone, leaving a wide gap through which characters can enter.
zh_tw: 這個地點漂浮在20尺高的空中，下面只有地面。角色們需要魔法或攀爬裝備才能到達那裡。房間的南牆大部分已經消失，留下了一個寬缺口，角色們可以透過它進入。

english: The king's bedroom is deteriorating to the extent that you can see furnishings being reduced to ash before your eyes. Mounted on the north wall above the king's bed is a painting of a regal man with kind eyes. The image is fleeting as you watch the painting dissolve into a cloud of ashes.
zh_tw: 國王的臥室正在惡化，以至於你可以看到傢俱在你面前變成灰燼。國王床的北牆上掛著一幅畫，畫中是一個眼神慈祥的高貴男子。當你看著這幅畫溶解成一團灰燼時，畫面轉瞬即逝。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who searches the east wall for a secret door finds one that leads to area S17.
zh_tw: 任何在東牆尋找秘密門的角色都會找到一個通向區域 S17 的門。

english: S17: Heart of Jhaeros
zh_tw: S17. 賈埃羅斯之心

english: This location is open to the sky. This room used to have a study below it, with a staircase connecting them. The study is gone, but the upper half of the staircase remains.
zh_tw: 這個地點向天空開放。這個房間下面曾有一個書房，有一段樓梯連線它們。書房已經消失了，但是樓梯的上半部分仍然存在。

english: The following description assumes the characters enter through the secret door in the west wall:
zh_tw: 以下描述假定角色透過西牆上的暗門進入：

english: This chamber holds the king in his new, terrible form: a hulking, ashen brute with his ribcage torn open, revealing an empty cavity where his heart used to be. You see no sign of the king's heart.
zh_tw: 這個房間關押著國王，他現在變成了一個可怕的樣子：一個巨大的、灰燼覆蓋的怪物，他的胸腔被撕裂開來，露出了他心臟曾經所在的空腔。你沒有看到國王心臟的任何跡象。

english: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}

english: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} is hostile and uses the {@creature clay golem} stat block, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 懷有敵意，並使用 {@creature clay golem||粘土魔像} 狀態塊，但有以下變化：

english: Replace the Acid Absorption trait with Fire Absorption. (All mentions of acid damage change to fire damage.)
zh_tw: 將酸性吸收特性替換為火焰吸收。（所有提到強酸傷害的地方都改為火焰傷害。）

english: In this form, Jhaeros has Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores of 10.
zh_tw: 在這種形態下，賈埃羅斯的感知、感知和魅力得分都是10。

english: When Jhaeros drops to 0 hit points, he explodes in a harmless cloud of ashes, leaving nothing else behind.
zh_tw: 當賈埃羅斯的生命值降至 0 點時，他將在一團無害的灰燼雲中爆炸，沒有留下任何其他東西。

english: Jhaeros won't leave this room except to chase after a character who has his heart (see below). Even then, he can't leave Ghalasine.
zh_tw: 賈埃羅斯不會離開這個房間，除非是追趕持有他心臟的角色（見下文）。即便如此，他也不能離開加拉辛。

english: Heart of the King
zh_tw: 國王之心

english: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} guards his heart, which is hidden in a cavity under the floor. The cavity, which is just big enough to contain the heart, is covered by a 2-foot-square stone tile. Characters within 5 feet of the tile can hear the heart beating.
zh_tw: {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 守護著他的心臟，它隱藏在地板下的一個空洞中。這個空洞剛好足夠容納心臟，被一塊2尺見方的石磚覆蓋。在磚塊5尺範圍內的角色可以聽到心臟跳動的聲音。

english: As an action, a character in the middle of the room can try to lift the stone tile, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The check is made with advantage if the character uses a crowbar or similar tool. The heart can then be removed from the cavity under the tile.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，房間中央的角色可以嘗試抬起石磚，成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可做到。如果角色使用撬棍或類似工具，則該檢定具有優勢。然後，可以將心臟從石磚下的空腔中取出。

english: Any character who touches the heart must make on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After taking this damage, the character can handle the heart safely.
zh_tw: 任何觸碰這顆心臟的角色都必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，檢定失敗則受到 22 ({@dice 4d10}) 點暗蝕傷害，成功則只受一半傷害。受到傷害後，該角色便可安全地處理這顆心臟。

english: The heart is twice the size of an adult human's heart. It is a Tiny object with AC 10, 5 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage. If the heart is reduced to 0 hit points, the following things happen:
zh_tw: 這個心臟是成年人心臟的兩倍大小。它是一個超小型物體，具有10的護甲等級，5點生命值，並對心靈傷害免疫。如果心臟的生命值降至0點，將發生以下事情：

english: The Heart Dies
zh_tw: 心臟死亡

english: The heart stops beating and dies.
zh_tw: 心臟停止跳動並死亡。

english: Jhaeros Dies
zh_tw: 賈埃羅斯死亡

english: Jhaeros in his golem-like form loses 20 hit points at the start of each of his turns.
zh_tw: 賈埃羅斯以他的魔像形態在每個回合開始時失去 20 點生命值。

english: The Void Collapses
zh_tw: 虛空崩潰

english: The void above Castle Cinis collapses, freeing all the souls trapped within it. These souls then travel to the afterlife.
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡上方的虛空坍塌，釋放了所有被困住的靈魂。這些靈魂隨後前往來世。

english: The Castle Falls
zh_tw: 城堡墜落

english: One minute after the heart dies and the void collapses, the floating pieces of Castle Cinis (areas {@area S14|3f6|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x}) fall to the ground and are destroyed. Creatures inside or underneath these areas when they fall take 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage and are knocked {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 心臟死亡並且虛空坍塌後的一分鐘內，灰燼城堡的漂浮部分（區域 {@area S14|3f6|x}–{@area S17|3fe|x}）墜落到地面並被摧毀。當這些區域墜落時，在這些區域內或下方的生物會受到 55 ({@dice 10d10}) 點鈍擊傷害並被擊倒 {@condition prone||伏地}。

english: Fleeing with the Heart
zh_tw: 帶著心臟逃跑

english: If the characters had a relatively easy time getting their hands on Jhaeros's heart, use the following encounter to complicate their escape.
zh_tw: 如果角色們相對容易地拿到了賈埃羅斯的心臟，使用以下遭遇來複雜化他們的逃脫。

english: Two {@creature Ashen Knight|KftGV|ashen knights} mounted on {@creature Ashen Warhorse|KftGV|ashen warhorses} (see the "{@area Ashen Creatures|3c8|x}" sidebar) catch up to the characters as they make their way through the dead city of Ghalasine toward their rendezvous with Naevys. While the characters battle the knights, two {@creature Ashen Shambling Mound|KftGV|ashen shambling mounds} take shape and join the fray against the heroes.
zh_tw: 兩名騎乘在{@creature Ashen Warhorse|KftGV|灰燼戰馬}上的{@creature Ashen Knight|KftGV|灰燼騎士}（見"{@area 灰燼生物|3c8|x}"側邊欄）在角色們穿越死亡之城加拉辛前往與納維斯的會合點時追上了他們。當角色們與騎士們戰鬥時，兩個{@creature Ashen Shambling Mound|KftGV|灰燼蔓生怪}成形並加入戰鬥，對抗英雄們。

english: Once these forces are defeated, the characters can conclude their business with Naevys.
zh_tw: 一旦這些力量被擊敗，角色們就可以與納維斯完成他們的事務。

english: The Void
zh_tw: 虛空

english: The void above Castle Cinis is slowly consuming Ghalasine. If a creature dies in Ghalasine, the creature's soul (if it has one) becomes trapped in the void until the void collapses or the creature is raised from the dead by magic. The void already contains the souls of all those Charmayne killed, including {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡上方的虛空正在慢慢吞噬加拉辛。如果在加拉辛中有生物死亡，該生物的靈魂（如果有的話）會被困在虛空中，直到虛空坍塌或生物透過魔法被復活。虛空中已經包含了所有被夏梅恩殺死的人的靈魂，包括 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}。

english: Characters would be wise to keep their distance from the void. Any creature that enters the void or starts its turn there takes 70 ({@dice 20d6}) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, the creature, along with any nonmagical equipment it is wearing or carrying, turns to ash, and its soul becomes trapped in the void. Magic items that end up in the void remain trapped in it until the void is destroyed (see "Conclusion").
zh_tw: 角色們最好遠離虛空。任何進入虛空或在其內開始回合的生物都會受到70（{@dice 20d6}）點暗蝕傷害。如果這個傷害使生物的生命值降至0點，生物及其穿戴或攜帶的所有非魔法裝備都會變成灰燼，其靈魂被困在虛空中。如果魔法物品最終落入虛空，它們將一直被困在那裡，直到虛空被摧毀（見"結論"）。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: If Jhaeros's still-beating heart is delivered to Naevys outside the city, it disappears in her hands. When the heart vanishes, the following things happen:
zh_tw: 如果賈埃羅斯仍在跳動的心臟被送到城外的納維斯手中，它會在她的手中消失。當心髒消失時，以下事情會發生：

english: Charmayne Dies
zh_tw: 夏梅恩死亡

english: Charmayne collapses, dies, and turns to ash.
zh_tw: 查爾梅恩倒下，死亡，並化為灰燼。

english: The Void Collapses
zh_tw: 虛空崩潰

english: The void above Castle Cinis collapses, freeing all the souls trapped within it. Everyone whose soul was trapped inside the void is restored to life with all their hit points, materializing in unoccupied spaces within the city. Characters whose souls are released from the void are deposited in {@area area S9|3e7|x}, as is {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} (lawful good, human {@creature archmage}) and Councilor Regine LaVerne (lawful neutral, tiefling {@creature noble}).
zh_tw: 灰燼城堡上方的虛空坍塌，釋放了其中所有被困住的靈魂。所有靈魂被困在虛空中的人將恢復生命，以滿生命值的狀態在城市中未被佔據的空間中顯現。從虛空中釋放出的靈魂的角色將被放置在 {@area 區域S9|3e7|x}，包括 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}（守序善良，人類 {@creature archmage||大法師}）和顧問蕾吉娜·拉維恩（守序中立，提夫林 {@creature noble||貴族}）。

english: Ghalasine Is Restored
zh_tw: 加拉辛得到恢復

english: The damage to Ghalasine is undone, and the city is made resplendent once more, as though no calamity ever threatened it. Gray ash is swept away as the structures of the city are magically rebuilt before the eyes of weeping onlookers. Castle Cinis is made whole again.
zh_tw: 加拉辛的破壞被修復，這座城市再次煥發出輝煌，彷彿從未受到過任何災難的威脅。灰色的灰燼被掃走，城市的建築在哭泣的旁觀者眼前神奇地重建。灰燼城堡再次變得完整。

english: Jalynvyr Is Set Free
zh_tw: 賈琳維被釋放

english: Jalynvyr is released from captivity in {@area area S9|3e7|x} and is restored to his true form at full health.
zh_tw: 賈琳維從 {@area 區域S9|3e7|x} 的囚禁中被釋放，並恢復到他的真正形態，處於滿生命值狀態。

english: The Hounds Are Restored
zh_tw: 獵犬得到恢復

english: The hell hounds Cinnabar and Sol transform back into friendly {@creature Mastiff||mastiffs}.
zh_tw: 地獄獵犬朱砂和索爾變回友好的 {@creature Mastiff||獒犬}。

english: If Jhaeros's heart dies or if things otherwise go wrong, Ghalasine is reduced to ashes. Her victory complete, Charmayne abandons the ruined city. The characters might encounter her again after she finds some other city to torment.
zh_tw: 如果賈埃羅斯的心臟死亡，或者事情出了其他差錯，加拉辛將化為灰燼。查爾梅恩在取得完全勝利後，放棄了這座被毀滅的城市。角色們可能會再次遇到她，那時她可能找到了其他城市來折磨。

english: Rewards
zh_tw: 獎勵

english: After delivering {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV}'s heart to Naevys, characters are eligible to receive one or more of the following rewards at the end of the adventure:
zh_tw: 在將 {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 的心臟交給納維斯後，角色們在冒險結束時有資格獲得以下一項或多項獎勵：

english: Naevys's Gifts
zh_tw: 納維斯的禮物

english: If Charmayne's ritual is reversed and Ghalasine is restored, Naevys gives the characters a {@item flame tongue longsword}, a {@item necklace of fireballs}, and a suit of {@item dragon scale mail} from Ghalasine's treasury. She also gives the characters 2,000 gp each from her personal savings. If the characters end the ritual but fail the undo the damage it caused, Naevys awards them the money but not the magic items.
zh_tw: 如果夏梅恩的儀式被逆轉，並且加拉辛得到恢復，納維斯會從加拉辛的國庫中給角色們一把 {@item flame tongue longsword||焰舌長劍}（火焰舌長劍）、一條 {@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}（火球項鍊）和一套 {@item dragon scale mail||龍鱗甲}（龍鱗甲）。她還會從個人的積蓄中給每個角色 2,000 金幣。如果角色們結束了儀式，但未能撤銷它所造成的損害，納維斯會獎勵他們金幣，但不包括魔法物品。

english: Jhaeros's Favor
zh_tw: 賈埃羅斯的青睞

english: If {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} survives and Ghalasine is restored, the king gives the characters a tract of land, perhaps even a keep and titles. The estate's exact location is up to you.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯}倖存下來，並且加拉辛得到恢復，國王將贈予角色們一塊土地，甚至可能是一座城堡和頭銜。莊園的確切位置由你決定。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization rewards the characters with a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment for delivering Jhaeros's still-beating heart to Naevys and saving Ghalasine. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，該組織會獎勵角色們一件他們選擇的稀有魔法物品（需經你批准）作為將賈埃羅斯仍在跳動的心臟交給納維斯並拯救加拉辛的報酬。這件物品將在第二天交給角色們。

english: {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}

english: Affair on the Concordant Express
zh_tw: 協和快車上的事件

english: {@i An Adventure for 9th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合9級角色的冒險}

english: Wanted for crimes across the multiverse, an outlaw known as {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} is currently a prisoner aboard the Concordant Express, an interplanar train destined for Mechanus, where the outlaw is set to stand trial. In this heist, the characters must obtain a list of names {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} has committed to memory. The names in question are the true names of several powerful demons, devils, and yugoloths.
zh_tw: 一名被稱為{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}的罪犯，因在多元宇宙各處犯案而遭通緝，如今被囚禁在跨位面列車協和快車上。列車正前往機械境，將其送去受審。在這場劫案中，角色必須取得{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}牢記於心的一份名單，其中記載著幾個強大惡魔、魔鬼和尤格羅斯魔的真名。

english: The Concordant Express rockets through the Outlands on its way to Mechanus
zh_tw: 協和快車列車在前往機械境的路上，飛速穿越外域。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: The interplanar outlaw known as {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} had humble origins. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} was born into a slum and orphaned as an infant. Early on, they used their knack for magic to masquerade as a lost noble scion and earn patronage as a spellcasting student. Inevitably, the school {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} was attending discovered the ruse, but {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} always slipped away and reemerged at an even more prominent academy in another city with a new false identity.
zh_tw: 被稱為{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}的跨位面逃犯出身卑微。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}出生在貧民窟，還是嬰兒時就成了孤兒。他們很早就利用自己對魔法的天賦，偽裝成一個迷路的貴族後裔，作為施法學生獲得贊助。不可避免地，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}就讀的學校發現了這個騙局，但{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}總是設法逃脫，並以一個新的虛假身份在另一個城市的更加著名的學院重新出現。

english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} perpetrated many crimes, none greater than the attempted theft of a book that held the true names of many demons, devils, and yugoloths (see "True Names" below). When {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} tried to flee with the book, a fiendish ward caused the book to disappear. By then, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} had already committed many of the true names to memory. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} then set off across the multiverse, making deals with various Fiends in exchange for keeping their true names secret. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} survived all these dealings unscathed for years, but their luck eventually ran out.
zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 犯下了許多罪行，其中最嚴重的是試圖盜竊一本包含許多惡魔、魔鬼和尤格羅斯魔真實姓名的書（見下面的"真實姓名"）。當 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 試圖帶著書逃跑時，一道邪魔結界導致書消失了。到那時，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 已經記住了許多真實姓名。隨後，{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 踏上了跨越多元宇宙的旅程，與各種邪魔進行交易，以保守他們的真實姓名。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 多年來在這些交易中毫髮無損地生存下來，但他們的運氣最終耗盡了。
