english: Fiendish foes set their sights on {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, forcing {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} to flee to the Material Plane and take refuge in the city-state of Akharin Sangar, which is ruled by a powerful angelic being. ({@adventure Akharin Sangar|JttRC|11|Akharin Sangar Gazetteer} is detailed further in {@adventure Journeys through the Radiant Citadel|JttRC}). But {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} underestimated the vigilance of Akharin Sangar's celestial host and was caught impersonating an angel. When {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} refused to divulge any information about themself, a deva enforcer named Omid was tasked with delivering {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} to Mechanus to stand trial. The prisoner was clamped in {@item dimensional shackles} and taken aboard the Concordant Express for safe transport.
zh_tw: 邪魔仇敵盯上了{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}，迫使{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}逃往物質界，在由一位強大天使統治的城邦阿卡林·桑加爾避難。（{@adventure 耀光城之旅|JttRC}中有{@adventure 阿卡林·桑加爾|JttRC|11|Akharin Sangar Gazetteer}的詳細介紹。）然而，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}低估了阿卡林·桑加爾天界軍團的警覺，冒充天使時遭到逮捕。由於{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}拒絕透露任何自身資訊，一名叫奧米德的天神使徒執法者受命將{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}押往機械境受審。囚犯被戴上{@item dimensional shackles||次元鐐銬}，帶上協和快車以確保押送安全。

english: True Names
zh_tw: 真名

english: Every Fiend has a true name that it tries to keep secret. One who knows a Fiend's true name can use this name to bind that Fiend to service. Other powerful creatures such as Celestials and Fey might have true names that function similarly.
zh_tw: 每個惡魔都有一個它試圖保密的真實姓名。知道惡魔真實姓名的人可以使用這個名字來束縛那個惡魔為其服務。其他強大的生物，如天界生物和精類，也可能擁有類似功能的真實姓名。

english: True names aren't restricted to spoken language or script. A creature's true name could be a specific gesture, sound, or other type of expression, such as the tolling of an iron bell, a mathematical equation, or a sequence of notes played on a particular kind of instrument.
zh_tw: 真實的名字不僅限於口語或書寫文字。一個生物的真實名字可以是一個特定的手勢、聲音或其他型別的表達方式，比如鐵鐘的敲擊聲、數學方程式，或者在特定樂器上演奏的音符序列。

english: Adventure Hooks
zh_tw: 冒險引子

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as the hook for the adventure, skip ahead to the "{@area Using the Golden Vault|40e|x}" section. Otherwise, choose one of the following adventure hooks.
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為冒險的引子，請跳至"{@area 使用金庫|40e|x}"部分。否則，請選擇以下冒險引子之一。

english: Blood War Balance
zh_tw: 血戰平衡

english: A planar faction known as the Fixers aims to restore balance to the Blood War (the eternal feud between demons and devils) by obtaining the true names of a pit fiend commonly known as Karnyros, a balor called Errtok, and a marilith known as Hexalanthe. A representative of the Fixers hires the characters to obtain these Fiends' true names from {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 一個名為修理工的位面派系旨在透過獲取一個通常被稱為卡尼羅斯的深獄煉魔、一個名為埃爾托克的巴洛炎魔和一個被稱為赫克莎蘭瑟的六臂蛇魔的真實名字，來恢復血戰（惡魔和魔鬼之間永恆的爭鬥）的平衡。修理工的一位代表僱傭角色們從{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}那裡獲得這些邪魔的真名。

english: Fiendish Extortion
zh_tw: 惡魔敲詐

english: A high-ranking member of the Fated, a faction in Sigil, has been captured and is being ransomed by an ultroloth known as Zeevok. Faction leaders hire the characters to obtain Zeevok's true name so the Fated can force Zeevok to release his captive without collecting a ransom.
zh_tw: 命運派系（定命盟）的一名高階成員在印記城被捕，並被一個名為齊沃克的超等羅斯魔勒索。派系領袖僱傭角色們獲取齊沃克的真實姓名，以便命運派系可以迫使齊沃克釋放他的人質而不收取贖金。

english: Personal Reasons
zh_tw: 個人原因

english: The characters seek the true name of a Fiend that has bedeviled them in the past.
zh_tw: 角色們尋找過去困擾他們的惡魔的真實姓名。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一個金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們用這把鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. The Golden Vault needs you to obtain the true names of three powerful denizens of the Lower Planes: the pit fiend Karnyros, the balor Errtok, and the marilith Hexalanthe. Their true names are known to an outlaw called {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, who is being transported to Mechanus on an interplanar train called the Concordant Express. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you board the train, locate {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, and acquire the true names from them. Expect to be contacted shortly by a quadrone named Glitch, a former train operative who now works for us. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。金庫需要你們獲得三位下層界強大居民的真實姓名：深獄煉魔卡尼羅斯，巴洛炎魔埃爾托克，以及六臂蛇魔赫克莎蘭瑟。他們的真實姓名被一個名叫 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 的通緝犯所知曉，他正在被運送到機械境的一列稱為協和快車的跨位面列車上。如果你們選擇承擔這項任務，你們需要登上列車，找到 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}，並從他們那裡獲得真實姓名。預期不久將由一個名叫格利奇的四元冢聯絡你們，他曾是列車特工，現在為我們工作。祝好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Glitch the Quadrone
zh_tw: 格利奇·四元冢

english: Not long after agreeing to undertake the adventure, the characters encounter a friendly {@creature quadrone} named Glitch. (When and where this happens is up to you.) The quadrone used to oversee hospitality on the Concordant Express. For this reason, it was imbued with the ability to speak Celestial, Common, and Infernal in addition to Modron.
zh_tw: 在同意承擔這次冒險後不久，角色們遇到了一個友好的 {@creature quadrone||四元冢}，名叫格利奇。（這何時何地發生由你決定。）這個四臂人過去負責監督協和快車上的款待工作。因此，除了魔冢語之外，它還被賦予了說天界語、通用語和地獄語的能力。

english: Conflicting directives from two pentadrone superiors caused a glitch that prompted the confused quadrone to quit its job. Glitch has become a free-thinking being with no desire to reintegrate into the modron hierarchy.
zh_tw: 兩個五元冢上級發出的相互衝突的指令導致了一個故障，這使得困惑的四元冢決定辭職。格利奇已經變成了一個自由思考的生物，沒有重新融入魔冢等級體系的願望。

english: Eager to help the characters, Glitch speaks to them in Common:
zh_tw: 格利奇渴望幫助角色們，用通用語對他們說：

english: "Ah, hello! Yes, good, finally—friends looking to catch {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}—{@creature the Stranger|KftGV} who has already been caught. Here, take this map. It shows the train cars. Here are your tickets and a pen to write down names. Not ordinary names—secret names! I am Glitch, by the way."
zh_tw: "啊，你好！是的，很好，終於——朋友們想要抓住 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}——那個已經被抓住的 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}。來，拿著這張地圖。它顯示了列車車廂。這是你們的車票和一支筆，用來記錄名字。不是普通的名字——是秘密的名字！順便說一下，我是格利奇。"

english: Glitch hands the characters an old blueprint of the Concordant Express (see {@area map 11.1|412|x}), one train ticket per character, and an ink pen. The tickets are made from paper-thin sheets of brass and grant passage to Mechanus aboard the Concordant Express. Each ticket is stamped with a boarding time, and the characters have 24 hours until the train departs.
zh_tw: 格利奇遞給角色們一份協和快車的舊藍圖（見 {@area 地圖 11.1|412|x}），每個角色一張火車票，以及一支鋼筆。這些車票是用紙一樣薄的黃銅片製成的，允許乘坐協和快車前往機械境。每張票上都蓋有登車時間，角色們有 24 小時直到火車出發。

english: Glitch takes the characters to the train when they're ready (see "{@area Catching the Train|416|x}" below) and stays with them in the interim. Glitch also shares the following information:
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好時，格利奇會帶他們去火車站（見下面的 "{@area 趕上火車|416|x}"）。在此期間，格利奇還分享了以下資訊：

english: Configuration
zh_tw: 配置

english: Like most trains, the Concordant Express includes an Engine Car at the front and a Caboose at the back. The number of other train cars and their configuration can change, so Glitch can't say much more about the size of the train or the order in which the cars will be arranged. The configuration of the cars might be different than what's shown on the blueprint. (In fact, it is. See the "{@area Train Configuration|413|x}" section for details.)
zh_tw: 像大多數火車一樣，協和快車前面有一個機車車廂，後面有一個守車。其他車廂的數量和配置可能會變化，所以格利奇對火車的大小或車廂排列的順序無法提供更多資訊。車廂的配置可能與藍圖上顯示的不同。（實際上，確實不同。詳見 "{@area 列車配置|413|x}" 部分了解詳細資訊。）

english: Fuel
zh_tw: 燃料

english: The train is fueled by treasure, which is kept in the Engine Car.
zh_tw: 火車由寶藏提供動力，這些寶藏存放在機車車廂中。

english: Location of the Stranger
zh_tw: 陌生人的位置

english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} is likely being held in the Jail Car, which has a skylight.
zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 很可能被關在有天窗的囚車中。

english: Patrols
zh_tw: 巡邏隊

english: Modrons patrol the exterior of the train.
zh_tw: 魔冢在列車外部巡邏。

english: Teleportation Ward
zh_tw: 傳送防護結界

english: Creatures can't teleport into or out of the train.
zh_tw: 生物不能傳送進或傳出列車。

english: The Concordant Express
zh_tw: 協和快車

english: The Concordant Express is a clockwork locomotive that traverses the multiverse. Modrons constructed the train with mathematical precision, and they operate it in the same way. The train's conductor is its sapient Engine Car, which delivers passengers and cargo to their intended destinations on schedule.
zh_tw: 協和快車是一列穿越多元宇宙的發條式機車。魔冢s 以數學精度建造了這列火車，並以相同的方式操作它。火車的列車長是其有感知的機車車廂，它按計劃將乘客和貨物送達預定目的地。

english: No terrain is too rugged for the train. Like the landmasses that make up Mechanus, the wheels of the Concordant Express are a network of interlacing cogs. A series of mechanical arms rapidly places levitating tracks before the train, while a similar set of arms beneath the Caboose collects the trailing tracks and delivers them to the Engine Car. This system allows the train to traverse inhospitable environments and to adjust course as needed.
zh_tw: 沒有任何地形對這列火車來說太崎嶇。就像組成機械境的陸地一樣，康科德快車的輪子是一系列交織在一起的齒輪網路。一系列機械臂在火車前迅速鋪設懸浮軌道，而守車下方的一組類似的機械臂收集軌道，並將它們傳送到機車。這個系統允許火車穿越不適宜的環境，並根據需要調整路線。

english: Map 11.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 11.1：玩家地圖

english: Train Configuration
zh_tw: 列車配置

english: The train has three mandatory cars and three optional cars, as described below.
zh_tw: 火車有三節必選車廂和三節可選車廂，如下所述。

english: Mandatory Cars
zh_tw: 必配車廂

english: In this adventure, the Concordant Express has one of each of the following cars:
zh_tw: 在這次冒險中，協和快車包含以下每種車廂的一節：

english: The Caboose ({@area area E1|423|x}) is the rearmost car.
zh_tw: 守車（區域 {@area 區域E1|423|x}）是最後一節車廂。

english: The Engine Car ({@area area E9|448|x}) is the frontmost car.
zh_tw: 機車車廂（{@area 區域E9|448|x}）是火車最前面的車廂。

english: The train has one Jail Car ({@area area E8|441|x}), which is adjacent to the Engine Car (not the Caboose, as shown on map 11.1).
zh_tw: 火車有一節囚車（{@area 區域E8|441|x}），它與機車車廂相鄰（不是守車，如地圖 11.1 上所示）。

english: Optional Cars
zh_tw: 可選車廂

english: {@area Map 11.2|422|x} includes maps for six additional cars: Abacus Car ({@area area E2|427|x}), Aquarium Car ({@area area E3|42a|x}), Cargo Car ({@area area E4|42d|x}), Planartarium Car ({@area area E5|42f|x}), Passenger Car ({@area area E6|432|x}), and Temple Car ({@area area E7|43e|x}).
zh_tw: {@area 地圖 11.2|422|x} 包括了六節額外車廂的地圖：計算器車廂（{@area 區域E2|427|x}），水族館車廂（{@area 區域E3|42a|x}），貨物車廂（{@area 區域E4|42d|x}），星象儀車廂（{@area 區域E5|42f|x}），乘客車廂（{@area 區域E6|432|x}），以及神廟車廂（{@area 區域E7|43e|x}）。

english: Pick any three of these cars and add them to the train in whatever configuration suits you, provided the mandatory cars stay where they are. (You can choose a different set of optional cars each time you run the adventure.)
zh_tw: 從這些車廂中任選三節，並根據你選擇的配置將它們新增到火車上，只要必選車廂保持在它們的位置。（每次進行冒險時，你可以選擇不同的可選車廂集合。）

english: You can add more than three optional cars to the train, at the risk of increasing the heist's length and difficulty. Conversely, you may opt for fewer cars for a shorter, easier heist.
zh_tw: 你可以將超過三節可選車廂新增到火車上，但這會增加劫案的長度和難度。相反，你也可能選擇較少的車廂來進行一次更短、更簡單的劫案。

english: Catching the Train
zh_tw: 趕上火車

english: Embedded in Glitch's body is an {@item amulet of the planes} that turns to dust (along with the rest of the quadrone) if Glitch is reduced to 0 hit points. Glitch uses this built-in amulet to cast {@spell plane shift}, delivering itself and the characters to a field in {@book the Outlands|DMG|2|The Outlands and Sigil} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for more information about this plane of existence). There they must wait for the train to arrive.
zh_tw: 格利奇的身體內嵌有一個 {@item amulet of the planes||位面護符}，如果格利奇的生命值降至 0 點，這個護符（連同四元冢的其餘部分）將化為塵土。格利奇使用這個內建的護符施展 {@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術，將自己和角色們傳送到 {@book 外域|DMG|2|The Outlands and Sigil}的一個田野中（有關這個位面的更多資訊，請參見 {@book 城主指南|DMG}）。在那裡，他們必須等待火車的到來。

english: As the train approaches the characters' location, read the following text:
zh_tw: 當火車接近角色們的位置時，請閱讀以下文字：

english: You pass the time on a grassy plain, waiting for the train to arrive. A few miles away, a colossal spire of rock rises into the sky, its peak lost in the clouds.
zh_tw: 你在一片草地平原上消磨時間，等待火車的到來。幾英里外，一根巨大的岩石尖塔聳入雲端，其頂端消失在雲霧中。

english: Glitch grows fidgety and impatient. Suddenly, the distant blare of a horn draws Glitch's attention—and yours—to a column of smoke on the horizon. "Good," says Glitch. "Here it comes, right on time!"
zh_tw: 格利奇變得焦躁不安且不耐煩。突然，遠處號角的轟鳴聲吸引了格利奇的注意——也吸引了你的注意——到地平線上的一股煙柱。"很好，"格利奇說。"它準時來了！"

english: A locomotive hurtles across the sky toward you, laying down magical tracks before it. As it draws near, you can see clockwork limbs disassembling the tracks behind the train and passing them forward so the locomotive can lay down new tracks in front of itself.
zh_tw: 一臺機車在天空中向您疾馳而來，在它前面鋪設魔法軌道。當它靠近時，您可以看到發條肢體在火車後面拆卸軌道，並將它們向前傳遞，以便機車可以在自己前面鋪設新的軌道。

english: As the train descends to ground level, its horn blares once more. It swerves away from you, coming to a gradual stop until its caboose is a short distance away, pointing in your direction.
zh_tw: 當火車下降到地面水平時，它的號角再次響起。它從您身邊拐彎，逐漸停下來，直到它的守車在您不遠處，指向您的方向。

english: "Got your tickets?" asks Glitch. "Excellent. Now go. Show your tickets to the modron in the caboose. This is where I leave you. Farewell, friends!"
zh_tw: "你們有票了嗎？" 格利奇問道。"太好了。現在去吧。向守車中的魔冢出示你們的車票。在這裡我要離開你們了。再見，朋友們！"

english: Glitch exits the adventure at this point, using its {@item amulet of the planes} to return whence it came.
zh_tw: 格利奇在這一點上退出冒險，使用它的 {@item amulet of the planes||位面護符} 回到它來時的地方。

english: Boarding the Train
zh_tw: 登車

english: The Caboose ({@area area E1|423|x}) doubles as a train station. Inside it is a booth containing a {@creature duodrone} attendant with a built-in ticket puncher. All passengers must get their tickets punched by this duodrone before they're permitted to explore the rest of the train.
zh_tw: 守車（區域 {@area 區域E1|423|x}）兼作火車站。裡面有一個攤位，攤位上有一個內建打孔機的{@creature duodrone||二元冢}服務員。所有乘客在被允許探索火車的其餘部分之前，都必須讓這個二元冢打孔他們的車票。

english: If one or more characters refuse to get their tickets punched, the duodrone whistles (no action required), causing four {@creature Tridrone||tridrones} to emerge from hidden compartments in the walls and act as described in area E1. If the characters then comply to avoid an altercation, the tridrones return to their compartments.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色拒絕讓他們的票被打孔，二元冢會吹哨（不需要動作），導致四個{@creature Tridrone||三元冢}從牆壁中隱藏的隔間中出現，並按照區域E1中的描述行動。如果角色們為了避免衝突而遵從，這些三頭無人機會返回到它們的隔間。

english: Choo, Choo!
zh_tw: 咻咻！

english: Once the characters' tickets are punched and the train is ready to go, read the following text:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們的車票被打孔，火車準備出發，請閱讀以下文字：

english: Machinery whirs and clicks as the train shudders and creeps forward, gradually picking up speed. Another horn blast signals that the Concordant Express is once again on the move.
zh_tw: 隨著列車顫抖並緩慢前進，機械裝置發出嗡嗡聲和點選聲，逐漸加速。另一聲號角響起，標誌著協和快車再次啟程。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The Concordant Express has the following features:
zh_tw: 協和快車具有以下特點：

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Car ceilings are 15 feet high unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 車廂的天花板高度為15尺，除非文字另有說明。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: At each end of every car is a sliding metal door. The doors to the Jail Car are locked (see {@area area E8|441|x} for details); all others are unlocked.
zh_tw: 每節車廂的兩端都有一個滑動的金屬門。監獄車廂的門是鎖著的（詳見 {@area 區域E8|441|x}）；其他車廂的門都是未上鎖的。

english: Flight
zh_tw: 飛翔

english: The train has a flying speed of 60 feet and can't hover.
zh_tw: 這列火車具有60尺的飛行速度，且不能懸停。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: All cars are brightly lit by magical orbs embedded in the ceilings.
zh_tw: 所有車廂都由嵌入天花板中的魔法球體照亮。

english: Modrons
zh_tw: 魔冢

english: All modrons serving aboard the Concordant Express speak no languages other than Modron unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 所有在康科德快車上服務的魔冢除了魔冢語外不說其他語言，除非文字另有說明。

english: Teleportation Ward
zh_tw: 傳送防護結界

english: Creatures can't teleport into or out of the train, or to any space within 120 feet of it. Any attempt to do so is wasted.
zh_tw: 生物不能傳送進或出火車，也不能傳送到距離火車120尺內的任何空間。任何此類嘗試都將白費。

english: Moving on the Train
zh_tw: 在火車上移動

english: To reach {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, the characters must make their way from the Caboose ({@area area E1|423|x}) to the Jail Car ({@area area E8|441|x}).
zh_tw: 要到達{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}，角色們必須從尾車（{@area 區域E1|423|x}）前往監獄車廂（{@area 區域E8|441|x}）。

english: Crossing between Cars
zh_tw: 車廂間穿行

english: Creatures can safely move from one car to another by stepping across couplers situated between the cars' exterior platforms.
zh_tw: 生物可以透過位於車廂外部平臺之間的聯結器安全地從一個車廂移動到另一個車廂。

english: Falling off the Train
zh_tw: 從火車上掉下來

english: If an effect would result in a creature falling off the train, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the creature instead falls {@condition prone} in the nearest unoccupied space on the train. On a failure, the creature is sucked into the train's undercarriage, taking 33 ({@dice 6d10}) bludgeoning damage and landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space at either end of the nearest train car.
zh_tw: 如果一個效果會導致生物從火車上跌落，該生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 14}敏捷豁免檢定。若成功，該生物改為跌落{@condition prone||伏地}在火車上最近的未被佔據的空間。若失敗，該生物被吸入火車的底盤，受到33（{@dice 6d10}）鈍擊傷害，並在最近車廂的任一端的一個未被佔據的空間{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: If a character falls off the Caboose, the train's track-retrieval arms snatch up the character and deposit them into an empty cell in the Jail Car ({@area area E8|441|x}).
zh_tw: 如果角色從守車上掉下來，列車的軌道回收臂會抓住角色並將他們放入監獄車廂（{@area 區域E8|441|x}）中的一個空牢房。

english: Guard Patrols
zh_tw: 守衛巡邏

english: Hostile modrons patrol the rooftops of the cars, attacking anyone they see who isn't supposed to be there. Whenever one or more characters reach the midpoint of a rooftop on any car other than the Jail Car, roll a {@dice d6} and use the Guard Patrols table to determine if an encounter occurs. Assume the patrol begins the encounter on the rooftop of an adjoining car. All the modrons have {@sense truesight}, and characters on the rooftop have nowhere to hide.
zh_tw: 敵對的魔冢在車廂的屋頂上巡邏，攻擊任何他們看到的不應該在那裡的人。每當一個或多個角色到達任何車廂（除了監獄車廂）屋頂的中點時，擲一個{@dice d6}骰子，並使用守衛巡邏表來確定是否發生遭遇。假設巡邏隊在相鄰車廂的屋頂上開始遭遇。所有的魔冢都有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}，並且屋頂上的角色無處可藏。

english: No random encounters occur on the roof of the Jail Car until after the squad of pentadrones stationed there is defeated (see {@area area E8|441|x} for details).
zh_tw: 在監獄車廂的屋頂上，直到那裡駐紮的五元冢小隊被擊敗後（詳見{@area 區域E8|441|x}），才會發生隨機遭遇。

english: Guard Patrols
zh_tw: 守衛巡邏

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: No encounter
zh_tw: 無事發生

english: Three {@creature Tridrone||tridrones} and one {@creature quadrone} leader
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Tridrone||三元冢}和一個{@creature quadrone||四元冢}領導者

english: Four {@creature Quadrone||quadrones} and one {@creature pentadrone} leader
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature Quadrone||四元冢}和一隻{@creature pentadrone||五元冢}領導者

english: Strong Winds
zh_tw: 強風

english: Creatures climbing on the outside the train or flying within 15 feet of it while it's in motion are subject to strong winds, the effects of which are as follows:
zh_tw: 生物在列車外部攀爬或在運動中距離它15尺以內飛行時，會受到強風的影響，具體效果如下：

english: Difficult Terrain
zh_tw: 困難地形

english: The wind-whipped exterior of the train is {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
zh_tw: 列車外部被風吹打，構成{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。

english: Ranged Attacks
zh_tw: 遠端攻擊

english: Ranged weapon attacks are made with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 遠端武器攻擊處於不利狀態。

english: Planar Effects
zh_tw: 位面效應

english: The Concordant Express moves across the known planes of existence by passing through invisible portals only the train's sapient Engine Car can find. The train's next stop is Mechanus, but it will pass through several other Outer Planes on its way there. While the train shields passengers from the harmful planes through which it travels, creatures aboard the train aren't entirely immune to the planes' effects.
zh_tw: 協和快車透過穿過只有列車的智慧引擎車廂才能找到的隱形門戶，在已知的位面之間移動。列車的下一站是機械境，但在到達那裡之前，它將經過幾個其他的外層位面。雖然列車透過它所旅行的有害位面保護乘客，但列車上的生物並不完全免疫於這些位面的影響。

english: The Planar Effects table contains effects for various planes of existence on the train's current route. Unless otherwise noted, each effect lasts until the train leaves the plane. Some effects apply only to creatures outside the train.
zh_tw: 位面效果表包含了列車當前路線上各種位面對列車的影響。除非另有說明，每種效果持續到列車離開該位面。有些效果僅適用於列車外部的生物。

english: The train enters a new plane whenever you like. Roll or choose from the options on the table to determine which plane the train is on and its accompanying effect. Once a train leaves a plane, it doesn't return to that plane for the rest of the adventure.
zh_tw: 您可以在任何時候讓列車進入一個新的位面。擲骰或從表中選擇以確定列車所在的位面及其相應的效果。一旦列車離開一個位面，在整個冒險的剩餘時間內它就不會再次回到那個位面。

english: Planar Effects
zh_tw: 位面效應

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Plane and Effect
zh_tw: 位面與效果

english: Acheron. The train flies over a vast battlefield where legions of devils clash with hordes of demons. Whenever one creature aboard the train deals damage to another creature aboard the train, both take 4 ({@dice 1d8}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 修羅場。列車飛越一個廣闊的戰場，那裡有魔鬼軍團與惡魔大軍激戰。每當列車上的一個生物對列車上的另一個生物造成傷害時，兩者都會受到4點（{@dice 1d8}）心靈傷害。

english: Elysium. All creatures aboard the train feel a sense of inner peace. No creature aboard the train can make an attack or cast a spell that deals damage.
zh_tw: 極樂世界（極樂境）。列車上的所有生物都感到一種內心的平靜。列車上的生物不能進行攻擊或施放造成傷害的法術。

english: Mount Celestia. Good-aligned creatures aboard the train gain a benefit of a {@spell bless} spell that lasts until the train leaves Mount Celestia.
zh_tw: 天界山。列車上的善良陣營生物獲得一個持續到列車離開天界山的{@spell bless||祝福術}法術的效果。

english: The Nine Hells. On one of the blisteringly cold layers of the Nine Hells (either Cania or Stygia), the train passes through a frigid gorge filled with whirlwinds of ice needles. Any creature outside the train takes 5 ({@dice 2d4}) cold damage plus 5 ({@dice 2d4}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. Modrons that normally patrol the outside of the train lock themselves in compartments for safety until the train leaves the plane.
zh_tw: 九層地獄。在九層地獄中極度寒冷的一層（卡尼亞或斯提吉亞），列車穿過一個充滿冰針旋風的寒冷峽谷。列車外部的任何生物在每個回合開始時受到5點（{@dice 2d4}）寒冷傷害加上5點（{@dice 2d4}）點穿刺傷害。通常在列車外部巡邏的魔冢在列車離開該位面前會將自己鎖在隔間裡以確保安全。

english: Pandemonium. Howling darkness surrounds the train. Creatures outside the train are {@condition deafened}. Outside the train, {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} becomes {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}, and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} becomes darkness.
zh_tw: 喧癲空隧。嚎叫黑暗環繞著列車。列車外的生物處於{@condition deafened||耳聾}狀態。列車外，{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}變為{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，而{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}變為黑暗。

english: Ysgard. Silent, spectral warriors from Valhalla fly around the train on ghostly chariots pulled by ghostly steeds. Any creature aboard the train that would be reduced to 0 hit points drops to 1 hit point instead.
zh_tw: 伊斯加德（約瑟園）。來自瓦爾哈拉的沉默幽靈戰士乘坐著由幽靈馬匹拉動的幽靈戰車圍繞列車飛行。列車上任何本應降至0生命值的生物，生命值反而降至1點。

english: Train Cars
zh_tw: 火車車廂

english: The various train cars are shown on map 11.2. The earlier "{@area Train Configuration|413|x}" section explains how to choose and arrange the cars.
zh_tw: 各種車廂在地圖11.2上顯示。早期的"{@area 列車配置|413|x}"部分解釋了如何選擇和排列車廂。

english: Map 11.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖11.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: E1: Caboose
zh_tw: E1. 守車

english: The characters are assumed to be in this car when the train gets underway. As the train begins to pick up speed and lifts into the air, a disembodied voice says, "Next stop: Mechanus!" in Common, Modron, Celestial, Infernal, Abyssal, and Primordial.
zh_tw: 角色們被假定在列車啟動時位於這節車廂內。當列車開始加速並升空時，一個無形的聲音用通用語、魔冢語、天界語、煉獄語、深潛語和原始語說：'下一站：機械境！'

english: Modrons in the Caboose
zh_tw: 守車中的魔冢

english: The {@creature duodrone} attendant who punched the characters' tickets has another function aboard the train: making minor repairs while the train is in motion. As the train gets underway, the duodrone dons gear from a nearby locker (see "Locker" below). It then departs to perform its duties, whistling as it marches to the next car.
zh_tw: 那個給角色們打票的{@creature duodrone||二元冢}服務員在列車上還有另一個功能：在列車行駛中進行小修小補。當列車啟動時，雙聯機甲從附近的儲物櫃中拿出裝備（見下文的"儲物櫃"）。然後它出發去執行它的職責，邊走邊吹著口哨前往下一節車廂。

english: Hidden in the walls of the Caboose are four {@creature Tridrone||tridrones} that emerge from their compartments to attack passengers who refuse to get their tickets punched or who perform an unlawful act, such as threatening the duodrone or plundering the locker.
zh_tw: 守車牆壁內隱藏著四個{@creature Tridrone||三元冢}，它們會從各自的隔間出來攻擊拒絕打票或進行非法行為的乘客，例如威脅二元冢或洗劫儲物櫃。

english: Locker
zh_tw: 儲物櫃

english: The locker contains a blue engineer's hat and a crew uniform consisting of a tool belt and a pair of grimy overalls labeled with a number.
zh_tw: 儲物櫃內包含一頂藍色的工程師帽子和一套工作服，包括一條工具腰帶和一件標有編號的髒兮兮的工作服。

english: Rear Platform
zh_tw: 後平臺

english: A railing on the car's rearmost platform prevents creatures from stumbling over the edge and into the dizzying blur of mechanical arms that retrieve the trailing railway tracks. A bronze ladder welded to the car provides access to its roof.
zh_tw: 車廂後端平臺的欄杆防止生物跌入機械臂回收軌道的令人眩暈的模糊區域。一個焊接在車廂上的青銅梯子提供了通往車頂的通道。

english: E2: Abacus Car
zh_tw: E2. 算盤車

english: Ten spherical modrons are lined up against the wall opposite a podium, behind which is a chalkboard covered with mathematical equations. Next to the podium stands a boxy modron wearing a wizard's cap. It taps the podium with a brass wand to get your attention. "Well met!" it says in Common. "I am the Math Wizard, Captain of Calculus, Admiral of Abaci, Unifier of Units! Welcome to my Sanctum Numerum, where any problem can be solved. I beseech thee, travelers, what numerical enigmas plague thee?"
zh_tw: 十個球形魔冢排列在講臺對面的牆壁旁，講臺後面是覆蓋著數學方程式的黑板。講臺旁邊站著一個戴著法師帽的方形魔冢。它用一根黃銅魔杖敲擊講臺以引起你的注意。"幸會！"它用通用語說。"我是數學法師，微積分的船長，算盤的海軍上將，單位的統一者！歡迎來到我的數字聖所，這裡任何問題都可以解決。旅行者們，有什麼數學難題困擾著你們嗎？

english: The eleven modrons stationed here act as a mathematical calculator for passengers.
zh_tw: 這裡駐守的十一個魔冢充當乘客的數學計算器。

english: The self-proclaimed Math Wizard is a friendly {@creature duodrone}. The Math Wizard speaks both Common and Modron.
zh_tw: 自稱數學法師的是一個友好的{@creature duodrone||二元冢}。數學法師會說通用語和魔冢語。

english: The ten {@creature Monodrone||monodrones} speak Modron only and are indifferent toward passengers. Each one holds a stack of ten placards numbered 0 through 9. When a creature inside the Abacus Car asks a mathematical question to which the answer is a number, the Math Wizard taps the podium with its wand and says, "Calculate!" In response, the monodrones select from their placards, shuffle around, and hold up their numerals to display the answer. The Math Wizard cheers "Huzzah!" after every successful calculation.
zh_tw: 這十個{@creature Monodrone||單元冢}只說魔冢語，對乘客漠不關心。每個單聯機甲都拿著一疊標有0到9的十塊牌子。當計算車廂內的生物提出一個數學問題，答案是一個數字時，數學法師會用它的魔杖敲擊講臺並說："計算！"作為回應，單聯機甲從它們的牌子中選擇，四處移動，並舉起它們的數字來顯示答案。每次成功計算後，數學法師都會歡呼"好極了！"

english: The monodrones do their best to calculate accurately, but sometimes they must estimate. Furthermore, if the ten monodrones are asked a question to which the answer exceeds 9,999,999,999 or the solution is uncountable, they scramble in circles while screaming in existential terror for a few moments before calmly returning to their positions.
zh_tw: 單元冢盡力準確計算，但有時它們必須進行估算。此外，如果這十個單元冢被問到一個答案超過9,999,999,999或解決方案是不可數的問題，它們會在驚恐中尖叫著亂轉幾圈，然後平靜地回到它們的位置。

english: Chalkboard
zh_tw: 黑板

english: The chalkboard is covered with equations explaining, rather incomprehensibly, why the Great Modron March happens only once every 289 years. To anyone other than a modron, most of the equations are utter nonsense.
zh_tw: 黑板上覆蓋著方程式，這些方程式難以理解地解釋了為什麼大魔冢遊行每289年只發生一次。對於魔冢以外的任何人來說，大多數方程式都是完全無意義的。

english: A character who studies the equations for at least 10 minutes can make a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check at the end of that time. If the check fails, the character takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) psychic damage and suffers a mild headache for the next hour. If the check succeeds, the character discovers a profound equation nestled among the others. Like a key, this equation unlocks something in the character's brain, with the effect determined by rolling on the Mysterious Equation table. A character who experiences this revelation gains no further benefit from studying the chalkboard equations. If any of the equations are erased, the modrons in the car turn hostile and attack, and no one can benefit from studying the equations.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果研究了這些方程式至少10分鐘，可以在結束時進行一個 {@dc 25} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色受到3點（{@dice 1d6}）心靈傷害，並在接下來的一個小時裡感到輕微頭痛。如果檢定成功，角色會發現一個深奧的方程式夾雜在其他式子中。這個方程式就像一把鑰匙，解鎖了角色大腦中的某個東西，其效果由在神秘方程式表上擲骰決定。經歷此啟示的角色不會從繼續研究黑板方程式中獲得更多好處。如果任何方程式被擦除，車廂中的魔冢會變得敵對並發動攻擊，沒有人能從研究這些方程式中獲得好處。

english: Mysterious Equation
zh_tw: 神秘方程

english: d8
zh_tw: d8

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: You gain {@book inspiration|PHB|4|inspiration}.
zh_tw: 你獲得了{@book 激勵|PHB|4|inspiration}。

english: You gain proficiency in one tool of your choice.
zh_tw: 你獲得了選擇的一項工具的熟練度。

english: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Deception}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Medicine}, or {@skill Performance}.
zh_tw: 你獲得了以下技能中選擇的一項的熟練度：{@skill Deception||欺瞞}、{@skill History||歷史}、{@skill Insight||洞悉}、{@skill Investigation||調查}、{@skill Medicine||醫療}或{@skill Performance||表演}。

english: You learn a new language of your choice.
zh_tw: 你學會了一種你選擇的新語言。

english: Your Intelligence score permanently increases by 2 (to a maximum of 20).
zh_tw: 你的智力得分永久增加2點（最高不超過20）。

english: E3: Aquarium Car
zh_tw: E3. 水族館車廂

english: This car is filled with clear water that isn't displaced when the door opens. The car's interior space is a large aquarium, complete with a coral reef and algae-coated ruins. Tiny fish dart through the ruins and circle an alabaster statue carved in the likeness of an angel clutching a decanter. Nearby fish scatter at the sight of you.
zh_tw: 這節車廂裡充滿了清澈的水，即使門開啟時水也不會被排開。車廂的內部空間是一個大型水族館，配備了珊瑚礁和覆蓋著藻類的廢墟。小魚在廢墟間穿梭，圍繞著一尊雕刻成天使形象的雪花石膏雕像遊動，天使手中緊握著一個水壺。附近的魚兒看到你後四散逃開。

english: This car is completely flooded, and magic keeps the water from being displaced when either door is opened. Creatures that can't breathe underwater must hold their breath in the aquarium. Magic instantly dries creatures as they exit the water.
zh_tw: 這節車廂完全被水淹沒了，而且當任何一扇門開啟時，魔法都會阻止水被排開。不能在水下呼吸的生物必須在水族館裡屏住呼吸。生物離開水面時，魔法會立即將它們變幹。

english: The aquarium can be slowly drained by removing a fist-sized plug near the base of the car's port-side wall. As an action, a character within reach of the plug can try to pull it out, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Strength check. Once the plug is removed, the aquarium's water level decreases at a rate of 1 foot per minute. It takes 15 minutes for all the water to drain from the car. The car's fish can't survive more than a few minutes without water.
zh_tw: 可透過拔除車廂左舷牆基附近拳頭大小的塞子來緩慢排空水族箱。範圍內的角色可用一個動作嘗試拔出塞子，需透過一次{@dc 17}力量檢定。塞子移除後，水族箱水位以每分鐘1尺的速度下降，15分鐘後完全排空。車廂內的魚類離水存活時間不超過數分鐘。

english: Angelic Statue
zh_tw: 天使雕像

english: The alabaster statue is a {@condition petrified} {@creature deva} with a {@item decanter of endless water}. If any harm befalls the fish in the aquarium, the deva immediately reverts to flesh and chastises whoever is responsible. If the aquarium's plug was removed, the deva replaces it. If any water was drained from the car, the deva uses the decanter to replenish it. If any fish died, the deva uses {@spell raise dead} spells to revive one fish per day for ten days. Once all is set right, the deva flies from the train and casts {@spell plane shift} to return to Mount Celestia, taking the decanter with it.
zh_tw: 這尊雪花石膏雕像是一位被石化的{@condition petrified||石化} {@creature deva||天神使徒}，手持一個{@item decanter of endless water||無盡水瓶}。如果水族館裡的魚受到任何傷害，這位天神使徒會立即恢復肉體，並懲罰責任人。如果水族館的塞子被移除，天神使徒會替換它。如果車廂內的水被排掉，天神使徒會使用水壺將其重新填滿。如果有任何魚死亡，天神使徒會使用{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術每天覆活一條魚，持續十天。一旦一切恢復正常，天神使徒會從列車上飛走，並施放{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術返回天界山，同時帶走水壺。

english: E4: Cargo Car
zh_tw: E4. 貨運車廂

english: A battered war machine rests at one end of this spacious car. Acid drips from a hose-like weapon mounted on the front of the vehicle, leaving a sizzling hole in the train car's floor.
zh_tw: 這節寬敞的車廂一端停放著一臺破舊的戰爭機器。酸液從一個安裝在車輛前部的類似軟管的武器滴落，在地上的車廂地板上留下一個嘶嘶作響的洞。

english: The war machine comes from the wastelands of Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. The vehicle isn't operational, but its hose-like sprayer is. A creature standing within 5 feet of the nozzle can take an action to cause the weapon to spray acidic bile in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 ({@dice 9d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is dissolved, leaving behind any objects it was carrying or wearing. Once used, the sprayer can't be used again.
zh_tw: 這輛戰車來自九層地獄第一層阿弗納斯的荒原。車輛本身無法操作，但其軟管狀的噴器仍可使用。站在噴嘴5尺內的生物可以採取一個行動來讓武器噴射出酸性膽汁，形成一個30尺的錐形區域。錐形區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 12}的敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到40點（{@dice 9d8}）酸蝕傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。若生物因該傷害生命值降至0，則會被溶解，僅留下其攜帶或穿戴的物品。噴器一旦使用，便無法再次使用。

english: A creature that interacts with the war machine spooks six {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps} lurking in its bent chassis. The imps fly out and attack the source of their fright while yelling, "I can't go back to jail!" in Infernal. If the infernal war machine's acid sprayer hasn't already been used, one of the imps uses it.
zh_tw: 與這臺戰爭機器互動的生物驚動了潛伏在其彎曲底盤中的六個{@condition invisible||隱形} {@creature Imp||小魔鬼}。小惡魔飛出來，攻擊它們恐懼的源頭，同時用煉獄語大喊："我不能再回監獄了！"如果這臺煉獄戰爭機器的酸液噴射器尚未使用，其中一個小惡魔會使用它。

english: A character who sits in the driver's seat notices a glowing {@item Potion of Fire Resistance||potion of resistance (fire)} jammed in a dirty glove compartment along with six unpaid infernal parking tickets.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果坐在駕駛座上，會發現一個發光的{@item Potion of Fire Resistance||抗火藥水}卡在髒亂的手套箱裡，旁邊還有六張未付的煉獄停車罰單。

english: E5: Planartarium Car
zh_tw: E5. 平行宇宙天文館車廂

english: Glowing symbols on the floor line the perimeter of this domed car. In the middle of the car is a mechanical model suspended over a dais that has more glowing symbols on it. The model resembles a large wheel with a tall spire protruding from the top. A tiny brass ring floats above the spire's peak.
zh_tw: 地板上的發光符號勾勒出這個圓頂車廂的邊界。車廂中央是一個懸掛在帶有更多發光符號的講臺上的機械模型。這個模型看起來像一個大型輪子，頂部有一個高聳的尖塔。一個微小的黃銅環在尖塔頂端上方浮動。

english: The spectral blue image of a modron materializes before the dais. It has a boxy shape and wears a pair of oversized glasses. The illusory modron adjusts its glasses and joyfully greets you in Common:
zh_tw: 一個幽靈般的藍色魔冢影像在講臺前顯現。它有著方形的外形，戴著一副過大的眼鏡。這個幻象魔冢調整了一下眼鏡，並用通用語高興地問候你：

english: "Hello, and welcome to the Planartarium. You can learn more about the planes of existence by donating to this car. All proceeds benefit the establishment of order across the multiverse." Before disappearing, the modron gestures toward a short tube protruding from the floor near the dais.
zh_tw: "你好，歡迎來到位面天文館。你可以透過向這節車廂捐款來瞭解更多關於位面的存在。所有的收益都將用於在多元宇宙中建立秩序。"在消失之前，魔冢指向講臺附近從地板上突出的一個短管。

english: The sixteen glowing sigils on the floor represent each of the Outer Planes, while the raised dais in the center of the room bears symbols of the four elemental Inner Planes. The wheel-shaped model above the dais represents the Outlands and its sixteen gate-towns. The tiny ring at the top of the spire represents Sigil.
zh_tw: 地板上的十六個發光符文分別代表每一個外層位面，而房間中央的高臺上刻有四個元素內層位面的符號。高臺上方的輪形模型代表外域及其十六個門城。尖塔頂部的微小戒指代表印記城。

english: A magical mote of golden light denotes the train's location. Since the train's travels are usually limited to the Inner Planes, the Outer Planes, and the Outlands, this mote can be seen floating above one of the symbols or above the model wheel representing the Outlands. If the train is in some other location not represented in this car, no mote is visible.
zh_tw: 一個金色的光點以魔法的方式表示列車的位置。由於列車的旅行通常限於內層位面、外層位面和外域，這個光點可以在代表外層位面的一個符號上方或代表外域的模型輪上方看到。如果列車位於這節車廂中沒有表示的其他位置，就看不到光點。

english: Donation Tube
zh_tw: 捐款管

english: The short tube rising from the floor near the dais has a slot large enough to insert coins, gemstones, and other small valuables. Such valuables are then teleported to the cart in {@area area E9|448|x}.
zh_tw: 從講臺附近地板上升起的短管上有一個足夠大的槽口，可以插入硬幣、寶石和其他小件貴重物品。這些貴重物品隨後會被傳送到{@area 區域E9|448|x}的購物車裡。

english: Whenever a creature drops at least 10 gp worth of treasure into the tube, Cosmo, the illusory modron, reappears. It thanks the donor and asks which plane of existence they'd like to learn about.
zh_tw: 每當生物向管內投入至少價值10金幣的財寶時，幻象魔冢科斯莫就會重新出現。它感謝捐贈者，並詢問他們想了解哪一個位面的存在。

english: Cosmo can give a brief lecture on any {@book plane of existence|DMG|2} described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If a character asks about a plane on the train's route, Cosmo also alludes to noteworthy planar effects. For example, if asked about the Nine Hells, the spectral duodrone might say, "Rest assured, the Concordant Express is reinforced to withstand extreme heat and extreme cold." Cosmo lectures about one plane per donation and vanishes after each lecture.
zh_tw: 科斯莫可以簡要講解任何在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中描述的{@book 位面|DMG|2}。如果有角色詢問關於列車路線上的位面，科斯莫還會提及值得注意的位面效應。例如，如果被問及九層地獄，這個幽影般的二元冢可能會說："請放心，協和快車已加固以承受極端高溫和極端低溫。" 科斯莫每次講解一個位面後便會消失，且每次講解需要一次捐贈。

english: If a character inserts something worthless into the donation slot or otherwise tries to fool it with counterfeits and the like, the tube disgorges poisonous gas that quickly fills the compartment. This gas duplicates the effect of a {@spell stinking cloud} spell that lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色將無價值的物品插入捐贈槽，或者以其他方式試圖用偽造品欺騙它，管子會排出有毒氣體，這種氣體迅速填滿隔間。這種氣體複製了持續1分鐘或直到被驅散的{@spell stinking cloud||臭雲術}法術的效果。

english: E6: Passenger Car
zh_tw: E6. 客車車廂

english: A mind flayer in a beige coat kneels beside a body in the aisle of this passenger car. Three curious onlookers—a cambion, a drow, and bronze dwarf with flames for hair—poke their heads out of nearby cabins. "No one move a muscle!" warns the mind flayer. "This whole car just became a crime scene."
zh_tw: 一個穿著米色外套的靈吸怪魔跪在客車廂過道的一具屍體旁。三個好奇的旁觀者——一個坎比翁、一個黑暗精靈和一個頭發是火焰的青銅矮人——從附近的隔間探出頭來。"誰也不許動！"靈吸怪魔警告說。"整節車廂現在成了犯罪現場。"

english: This car contains three cozy passenger cabins and two privies (one at each end of the car). Quintus Malvesh, an aasimar cartographer, lies dead in the aisle (in the square marked X on {@area map 11.2|422|x}), and a detective is already on the case.
zh_tw: 這節車廂包含三個舒適的乘客隔間和兩個廁所（分別位於車廂的兩端）。昆圖斯·馬爾維斯，一個阿斯莫製圖師，在過道中死去（位於{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}上標有X的方格），已經有偵探在調查此案。

english: Illithid Detective
zh_tw: 靈吸怪偵探

english: The detective is a lawful neutral {@creature mind flayer} named {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV}. Seeing the characters, Ignatius lights a pipe with a match it holds with one of its face tentacles. The pipe exudes a green vapor that smells of absinthe. Since the characters weren't on the car when the murder occurred, Ignatius doesn't regard them as suspects and is friendly toward them. Ignatius can speak Common but loathes doing so; the mind flayer prefers to converse telepathically. Its tone is strident, and it uses stereotypical detective phrases such as "The game is afoot!" and "The devil is in the details!"
zh_tw: 這位偵探是一個守序中立的{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}，名叫{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}。看到角色們，伊格納提斯用它的一根面部觸手拿著火柴點燃了菸鬥。菸鬥散發出一股帶有苦艾酒氣味的綠色煙霧。由於角色們在謀殺發生時並不在車廂內，伊格納提斯不將他們視為嫌疑人，對他們態度友好。伊格納提斯會說通用語，但不喜歡這樣做；奪心魔更喜歡用心靈感應進行交流。它的語調尖銳，並且使用諸如"好戲開始了！"和"魔鬼藏在細節中！"等典型的偵探用語。

english: Ignatius tries to enlist the characters in its investigation. If they agree to help, the mind flayer asks them to look for clues and question suspects. (In the meantime, the mind flayer quietly casts {@spell detect thoughts}, focusing on every creature in the Passenger Car.) Ignatius asks that no one leave the car until the mystery is solved. If the characters leave anyway, Ignatius solves the case without their help.
zh_tw: 伊格納提斯試圖招募角色們參與其調查。如果他們同意幫忙，這位靈吸怪魔要求他們尋找線索並詢問嫌疑人。（與此同時，靈吸怪魔悄悄地施放了{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，專注於客車廂中的每一個生物。）伊格納提斯要求在謎題解開之前，任何人都不得離開車廂。如果角色們還是離開了，伊格納提斯將在沒有他們幫助的情況下解決案件。

english: What Ignatius Knows
zh_tw: 伊格納提斯所知

english: Ignatius has already determined that Quintus was killed while walking to his cabin from one of the Passenger Car's two privies. The aasimar's body lies outside the door to the middle cabin, which Quintus and another passenger shared. Ignatius was using the other privy at the time of Quintus's death and heard the aasimar gasp before hitting the floor. Ignatius quickly reached the scene, but the killer was nowhere in sight.
zh_tw: 伊格納提斯已經確定昆圖斯是在從客車廂的兩個廁所之一走回他的隔間時被殺的。這位阿斯莫的屍體躺在中間隔間的門外，昆圖斯和另一位乘客共享這個隔間。昆圖斯死亡時，伊格納提斯正在使用另一個廁所，並聽到阿斯莫倒地前的喘息聲。伊格納提斯迅速到達現場，但兇手已不見蹤影。

english: {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV}, the great mind flayer detective, examines a corpse aboard the Concordant Express
zh_tw: 偉大的靈吸怪魔偵探{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}在協和快車上檢查一具屍體

english: Murder Suspects
zh_tw: 謀殺案嫌疑人

english: The suspects aboard the Passenger Car are as follows:
zh_tw: 客車廂內的嫌疑人如下：

english: {@b Abernathy Vernus} (lawful evil {@creature cambion}) is a friendly, ingratiating fellow who claims to have won a free tour aboard the Concordant Express. He insists that others call him Vern. No other passengers occupy his cabin (the one marked "a" on {@area map 11.2|422|x}), which Vern shares with a {@creature monodrone} valet that answers to the name Higglesworth.
zh_tw: {@b 阿伯納西·維爾納斯}（守序邪惡的{@creature cambion||坎比翁}）是一個友好、討好的人，聲稱自己贏得了協和快車的免費旅行。他堅持讓別人稱呼他為弗恩。沒有其他乘客佔用他的隔間（在{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}上標記為'a'），弗恩與一個名叫希格爾斯沃斯的{@creature monodrone||單元冢}男僕共享這個隔間。

english: {@b Ethlynn Stalaczic} (neutral, drow {@creature mage}) is a friendly, somewhat gullible dragonologist on a planar quest to find a "time dragon" (which may or may not be a real thing). Until a few moments ago, Ethlynn and Quintus were cabin mates. Ethlynn currently shares her cabin (the one marked "b" on {@area map 11.2|422|x}) with a {@creature monodrone} valet called Bot.
zh_tw: {@b 埃瑟琳·斯塔拉奇克}（中立，黑暗精靈{@creature mage||魔法師})是一個友好的、有點輕信的龍學家，她正在進行一次尋找"時間龍"（可能存在也可能不存在的東西）的位面任務。直到幾分鐘前，埃瑟琳和昆圖斯還是室友。埃瑟琳目前與一個名叫博特的{@creature monodrone||單元冢}男僕共享她的隔間（在{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}上標記為'b'）。

english: {@b Meldar} (lawful neutral {@creature azer}) is indifferent toward others, speaks nothing but Ignan, and provides curt answers to questions put to them. The azer is returning to the City of Brass after attending a smiths' convention in Bytopia. Meldar shares a cabin (the one marked "c" on {@area map 11.2|422|x}) with {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV} and a monodrone valet known as Orb.
zh_tw: {@b 梅爾達爾}（守序中立的{@creature azer||火矮人}）對他人漠不關心，只會說火族語，並且對提出的問題會給出簡短的回答。這位火矮人在雙生天堂參加完一場鐵匠大會後，正返回黃銅城。梅爾達爾與{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}以及一位名為奧布的單元冢僕從共住一間小屋（在{@area 地圖 11.2|422|x}中標有"c"的房間）。

english: The monodrones never leave the train. Ignatius was already aboard when Meldar boarded the train a day ago in Bytopia. The other suspects boarded the train near Excelsior (a gate-town in the Outlands) shortly before the characters came aboard.
zh_tw: 單元冢從不離開列車。伊格納提斯在梅爾達爾一天前於雙生天堂登車時已經在列車上了。其他嫌疑人是在角色們登車前不久，在外域的門城卓越鎮（精益求精）附近登車的。

english: Murder Victim
zh_tw: 謀殺案受害者

english: Characters can examine Quintus or cast spells on the corpse. The following information can be learned by doing so:
zh_tw: 角色們可以檢查昆圖斯或對屍體施放法術。透過這樣做，可以瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Examining the Corpse
zh_tw: 檢查屍體

english: A character who examines Quintus and succeeds on a {@dc 11} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) or Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check determines that the aasimar was killed by three bolts of magical force identical to those created by a {@spell magic missile} spell. Given where the body fell, the direction Quintus was walking when he died, and where the wounds on the body are located, a character can deduce, with a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, that the killer likely didn't come from Meldar's cabin.
zh_tw: 一名角色若檢查昆圖斯並透過了一次 {@dc 11} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）或智慧（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定，可以確定這名亞西瑪人是被三發與 {@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈} 法術相同的魔法力量彈射物所殺。根據屍體倒下的位置、昆圖斯死亡時行進的方向以及屍體上傷口的位置，角色若透過一次 {@dc 16} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，便可以推斷出兇手很可能並非來自梅達的小屋。

english: Raising the Dead
zh_tw: 復活死者

english: A character who has the {@spell raise dead} spell prepared can use it to restore Quintus to life. (The devas in {@area areas E3|42a|x}and {@area E8|441|x} can also provide this service, if asked nicely.) Quintus is chaotic neutral and uses the {@creature noble} stat block, although he is unarmored and carries no weapons. Alive, the aasimar is less cooperative than when he was dead, for reasons explained in the "{@area Motive|439|x}" section below. He offers no possible reasons for why someone would want to kill him.
zh_tw: 一個準備了{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術的角色可以使用它來復活昆圖斯。（位於{@area 區域E3|42a|x}和{@area E8|441|x}的天族如果被禮貌地請求，也可以提供這項服務。）昆圖斯是混亂中立陣營，使用{@creature noble||貴族}資料卡，儘管他未穿護甲且不攜帶任何武器。活著的亞西瑪比死時更不合作，原因在下面的"{@area 動機|439|x}"部分中說明。他沒有提供任何關於為什麼有人想殺他的可能原因。

english: Speaking with the Dead
zh_tw: 與死者對話

english: If a {@spell speak with dead} spell is cast on the corpse, the aasimar's spirit answers questions honestly. Quintus did not see his killer, but he knows one reason why every other passenger in this car (besides Ignatius) might want him dead. These reasons are summarized in the {@area Murder Suspects table|436|x}.
zh_tw: 如果對屍體施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術，這位阿斯莫的靈魂會誠實地回答問題。昆圖斯沒有看到他的兇手，但他知道這節車廂裡除了伊格納提斯之外的每位乘客可能想要他死的一個原因。這些原因在{@area 謀殺案嫌疑人表|436|x}中進行了總結。

english: Searching the Cabins
zh_tw: 搜尋隔間

english: Characters can search for clues in the passenger cabins and question the modron valet in each one:
zh_tw: 角色們可以在乘客隔間尋找線索，並詢問每個隔間的魔冢男僕：

english: Cabin A
zh_tw: 隔間A

english: This cabin holds Vern's battered suitcase, which contains two {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|traveler's outfits}, three odd-looking compasses, and a set of {@item tinker's tools|PHB}. If asked about the compasses, Vern says he builds and repairs them to pass the time on long trips.
zh_tw: 這個隔間裡放著弗恩破舊的手提箱，裡面有兩套{@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|旅行者服裝}，三個外觀奇特的指南針，以及一套{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}。如果問及這些指南針，弗恩表示他在長途旅行中建造和修理它們來打發時間。

english: Cabin B
zh_tw: 隔間B

english: Ethlynn shared this cabin with the murder victim and knows Quintus was a cartographer. Ethlynn confirms that Quintus left their cabin to use the privy at one end of the train car. Characters who search the cabin find Quintus's satchel, which contains two spare {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|traveler's outfits}, a set of {@item cartographer's tools|PHB}, and a {@item Map or Scroll Case|PHB|map case} containing what look like ancient treasure maps. A similar map, stolen by Ethlynn while Quintus was visiting the privy, is stuffed in her spider silk handbag. (Ethlynn insists Quintus gave the map to her, which he never did. He did, however, tell her that the map shows the way to a time dragon's lair, which it does not.) A character who spends 1 minute examining any one of Quintus's maps can, with a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, cast serious doubt on the map's accuracy.
zh_tw: 艾思琳與謀殺受害者同住這個車廂，並知道昆圖斯是一名製圖師。艾思琳證實昆圖斯曾離開車廂去使用列車末端的廁所。搜查車廂的角色會發現昆圖斯的挎包，裡面裝著兩套備用的{@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|旅行者服裝}、一套{@item cartographer's tools|PHB|製圖工具}和一個裝有看似古老藏寶圖的{@item Map or Scroll Case|PHB|地圖匣}。昆圖斯去廁所時，艾思琳偷走了一張類似的地圖，塞在她的蛛絲手提包裡。（艾思琳堅稱地圖是昆圖斯給她的，其實從未有過。不過昆圖斯確實告訴過她這張地圖指向一條時龍巢穴——實際上並沒有。）角色花費1分鐘檢查任意一張昆圖斯的地圖時，若透過一次{@dc 16}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，可嚴重質疑該地圖的準確性。

english: Cabin C
zh_tw: 隔間C

english: Meldar and Ignatius share this cabin, which contains nothing incriminating. Its occupants travel light.
zh_tw: 梅爾達爾和伊格納提斯共享這個隔間，裡面沒有任何罪證。它的居住者旅行時攜帶的物品很少。

english: Questioning the Modrons
zh_tw: 詢問魔冢

english: Monodrone valets aboard the Concordant Express have built-in language interpreters instead of voice boxes; consequently, they can understand any spoken language but can't speak. Bot and Orb shrug their shoulders if questioned about the murder (of which they know nothing). Higglesworth simply points to itself if questioned about the murder.
zh_tw: 協和快車上的單元冢服務員配備了內建的語言翻譯器而不是聲音盒；因此，它們可以理解任何口頭語言，但不能說話。如果被問及謀殺案（它們一無所知），博特和法球會聳肩表示不知情。如果被問及謀殺案，希格斯沃斯只會指向自己。

english: Solving the Mystery
zh_tw: 解開謎團

english: The monodrone Higglesworth killed Quintus using a {@item wand of magic missiles}, which is hidden in a secret compartment inside the monodrone's spherical body. The monodrone won't subject itself to inspection and attacks anyone who tries to search or dismantle it. Its impeccable valet programming prevents it from incriminating passengers or accusing them of any wrongdoing.
zh_tw: 單元冢希格斯沃斯使用一根藏在其球形身體內的秘密隔間的{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}殺死了昆圖斯。單元冢不會讓自己被檢查，並且會攻擊任何試圖搜尋或拆解它的人。它無可挑剔的管家程式阻止它指控乘客或指責他們有任何不當行為。

english: Higglesworth did not commit the crime willingly. The cambion Vern used his tinker's tools and magical know-how to reprogram the monodrone valet to murder Quintus using a wand Vern pilfered from a wizard's apprentice in Excelsior. Vern then used the modron's body to hide the murder weapon and instructed Higglesworth not to tolerate invasive scrutiny.
zh_tw: 希格斯沃斯並非自願犯罪。坎比翁維恩使用他的修補工具和魔法知識重新程式設計了單元冢服務員，用一根從精益求精的法師學徒那裡偷來的魔杖謀殺了昆圖斯。然後，維恩使用魔冢的屍體隱藏了兇器，並指示希格斯沃斯不允許接受侵入性審查。

english: Murder Weapon
zh_tw: 兇器

english: A character can use an action to search Higglesworth for a secret compartment, finding it with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, but this can be done only while the monodrone is {@condition incapacitated}. The same is true for opening the compartment, which requires another action, thieves' tools or tinker's tools, and a successful {@dc 11} Dexterity check. Opening the compartment causes the wand to tumble out.
zh_tw: 角色可以用一個動作搜尋希格爾斯沃思，尋找一個秘密隔間，成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定即可找到，但這只能在單體機器人 {@condition incapacitated||無力} 時進行。開啟隔間同樣如此，需要另一個動作、盜賊工具或修補匠工具，以及成功透過 {@dc 11} 敏捷檢定。開啟隔間會使魔杖掉出來。

english: If Higglesworth is reduced to 0 hit points, its body disintegrates, but the {@item wand of magic missiles} hidden inside it remains.
zh_tw: 如果希格斯沃斯的生命值降至0點，它的身體會解體，但隱藏在它體內的{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}依然存在。

english: One of the wand's charges has been expended—the same charge that killed Quintus.
zh_tw: 魔杖的一個充能已經被消耗了——正是那個殺死昆圖斯的充能。

english: Motive
zh_tw: 動機

english: Vern is a con artist who makes and sells "magic compasses" to gullible folk looking for an easy way to find that which their hearts desire. Quintus, also a con artist, made and sold bogus treasure maps. Vern and Quintus both identified Ethlynn as a likely mark, but Quintus got to her first by preying on her dream of finding a time dragon's lair. Vern decided to eliminate the competition while laying the blame on a malfunctioning modron that can't speak in its own defense.
zh_tw: 維恩是一個詐騙者，他製造並銷售所謂的"魔法指南針"給那些輕信的人，這些人在尋找一種簡單的方法來找到他們心中所渴望的東西。昆圖斯也是一個詐騙者，他製造並銷售假的藏寶圖。維恩和昆圖斯都認定艾絲琳是一個可能的目標，但是昆圖斯透過利用她尋找時間龍巢穴的夢想先一步接近了她。維恩決定消除競爭，同時將責任歸咎於一個無法為自己辯護的故障魔冢。

english: J'Accuse
zh_tw: 我指控

english: If the characters accuse Ethlynn or Meldar of murdering Quintus, Ignatius telepathically warns the characters that their investigation has gone "off the rails." He then recommends they "look for clues within clues" and "try to understand the motive behind the killing." Gifted with the ability to cast {@spell detect thoughts} at will, Ignatius has already identified Vern as the individual responsible for Quintus's death, but Ignatius wants the characters to see the truth for themselves—not simply take a mind flayer's word for it.
zh_tw: 如果角色指控艾絲琳或梅爾達謀殺了昆圖斯，伊格納提斯透過心靈感應警告角色，他們的調查已經"偏離了軌道"。然後他建議他們"線上索中尋找線索"，並"嘗試理解殺人背後的動機"。伊格納提斯擁有隨意施放{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}的能力，他已經識別出維恩是對昆圖斯死亡負責的個體，但伊格納提斯希望角色們自己看到真相——而不是僅僅接受一個靈吸怪的話。

english: Case Closed
zh_tw: 案件結案

english: The mystery concludes with Ignatius confining Vern to his cabin until the authorities in Mechanus remove the cambion from the train. If the characters don't have the means to raise Quintus from the dead, Ignatius suggests they speak to the deva guarding the Jail Car and convince the angel to revive the dead aasimar. The characters are free to keep the {@item wand of magic missiles}, since Ignatius doesn't need it to make a case against Vern.
zh_tw: 這個謎團以伊格納提斯將維恩限制在他的小屋中結束，直到機械境的當局將這個坎比翁從列車上移走。如果角色們沒有手段將昆圖斯從死亡中復活，伊格納提斯建議他們與守護監獄車廂的天神使徒交談，並說服天神使徒復活死去的阿斯莫。角色們可以自由保留 {@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}，因為伊格納提斯不需要它來對維恩提出指控。

english: Ignatius won't press Ethlynn on the theft of Quintus's bogus map, but characters may do so. Ethlynn can be guilted into returning the map and apologizing for the theft. As for Quintus, the aasimar won't admit to any wrongdoing unless magic is used to coerce him.
zh_tw: 伊格納提斯不會對艾絲琳偷走昆圖斯的假地圖一事進行追究，但角色們可以這麼做。艾絲琳可能會因為內疚而歸還地圖併為盜竊道歉。至於昆圖斯，這位阿斯莫除非使用魔法強迫他，否則他不會承認任何錯誤。

english: Murder Suspects
zh_tw: 謀殺案嫌疑人

english: Suspect
zh_tw: 嫌疑人

english: Possible Motive
zh_tw: 可能的動機

english: Abernathy Vernus
zh_tw: 阿伯納西·維爾納斯

english: The cambion seemed upset, maybe even jealous, that Ethlynn and Quintus were getting along so well. The cambion seemed to have his heart set on spending more time with Ethlynn, which necessitated getting rid of Quintus.
zh_tw: 那個坎比翁似乎很不高興，甚至可能是嫉妒，因為艾絲琳和昆圖斯相處得如此融洽。坎比翁似乎決心要和艾絲琳多花些時間在一起，這就需要擺脫昆圖斯。

english: Ethlynn Stalaczic
zh_tw: 埃瑟琳·斯塔拉奇克

english: Ethlynn was eyeballing Quintus's maps. Killing Quintus would allow her to steal the maps without anyone knowing.
zh_tw: 艾絲琳對昆圖斯的地圖很感興趣。殺害昆圖斯可以讓她無人知曉地偷走地圖。

english: Meldar
zh_tw: 梅爾達爾

english: Quintus referred to Meldar as a "hothead" when he didn't think the azer was close enough to hear him. Killing Quintus could've been payback for the insult. (Since Meldar knows only one language—Ignan—and the insult wasn't spoken in that tongue, this motive evaporates quickly.)
zh_tw: 昆圖斯在認為火矮人聽不見他的時候，稱梅爾達為"火爆頭"。殺害昆圖斯可能是為了報復這個侮辱。（由於梅爾達只知道一種語言——火族語語——並且這個侮辱不是用那種語言說的，這個動機很快就消失了。）

english: E7: Temple Car
zh_tw: E7. 神廟車廂

english: Stained-glass windows decorate the walls of this car, while its floors are adorned with exquisitely patterned rugs. Several columns support a vaulted mosaic ceiling. Kneeling before an altar is a serene priest in sunny robes.
zh_tw: 這節車廂的牆壁裝飾著彩色玻璃窗，地板上鋪著精美圖案的地毯。幾根柱子支撐著一個拱形的馬賽克天花板。一位穿著陽光般長袍的寧靜牧師跪在祭壇前。

english: The priest is, in fact, a {@creature gray slaad} using its Change Shape ability to fool the characters. The slaad was sent here to kill them, plain and simple. It killed the real priest, stole his robes, and threw his body and holy symbol off the train.
zh_tw: 實際上，這位牧師是一個使用其變化形態能力的{@creature gray slaad||史拉灰蟾}，以此來欺騙角色們。史拉蟾被派到這裡來就是為了殺死他們，簡單明瞭。它殺死了真正的牧師，偷走了他的長袍，並將他的身體和聖徽扔出了列車。

english: The slaad works for an evil, multiverse-spanning organization called the Syndicate of Terror, Extortion, Assassination, and Larceny (STEAL), which has been spying on the characters for some time and wants their mission aboard the Concordant Express to fail. (This is doubly true if the characters are working for STEAL's rival, the Golden Vault.) If you're weaving multiple adventures from this anthology into your campaign, one or more villains from earlier adventures might have secret ties to this evil organization. Likely candidates (assuming they're still alive) include Quentin Togglepocket from "{@adventure The Stygian Gambit|KftGV|2}," Guildmaster Dusk from "{@adventure Masterpiece Imbroglio|KftGV|6}," and {@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV} from "{@adventure Vidorant's Vault|KftGV|8}." If you're using the rivals described in this book's {@area introduction|00c|x}, their patron might be a STEAL operative.
zh_tw: 這個史拉蟾為名為恐怖、敲詐、刺殺與盜竊聯合會（STEAL）的邪惡組織效力，該組織跨越多元宇宙，已經暗中監視了角色們一段時間，並希望他們在協和快車上的任務失敗。（如果角色們為STEAL的競爭對手金庫工作，這一點就更加成立。）如果你將這本選集中的多個冒險編織到你的戰役中，早期冒險中的一個或多個反派可能與這個邪惡組織有秘密聯絡。可能的候選人（假設他們還活著）包括來自"{@adventure 冥河的謀略|KftGV|2}"的昆汀·托格波克，來自"{@adventure 傑作糾葛|KftGV|6}"的公會會長達斯克，以及來自"{@adventure 維朵蘭特的金庫|KftGV|8}"的{@creature Nixylanna Vidorant|KftGV|尼克絲拉娜·維朵蘭特}。如果你使用的是本書{@area 簡介|00c|x}中描述的對手，他們的庇護人可能是STEAL的特工。

english: One of STEAL's operatives, having recently acquired the gray slaad's control gem, used the gem to command the slaad to slip aboard the Concordant Express and kill the characters on sight. The slaad loathes being surrounded by modrons on the train and fights to the death.
zh_tw: STEAL 的一名特工最近獲得了灰色史拉蟾的控制寶石，利用這顆寶石命令史拉蟾潛入協和快車並立即殺害角色們。史拉蟾討厭被列車上的魔冢包圍，並戰鬥至死。

english: Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: 偵測感應器

english: The slaad's master watches the battle unfold through an invisible scrying sensor like the one created by a {@spell scrying} spell. If the characters defeat the slaad, a magically altered voice issues from the invisible sensor and says in Common, "So much for that. Next time you won't be so lucky!" If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the voice adds, "The Golden Vault won't be able to protect you from our wrath." The scrying sensor then disappears.
zh_tw: 史拉蟾的主人透過一個如同由{@spell scrying||探知術}法術所創造的隱形探知感測器觀察戰鬥的發展。如果角色們擊敗了史拉蟾，一個經過魔法改變的聲音從隱形偵測器中發出，並用通用語說："就這樣了。下一次你們不會這麼幸運！"如果角色們為金庫工作，聲音補充說："金庫無法保護你們免受我們的憤怒。"然後偵測器消失了。

english: E8: Jail Car
zh_tw: E8. 監獄車廂

english: This soundproof car is two stories tall (30 feet high) and encased in thick iron. Four {@creature Pentadrone||pentadrones} guard the rooftop. These guards are positioned near the corners of the roof, allowing them to spot trouble coming from the sides of the car.
zh_tw: 這節隔音車廂高兩層（30尺高），並且被厚實的鐵皮包裹。四隻{@creature Pentadrone||五元冢}守衛著屋頂。這些守衛位於屋頂的角落附近，使它們能夠發現從車廂兩側來的麻煩。

english: The outer doors of the car are locked tight, as is the 10-foot-square skylight in the roof. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can try to open one of the doors or the skylight, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check. The skylight can also be shattered; it is made of thick glass and has AC 13, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Conversely, the doors are too strong to be forced open by anything other than {@spell knock} spells or similar magic.
zh_tw: 車廂的外部門被緊緊鎖住，車頂上的10尺見方的天窗也是如此。作為動作，擁有盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試開啟一扇門或天窗，成功進行一個{@dc 17}敏捷檢定即可完成。天窗也可以被擊碎；它由厚玻璃製成，具有AC 13，27點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。相反，門過於堅固，除非使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法，否則無法強行開啟。

english: When the characters enter the car, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入車廂時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Two iron balconies protrude from the side walls of this train car. Iron stairwells connect these balconies to the lower level. Lining the walls on both levels are cell doors made of riveted iron, each one fitted with a large, gear-shaped keyhole. Pale light shines through paper-thin gaps around the doors, but not the keyholes.
zh_tw: 這節車廂的側壁上突出兩個鐵製陽臺。鐵製樓梯將這些陽臺連線到下層。兩層的牆壁上都排列著鉚接鐵製成的牢房門，每個門上都配有一個大型齒輪形狀的鑰匙孔。蒼白的光線透過門周圍的紙薄縫隙照射進來，但鑰匙孔處並沒有。

english: A stocky angel with cerulean skin and a pointed helmet leans against the railing on one balcony, a radiant flanged mace at its hip and its fiery wings folded behind it.
zh_tw: 一個身材魁梧的天使，皮膚呈天藍色，戴著尖頂頭盔，靠在其中一個陽臺的欄杆上，腰間掛著一把光輝的帶刺釘頭錘，它那火焰般的翅膀在背後摺疊著。

english: Omid the Deva
zh_tw: 奧米德天使

english: The angel guarding the Jail Car is Omid, a {@creature deva} with fiery instead of feathery wings. Omid has orders to deliver {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} safely to Mechanus, where judgment awaits.
zh_tw: 守衛監獄車廂的天使是奧米德，一個擁有火焰翅膀而非羽毛翅膀的{@creature deva||天神使徒}。奧米德接到命令，要安全地將{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}送達機械境，那裡等待著審判。

english: The deva's glowing mace is reminiscent of a large key. The head of the mace lines up neatly with the gear-shaped keyhole on each of the car's eight cell doors. As an action, a character can use the mace-key to unlock any one of these doors, which can be opened no other way.
zh_tw: 這位天使的發光釘頭錘讓人聯想到一把大鑰匙。釘頭錘的頭部整齊地對準了車廂八扇牢房門上的齒輪形狀的鑰匙孔。作為一個動作，角色可以使用這個釘頭錘鑰匙來開啟這些門中的任意一扇，這些門沒有其他方式可以開啟。

english: Omid remains in the Jail Car and can't be lured from it. When the deva encounters the characters, read the following:
zh_tw: 奧米德留在監獄車廂內，不能被誘離。當這位天神使徒遇到角色們時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The angel unfurls its wings, releasing a flurry of glowing embers, and says, "Speak your business, trespassers, and speak it truthfully."
zh_tw: 天使展開它的翅膀，釋放出一陣發光的火星，並說："說出你們的來意，入侵者們，並誠實地說出來。"

english: The characters need not resort to violence to obtain the deva's mace-key. Here are some alternate approaches:
zh_tw: 角色們不需要訴諸暴力來獲得天使的釘頭錘鑰匙。以下是一些替代方法：

english: Clever Deception
zh_tw: 巧妙欺騙

english: The characters can pose as emissaries of a jurisdiction with greater claim to {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}'s custody. Convincing Omid to release {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} requires a successful {@dc 17} group Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If the characters used a forgery kit to create documentation to support their claim, the group check is made with advantage.
zh_tw: 角色可以冒充一個對該司法管轄區有更大監護權的使節，以獲得{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}的監護權。說服奧米德釋放{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}需要成功透過一個{@dc 17}的團隊魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定。如果角色使用偽造工具建立了支援其主張的檔案，則團隊檢定將帶有優勢。

english: Convincing Argument
zh_tw: 說服性論證

english: Since Omid knows little about {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, a character can convince the deva that the outlaw has been wrongly accused and should be released. Making the argument might take a minute or two, after which the character must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to secure {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}'s release.
zh_tw: 由於奧米德對{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}知之甚少，角色可以說服迪瓦認為這名不法之徒被冤枉了並應該被釋放。提出這個論點可能需要一兩分鐘，之後角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 17}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定以確保{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}獲釋。

english: Friendly Game
zh_tw: 友好遊戲

english: A character who has a gaming set can challenge the deva to a friendly game. Omid loves games and is too proud (and bored) not to accept. If the character wins the game, Omid allows the party to speak with {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} (but not set them free). Determine the game's outcome by having the deva's challenger make a {@dc 19} Intelligence check. Proficiency with the gaming set allows the character to add their proficiency bonus to their roll. If the check is successful, the character wins. On a failed check, the character can opt to cheat in the late stages of the game and make a {@dc 19} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. A successful check overrides the earlier failure. If the character loses gracefully and didn't cheat, the deva (a gracious winner) still allows the party to speak with {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 一個擁有遊戲套件的角色可以向天使發起一場友好的遊戲挑戰。奧米德熱愛遊戲，並且太驕傲（也太無聊）而不會拒絕。如果角色贏得遊戲，奧米德允許隊伍與{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}交談（但不能釋放他們）。透過讓天使的挑戰者進行一次{@dc 19}智力檢定來決定遊戲的結果。擁有遊戲套件的熟練可以讓角色在擲骰時加上他們的熟練加值。如果檢定成功，角色贏得遊戲。如果檢定失敗，角色可以選擇在遊戲的後期階段作弊，並進行一次{@dc 19}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定。成功的檢定可以覆蓋之前的失敗。如果角色優雅地輸掉遊戲並且沒有作弊，天使（一個慷慨的贏家）仍然允許隊伍與{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}交談。

english: Cells
zh_tw: 牢房

english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV}
zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}

english: The door to each cell opens into a 10-foot-square extradimensional space brightly lit by magic. The cells and their contents are as follows:
zh_tw: 每個牢房的門通向一個10尺見方的超維度空間，由魔法明亮地照亮。牢房及其內容如下：

english: Cell 1
zh_tw: 牢房1

english: This cell contains a hostile {@creature nycaloth} known as Dardo (not its true name). If someone opens the door to its cell, Dardo tries to exit the cell on its next turn, attacking anyone who stands in its way. The nycaloth then tries to leave the train. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} (see below) happens to know Dardo's true name: a simple math equation. The characters can use this knowledge to keep the nycaloth from attacking them, or to force it to work for them.
zh_tw: 這個牢房裡有一個敵對的{@creature nycaloth||征伐羅斯魔}，被稱為達爾多（不是它真正的名字）。如果有人開啟它牢房的門，達爾多會嘗試在下一回合離開牢房，攻擊任何阻擋它的人。然後征伐羅斯魔會嘗試離開火車。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}（見下文）碰巧知道達爾多的真名：一個簡單的數學方程。角色們可以利用這個知識防止征伐羅斯魔攻擊他們，或者強迫它為他們工作。

english: Cell 2
zh_tw: 牢房2

english: This cell is empty.
zh_tw: 這個牢房是空的。

english: Cell 3
zh_tw: 牢房3

english: A bench against the far wall has a {@item +2 rod of the pact keeper} resting on it. The cell is otherwise empty.
zh_tw: 靠在遠牆上的長凳上放著一根{@item +2 rod of the pact keeper||+2 契約掌控者權杖}。牢房裡沒有其他東西。

english: Cell 4
zh_tw: 牢房4

english: This cell contains a friendly {@creature erinyes} who recently helped an efreeti named Vrakir get his hands on the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}. Speaking with this prisoner might kick off "{@adventure Fire and Darkness|KftGV|13}," another adventure in this book. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} (see below) doesn't know this erinyes's true name.
zh_tw: 這個牢房裡有一個友好的{@creature erinyes||罪魔}，他最近幫助一個名叫弗拉基爾的火巨靈得到了{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。與這個囚犯交談可能會啟動這本書中的另一個冒險——"{@adventure 火與黑暗|KftGV|13}"。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}（見下文）不知道這個罪魔的真實姓名。

english: Cell 5
zh_tw: 牢房5

english: This cell is empty.
zh_tw: 這個牢房是空的。

english: Cell 6
zh_tw: 牢房6

english: This cell is empty.
zh_tw: 這個牢房是空的。

english: Cell 7
zh_tw: 牢房7

english: A {@creature monodrone} janitor accidentally locked itself in this cell.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature monodrone||單元冢}清潔工不小心把自己鎖在了這個牢房裡。

english: Cell 8
zh_tw: 牢房8

english: This cell contains {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} (see below).
zh_tw: 這個牢房裡關著{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}（見下文）。

english: The Stranger
zh_tw: 陌生人

english: This individual looks like a human with a flat-brimmed leather hat and a tattered traveler's cloak. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV}'s face is permanently obscured behind a shifting blur like that of a deep desert haze. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} is chaotic neutral and uses the {@creature archmage} stat block, though they abhor combat. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} wears an invisible {@item ring of mind shielding} that thwarts magical attempts to read their thoughts. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} also wears {@item dimensional shackles} but is eager to be rid of them. One touch from Omid's mace-key causes the shackles to fall off, freeing {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 這個人看起來像一個戴著平簷皮帽和破舊旅行斗篷的人類。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}的面容永遠被一層像深沙漠中的霧氣一樣不斷變化的模糊遮擋。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}是混亂中立的，並且使用{@creature archmage||大法師}的屬性塊，儘管他們厭惡戰鬥。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}戴著一枚看不見的{@item ring of mind shielding||心靈護盾戒指}，這枚戒指阻止了魔法試圖讀取他們的思想的嘗試。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}還戴著{@item dimensional shackles||次元鐐銬}，但渴望擺脫它們。奧米德的釘頭錘鑰匙一觸即可使鐐銬脫落，釋放了{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}。

english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} is initially indifferent to the characters but becomes friendly if presented with the prospect of escape, at which point {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} replies in a gravelly voice:
zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}最初對角色們漠不關心，但如果有逃脫的機會，他會變得友好，此時{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}會用沙啞的聲音回答：

english: "Let me guess. You want a name. Maybe more than one. Got a pen?"
zh_tw: "讓我猜猜。你們想要一個名字。也許不止一個。有筆嗎？"

english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} promises to recite the true names the characters seek in exchange for freedom but warns them of the heavy toll such knowledge carries.
zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}承諾，作為換取自由的條件，他將背誦角色們尋求的真實姓名，但他警告他們，這樣的知識會帶來沉重的代價。

english: If the characters are after the true names of Karnyros, Errtok, and Hexalanthe, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} reveals the following once free of the {@item dimensional shackles} and outside the cell:
zh_tw: 如果角色們追求的是卡尼羅斯、埃爾托克和赫克莎蘭瑟的真實姓名，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}在擺脫了{@item dimensional shackles||次元鐐銬}並走出牢房後，會透露以下資訊：

english: Karnyros's true name is a series of guttural growls and grimaces, followed by a sound like a popping balloon.
zh_tw: 卡尼羅斯的真實姓名是一系列喉音咕噥和做鬼臉，之後是像氣球爆炸一樣的聲音。

english: Errtok's true name is Ar-lothe Gothu Ka.
zh_tw: 埃爾托克的真實姓名是 Ar-lothe Gothu Ka。

english: Hexalanthe's true name is a low-toned, rhythmic chant accompanied by a series of hand gestures, dance moves, and drumrolls.
zh_tw: 赫克莎蘭瑟的真實姓名是一種低沉、有節奏的吟唱，伴隨著一系列手勢、舞蹈動作和鼓點。

english: If the characters are after the true name of some other creature, perhaps a fiendish nemesis or tenuous planar ally, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} might know that creature's true name as well and can reveal it to the characters. Even if {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} doesn't know a particular true name, they can give characters the true names of one or more Fiends who have the power to help the characters in some other way.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在尋找另一個生物的真實姓名，也許是一個惡魔般的敵人或不穩定的位面盟友，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}可能也知道那個生物的真實姓名，並且可以將其透露給角色們。即使{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}不知道特定的真實姓名，他們也可以給角色們提供一或多個擁有能力以其他方式幫助角色們的惡魔的真實姓名。

english: If you have trouble coming up with ideas for new true names, roll on the {@area Random True Names table|44f|x} at the end of this adventure when you need one.
zh_tw: 如果您在想出新的真實姓名方面遇到困難，當您需要時，可以在這次冒險結束時的{@area 隨機真實姓名錶|44f|x}上進行擲骰。

english: E9: Engine Car
zh_tw: E9. 機車車廂

english: A massive furnace dominates the interior of this noisy car. Two spherical modrons shovel coins into the roaring fire while a brawny, nine-foot-tall automaton guards a treasure-filled fuel cart nearby. "Faster!" bellows a deep, disembodied voice.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的熔爐佔據了這節嘈雜車廂的內部。兩個球形的魔冢往熊熊烈火中鏟硬幣，而一個肌肉發達、九尺高的自動機械守衛著附近裝滿財寶的燃料車。"快點！"一個深沉的、無實體的聲音大聲喊道。

english: The sapient Engine Car is the source of the deep, booming voice. The car speaks Common and Modron. While it's moving and not talking, the Engine Car labors through an endless chain of short, forceful breaths timed with each rhythmic churn of its mechanisms. Its undercarriage chatters as dozens of mechanical arms lay railway tracks before the train.
zh_tw: 有感知能力的引擎車廂是深沉、迴盪聲音的來源。車廂會說通用語和魔冢語。當它在移動且不講話時，引擎車廂透過其機械運轉的節奏伴隨著一連串短暫而有力的呼吸。它的底盤發出咔嗒聲，因為幾十隻機械臂在列車前鋪設鐵路軌道。

english: Inside the car, two {@creature Monodrone||monodrones} stoke the fire in the furnace by shoveling loot into it from a nearby cart (see "{@area Treasure|44b|x}" below). A {@creature shield guardian} stands next to the cart, guarding the treasure from thieves. Thanks to its Spell Storing trait, the guardian can cast {@spell sleep} (4th-level version) once.
zh_tw: 在車廂內部，兩個{@creature Monodrone||單元冢}從附近的車上鏟來戰利品，投入熔爐中煽火（見下文的"{@area 寶藏|44b|x}"）。一個{@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}站在車旁，守護著財寶，防止小偷。由於它的法術儲存特性，這個守衛可以施放一次{@spell sleep||睡眠術}（4級版本）。

english: A monodrone shovels treasure into the locomotive's engine
zh_tw: 一個單元冢將財寶鏟入機車的引擎

english: Furnace
zh_tw: 火爐

english: Any object not being worn or carried that is placed inside the blazing furnace is incinerated instantly. Even magic items succumb to the blazing furnace, though the flames aren't powerful enough to harm artifacts.
zh_tw: 任何未被穿戴或攜帶而被放入熊熊燃燒的熔爐中的物品會立即被焚化。即使是魔法物品也會被熔爐所屈服，儘管火焰的強度不足以損壞神器。

english: If the furnace isn't replenished every hour with at least 100 gp worth of treasure, the Engine Car sputters and the train comes to a halt, causing a guard patrol (see "{@area Guard Patrols|41f|x}" earlier in the adventure) to investigate.
zh_tw: 如果熔爐每小時沒有至少100金幣價值的財寶補充，引擎車廂就會發出咔咔聲，列車也會停止前進，這將引起守衛巡邏隊（見冒險早期的"{@area 守衛巡邏|41f|x}"）前來調查。

english: A creature that enters the furnace for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and is reduced to a pile of ash.
zh_tw: 第一次進入熔爐的生物或在其內開始回合的生物會受到55點（{@dice 10d10}）火焰傷害。被此傷害降至0生命值的生物會死亡並化為一堆灰燼。

english: The furnace door can be latched from the outside. A creature trapped inside the furnace can use an action to try to force open the door, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 熔爐的門可以從外部閂上。被困在熔爐內的生物可以使用一個動作嘗試強行開啟門，成功進行一次 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可開啟。

zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Five {@item Amethyst||amethysts} (100 gp each)
zh_tw: 五枚{@item Amethyst||紫水晶}（每枚價值100金幣）

english: Gilded mind flayer skull (150 gp)
zh_tw: 鍍金靈吸怪頭骨（150金幣）

english: {@item Horn of Valhalla, Silver||Horn of Valhalla (silver)}
zh_tw: {@item Horn of Valhalla, Silver||瓦爾哈拉號角（銀色）}

english: Suit of {@item Mithral Chain Mail||mithral armor (chainmail)}
zh_tw: 一套{@item Mithral Chain Mail||秘銀護甲 (鍊甲)}

english: {@item Potion of Greater Healing||Potion of healing (greater)}
zh_tw: {@item Potion of Greater Healing||治療藥水（高等）}

english: Silvered {@item +3 greatsword} that once belonged to a githyanki knight
zh_tw: 一把曾經屬於吉斯洋基騎士的鍍銀{@item +3 greatsword||+3 巨劍}

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: After imparting the true names, the freed Stranger tips their hat and leaps from the train. Once out of range of the train's teleportation ward, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} casts {@spell plane shift} and disappears. The characters can leave the Concordant Express in a similar fashion, or they can remain on the train until it arrives in Mechanus and secure safe passage home from there. Whether or not they helped solve the murder in the Passenger Car ({@area area E7|43e|x}), characters who disembark in Mechanus see {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV}, the mind flayer detective, escorting the cambion Abernathy Vernus off the train and into the waiting arms of a group of modrons.
zh_tw: 在透露了真實姓名之後，被釋放的陌生人輕扶帽沿致意，從列車上跳下。一旦離開了列車的傳送防護範圍，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}施放了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術然後消失了。角色們可以以類似的方式離開協和快車，或者他們可以留在列車上，直到它抵達機械境，並從那裡獲得安全回家的通道。無論他們是否幫助解決了乘客車廂中的謀殺案（{@area 區域E7|43e|x}），在機械境下車的角色們會看到奪心魔偵探{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}，護送著坎比翁阿伯納西·維爾納斯下列車，進入一群魔冢的等待之中。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization sends the group's contact to retrieve the true names the day after the characters record them. This operative offers the characters a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment, which is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，該組織會在角色們記錄下真實姓名的第二天派聯絡人來取回這些姓名。這位特工提供給角色們一個他們選擇的稀有魔法物品（需經你同意）作為報酬，該物品將在第二天送達角色們手中。

english: Other Rewards
zh_tw: 其他獎勵

english: If the characters helped solve the murder mystery aboard the Concordant Express, the mind flayer detective {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV} uses its {@spell plane shift} spell to deliver a wrapped parcel to the characters several days later. The parcel contains a token of the illithid's esteem: a masterfully crafted magnifying glass worth 1,000 gp.
zh_tw: 如果角色們幫助解決了協和快車上的謀殺之謎，靈吸怪偵探{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}使用它的{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術在幾天後給角色們送去一個包裹。包裹裡包含著這個靈吸怪的尊敬象徵：一個精心製作的放大鏡，價值1000金幣。

english: Characters can also leverage any true names they learn into further rewards, as discussed below:
zh_tw: 角色們也可以利用他們學到的任何真實姓名來獲取進一步的獎勵，具體討論如下：

english: Home Ownership
zh_tw: 房屋所有權

english: Knowing a creature's true name may entitle the characters to that creature's property, such as a parcel of land, lair, or stronghold.
zh_tw: 知道一個生物的真實姓名可能使角色們有權擁有該生物的財產，例如一塊土地、巢穴或要塞。

english: Slayer's Weapon
zh_tw: 殺手的武器

english: A master smith might be able to work the true name of a creature into an {@item arrow of slaying} or other target-specific magic item.
zh_tw: 一個精通鍛造的鐵匠可能能夠將一個生物的真實姓名融入到一個{@item arrow of slaying||屠殺箭}或其他特定目標的魔法物品中。

english: Further Adventures
zh_tw: 更多冒險

english: The characters might have made a number of planar enemies during this heist. Subsequent adventures could include the following:

english: {@b STEAL}. The rival organization STEAL (see {@area area E7|43e|x}) might figure prominently in future adventures. At higher levels, run-ins with STEAL operatives or raids on STEAL vaults might place the characters in conflict with the syndicate's leaders, including arcanaloths and ultroloths with true names only {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} knows.
zh_tw: {@b STEAL}。競爭對手組織 STEAL（見 {@area 區域E7|43e|x}）可能在未來的冒險中扮演重要角色。在更高等級時，與 STEAL 特工的衝突或對 STEAL 金庫的襲擊可能會使角色與該集團的領導者發生衝突，包括只有 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 知道真實姓名的奧法羅斯魔和超等羅斯魔。

english: Trials and Tribulations

zh_tw: 角色們可能被迫在機械境的法庭前為幫助一個跨位面逃犯而辯護，或對一個強大的天界生物為殺死一個天使而作出解釋。

english: {@i An Adventure for 10th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合10級角色的冒險}

english: Every year during the winter solstice, {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV} holds a grand gala in Paliset Hall, her palatial retreat in the Feywild. The characters are hired to infiltrate the gala and steal Zorhanna's {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, a magical diamond with peculiar properties. As the evening unfolds, they learn that nothing is quite what it seems.
zh_tw: 每年冬至期間，{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}在她的妖精荒野宮殿式隱居地帕利塞特莊園舉行盛大的晚會。角色們被僱傭潛入晚會並偷走佐哈娜的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}，這是一顆具有奇特特性的魔法鑽石。隨著晚上的展開，他們發現事情並不像看起來那樣。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: Lady {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV} is an elf and a retired adventurer. On one of her many adventures, she stole a diamond {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} (a magic item described at the {@area end of the adventure|4bd|x}) from a trio of night hags known as the Crestfall Coven. Zorhanna later mounted the diamond into a glittering platinum necklace, which she often wears during special occasions. Trapped within the iridescent facets of the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} is an unstable extradimensional rift that gives the diamond its remarkable powers.
zh_tw: {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷} 是一位精靈，也是一位退休的冒險家。在她眾多的冒險中，她從一個被稱為失落女巫團的夜巫婆三人組那裡偷走了一個魔法物品——鑽石{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}（在冒險的{@area 冒險的結束|4bd|x}有描述）。佐哈娜後來將這顆鑽石鑲嵌在一個閃亮的白金項鍊上，她經常在特殊場合佩戴它。不穩定的跨維度裂縫被困在{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的彩虹切面中，賦予了鑽石其非凡的力量。

english: Every year during the winter solstice, Zorhanna and her husband, a werebear tinkerer named Eliphas, withdraw to their Feywild home of Paliset Hall to throw a lavish gala. Many guests from the Material Plane and the Feywild attend this pleasant gathering. This year, Zorhanna plans to show off her {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace once again, unaware that forces are conspiring to steal it from her.
zh_tw: 每年冬至期間，佐哈娜和她的丈夫，一位名叫伊萊法斯的熊人修補匠，都會退回到他們在妖精荒野的家帕利塞特莊園，舉辦一場奢華的盛會。來自物質界和妖精荒野的許多客人都會參加這個愉快的聚會。今年，佐哈娜計劃再次展示她的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊，卻不知有力量正在密謀從她那裡偷走它。

english: Far Realm Invader
zh_tw: 遙遠國度入侵者

english: Some time ago, a malevolent entity from the Far Realm found a way into the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} through the extradimensional rift contained inside it. Since then, this bodiless entity has been trapped in the stone—but it won't be for much longer. The entity's presence is weakening the stone, and when the diamond finally cracks, the effects could be catastrophic.
zh_tw: 不久前，一個來自遙遠國度的惡毒實體透過其中包含的跨維度裂縫找到了進入{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的方法。從那時起，這個無實體的實體一直被困在石頭裡——但這種情況不會持續太久。實體的存在正在削弱石頭，當鑽石最終破裂時，其影響可能是災難性的。

english: A few days ago, unaware of the danger, Zorhanna donned the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace to see how it looked with a new gown she planned to wear at the gala. Zorhanna's close contact with the necklace allowed the Far Realm entity to trap her inside the diamond. The entity then replaced Zorhanna with a simulacrum using one of the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV}'s magical properties. {@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV} now wanders Paliset Hall, preparing for the arrival of the gala's guests, while the real Zorhanna remains trapped inside the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 幾天前，在不知道危險的情況下，佐哈娜戴上了{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊，想看看它與她計劃在盛會上穿的新禮服搭配起來如何。佐哈娜與項鍊的密切接觸使遙遠國度實體能夠將她困在鑽石裡。然後，實體利用{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的魔法屬性之一，用一個模擬體替換了佐哈娜。{@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV|佐哈娜的擬像}現在在帕利塞特莊園徘徊，準備迎接盛會的客人，而真正的佐哈娜仍然被困在{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}裡。

english: Stealing the Shard Solitaire
zh_tw: 竊取鑽石孤鑽

english: The characters become embroiled in this story after Eliphas, suspicious of the simulacrum's behavior, sends a friendly satyr named Fifel to get help. Fifel gives the characters invitations to the gala and reads a letter from Eliphas, urging them to steal the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace from Zorhanna and take it far from Paliset Hall.
