zh_tw: 在伊萊法斯對仿製品的行為感到懷疑後，他派了一位名叫菲菲爾的友好半羊人去尋求幫助，角色們因此捲入了這個故事。菲菲爾給角色們遞上了晚會的邀請函，並宣讀了伊萊法斯的一封信，信中敦促他們從佐哈娜那裡偷走{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊，並將其遠離帕利塞特莊園。

english: An added complication occurs toward the end of the adventure, as the hags of the Crestfall Coven crash the gala and attempt to reclaim that which was stolen from them. The hags know nothing about the Far Realm entity or {@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV}, but they have their own clever plan to steal the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}—a plan the characters can turn to their advantage, if all else fails.
zh_tw: 冒險接近尾聲時，出現了額外的複雜情況，因為失落女巫團的女巫們闖入了盛會，試圖奪回被偷走的東西。女巫們對遙遠國度實體或{@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV|佐哈娜的擬像}一無所知，但她們有自己的巧妙計劃來竊取{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}——如果其他方法都失敗了，角色們可以利用這個計劃來為自己謀取優勢。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit. When the characters use this key to open the music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，一把金鑰匙將以您認為合適的方式送到角色們手中。當角色們使用這把鑰匙開啟音樂盒時，盒蓋彈開，一個悅耳的聲音說出了以下的話：

english: "Greetings, operatives. A magical diamond called a shard solitaire is known to contain an unstable extradimensional rift. Its owner, {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV}, is a retired adventurer. Her husband, Eliphas, used to work for the Golden Vault. He suspects that an evil force has somehow entered the stone and is using it to control Zorhanna. He has asked the Golden Vault to steal the stone from Paliset Hall, where he and Zorhanna host their annual gala celebrating the winter solstice.
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。一顆被稱為碎晶掛飾的魔法鑽石，被認為包含一個不穩定的超維度裂縫。它的主人，{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}，是一位退休的冒險家。她的丈夫伊萊法斯，曾為金庫工作。他懷疑某種邪惡力量以某種方式進入了這塊石頭，並正在利用它來控制佐哈娜。他已請求金庫從帕利塞特莊園偷走這塊石頭，他和佐哈娜在那裡舉辦一年一度的晚會，慶祝冬至。"

english: "This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to obtain the shard solitaire without harming Zorhanna, Eliphas, or their guests. You will be approached shortly by a messenger named Fifel, who has your invitations to the gala and directions to Paliset Hall, which is in the Feywild. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "這項任務，如果您選擇承擔，要求您在不傷害佐哈娜、伊萊法斯或他們的客人的情況下獲得鑽石孤鑽。不久將有一位名叫菲菲爾的使者接近您，他有您參加盛會的邀請函以及前往位於妖精荒野的帕利塞特莊園的指引。祝好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Meeting Fifel
zh_tw: 遇見菲菲爾

english: The adventure begins in earnest when the characters meet Fifel, a {@creature satyr} who works for {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV}. Where Fifel appears is up to you. You can use the following boxed text to describe what he looks like:
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到菲菲爾，一位為{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}工作的{@creature satyr||半羊人}時，冒險正式開始。菲菲爾出現的地方由你決定。你可以使用以下框定文字來描述他的外貌：

english: Fifel is a lanky satyr with dark curly hair pulled into a small bun and golden eyes alight with excitement. He wears a maroon tunic, over which are slung various belts and bulging leather pouches. Rolled tubes of parchment jut from his haversack, and his pockets jingle and clank as he walks. "Salutations!" he says with a clumsy salute.
zh_tw: 菲菲爾是一位身材瘦長的半羊人，他有著一頭捲曲的深色頭髮，紮成一個小發髻，金色的眼睛閃爍著興奮的光芒。他穿著一件深紅色的束腰外衣，上面掛著各種皮帶和鼓鼓囊囊的皮製小包。捲起的羊皮紙管從他的揹包裡伸出，他走路時口袋裡的硬幣和金屬發出叮噹聲。"向您致敬！"他笨拙地敬了個禮說道。

english: Fifel carries a {@item Heward's handy haversack}, in which he stores various documents. The satyr is a bit scatterbrained, but Eliphas trusts him to run errands and deliver important messages.
zh_tw: 菲菲爾攜帶一個{@item Heward's handy haversack||霍華德便利袋}，在其中他存放各種檔案。這個半羊人有點健忘，但伊萊法斯信任他去跑腿和傳遞重要資訊。

english: From his haversack, Fifel produces a handful of invitations and hands one to each character. Each invitation is contained in a pale-blue envelope that is cool to the touch and smells like a crisp winter morning. The invitations read as follows:
zh_tw: 菲菲爾從他的揹包裡拿出一把邀請函，然後遞給每個角色一份。每份邀請函都裝在一個觸感涼爽、散發著清新冬晨氣息的淡藍色信封裡。邀請函的內容如下：

english: Zorhanna and {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV} request the pleasure of your company at Paliset Hall to celebrate the arrival of the winter solstice. Come to Loch Wynnis no earlier than three days before the winter solstice, then take the crossing there to the Feywild at sundown. The many splendors of Paliset Hall await you on the other side! Formal attire is expected but not required.
zh_tw: 佐哈娜和{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}誠邀您光臨帕利塞特莊園，共慶冬至的到來。請在冬至前不早於三天到達溫尼斯湖，然後在日落時分從那裡穿越至妖精荒野。帕利塞特莊園的眾多輝煌景象在另一邊等待著您！我們期望您穿著正式，但不強制要求。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an invisible watermark on the back of each invitation, which is used to verify its authenticity.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了每張邀請函背面的隱形水印，用來驗證其真實性。

english: Once the invitations are distributed, Fifel uncorks a scroll tube with his teeth, then flips the tube upside-down and shakes it vigorously until a rolled-up sheet of parchment falls out. He picks up the parchment, unrolls it, and reads what's written on it in Common:
zh_tw: 分發完邀請函後，菲菲爾用牙齒拔出卷軸筒的塞子，然後將筒子倒過來，使勁搖晃直到一張捲起的羊皮紙掉落出來。他撿起羊皮紙，展開它，並用通用語讀出上面寫的內容：

english: "I, {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV}, have sent my esteemed messenger, Fifel Amberhoof, to lead you to the shores of Loch Wynnis, so that you may cross into the Feywild with great haste. The winter solstice is nearly upon us, and I fear evil forces are as well.
zh_tw: "我，{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}，已派遣我尊敬的使者菲菲爾·琥珀蹄引領你們前往溫尼斯湖岸，以便你們能迅速穿越至妖精荒野。冬至即將到來，我擔心邪惡勢力也即將到來。"

english: "My wife, the archmage Zorhanna, has not been herself of late. I believe something or someone is controlling her through a magic diamond, which she acquired many years ago on one of her adventures. Zorhanna had it fitted into a necklace, which she wears on special occasions. A few days ago, she removed the necklace from our vault and wore it during a dress fitting. Since then, she has been uncharacteristically cruel to the household staff. When I confronted her, she dismissed me out of hand, clutched the necklace, and uttered something in a dreadful language I've never heard her speak before. All her warmth is gone. When I look into her eyes, I see a cold and spiteful woman staring back at me.
zh_tw: "我的妻子，大法師佐哈娜，最近一直不太對勁。我相信有某種東西或某人透過一顆魔法鑽石控制了她，這顆鑽石是她多年前在一次冒險中獲得的。佐哈娜將它鑲嵌在一條項鍊上，只在特殊場合佩戴。幾天前，她從我們的金庫中取出項鍊，在試穿禮服時戴上了它。從那時起，她就對家中的工作人員異常殘忍。當我面對她時，她輕率地駁回了我，緊握著項鍊，用一種我從未聽過的可怕語言說了些什麼。她所有的溫暖都消失了。當我看著她的眼睛時，我看到的是一個冷酷而懷有惡意的女人在回望我。"

english: "I want you to steal the necklace, which Zorhanna now refuses to remove. I can't safely do it myself. Fifel will give you invitations to our winter solstice gala at Paliset Hall. There will be other guests to distract Zorhanna while you figure out a way to remove the necklace.
zh_tw: "我想要你們偷走項鍊，佐哈娜現在拒絕摘下它。我自己無法安全地去做。菲菲爾會給你們我們的冬至盛會在帕利塞特莊園的邀請函。當你們想辦法摘下項鍊時，會有其他客人分散佐哈娜的注意力。"

english: "Once we're rid of the necklace, Fifel will deliver your reward."
zh_tw: "一旦我們擺脫了那條項鍊，菲菲爾將交付你的獎勵。"

english: Fifel can tell the characters that Eliphas is offering the following items as payment for their help:
zh_tw: 菲菲爾可以告訴角色們，伊萊法斯提供以下物品作為幫助他們的報酬：

english: {@item Bag of Tricks, Rust||Rust-colored bag of tricks}
zh_tw: {@item Bag of Tricks, Rust||鏽色魔法袋}

english: {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||Figurine of wondrous power (serpentine owl)}
zh_tw: {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||異能塑像，蛇紋石鴞}

english: {@item Gauntlets of ogre power} or {@item quiver of Ehlonna} (characters' choice)
zh_tw: {@item Gauntlets of ogre power||食人魔力量護手}或{@item quiver of Ehlonna||艾羅娜的箭袋}（角色選擇）

english: These magic items are on display in Paliset Hall's art gallery ({@area area P6|486|x}).
zh_tw: 這些魔法物品在帕利塞特莊園的藝術畫廊（{@area 區域P6|486|x}）展出。

english: If the characters accept the terms and agree to steal the necklace, Fifel leads them to Loch Wynnis, a lakeside hamlet with a fey crossing that serves as a gateway between the Material Plane and the Feywild (see the "{@area Loch Wynnis|45f|x}" section for details). Fifel explains that the fey crossing works only seven days of the year: three days before the winter solstice, the day of the winter solstice, and three days after the winter solstice.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了條件並同意偷走項鍊，菲菲爾會帶領他們前往溫尼斯湖，這是一個湖畔的小村莊，擁有一個精類穿越點，作為物質位面和妖精荒野之間的門戶（詳情見"{@area 溫尼斯湖|45f|x}"部分）。菲菲爾解釋說，精類穿越點一年中只有七天有效：冬至前的三天，冬至當天，以及冬至後的三天。

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: As they travel to Loch Wynnis in the company of Fifel, the characters can ask the satyr for information about the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, the Adulares, the winter solstice gala, and Paliset Hall.
zh_tw: 當角色們與菲菲爾一同前往溫尼斯湖時，他們可以向這位半羊人詢問有關{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}、阿杜拉雷家族、冬至盛會以及帕利塞特莊園的資訊。

english: Shard Solitaire Lore
zh_tw: 碎晶掛飾傳說

english: Fifel knows the following information about the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}:
zh_tw: 菲菲爾知道關於{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的以下資訊：

english: Origin Story
zh_tw: 起源故事

english: Fifel thinks the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} formed when someone dropped a {@item Heward's handy haversack} full of jewels into a {@item bag of holding}, creating an explosive portal to the Astral Plane. One of the jewels absorbed some of the portal's volatile energy to become the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. (See "{@area Secrets of the Shard Solitaire|4bd|x}" at the end of the adventure for what really happened.)
zh_tw: 菲菲爾認為{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的形成是因為有人將裝滿寶石的{@item Heward's handy haversack||霍華德便利袋}掉入了{@item bag of holding||次元袋}中，從而創造了一個通往星界平面的爆炸性傳送門。其中一顆寶石吸收了傳送門的一些不穩定能量，變成了{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。（關於真正發生了什麼，請在冒險結束時檢視"{@area 碎片獨奏的秘密|4bd|x}"部分。）

english: Previous Owners
zh_tw: 前所有者

english: When she was an adventurer many years ago, Zorhanna stole the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} from a trio of night hags known as the Crestfall Coven. She never encountered the hags again, to the best of Fifel's knowledge.
zh_tw: 多年前，當她還是一名冒險家時，佐哈娜從一個被稱為失落女巫團的三個夜巫婆那裡偷走了{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。據菲菲爾所知，她再也沒有遇到過這些巫婆。

english: Safeguard
zh_tw: 佑護

english: Zorhanna paid a master jeweler to craft a platinum necklace and attach the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} to it. If it is removed from Zorhanna's neck, the necklace automatically teleports to a secret vault in Paliset Hall. The vault is located somewhere in Zorhanna's bedchamber on the second floor. (Fifel is wrong about the vault's location.) The necklace doesn't teleport if it's removed from the vault, so stealing it requires that it be taken from that location.
zh_tw: 佐哈娜聘請了一位珠寶大師打造了一條鉑金項鍊，並將{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}鑲嵌在上面。如果它從佐哈娜的脖子上移除，項鍊會自動傳送到帕利塞特莊園的一個秘密金庫中。據菲菲爾所知，金庫位於佐哈娜二樓臥室的某個地方。（菲菲爾關於金庫位置的說法是錯誤的。）如果項鍊從金庫中移除，它不會自動傳送，所以偷取它需要從那個地點拿走。

english: The Adulares
zh_tw: 阿杜拉雷家族

english: Fifel knows the following information about Zorhanna and {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV}:
zh_tw: 菲菲爾知道以下有關佐哈娜和{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}的資訊：

english: Zorhanna's Past
zh_tw: 佐哈娜的過去

english: Zorhanna had a long and successful adventuring career before she settled down and married Eliphas. During one of Zorhanna's adventures, she befriended an archfey who, years later, built Paliset Hall and bequeathed it to Zorhanna. Rumor has it the archfey was the Prince of Frost.
zh_tw: 佐哈娜在安定下來並嫁給伊萊法斯之前，有著漫長而成功的冒險生涯。在佐哈娜的一次冒險中，她與一位大精類結成了朋友，多年後，這位大精類建造了帕利塞特莊園並將其遺贈給了佐哈娜。有傳言說這位大精類是霜凍王子。

english: Eliphas's Past
zh_tw: 伊萊法斯的過去

english: Eliphas is a gentleman and a tinkerer. (Fifel doesn't reveal that Eliphas is a werebear.) For years, he offered his services to the Golden Vault, an organization dedicated to preserving historical relics and keeping powerful items out of evil hands. Eliphas designed the magical music boxes that the Golden Vault uses to communicate with its field operatives.
zh_tw: 伊萊法斯是一位紳士，也是一位修補匠。（菲菲爾沒有透露伊萊法斯是一隻熊人。）多年來，他為金庫提供服務，這是一個致力於保護歷史遺蹟，並將強大物品從邪惡之手保護起來的組織。伊萊法斯設計了金庫用來與其現場特工溝通的魔法音樂盒。

english: Winter Solstice Gala
zh_tw: 冬至盛會

english: Fifel knows the following information about the winter solstice gala hosted by Zorhanna and Eliphas:
zh_tw: 菲菲爾知道由佐哈娜和伊萊法斯主辦的冬至晚會的以下資訊：

english: Guests
zh_tw: 客人

english: The Adulares have invited guests from the Feywild and the Material Plane. Feywild guests don't need to use the fey crossing in Loch Wynnis; instead, coaches pulled by unicorns will deliver them to the palace.
zh_tw: 阿杜拉雷家族邀請了來自妖精荒野和物質位面的客人。妖精荒野的客人不需要使用溫尼斯湖的精類穿越點；相反，由獨角獸拉動的馬車會將他們送到宮殿。

english: Weapons and Armor
zh_tw: 武器和護甲

english: Guests may bring weapons and wear armor as fashion accessories.
zh_tw: 賓客們可以攜帶武器並穿戴盔甲作為時尚配飾。

english: Map of Paliset Hall
zh_tw: 帕利塞特莊園地圖

english: If the characters ask him questions about the layout of Paliset Hall, Fifel sketches a rough map of the manor and gives it to them (see map 12.1).
zh_tw: 如果角色們向他詢問帕利塞特莊園的佈局，菲菲爾會草繪出莊園的大致地圖並交給他們（見地圖12.1）。

english: Map 12.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 12.1：玩家地圖

english: Loch Wynnis
zh_tw: 溫尼斯湖

english: Loch Wynnis is the name of both a deep lake and the hamlet next to it. The adventure assumes the characters arrive at Loch Wynnis shortly before sundown on the day of the winter solstice—just in time to attend the gala at Paliset Hall.
zh_tw: 溫尼斯湖是一個深湖的名字，也是旁邊小村莊的名字。冒險設定角色們在冬至日的日落前不久到達溫尼斯湖——剛好趕上參加帕利塞特莊園的盛會。

english: Nestled in the highlands is a quaint hamlet, its cottages and shops idyllically situated between a thick, snow-dusted evergreen forest and a dark lake with icy shores. A wharf stands where the village meets the water.
zh_tw: 坐落在高地上的是一個迷人的小村莊，它的小屋和商店被理想地安置在一片厚厚的、覆蓋著雪的常綠森林和一個有著冰冷岸邊的黑暗湖泊之間。碼頭位於村莊與水相接的地方。

english: For most of the year, the hamlet of Loch Wynnis has shuttered storefronts, too many empty tavern tables, and fewer than two dozen permanent residents. As midwinter approaches, the town's population balloons with seasonal merchants and visitors eager to glimpse Loch Wynnis's magical marvel: the opening of the fey crossing in the lake. The crossing opens briefly at sundown the day of the winter solstice, the three days before, and the three days after it.
zh_tw: 一年中的大部分時間，洛克·溫尼斯的村莊都門窗緊閉，空蕩蕩的酒館桌子太多，常住居民不到兩打。隨著冬至的臨近，這個小鎮的人口隨著季節性商人和渴望一睹洛克·溫尼斯神奇奇觀的遊客而激增：湖中的精類通道的開啟。通道在冬至那天的日落時分短暫開啟，以及之前的三天和之後的三天。

english: People of Loch Wynnis
zh_tw: 溫尼斯湖的居民

english: Residents of Loch Wynnis know of the winter solstice festivities that occur at Paliset Hall in the Feywild, even though few of these residents are invited to participate. Most are content to stay on the Material Plane side of the fey crossing, selling goods and services to passing tourists. The Adulares and their servants are known to the villagers, all of whom Fifel knows by name. Fifel encourages the characters to briefly tour the hamlet before heading to the lake by sundown.
zh_tw: 溫尼斯湖的居民知道在妖精荒野的帕利塞特莊園舉行的冬至慶典，儘管這些居民中很少有人被邀請參加。大多數人滿足於留在精類穿越點的物質位面一側，向過往的遊客出售商品和服務。村民們都知道阿杜拉雷家族及其僕人，菲菲爾能叫出每個人的名字。菲菲爾鼓勵角色們在日落前前往湖邊之前，先簡短地遊覽一下這個小村莊。

english: Other Gala Attendees
zh_tw: 其他盛會參與者

english: As the characters pass through the village, they may encounter other gala invitees waiting anxiously for the fey crossing to appear at sundown. You can use the Gala Guests table to generate random NPCs for the characters to meet. These NPCs don't wear armor or carry weapons, but every gala attendee has an invitation like the ones Fifel gave to the adventurers.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過村莊時，他們可能會遇到其他焦急等待精類通道在日落時分出現的晚會嘉賓。您可以使用晚會嘉賓表格為角色們生成隨機NPC進行互動。這些NPC不穿戴盔甲或攜帶武器，但每位晚會參與者都有一份像菲菲爾給冒險家們的那樣的邀請函。

english: Gala Guests
zh_tw: 盛會嘉賓

english: d8
zh_tw: d8

english: Guest
zh_tw: 客人

english: Kaden Lannis is a lonely human {@creature noble} in his twenties. He hopes to find true love in the Feywild.
zh_tw: 卡登·蘭尼斯是一位孤獨的{@creature noble||貴族}，二十多歲。他希望在妖精荒野中找到真愛。

english: Verano Honeywell is a halfling {@creature spy} employed by a big-city broadsheet to attend the gala and write a story about the goings-on in Paliset Hall.
zh_tw: 維拉諾·蜜井是一位受僱於大城市報紙的半身人{@creature spy||間諜}，他參加盛會並撰寫有關帕利塞特莊園發生的事情的故事。

english: Lycoris, a {@creature dryad}, was Paliset Hall's head of staff until she retired six years ago. She comes to the gala every year to see her old friends, and she knows Paliset Hall's features and staff supremely well.
zh_tw: 萊克瑞絲，一位{@creature dryad||樹精}，曾是帕利塞特莊園的首席管理員，直到六年前她退休。她每年都會來參加晚會看望她的老朋友們，並且她對帕利塞特莊園的佈局和員工瞭如指掌。

english: Berengar is a {@creature werebear} and {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV}'s longtime friend. Eliphas is the only other person at the gala who knows Berengar is a werebear. Berengar likewise knows that Eliphas is a werebear.
zh_tw: 貝倫加爾是一隻{@creature werebear||熊人}，也是{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}的多年好友。伊萊法斯是宴會上唯一知道貝倫加爾是熊人的人。貝倫加爾同樣也知道伊萊法斯是熊人。

english: Nix, a gnome {@creature mage}, was Zorhanna's apprentice for several years. Nix has agreed to look after Paliset Hall once the gala ends and the Adulares return to the Material Plane. Nix plans to stay until the next winter solstice.
zh_tw: 尼克斯，一位侏儒{@creature mage||魔法師}，曾是佐哈娜的學徒多年。尼克斯已同意在盛會結束後以及阿杜拉雷家族返回物質界時照看帕利塞特莊園。尼克斯計劃一直待到下一個冬至。

english: Eggsy, a gnome {@creature bandit}, plans to pick some pockets at the gala. He attends under a false name ("Dworp Q. Guzzler, Esq., Gnome Adventurer") and has altered his appearance using a disguise kit. His disguise includes a curly wig, a more pronounced chin, copper-wired spectacles, and a fake beard. His invitation is a well-crafted forgery, including a fake invisible watermark on the back. Exposing it as a forgery requires a successful {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 艾格西，一個地精 {@creature bandit||匪徒}，計劃在晚宴上扒竊。他以假名（"德沃普·Q·古茲勒，地精冒險家"）出席，並使用偽裝工具改變了外貌。他的偽裝包括一個捲曲的假髮、一個更突出的下巴、銅線眼鏡和一個假鬍子。他的邀請函是一個精心製作的偽造品，背面還包括一個假的隱形水印。要揭露它是一個偽造品，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘} 或 {@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。

english: Yalara is an elf {@creature commoner} and singer whose music troupe was invited to perform at the gala. The other two members of her troupe were unable to make it to Loch Wynnis in time.
zh_tw: 雅拉拉是一位精靈{@creature commoner||平民}兼歌手，她的樂團受邀在盛會上演出。她的樂團中其他兩名成員未能及時趕到洛赫溫尼斯。

english: Mettle, an unarmed tiefling {@creature scout} with horn-rimmed spectacles, pretends to be a noble named Adira and secretly works for the hags of the Crestfall Coven (see "{@area The Crestfall Coven|4b4|x}" later in the adventure). Upon arriving in the Feywild, Mettle slips a copper ring onto the third finger of her left hand. Affixed to the ring is a hag eye, a varnished eyeball that enables the hags to see what's happening at the gala (see the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for details about this item).
zh_tw: 梅特爾，一個戴著角框眼鏡的非武裝提夫林{@creature scout||斥侯}，假裝是一位名叫阿迪拉的貴族，並秘密為克雷斯特福爾集會的老妖婆們工作（見冒險後文的"{@area 失落女巫團|4b4|x}"）。到達妖精荒野後，梅特爾將一個銅戒戴在左手的第三根手指上。戒指上附有一個老妖婆之眼，這是一個塗漆的眼球，使老妖婆們能夠看到宴會上發生的事情（有關此物品的詳細資訊，請參見{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的"老妖婆集會"側欄）。

english: Locations in Loch Wynnis
zh_tw: 溫尼斯湖的地點

english: The following locations are points of interest for characters who explore the hamlet of Loch Wynnis.
zh_tw: 以下地點是探索洛克·溫尼斯村莊的角色們感興趣的點。

english: Auberge Aurore
zh_tw: 晨曦客棧

english: {@i Tavern and Inn}
zh_tw: {@i 酒館和客棧}

english: Wintertime visitors who don't have friends or family in the village stay in the Auberge Aurore while awaiting the solstice. When the characters arrive, the three-towered inn has two rooms available, each containing two beds. A bed costs 2 gp per night; a hot supper costs 1 sp.
zh_tw: 沒有在村莊裡的朋友或家人的冬季訪客在冬至期間住在晨曦客棧。當角色們到達時，這家有三座塔的旅館還有兩個房間可用，每個房間包含兩張床。一張床每晚2金幣；一頓熱晚餐1銀幣。

english: The Auberge Aurore is owned and operated by Rei Paceran (neutral, elf {@creature veteran}), who is also the village's sheriff. Stern and unflappable, Rei has no patience for any misconduct under her watch. Rei is wary of the Feywild and has no interest in going there.
zh_tw: 晨曦客棧旅館由蕾·帕瑟蘭（中立，精靈{@creature veteran||老兵}）擁有並經營，她也是該村的警長。蕾嚴肅且不易動搖，對於她管轄範圍內的任何不當行為都沒有耐心。蕾對妖精荒野保持警惕，並且對去那裡沒有興趣。

english: Khorr's Kloths
zh_tw: 科爾的衣物店

english: {@i Tailor and Dress Shop}
zh_tw: {@i 裁縫和服裝店}

english: This small but vibrant fashion boutique is run by Khorr, a chaotic good {@creature bugbear}. Born from Khorr's frustration at being unable to find clothes that fit his frame, Khorr's shop has since gained a reputation as a source of untraditional and striking outfits for Humanoids of all shapes and statures.
zh_tw: 這家小巧而充滿活力的時裝精品店由一位混亂善良的{@creature bugbear||熊地精}科爾經營。源於科爾無法找到適合自己體型衣服的挫敗感，科爾的商店逐漸贏得了為各種形狀和身材的類人生物提供非傳統且引人注目服裝的聲譽。

english: If the characters need outfits for the gala, Khorr is happy to oblige. An exquisite ensemble from Khorr costs 20 gp. Individuals can also come to the bugbear for tailoring services, which cost 5 gp.
zh_tw: 如果角色們需要盛會的服裝，科爾很樂意提供幫助。一套來自科爾的精美服裝花費20金幣。個人也可以找這個食人魔進行裁縫服務，費用為5金幣。

english: Loch Wynnis Docks
zh_tw: 洛克·溫尼斯碼頭

english: {@i Wharf}
zh_tw: {@i 碼頭}

english: A few rowboats are tethered to these wooden docks. Visitors and residents who like to fish are free to use them. A thin layer of ice has formed around the boats, but the ice breaks apart easily.
zh_tw: 一些划艇被系在這些木製碼頭上。喜歡釣魚的遊客和居民可以自由使用它們。船周圍形成了一層薄冰，但冰很容易破碎。

english: Most of the docks are 10 feet long, but one particularly old and creaky dock is 50 feet long. This dock extends into the lake and allows easy access to Loch Wynnis's fey crossing (see "{@area Sundown Crossing|469|x}" below).
zh_tw: 大多數碼頭長度為10尺，但有一個特別古老且吱吱作響的碼頭長達50尺。這個碼頭延伸到湖中，便於接近洛克·溫尼斯的精類通道（見下文"日落通道"區域{@area 日落十字路口|469|x}）。

english: Fifel Takes His Leave
zh_tw: 菲菲爾告別

english: Eliphas gave Fifel strict orders not to return to Paliset Hall (for the satyr's safety) until the matter concerning the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace is resolved. When the characters are ready to head to the lake, Fifel says the following:
zh_tw: 伊萊法斯給菲菲爾下達了嚴格的命令，在關於{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊的問題解決之前，不得返回帕利塞特莊園（為了半羊人的安全）。當角色們準備前往湖邊時，菲菲爾說了以下的話：

english: "My friends, here is where I take my leave. By my good lord's orders, I shall remain at the Auberge Aurore and await your return."
zh_tw: "我的朋友們，這裡就是我告別的地方。根據我好主人的命令，我將留在晨曦客棧並等待你們的歸來。"

english: Fifel gives the characters a quick salute before skipping toward the tavern.
zh_tw: 菲菲爾向角色們快速敬了個禮，然後蹦蹦跳跳地朝酒館走去。

english: Sundown Crossing
zh_tw: 日落十字路口

english: Gala guests assemble at the docks shortly before sundown. As the sun sets, read or paraphrase the following text:
zh_tw: 晚會的嘉賓們在日落前不久聚集在碼頭。當太陽落山時，請閱讀或轉述以下文字：

english: When the last sliver of sun dips below the horizon, a silver glow emanates from deep within the water, and distant music and laughter drift through the air.
zh_tw: 當最後一縷陽光沉入地平線之下，一道銀光從水下深處發出，遠處的音樂和笑聲隨風飄蕩。

english: Two wolves as big as horses materialize out of thin air at the end of the dock. They have snow-white fur and eyes as cold and blue as glacial ice. As they walk slowly down the dock, one of them says in Common, "Honored guests, the lady and lord of Paliset Hall eagerly await your presence. Once your invitation has been validated, please walk to the end of the dock and jump in the water."
zh_tw: 兩隻像馬一樣大的狼從空氣中突然出現在碼頭的盡頭。它們有著雪白的皮毛和像冰川冰一樣冷冽的藍色眼睛。當它們慢慢沿著碼頭走來時，其中一隻用通用語說道："尊敬的客人，帕利塞特莊園的女士和領主熱切期待你們的到來。一旦你們的邀請函得到驗證，請走到碼頭盡頭跳入水中。"

english: The other wolf reassures any first-time guests, "While Loch Wynnis's gateway is open, you will find the water neither cold nor wet."
zh_tw: 另一隻狼向首次來訪的客人保證說："當洛克·溫尼斯的門戶開放時，你會發現水既不冷也不溼。"

english: The two {@creature Winter Wolf||winter wolves} inspect every guest's invitation but are fooled by well-crafted forgeries. Each wolf can cast {@spell see invisibility} on itself once per day, enabling it to see the invisible watermarks on the guests' invitations as well as to detect {@condition invisible} party-crashers.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Winter Wolf||冬狼}檢查每位客人的邀請函，但卻被精心製作的偽造品所欺騙。每隻狼每天可以對自己施放一次{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術，使它能夠看到客人邀請函上的隱形水印，並且能夠探測{@condition invisible||隱形}不請自來的闖入者。

english: The wolves attack anyone caught trying to enter the Feywild without a validated invitation. When the last guest has crossed, the wolves return to Paliset Hall. If one or both wolves are killed, their failure to return is noticed by four more winter wolves on the Feywild side of the crossing (see {@area area P1|473|x}). These wolves recheck all invitations and attack anyone whose invitation fails a second inspection.
zh_tw: 狼群會攻擊任何試圖在沒有經過驗證的邀請函的情況下進入妖精荒野的人員。當最後一位客人透過後，狼群返回帕利塞特莊園。如果一隻或兩隻狼被殺，它們未能返回會被妖精荒野通道另一側的四隻更多冬狼注意到（見{@area 區域P1|473|x}）。這些狼將重新檢查所有邀請函，並攻擊那些邀請函在第二次檢查中失敗的任何人。

english: Using the Fey Crossing
zh_tw: 使用精類穿越點

english: Anyone who steps off the end of the dock and into the lake while the fey crossing is open appears in the courtyard of Paliset Hall ({@area area P1|473|x}), on their feet and completely dry. The fey crossing closes 10 minutes after sundown, although it can be reopened from the other side as described in area P1.
zh_tw: 任何人在精類穿越點開啟時，從碼頭盡頭踏入湖中，將出現在帕利塞特莊園的庭院中（{@area 區域P1|473|x}），雙腳站立並且完全乾燥。精類穿越點在日落後10分鐘關閉，儘管如P1區域中所述，它可以從另一側重新開啟。

english: Paliset Hall
zh_tw: 帕利塞特莊園

english: Paliset Hall is the winter palace of Zorhanna and {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV}. It is situated in a peaceful meadow between snow-covered mountains and a mist-shrouded forest of evergreen trees. Winter's cool touch greets new arrivals, but there's no harsh wind.
zh_tw: 帕里斯大廳是佐哈娜和{@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯·阿杜拉雷}的冬季宮殿。它坐落在一處寧靜的草地上，四周被白雪覆蓋的山脈和常青樹林籠罩在迷霧中。冬天的涼意迎接新來者，但沒有刺骨的寒風。

english: Attempts by the Far Realm entity to escape from the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} have caused extraplanar energy to leak into Paliset Hall. This wayward energy has settled in the basement and is causing architectural anomalies to manifest briefly throughout the manor (see "General Features" below).
zh_tw: 來自遙遠國度實體試圖從{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}逃脫的嘗試，導致跨維度能量洩漏到帕利塞特莊園。這些離散的能量在地下室積聚，並在莊園內短暫地引發建築異常現象（見下方的"一般特徵"）。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: Paliset Hall has the following features throughout:
zh_tw: 帕利塞特莊園在整個建築中有以下特點：

english: Architectural Anomalies
zh_tw: 建築異常

english: Unstable energy leaking from the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} is affecting Paliset Hall, causing areas to warp in appearance momentarily. Whenever one or more characters enter a new area of the manor, roll a {@dice d6}. If you roll an odd number, the characters notice iridescent cracks crawling up the walls, followed by a sudden shift in the architecture: a square window becomes circular, a wood panel turns to stone, and the like. Immediately after, the cracks vanish, and the architecture returns to normal.
zh_tw: 從{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}洩漏的不穩定能量正在影響帕利塞特莊園，導致區域的外觀短暫扭曲。每當一個或多個角色進入莊園的新區域時，擲一個{@dice d6}。如果你擲出一個奇數，角色們會注意到彩虹色的裂縫在牆上爬行，接著是建築結構的突然變化：一個方形窗戶變成了圓形，一個木製鑲板變成了石頭，等等。裂縫隨後立即消失，建築結構恢復正常。

english: Ceilings and Walls
zh_tw: 天花板和牆壁

english: The ceilings and walls of the manor are 20 feet high and carved from alabaster stone that's cold to the touch.
zh_tw: 莊園的天花板和牆壁高20尺，由觸控時感覺冷的雪花石膏雕刻而成。

english: Decorations
zh_tw: 裝飾

english: Wintery decorations festoon many areas of the palace. Crystal snowflakes hang in the windows, illusory icicles dangle from the ceiling, frost fractals spreads across walls, and magically preserved ice sculptures perch atop similarly preserved ice pedestals. Some of the ice sculptures are, in fact, ice mephits assigned to guard an area (as noted in the area's description).
zh_tw: 宮殿的許多區域都裝飾著冬日的裝飾。水晶雪花掛在窗戶上，虛幻的冰柱從天花板垂下，霜凍的分形圖案在牆上蔓延，魔法儲存的冰雕坐落在同樣儲存的冰基座上。實際上，一些冰雕是被指派守護某個區域的冰魔（如區域描述中所註明）。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Unless otherwise stated, the doors of the manor are open and unlocked.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，莊園的門都是敞開且未上鎖的。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: The rooms of the manor are brightly lit with {@spell continual flame} spells spaced evenly along the walls.
zh_tw: 莊園的房間被沿牆壁均勻分佈的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術明亮地照亮。

english: Music
zh_tw: 音樂

english: Illusion magic creates jaunty music in the ballroom that can be heard throughout most of the palace—everywhere except the basement.
zh_tw: 幻術魔法在舞廳中創造出歡快的音樂，這種音樂幾乎在宮殿的每個地方都能聽到——除了地下室。

english: Zorhanna Adulare
zh_tw: 佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷

english: The real Zorhanna is trapped inside the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, where she is under attack by the Far Realm entity trapped in there with her. Using the power of the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, the Far Realm entity has created a simulacrum of Zorhanna.
zh_tw: 真正的佐哈娜被困在{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}中，她正受到與她一同被困在那裡的來自遙遠國度的實體的攻擊。利用{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的力量，來自遙遠國度的實體創造了一個佐哈娜的仿製品。

english: Zorhanna's Simulacrum
zh_tw: 佐哈娜的擬像

english: {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV}'s simulacrum appears identical to Zorhanna: a tall elf with purple skin and long, pale hair. The simulacrum wears a silvery gown embroidered with crystalline ferns and carnelian holly berries. It proudly shows off the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} it's wearing to guests. Any character who observes the simulacrum for 1 minute can discern its cold indifference with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.
zh_tw: {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}的幻象與佐哈娜本人一模一樣：一個身材高挑的精靈，皮膚呈紫色，長髮蒼白。幻象穿著一件銀色長袍，上面繡著水晶蕨類和瑪瑙冬青果。它自豪地向客人展示佩戴的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。任何觀察幻象1分鐘的角色，透過成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定，可以察覺到它的冷漠與漠不關心。

english: Abilities such as {@sense truesight} and magic that detects illusions reveal the true nature of the simulacrum: an elf made entirely of magical snow.
zh_tw: 諸如{@sense truesight||真實視覺}這樣的能力以及檢測幻象的魔法揭示了模擬體的真實本質：一個完全由魔法雪構成的精靈。

english: The {@creature Zorhanna's Simulacrum|KftGV|simulacrum} uses the {@creature archmage} stat block, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Zorhanna's Simulacrum|KftGV|擬像術}使用{@creature archmage||大法師}的統計資料塊，並有以下變化：

english: The simulacrum is a neutral evil Construct.
zh_tw: 這個幻象是一箇中立邪惡的構造物。

english: It speaks Common, Draconic, Elvish, Gnomish, or Sylvan while pretending to be Zorhanna, or Deep Speech when it is angry or frustrated.
zh_tw: 當它假裝成佐哈娜時，它會說通用語、龍語、精靈語、侏儒語或森林語；當它生氣或沮喪時，則會說深潛語。

english: It can't regain expended spell slots or use the properties of the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace. (The {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} is currently attuned to the Far Realm entity trapped inside.)
zh_tw: 它無法恢復已使用的法術位，也不能使用{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊的特性。（目前{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}已與困在其中的遙遠國度實體同步。）

english: If the simulacrum drops to 0 hit points, it turns to snow and melts away, and the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace teleports to the safe in Zorhanna's vault tower ({@area area P12|498|x}).
zh_tw: 如果仿製品降至0點生命值，它會化為雪並融化消失，而{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}會傳送到佐哈娜金庫塔的安全箱中（{@area 區域P12|498|x}）。

english: Simulacrum's Location
zh_tw: 模擬體的位置

english: To determine the location of {@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV} when the characters first arrive at Paliset Hall, or anytime the characters lose track of it and need to find it, roll a {@dice d4} and consult the Simulacrum's Location table, or choose an option you like.
zh_tw: 要確定當角色們第一次到達帕利塞特莊園時{@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV|佐哈娜的擬像}的位置，或者任何時候角色們失去了它的蹤跡並且需要找到它，擲一個{@dice d4}並查閱仿製品的位置表，或者選擇一個你喜歡的選項。

english: Simulacrum's Location
zh_tw: 模擬體的位置

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Location
zh_tw: 位置

english: Dancing in the ballroom ({@area area P4|47f|x})
zh_tw: 在舞廳（{@area 區域P4|47f|x}）跳舞

english: Relaxing in the parlor ({@area area P5|483|x})
zh_tw: 在客廳休息（{@area 區域P5|483|x}）

english: Mingling in the banquet hall ({@area area P7|48a|x})
zh_tw: 在宴會廳中交際（{@area 區域P7|48a|x}）

english: Observing from the balcony ({@area area P9|490|x})
zh_tw: 從陽臺上觀察（{@area 區域P9|490|x}）

english: Stealing the Necklace
zh_tw: 偷走項鍊

english: As an action, a character can try to steal the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, or a character can use a {@spell suggestion} spell or similar magic to try to make the simulacrum relinquish the necklace. (Even though the simulacrum is a Construct, it can be {@condition charmed}.) The simulacrum becomes hostile toward anyone who tries to take the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. The simulacrum doesn't care about collateral damage to Paliset Hall, its staff, or its guests.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試透過一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定來偷取{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊，或者角色可以使用{@spell suggestion||暗示術}法術或類似的魔法來嘗試使擬像交出項鍊。（儘管擬像是一個構裝體，它仍然可以被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。）擬像會對任何試圖拿走{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的人變得敵對。擬像並不在意對帕利塞特莊園、其員工或客人造成的附帶傷害。

english: The instant the necklace becomes separated from the simulacrum, the necklace teleports to the hidden vault in {@area area P12|498|x}. Eliphas knows where this vault is located, but only Zorhanna and her simulacrum know the proper way to open it.
zh_tw: 項鍊一旦與幻象分離，就會立即傳送到{@area 區域P12|498|x}中的秘密金庫。伊萊法斯知道這個金庫的位置，但只有佐哈娜和她的幻象知道正確的開啟方式。

english: Paliset Hall Locations
zh_tw: 帕利塞特莊園地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 12.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點在地圖12.2上有標註。

english: Map 12.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖 12.2：DM地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: P1: Fountain and Patio
zh_tw: P1. 噴泉和露臺

english: The following description assumes the characters arrive here from Loch Wynnis via the fey crossing:
zh_tw: 以下描述假設角色們是透過精類穿越點從溫尼斯湖來到這裡的：

english: You stand in a fountain of illusory water on a cobblestone patio. Colorful globes of light bob in the air, dancing in time with the stars that blink on the twilit horizon. The patio leads to a grand, two-story palace, its walls as white as fresh-fallen snow. The dark roof shimmers with the colors of an aurora. Crystal snowflakes decorate the windows, and music wafts through the palace's open doorway.
zh_tw: 你站在鵝卵石露臺上的一個虛幻噴泉中。彩色的光球在空中飄浮，隨著在暮色地平線上閃爍的星星的節奏而舞動。露臺通向一座宏偉的兩層樓宮殿，牆壁潔白如新降的雪。深色的屋頂閃爍著極光的色彩。水晶雪花裝飾著窗戶，音樂從宮殿敞開的門飄蕩而出。

english: Four winter wolves stand between you and Paliset Hall. After welcoming guests to the gala, the wolves insist on checking invitations once more before allowing anyone into the palace.
zh_tw: 四隻冬狼站在你和帕利塞特莊園之間。在歡迎客人參加盛會之後，這些狼堅持在允許任何人進入宮殿之前再次檢查邀請函。

english: A gnome adventurer acquires the shard solitaire necklace and a key belonging to Paliset Hall's head of staff
zh_tw: 一位侏儒冒險家獲得了鑽石獨奏曲項鍊和一把屬於帕利塞特莊園首席員工的鑰匙

english: The four {@creature Winter Wolf||winter wolves} are soon joined by the two {@creature Winter Wolf||winter wolves} from Loch Wynnis. Each wolf can cast {@spell see invisibility} on itself once per day, enabling it to see the invisible watermarks on the guests' invitations as well as detect {@condition invisible} party-crashers. The wolves are forbidden from entering Paliset Hall without a command from Zorhanna or Eliphas. If someone tries to slip past the wolves, they alert the ice mephits in {@area area P2|477|x}, which attack the offender.
zh_tw: 這四隻{@creature Winter Wolf||冬狼}很快被來自溫尼斯湖的另外兩隻{@creature Winter Wolf||冬狼}加入。每隻狼每天可以在自己身上施展一次{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術，使它能夠看到賓客邀請函上的隱形水印，以及檢測{@condition invisible||隱形}不速之客。未經佐哈娜或伊萊法斯的命令，這些狼不得進入帕利塞特莊園。如果有人試圖悄悄溜過這些狼，它們會提醒在{@area 區域P2|477|x}的冰魔（冰魔蝠），這些魔會攻擊違規者。

english: Fey Crossing
zh_tw: 精類穿越點

english: The fountain contains the fey crossing connected to Loch Wynnis. In addition to the few times when the fey crossing opens on its own, anyone can open the fey crossing from this side by reciting the rhyme, "Neither gleaming sword nor magic tome can soothe the soul like hearth and home." This rhyme is known to Zorhanna, Eliphas, the winter wolves, and Paliset Hall's staff. The fey crossing remains open for 10 minutes after the rhyme is recited.
zh_tw: 噴泉內含有連線到溫尼斯湖的精類通道。除了精類通道自己偶爾開啟的那幾次之外，任何人都可以透過朗誦押韻詩來從這邊開啟精類通道：「既非閃亮的劍也非魔法書，能像爐火和家一樣撫慰靈魂。」這個押韻詩為佐哈娜、伊萊法斯、冬狼以及帕利塞特莊園的工作人員所知曉。朗誦押韻詩後，精類通道會保持開啟10分鐘。

english: Anyone who steps into the fountain while the fey crossing is open immediately appears, completely dry, on Loch Wynnis's longest dock at the end farthest from the shore.
zh_tw: 當精類通道開啟時，任何踏入噴泉的人會立即出現在洛克·溫尼斯最長的碼頭上，遠離岸邊的那一端，而且完全乾燥。

english: Feywild Guests
zh_tw: 妖精荒野客人

english: The gala attracts not only folk from the Material Plane but guests from the Feywild as well. These guests (all of whom are dressed in fantastic, winter-themed outfits) arrive in coaches drawn by {@creature Unicorn||unicorns} and driven by {@creature Satyr||satyrs}. Characters who linger on the patio might see one or more of these coaches arrive and deposit their guests.
zh_tw: 晚會不僅吸引了來自物質界的人們，還有來自妖精荒野的客人。這些客人（他們都穿著奇妙的、以冬季為主題的服裝）乘坐由{@creature Unicorn||獨角獸}拉動的馬車，由{@creature Satyr||半羊人}駕駛。在露臺上逗留的角色可能會看到一輛或多輛這樣的馬車抵達並放下他們的客人。

english: P2: Foyer
zh_tw: P2. 門廳

english: The front doors of the palace are made of stained glass with silvery fractal patterns. Garlands of frost wind around two spiral alabaster staircases in the grand foyer, and flakes of magical snow fall from the icicle-covered ceiling, disappearing as they touch the floor. Guests mill about, idly chatting.
zh_tw: 宮殿的前門是由帶有銀色分形圖案的彩色玻璃製成。在宏偉的門廳裡，霜凍的花環纏繞著兩座螺旋形的雪花石膏樓梯，魔法雪花從覆蓋著冰柱的天花板上飄落，在觸碰到地面時消失。客人們在四處閒逛，輕鬆地交談。

english: Guests
zh_tw: 客人

english: At any given time during the gala, {@dice 1d6} {@creature Noble||nobles} loiter in the foyer. You can add a named guest to the foyer by rolling once on the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x}.
zh_tw: 在盛會期間的任何時候，都有{@dice 1d6}位{@creature Noble||貴族}在門廳閒逛。你可以透過在{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}上擲骰一次來在門廳增加一個命名的嘉賓。

english: Ice Mephits
zh_tw: 冰魔蝠

english: Six {@creature Ice Mephit||ice mephits} are disguised as ice decorations along the perimeter of the room. The mephits attack anyone who starts a fight in this area. Only Zorhanna, her simulacrum, and Eliphas can command the mephits to stop attacking and return to their posts.
zh_tw: 六個{@creature Ice Mephit||冰魔蝠}偽裝成房間周邊的冰雕裝飾。如果有人在這個區域開始戰鬥，這些魔就會攻擊。只有佐哈娜、她的幻象和伊萊法斯能夠命令這些魔停止攻擊並返回他們的崗位。

english: Staircases
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: Spiral staircases in the northern corners of the room lead to the upper floor and balcony ({@area area P9|490|x}).
zh_tw: 房間東北角的螺旋樓梯通向上層和陽臺（{@area 區域P9|490|x}）。

english: P3: Coat Check
zh_tw: P3. 衣帽間

english: Guests can entrust their coats to the manor's head of staff, a gray-haired, upbeat {@creature satyr} named Oren. He carefully hangs the coats on hooks that line the west and east walls of this area between the foyer and the ballroom.
zh_tw: 客人們可以將外套交給莊園的首席員工，一位名叫歐倫的灰髮、樂觀的{@creature satyr||半羊人}。他仔細地將外套掛在門廳和舞廳之間這個區域的西牆和東牆上的掛鉤上。

english: Oren is diplomatic and ingratiating without being obsequious. When confronted with turmoil, he does his best to maintain a calm facade.
zh_tw: 歐倫在外交上既親切又討好，但並不諂媚。面對動盪時，他會盡力保持冷靜的外表。

english: Finding Zorhanna and Eliphas
zh_tw: 尋找佐哈娜和伊萊法斯

english: Oren doesn't know where Zorhanna is, but characters who ask about Eliphas are told the following:
zh_tw: 歐倫不知道佐哈娜在哪裡，但是詢問伊萊法斯的角色會被告知以下資訊：

english: "Lord Adulare wasn't feeling well and has withdrawn to the upstairs guest room for a trice. But pine not! I expect he'll rejoin us before long."
zh_tw: "阿杜拉雷大人感覺不太舒服，已經暫時退到樓上的客房休息一下。但不用擔心！我預計他不久就會重新加入我們。"

english: Oren senses trouble between Lord and Lady Adulare, but he won't pry into their affairs, and he gently discourages other staff from doing the same. He carries a key for the storage closets in the cellar ({@area area P18|4a9|x}) but doesn't recall anything important being stored in them.
zh_tw: 歐倫察覺到阿杜拉雷勳爵和夫人之間的問題，但他不會去打探他們的私事，並且溫和地勸阻其他員工也這樣做。他持有通往地窖儲物櫃的鑰匙（{@area 區域P18|4a9|x}），但他不記得有什麼重要的東西存放在那裡。

english: P4: Ballroom
zh_tw: P4. 舞廳

english: A jaunty waltz draws you into this palatial ballroom. Above the dancing crowd spins a glittering chandelier that appears crafted from equal parts silver and frost. Icicles hang from the vaulted ceiling, sparkling in the light like jewels.
zh_tw: 一首輕快的華爾茲舞曲吸引你進入這座宏偉的舞廳。在跳舞的人群上方旋轉著一個閃閃發光的吊燈，看起來是由同等部分的銀和霜凍製成。冰柱從拱形天花板垂下，在燈光下像寶石一樣閃閃發光。

english: A 20-foot-high balcony ({@area area P9|490|x}) overlooks the ballroom floor.
zh_tw: 一個20尺高的陽臺（{@area 區域P9|490|x}）俯瞰著舞廳地面。

english: Guests
zh_tw: 客人

english: At any given time during the gala, {@dice 2d6 × 2} {@creature Noble||nobles} dance here. You can add a named guest to the ballroom by rolling once on the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x}.
zh_tw: 在晚會的任何時候，都有{@dice 2d6 × 2}位{@creature Noble||貴族}在這裡跳舞。你可以透過在{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}上擲骰一次來為舞廳增加一個命名的嘉賓。

english: Ice Mephits
zh_tw: 冰魔蝠

english: Six {@creature Ice Mephit||ice mephits} are disguised as ice decorations along the perimeter of the room. The mephits attack anyone who starts a fight in this area. Only Zorhanna, her simulacrum, and Eliphas can command the mephits to stop attacking and return to their posts.
zh_tw: 六個{@creature Ice Mephit||冰魔蝠}偽裝成房間周邊的冰雕裝飾。如果有人在這個區域開始戰鬥，這些魔就會攻擊。只有佐哈娜、她的幻象和伊萊法斯能夠命令這些魔停止攻擊並返回他們的崗位。

english: P5: Parlor
zh_tw: P5. 客廳

english: Gray chaise longues and sapphire-colored couches are arranged about this parlor, which is occupied by a handful of guests. A tall pine tree bedecked in tinsel and gilded baubles stands majestically in one corner.
zh_tw: 灰色的躺椅和藍寶石色的沙釋出置在這個客廳中，一些客人在此閒坐。一棵高大的松樹，裝飾著閃亮的金屬箔和小金球，莊嚴地矗立在一個角落裡。

english: Guests
zh_tw: 客人

english: At any given time during the gala, {@dice 1d8} {@creature Noble||nobles} lounge in this room. You can add a named guest to the parlor by rolling once on the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x}.
zh_tw: 在盛會期間的任何時候，都有{@dice 1d8}位{@creature Noble||貴族}在這個房間裡休息。你可以透過在{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}上擲骰一次來在客廳增加一個命名的嘉賓。

english: Left to Right: Rust-Colored Bag of Tricks, Serpentine Owl, Gauntlets of Ogre Power, Quiver of Ehlonna
zh_tw: 從左到右：鏽色魔法袋、蛇形貓頭鷹、食人魔力量護手、艾羅娜的箭袋

english: P6: Art Gallery
zh_tw: P6. 藝術畫廊

english: Vibrant paintings and tapestries depicting the seasons hang in this grand room. Along the walls are displays of statuettes, crystal vases, and other art objects.
zh_tw: 這個宏偉的房間掛滿了描繪四季的生動繪畫和掛毯。牆壁上陳列著小雕像、水晶花瓶以及其他藝術品。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the northeast corner of the room has a painting mounted to it. The painting depicts two tiefling children playing in the snow, and the painting's frame is made of gray wood carved with snowflakes. Pressing the snowflake in the bottom middle of the frame causes the secret door to swing outward on hidden hinges, revealing a staircase to the storage cellar ({@area area P18|4a9|x}). A character who examines the painting or searches the wall for secret doors and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices the sheen of frequent touches on the snowflake button.
zh_tw: 房間東北角的一扇暗門上掛著一幅畫。畫中描繪了兩個提夫林孩子在雪地裡玩耍的景象，畫框由灰色木材製成，上面雕刻著雪花。按下畫框底部中間的雪花，暗門會向外開啟，露出通往儲藏地下室樓梯的入口（{@area 區域P18|4a9|x}）。如果角色檢查這幅畫或在牆上尋找暗門，併成功透過 {@dc 17} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定，會注意到雪花按鈕上因頻繁觸碰而留下的光澤。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Four items on display are magical:
zh_tw: 展示的四個物品具有魔法特性：

english: {@item Bag of Tricks, Rust||Rust-colored bag of tricks}
zh_tw: {@item Bag of Tricks, Rust||鏽色魔法袋}

english: {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||Figurine of wondrous power (serpentine owl)}
zh_tw: {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||異能塑像，蛇紋石鴞}

english: {@item Gauntlets of ogre power}
zh_tw: {@item Gauntlets of ogre power||食人魔力量護手}

english: {@item Quiver of Ehlonna}
zh_tw: {@item Quiver of Ehlonna||艾羅娜的箭袋}

english: Some nonmagical treasures are displayed here as well, including three silk tapestries (250 gp each), eight paintings by famous artists (750 gp each), an onyx mountain goat statuette with garnets for eyes (250 gp), and a beautiful blue opal statuette depicting an archfey known as the Prince of Frost (5,000 gp).
zh_tw: 這裡也展示著一些非魔法寶藏，包括三幅絲綢掛毯（每幅250金幣），八幅著名藝術家的畫作（每幅750金幣），一尊黑曜石山羊小雕像，眼睛用石榴石製成（250金幣），以及一尊描繪被稱為冰霜王子的精類的精美藍色蛋白石小雕像（5000金幣）。

english: P7: Banquet Hall
zh_tw: P7. 宴會廳

english: Two long, mahogany tables are piled high with sugared plums, decadent gingerbreads, and glazed meats. Two sprites flutter near them, encouraging guests to sample the food.
zh_tw: 兩張長長的紅木桌子上堆滿了糖漬李子、奢華的薑餅和上釉的肉類。兩個小精靈在它們附近飛舞，鼓勵客人品嚐食物。

english: The two {@creature Sprite||sprites} are named Sysie and Val. Any character who converses with them and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check notices they are both uneasy. They sense something is amiss with Zorhanna, but neither sprite dares speak out for fear of inviting the Adulares' wrath or a stern lecture from Oren, the satyr head of staff. A character can convince either sprite to share their concerns by succeeding on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, but this check is made with disadvantage if Zorhanna is within the sprite's line of sight.
zh_tw: 這兩個{@creature Sprite||小仙靈}名叫西希爾和瓦爾。任何與他們交談並透過{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的人物都會注意到他們都感到不安。他們感覺到佐哈娜有些不對勁，但這兩個小精靈都不敢說出來，因為他們害怕招致阿杜拉瑞斯的憤怒或受到職員主管薩特奧倫的嚴厲訓斥。角色可以透過成功進行{@dc 13}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定說服其中一個小精靈分享他們的擔憂，但如果在佐哈娜的視線範圍內進行，則此檢定帶有劣勢。

english: Guests
zh_tw: 客人

english: At any given time during the gala, {@dice 1d6 + 2} {@creature Noble||nobles} enjoy food and refreshments here. You can add a named guest by rolling once on the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x}.
zh_tw: 在盛會期間的任何時候，都有{@dice 1d6 + 2}位{@creature Noble||貴族}在這裡享用食物和飲料。你可以透過在{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}上擲骰一次來增加一個命名的嘉賓。

english: P8: Kitchen
zh_tw: P8. 廚房

english: The scent of herbs and the clatter of pots fill this busy kitchen. Amid the satyr and pixie cooks stands a much taller figure with pale, knotted, bark-like skin. Her glassy black eyes survey the kitchen's staff with piercing sternness.
zh_tw: 草藥的香味和鍋碗瓢盆的碰撞聲充斥著這個忙碌的廚房。在半羊人和皮克精廚師中，站著一個身材高大得多的身影，皮膚蒼白、有結、像樹皮一樣。她那玻璃般的黑色眼睛以銳利的嚴肅態度審視著廚房的工作人員。

english: Two {@creature Satyr||satyrs} and three {@creature Pixie||pixies} busy themselves with cooking tasks. The dour {@creature dryad} head chef, Anisetta, lords over the kitchen and barks out orders. Anisetta also carries a key for the storage closets in the cellar ({@area area P18|4a9|x}) but doesn't recall anything important being stored in them.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Satyr||半羊人}和三個{@creature Pixie||皮克精}忙於烹飪任務。心情陰沉的{@creature dryad||樹精}主廚安妮瑟塔主宰著廚房並大聲下達指令。安妮瑟塔也持有通往地窖儲物櫃的鑰匙（{@area 區域P18|4a9|x}），但她不記得有什麼重要的東西存放在那裡。

english: If Anisetta catches anyone who isn't staff in the kitchen, she sharply asks them to leave in Elvish. If that doesn't work, she tromps out of the kitchen to find Oren, the head of staff ({@area see area P3|47c|x}), and demands he deal with the situation, which he tries to do diplomatically.
zh_tw: 如果安妮瑟塔發現任何非員工的人在廚房裡，她會用精靈語嚴厲地要求他們離開。如果這不起作用，她會走出廚房去找員工主管歐倫（{@area 檢視區域P3|47c|x}），並要求他處理這種情況，而他會嘗試以外交方式解決。

english: Staircase
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: A staircase leads to the storage cellar (area P18). This stairway is reserved for servants, but a character who succeeds on a {@dc 18} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check convinces Anisetta to let them access it.
zh_tw: 一段樓梯通往儲藏地窖（區域 P18）。此樓梯僅供僕人使用，但角色若透過一項 {@dc 18} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞} 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，可以說服阿妮塞塔允許他們進入。

english: P9: Balcony
zh_tw: P9. 陽臺

english: This balcony, which overlooks the ballroom, is enclosed by an alabaster balustrade that has gold-leaf reindeer for balusters.
zh_tw: 這個陽臺俯瞰著舞廳，被一個由雪花石膏製成的欄杆包圍，欄杆上裝飾著金箔製成的馴鹿形狀的欄杆柱。

english: It's a 20-foot drop from the balcony to the ballroom floor.
zh_tw: 從陽臺到舞廳地板是20尺的落差。

english: Guests. At any given time during the gala, {@dice 1d6} {@creature Noble||nobles} mingle here. You can add a named guest to the ballroom by rolling once on the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x}.
zh_tw: 賓客。在晚會的任何時候，都有{@dice 1d6}位{@creature Noble||貴族}在這裡交流。你可以透過在{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}上擲骰一次來為舞廳增加一個命名的嘉賓。

english: P10: Main Bedroom
zh_tw: P10. 主臥室

english: Paintings in gilded frames hang on the walls of this spacious, lavishly decorated bedchamber.
zh_tw: 這個寬敞、裝飾華麗的臥室牆壁上掛著金色畫框的畫作。

english: Magic Painting
zh_tw: 魔法畫

english: One of the paintings depicts a reindeer-shaped creature made of dark woven branches and emerald-green leaves. If a creature moves within 5 feet of the painting, the image animates, and the wooden reindeer-like creature cheerfully introduces itself as Oak, personal assistant to Zorhanna and Eliphas.
zh_tw: 其中一幅畫描繪了一隻馴鹿形狀的生物，由深色交織枝條與翠綠葉片構成。當生物接近畫作 5 尺內時，畫像便活動起來；那隻木製馴鹿般的生物會愉快地自我介紹，說自己名叫奧克（Oak，意為「橡樹」），是佐哈娜與伊萊法斯的私人助手。

english: Oak explains that his job is to keep track of Lord and Lady Adulare's schedule and remind them of any mundane tasks they might have forgotten. Oak doesn't normally share information with strangers, but Zorhanna and Eliphas have ignored the painting of late, and Oak is dying to talk to someone. Any character who asks Oak a question about Zorhanna, Eliphas, or the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace can make a {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the check is successful, Oak provides an answer other than, "Well, I can't really talk about that." Its answers are as follows:
zh_tw: 奧克解釋說，他的工作是記錄阿杜拉雷勳爵和夫人的日程，並提醒他們可能忘記的任何瑣事。奧克通常不會與陌生人分享資訊，但最近佐哈娜和伊萊法斯忽視了那幅畫，奧克渴望與人交談。任何向奧克詢問有關佐哈娜、伊萊法斯或 {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾} 項鍊的問題的角色都可以進行一次 {@dc 12} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果檢定成功，奧克會提供除"嗯，我不能真的談論那個。"以外的回答。他的回答如下：

english: Eliphas
zh_tw: 伊萊法斯

english: "Eliphas has been staying in the guest room on the opposite side of Paliset Hall. If you see him, please remind him he has an appointment with that emissary from Prismeer in two days."
zh_tw: "伊萊法斯一直住在帕利塞特莊園對面一側的客房裡。如果你看到他，請提醒他兩天後他有一個與來自普利茲米爾的使者的約會。"

english: Zorhanna
zh_tw: 佐哈娜

english: "Zorhanna doesn't sleep, but she used to check in with me after finishing her trance. Lately, she won't even say hello. I don't know what I said to offend her."
zh_tw: "佐哈娜不睡覺，但她過去常常在完成她的恍惚狀態後與我核對。最近，她甚至不打招呼。我不知道我說了什麼得罪了她。"

english: Shard Solitaire Necklace
zh_tw: 鑽石獨奏曲項鍊

english: "That old thing? Zorhanna took it from the pool a few weeks ago for a dress fitting and hasn't taken it off since. Oh, dear, did I say pool? You know what? Forget I said anything."
zh_tw: "那個舊東西？幾周前佐哈娜為了試穿禮服從池子裡拿出來，從那以後就沒再摘下來過。哦，天哪，我說的是池子嗎？你知道什麼？忘了我說過的話。"

english: The magic painting is a Small object with AC 11, 4 hit points, and immunity to poison or psychic damage. Reducing it to 0 hit points or removing it from the room renders it nonmagical. If a character threatens to destroy Oak, the painting reveals that Zorhanna's vault is "hidden in the tower pool beyond the bathroom," then nods toward area P11.
zh_tw: 這幅魔法畫作是一個小型物體，具有11的護甲等級，4點生命值，並對毒素或心靈傷害免疫。將其生命值降至0或從房間中移除使其失去魔法效果。如果角色威脅要破壞畫作，畫作會透露佐哈娜的金庫"隱藏在浴室之外的塔樓水池中"，然後指向區域P11。

english: P11: Main Bathroom
zh_tw: P11. 主浴室

english: A porcelain bathtub sits against one wall of this room, which also contains two tables stacked with clean towels, scented bars of soap, and bottles. At the back of the room, blocking a short staircase that climbs to a turret, is a ten-foot-tall marble statue of a reindeer.
zh_tw: 這個房間的一面牆上放著一個瓷制浴缸，房間裡還有兩張桌子上堆滿了乾淨的毛巾、香皂和瓶子。在房間的後部，擋住了通往角樓的短樓梯的，是一座十尺高的大理石馴鹿雕像。

english: The statue is a {@creature stone golem} that guards the way to area P12. Zorhanna, her simulacrum, or someone disguised as Zorhanna can command the golem to move aside. Otherwise, the golem attacks if it takes damage or if someone tries to sneak past it into area P12. In combat, the golem uses Slow on its first turn. On subsequent turns, it makes Slam attacks with its hooves and antlers. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, the golem turns to dust, then re-forms and returns to its post {@dice 1d4} hours later. After it is destroyed three times, it doesn't re-form.
zh_tw: 這座雕像是一個{@creature stone golem||石魔像}，守護著通往區域P12的道路。佐哈娜、她的幻象，或者偽裝成佐哈娜的人可以命令魔像讓開。否則，如果魔像受到傷害，或者有人試圖潛入區域P12，它就會發動攻擊。在戰鬥中，魔像在第一回合使用緩慢術。在隨後的回合中，它使用蹄子和角進行撞擊攻擊。如果它的生命值降至0點，魔像會化為塵土，然後在{@dice 1d4}小時後重新形成並返回其崗位。如果它被摧毀三次，它將不再重新形成。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the room find a {@item Potion of Superior Healing||potion of healing (superior)} and four bottles of scented bath oil (25 gp each) atop the table farthest from the bathtub.
zh_tw: 搜尋房間的角色在離浴缸最遠的桌子上找到了一瓶{@item Potion of Superior Healing||治療藥水（強效）}和四瓶香薰浴油（每瓶25金幣）。

english: P12: Vault Tower
zh_tw: P12. 金庫塔

english: A rectangular pool is situated in the middle of this octagonal turret, which has tiled walls and a tiled floor. The turret's vaulted ceiling bears a painted mural of a fantastically beautiful fey creature who looks like winter incarnate. The pool's water is perfectly clear, revealing a tile mosaic at the bottom of it. In the center of the pool's mosaic are three concentric, gilded rings. The pool has no visible drain.
zh_tw: 這個八角形角樓的中間設有一個長方形水池，四周牆壁和地面都貼有瓷磚。角樓的拱形天花板上繪有一幅壁畫，畫著一位極其美麗的精類生物，看起來像是冬天的化身。水池的水非常清澈，可以看到底部的瓷磚馬賽克。水池馬賽克的中心有三個同心的鍍金圓環。水池沒有可見的排水口。

english: The painted mural on the ceiling depicts the Prince of Frost, an archfey of Zorhanna's acquaintance.
zh_tw: 天花板上的繪畫壁畫描繪了霜凍王子，他是佐哈娜認識的一位高等精類。

english: Pool
zh_tw: 水池

english: The pool is 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet deep, and filled with frigid water. When a creature other than Zorhanna enters the water for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 這個水池長10尺，寬5尺，深5尺，裡面充滿了冰冷的水。當一個生物除卓爾漢娜外，在回合內第一次進入水中或在那裡開始其回合時，它必須進行一次{@dc 17}體質豁免檢定，如果失敗則受到14點（{@dice 4d6}）寒冷傷害，如果成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: No more than once per day, while Zorhanna is immersed in the pool, she can use it to contact the Prince of Frost and ask him up to three questions. He can choose not to answer a question or provide a truthful answer, but he can't lie. He can then ask Zorhanna three questions, each of which must be answered truthfully or not at all.
zh_tw: 每天最多一次，當佐哈娜沉浸在池中時，她可以使用它與霜凍王子聯絡並向他提出最多三個問題。他可以選擇不回答問題或不提供真實的答案，但他不能撒謊。然後，他可以向佐哈娜提出三個問題，每個問題都必須真實回答或根本不回答。

english: Rune Tile
zh_tw: 符文瓷磚

english: The Elvish rune for "winter" is inscribed on the wall opposite the stairs. A character who examines that wall and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots the rune, which can also be found with a {@spell detect magic} spell. Pressing the rune's tile opens hidden pipes at the bottom of the pool and drains it completely in 1 minute. The pool remains empty for 10 minutes, after which it automatically refills with frigid water.
zh_tw: 精靈語的符文"冬季"被刻在樓梯對面的牆上。一個角色如果檢查這面牆併成功透過一個{@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定，會發現這個符文，也可以透過{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術發現。按下符文的瓷磚會開啟池底隱藏的管道，並在1分鐘內將池水完全排幹。池子會保持乾涸狀態10分鐘，之後會自動重新充滿冰冷的水。

english: Vault
zh_tw: 金庫

english: The three concentric, gilded rings at the bottom of the pool are the locking mechanisms for a hidden safe. Each ring is flat and set in a shallow groove, such that it can be rotated. Once the water in the pool is drained, tiny Elvish runes representing the letters A through Z magically appear on the surface of each ring, with the letters spaced around the ring at equal intervals. Opening the safe requires that the three rings be turned in their grooves until their runes line up to form the word "OAK." Only Zorhanna and her simulacrum know the correct combination of letters (although "OAK" is a direct reference to the magic painting in {@area area P10|492|x}).
zh_tw: 水池底部的三個同心鍍金圓環是一個隱藏保險箱的鎖定機制。每個圓環都是平的，並且設定在一個淺槽中，可以旋轉。一旦水池中的水被排幹，代表字母A到Z的微小精靈符文就會神奇地出現在每個圓環的表面上，字母在圓環上以相等的間隔排列。開啟保險箱需要將三個圓環在它們的槽中旋轉，直到它們的符文排成單詞「OAK」（奧克的名字，意為「橡樹」）。只有佐哈娜和她的擬像知道正確的字母組合（儘管"OAK"是對{@area 區域P10|492|x}中魔法畫的直接引用）。

english: The safe has no mechanisms that a thief can exploit using thieves' tools, but a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic can be used to open it.
zh_tw: 這個保險箱沒有小偷可以使用盜賊工具利用的機制，但是可以使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法來開啟它。

english: When the rings are properly aligned or the safe is opened by other means, the circular area inside the innermost ring disappears, allowing access to a hidden compartment measuring 1 foot on each side. If the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace was taken from {@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV}, it rests in the compartment (the stone is still attuned to the Far Realm entity trapped inside it). Otherwise, the compartment is empty.
zh_tw: 當戒指正確對齊或透過其他方式開啟保險箱時，最內圈的圓形區域消失，允許進入一個隱藏的隔間，每邊長1尺。如果{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊是從{@creature Zorhanna's simulacrum|KftGV|佐哈娜的擬像}那裡拿走的，它就放在隔間裡（寶石仍然與裡面困住的遙遠國度實體保持共鳴）。否則，隔間是空的。

english: Seconds before the pool refills with water, the safe reseals itself and the runes vanish from the golden rings.
zh_tw: 在水池重新注滿水的幾秒鐘前，保險箱自行重新封閉，金戒指上的符文也隨之消失。

english: P13: Vanity
zh_tw: P13. 梳妝室

english: Elegant dresses and blouses hang on racks along the walls of this narrow chamber. A white wooden dresser against the far wall has a circular mirror mounted above it.
zh_tw: 這個狹長房間的牆上掛著架子，上面掛著優雅的連衣裙和女式襯衫。靠遠端牆的白色木製梳妝檯上方安裝著一個圓形鏡子。

english: The garments stored here are exquisite. The dresser's drawers contain enough materials (wigs, cosmetics, and whatnot) to assemble one {@item disguise kit|PHB}.
zh_tw: 這裡存放的服裝非常精美。梳妝檯的抽屜裡裝有足夠的材料（假髮、化妝品等），可以組裝一套{@item disguise kit|PHB|易容工具}。

english: P14: Guest Bedroom
zh_tw: P14. 客房

english: The door to this room is closed and unlocked.
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是關著的，沒上鎖。

english: This bedroom is spacious and nicely appointed. A man wearing a rich-blue coat sits on the edge of a narrow bed. His trimmed white beard darkens at its roots, and kindly wrinkles frame his brow and eyes.
zh_tw: 這間臥室寬敞且佈置得很漂亮。一個穿著深藍色外套的男子坐在一張窄床的邊緣。他修剪過的白色鬍鬚在根部變深，和藹的皺紋圍繞在他的額頭和眼睛周圍。

english: "Looking to escape the crowds?" he asks with a thin smile. "I get that. You're welcome to hide in here with me for as long as you like."
zh_tw: "想逃離人群嗎？"他帶著一絲微笑問道。"我懂的。只要你願意，你可以隨時和我在這裡躲藏。"

english: {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|Eliphas} is a neutral good, human {@creature werebear} who can adopt the form of a polar bear. He has an Intelligence score of 18 and the following additional action option:
zh_tw: {@creature Eliphas Adulare|KftGV|伊萊法斯}是一箇中立善良的人類{@creature werebear||熊人}，可以變成一隻北極熊。他有一個18點的智力評分，以及以下額外的行動選項：

english: Spellcasting (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
zh_tw: 施法（僅類人與半人形態）

english: Eliphas casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 15}):
zh_tw: 埃利法斯施放以下任意一個法術，使用智力作為施法能力（豁免{@dc 15}）：

english: At will: {@spell light}, {@spell minor illusion}, {@spell prestidigitation}
zh_tw: 隨意：{@spell light||光亮術}，{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}，{@spell prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}

english: 2/day each: {@spell detect magic}, {@spell fog cloud}
zh_tw: 每日2次：{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell fog cloud||雲霧術}

english: 1/day each: {@spell phantasmal force}, {@spell shatter}
zh_tw: 每種每天 1 次：{@spell phantasmal force||魅影之力}，{@spell shatter||粉碎音波}

english: If the characters reveal who they are and why they've come, a great weight seems to lift from Eliphas's shoulders as he thanks them for heeding his summons. "I knew Fifel wouldn't let me down!" he adds.
zh_tw: 如果角色們透露了自己的身份以及他們為何而來，伊萊法斯的肩上似乎卸下了沉重的負擔，他感謝他們響應了他的召喚。"我知道菲菲爾不會讓我失望的！"他補充道。

english: Eliphas knows the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 伊萊法斯知道以下資訊：

english: Zorhanna's Simulacrum
zh_tw: 佐哈娜的擬像

english: "I'm now convinced that my wife has been replaced by a simulacrum—a lookalike invested with her knowledge and spellcasting ability. I dimly recall Zorhanna mentioning that the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} has the power to create such a thing."
zh_tw: "我現在確信我的妻子已經被一個幻象取代了——一個擁有她知識和施法能力的複製品。我隱約記得佐哈娜提到過{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}有創造這樣東西的力量。"

english: Secret Vault
zh_tw: 秘密金庫

english: "Zorhanna usually keeps her {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace in a vault hidden beneath a pool of frigid water in Paliset Hall's bathroom turret, which is guarded by a stone golem. Only Zorhanna can safely bypass the golem, and only Zorhanna knows the three-letter combination to the vault." (Eliphas can lead characters safely to {@area area P11|495|x} if they ask to see the bathroom turret, and he will help them defeat the golem that guards it.)
zh_tw: "佐哈娜通常把她的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}儲存在帕利塞特莊園浴室角樓的冰冷水池下的隱藏金庫中，那裡由一個石魔像守衛。只有佐哈娜能夠安全地繞過魔像，只有她知道金庫的三字母組合密碼。"（如果角色們請求看看浴室角樓，伊萊法斯可以帶領他們安全到達{@area 區域P11|495|x}，並且他將幫助他們擊敗守衛魔像。）

english: Weird Anomalies
zh_tw: 奇異異常

english: "Something strange is happening. I've seen walls, windows, and doors transform before my eyes, then suddenly everything is normal again. This only started a few hours ago, and it scares me. I just don't know what to do!"
zh_tw: "發生了一些奇怪的事情。我親眼看到牆壁、窗戶和門在我眼前變形，然後突然一切又恢復正常了。這僅僅是幾個小時前開始的，這讓我感到害怕。我只是不知道該怎麼辦！"

english: If the characters tell Eliphas they've also seen weird anomalies, Eliphas begins to wonder if Zorhanna is causing the anomalies because she is trapped somewhere in Paliset Hall and trying to reach out to them. If a character suggests the anomalies are caused by the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} or something else trapped inside it, Eliphas urges the characters to search Paliset Hall until they discover the truth.
zh_tw: 如果角色們告訴伊萊法斯他們也看到了奇異的異常現象，伊萊法斯開始懷疑是不是因為佐哈娜被困在帕利塞特莊園的某個地方，試圖與他們聯絡才造成了這些異常。如果某個角色提出這些異常是由{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}或者它內部困住的其他東西引起的，伊萊法斯會敦促角色們搜尋帕利塞特莊園，直到他們發現真相。

english: P15: Guest Bathroom
zh_tw: P15. 客用浴室

english: A porcelain tub rests against one wall of this bathroom. The mirror hanging above the vanity is cracked. If asked, Eliphas sheepishly explains that he cracked the mirror in a shaving accident.
zh_tw: 這個浴室的一面牆上放著一個瓷制浴缸。懸掛在梳妝檯上方的鏡子裂了。如果被問及，伊萊法斯會羞怯地解釋說，他在一次剃鬚事故中弄裂了鏡子。

english: P16: Private Study
zh_tw: P16. 私人書房

english: An {@spell arcane lock} spell has been cast on the door to this room. Zorhanna, her simulacrum, and Eliphas treat the door as though it were unlocked.
zh_tw: 這個房間的門上施加了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術。佐哈娜、她的幻象和伊萊法斯可以像門沒有上鎖一樣對待它。

english: As an action, a character can try to open the magically locked door using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 22} Dexterity check, or try to force it open, doing so with a successful {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the door.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具開啟這扇魔法鎖住的門，透過一次成功的 {@dc 22} 敏捷檢定，或者嘗試強行開啟，透過一次成功的 {@dc 22} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。一個 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也能開啟這扇門。

english: The walls of this room are lined with tall shelves stuffed with leather-bound tomes. An elegant wooden desk is situated under a stained-glass window. Atop the desk is a thick book with a furry white cover and a crystal ball in a gilded stand.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上排列著高大的書架，書架上擺滿了裝訂精良的皮革封面書籍。一張優雅的木製書桌位於一扇彩色玻璃窗下。書桌上放著一本封面毛茸茸的白色厚書和在一個鍍金支架上的水晶球。

english: The books on the shelves span many topics mostly related to nature, the planes, and the Feywild in particular.
zh_tw: 書架上的書籍涵蓋了許多主題，主要與自然、位面，特別是妖精荒野有關。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Any character who spends 1 hour examining the books on the shelves can, at the end of that hour, make a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. If the check is successful, the character finds a rare book worth 250 gp to a collector. Only four such books can be found here.
zh_tw: 任何角色花費1小時檢查書架上的書籍，可以在小時結束時進行一個 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。如果檢定成功，該角色會發現一本對收藏家來說價值250金幣的稀有書籍。這裡只能找到四本這樣的書籍。

english: The fur-covered book on the desk is Zorhanna's {@item spellbook|PHB}, which contains the following spells: {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell banishment}, {@spell cone of cold}, {@spell counterspell}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell fire shield}, {@spell fly}, {@spell globe of invulnerability}, {@spell ice storm}, {@spell identify}, {@spell knock}, {@spell legend lore}, {@spell lightning bolt}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell mind blank}, {@spell mirror image}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell plane shift}, {@spell polymorph}, {@spell remove curse}, {@spell scrying}, {@spell sending}, {@spell stoneskin}, {@spell teleport}, {@spell time stop}, {@spell true seeing}, and {@spell wall of force}.
zh_tw: 桌上被毛皮覆蓋的書是佐哈娜的{@item spellbook|PHB|法術書}，其中包含以下法術：{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}，{@spell banishment||放逐術}，{@spell cone of cold||寒冰錐}，{@spell counterspell||法術反制}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，{@spell fire shield||火焰護盾}，{@spell fly||飛行術}，{@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}，{@spell ice storm||冰風暴}，{@spell identify||鑑定術}，{@spell knock||敲擊術}，{@spell legend lore||通曉傳奇}，{@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}，{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}，{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}，{@spell mind blank||心靈屏障}，{@spell mirror image||鏡影術}，{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}，{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}，{@spell polymorph||變形術}，{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}，{@spell scrying||探知術}，{@spell teleport||傳送術}，{@spell stoneskin||石膚術}，{@spell sending||短訊術}，{@spell time stop||時間停止}，{@spell true seeing||真知術}，以及{@spell wall of force||力場牆}。

english: The crystal ball on the desk is nonmagical but worth 1,000 gp. It can be used as a focus for the {@spell scrying} spell.
zh_tw: 桌子上的水晶球是非魔法的，但價值1000金幣。它可以用作{@spell scrying||探知術}法術的媒介。

english: Inside one of the desk drawers is a set of {@item tinker's tools|PHB} and a partially dismantled (and nonfunctional) music box similar in design to the ones used by the Golden Vault. Inside another desk drawer is a set of {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|PHB|calligrapher's tools}, three blank invitations to the winter solstice gala, some envelopes, a wax seal, and a silk {@item pouch|PHB} containing 50 pp.
zh_tw: 在書桌的一個抽屜裡，有一套{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}和一個部分拆卸（且無法使用的）音樂盒，設計與金庫使用的音樂盒相似。在另一個抽屜裡，有一套{@item Calligrapher's Supplies|PHB|書法工具}，三份冬至晚會的空白邀請函，一些信封，一個蠟封，以及一個裝有50枚鉑金幣的絲質{@item pouch|PHB|小包}。

english: P17: Powder and Fitting Room
zh_tw: P17. 化妝間和更衣室

english: This room contains a wooden vanity with a circular mirror mounted to the wall above it. Other furnishings include a table, a padded chair, and a dresser.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張木質梳妝檯，上面安裝著一個圓形的鏡子。其他的傢俱包括一張桌子、一把墊椅子和一張梳妝檯。

english: The dresser contains folded garments, straight pins, scissors, wigs, and a cloth tape measure. The table bears an impressive selection of cosmetics.
zh_tw: 梳妝檯內含有摺疊整齊的衣物、別針、剪刀、假髮和布尺。桌子上擺放著一系列令人印象深刻的化妝品。

english: P18: Cellar
zh_tw: P18. 地下室

english: Wooden casks and crates line the walls of this cellar, which has an ascending staircase at each end. A pair of wooden doors flank a narrow passageway in the middle of one wall. Eerie, scintillating light streams around the edges of one of the doors.
zh_tw: 這個地窖的牆上排列著木桶和板條箱，兩端各有一段上升的樓梯。一對木門圍繞著牆上中間的一條狹窄通道。令人不安的閃爍光線從其中一扇門的邊緣透出。

english: The crates contain foodstuffs, and the casks contain wine. The staircases lead to {@area areas P6|486|x} and {@area P8,|48d|x} respectively.
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有食品，木桶裡裝有葡萄酒。樓梯分別通向{@area 區域P6|486|x}和{@area P8,|48d|x}。

english: Storage Closets
zh_tw: 儲藏室

english: Both storage closets are locked. Oren (see {@area area P3|47c|x}) and Anisetta (see {@area area P8|48d|x}) carry keys to these closets. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to open a locked door, doing so with a successful {@dc 11} Dexterity check, or try to force open the door, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the door.
zh_tw: 兩個儲物櫃都被鎖上了。奧倫（見 {@area 區域P3|47c|x}）和安妮塞塔（見 {@area 區域P8|48d|x}）攜帶著這些櫃子的鑰匙。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試開啟一扇鎖著的門，成功透過一個 {@dc 11} 敏捷檢定即可開啟，或者試圖強行開啟門，成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可開啟。一個 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟門。

english: The easternmost closet is the one emitting light. When a character opens this closet for the first time, read or paraphrase the following text:
zh_tw: 最東邊的壁櫥是發出光亮的。當角色第一次開啟這個壁櫥時，請閱讀或轉述以下文字：

english: Floating in space is a pulsing rift of iridescent energy, like a jagged scar in the fabric of reality. The light dims for a second, revealing faint shadows shifting deep within the rift, before it flares once more.
zh_tw: 在太空中漂浮著一個脈動的、閃爍著彩虹般光芒的能量裂縫，就像現實結構上的一道參差不齊的傷疤。光線在一瞬間變暗，露出裂縫深處隱約變化的陰影，然後再次變得明亮。

english: Rift
zh_tw: 裂谷

english: The rift is a one-way portal to the extraplanar space inside the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. A creature that enters the rift's space immediately disappears, then reappears in {@area area P20|4af|x}in a random unoccupied space atop the rock marked A or B on {@area map 12.2|472|x}. The rift can't be dispelled, but it disappears when the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} ceases to be magical (see "{@area The Solitaire Cracks|4b7|x}" later in the adventure).
zh_tw: 這個裂隙是一個通往{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}內跨位面空間的單向傳送門。進入裂隙空間的生物會立即消失，然後重新出現在{@area 區域P20|4af|x}中標有A或B的岩石頂部的隨機空閒位置，如{@area 地圖 12.2|472|x}所示。裂隙無法被驅散，但當{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}失去魔法能量時，它會消失（見冒險中的"{@area 索利塔裡裂縫|4b7|x}"）。

english: Adventurers are trapped in the shard solitaire's extradimensional space with {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 冒險者們被困在碎片獨行者的異次元空間中，與{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}在一起。

english: P19: Servants' Quarters
zh_tw: P19. 僕人住處

english: This hallway has numerous doors leading to simple bedrooms for servants. All the bedroom doors can be locked from the inside, but all are currently unlocked. No servants are here during the gala.
zh_tw: 這個走廊有許多門通向僕人的簡單臥室。所有的臥室門都可以從內部上鎖，但目前都是未上鎖狀態。在盛會期間，這裡沒有僕人。

english: P20: Inside the Solitaire Rift
zh_tw: P20. 索利塔裡裂隙內部

english: Each character who enters the rift in {@area area P18|4a9|x}is deposited in the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire's} extradimensional space, appearing atop the rock marked A or B on {@area map 12.2|472|x}. Divide the party as evenly as possible among these two locations. To set the scene, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 每個進入{@area 區域P18|4a9|x}裂隙的角色都會被傳送到{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|鑽石孤鑽的}的異次元空間，出現在{@area 地圖 12.2|472|x}上標記為A或B的岩石上。儘可能平均地將隊伍分配到這兩個地點。為了設定場景，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: You appear on a smooth, flat-topped rock floating in the middle of a magically charged maelstrom filled with thunderous roars. Other rocks float nearby. Standing on the largest one is Zorhanna in her regalia. You also sense a terrible presence—something formless and indescribable—lurking all around you.
zh_tw: 你出現在一個在充滿魔法能量的漩渦中心飄浮的平坦岩石上，周圍雷聲轟鳴。其他岩石也在附近飄浮。站在最大的岩石上的是身著盛裝的佐哈娜。你還感覺到一個可怕存在——某種無形且難以形容的東西——潛伏在你周圍。

english: Zorhanna points at you and laughs. "The shapeless evil finally appears! Whatever you are, you can't fool me! Prepare to face the wrath of {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV}!"
zh_tw: 佐哈娜指著你並笑了。"無形的邪惡終於現身了！不管你是什麼，你騙不了我！準備面對{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}的憤怒吧！

english: {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV} stands in the middle of the largest floating rock (marked C on {@area map 12.2|472|x}). She is a chaotic good, elf {@creature archmage} who speaks Auran, Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Sylvan. She has expended all her 6th-level and higher spell slots trying to escape from the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire's} extradimensional space, to no avail.
zh_tw: {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}站在最大的浮石（在{@area 地圖 12.2|472|x}上標記為C）的中央。她是一個混亂善良的精靈{@creature archmage||大法師}，會說奧拉語、通用語、龍語、精靈語和森林語。她已經用盡了她所有的6級及更高階別的法術位，試圖從{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|鑽石孤鑽的}的超維度空間逃脫，但都無濟於事。

english: Zorhanna's sense of reality has been warped by prolonged contact with the shapeless Far Realm entity that haunts the extradimensional space. She is convinced that the characters were conjured by this entity to harm her, so she attacks them. She casts {@spell cone of cold} or {@spell lightning bolt} every round on her turn for as long as she is able to do so. If one or more characters close to melee distance, she casts {@spell shocking grasp} and {@spell misty step} on her next turn, using the latter spell to teleport to another rock.
zh_tw: 佐哈娜對現實的感知因長時間接觸無形的遙遠國度實體而扭曲，這個實體出沒於超維度空間。她堅信角色們是由這個實體召喚來傷害她的，所以她攻擊他們。只要她能夠做到，她每一輪都會施放{@spell cone of cold||寒冰錐}或{@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}。如果一個或多個角色靠近到近戰距離，她會在下一輪施放{@spell shocking grasp||電爪}和{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}，使用後者的法術來傳送到另一塊岩石上。

english: As an action, a character can make a {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check while trying to convince Zorhanna that the party is not her enemy. If the check is successful, Zorhanna does nothing on her next turn except mutter to herself as she ponders what the character said. If the check fails, Zorhanna continues her attack. Once three such checks succeed, Zorhanna concludes that the characters are not her enemies and calls for an end to hostilities. She then screams into the void, "You almost had me! Nice try, whatever you are!"
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以進行一次 {@dc 17} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，試圖說服佐哈娜相信團隊不是她的敵人。如果檢定成功，佐哈娜在她的下一回閤中除了自言自語地思考角色所說的話外，不會做任何其他事情。如果檢定失敗，佐哈娜會繼續攻擊。一旦三次這樣的檢定成功，佐哈娜會得出結論認為角色們不是她的敵人，並呼籲停止敵對行動。然後她對著虛空尖叫，"你差點就控制住我了！休想得逞，不管你是什麼東西！"

english: The characters can also convince Zorhanna to stop attacking them by returning her spellbook to her. The spellbook (found in {@area area P16|4a4|x}) excites her because it contains the {@spell plane shift} spell—her ticket to freedom (see "{@area Escaping the Rift|4b3|x}" below).
zh_tw: 角色們也可以透過歸還她的魔法書來說服佐哈娜停止攻擊他們。魔法書（在{@area 區域P16|4a4|x}找到）讓她感到興奮，因為其中包含了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術——她通往自由的門票（見下文"{@area 逃離裂縫|4b3|x}"）。

english: Once Zorhanna is no longer hostile toward the characters, they can question her and learn the following information:
zh_tw: 一旦佐哈娜不再對角色們抱有敵意，他們就可以向她提問，並瞭解到以下資訊：

english: About the Shard Solitaire
zh_tw: 關於鑽石孤鑽

english: "Years ago, I stole the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} from three hags who were trying to harness its extradimensional energy, which, as you can see, is highly unstable. I thought I could keep the diamond safe, but I couldn't resist showing it off from time to time. I let my vanity get the better of me."
zh_tw: "幾年前，我從三個女巫那裡偷走了{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}，她們試圖利用它的超維度能量，如你所見，這是非常不穩定的。我以為我可以安全地保管這顆鑽石，但我忍不住時不時地炫耀它。我的虛榮心佔了上風。"

english: The Entity
zh_tw: 實體

english: "Something alien and evil wormed its way into the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire's} extradimensional rift and became trapped here, just as we are. This entity has a mind, but no body or soul. I believe it comes from a dimension called the Far Realm. It is pure evil and can't be allowed to escape."
zh_tw: "某種外來且邪惡的東西鑽進了{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|鑽石孤鑽的}的超維度裂縫中，並像我們一樣被困在了這裡。這個實體有意識，但沒有身體或靈魂。我相信它來自一個叫做遙遠國度的維度。它是純粹的邪惡，絕不能被允許逃脫。"

english: Extradimensional Rift
zh_tw: 跨維度裂縫

english: The rocks that float in the extradimensional rift are flat on top and suspended in the air at roughly the same elevation. A creature can leap from one rock to its closest neighbor without having to make an ability check.
zh_tw: 漂浮在超維度裂縫中的岩石頂部是平坦的，並且大致在同一高度懸浮在空中。一個生物可以從一塊岩石跳到它最近的鄰居，而無需進行屬性檢定。

english: Any creature that falls off a rock plunges into the rift. At the start of that creature's next turn, energy from the rift strikes the creature for 22 ({@dice 4d10}) force damage, then teleports the creature, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, to a random unoccupied space atop one of the larger rocks. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine which rock: 1–2, rock A; 3–4, rock B; or 5–6, rock C.
zh_tw: 任何從岩石上掉下來的生物都會墜入裂縫。在那個生物的下一回合開始時，裂縫中的能量會擊中該生物，造成22（{@dice 4d10}）點力場傷害，然後將該生物及其穿戴或攜帶的任何物品傳送到較大岩石上的一個隨機空位。擲一個{@dice d6}來確定是哪塊岩石：1-2，岩石A；3-4，岩石B；或者5-6，岩石C。

english: Far Realm Entity
zh_tw: 遙遠國度實體

english: The Far Realm entity can't be seen, heard, targeted, attacked, or harmed. Its presence can merely be felt. At the end of each hour spent in the extradimensional space with this entity, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 無法看到、聽到、選擇、攻擊或傷害這個來自遙遙遠國度域的實體。它的存在只能被感覺到。在每個小時結束，當一個生物在這個異次元空間與該實體共處後，它必須成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 魅力豁免檢定，否則將受到7點（{@dice 2d6}）精神傷害。

english: If the characters crave more combat or if you think they've had too easy a time so far, the entity manifests three {@creature Invisible Stalker||invisible stalkers} that are hostile toward the characters. When a stalker drops to 0 hit points, it lets out a terrible howl as it disperses. Creating these stalkers takes energy the entity needs to free itself from the extradimensional rift, so it won't create more than three of them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們渴望更多的戰鬥，或者你認為他們到目前為止過得太輕鬆了，這個實體就會顯現出三個懷有敵意的{@creature Invisible Stalker||隱形追獵者}。當一個追獵者的生命值降至0點時，它會在消散時發出可怕的嚎叫。創造這些追獵者會消耗實體從跨維度裂縫中解放自身所需的能量，所以它不會創造出超過三個追獵者。

english: Escaping the Rift
zh_tw: 逃離裂縫

english: A creature can't simply teleport from the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire's} extradimensional space. A {@spell plane shift} spell or similar magic is required.
zh_tw: 一個生物不能簡單地從{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|鑽石孤鑽的}的超維度空間傳送出來。需要使用{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術或類似的魔法。

english: If Zorhanna obtains her spellbook, she can use it to prepare the {@spell plane shift} spell, but only after finishing a 4-hour trance (the equivalent of a long rest for her). If the characters escape with Zorhanna before the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} cracks, she admits that the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} is too dangerous to keep in Paliset Hall and does everything in her power to make sure the characters leave with it. She also suggests the characters place it inside a {@item bag of holding} or some other item that contains extradimensional storage space, in case the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} explodes.
zh_tw: 如果佐哈娜獲得了她的魔法書，她可以使用它來準備{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術，但前提是她必須完成4小時的冥想（對她來說相當於長休）。如果在{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}破裂之前，角色們與佐哈娜一起逃脫，她會承認{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}太危險，不適合保留在帕利塞特莊園，並盡她所能確保角色們帶著它離開。她還建議角色們將它放在一個{@item bag of holding||次元袋}或其他具有超維度儲存空間的物品中，以防{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}爆炸。

english: If Zorhanna and the characters have no means of escaping the extradimensional space on their own, they are released when the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} cracks (see "{@area The Solitaire Cracks|4b7|x}" below). Until then, they must try to resist the psychic damage caused by the Far Realm entity.
zh_tw: 如果佐哈娜和角色們沒有自己的方法逃離超維度空間，他們在{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}裂開時（見下文"{@area 索利塔裡裂縫|4b7|x}"）會被釋放。在那之前，他們必須嘗試抵抗來自遙遠國度實體的心靈傷害。

english: The Crestfall Coven
zh_tw: 失落女巫團

english: The hags of the Crestfall Coven have waited many years to steal back the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. Until now, ill omens and vague auguries have stayed their hand, but the moment has finally come.
zh_tw: 失落女巫團的女巫們已經等待了很多年，想要奪回{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。直到現在，不祥的預兆和模糊的預言一直使她們猶豫不決，但最終的時刻終於到來了。

english: With the help of a tiefling {@creature scout} named Mettle (see the {@area Gala Guests table|462|x} earlier in the adventure), the hags have been able to spy on the gala. Disguised as three elf nobles from the Feywild, the three {@creature Night Hag||night hags} (whose names are Myrrel Malum, Esadora Crane, and Netheria Nightblossom) arrive at Paliset Hall in one of the Adulares's unicorn-drawn coaches. After exiting the coach, the hags present stolen invitations to the winter wolves standing guard outside, then waltz into Paliset Hall, cackling with delight at how well their plan is unfolding.
zh_tw: 在一位名叫勇氣的提夫林{@creature scout||斥侯}的幫助下（見冒險早期的{@area 晚會客人表格|462|x}），巫婆們得以窺探晚會。偽裝成來自妖精荒野的三位精靈貴族，三位{@creature Night Hag||夜鬼婆}（名字分別是米瑞爾·瑪勒姆、艾莎多拉·克雷恩和奈瑟莉雅·夜花）乘坐阿杜拉雷家族的一輛由獨角獸拉動的馬車抵達帕利塞特莊園。下了馬車後，巫婆們向站在外面的冬狼守衛出示了偷來的邀請函，然後大搖大擺地走進帕利塞特莊園，為自己的計劃進展得如此順利而咯咯大笑。

english: Hunt for the Shard Solitaire
zh_tw: 追尋鑽石獨奏曲

english: If all three members of the Crestfall Coven are within 30 feet of each other, they gain the benefit of the Shared Spellcasting trait described in the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}. One of the three hags uses this trait to cast {@spell locate object} to find the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}. If they find the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} in another creature's possession, the hags attack whoever has it. If the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} necklace teleported to Zorhanna's vault, the hags use Change Shape to assume Zorhanna's appearance and slip past the vault's stone golem guardian.
