One of the hags then casts {@spell contact other plane} (which has a 1-minute casting time) to learn the three-letter combination needed to open the vault.
zh_tw: 如果失落女巫團的三名成員彼此相距30尺以內，他們將獲得"女巫聯盟"側邊欄中描述的"共享施法"特性的好處，這一特性在{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中有所描述。其中一名女巫利用這一特性施放{@spell locate object||物件定位術}法術來尋找{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。如果她們發現{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}在另一個生物的手中，女巫們就會攻擊持有它的人。如果{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊傳送到了佐哈娜的金庫中，女巫們使用變化形態變成佐哈娜的樣子，以此悄悄透過金庫的石像鬼守衛。然後其中一名女巫施放{@spell contact other plane||異界探知}（施法時間為1分鐘）來瞭解開啟金庫所需的三位字母組合。

english: If the characters are trapped inside the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} or otherwise unable to thwart the Crestfall Coven, the hags snatch the necklace from the vault and use their {@spell plane shift} spells to transport to Loch Wynnis, where they wait for Mettle.
zh_tw: 如果角色們被困在{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}內部，或者無法阻止失落女巫團，女巫們會從金庫中搶走項鍊，並使用她們的{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術傳送到溫尼斯湖，在那裡等待勇氣。

english: Confronting the Hags
zh_tw: 面對巫婆

english: Characters in Paliset Hall might encounter the Crestfall Coven as the hags search for the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} necklace. The hags are willing to cut a deal with the characters, provided the coven gets to keep the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV}. Clever characters might help the hags break into Zorhanna's vault, then betray the hags and claim the {@item shard solitaire|KftGV} for themselves. Similarly, any character who took Mettle's {@item hag eye|MM} can trade it for the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, since the hags don't want to suffer the consequences of their {@item hag eye|MM} being destroyed.
zh_tw: 在帕利塞特莊園中，角色們可能會遇到失落女巫團，因為這些女巫正在尋找{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}項鍊。只要女巫團體能夠保留{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}，她們願意與角色們達成協議。聰明的角包可能會幫助女巫們闖入佐哈娜的金庫，然後背叛女巫們，併為自己索取{@item shard solitaire|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。同樣，任何拿到勇氣的{@item hag eye|MM|鬼婆之眼}的角色都可以用它來交換{@item hag eye|MM|鬼婆之眼}，因為女巫們不想承受她們的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}被摧毀的後果。

english: If a night hag is reduced to 50 hit points or fewer, it uses {@spell plane shift} to flee. If two members of the coven are forced to flee in this manner, the third flees as well.
zh_tw: 如果一個夜巫婆的生命值降至50點或更少，她會使用{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}來逃跑。如果巫婆會的兩個成員以這種方式被迫逃跑，第三個也會逃跑。

english: The Solitaire Cracks
zh_tw: 索利塔裡裂縫

english: At some point before the end of the adventure, the Far Realm entity finally breaks free of the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, causing it to crack like a walnut. Here are some suggestions for when this event might occur:
zh_tw: 在冒險結束之前的某個時刻，遙遠國度的實體最終從{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}中掙脫出來，導致它像核桃一樣裂開。以下是這一事件可能發生時的一些建議：

english: {@dice 1d8} hours after the characters return to the Material Plane with the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} in their possession
zh_tw: 角色們帶著{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}返回物質位面後的{@dice 1d8}小時

english: If the characters are trapped in {@area area P20|4af|x} with the Far Realm entity and have no means of escape
zh_tw: 如果角色們被困在{@area 區域P20|4af|x}與遙遠國度實體一起，並且沒有辦法逃脫

english: After the night hags obtain the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} but before they can use their {@spell plane shift} spells to escape with it
zh_tw: 在夜巫婆們獲得{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}但在她們能夠使用她們的{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術帶著它逃跑之前

english: The cracking of the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} is audible to anyone holding or wearing it. In that instant, the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} becomes a flawed, nonmagical diamond worth 500 gp, and all the creatures and extradimensional energy contained within it are released at once. If Zorhanna is alive, she materializes in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the stone, as do any characters who were trapped in the stone with her. The Far Realm entity is nowhere to be seen, and its presence can no longer be felt.
zh_tw: {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的破裂聲可以被任何持有或佩戴它的人聽到。在那一瞬間，{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}變成了一個有瑕疵的非魔法鑽石，價值500金幣，它內部包含的所有生物和超維度能量都會一次性釋放出來。如果佐哈娜還活著，她會在距離石頭30尺內的未被佔據的空間中物質化，和她一起被困在石頭中的任何角色也會如此。來自遙遠國度的實體無處可見，它的存在也不再能被感覺到。

english: The extradimensional energy released from the stone has the same effect as a {@item Staff of Power||staff of power's} Retributive Strike property, centered on the stone itself. The explosion occurs a split second before creatures trapped inside the stone are released, sparing them from the effect.
zh_tw: 從石頭釋放出的超維度能量具有與{@item Staff of Power||威力法杖}的反擊打擊屬性相同的效果，以石頭本身為中心。爆炸發生在被困在石頭內的生物被釋放的瞬間之前，使它們免受效果影響。

english: If the characters placed the uncracked stone in the extradimensional space of a magic item such as a {@item bag of holding} or Fifel's {@item Heward's Handy Haversack||haversack}, the explosion is confined to that item's extradimensional space, doing no harm to the container; a split second later, creatures released from the stone appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of that container, rather than inside its extradimensional space near the stone itself.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將未裂開的石頭放置在魔法物品的超維度空間中，例如一個{@item bag of holding||次元袋}或菲菲爾的{@item Heward's Handy Haversack||揹包}，爆炸將被限制在該物品的超維度空間內，不會對容器造成傷害；在爆炸發生後的一瞬間，從石頭中釋放的生物將出現在距離該容器30尺內的未佔據空間中，而不是出現在容器的超維度空間中靠近石頭本身的地方。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: After the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} cracks, assuming they survive, the characters can take stock of their triumphs or failures.
zh_tw: 在{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}裂開之後，假設他們倖存下來，角色們可以評估他們的勝利或失敗。

english: Midwinter Miracles
zh_tw: 冬至奇蹟

english: If Zorhanna and Eliphas are reunited and the characters did their utmost to protect Paliset Hall and its guests, Eliphas sees that the characters receive their promised reward. If they already helped themselves to the magic items on display in the art gallery ({@area area P6|486|x}), Eliphas considers their reward paid in full.
zh_tw: 如果佐哈娜和伊萊法斯重聚，並且角色們盡了最大努力保護帕利塞特莊園及其客人，伊萊法斯會確保角色們得到他們應得的獎勵。如果他們已經自行取走了在美術館（{@area 區域P6|486|x}）展出的魔法物品，伊萊法斯會認為他們的獎勵已經完全支付。

english: If one or more characters died but Zorhanna survived, she makes arrangements with the Summer Queen, a powerful archfey, to have the characters brought back to life at no charge to the party, provided the characters didn't commit any despicable acts she's aware of. If Zorhanna perished but Eliphas survived, he calls in a few favors to raise characters from the dead.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色死亡，但佐哈娜倖存下來，她會與一位強大的精類——夏之女王達成安排，讓角色們免費復活，前提是這些角色沒有做出她所知道的任何卑鄙行為。如果佐哈娜死亡但伊萊法斯倖存下來，他會利用一些人情來讓角色們從死亡中復活。

english: Back in Loch Wynnis
zh_tw: 回到洛奇·溫尼斯

english: When the characters return to Loch Wynnis, Fifel greets them and asks about their visit to the Feywild. If they need to borrow his {@item Heward's handy haversack} to safely contain and transport the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, he empties it and hands it to them.
zh_tw: 當角色們返回溫尼斯湖時，菲菲爾迎接他們並詢問他們對妖精荒野的訪問情況。如果他們需要借用他的{@item Heward's handy haversack||霍華德便利袋}來安全地存放和運輸{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}，他會清空揹包並遞給他們。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the organization rewards them only if Eliphas and Zorhanna both survived, no innocent lives were lost in Paliset Hall, and the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} didn't end up in the clutches of the Crestfall Coven. A Golden Vault operative offers the characters a rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as a reward, which is delivered the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，只有在伊萊法斯和佐哈娜都倖存下來，帕利塞特莊園中沒有無辜的生命喪失，並且{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}沒有落入失落女巫團之手的情況下，組織才會獎勵他們。一位金庫的特工提供給角色們一個他們選擇的稀有魔法物品作為獎勵（需經你同意），該物品將在第二天送達。

english: It Came from the Far Realm
zh_tw: 它來自遙遠國度

english: What happens to the Far Realm entity is for you to decide. As a thing of pure thought, it might corrupt creatures in its vicinity, transforming them into horrible Aberrations or zealous Far Realm cultists. Conversely, it might find solace in the body of some creature powerful enough to serve as its new host.
zh_tw: 遙遠國度實體的命運由你來決定。作為一個純粹思想的生物，它可能會腐蝕其附近的生物，將它們轉變為可怕的異怪或狂熱的遙遠國度邪教徒。相反，它也可能在某個足夠強大的生物體內找到慰藉，作為它的新宿主。

english: Secrets of the Shard Solitaire
zh_tw: 碎片獨奏的秘密

english: Long ago, someone dropped a {@item bag of holding} full of jewels into a {@item portable hole}, creating an explosive portal to the Astral Plane. A 5,000 gp diamond contained within the bag absorbed some of the portal's volatile energy and became the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire} featured in this adventure.
zh_tw: 很久以前，有人把裝滿寶石的{@item bag of holding||次元袋}掉進了一個{@item portable hole||次元洞}，從而創造了一個通往星界爆炸性的傳送門。袋子裡含有的一顆價值5000金幣的鑽石吸收了傳送門的一部分不穩定能量，變成了這次冒險中的特色物品{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}。

english: The same Far Realm entity that wormed its way into the {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire's} extradimensional rift has also attuned to the stone. The entity can't do anything with the stone other than what it has already done to {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV} (as described in this adventure). When the entity escapes the rift, the stone cracks and becomes nonmagical.
zh_tw: 那個鑽進{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|鑽石孤鑽的}超維度裂縫的同一遙遠國度實體也與這塊石頭同步了。除了對{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}已經做的（如本冒險所述）之外，這個實體不能對石頭做任何事情。當實體從裂縫中逃脫時，石頭會裂開並變成非魔法物品。

english: Although the characters never get the chance to wield the power of Zorhanna's {@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|shard solitaire}, other {@item Shard Solitaire|KftGV|such items} are scattered throughout the multiverse, waiting to be found.
zh_tw: 儘管角色們沒有機會使用佐哈娜的{@item Shard Solitaire (Diamond)|KftGV|碎晶掛飾}的力量，但其他類似的{@item Shard Solitaire|KftGV|這類物品}散佈在多元宇宙中，等待著被發現。

english: Fire and Darkness
zh_tw: 火與黑暗

english: {@i An Adventure for 11th-Level Characters}
zh_tw: {@i 一場適合11級角色的冒險}

english: For centuries, a powerful efreeti named Vrakir sent his armies against numerous foes and burned countless cities to ash. Now, the tyrant has found an artifact of unimaginable evil: the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀以來，一個名叫弗拉基爾的強大火巨靈派遣他的軍隊對抗無數敵人，將無數城市燒成灰燼。現在，這個暴君找到了一個難以想象的邪惡神器：{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。

english: In this heist, the heroes must infiltrate Brimstone Hold, the prison-fortress where Vrakir has locked away the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}, and escape with the efreeti's prize. The characters' contact is an arcanaloth named Nebukath, the hold's duplicitous administrator, who secretly covets the book and plans to betray the heroes as soon as the group recovers it.
zh_tw: 在這次劫案中，英雄們必須潛入硫磺堡，這是弗拉基爾關押{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}的監獄堡壘，並帶著伊夫利提的戰利品逃脫。角色們的聯絡人是一個名叫內布卡斯的奧法羅斯魔，這座堡壘的奸詐管理員，他暗中覬覦這本書，並計劃在小組找到它後立即背叛英雄們。

english: An efreeti's fortress holds the Book of Vile Darkness. Good luck storming this castle
zh_tw: 一個伊夫利特的堡壘中藏有邪惡黑暗之書。祝你好運，攻佔這座城堡

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: Vrakir obtained the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} by accident. The efreeti knew the red dragon Drendarylix laired only a few days' ride from Brimstone Hold, one of Vrakir's fortresses. Many adventurers over the years tried to slay the foul creature, which had attacked and looted nearby villages for decades. One day, word reached Vrakir that Drendarylix had been slain but that the dragon's vanquishers had also perished in the battle. Thinking the lair would be easy to plunder, Vrakir set off with a contingent of warriors to claim its riches.
zh_tw: 弗拉基爾偶然獲得了{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。這個火巨靈知道紅龍德倫達里克斯的巢穴位於離硫磺堡——弗拉基爾的堡壘之一——只有幾天路程的地方。多年來，許多冒險者試圖殺死這個邪惡的生物，它已經攻擊並掠奪附近村莊數十年了。有一天，訊息傳到弗拉基爾那裡，德倫達里克斯已被殺死，但擊敗它的英雄們也在戰鬥中喪生。弗拉基爾認為這個巢穴將容易被掠奪，於是帶領一隊戰士出發去奪取它的財富。

english: When he arrived, however, Vrakir learned the truth: the adventurers who had supposedly slain Drendarylix were cultists who had arrived to worship the wicked beast. Worse, the cult was conducting a ritual to turn Drendarylix into a dracolich.
zh_tw: 然而，當弗拉基爾到達時，他得知了真相：那些據說殺死了德倫達里克斯的冒險家其實是來崇拜這個邪惡野獸的邪教徒。更糟糕的是，邪教正在進行一個儀式，將德倫達里克斯變成一條龍巫妖。

english: Displeased with the idea of a dracolich on his doorstep, Vrakir slew the cultists before they could finish the ritual, destroying Drendarylix in the process. Only once the dust settled did the efreeti learn what had given the cultists their power: the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}. Without hesitation, Vrakir claimed the artifact, taking it to Brimstone Hold to plot how best to use it to fuel his evil.
zh_tw: 弗拉基爾對於家門口出現一個龍巫妖的想法感到不悅，在那些邪教徒完成儀式之前就將他們殺害了，在此過程中也摧毀了德倫達里克斯。直到塵埃落定，這個火巨靈才發現是什麼賦予了邪教徒他們的力量：{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。弗拉基爾毫不猶豫地聲稱了這件神器，並將其帶回硫磺堡，策劃如何最好地利用它來助長他的邪惡。

english: Hooks and Rewards
zh_tw: 鉤子和獎勵

english: If you're not using the Golden Vault as the characters' patron (see the "{@area Using the Golden Vault|4c8|x}" section), you can use one of the following hooks to get the characters involved in the adventure.
zh_tw: 如果您不使用金庫作為角色的贊助人（見"使用金庫"部分{@area 使用金庫|4c8|x}），您可以使用以下之一的鉤子讓角色參與到冒險中。

english: Close to Home
zh_tw: 接近家園

english: Vrakir has set his mind to conquering the characters' homeland. The region's brave defenders have rebuffed his army's initial assaults, but they stand little chance of holding out once Vrakir unleashes the fell power of the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}.
zh_tw: 弗拉基爾決心征服角色們的家園。該地區的勇敢捍衛者已經擊退了他的軍隊的初步攻擊，但是一旦弗拉基爾釋放了{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}的可怕力量，他們幾乎沒有機會繼續抵抗。

english: Syr Isbeth, the human leader of the defense effort, received a missive from the arcanaloth Nebukath professing the arcanaloth's sympathies for her cause and providing information about the book's location. Syr Isbeth doesn't know whether Nebukath can be trusted, but stealing the book would stymie Vrakir's war effort—it's too good an opportunity to pass up. She asks the characters to undertake this perilous mission, promising them the title to a regional stronghold, along with its retinue of five {@creature Knight||knights} and one hundred {@creature Guard||guards}, if they bring her the book or proof of its destruction.
zh_tw: 伊絲貝絲爵士，防禦工作的人類領袖，收到了來自奧法羅斯魔使內布卡斯的信函，信中表達了奧法羅斯魔使對她事業的同情，並提供了關於書籍位置的資訊。伊絲貝絲爵士不知道是否可以信任內布卡斯，但竊取這本書將阻礙弗拉基爾的戰爭努力——這是一個不容錯過的良機。她請求角色們承擔這項危險的任務，並承諾如果他們能帶給她這本書或其被摧毀的證據，她將授予他們一個地區要塞的所有權，以及五個{@creature Knight||騎士}和一百個{@creature Guard||警衛}的隨從。

english: A Short Leash
zh_tw: 短鏈

english: The Fated (a faction based in Sigil) has interests throughout the multiverse, and many of them have been disrupted by Vrakir's conquests. The Fated has decided it is time to curtail Vrakir's power, so it contacted the opportunistic arcanaloth Nebukath for information about how to deprive the efreeti of his greatest weapon.
zh_tw: 宿命派（一個以西吉爾為基地的派系）在多元宇宙中有廣泛利益，其中許多因弗拉基爾的征服而受到幹擾。宿命派決定是時候限制弗拉基爾的權力了，所以它聯絡了機會主義的奧術惡魔內布卡斯，以獲取有關如何剝奪火巨靈最大武器的資訊。

english: Farn Bindelbrot, a gnome operative for the Fated, identified the characters as having the skills needed for such a difficult task. Should the characters deliver the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} to Farn, he will reward them with an {@item amulet of the planes}. Farn promises the Fated will then safely secure the book.
zh_tw: 法恩·賓德爾布洛特，一個為宿命派工作的侏儒特工，認定角色們擁有完成這項艱鉅任務所需的技能。如果角色們能將{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}交給法恩，他將用一個{@item amulet of the planes||位面護符}作為獎勵。法恩承諾宿命派隨後將安全地保管這本書。

english: Redemption
zh_tw: 救贖

english: A halfling warlock named Remi Duskweather renounced her pact and dedicated herself to serving a holy order (potentially one connected with a cleric or paladin in the party). As her final test of faith, Remi has been tasked with using her connection to her former patron—the arcanaloth Nebukath—to help the holy order obtain and destroy the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}.
zh_tw: 一個名叫雷米·暮天的半身人魔契師放棄了她的契約，致力於服務於一個神聖的秩序（可能與隊伍中的牧師或聖武士有關）。作為她對信仰的最後考驗，雷米被指派利用她與前贊助者——奧法羅斯魔使內布卡斯的聯絡——來幫助神聖秩序獲得並摧毀{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。

english: Remi has gotten the necessary information from Nebukath, but stealing the book is beyond her ability, so she recruits the characters to carry out this task for the order. Remi offers no reward, but if the characters bring the book or proof of its destruction to the order, each character receives a {@book blessing|DMG|7|Blessings} of their choice, either from the gods they worship or from a god worshiped by Remi's holy order: a {@reward blessing of health}, a {@reward blessing of protection}, or a {@reward blessing of understanding}, all of which are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
zh_tw: 雷米已從內布卡斯取得必要資訊，但偷取這本書超出了她的能力，因此她招募角色替教團執行任務。雷米本人不提供報酬；不過，如果角色將書或其已被摧毀的證據交給教團，每位角色都能從下列{@book 祝福|DMG|7|Blessings}中選擇一項：{@reward blessing of health||健康祝福}、{@reward blessing of protection||護佑祝福}或{@reward blessing of understanding||理解祝福}。祝福可由角色信奉的神祇賜予，也可來自雷米教團所崇拜的神祇；這些祝福皆詳述於{@book 城主指南|DMG}。

english: Using the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 使用金庫

english: If you're using the Golden Vault as a patron, a golden key is delivered to the characters in whatever manner you deem fit, along with a hand-drawn map of Brimstone Fortress (see {@adventure map 13.1|KftGV|13|Map 13.1: Players' Map}).
zh_tw: 如果您使用金庫作為贊助人，金鑰匙會以您認為合適的方式交給角色，同時附上一張手繪的硫磺堡地圖（見{@adventure 地圖 13.1|KftGV|13|Map 13.1: Players' Map}）。

english: When the characters use the golden key to open their music box, the lid pops open and a soothing voice says the following:
zh_tw: 當角色使用金鑰匙開啟他們的音樂盒時，蓋子彈開，一個舒緩的聲音說出了以下內容：

english: "Greetings, operatives. The Golden Vault has learned that an efreeti named Vrakir has the Book of Vile Darkness. We need you to steal this evil artifact so we can destroy it. This quest, should you choose to undertake it, requires you to infiltrate the fortress of Brimstone Hold, where the book is kept.
zh_tw: "問候，特工們。金庫得知一個名叫弗拉基爾的火巨靈擁有《邪惡黑暗之書》。我們需要你們偷取這個邪惡的神器以便我們將其銷燬。這個任務，如果你們選擇接受，需要你們潛入硫磺堡，那裡存放著這本書。"

english: "We obtained a map of the fortress from an informant of ours, an arcanaloth named Nebukath, who works in Brimstone Hold. Nebukath is willing to provide further assistance, but we suspect the arcanaloth has reasons of their own to acquire the book, so be on your guard!
zh_tw: "我們從我們的一個線人那裡獲得了城堡的地圖，這個線人是一個名叫內布卡斯的奧法羅斯魔，他在硫磺堡工作。內布卡斯願意提供進一步的幫助，但我們懷疑這個奧法羅斯魔有他們自己獲取這本書的理由，所以請保持警惕！"

english: "Nebukath is unsure how long Vrakir plans to keep the book in the fortress, meaning time is of the essence. Good luck, operatives."
zh_tw: "內布卡斯不確定弗拉基爾計劃在城堡中保留這本書多久，這意味著時間至關重要。祝好運，特工們。"

english: Closing the music box causes the golden key to vanish.
zh_tw: 關閉音樂盒導致金鑰匙消失。

english: Planning the Heist
zh_tw: 策劃盜竊

english: Once the characters are ready to begin planning the heist, show the players map 13.1. The map arrives via whoever asks the characters to undertake this mission. Written on the backside of the map is the following note in Common:
zh_tw: 一旦角色準備開始策劃這次盜竊行動，就向玩家展示地圖13.1。這張地圖是透過請求角色執行此任務的人送達的。地圖背面用通用語寫著以下便條：

english: This is as detailed a map as I could find. The book's location is marked with an X. Please hurry, as Vrakir could move it at any time. I fear the chaos and destruction he will unleash once he has fully embraced the book's power.—N.
zh_tw: 這是我能找到的最詳細的地圖。書的位置用X標記。請快點，因為弗拉基爾隨時可能移動它。我擔心一旦他完全掌握了書的力量，他將釋放混亂和破壞。——N.

english: The following sections contain information that can help guide the characters as they form their plan. You can provide this information straightforwardly to the players, present it through conversations with the party's patron, or allow characters to use their skills and abilities to research and gather information.
zh_tw: 以下部分包含可以幫助引導角色形成計劃的資訊。您可以直接向玩家提供這些資訊，透過與黨的贊助人的對話呈現，或者允許角色使用他們的技能和能力來研究和收集資訊。

english: Map 13.1: Players' Map
zh_tw: 地圖 13.1: 玩家地圖

english: Brimstone Hold's Inhabitants
zh_tw: 硫磺堡的居民

english: Here's a summary of Brimstone Hold's inhabitants:
zh_tw: 以下是硫磺堡居民的概要：

english: Efreet
zh_tw: 火巨靈

english: Vrakir spends most of his time on the Elemental Plane of Fire, visiting Brimstone Hold only occasionally. In his absence, the hold is under the command of an efreeti named {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}.
zh_tw: 弗拉基爾大部分時間都在火元素位面，偶爾才會訪問硫磺堡。在他缺席時，堡由一個名叫{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}的火巨靈指揮。

english: Nebukath the Arcanaloth
zh_tw: 奧法羅斯魔內布卡斯

english: The characters' map was provided by an arcanaloth named Nebukath, who serves as Brimstone Hold's administrator and is working to undermine Vrakir. If the characters seek out Nebukath in the hold, the arcanaloth may help them.
zh_tw: 角色們手中的地圖是由一個名叫內布卡斯的奧法羅斯魔提供的，他擔任硫磺堡的管理員，並且正在努力破壞弗拉基爾。如果角色們在堡中尋找內布卡斯，這位奧法羅斯魔可能會幫助他們。

english: Various Defenders
zh_tw: 各種守衛

english: The hold is defended by {@creature erinyes} devils (whose {@sense truesight} allows them to see through most forms of magical concealment), duergar, and {@creature Salamander||salamanders}, as well as a {@creature young red dragon} named Kalimrax and a {@creature beholder} known as the Eye of the Efreet.
zh_tw: 堡的防禦由{@creature erinyes||罪魔}魔鬼（他們的{@sense truesight||真實視覺}使他們能夠看穿大多數魔法隱蔽形式）、灰矮人、{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}組成，還有一條名叫卡利姆拉克斯的{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}和被稱為火巨靈之眼的{@creature beholder||眼魔}。

english: Approaching Brimstone Hold
zh_tw: 接近硫磺堡

english: Possible ways to approach the fortress include the following:
zh_tw: 接近堡壘的可能方式包括以下幾點：

english: Across Volcanic Terrain
zh_tw: 穿越火山地形

english: The hold is built inside a rock wall at the foot of a volcano. Lava pours down the volcano's slopes on either side of the hold and forms a molten river that flows around the hold.
zh_tw: 堡建在火山腳下的巖壁內。熔岩沿著堡兩側的山坡傾瀉而下，形成了一條環繞堡的熔岩河。

english: Main Entrance
zh_tw: 正門

english: A stone bridge spans the lava river and leads to the hold's main entrance. The bridge is mostly used by Vrakir's troops, who often return with prisoners in tow, and sometimes visitors who have business with {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} approach this way.
zh_tw: 一座石橋橫跨熔岩河，通向堡的主要入口。這座橋主要由弗拉基爾的部隊使用，他們經常帶著俘虜返回，有時與{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}有業務往來的訪客也會透過這條路線接近。

english: The Harbor
zh_tw: 港口

english: A mile further down the lava river, a chaotic neutral cambion named Klax runs a trading depot that ships supplies to Brimstone Hold. Klax's fire-resistant boats dock at the hold's lava harbor once every ten days. The crews lay over in guest quarters at the hold before departing the following day. (If the characters embark on their mission while Klax's traders are at the hold, the cambion can be found in {@area area B6|4eb|x}.)
zh_tw: 沿著熔岩河再往下一英里，一個混亂中立的坎比翁名叫克拉克斯經營著一個貿易倉庫，向硫磺堡運送物資。克拉克斯的耐火船每十天在堡的熔岩港口停靠一次。船員們在堡的客房休息，然後在第二天離開。（如果角色們在克拉克斯的商人在堡的時候執行他們的任務，這位坎比翁可以在{@area 區域B6|4eb|x}找到。）

english: Additional Considerations
zh_tw: 其他考慮因素

english: Here are some other things for characters to consider as they plan their heist:
zh_tw: 以下是角色在計劃盜竊行動時需要考慮的其他事項：

english: Fire Protection
zh_tw: 火焰防護

english: Many creatures and hazards in the hold deal fire damage.
zh_tw: 堡中的許多生物和危險都會造成火焰傷害。

english: Timing Arrival
zh_tw: 到達時間的安排

english: The characters can time their arrival to coincide with the arrival of a prisoner escort or supply shipment. Timing their arrival to Vrakir's presence or absence is harder, since the efreeti travels to the fortress via the {@spell plane shift} spell. Doing so might first require characters to spy on the hold's activities.
zh_tw: 角色們可以安排他們的到達時間，以與囚犯護送或物資運輸的時間相吻合。安排他們的到達時間以弗拉基爾在場或缺席則更難，因為這位火巨靈是透過{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術來到堡壘的。這樣做可能首先需要角色們監視堡的活動。

english: Avoiding Confrontation
zh_tw: 避免衝突

english: Vrakir is a powerful adversary. The characters are best off avoiding a confrontation with him, at least until the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} is out of his grasp.
zh_tw: 弗拉基爾是一個強大的對手。角色們最好避免與他正面衝突，至少在他失去對{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}的控制之前。

english: Brimstone Hold
zh_tw: 硫磺堡

english: Brimstone Hold is one of Vrakir's remote military outposts on the Material Plane. The adventure assumes the hold is built alongside an active volcano in the middle of a vast lava plain, but you can place the hold in any suitably fiery region in your game's setting.
zh_tw: 硫磺堡是弗拉基爾在物質位面上的一個偏遠軍事前哨。冒險假設堡是建在一座活躍的火山旁邊，位於廣闊的熔岩平原中央，但你可以在你的遊戲設定中將堡放置在任何合適的火山區。

english: Brimstone Hold is bordered on three sides by a river of lava. The hold is enclosed on its eastern edge by a rocky volcanic slope, and the hold's interior areas have been carved into the volcano. The main entrance into the interior has been carved to resemble a giant efreeti face, whose open mouth spews lava into the harbor below.
zh_tw: 硫磺堡三面被熔岩河環繞。堡的東邊被一個多岩石的火山斜坡所包圍，堡的內部區域已經被雕刻進火山內部。進入內部的主要入口被雕刻成一個巨大的火巨靈面孔，其張開的嘴巴將熔岩噴入下方的港口。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The following features are common throughout Brimstone Hold.
zh_tw: 硫磺堡內普遍存在以下特點。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Interior areas have 15-foot-high ceilings, except in areas {@area B22|512|x} and {@area B25|51b|x}–{@area B29|529|x}, where the ceilings are 30 feet high.
zh_tw: 內部區域的天花板高度為15尺，除了在區域{@area b22|512|x}和{@area B25|51b|x}–{@area b29|529|x}，那裡的天花板高度為30尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: All exterior doors are made of solid iron and are barred on the inside. As an action, a character can try to break down a barred door, doing so with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 所有外部門都是由實心鐵製成，並從內部上閂。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試破開上閂的門，這需要透過一次 {@dc 25} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定。

english: Interior doors are made of iron and are unlocked unless the text states otherwise.
zh_tw: 內部門由鐵製成，除非文字另有說明，否則門是未上鎖的。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Each secret door in the fortress is opened by stepping on a tiny pressure plate hidden in the floor nearby. As an action, a character can search the wall for secret doors and make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the check is successful, the character finds the secret door and the pressure plate used to open it.
zh_tw: 要塞中的每一扇密門都需要踩在附近隱藏在地板上的小型壓力板上才能開啟。作為一個動作，角色可以搜尋牆壁尋找密門，並進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會發現密門以及用於開啟它的壓力板。

english: Extreme Heat
zh_tw: 極度高溫

english: Creatures that spend 1 hour or more anywhere in the hold, or sail on the river of lava, are subject to the effects of {@book extreme heat|DMG|5|Extreme Heat} as described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
zh_tw: 在硫磺堡內任何位置停留1小時或更長時間或航行在熔岩河上的生物，將受到{@book 極度高溫|DMG|5|Extreme Heat}的影響，如{@book 城主指南|DMG}中所述。

english: Illumination
zh_tw: 照明

english: Lava bathes the outer areas of the hold in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} even on starless nights, while most of the hold's interior areas are dimly lit by braziers of glowing coals. Exceptions are noted in the text.
zh_tw: 即使在無星的夜晚，熔岩也為貨艙的外部區域提供了{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，而貨艙的大部分內部區域則由發光的煤炭火盆提供微光光照。例外情況在文字中註明。

english: Lava
zh_tw: 熔岩

english: The lava around the hold and in the harbor is 10 feet deep, while the stream of lava pouring from {@area area B22|512|x} is 2 feet deep. Any creature that enters lava for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 圍繞貨艙和在港口的熔岩深度為10尺，而從{@area 區域B22|512|x}流出的熔岩流深度為2尺。任何生物如果在回合中首次進入熔岩或在其回合開始時處於熔岩中，將受到55點（{@dice 10d10}）火焰傷害。

english: Outer Walls
zh_tw: 外牆

english: The hold's 20-foot-thick curtain walls are faced with blocks of carved basalt and filled with a rubble core. The walls on the hold's lower level (bordering areas {@area B4|4e5|x} and {@area B5|4e9|x}) stand 40 feet high, while those on the hold's upper level (bordering {@area area B6|4eb|x}) stand 20 feet high. Crenellations rise another 3 to 8 feet. Scaling a wall without magic or climbing gear requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 據點的20尺厚的幕牆外表面由雕刻的玄武岩塊構成，內部填滿碎石核心。據點下層的牆壁（與區域 {@area B4|4e5|x} 和 {@area B5|4e9|x} 相鄰）高達40尺，而上層的牆壁（與 {@area 區域B6|4eb|x} 相鄰）高20尺。城垛再高出3至8尺。在沒有魔法或攀爬裝備的情況下，攀爬牆壁需要透過一個難度等級為 {@dc 20} 的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Towers
zh_tw: 塔樓

english: Tower walls are 15 feet thick, made of carved basalt, and studded with arrow slits. The towers on the hold's lower level ({@area areas B2a, B2b,|4de|x} and {@area B3|4e2|x}) stand 60 feet high, while those on the hold's upper level (areas {@area B8|4f2|x} and {@area B9|4f4|x}) are 80 feet high. Towers have interior floors every 20 feet, with stone stairs along the inside walls leading between floors. Tower doors shown on the map allow access from ground level. All towers also have doors that open onto the walkways of adjoining curtain walls, as well as trapdoors that open onto the towers' roofs.
zh_tw: 塔牆厚15尺，由雕刻的玄武岩構成，並配有箭縫。堡下層的塔（區域{@area 區域B2a, B2b,|4de|x}和{@area B3|4e2|x}）高60尺，而上層的塔（區域{@area B8|4f2|x}和{@area B9|4f4|x}）高80尺。塔內每20尺就有一層樓，內部牆壁上有石階連線各層。地圖上顯示的塔門允許從地面層進入。所有塔還有門通向相鄰幕牆的步道，以及通往塔頂的活板門。

english: Denizens
zh_tw: 居民

english: The erinyes, duergar, and salamanders that defend the hold are united by their loyalty to Vrakir, but each group otherwise disdains the others. The defenders are slow to assist or seek assistance from members outside their own group.
zh_tw: 保衛堡的罪魔、灰矮人和火蜥蜴因對弗拉基爾的忠誠而團結在一起，但除此之外，每個群體都鄙視其他群體。這些守衛不情願向自己群體之外的成員提供幫助或尋求幫助。

english: Any fights or suspicious activities in the hold are reported to the {@creature efreeti} {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}, who places the defenders on high alert. Even if Vrakir is at the hold, the defenders bring their reports to {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} first, allowing him to deal with any trouble himself rather than risk Vrakir's ire. While on high alert, the hold's inhabitants can't be surprised, and {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} responds personally to any further reports of trouble, arriving after 1 minute with two {@creature Salamander||salamanders} from {@area area B20|50d|x}. After 24 hours with no incidents, the hold goes off high alert.
zh_tw: 堡內任何打鬥或可疑活動都會被報告給{@creature efreeti||火巨靈} {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}，他會將守衛置於高度警戒狀態。即使弗拉基爾在堡內，守衛們也會先將報告交給{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}，讓他自己處理任何麻煩，而不是冒險激怒弗拉基爾。在高度警戒狀態下，堡的居民不會被突襲，而且{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}會親自響應任何進一步的麻煩報告，1分鐘後帶著兩隻來自{@area 區域B20|50d|x}的{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}到達。如果沒有發生任何事件，24小時後堡將解除高度警戒狀態。

english: Visitors
zh_tw: 訪客

english: Klax's traders and Vrakir himself are visitors rather than full-time occupants. You can determine whether Vrakir and the traders are present by rolling a {@dice d10} and a {@dice d20}. A result of 1 or 2 on the {@dice d10} indicates that Vrakir is present. A result of 1 or 2 on the {@dice d20} indicates that Klax and her crew are present.
zh_tw: 克拉克斯的商人和弗拉基爾本人是訪客，而不是長期居住者。你可以透過擲一個{@dice d10}和一個{@dice d20}來決定弗拉基爾和商人是否在場。在{@dice d10}上得到1或2表示弗拉基爾在場。在{@dice d20}上得到1或2表示克拉克斯和她的船員在場。

english: Alternatively, you can decide that Vrakir is either present or absent depending on how challenging you want the heist to be. The efreeti keeps his own schedule, and not even his most trusted servants know when or where he will appear next.
zh_tw: 或者，你可以根據你希望這次盜竊任務的挑戰程度來決定弗拉基爾是在場還是缺席。這位火巨靈有自己的時間表，即使是他最信任的僕人也不知道他下一次何時或在哪裡出現。

english: Brimstone Hold Locations
zh_tw: 硫磺堡地點

english: The following locations are keyed to map 13.2.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應地圖13.2。

english: Map 13.2: DM's Map
zh_tw: 地圖 13.2: 地下城主地圖

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: B1: Bridge
zh_tw: B1. 橋樑

english: A broad stone bridge spans the fiery river, its arches luridly lit from below. Three-foot-high barriers line the causeway's edges, funneling travelers toward the gatehouse of Vrakir's imposing fortress.
zh_tw: 一座寬闊的石橋橫跨著火河，其拱形結構從下方被照亮得十分明亮。三尺高的欄杆排列在堤道的邊緣，引導旅行者走向弗拉基爾城堡的門房。

english: The bridge crosses the lava river at its narrowest point, spanning 300 feet and rising 30 feet above the river's surface. Constructed of heavy basalt blocks, the bridge's piers are plated with iron.
zh_tw: 這座橋在熔岩河最狹窄的地方跨越，跨度為300尺，高出河面30尺。橋由沉重的玄武岩塊建造，其橋墩上覆蓋著鐵板。

english: B2: Gatehouse
zh_tw: B2. 門樓

english: Two mighty towers of black stone flank the fortress's iron gate, while a third tower looms behind it. Fiery orange banners hang from the towers' parapets, rippling in the plumes of heat that rise off the river of lava.
zh_tw: 兩座雄偉的黑色石塔守衛著城堡的鐵門，而第三座塔樓在其後高聳。熔岩河上升騰的熱氣使塔樓的城垛上掛著的火橙色旗幟飄揚。

english: The banners are 20 feet long and emblazoned with Vrakir's symbol—a crown encircling the branches of a tree wreathed in flame—as well his motto, atka ignari (Ignan for "all shall burn").
zh_tw: 這些旗幟長20尺，上面印有弗拉基爾的標誌——一頂環繞著樹枝的皇冠，樹枝被火焰環繞——以及他的座右銘，atka ignari（火族語為"一切都將燃燒"）。

english: Two {@creature erinyes} are stationed on the rooftops of the towers closest to the bridge. If the characters approach the gatehouse and give a sound reason for being here, the erinyes open the way (see "Doors" and "Portcullises" below), escort the characters to {@area area B10|4f6|x}, and announce their presence to the salamanders in {@area area B22|512|x} before returning to their posts.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature erinyes||罪魔}駐守在最靠近橋樑的塔樓屋頂上。如果角色們接近門房並給出了合理的來意，這些罪魔會開啟通道（見下文的"門"和"吊閘"），護送角色們到{@area 區域B10|4f6|x}，並在返回崗位之前向{@area 區域B22|512|x}中的火蜥蜴宣佈他們的到來。

english: When the hold is on high alert, a third {@creature erinyes} from {@area area B15|501|x} takes up position in the gatehouse's rear tower.
zh_tw: 當堡處於高度警戒狀態時，來自{@area 區域B15|501|x}的第三名{@creature erinyes||罪魔}會佔據門房的後塔樓位置。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The entrances from areas {@area B1|4dc|x} and {@area B4|4e5|x} are each protected by an iron double door that stands 20 feet high. The doors are held shut with interlocking iron bars that can be levered up or down as an action from the first floors of the adjoining towers.
zh_tw: 來自區域{@area B1|4dc|x}和{@area B4|4e5|x}的入口各自由一扇20尺高的鐵製雙門保護。這些門被交錯的鐵條固定，可以從相鄰塔樓的一樓作為一個動作來操作鐵條，使其上下移動。

english: Lifting the bars from within the central yard of area B2 requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, while bursting the gates from area B1 or B4 requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Any Medium or smaller creature attempting to force open one of these doors has disadvantage on its ability check to do so.
zh_tw: 從B2區的中央庭院內抬起欄杆需要成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定，而從B1區或B4區爆開大門需要成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。任何中型或更小的生物試圖強行開啟這些門中的一扇，其能力檢定將處於劣勢。

english: Portcullises
zh_tw: 吊閘門

english: The gatehouse's portcullises are so large that they each require two winches to operate, one on the second floor of each adjoining tower, and the two winches must be operated simultaneously. For each winch, it takes 3 actions to raise a portcullis or 1 action to lower it.
zh_tw: 門房的吊閘是如此之大，以至於每個吊閘都需要兩個絞車來操作，一個在每個相鄰塔樓的二樓，而且兩個絞車必須同時操作。對於每個絞車，需要3個動作來升起吊閘，或者1個動作來降下它。

english: As an action, a creature can try to lift a portcullis above its head, doing so with a successful a {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Any Medium or smaller creature attempting to do so has disadvantage on this check.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，一個生物可以嘗試抬起其頭頂的吊門，成功透過一個 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。任何中型或更小的生物嘗試這樣做時，在此檢定中處於劣勢。

english: B3: Prison Tower
zh_tw: B3. 監獄塔

english: A forbidding tower overlooks the yard below, its toothed parapets etched black against the sky's ruddy glow.
zh_tw: 一座令人生畏的塔樓俯瞰著下面的院子，其帶齒的城垛在天空的紅光中顯得漆黑。

english: The {@creature erinyes} stationed here carries a {@item rope of entanglement}, which it uses to ensnare any prisoner who tries to escape.
zh_tw: 駐守在這裡的{@creature erinyes||罪魔}攜帶著一根{@item rope of entanglement||糾纏繩}，它用這根繩索來困住任何試圖逃跑的囚犯。

english: Gruk-Gruk
zh_tw: 格魯克－格魯克

english: Tossed carelessly on the floor of the tower's lowest story is Gruk-Gruk, a rag doll the size of a halfling. It has a goblin's skull for a head. The doll belongs to Yug, the ogre in {@area area B14|4ff|x}. The erinyes stole the doll as an act of cruelty.
zh_tw: 塔樓最底層的地板上隨意扔著格魯克－格魯克，一個半身人大小的布娃娃。它的頭部是一個地精的頭骨。這個娃娃屬於{@area 區域B14|4ff|x}中的食人魔尤格。罪魔偷走了這個娃娃作為一種殘忍的行為。

english: Gruk-Gruk
zh_tw: 格魯克－格魯克

english: B4: Prison Yard
zh_tw: B4. 監獄院子

english: Huge blocks of rough basalt lie scattered about the center of this spacious yard, where ten armored duergar oversee a large number of haggard prisoners. The prisoners are using chisels and mallets to turn the basalt blocks into smaller worked-stone blocks, which are then stacked in piles around the yard's perimeter. The yard's eastern wall is a natural stone cliff, with two entrances carved into the cliff face and secured with heavy iron portcullises.
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的院子中央散佈著巨大的粗糙玄武岩塊，十個裝甲灰矮人監督著一大群疲憊的囚犯。囚犯們正在使用鑿子和錘子將玄武岩塊加工成較小的石塊，然後將這些石塊堆放在院子周圍的一堆堆中。院子的東牆是一面天然的石崖，崖面上雕刻有兩個入口，並用沉重的鐵製吊閘加固。

english: Eighty prisoners ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) labor here under the watchful eyes of ten {@creature duergar}.
zh_tw: 八十名囚犯（{@creature Commoner||平民}）在十名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}的嚴密監視下在這裡勞作。

english: The duergar pay little mind to anyone they believe to be on legitimate business in the hold. However, they don't allow anyone to communicate with the prisoners unless ordered to by one of the efreet. The duergar issue a stern warning the first time anyone makes unapproved contact with a prisoner, and they turn hostile after a second instance, attempting to subdue and capture the offender.
zh_tw: 灰矮人對那些他們認為是在堡內有合法事務的人不太關注。然而，除非是火巨靈的命令，他們不允許任何人與囚犯交流。如果有人第一次未經批准與囚犯接觸，灰矮人會發出嚴厲的警告，並且如果再有第二次，他們會轉為敵對，試圖制服並捕獲違規者。

english: Most of the prisoners are too fearful to speak with visitors, but one prisoner named Venture (chaotic good, tiefling {@creature gladiator}) tries to get the characters' attention, seeing the party's arrival as a golden opportunity to escape. If the characters smuggle her some weapons, rope, and a grappling hook, Venture agrees to start a prison riot (see "Prison Riot" below).
zh_tw: 大多數囚犯過於害怕，不敢與訪客交談，但有一個名叫冒險的囚犯（混亂善良，提夫林{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}）試圖引起角色們的注意，她把團隊的到來視為逃跑的絕佳機會。如果角色們能偷偷給她一些武器、繩子和抓鉤，冒險同意發起一場監獄暴動（見下文的"監獄暴動"）。

english: Portcullises
zh_tw: 吊閘門

english: The passages into the hold's interior are blocked by portcullises. The winch to operate the northern portcullis is accessible from the yard. The winch to operate the southern portcullis is inside the passage leading to {@area area B11|4f9|x}. It takes 3 actions to raise a portcullis or 1 action to lower it using the winch. As an action, a creature can try to lift a portcullis above its head, doing so with a successful a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 通往堡壘內部的通道被落閘封鎖。操作北邊落閘的絞盤可以從院落使用。操作南邊落閘的絞盤位於通往 {@area 區域B11|4f9|x} 的通道內部。使用絞盤需要用3個動作來升起一個落閘，或1個動作來降下它。作為一個動作，一個生物可以嘗試將一個落閘舉過頭頂，成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。

english: Prison Riot
zh_tw: 監獄暴動

english: If either Venture or the characters start a prison riot, all the duergar from areas {@area B11|4f9|x} and {@area B18|508|x} rush to area B4 to quell it. The erinyes in areas {@area B2|4de|x}, {@area B3|4e2|x}, and {@area B8|4f2|x} watch in amusement but don't intervene. If the characters aren't present, it takes the duergar 10 minutes to subdue the rioting prisoners.
zh_tw: 如果冒險或角色們引發了監獄暴動，來自區域{@area B11|4f9|x}和{@area B18|508|x}的所有灰矮人會衝向區域B4以平息暴動。在區域{@area B2|4de|x}、{@area B3|4e2|x}和{@area B8|4f2|x}的罪魔則以娛樂的心態旁觀，但不會幹預。如果角色們不在場，灰矮人需要10分鐘才能鎮壓暴動的囚犯。

english: If the characters return to the prison yard after obtaining the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}, the prisoners start another riot and overcome their captors.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在獲得{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}後返回監獄院子，囚犯們會再次引發暴動並制服他們的俘虜。

english: B5: Inner Yard
zh_tw: B5. 內院

english: This empty yard is hemmed in by a rocky cliff on its eastern edge. A flight of stairs has been carved into the cliff face leading to the top, while a doorway at the base of the steps is set into the stone.
zh_tw: 這個空蕩蕩的院子東邊被岩石峭壁所環繞。一組樓梯被雕刻在峭壁上，通向頂部，同時在樓梯底部的岩石中嵌入了一個門道。

english: Behind the door at the base of the stairs is a long tunnel that leads to areas {@area B11|4f9|x} and {@area B15|501|x}–{@area B19|50b|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯底部的門後面是一條長長的隧道，通往區域{@area B11|4f9|x}和{@area B15|501|x}–{@area B19|50b|x}。

english: B6: Upper Yard
zh_tw: B6. 上層院子

english: The large, horseshoe-shaped upper yard wraps around the harbor in its center. Sturdy wooden cranes to the west overlook the quay below, while the eastern side houses small outbuildings. Towering over the eastern edge of the yard is the volcano's ash-covered slope, featuring a giant efreeti face carved from the stone and spewing lava from its mouth.
zh_tw: 這個大型的馬蹄形上院環繞著中心的港口。西側堅固的木製起重機俯瞰著下面的碼頭，而東側則是一些小附屬建築。在院子的東側邊緣高聳的是覆蓋著火山灰的火山斜坡，上面雕刻著一個巨大的火巨靈面孔，從它的口中噴出熔岩。

english: The upper yard is patrolled by a {@creature young red dragon} named Kalimrax. The dragon guards the fortress against aerial assault, but attacks from the air are few and far between. Kalimrax spends most of her time prowling about the harbor, idly threatening to devour any dockhands working there.
zh_tw: 上院由一條名叫卡利姆拉克斯的{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}巡邏。這條龍守衛著堡壘以抵禦空中攻擊，但空中攻擊很少見。卡利姆拉克斯大部分時間在港口巡邏，隨意威脅要吞噬那裡工作的碼頭工人。

english: Kalimrax finds her task incredibly dull and looks to the hold's occasional visitors to provide some interest. The dragon interrogates newcomers, hoping to hear something other than the same tales of conquest Vrakir's armies always tell. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check can command Kalimrax's rapt attention for up to 1 hour. The dragon threatens to eat any character who fails to hold her interest.
zh_tw: 卡利姆拉克絲覺得她的任務極其無聊，並希望在堡壘的偶爾來訪者中找到一些樂趣。這條巨龍會審問新來的人，希望能聽到一些與弗拉基爾軍隊講述的征服故事不同的東西。一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定的角色可以吸引卡利姆拉克絲的全神貫注長達1小時。巨龍威脅說，任何無法引起她興趣的角色她都要吃掉。

english: Kalimrax attacks any character she sees trying to enter the hold by stealth or by force, but she doesn't pursue characters into the hold's interior. If reduced to 50 hit points or fewer, Kalimrax retreats to her lair in {@area area B10|4f6|x}.
zh_tw: 卡利姆拉克斯會攻擊任何她看到的試圖透過潛行或武力進入堡的角色，但她不會追擊角色進入堡的內部。如果卡利姆拉克斯的生命值降至50點或更少，她會撤退到她在{@area 區域B10|4f6|x}的巢穴。

english: Cranes
zh_tw: 起重機

english: Three large, wooden cranes extend over the harbor. They are used to lift cargo unloaded from the boats in area B7 to the upper yard for transport to areas B19 and B21. The cranes' platforms also provide the only means for dockhands and traders to move between area B6 and area B7, 40 feet below. A creature can use an action to raise or lower the crane's platform 5 feet. Each crane can support up to 5,000 pounds.
zh_tw: 三臺大型木製起重機延伸在港口上方。它們用於將從區域B7的船隻上卸下的貨物提升到上院，以便運輸到區域B19和B21。起重機的平臺還提供了碼頭工人和商人在B6區域和下方40尺的B7區域之間移動的唯一手段。一個生物可以用一個動作將起重機的平臺提升或降低5尺。每臺起重機可以支撐高達5000磅的重量。

english: Outbuildings
zh_tw: 附屬建築

english: The yard's four outbuildings have 2-foot-thick walls of basalt blocks and 10-foot-high ceilings roofed with slate. The smaller buildings (area B6a) are littered with ropes and loading hooks and contain stairwells that lead to the hold's main storage rooms (areas {@area B19|50b|x} and {@area B21|50f|x}). The larger buildings (area B6b) each contain a dozen cots and serve as quarters for the hold's visitors, most frequently Klax and her traders.
zh_tw: 院子的四個附屬建築有2尺厚的玄武岩牆壁和10尺高的石板屋頂。較小的建築（區域B6a）裡散佈著繩索和裝卸鉤，並且包含通往堡主儲藏室（區域{@area B19|50b|x}和{@area b21|50f|x}）的樓梯。較大的建築（區域B6b）每個包含一打簡易床，用作堡的訪客宿舍，最常住的是克拉克斯和她的商人。

english: If the characters arrive at the hold while the traders are present, one of the larger buildings is inhabited by Klax (chaotic neutral {@creature cambion}) and eight traders ({@creature Commoner||commoners}). The traders are indifferent to the characters, although Klax is protective of her business arrangement with {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} and turns in the party to the hold's defenders if the characters seem likely to threaten that arrangement.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在商人在場時到達堡，其中一個較大的建築被克拉克斯（混亂中立的{@creature cambion||坎比翁}）和八名商人（{@creature Commoner||平民}）佔據。商人們對角色們漠不關心，儘管克拉克斯對她與{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}的商業安排很保護，如果角色們看起來可能會威脅到這一安排，她會將團隊交給堡的守衛。

english: B7: Harbor
zh_tw: B7. 港口

english: At the stronghold's center is a harbor of lava connected by an inlet to the main river. A quay along the harbor's western edge is lined with iron mooring posts, while wooden cranes tower overhead. At the eastern edge, a stream of lava cascades into the harbor from the cliff above.
zh_tw: 在堡壘中心是一個與主河相連的熔岩港。港口西邊的碼頭邊排列著鐵製系船柱，而木製起重機在頭頂上方高聳。在東側，一股熔岩流從上方的懸崖傾瀉進港口。

english: The harbor is primarily used by Klax's traders to make their regular supply runs. The traders unload their cargo onto the platforms suspended by the cranes, allowing for transport to the yard above.
zh_tw: 這個港口主要由克拉克斯的商人用來進行他們的定期補給運輸。商人們將貨物解除安裝到由起重機懸掛的平臺上，從而方便運輸到上面的院子。

english: Boats
zh_tw: 船隻

english: If the characters arrive while the traders are at the hold, two boats are moored at the quay. The boats are 30 feet long and 10 feet wide, with wooden decks and iron-plated hulls fashioned to resemble dragon turtles. The boats are magically immune to fire damage and remain cool to the touch, even when floating in lava. Each boat has six flipper-shaped iron paddles protruding from its hull, which are controlled by levers on the boat's deck.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在商人在堡的時候到達，兩艘船將停靠在碼頭。這些船長30尺，寬10尺，有木製甲板和鐵板船體，設計成類似龍龜的形狀。這些船對火焰傷害有魔法免疫，並且即使在熔岩中漂浮時也能保持觸感涼爽。每艘船的船體上都有六個像魚鰭形狀的鐵質槳片突出，這些槳片可以透過船甲板上的操縱桿進行控制。

english: B8: Cliff Towers
zh_tw: B8. 懸崖塔樓

english: These two towers stand at opposite ends of the fortress's high rock platform. Each one can be described as follows:
zh_tw: 這兩座塔樓位於堡壘高岩石平臺的兩端。每座塔樓可以描述如下：

english: This imposing tower is buttressed by the stone cliffs of the stronghold's upper level. Its battlements have a commanding view of the hold's upper and lower yards.
zh_tw: 這座令人印象深刻的塔樓由堡壘上層的石崖支撐。其城垛可以俯瞰堡的上院和下院。

english: One {@creature erinyes} is on guard in each of these towers, occasionally leaving the tower to walk the battlements of the adjoining curtain walls. Each erinyes is hostile to anyone attempting to climb the outer walls but is otherwise indifferent to the goings-on in the yards below.
zh_tw: 每座塔樓中都有一名{@creature erinyes||罪魔}在守衛，他們偶爾會離開塔樓，沿著相鄰幕牆的城垛行走。每個罪魔對任何試圖攀爬外牆的人都持敵對態度，但對下方院子裡的事務則漠不關心。

english: B9: Harbor Towers
zh_tw: B9. 港口塔樓

english: Two mighty towers flank the entrance to the fortress's harbor. A great steel chain stretches between the towers, barring access from the lava river beyond.
zh_tw: 兩座雄偉的塔樓守衛著堡壘港口的入口。一條巨大的鋼鏈橫跨在塔樓之間，阻擋了來自外部熔岩河的通道。

english: Two {@creature erinyes} guard access to the harbor, one in each tower. These guards are hostile to anyone attempting to enter or leave the hold via the river without {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}'s approval. The erinyes admit Klax and her traders after a cursory inspection of their cargo, although the erinyes become suspicious if the traders aren't following their usual schedule.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature erinyes||罪魔}守衛著通往港口的入口，每座塔樓中各有一個。這些守衛對任何未經{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}批准就試圖透過河流進入或離開堡的人都持敵對態度。在對貨物進行簡單檢查後，罪魔允許克拉克斯和她的商人進入，儘管如果商人沒有按照他們通常的時間錶行事，罪魔會變得懷疑。

english: Each tower contains a large winch for raising and lowering the chain that controls access to the harbor. The chain is effective only if both sides are raised, and it takes 3 actions to fully raise or lower one end of the chain.
zh_tw: 每座塔內都裝有一個大型絞盤，用於升起和降下控制港口通道的鏈條。鏈條只有在兩端都升起時才有效，完全升起或降下鏈條的一端需要3個動作。

english: B10: Efreeti Face
zh_tw: B10. 火巨靈之面

english: Carved into the slope of the volcano is the enormous visage of a scowling efreeti. A stream of lava issues from the efreeti's open mouth, falling to the yard below, where it pools before spilling into the harbor.
zh_tw: 在火山斜坡上雕刻著一個怒容滿面的伊夫裡特的巨大面容。一股熔岩從伊夫裡特張開的嘴裡流出，落到下面的院子裡，在流入港口之前彙整合池。

english: The efreeti's mouth is the main entrance to the hold's interior and is primarily used by Vrakir and {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}, who can easily navigate its 20-foot elevation above the yard. A steel chain ladder coiled in a corner of the efreeti's mouth can be lowered to allow access for non-flying creatures.
zh_tw: 伊夫利提的嘴巴是通往要塞內部的主要入口，主要由弗拉基爾和{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}使用，他們可以輕鬆地越過庭院上方20尺的高度。伊夫利提的嘴巴角落裡卷著的鋼鏈梯可以放下來，以便非飛行生物進入。

english: Above the carved efreeti face, a fissure in the volcano's slope leads into a small cave not visible from the stronghold below. Kalimrax lairs here, returning for a few hours every evening to rest and check on her hoard, which consists of the plunder Vrakir allows her to take as payment for her service.
zh_tw: 在雕刻的火巨靈面孔上方，火山斜坡上的一條裂縫通向一個從下面的要塞看不見的小洞穴。卡利姆拉克斯在這裡棲息，每天晚上回來幾個小時休息並檢查她的寶藏，這些寶藏由弗拉基爾允許她作為對她服務的報酬所掠奪的物品組成。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Kalimrax's lair contains 14,213 sp, 7,029 gp, 923 pp, eighteen gemstones (500 gp each), a fan made of couatl feathers (1,250 gp), a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon||figurine of wondrous power (bronze griffon)}, and a {@item mace of terror}.
zh_tw: 卡利姆拉克斯的巢穴包含14,213枚銀幣，7,029枚金幣，923枚鉑金幣，十八顆寶石（每顆500金幣），一把由羽蛇羽毛製成的扇子（1,250金幣），一個{@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon||奇妙的青銅獅鷲雕像}，以及一根{@item mace of terror||恐懼之錘}。

english: B11: Guard Room
zh_tw: B11. 警衛室

english: This small chamber is lit by a glowing brazier and furnished only with a pair of iron stools sitting next to a stone block that serves as a crude table.
zh_tw: 這個小房間由一個發光的火盆照亮，陳設簡陋，只有一對鐵凳子放在一個充當粗糙桌子的石塊旁邊。

english: Two {@creature duergar} are always on guard here. They react with suspicion toward the characters, as visitors don't usually come through this area, and become hostile if the characters attempt to force their way to or from {@area area B4|4e5|x}.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}在守衛。他們對角色們持懷疑態度，因為訪客通常不會經過這個區域，如果角色們試圖強行進入或從{@area 區域B4|4e5|x}離開，他們會變得敵對。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A pressure plate in the corner of the floor behind the brazier opens a secret door leading to area B12.
zh_tw: 在火盆後面地板角落的一個壓力板開啟了一個通往區域B12的秘密門。

english: B12: Secret Passage
zh_tw: B12. 秘密通道

english: This hidden corridor has a secret door at each end of it.
zh_tw: 這個隱藏的走廊在兩端各有一個秘密門。

english: The floor of this darkened corridor is coated with a fine layer of black dust, and the air is stale and hot.
zh_tw: 這個昏暗走廊的地板上覆蓋著一層細薄的黑色灰塵，空氣悶熱且不新鮮。

english: The duergar created this passage to access the cells in case the prisoners ever managed to take control of the prison yard. The passage has never seen use, and Brimstone Hold's other defenders don't know it exists. The secret doors at each end are readily visible from inside the hallway and don't require an ability check to find.
zh_tw: 這個通道是灰矮人為了在囚犯們控制監獄院子的情況下能夠進入牢房而建造的。這個通道從未被使用過，而且硫磺堡的其他守衛並不知道它的存在。走廊兩端的秘密門從走廊內部很容易看到，不需要進行屬性檢定就能找到。

english: B13: Prison Cells
zh_tw: B13. 監獄牢房

english: The door to this chamber bolts from the outside. Inside, bundles of rags have been gathered into squalid sleeping pallets.
zh_tw: 這間房間的門可以從外面上鎖。裡面，成捆的破布被收集起來做成了簡陋的睡墊。

english: At night, twenty prisoners ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) sleep in these cells. During the day, the cells are empty.
zh_tw: 晚上，二十名囚犯（{@creature Commoner||平民}）在這些牢房裡睡覺。白天，牢房是空的。

english: B14: Large Prison Cell
zh_tw: B14. 大型監獄牢房

english: The door to this chamber bolts from the outside. Inside, a pile of sackcloth and bones lies in one corner of the otherwise bare room, and the air is thick with the stench of filth. Sobbing on the filthy mound is an ogre wearing a loincloth.
zh_tw: 這間房間的門可以從外面上鎖。裡面，一堆麻袋布和骨頭堆放在房間的一角，房間裡除了這些外別無他物，空氣中瀰漫著汙穢的惡臭。在骯髒的堆上哭泣的是一個穿著腰布的食人魔。

english: A chaotic neutral {@creature ogre} named Yug occupies this cell. For the past three days, Yug has been confined here for breaking a duergar's arm in anger over the theft of Gruk-Gruk, a crude rag doll.
zh_tw: 一個混亂中立的食人魔{@creature ogre||食人魔}名叫尤格，佔據了這個牢房。在過去的三天裡，因為憤怒地打斷了一個灰矮人的手臂，作為對偷走格魯克－格魯克——一個簡陋的布娃娃——的報復，尤格一直被關押在這裡。

english: Yug is initially wary of the characters but becomes talkative if they seem sympathetic to his plight. If the characters find and return Gruk-Gruk to Yug, the ogre happily aids them in any way he can.
zh_tw: 尤格最初對角色們持謹慎態度，但如果他們對他的困境表現出同情，他就會變得很健談。如果角色們找到並把格魯克－格魯克還給尤格，這位食人魔就會高興地以任何方式幫助他們。

english: B15: Erinyes Barracks
zh_tw: B15. 罪魔營房

english: The floor of this chamber is covered in smoldering cinders, heating the room like an oven. Several chain hammocks are slung from the walls.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上覆蓋著正在悶燒的餘燼，像烤箱一樣加熱著房間。幾副鏈式吊床懸掛在牆上。

english: Three {@creature erinyes} lounge in their hammocks here, resting between shifts patrolling the walls. The erinyes are immediately suspicious of the characters, as visitors don't usually come here. Unless the characters provide a compelling reason for their intrusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check, the erinyes try to capture the characters for questioning.
zh_tw: 三位{@creature erinyes||罪魔}在這裡的吊床上休息，她們正在輪班巡邏城牆的間隙中。這些復仇女神立即對角色們產生了懷疑，因為訪客通常不會來到這裡。除非角色們能提供一個令人信服的理由解釋他們的闖入，併成功透過一個{@dc 20}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，否則復仇女神們會試圖抓住角色們進行審問。

english: B16: Common Room
zh_tw: B16. 公共休息室

english: This room is furnished with two long trestle tables and several benches. Tin plates and cups are set on one of the tables next to several barrels with iron spigots jutting from their sides.
zh_tw: 這個房間配備了兩張長條桌和幾條長凳。一個桌子上放著錫制盤子和杯子，旁邊是幾個側面伸出鐵龍頭的酒桶。

english: The duergar take their meals here. All but one of the barrels contain water. The last barrel holds dregs of sour beer.
zh_tw: 灰矮人在這裡用餐。除了一個桶外，其餘的桶裡都裝著水。最後一個桶裝著酸啤酒的殘渣。

english: B17: Kitchen
zh_tw: B17. 廚房

english: A large iron stove occupies one side of this room, while a workbench stands against the opposite wall. Sacks of flour and baskets of tubers are piled in the corners. Two gray-skinned dwarves use iron spoons to sip from a stewpot, then begin arguing.
zh_tw: 這個房間的一側有一個大型鐵爐，而對面的牆上則放著一個工作臺。角落裡堆放著麵粉袋和籃子裡的塊根。兩個灰皮膚的矮人用鐵勺從燉鍋裡舀湯喝，然後開始爭吵。

english: Two {@creature duergar} are busily preparing the hold's next meal: tuber stew. They are arguing about how spicy the stew ought to be. If the duergar notice the party, they assume the characters are members of Klax's crew and start instructing them where to put the new supplies. Only if the characters ignore the cooks' instructions do the duergar become suspicious, attacking while shouting to the duergar in area B18 if the characters can't justify their presence.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature duergar||灰矮人}正忙著準備堡裡的下一頓餐點：塊根燉菜。他們正在爭論燉菜應該有多辣。如果灰矮人注意到隊伍，他們會認為角色們是克拉克斯的船員，並開始指導他們把新補給放在哪裡。只有當角色們忽視廚師的指示時，灰矮人才會變得懷疑，如果角色們不能證明他們的存在合理，灰矮人會邊攻擊邊向區域B18的灰矮人呼喊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The duergar keep a vial of {@item midnight tears} poison (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) among the pots of seasoning on the table.
zh_tw: 灰矮人在桌上的調味品罐中藏有一瓶{@item midnight tears||午夜之淚}毒藥（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。

english: B18: Duergar Barracks
zh_tw: B18. 灰矮人營房

english: This chamber is lined with stone bunks that protrude from the walls. Two iron chests stand in the back corners of the room.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上突出著石制的雙層床鋪。兩個鐵箱放在房間的后角。

english: Six {@creature duergar} are sleeping here on the stone slabs that serve as their beds. They wear their armor and keep their weapons within arm's reach. The sound of normal movement doesn't wake them, but they are roused by the sounds of battle or other loud noises in areas {@area B15|501|x}–{@area B19|50b|x}.
zh_tw: 六名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}正在這裡，躺在作為他們床鋪的石板上睡覺。他們穿著盔甲，武器伸手可及。正常活動的聲音不會吵醒他們，但如果在區域{@area B15|501|x}至{@area B19|50b|x}聽到戰鬥或其他大聲噪音，他們會醒來。

english: The duergar are alarmed if they wake to find the characters here and shout to the duergar in area B17. They demand the characters explain themselves and attack if the characters attempt to escape without giving an account of their presence.
zh_tw: 如果灰矮人醒來發現角色們在這裡，他們會警覺起來，並向區域B17的灰矮人大喊。他們要求角色們解釋自己的行為，如果角色們試圖在不說明自己存在的理由的情況下逃跑，他們會發起攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The iron chests are unlocked. Each chest contains ten spare sets of plain, dwarf-sized clothing. One chest also holds a small black {@item pouch|PHB} containing two eight-sided obsidian dice (50 gp) and a dagger with a malachite blade (250 gp). The other chest also contains a {@item Potion of Fire Resistance||potion of resistance (fire)} in a vial made from a hollowed-out dragon's fang.
zh_tw: 鐵箱沒有上鎖。每個箱子裡都裝有十套普通的矮人尺寸的衣物。其中一個箱子裡還有一個小黑色{@item pouch|PHB|小包}，裡面裝有兩枚八面黑曜石骰子（50金幣）和一把帶有孔雀石刀刃的匕首（250金幣）。另一個箱子裡還裝有一瓶用挖空的龍牙製成的{@item Potion of Fire Resistance||抗火藥水}。

english: B19: Storeroom
zh_tw: B19. 儲藏室

english: Boxes, barrels, crates, and sacks are piled high in this chamber.
zh_tw: 箱子、桶、板條箱和麻袋在這個房間裡堆積如山。

english: This is the fortress's primary storage area. Most of Klax's deliveries are carried here by the dockhands via the staircase from the outbuilding above ({@area area B6a|4eb|x}). The supplies primarily consist of food, water, timber, rope, and raw iron.
zh_tw: 這是堡壘的主要儲藏區。克拉克斯的大部分貨物都是由碼頭工人透過上面的附屬建築（{@area 區域B6a|4eb|x}）的樓梯運到這裡的。供應品主要包括食物、水、木材、繩索和生鐵。

english: B20: Salamander Barracks
zh_tw: B20. 火蜥蜴營房

english: The floor of this room is coated in solidified lava that resembles the undulations of waves on the sea. Lounging between the lava formations are two serpentine creatures with heat ripples and smoke rising from their bodies.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上覆蓋著類似海浪波紋的凝固熔岩。在熔岩形態之間躺著兩個蛇形生物，它們身上冒著熱氣和煙霧。

english: Two {@creature Salamander||salamanders} rest in these barracks, their bodies coiled to nestle into the depressions in the solidified lava. If the characters aren't escorted by other members of the hold, the salamanders assume the characters are a threat and attack immediately.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}在這些營房中休息，它們的身體捲曲著，舒適地躺在凝固熔岩的凹槽裡。如果角色不是由堡內的其他成員陪同，火蜥蜴會認為角色是威脅並立即攻擊。

english: B21: Storeroom
zh_tw: B21. 儲藏室

english: Boxes and crates are neatly stacked along one wall of this chamber, while iron braziers and spare furniture line the opposite wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間的一面牆上整齊地堆放著盒子和板條箱，而另一面牆上則擺放著鐵製火盆和備用傢俱。

english: This storage area contains supplies for the efreet's chambers. The items are delivered by Klax's crew via the staircase from the outbuilding above ({@area area B6a|4eb|x}).
zh_tw: 這個儲藏區存放著伊夫利特（火巨靈）的房間所需的供應品。這些物品是由克拉克斯的團隊透過上面附屬建築的樓梯（{@area 區域B6a|4eb|x}）運送過來的。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the supplies are twelve 20-pound crates of fine silk (1,000 gp each) and a small chest containing six blocks of rich incense (250 gp each).
zh_tw: 供應品中包括十二箱重20磅的上等絲綢（每箱1000金幣）和一個小箱子，裡面裝有六塊濃鬱的香料（每塊250金幣）。

english: B22: Antechamber
zh_tw: B22. 前廳

english: A fountain of lava wells up from the floor of this antechamber, pooling in the room's center before running along a broad channel cut in the stone tile. A walkway along the pool's edge grants access to a grand set of brass doors behind the fountain, as well as to smaller iron doors along the side walls.
zh_tw: 一股熔岩從這個前廳的地板中湧出，在房間中央匯聚成池，然後沿著刻在石磚上的寬闊渠道流動。沿著池邊的步道可以通往熔岩池後面的宏偉銅門，也可以通往側牆上的較小鐵門。

english: Coiled before the brass doors are two serpentine creatures clutching spears. Floating ten feet above them is a spherical creature with a large central eye and ten eyestalks.
zh_tw: 在銅門前盤旋著兩個蛇形生物，它們緊握著長矛。在它們上方十尺處漂浮著一個球形生物，它有一個巨大的中央眼睛和十個眼柄。

english: Two {@creature Salamander||salamanders} stand guard here along with a {@creature beholder} known as the Eye of the Efreet. These creatures are hostile unless the characters arrive with an escort, in which case the characters are directed to area B23 to make an appointment to see {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}. Once the characters proceed to {@area area B25|51b|x}, the salamanders accompany them and remain there for the duration of their visit.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}和被稱為火巨靈之眼的{@creature beholder||眼魔}在這裡站崗。除非角色們有護送人員到來，否則這些生物是敵對的。如果有護送，角色們會被指引到區域B23去預約見{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}。一旦角色們前往{@area 區域B25|51b|x}，火蜥蜴會陪同他們，並在他們的訪問期間一直留在那裡。

english: B23: Administrative Office
zh_tw: B23. 行政辦公室

english: The walls of this office are decorated with paintings depicting an array of otherworldly landscapes. At its center stands a heavy desk engraved with grotesque, fiendish figures, and seated at the desk is a slender, bipedal creature wearing a red robe, a sparkly ring, and a fez. The creature has the head and tawny fur of a fox.
zh_tw: 這個辦公室的牆壁上裝飾著描繪著各種異世界風景的畫作。在中心位置是一個刻有怪異、惡魔形象的沉重書桌，坐在書桌前是一個苗條的兩足生物，穿著紅色長袍，戴著閃亮的戒指和一頂圓筒帽。這個生物有著狐狸的頭部和黃褐色的皮毛。

english: Nebukath the {@creature arcanaloth} sees to the hold's administrative tasks. Nebukath is initially indifferent toward the characters and presumes they have come seeking an audience with {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV}. The arcanaloth languidly informs the characters that the efreeti is too busy to meet with them.
zh_tw: 內布卡斯這個{@creature arcanaloth||奧法羅斯魔}負責堡的行政任務。內布卡斯最初對角色們漠不關心，假設他們是來尋求與{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}的會面。這個奧法羅斯魔懶洋洋地告訴角色們，火巨靈太忙了，無法與他們會面。

english: If the characters reveal their true purpose, Nebukath perks up and excitedly offers to aid them. The arcanaloth knows the routines of all the hold's inhabitants and can provide the characters with an alibi or escort if they need one. However, the terms of its magically binding employment contract prevent Nebukath from taking direct action against Vrakir, his forces, or his property (for example, by attacking the hold's defenders).
zh_tw: 如果角色們透露了他們真正的目的，內布卡斯會興奮地提出幫助他們。這位奧術惡魔知道要塞所有居民的例行公事，並且如果角色們需要，可以為他們提供不在場證明或護送。然而，其魔法約束的僱傭合同的條款阻止內布卡斯直接對弗拉基爾、他的力量或他的財產採取行動（例如，攻擊要塞的防禦者）。

english: If Nebukath discovers the party's purpose, the arcanaloth follows them closely, waiting for the characters to steal the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}. Once the book is in the party's possession, the terms of Nebukath's contract no longer prevent the arcanaloth from seizing the artifact, and Nebukath attempts to steal the book from the characters.
zh_tw: 如果內布卡斯發現了隊伍的目的，這個奧法羅斯魔會緊緊跟隨他們，等待角色們偷取{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}。一旦隊伍擁有了這本書，內布卡斯的合同條款就不再阻止他奪取這件神器，內布卡斯會試圖從角色們那裡偷走這本書。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The office's three paintings are worth 100 gp each, or five times that to a collector of planar antiquities. Nebukath wears a {@item ring of telekinesis} and a platinum brooch set with tourmaline (1,000 gp).
zh_tw: 辦公室裡的三幅畫每幅價值100金幣，或者對於位面古董收藏家來說，價值是這個數字的五倍。內布卡斯戴著一枚{@item ring of telekinesis||心靈遙控戒指}和一個鑲嵌著電氣石的白金胸針（1000金幣）。

english: B24: Nebukath's Chamber
zh_tw: B24. 內布卡斯的房間

english: In this room, a bookshelf and armchair stand alongside a simple bed fitted with silken sheets.
zh_tw: 在這個房間裡，書架和扶手椅與一張配備了絲質床單的簡單床鋪並排擺放。

english: When Nebukath isn't working in area B23, the arcanaloth rests here. A small brass bell attached to a rope in area B26 alerts Nebukath anytime they're needed by the efreet.
zh_tw: 當內布卡斯不在區域B23工作時，這個奧法羅斯魔就在這裡休息。在區域B26的一個小型銅鈴透過一根繩索連線，每當伊夫利特需要內布卡斯時，銅鈴就會發出警報。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A creature can open the secret door leading to {@area area B26|51f|x} by pulling on a false book on the lowest rack of the bookshelf, which causes the adjoining section of wall to swing open (the door can be opened normally from the other side).
zh_tw: 一個生物可以透過拉動書架最低層的假書來開啟通往{@area 區域B26|51f|x}的秘密門，這會使相鄰的牆壁部分旋轉開啟（門也可以從另一側正常開啟）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the arcanaloth's library is a volume entitled The Blood War, which describes the unending conflict between devils of the Nine Hells and the demons of the Abyss. The tome is worth 500 gp to a collector. Scribbled in the margin of one page is the sequence for a teleportation circle that leads to Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 在奧法羅斯魔的圖書館中，有一本名為《血戰》的卷冊，它描述了九層地獄的魔鬼和無底深淵的惡魔之間無休止的衝突。這本書對收藏家來說價值500金幣。在其中一頁的邊緣潦草地寫著一個傳送圈的序列，它通向阿弗納斯，即九層地獄的第一層。

english: B25: Audience Chamber
zh_tw: B25. 接見室

english: Pillars of writhing flame wrought in stone hold up the vaulted ceiling of this great hall. In the center, a magnificent, gilded throne gleams like the sun itself, reflecting the light of the roaring braziers at its foot.
zh_tw: 這個宏偉大廳的拱形天花板由石制的扭曲火焰柱支撐。在中心，一個華麗、鍍金的寶座閃耀著光芒，就像太陽本身一樣，反射著它腳下熊熊燃燒的火盆的光線。

english: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} the Efreeti
zh_tw: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 伊夫利特

english: If he hasn't been encountered and defeated elsewhere, the {@creature efreeti} {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} sits on the throne, acting as master of Brimstone Hold in Vrakir's absence. {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} has little patience for the business of running a stronghold and leaves most of the decision-making to Nebukath. The stronghold's denizens see {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} for the petty tyrant he is, but they obey him out of fear of his patron, Vrakir.
zh_tw: 如果他還沒有在其他地方被遇到並擊敗，那麼{@creature efreeti||火巨靈} {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 就坐在寶座上，在弗拉基爾缺席時充當硫磺堡的主人。{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 對於管理要塞的事務幾乎沒有耐心，並且將大部分決策權交給了內布卡斯。要塞的居民們看清了{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 這個小暴君的真面目，但他們出於對他主人弗拉基爾的恐懼而服從他。

english: If the characters come before {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} posing as visitors with legitimate business at the hold, the efreeti treats them with indifference. He enjoys lording his power over petitioners and denies any requests the characters make dismissively, relenting only if plied with substantial wealth or flattery—a very rare magic item, 10,000 gp worth of treasure, or a successful {@dc 25} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check suffices.
zh_tw: 如果角色們以持有合法事務的訪客身份出現在偽裝成 {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 的精靈面前，這位火巨靈會對他們表現冷淡。他喜歡凌駕於請願者之上，並輕蔑地拒絕角色們的任何請求，只有在被大量財富或奉承所打動時才會讓步——一件非常稀有的魔法物品、價值10,000 gp的財寶，或一個成功的 {@dc 25} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定即可滿足其要求。

english: If the characters insult {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} or reveal their true purpose, the efreeti becomes hostile and shouts for the salamanders in {@area area B22|512|x} to apprehend the characters and imprison them in {@area area B13|4fd|x}. If the party resists, {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} fights desperately, fearing Vrakir's wrath if the characters were to escape.
zh_tw: 如果角色們侮辱{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}或透露他們真正的目的，這個火巨靈會變得敵對，並大聲呼喊{@area 區域B22|512|x}中的火蜥蜴抓住角色們並將他們監禁在{@area 區域B13|4fd|x}。如果隊伍抵抗，{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊}會拼命戰鬥，擔心如果角色們逃脫，弗拉基爾會大發雷霆。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door hidden in the north wall leads to area B26.
zh_tw: 一個隱藏在北牆的秘密門通向區域 B26。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} wears a gold chain of office studded with fire opals (5,000 gp) and eight gold rings set with precious stones (250 gp each). He also carries the key to {@area area B28|526|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 佩戴著一條鑲有火蛋白石的金質官鏈（5000金幣）和八個鑲有寶石的金戒指（每個250金幣）。他還攜帶著通往{@area 區域B28|526|x}的鑰匙。

english: B26: Lounge
zh_tw: B26. 休息室

english: The walls of this chamber are draped with silk, and its floor is festooned with cushions. A fountain in the room's center burbles with ruby-red liquid, while an ornately wrought brazier stands in the corner.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上掛著絲綢，地板上擺滿了墊子。房間中心的噴泉裡冒著紅寶石色的液體，而角落裡則放著一個裝飾華麗的火盆。

english: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} entertains favored guests here. The ruby liquid is firewine imported from the City of Brass. Any creature that drinks the wine gains 15 temporary hit points. The creature must finish a long rest before it can gain this benefit again.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 在這裡招待他青睞的客人。紅寶石色的液體是從黃銅之城進口的火焰酒。任何飲用這種酒的生物都會獲得15點臨時生命值。該生物必須完成一次長休，才能再次獲得這個好處。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the west wall leads to {@area area B24|517|x}, and a secret door in one corner of the south wall leads to area B25.
zh_tw: 西牆上有一個秘密門，通向 {@area 區域B24|517|x}，而南牆的一個角落中也有一個秘密門，通向區域 B25。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The brazier is a {@item brazier of commanding fire elementals}. Its command word, ilkath keri (Ignan for "blaze brightly"), is inscribed along the brazier's inside rim.
zh_tw: 這個火盆是一個{@item brazier of commanding fire elementals||命令火元素火盆}。它的口令，ilkath keri（火族語中的"明亮地燃燒"），刻在火盆的內緣上。

english: B27: Vestibule
zh_tw: B27. 門廳

english: Woven carpets line this corridor, which has doors leading in all four directions. Two large statues of efreet warriors stand sentinel here, one at either end of the corridor.
zh_tw: 這個走廊鋪著編織地毯，四面都有門。兩個大型的伊夫利特戰士雕像在這裡守衛，走廊的兩端各有一個。

english: The doors to areas B28 and B29 are both locked. {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} carries the key to area B28, while Vrakir carries the key to {@area area B29|529|x}. As an action, a character can use thieves' tools to try to pick either lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: B28 和 B29 區域的門都是鎖著的。{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 攜帶著 B28 區域的鑰匙，而弗拉基爾攜帶著 {@area 區域B29|529|x} 的鑰匙。作為一個動作，角色可以使用盜賊工具嘗試撬開任一鎖，成功完成 {@dc 20} 的敏捷檢定即可撬開。

english: Statues
zh_tw: 雕像

english: The statues are two {@creature Stone Golem||stone golems} that are normally quiescent and don't react to the characters' presence. However, the golems are magically attuned to the door to area B29 and become hostile if a creature attempts to open the door by any means other than using Vrakir's key. A character who succeeds on their ability check to pick the lock by 10 or more avoids triggering the golems. Entering area B29 by using magic (such as the {@spell passwall} spell) to bypass the door entirely doesn't trigger the golems.
zh_tw: 這些雕像是兩個{@creature Stone Golem||石魔像}，它們通常處於靜止狀態，不會對角色們的存在做出反應。然而，這些魔像被魔法調諧到通往B29區域的門，如果有任何生物試圖以非弗拉基爾的鑰匙的方式開門，它們就會變得敵對。如果角色嘗試撬鎖的屬性檢定結果比 DC 高出10或更多，就可以避免觸發魔像。透過使用魔法（例如{@spell passwall||穿牆術}法術）完全繞過門進入B29區域，不會觸發魔像。

english: B28: Jarazoun's Chamber
zh_tw: B28. 賈拉尊的房間

english: A large bed with brass posts and silk curtains dominates this chamber. In the corner, a lyre engraved with elaborate figures leans on the wall next to a cushioned stool.
zh_tw: 這個房間的中心位置是一張帶有銅柱和絲綢簾子的大床。在角落裡，一把雕刻著精美圖案的豎琴靠在牆上，旁邊是一個有墊子的凳子。

english: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} is usually here when he isn't conducting business in {@area area B25|51b|x} or entertaining visitors in {@area area B26|51f|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 通常在不處理{@area 區域B25|51b|x}的事務或在{@area 區域B26|51f|x}招待訪客時會在這裡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The lyre is an {@item Instrument of the Bards, Cli Lyre||instrument of the bards (Cli lyre)} decorated with carvings of phoenixes. {@creature Jarazoun|KftGV} fancies himself a musician but is unable to attune to the instrument.
zh_tw: 這把豎琴是一把雕刻有鳳凰圖案的{@item Instrument of the Bards, Cli Lyre||詩人的樂器（豎琴）}。{@creature Jarazoun|KftGV|賈拉尊} 自認為是音樂家，但卻無法與這把樂器調諧。

english: B29: Vrakir's Chamber
zh_tw: B29. 弗拉基爾的房間

english: The luxurious appointments of this palatial bedchamber are at odds with its back wall. There, scorch marks and cracked masonry radiate from a grotesque face carved into the stone, its forehead set with a blood-red gem. Sitting on a desk off to one side is a black tome, its cover emblazoned with fell iconography.
zh_tw: 這個豪華的宮殿式臥室與其後牆的裝飾格格不入。那裡，焦痕和破裂的石工從一塊刻在石頭上的怪誕面孔中輻射出來，它的額頭上鑲嵌著一塊血紅色的寶石。在一邊的桌子上放著一本黑色的書，封面上印有邪惡的圖示。

english: The tome resembles the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} but is actually a trained {@creature mimic}. Any character who examines the tome and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognizes it as a fraud. The mimic attacks any creature that touches or attacks it.
zh_tw: 這本典籍類似於{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}，但實際上是一隻訓練有素的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。任何檢查這本典籍併成功透過{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的人物都會認出它是一個贗品。擬怪會攻擊任何觸碰或攻擊它的生物。

english: The room's back wall appears solid but is the anchor for a magical doorway to area B30: the demiplane where Vrakir keeps the real {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}. Anyone examining the wall using {@spell detect magic} can see the outline of the door. The scorch marks and cracked masonry are due to the book's corrupting influence, which seeps out every time the doorway is opened.
zh_tw: 這個房間的後牆看起來是實心的，但實際上是通往區域 B30 的魔法門錨點：弗拉基爾保管真正的 {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書} 的半位面。任何使用 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 檢查牆壁的人都能看見門的輪廓。焦痕和破裂的石工是由於這本書的腐蝕性影響，每次門被開啟時都會滲透出來。

english: The key to opening the door is the gemstone set in the wall carving. The gem is trapped with a 6th-level {@spell glyph of warding} spell. The glyph casts {@spell disintegrate} on any creature that touches the gem without speaking Vrakir's motto: atka ignari. While touching the gem, a creature can take an action to open the door to area B30 as if the creature had cast the {@spell demiplane} spell; this causes the face in the wall to stretch its mouth wide as a shimmering gray portal appears within. Removing the gem from the wall causes the doorway to disappear, trapping anything in area B30 in the demiplane until the gem is replaced or someone else accesses the room with a {@spell demiplane} spell.
zh_tw: 開啟門的鑰匙是鑲嵌在牆雕中的寶石。這塊寶石設有一道6環{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術作為陷阱。任何碰觸寶石而不說弗拉基爾的座右銘：atka ignari 的生物都會被{@spell disintegrate||解離術}法術擊中。在碰觸寶石的同時，生物可以採取動作開啟通往區域 B30 的門，就好像生物施放了{@spell demiplane||半位面}法術一樣；這會導致牆上的面孔張開它的嘴，露出一個閃爍的灰色傳送門。從牆上取下寶石會導致門消失，將區域 B30 中的任何東西困在半位面裡，直到寶石被重新放置或有人透過{@spell demiplane||半位面}法術訪問房間。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If removed from the wall, the gem continues to radiate magic but doesn't otherwise function. It is worth 5,000 gp.
zh_tw: 如果從牆上取下，這顆寶石會繼續散發魔法光芒，但除此之外不會發揮其他作用。它的價值是5000金幣。

english: B30: Vrakir's Demiplane
zh_tw: B30. 弗拉基爾的半位面

english: On the floor of this otherwise empty room rests an open book, its ancient pages rustling ominously despite the lack of breeze. The flagstones around it are charred and cracked, and the room's walls are veined with narrow fissures that disappear into darkness.
zh_tw: 在這個除此之外空無一物的房間地板上，放著一本開啟的書，儘管沒有微風，它古老的書頁卻不祥地沙沙作響。它周圍的石板被燒焦並裂開，房間的牆壁上佈滿了延伸進黑暗中的狹窄裂縫。

english: The Book of Vile Darkness
zh_tw: 穢暗之書

english: If the characters had a relatively easy time getting here, add two {@condition invisible} {@creature Nycaloth||nycaloths} as guards. The nycaloths are mercenaries hired by Vrakir to protect the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}, and their {@spell invisibility} spells end when they attack.
zh_tw: 如果角色們到達這裡的過程相對容易，增加兩個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Nycaloth||征伐羅斯魔}作為守衛。這些征伐羅斯魔是弗拉基爾僱傭的傭兵，用來保護{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}，當它們攻擊時，它們的{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術會結束。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The {@item Book of Vile Darkness} is so blasphemous that its mere presence erodes the demiplane Vrakir made to contain it. Review the {@item book of vile darkness||artifact's description} in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, then replace its Random Properties with the following preset ones:
zh_tw: {@item Book of Vile Darkness||穢暗之書}是如此褻瀆神明的存在，以至於僅僅其存在就會腐蝕弗拉基爾為封存它而創造的半位面。請在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中查閱{@item book of vile darkness||神器的描述}，然後以以下預設屬性取代其「隨機屬性」：

english: Circle of Death
zh_tw: 死亡法陣

english: While attuned to the book, you can cast {@spell circle of death} (save {@dc 20}) from it as an action. After you cast the spell, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1–5, you can't use this property again until the next dawn.
zh_tw: 當你與該書共鳴時，你可以使用一個動作從中施放 {@spell circle of death||死亡法陣}（豁免 {@dc 20}）。施放該法術後，擲一枚 {@dice d6}。如果擲出1到5，你在下一個黎明前無法再次使用該特性。

english: Condition Immunities
zh_tw: 狀態免疫

english: While attuned to the book, you can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
zh_tw: 在與這本書共鳴時，你不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}或{@condition frightened||恐懼}。

english: Evil Presence
zh_tw: 邪惡威儀

english: The book houses an evil spirit that is hostile toward you. When you become attuned to the book, the spirit tries to leave the book and enter your body. If you fail a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw, it succeeds, and you become an NPC under the DM's control until the intruding spirit is banished using magic such as the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. The banished spirit returns to the book.
zh_tw: 這本書中寄居著一個對你有敵意的邪惡靈魂。當你與這本書建立調諧時，靈魂會試圖離開書本並進入你的身體。如果你在{@dc 20}魅力豁免檢定中失敗，它就會成功，你將成為由DM控制的NPC，直到使用諸如{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}這類魔法將入侵的靈魂驅逐。被驅逐的靈魂會回到書中。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: After the characters escape Brimstone Hold, they might find themselves pursued by Nebukath, Vrakir, or both. The former is focused solely on obtaining the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness}, while the latter seeks vengeance against the characters regardless of what happens to the artifact. Meanwhile, the book has its own designs, and it might subvert the aims of the party's patron or find its way back into the party's possession if it senses a character is ripe for corruption.
zh_tw: 在角色們逃離硫磺堡之後，他們可能會發現自己被內布卡斯、弗拉基爾或兩者追趕。前者只專注於獲取{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}，而後者則無論神器發生什麼，都尋求對角色們的復仇。與此同時，這本書有自己的計劃，如果它感覺到角色適合腐敗，它可能會破壞隊伍贊助人的目標，或者找到回到隊伍手中的方法。

english: For the Golden Vault
zh_tw: 對於金庫

english: If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, they must deliver the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} to their contact. Once they do, the organization rewards the characters with a very rare magic item of their choice (subject to your approval) as payment. The item is delivered to the characters the next day.
zh_tw: 如果角色們為金庫工作，他們必須將{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}交給他們的聯絡人。一旦他們這麼做了，組織會以他們選擇的非常罕見的魔法物品（須經你批准）作為報酬獎勵角色們。物品將在第二天送達角色們。

english: Further Adventures
zh_tw: 更多冒險

english: Recovering the {@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|Book of Vile Darkness} could be the first in a series of adventures revolving around the party's efforts to contain or destroy the artifact—efforts that might involve courting the aid of powerful celestials, unearthing ancient spells of binding, or undergoing trials of purification.
zh_tw: 恢復{@item Book of Vile Darkness (Variant)|KftGV|穢暗之書}可能是一系列冒險的開始，這些冒險圍繞著隊伍努力控制或摧毀這個神器——這些努力可能涉及尋求強大的天界生物的幫助，挖掘古老的束縛法術，或經歷淨化的試煉。

english: Meanwhile, even without the book, Vrakir and his armies remain a threat. The characters might have to fend off a reprisal by the efreeti's forces before traveling to the Elemental Plane of Fire to deal with Vrakir himself.
zh_tw: 與此同時，即使沒有這本書，弗拉基爾和他的軍隊仍然是一個威脅。角色們可能需要抵禦伊夫利特勢力的報復，然後才能前往火元素位面去對付弗拉基爾本人。
